topics.descZh: 针杆成环、旋梭钩线、挑线收紧——一针如何成形
topics.descEn: Needle loop, rotary hook, thread take-up — how a single stitch forms

topics.descZh: 轴颈滑动 μ≈0.1 的税被几颗滚珠换成 μr≈0.002 的滚动——摩擦骤降两个数量级;纯滚动的运动学:内圈转、球心只走一半、外圈静止,接触点零滑差;L10=(C/P)³,载荷翻倍寿命只剩 1/8,过载当场压出凹痕。
topics.descEn: Sliding friction μ≈0.1 is taxed away by a handful of balls rolling at μr≈0.002 — two orders of magnitude cheaper; pure rolling means the inner race turns, ball centers go half speed, the outer race rests — zero slip at contact; L10=(C/P)³ — double the load, one eighth the life, and overload brinells the raceway on the spot.

topics.descZh: 省力不省功是唯一的账本:F₁·L₁=F₂·L₂,省几倍力就费几倍行程;三类杠杆由支点位置定命运,定滑轮改向、动滑轮省半力、滑轮组 n 段绳分摊 W/n;把支点拖到 9:1,一颗小砝码撬起九颗大砝码——阿基米德的支点。
topics.descEn: Force is bought with distance: F₁·L₁=F₂·L₂ — save n times the force, pay n times the travel; the fulcrum position seals a lever's fate, a fixed pulley turns the pull, a movable one halves it, and an n-rope block shares W/n; slide the fulcrum to 9:1 and one small weight lifts nine — Archimedes's place to stand.

topics.descZh: 弹簧撑住车重、存下冲击,但只管存不管散——减振器活塞推油过孔把动能变热;阻尼比 ζ=c/2√(km) 一票定江山:0 弹跳不停、0.35 一次半稳住、>1 又硬又颠;无阻尼过减速带,车身上下弹 5 次、轮胎离地红闪。
topics.descEn: The spring carries the weight and banks the bump but never spends it — the damper's piston pumps oil through orifices, turning motion into heat; the damping ratio ζ=c/2√(km) decides everything: 0 bounces forever, 0.35 settles in a cycle and a half, >1 is harsh; undamped over a speed bump the body bounces five times and the tire leaves the road.

topics.titleZh: 四冲程内燃机配气相位
topics.descZh: 气门早开晚闭与 720° 双圈相位图
topics.descEn: Early-open / late-close valves on a 720° two-revolution phase diagram

topics.descZh: 推程带动、回程滑过、陡面锁死
topics.descEn: Drive on the push stroke, slide on the return, lock on the steep face

topics.descZh: 轮廓就是位移曲线的「卷起来」，简谐/摆线/等速
topics.descEn: The profile is the displacement curve rolled up — harmonic / cycloidal / uniform

topics.descZh: 转弯时行星轮如何吸收左右轮速差，n左 + n右 = 2n壳
topics.descEn: How planet gears absorb the wheel-speed difference in a turn: nL + nR = 2nC

topics.descZh: 连续旋转变精确间歇：切向入槽 + 锁定弧 + 转位曲线
topics.descEn: Continuous rotation into precise indexing: tangential entry, locking arc, motion curve

topics.descZh: 传动比恒定的秘密藏在几何里:拉直的细线从基圆展开扫出的渐开线做齿廓,啮合点沿两基圆的公切线滑行,压力角 20° 不变——瞬时速比恒定;中心距装错 ±2% 也只改啮合角、不改速比;对照组的圆弧齿一转之内就快慢打架、直接卡死。
topics.descEn: A taut string unwrapped from the base circle sweeps the involute flank; contact glides along the common tangent at a steady 20° pressure angle — the instantaneous ratio never wavers, and ±2% of center-distance error only shifts the angle, not the ratio; round-profile teeth fall out of step within one turn and jam.

topics.descZh: 最简单的液压心脏:两个齿轮在微过盈壳体里啮合,每个齿间空腔是一格「斗」,把油从吸入口背到压出口,啮合点既是密封脊又是卸料口;流量 = 排量×转速,这台每转 16 mL,但没卸荷槽的泵每咬合一次,出口压力就脉动一次。
topics.descEn: The simplest hydraulic heart: two gears meshing in a snug housing carry oil tooth-space by tooth-space from suction to pressure, the meshing point doubling as seal and unloading port; flow = displacement × rpm — 16 mL per rev here — and each engagement pulses the outlet unless relief grooves smooth it.

topics.descZh: 动量守恒和动能守恒同时出手,两球碰撞只剩两个解——全部停止,或速度完全互换,所以拉 1 球只有对端 1 球飞出;「两球各半速」动量对、动能亏一截,当场被否决;慢镜头里冲击以压缩波的形式一球一球穿过去。
topics.descEn: Momentum and energy conservation together leave only two solutions for two equal balls: stop both, or swap velocities exactly — so one ball in, one ball out; 'both at half speed' balances momentum but loses kinetic energy, rejected on the spot; in slow motion the impact crosses the row as a compression wave.

topics.descZh: 电机曲柄转一圈,中心连杆推着双摇臂走平行四边形,两根刮片同相位扫过 43° 弧、几乎无死角;间歇档靠 RC 电路:电容充到阈值触发继电器扫一次、复位开关放空重来,R·C·ln(V/(V−Vth)) 就是停顿的秒数。
topics.descEn: One crank turn drives a center link and a parallel rocker pair, sweeping both blades across a 43° arc in phase; the intermittent timer is just RC: the capacitor charges to threshold, the relay fires one wipe, the park switch drains it — R·C·ln(V/(V−Vth)) sets the pause.

topics.descZh: 固定齿圈 5:1 减速,固定行星架变倒挡,全锁直连——一套齿轮就是一只变速箱
topics.descEn: Fix the ring for 5:1, fix the carrier for reverse, lock all for direct — one gear set is a gearbox

topics.descZh: 升角小于摩擦角,反向推纹丝不动——电梯和千斤顶的命根子;拉大升角看自锁失效
topics.descEn: Lead angle below friction angle: nothing back-drives it — the reason elevators trust worms

topics.descZh: 单节让轴拐弯但速度波动,双节 Z 字同相位互相抵消——后驱车传动轴的日常
topics.descEn: One joint bends the shaft but pulses; a Z-phased second cures it — life under a rear-drive car

topics.descZh: Grashof 条件卡死演示 + 急回比 K + 连杆点画出六次方曲线
topics.descEn: Grashof jam demo, quick-return ratio K, and the coupler point curve

topics.descZh: 半联动:摩擦片带滑差温柔起步;换挡先分离再同步;升扭必降转
topics.descEn: Half-clutch slips torque in gently; shifting = disengage, sync, engage; more torque, fewer rpm

topics.descZh: 擒纵叉放一格、踢一腿,摆轮等时谐振——发条的力被切成 tick-tock
topics.descEn: The fork releases one tooth and kicks the balance — spring power sliced into tick-tock

topics.descZh: 总距管升降,周期变距管方向:每片桨转到哪儿就在哪儿变迎角
topics.descEn: Collective for climb, cyclic for direction: every blade pitches only where it is

topics.descZh: 飞锤读转速、套筒拉节气阀——负荷突变看反馈三角追逐到新平衡
topics.descEn: Fly-balls read speed, the sleeve drives the valve — watch the feedback triangle chase balance

topics.descZh: 外燃加热、回热器把热寄存而非扔弃——效率逼近卡诺同温限,什么热源都能烧
topics.descEn: External combustion with a regenerator that banks heat instead of dumping it — Carnot-class efficiency from any heat source

topics.descZh: 三角转子三条弧边=三个气缸,错开一转三次点火;无气门平顺高转,角片密封是软肋
topics.descEn: A three-flank rotor forms three chambers firing in parallel — three sparks per turn; valveless and smooth, apex seals are the weak spot

topics.descZh: 废气吹涡轮上 10 万转,同轴压气机把更多空气压进缸;迟滞可被地板油现场测出
topics.descEn: Exhaust spins a turbine past 100k rpm, the shared shaft packs more air in; floor it and measure the lag live

topics.descZh: 对的钥匙把五条弹子缝对齐到剪切线,错的一根卡死全线——单钩开锁逐根设线
topics.descEn: The right key lands five pin gaps on the shear line; a wrong key jams one — picking sets them one by one

topics.descZh: 钢球在螺母滚道里列队循环,把滑动摩擦换成滚动——90% 效率、1 N·m 顶几百牛;反向一推就倒转,立式必配抱闸
topics.descEn: Steel balls recirculate through the nut, swapping sliding for rolling friction — 90% efficiency; push back and it back-drives, so vertical axes need brakes

topics.descZh: 手指拉几毫米变速线,平行四边形把链条顶上不同飞轮片——齿比换命:爬坡省力、巡航飞快;张紧轮吃掉长度差
topics.descEn: A few mm of cable, a parallelogram, and the chain hops cogs — trading force for speed; the tension pulley swallows the slack

topics.descZh: 刹车把 1 吨车的动能搬进 8 kg 小飞轮,E=½Iω² 转到 5 万转;σ=ρv² 是材料红线——钢到顶,碳纤维才放得下
topics.descEn: Braking banks a 1-tonne car's KE into an 8 kg wheel at 50k rpm; hoop stress σ=ρv² is the red line — steel tops out, carbon holds

topics.descZh: 两个锥轮一对推式钢带,液压推移锥盘让传动比沿锥面连续滑动,发动机钉在功率峰值转速而车速无级爬升——一次「换挡」都不发生
topics.descEn: Two cone pulleys and one push-belt: hydraulics slide the sheaves so the ratio glides continuously, letting the engine sit pinned at its power peak while road speed climbs — not a single shift

topics.descZh: 没有火花塞也没有节流阀:绝热压缩把空气烧到约 570 °C,油雾喷进来自燃,沿 P–V「方肩」定压燃烧;拖低压缩比它就拒绝点火——压燃的命门就是压缩比
topics.descEn: No spark plug and no throttle: adiabatic compression heats air to ~570 °C so injected fuel self-ignites along the P–V square shoulder — drag the compression ratio down and the engine refuses to fire

topics.descZh: 转弯时内侧轮要的角比外侧大——四根轮轴延长线共点于后轴延长线上的瞬时中心,一条 1817 年的几何铁律;转向梯形用四杆自动给出这两个角,平行转向又滚又蹭,反阿克曼是赛车的偏爱
topics.descEn: The inner wheel always steers tighter: all four axle lines meet at one instant center on the rear-axle extension — geometry, not preference; the steering trapezoid synthesizes both angles, parallel steering scrubs, anti-Ackermann is the racing choice

topics.descZh: 椭圆波发生器把薄杯柔轮撑成椭圆:长轴两端与固定刚轮全啮合、短轴脱开;发生器每转一圈,少 2 齿的柔轮被迫反向错开 2 齿=3.6°,i=200/2=100;约三成齿同时受载——零背隙、高扭矩密度,机器人关节的灵魂。
topics.descEn: An elliptical wave generator stretches the thin-cup flexspline: full mesh at the major axis, disengaged at the minor; each revolution the 2-tooth-shorter flex creeps 2 teeth = 3.6° backwards, i = 200/2 = 100 — zero backlash, huge torque density.

topics.descZh: 链条不是柔绳,是销轴串起的刚节:绕上链轮时铺成边长为节距的正多边形,有效半径在 r 与 r·cos(π/N) 间周期跳动——主动轮匀速,链速却每过一齿搏动一次;齿数越少颠簸越狠,磨损伸长更会让链节爬上齿尖、直至跳齿。
topics.descEn: A chain is rigid links pinned together, not a soft rope: on a sprocket it forms a regular polygon with one-pitch sides, so the effective radius jumps between r and r·cos(π/N) — even at constant crank speed the chain pulses once per tooth; fewer teeth, harsher surge, and wear stretches the pitch until teeth skip.

topics.descZh: 同轴刚连 R、r 两个链轮:手拉链绕大轮,重物链经动滑轮绕小轮回卷;拉一圈大轮收 2πR、小轮放 2πr,重物只升 π(R−r);F=W(R−r)/(2R),差 1 cm 省力 24 倍也慢 24 倍,功一点没省;棘轮+几何双自锁,松手绝不倒转。
topics.descEn: Two sprockets keyed on one axle: the hand chain loops over the big wheel, the load chain scoops a movable pulley and winds back over the small one; each turn takes in 2πR, pays out 2πr and lifts the load just π(R−r). F=W(R−r)/(2R) trades force for distance at 24:1 — and ratchet plus geometry make it self-locking.

topics.descZh: 太空里没有地面可蹬,想转身只能自己拧自己:飞轮正加速、星体反着转,I·ω 严格守恒;到点后轮稳速、星停转;轮速顶到上限就饱和漂移,磁力棒借地磁场把净动量「放电」给地球——哈勃 0.007″ 指向的秘密。
topics.descEn: Nothing to push against in space: spin the flywheel up and the bus turns the other way with angular momentum conserved to the last digit; saturate the wheel and the bus drifts — magnetorquers then dump the leftover momentum into Earth's field. The secret behind Hubble's 0.007″ pointing.

topics.descZh: 锅炉蓄压、滑阀换向、飞轮平峰,瓦特离心调速器把转速闭环——脱开它看飞轮红热,示功图面积=每圈净功。
topics.descEn: A charging boiler, slide-valve reversal, flywheel smoothing and Watt's governor closing the loop — detach it and the rim glows red; the indicator loop's area is work per turn.

topics.descZh: 对角两正两反,反扭矩互相抵消——不用尾桨;四转速混控矩阵管升降、俯仰、横滚与偏航;机身一前倾,推力矢量分出水平分量,把飞机"泼"向前方。
topics.descEn: Diagonal rotors counter-spin so reaction torques cancel — no tail rotor; a four-motor mix matrix steers climb, pitch, roll and yaw; tilt forward and the thrust vector's horizontal component shoves the craft ahead.

topics.descZh: 重心悬在支点上方,任何微扰都按 θ̈=(g/L)θ 指数放大——平衡在刀尖上;自平衡车的对策反直觉:往倒的方向先加速,让惯性把车身扶正;陀螺仪测倾角、控制器 200 Hz 出轮矩,推一把看它窜出、刹车、回正,关掉闭环当场倒地。
topics.descEn: With the center of mass above the pivot, any nudge grows exponentially as θ̈=(g/L)θ — balance is a knife edge; the self-balancing rover’s move is counterintuitive: accelerate toward the fall and let inertia right the body; a gyro senses tilt, the controller commands wheel torque at 200 Hz — shove it and it dashes, brakes, steadies; cut the loop and it drops.

topics.descZh: 无刷电机用 6 个 MOSFET 三相桥当电子换向器:按六步真值表(+A−B→+A−C→+B−C→+B−A→+C−A→+C−B)轮流通电,定子磁场每步跳进 60° 电角度,转子永磁体持续追赶;霍尔或反电动势过零定换相时机,PWM 调速;小型 BLDC KV 约 130–2300 rpm/V,效率 85–95%,2 对极每转换相 12 次。
topics.descEn: A BLDC motor replaces the brush/commutator with a six-MOSFET bridge: phases energized in the six-step truth table jump the stator field 60 electrical degrees per step so the rotor magnets keep chasing; Hall sensors or back-EMF zero crossings set the timing, PWM sets the speed — small BLDCs run KV 130–2300 rpm/V at 85–95% efficiency.

topics.descZh: 泵轮把 ATF 油甩向外缘、沿循环圆推动涡轮,怠速软连接蠕行不熄火;失速时导轮把回流重新导向,反作用扭矩叠加输出,变矩比达 2.1、效率 0% 全变热;e≈0.9 耦合点导轮单向离合器空转、K=1;锁止离合器吸合后滑差归零,效率≈99%。
topics.descEn: The pump flings ATF oil around the torus into the turbine — a soft link that idles and creeps without stalling; at stall the stator redirects the return flow and multiplies output 2.1x at 0% efficiency (all heat); at speed ratio 0.9 the one-way clutch frees the stator; the lockup clutch then removes slip for ~99% efficiency.

topics.descZh: 塔吊是竖起的力矩天平:4 t 吊在 25 m 产生 980 kN·m,恰被 10 m 力臂上的 10 t 配重对消;额定力矩 1000 kN·m 使允许吊重沿双曲线衰减——56 m 臂端 1.8 t,近端封顶 8 t;超载先坏的是受压弦杆 Euler 失稳,不是安全系数 5–6 的钢丝绳。
topics.descEn: A tower crane is a moment balance stood on end: 4 t at 25 m makes 980 kN·m, cancelled by 10 t of ballast on a 10 m arm; the rated 1000 kN·m bends the load chart into a hyperbola — 1.8 t at the 56 m tip, 8 t near the mast. Overload fails by Euler buckling of the chords, not the rope (safety factor 5–6).

topics.descZh: 货车压弯桥面,吊索张力被拉亮,主缆以 H=wL²/8f≈370 MN 把力送向两岸:塔顶折成约 420 MN 竖向压力压入基础墩,锚碇用 6 万吨混凝土顶住每缆 185 MN 水平拉;金门主跨 1280 m、主缆 Ø0.92 m·27572 丝、安全系数约 4。
topics.descEn: A truck sags the deck and lights up the hangers: the cable carries the load home with H=wL²/8f≈370 MN, towers fold it into ~420 MN of compression into the piers, and 60,000-t anchorages hold 185 MN of pull per cable. Golden Gate: 1,280 m span, 0.92 m cables of 27,572 wires, safety factor ≈4.

topics.descZh: 螺旋就是绕在圆柱上的斜面:每转一圈,手柄末端走 2πL、重物只升一个导程 p——5 t 载荷只需约 356 N 手柄力;梯形螺纹摩擦角 ρ′=6.8° 大于升角 λ=5.5° 时自锁,松手重物纹丝不动;代价是效率只有 20–44%,滚珠丝杠用滚动抬到 90%+ 却会倒转。
topics.descEn: A screw is an incline curled around a cylinder: one turn moves the hand 2πL while the load climbs one lead p — 5 t lifts with ~356 N of hand force; when the thread friction angle ρ′=6.8° exceeds the lead angle λ=5.5° it self-locks — let go and nothing back-drives; the price is 20–44% efficiency, which ball screws raise past 90% at the cost of self-locking.

topics.descZh: 节圆在节线上纯滚：每转一圈推进 2πr；渐开线齿面接触点沿压力线滑行，压力角恒 20°；两端拉杆推动轮胎转向——汽车方向机的核心传力路径。
topics.descEn: Pitch circle rolls on pitch line — one revolution advances 2πr; involute contact glides along the pressure line at constant 20°; rack ends push the wheel knuckles — the steering rack's force path.

topics.descZh: 两杆折叠成角 θ，小横向力经几何放大成大纵向力：F_out/F_in=1/(2sinθ)；θ→0° 时理论无穷大，过死点后自锁——冲床与快速夹具的力量秘密。
topics.descEn: Two links at angle θ turn a small side force into a large clamping force: 1/(2sinθ) gain; as θ→0° the gain approaches infinity; past dead center the mechanism self-locks — the secret of presses and quick clamps.

topics.descZh: 虎克铰每转两次快慢，Rzeppa 球笼把六颗钢球强制留在角平分面——任何铰链角下输出转速精确等于输入，前驱车半轴以此在转向时平顺传扭。
topics.descEn: A Hooke joint oscillates twice per revolution; the Rzeppa cage forces six balls into the bisecting plane — output speed exactly equals input at any angle, letting a FWD driveshaft transmit torque smoothly while steering.

topics.descZh: 斜拉索不走抛物线——每根索都是直线张拉的弹性支点,直接把梁的重量拉上塔;塔吃压力(竖直分量沿塔叠到塔底 ~800 MN),梁吃轴压(水平分量往塔挤),主梁因此可以做薄;不用锚碇,山地软土都能建——苏通大桥 1088 m 主跨、306 m 塔、最长索 580 m。
topics.descEn: Stays never sag into parabolas — each is a straight, tensioned elastic support carrying deck load straight up the pylon; the tower takes compression (vertical components stack to ~800 MN at its base), the girder takes axial squeeze, so the deck stays thin; no anchorages — Sutong spans 1088 m with a 306 m tower and a 580 m longest stay.

topics.descZh: 带轮靠摩擦传扭矩，欧拉公式 T1/T2=e^(μθ)——包角 θ 是指数级的本钱，张紧轮既增包角又提预紧；带是弹性体，紧边伸长多、松边短，~1% 弹性滑动不可避免（链传动靠啮合就没有）；负载越过打滑阈值的瞬间，带从「整体跟着走」变成「轮转带不转」，烧带保护机器。
topics.descEn: Pulleys carry torque by friction: Euler's T1/T2=e^(μθ) makes wrap angle exponential capital, and the tensioner buys both wrap and preload. The belt is elastic — the tight side stretches and runs faster, so ~1% creep is inherent (chains, meshing by teeth, have none). Past the slip threshold the belt goes from "moving as one" to "pulley spinning inside a stalled belt" — the belt burns so the machine survives.

topics.descZh: 拧紧扭矩只有约 10% 变成预紧力，其余消耗在螺纹与支承面摩擦；真正扛横向载荷的是被夹紧面间的摩擦，螺栓本身只受拉；Junker 振动让螺纹面反复滑移，预紧力一格格泄掉、螺母肉眼可见倒转直至松脱；对顶螺母、尼龙圈、楔形垫圈各用不同原理锁住这条泄漏路径。
topics.descEn: Only ~10% of tightening torque becomes clamp load — the rest burns in thread and bearing-surface friction; transverse loads are carried by friction between clamped parts while the bolt stretches in pure tension. Junker vibration walks the thread faces back and forth, bleeding preload away step by step until the nut visibly backs off; jam nuts, nylon rings and wedge washers each lock a different link in that leak path.

topics.descZh: 钟表齿轮不用渐开线：一个滚圆沿节圆外侧滚出外摆线作齿顶、沿内侧滚出内摆线作齿根，两轮共用同一滚圆即共轭，接触点沿描述圆弧滑移；凸-凹接触当量曲率半径大、接触应力小，敢用 6–7 齿小轮；代价是中心距敏感，拖歪半毫米就卡死，而渐开线靠可分性照转。
topics.descEn: Clock gears skip the involute: a rolling circle traces the epicycloid tip flank outside the pitch circle and the hypocycloid root flank inside; sharing one roller makes the pair conjugate, with contact sliding along describing-circle arcs. Convex-on-concave contact keeps stress low enough for 6-7 tooth pinions — but center distance is critical: shift it half a millimeter and the mesh jams while an involute pair keeps turning.

topics.descZh: 内外两个转子各镶一圈永磁体，隔着一层密封壁互相「隔空咬合」：主动转子转动时磁场像看不见的齿轮拖动从动转子；转差角 δ 拉大磁力线扭斜，扭矩 τ=τmax·sin(pδ)；负载超过 τmax 的瞬间脱耦打滑、磁体一格格跳，是天然的过载保护；泵轴不穿壁→零泄漏，气隙翻倍扭矩掉到 1/8。
topics.descEn: Two permanent-magnet rings bite through a sealed wall like an invisible gear set: the field drags the driven rotor in sync, lag angle δ skews the field lines, and torque follows τ=τmax·sin(pδ). Past τmax the coupling decouples and the magnets skip pole by pole — a natural overload fuse. The pump shaft never pierces the wall: zero leakage; double the gap and peak torque drops to 1/8.

topics.descZh: 曲柄销插在滑块的纵向滑槽里旋转，销的横坐标直接成为滑块位移，x=r·cosθ 不经过连杆、不含任何高次谐波，是简谐运动的机械实现；曲柄滑块机构只有连杆无限长才近似正弦；页面让两台机器同速转动，位移曲线实时叠在一个示波器上对照二次谐波偏差。
topics.descEn: The crank pin rides in a vertical slot, so the yoke's displacement is exactly x=r·cosθ — pure harmonic motion with no link and no higher harmonics; a slider-crank only approaches a sine as the rod nears infinite length. Two machines spin side by side while both displacement traces overlay live on one oscilloscope.

topics.descZh: 六根液压/电动腿上下两端球铰，上平台的任意位姿（3 平移+3 旋转）由 6 个腿长唯一确定：反解是显式公式 L=|Rp+T−b|，并联结构载荷分摊、刚度大、误差不累积；串联机械臂每一级关节的间隙都叠加到末端；飞行模拟器、望远镜副镜、并联机床都靠这六根腿。
topics.descEn: Six legs with ball joints at both ends: any pose of the top platform (3 translations + 3 rotations) is fixed uniquely by 6 leg lengths — inverse kinematics is the explicit formula L=|Rp+T−b|. Loads split across six cylinders, stiffness is high, errors never stack the way they do down a serial arm's joint chain. Flight simulators, telescope secondaries and parallel machine tools all ride on these six legs.

topics.descZh: 密封氮气被压缩，F=p·A 随行程按 pV≈常数放大，撑得住开门却拦不住在闭合位最大的重力矩；自由段只有弹性、门越落越快，末端 15° 油液挤孔产生∝速度的阻尼——同一扇门，无阻尼砰地撞底弹两下，阻尼铰链优雅缓降，两条角度-时间曲线叠在一个示波器上。
topics.descEn: Compressed nitrogen multiplies F=p·A along the stroke (pV≈const), holding the door open but powerless against gravity that peaks near closed; the free stroke is pure elasticity, then the last 15° squeezes oil through an orifice for velocity-proportional damping — the undamped door slams and bounces twice while the damped hinge lands softly, both curves overlaid on one scope.

topics.descZh: 主动轮只有一段有齿、其余是光滑锁止弧：有齿段拨从动轮转过 n₁ 个齿角，随后锁止弧滑进从动轮凹弧把它几何锁死，ω 曲线被切成带冲击尖峰的方波；转停比由有齿段角度自由设计；电影放映机取片机构正是它。
topics.descEn: Only one arc of the driver carries teeth; the rest is a smooth locking rim that slips into recesses of the driven wheel and dead-locks it, slicing rotation into a square wave of motion and dwell with impact spikes at each engagement; the go/stop ratio is freely designable — the movie-projector pull-down is exactly this.

topics.descZh: 丰田 THS 用一套行星轮把发动机、MG1、MG2 三个转速锁在杠杆定律 Zsωs+Zrωr=(Zs+Zr)ωc 上：发动机转速因此无级自选；功率分机械直驱与电路径两道，电池只在差值上收支；无离合器无钢带，MG1 反转过零即发动机点火点。
topics.descEn: One planetary set locks engine, MG1 and MG2 speeds onto a single lever (Zs·ωs+Zr·ωr=(Zs+Zr)·ωc), so engine speed is freely chosen; power splits into a direct mechanical path and an electric path while the battery only balances the difference — no clutches, no belt, and MG1 crossing zero rpm marks the engine-start point.

topics.descZh: 轴颈在轴瓦里并不居中：旋转把润滑油卷进收敛楔，油膜压力把轴托起（流体动压润滑，S=μN/P·(r/c)²）；全油膜时 h_min 只剩几十微米却零固体接触，f 低到 0.001–0.01；停车或断油即回到边界润滑→金属接触→烧瓦，高速轻载还会激发 0.47ω 的油膜涡动。
topics.descEn: The journal never centers in its bore: rotation drags oil into a converging wedge whose pressure lifts the shaft (hydrodynamic lubrication, S=μN/P·(r/c)²); at full film h_min is tens of microns yet contact-free with f as low as 0.001–0.01. Starve it or stop and boundary lubrication seizes; light load at speed excites half-frequency oil whirl.

topics.descZh: 四根杆两两平行构成可活动的平行四边形，固定枢轴落在短杆延长线上，使枢轴、画笔、描迹针三点恒共线；由相似三角形，OF/OD 恒为定比 ρ，描迹针走什么，画笔就同步画出 ρ 倍的同位相似图形；反向使用即放大——制图与雕花行业的纯几何模拟计算机。
topics.descEn: Four equal-parallel bars make a flexing parallelogram whose fixed pivot sits on a short bar's extension, keeping pivot, pencil and tracer collinear at every pose; similar triangles fix OF/OD to a constant ratio ρ, so the pencil draws a similar copy of whatever the tracer follows. Reversed, it enlarges — the drafting trade's pure-geometry analog computer.

topics.descZh: 木头不能焊不能铸，连接只能靠几何互锁：燕尾榫的梯形斜面把抬拉力分解为斜面正压力 N=F/(2cos21°)，越拉咬得越紧（机械自锁），沿槽滑动方向却自由；直榫截面无倒钩，只剩摩擦与胶、约 60 N 即拔出；木材横纹湿胀干缩可达百分之几，榫卯必须预留伸缩缝。
topics.descEn: Wood cannot be welded or cast, so joints interlock: a dovetail's slanted flanks resolve lift-off into normal pressure N=F/(2cos21°) — pull harder, it wedges tighter — while the slide direction stays free; a straight tenon holds by friction and glue alone and slips at about 60 N; cross-grain moisture swing demands movement gaps.

topics.descZh: 摆轮轴的方位不同，重力对走时的贡献就不同——普通机芯横放竖放能差几十秒每天；陀飞轮把摆轮、游丝与擒纵整套装进每 60 秒自转一圈的笼架，每位姿的误差在旋转中被逐位平均，围一圈平均偏差趋零；它是怀表竖放时代的产物，如今更多是工艺的展示。
topics.descEn: A balance at different orientations feels gravity differently — a plain movement can drift tens of seconds a day between positions; the tourbillon packs balance, spring and escapement into a cage rotating once a minute, averaging positional error around the circle until it cancels; a pocket-watch-era fix, now a showcase of craft.

topics.descZh: 螺旋叶片把斜管切成一格格小斗：转动时每斗里的水想下滑，却被下一圈叶片接住往上送——方向对了水就一路爬升；倾角越大每圈抬得越高但越容易漏回去，流量随转速与倾角逐区权衡；从尼罗河岸边到今天的螺旋输送机，两千年没换过原理。
topics.descEn: The helix blades slice an inclined pipe into pockets: as it turns, water in each pocket tries to slide down but the next blade catches it and lifts it a notch — spin the right way and water climbs the whole pipe; steeper angles lift more per turn but leak back more, trading flow against inclination; two millennia from the Nile to modern screw conveyors.

topics.descZh: 砝码放到秤盘边缘，读数却纹丝不动：两副平行四边形连杆把秤盘约束成只能竖直平移，偏载的水平力被连杆原样直送主梁，对支点的力臂恒等于臂长、与放置位置无关；普通刀口悬挂天平一偏载，有效力臂立刻被挪走。厨房秤与柜台秤用了两百年的秘密。
topics.descEn: Put the weight at the pan edge and the reading stays put: two parallelogram linkages let each pan only translate, so an off-center load's force rides the links straight to the beam with a moment arm always equal to the beam length — position-free; a knife-edge balance's effective arm moves the moment the load does. The kitchen-scale trick for two centuries.

topics.descZh: 泵送的是流量,决定压力的是负载:小活塞面积乘以高压得出大推力,经动臂-斗杆-铲斗三级杠杆放大;挖到硬石压力冲顶,溢流阀当场泄油让动作「憋住」——液压系统的自我保护。
topics.descEn: The pump delivers flow, but the load sets the pressure: small piston area times high pressure gives huge force, amplified through boom, arm and bucket linkages; hit a rock and pressure spikes until the relief valve dumps oil and the cylinder stalls — the hydraulics protecting themselves.

topics.descZh: 滚筒上的音钉按谱面排布,拨过音梳的每一根齿:齿是一根悬臂梁,越短固有频率越高——音高在出厂时就锯定了,转速只改节拍不改音高;阻尼衰减决定每个音的余韵。
topics.descEn: Pins arranged on the rotating cylinder pluck the tuned comb: each tooth is a cantilever, and the shorter it is, the higher its natural frequency — pitch is filed in at the factory, speed only changes tempo, and damping decay sets each note's ring-out.

topics.descZh: 偏心转子上的滑片把月牙腔分成两半:吸气侧容积变大把气体吸进来,压缩侧容积变小把它顶开阀片排出去;死隙里的返流决定极限压强,气镇阀掺空气防止蒸汽凝结。
topics.descEn: Vanes riding an eccentric rotor split the crescent chamber in two: the suction side grows to draw gas in, the compression side shrinks to push it out through the check valve; backflow through the dead volume sets the ultimate pressure, and the gas ballast bleeds air in to keep vapor from condensing.

topics.descZh: 一根液压缸顶在剪叉臂中点销上,相似三角形把推程放大 n 倍:平台只沿竖直导轨平移,负载全由臂内轴力扛——行程白赚,刚度与压杆稳定才是本钱
topics.descEn: One cylinder pushes the mid-pin while similar triangles multiply its stroke n-fold: the platform only translates vertically and the links carry the load as pure axial force — stroke comes free, stiffness and buckling are the real currency

topics.descZh: 每根杆只肯沿轴向传力:节点平衡把外载荷一格格分进杆件,上弦压、下弦拉;杆件按轴力着色,小车走行看受力实时重排
topics.descEn: Every member carries pure axial force: nodal equilibrium distributes the load member by member — top chord in compression, bottom in tension, colored live as the truck rolls across

topics.descZh: 三根硬棒互不接触,悬浮在连续张拉的索网里:压杆顶开的力全被索的张力网络收走;断一根索,形状当场重组
topics.descEn: Three struts never touch, floating in a continuous tension net: the compression members push outward while cables gather the load; cut one and the shape re-forms on the spot

topics.descZh: 石拱的楔块之间只传压力:外载荷被一条看不见的推力线一路引到两岸——它落在拱轴带内就安全,弯出带外拱就开铰变成机构当场垮塌;悬索翻过来就是拱
topics.descEn: Voussoirs pass pure compression: a hidden thrust line funnels every load to the banks — safe while it stays inside the arch band, and the moment it escapes, hinges open, the arch becomes a mechanism and collapses; a hanging chain turned upside down is the arch

topics.descZh: 缆绳每绕桩一圈,两端张力之比就乘一次 e^{μθ}:三圈下来人手几公斤的握力扛住几吨的大船——摩擦力按指数收费,圈数与摩擦系数是仅有的两个旋钮
topics.descEn: Every wrap around the post multiplies the tension ratio by e^{μθ}: three turns and a few kilograms of hand force hold a multi-ton ship — friction charges by the exponent, and wraps plus μ are the only dials

topics.descZh: 阴阳转子啮合,齿槽从吸气口被螺杆一路背到排气口,容积连续缩小把气体压上去:没有气阀没有脉动,排气口的位置锯定了内容积比与内压缩
topics.descEn: Male and female rotors mesh, carrying each gas pocket from the suction port to the discharge while the volume shrinks continuously: no valves, no pulsation — the discharge-port position sets the built-in volume ratio and the internal compression

topics.descZh: 绞盘把几吨配重举上高处，释放销一脱，势能在半秒内走完交接：长臂立起、软索甩摆追上、末端鞭击补速，石弹以接近 45° 出射——射程由配重比、臂比与释放角三方合谋
topics.descEn: A winch hoists tons of counterweight; the pin releases and potential energy changes hands in half a second — the beam rears up, the sling lashes like a whip, and the stone leaves near 45°.

topics.descZh: 一根匀速旋转的曲柄拖着八根定长杆开合如掌，脚端描出 D 形脚印：下段平直撑地推进行走、上段弯弧抬腿回摆——双腿相位差 180°，任意时刻都有脚在触地
topics.descEn: One constant-speed crank drags eight fixed-length links that open and close like a hand; the foot traces a D-shaped print — flat stance stroke below, arcing swing above — with legs phased so something always touches the ground.

topics.descZh: 发条满链力矩大、将尽力矩小，直连擒纵走时先快后慢；宝塔轮让链条搬家对调：满链绕细端、松链绕粗端，力矩乘力臂当场拉平——钟表走得匀，靠这条会搬家的链子
topics.descEn: A wound mainspring pulls hard; a spent one pulls weakly — geared straight to the escapement the watch runs fast then slow. The fusee evens it out: chain at the small radius when strong, the large one when weak, so torque times arm stays flat.

topics.descZh: 转速一高,离心力就把蹄块甩向鼓壁:低速打滑、高速咬死,接合点由弹簧刚度锯定——怠速不熄火、起步自动咬的默契,全在一对力的交点上
topics.descEn: Spin fast enough and centrifugal force flings the shoes against the drum: slipping at idle, locked at speed, the engagement point filed in by spring stiffness — the tacit deal between idling and pulling away is where two force curves cross

topics.descZh: 弹簧预紧力把阀瓣压在阀座上,罐压一旦顶穿预紧就起跳泄放:起跳与回座之间留一手滞后,免得阀在临界点频跳——锅炉与压力锅的最后防线
topics.descEn: A spring preload holds the disc on its seat; the moment vessel pressure overpowers it the valve pops and vents: the pop-and-reseat gap is deliberate hysteresis so the valve never chatters at the brink — the last line of defense on boilers and pressure cookers

topics.descZh: 先给钢绞线拉上力再放张,混凝土从出生起就泡在压应力里:荷载的拉先抵消预压才轮到开裂——裂缝不是被治好,是被提前抵消
topics.descEn: Tension the tendons first, release, and the concrete lives its whole life squeezed: a load's tension must first eat the built-in compression before any crack can open — cracks aren't cured, they're pre-paid

topics.descZh: 传动链里最便宜的保护件:一根故意做弱的销子,过载时宁可自己断——剪断销一步到位,摩擦式扭矩限制器打滑后还能复位;保险丝的逻辑被搬进了机械
topics.descEn: The cheapest protection in a drivetrain: a deliberately weak pin that breaks rather than the machine — the shear pin solves it in one stroke, the friction limiter slips and can be re-engaged; fuse logic, built into steel

topics.descZh: 转子偏心安在定子腔里,槽中滑片随旋转一伸一缩:相邻叶片间的容积变大就吸油、变小就压油——排量由偏心距说了算,压力由负载说了算;离心力把叶片甩向内壁,缝隙里的泄漏是唯一的账单
topics.descEn: Set the rotor off-center in the stator ring and the vanes slide in and out of their slots: the chamber between neighboring vanes grows to inhale oil and shrinks to squeeze it out — displacement is set by the eccentricity, pressure is set by the load; centrifugal force seats the vanes on the ring, and tip leakage is the only bill

topics.titleZh: 罗茨增压器与容积送风
topics.descZh: 两枚 8 字转子靠同步齿轮反向旋转,空气被壳体与叶瓣间的口袋整格搬运到出口——压缩不在腔里做,而是到出口被背压一口气顶回去:回吹是它的效率税,但大流量零迟滞是它的身价;机械增压的「随叫随到」与涡轮的「等人踢一脚」由此分野
topics.descEn: Two 8-lobed rotors, geared in sync, ferry air pocket by pocket from inlet to outlet — compression doesn't happen inside the case; each pocket arrives at the outlet and gets slammed by back-pressure: backflow is its efficiency tax, while big flow with zero lag is its price; instant response separates the supercharger from a turbo that waits for a kick

topics.descZh: 阀瓣+弹簧只许流体一路走:正向压差顶开、反向压差压回阀座——旋启式靠摆臂自重关门,慢半拍;升降式靠弹簧预紧,关门快;泵一停回流扑来,迟到的阀瓣拍上阀座,那一声「哐」就是水锤
topics.descEn: A disc and spring let fluid pass one way only: forward pressure lifts the disc, reverse pressure seats it — a swing check closes by gravity and lags; a spring-loaded lift check closes fast; when the pump dies the backflow rushes in and the late disc slams its seat — that clang is water hammer

topics.descZh: 轴向力怎么交给油膜:固定瓦会把油挤死,只有绕支点自由摆动的瓦才能自动张出楔形油楔——载荷一变倾角就变,水电站大轴靠它浮着
topics.descEn: How axial load is handed to an oil film: a fixed pad squeezes the oil dead, only a pad free to tilt on its pivot opens a self-forming wedge — load shifts, the tilt follows; big hydro shafts float on it

topics.titleZh: 锥形踏面与轮对自导向
topics.descZh: 火车轮不是圆柱而是削成锥:跑偏的一侧压上大半径,立刻被推回来——两根刚性轴靠锥度自动回中,曲线上外轨半径差还免费提供转向
topics.descEn: Railway wheels are not cylinders but cones: drift to one side and that wheel rides its larger radius, pushing you straight back — a rigid axle self-centers by taper, and on curves the radius difference steers for free

topics.descZh: 直齿的接触线横跨整个齿宽、同时进同时出,每换一齿「哐」一声;斜齿的接触线斜跨齿面、渐进扫过——重合度冲破 2、传力平稳;代价是 F_t·tanβ 的轴向力,人字齿左右手螺旋对消之
topics.descEn: Spur contact lines span the whole face and pop in and out — one thud per tooth; helical lines sweep diagonally for overlap beyond 2 and smooth torque; the bill is the tanβ axial thrust, which herringbone hands cancel

topics.descZh: 环不靠弹力硬贴缸壁——燃烧压力钻进环背缝隙把它压向缸壁,压力越大密封越紧;端隙错开 120°,泄漏要连闯三关;磨损拉开端隙,高压气下窜曲轴箱、机油上行烧成蓝烟
topics.descEn: Rings don’t seal by spring alone — combustion pressure sneaks behind each ring and packs it onto the wall, the harder the burn the tighter the fit; gaps staggered 120° force leaks through three gauntlets; wear widens them and gas blows by while oil climbs to burn blue

topics.descZh: 旋转惯性用曲柄配重就能对消,但活塞往复惯性永远指着缸轴方向,一根旋转配重按下葫芦浮起瓢;两根同速反转的平衡轴把一阶分量咬掉——直列四缸天生平衡一阶,二阶抖动交给双平衡轴
topics.descEn: Rotating shake cancels with crank counterweights, but reciprocating inertia always points along the bore and one spinning weight just moves the problem; two counter-rotating shafts bite away the first order — the inline-four balances itself, twin shafts swallow the second-order shudder

topics.descZh: 轮缸把两蹄撑向鼓壁,领蹄的摩擦力绕支点与推力同向——越刹越紧的自增力;从蹄被摩擦按回去、全靠液压硬顶;μ 是放大器也是隐患:热了掉增益,过头就抱死
topics.descEn: The wheel cylinder spreads both shoes; on the leading shoe friction torques the same way as the push — a self-energizing servo; the trailing shoe fights back and needs raw pressure; μ is the amplifier and the hazard: heat saps it, excess locks it

topics.descZh: 弯道把车身压向外侧,横向扭杆被左右轮的行程差拧转、当场顶回一个反力矩——只治侧倾不治颠簸;前后杆的刚度配比还在暗中决定转向是推头还是甩尾
topics.descEn: Cornering leans the body; a transverse torsion rod, twisted by the left-right travel difference, pushes back on the spot — it cures roll, not bumps; the front/rear stiffness split quietly steers understeer vs oversteer

topics.descZh: 曲柄匀速转一圈,刨刀切削慢、回程快——急回特性把非切削时间省下来;速比 K=(180°+θ)/(180°−θ) 只由极位夹角决定;导杆机构的几何一改,节拍就变
topics.descEn: The crank turns at constant speed yet the ram cuts slowly and returns fast — quick-return saves the non-cutting stroke; K=(180°+θ)/(180°−θ) depends only on the extreme-position angle; change the geometry, change the cycle

topics.descZh: 左右履带各卷各的,速差就是角速度 ω=(v_R−v_L)/B:车体绕瞬时中心画弧,R=B(v_L+v_R)/2(v_R−v_L);一侧停转原地小转、两侧反转原地自转;代价是履带横向刮地,急转时功率暴涨——轮式阿克曼省力却转不了这么急
topics.descEn: Each track rolls at its own speed and the difference is yaw rate ω=(v_R−v_L)/B: the hull pivots about an instantaneous center, R=B(v_L+v_R)/2(v_R−v_L); stop one side to spin tight, counter-rotate to turn in place; the bill is tracks scraping sideways — skid-steer power soars, a bill wheels never pay

topics.descZh: 轿厢经钢索带动限速器轮,超速 115% 时离心飞锤甩出扣住棘轮,提拉钢丝拽起安全钳楔块楔进导轨——楔形自锁、越坠越紧;渐进式钳以 0.2~1g 摁停轿厢,对重同款保护、井底缓冲器兜底——1852 年奥的斯当众砍断吊绳
topics.descEn: The car spins a governor via rope; at 115% speed a flyweight flies out, seizes the wheel and yanks the safety lever — wedges jam into the guide rails and lock harder the harder you fall; progressive brakes stop the car at 0.2–1 g; in 1852 Otis cut the rope in public and the car held

topics.descZh: 综框把经线分上下两片拉开成梭口,梭子引纬飞越,钢筘打纬压紧,卷取前进;平纹一上一下最紧实、斜纹错位出斜线、缎纹散点浮长出光泽;提花机用打孔卡逐纬决定哪根经针抬起——穿孔即程序,织机是第一台可编程机器
topics.descEn: Heddles split the warp into two sheds, the shuttle carries weft across, the reed beats it home, the cloth advances; plain weaves tightest, twill steps diagonals, satin floats shine; Jacquard's punched cards lift chosen threads each pick — holes are code, the loom the first programmable machine

topics.descZh: 接合套 1325 r/min、齿圈只有 925,速差 400 r/min 硬推=打齿冒火花;拨叉先把锁环压上同步锥,7° 锥半角把 100 N 推力放大成约 820 N 压力,摩擦扭矩约 0.25 s 拖齐转速(典型 0.1–0.3 s);~35° 锁止角同步前挡住接合套、同步后让开;无同步器只能两脚离合补油人工对速
topics.descEn: Pushing across a 400 rpm gap grinds tooth tips; the brass lock ring rides the friction cone first — a 7° half-angle turns 100 N of shift force into ~820 N of clamp and drags the speeds level in ~0.25 s; the ~35° lock angle bars the sleeve until synced, then yields; no synchronizer, double-clutch and rev-match or grind

topics.descZh: 螺杆旋转边输送边剪切熔融、后撤蓄料;再像活塞前推,以 40–130 MPa 把 240 °C 熔体压进闭模模腔,前沿按喷泉流翻向模壁冻成皮层;冷却收缩由保压补喂、浇口冻结后失效;锁模力=型腔压力×投影面积;保压不足→缩痕、压力低→缺料、过大→飞边
topics.descEn: The screw shears pellets into melt and retracts to store a shot, then rams forward — 240 °C melt enters the closed cavity at 40–130 MPa, the fountain-flow front freezing into a skin; holding pressure feeds shrinkage until the gate freezes; clamp force = pressure × area; too little holding → sink marks, too little pressure → short shot, too much → flash

topics.descZh: 焊丝与母材间烧着 6000–8000 K 电弧,金属瞬间熔成液态熔池;表面张力与电磁力驱动对流,后缘周期性凝固拉出鱼鳞纹;保护气罩住熔池隔绝空气——关掉它,氮氢氧当场入侵:气孔冒泡、氢致裂纹抬头;热影响区被回火正火分层,焊后缓冷就是一次热处理
topics.descEn: A 6000–8000 K arc melts filler and base metal into a liquid pool; surface tension and EM forces stir it while the trailing edge freezes into fish-scale ripples; shielding gas keeps air out — switch it off and N/H/O break in: pores bubble up, hydrogen cracks loom; the HAZ is tempered in layers and slow cooling is a heat treatment

topics.descZh: 两轴交 90°,轴线交汇于锥顶,两个节锥沿公共母线纯滚动;速比只看齿数 i=z₂/z₁=40/12≈3.33,1200→360 r/min,扭矩 20→66.7 N·m;直齿沿齿线整条同时砸上、约 85 dB,螺旋齿 β≈35° 渐进滑入、同时啮合 2–3 齿、降到约 74 dB;代价是轴向力 F_a=F_t·tanβ 从 87 N 涨到 583 N,全靠圆锥滚子轴承顶住
topics.descEn: Two shafts cross at 90° with axes meeting at the cone apex, two pitch cones rolling along a common generatrix; the ratio is pure tooth count, i=z₂/z₁=40/12≈3.33: 1200→360 rpm with torque 20→66.7 N·m. Straight teeth slam the whole line at once (~85 dB) while spirals at β≈35° slide in over 2–3 teeth (~74 dB) — at the price of axial thrust F_a=F_t·tanβ growing from 87 N to 583 N, held by tapered roller bearings

topics.descZh: 空心外轴连 K₁ 挂 1/3/5 挡、实心内轴连 K₂ 挂 2/4/6 挡,各配一个离合器;1 挡巡航 K₁ 独自传力 950 N·m 时,K₂ 已把 2 挡预啮合待命;升挡只是 K₁ 泄压、K₂ 充压的扭矩交接,重叠 150–250 ms,轮上扭矩 950→525 N·m 全程不为零;手动挡同样一换要断油→摘挡→同步→挂挡约 700 ms,扭矩归零踩出一个坑
topics.descEn: Two concentric input shafts split the gears: K1 drives the hollow outer shaft (1/3/5), K2 the solid inner shaft (2/4/6). While K1 carries 950 N·m in 1st, K2 has already pre-engaged 2nd; an upshift is just a 150–250 ms torque handover, wheel torque gliding 950→525 N·m without hitting zero. A manual needs ~700 ms of fuel-cut, disengage, sync and re-engage — torque drops to zero

topics.titleZh: 超越离合器与滚柱楔紧
topics.descZh: 内外圈之间 6 只滚柱坐在偏心凹坑里,半径间隙只有 0.08R;正转时摩擦力把滚柱滚上 5° 楔面,楔紧角 α 小于摩擦角 arctan 0.15=8.5°,0.1 s 内挤死于内外滚道之间同步传扭;反转立刻滚回凹坑空转,超越转速可达 3000 r/min;把楔角推过 8.5° 自锁条件破缺,滚柱永远咬不住、当场滑脱——自行车飞轮、起动机、液力变矩器导轮全靠它
topics.descEn: Six rollers sit in eccentric pockets between the races with only 0.08R of radial clearance; driving forward, friction walks each roller up the 5° wedge ramp — below the friction angle arctan 0.15=8.5° — and it locks between the races within 0.1 s to transmit torque. Spin backward and the rollers roll back into the pockets to freewheel at up to 3000 rpm; push the wedge angle past 8.5° and self-lock fails on the spot. Bike freewheels, starter drives and torque-converter stators all live on this trick

topics.titleZh: 涡旋压缩机与动涡卷公转
topics.descZh: 两条涡卷相位差 180° 相互啮合,动涡卷被曲柄拖着只公转、不自转,十字滑环管住姿态;月牙形压缩腔从外缘一路挤到中心,吸气/压缩/排气三腔同一时刻并存,排气几乎无脉动;e=4 mm、节距≈25 mm、圈数 2.75,排量 90.5 cm³/r,吸气 0.5 MPa 到排气 2.0 MPa 内压比固定为 4,变频 20–120 r/s
topics.descEn: Two wraps mesh 180° out of phase; the orbiting wrap is dragged around by the crank — pure revolution, no spin — while an Oldham ring blocks rotation. Crescent chambers squeeze from the rim to the center with suction, compression and discharge live simultaneously, so flow is nearly pulseless: e=4 mm, pitch ≈25 mm, 2.75 turns, 90.5 cm³/rev, 0.5 → 2.0 MPa with a fixed built-in volume ratio of 4, inverter-driven 20–120 r/s

topics.descZh: 刀尖每转吃进 0.2 mm,剪切角 φ≈25° 的窄带里材料瞬间剪切滑移、卷成切屑——切削不是刮,是受控剪切;45 钢 ap=1.5 mm 时 MRR=60 cm³/min、kc≈2400 N/mm² → F_c=720 N、P≈2.4 kW,前刀面 700–900 °C 最热;前角从 +10° 拧到 −10°,切屑从长螺卷变节状碎屑、力与温度都涨;30–60 m/min 积屑瘤长大又崩掉拉毛表面;v·Tⁿ=C 定换刀时刻
topics.descEn: The tool feeds 0.2 mm per rev and the material shears instantly across a narrow band at φ≈25°, curling into a chip — cutting is controlled shear, not scraping. At ap=1.5 mm on steel: MRR=60 cm³/min, kc≈2400 N/mm² gives F_c=720 N and P≈2.4 kW, with the rake face hottest at 700–900 °C. Swing the rake from +10° to −10° and ribbon chips turn segmented as force and heat climb; at 30–60 m/min a built-up edge grows and tears off; v·Tⁿ=C calls the tool change

topics.descZh: 0.6 MPa 压缩空气经 5/2 阀灌进 Ø32 缸的无杆腔,A=804 mm² → F=p·A≈483 N 推出负载;速度由排气节流阀调,末端缓冲柱塞封口、腔内气体压缩吸能防撞;阀芯横移 5 mm,整条气路镜像翻转、活塞退回;可压缩空气是代价:负载突变当场软腿、低速爬行——力密度不如液压,但快、净、便宜
topics.descEn: 0.6 MPa air flows through a 5/2 valve into the cap side of a Ø32 bore: A=804 mm² gives F=p·A≈483 N. Meter-out throttling sets speed, and at stroke end a cushion spear seals the port so trapped air compresses to absorb the impact. Slide the spool 5 mm and every pipe mirrors — the rod retracts. Compressibility is the bill: a sudden load makes the piston sag, and low speed crawls — weaker than hydraulics but faster, cleaner, cheaper

topics.descZh: 琴键是二级杠杆:10 mm 行程放大成 ~45 mm 槌程、速度比约 5 倍;行程中点顶杆侧向脱开鼓轮,琴槌惯性飞弦、回落被托木接住;复奏杆让 1/3 键程即可再击——同键每秒 13–15 次,立式钢琴做不到;制音器随键抬起、松键落回止音
topics.descEn: The key is a two-stage lever: 10 mm of dip amplifies to ~45 mm of hammer travel at ~5x. Mid-stroke the jack escapes sideways off the roller, the hammer flies free, and the back check catches its rebound; the repetition lever resets after just 1/3 dip — 13-15 repeats a second, beyond any upright. Dampers lift with the key and stop the string on release.

topics.descZh: 转盘带动主凸轮拉第一只轮,驻轮鼻依拨序逐轮传递;每只轮外缘一个缺口,三缺口全部对齐到卡子正下方,fence 下落、锁舌退开;40 格 × 3 轮 = 64000 组合、±1.5 格容差窗——盲试期望 3.2 万次不可行,真实的威胁是听声与手感的侧信道
topics.descEn: The dial drives the cam and the first wheel; parking tabs hand torque on wheel by wheel. Each wheel carries a gate — only when all three align under the fence does it drop and the bolt retract. 40 marks × 3 wheels = 64,000 combinations with a ±1.5-notch window; blind trial expects 32,000 tries. The real threat is sound and feel.

topics.descZh: 游标把 49 mm 摊成 50 格,每格比主格短 0.02 mm——找「哪两条线对齐」就把余数读了出来;千分尺走螺旋路:0.5 mm 螺距、套筒 50 格把 0.5 mm 放大成 0.01 mm,摩擦棘轮限定测力 5–10 N;卡尺违反阿贝原则、千分尺遵守——10″ 偏摆加 50 mm 阿贝臂就吃掉 2.4 μm
topics.descEn: The vernier spreads 49 mm over 50 divisions, each 0.02 mm short of a main line — find the aligned pair and the remainder is read. The micrometer takes the screw road: 0.5 mm pitch across 50 thimble divisions gives 0.01 mm, with a ratchet holding 5-10 N. The caliper violates Abbe's principle, the micrometer honors it — a 10-second tilt on a 50 mm arm costs 2.4 μm.

topics.descZh: 手腕每天摆动 3000-6000 次,直径约 28 mm、重 3-4 g 的偏心摆陀靠外缘重环(约 70% 质量)的转动惯量把每次倾斜变成力矩;换向轮内两个反向单向离合器并联,正摆反摆都能驱动约 300:1 的轮系,把 0.4-0.5 m 的主发条卷紧成 38-70 h 动力储备;满弦后 bridle 打滑恒力矩护条,佩戴 8-12 h 即充满。
topics.descEn: Your wrist swings 3,000-6,000 times a day; an eccentric rotor ~28 mm across and 3-4 g heavy, with ~70% of its mass in the rim, turns each tilt into torque; two opposite one-way clutches in the reverser feed a ~300:1 train either way, coiling the 0.4-0.5 m mainspring into a 38-70 h reserve; once full a slipping bridle holds torque constant - 8-12 h of wear winds it full.

topics.titleZh: 叉车门架与链传动倍率
topics.descZh: 三节门架靠一只油缸加一组链轮升起 3 米:油缸顶中门架,链条绕过链轮再提货叉架——中门架升 1 米,货叉对地升 2 米、速度 2 倍,是动滑轮的反用:省缸长、费行程。自由提升让货叉在门架不动时先升 1-1.5 米,才能钻进 2.3 米净高的集装箱;2500 kg @ 500 mm 载荷中心 = 12.3 kN·m 倾翻力矩,载荷中心移到 900 mm 近乎翻倍,靠配重与 3-6° 后倾压住。
topics.descEn: A single cylinder and a chain-over-sprocket set raise a three-stage mast 3 m: the plunger pushes the middle mast while the chain lifts the carriage again - middle mast up 1 m, forks up 2 m at twice the speed, a pulley run in reverse: shorter cylinder, longer stroke. Free lift raises the forks 1-1.5 m before the mast moves, so the truck drives into a 2.3 m-clear container; 2500 kg at a 500 mm load center means a 12.3 kN·m tip moment, nearly doubled at 900 mm, held by counterweight and 3-6° rear tilt.

topics.titleZh: 振动压路机与偏心激振
topics.descZh: 钢轮内偏心块以 ω≈150-220 rad/s 旋转,激振力 F=m·e·ω² 达 200-400 kN,竖直分量把 10-20 t 单钢轮的瞬时载荷顶到静重 2-4 倍;25-35 Hz 激振扫过 20-30 Hz 的「土壤-钢轮」共振区时压实效率最高,工作点取 1.1-1.3 倍共振频率;颗粒重排、孔隙比从 0.62 降至 0.40,4-6 遍收敛到 96% 压实度;激振力一旦超过轮重便跳振,压不实还伤机。
topics.descEn: Eccentric weights spinning at ω ≈ 150-220 rad/s generate F = m·e·ω² of 200-400 kN, driving a 10-20 t single drum to 2-4× its static load each cycle. Sweeping 25-35 Hz through the 20-30 Hz soil-drum resonance compacts best; machines run at 1.1-1.3× resonance. Grains repack, void ratio falls from 0.62 to 0.40, and 4-6 passes converge at 96% compaction — let the force exceed the drum weight and the roller skip-jumps.

topics.descZh: 一颗按钮为什么能按出锁定和释放两种结局:按钮内壁三条 120° 斜槽把 ~3 mm 的下压分解成爪尖的径向撑开,三片铍铜/POM 弹性卡爪各弯 0.2-0.4 mm、合计储能 ~1 mJ,按压力从空程 ~1 N 爬到 3-6 N 峰值;行程约 75% 处越过锁点,负刚度失稳让爪尖在 5-10 ms 内「咔哒」跳进另一组槽底——笔芯弹出并锁住;再按时凸轮换轨,K≈0.1-0.3 N/mm 的笔芯弹簧把笔芯收回。直筒无斜面则无槽可落,一按就废。
topics.descEn: Why does one button both lock and release? Three 120°-spaced ramps inside the button split a ~3 mm press into radial spreading of three BeCu/POM spring claws, each bending 0.2-0.4 mm to store ~1 mJ while the force climbs from ~1 N to a 3-6 N peak. Past the crest at ~75% of the stroke, negative stiffness snaps the tips into the next detent within 5-10 ms — the click — extending and locking the refill. A second press switches cam tracks, and the K≈0.1-0.3 N/mm refill spring pulls the refill back. A straight sleeve without ramps has nothing to fall into: no click, no lock.

topics.descZh: 双车位钢板门重约 130 kg,一只 ~250 W 管状电机十几秒就能开门——重活门轴上方的扭簧早已干完:预绕 6-8 圈,开门时缆绳绕上鼓轮(半径 ~55 mm)把门重矩逐步卸给簧,关门时门重把簧拧回,全关时储能约 1.5 kJ。平衡是两条曲线对账:簧的扭矩-转角直线对上门重矩 m·g·(h/2)·cosθ 的余弦曲线,匹配得当时电机只补摩擦差额、出力不到门重 10-20%;欠平衡门自己砸下,过平衡门自己飘上;断簧后门以 ~2-4 m/s 砸地,换簧务必夹紧杆+安全缆。
topics.descEn: A double-car steel door weighs ~130 kg, yet a ~250 W tubular motor opens it in seconds - the torsion spring above the shaft did the heavy lifting first: pre-wound 6-8 turns, it takes over the door weight moment through 55 mm drums and cables, and the door weight winds it back on closing, storing ~1.5 kJ when fully shut. Balance means matching the spring's straight torque-angle line to the cosine m·g·(h/2)·cosθ: matched well, the motor covers only friction, under 10-20% of door weight. Under-balanced doors slam, over-balanced ones float; a broken spring hits the floor at 2-4 m/s - use winding bars and safety cables.

topics.titleZh: 游梁式抽油机与四连杆配重
topics.descZh: 电机 1,450 r/min 经皮带+减速箱降到 3-9 min⁻¹ 带动曲柄;半径 1.25 m 的曲柄经连杆推拉游梁,驴头弧面以支点为圆心,悬绳切点恒在铅垂线上,光杆冲程 1.2-7.6 m;地下 1,500 m 处泵径 38-95 mm 的柱塞泵靠两球阀吸油:上冲程固定阀开、液柱 ~38 kN 压上杆柱,下冲程载荷移交油管;调好曲柄平衡块相位,电流从「双峰一谷」变对称、不平衡度 <15%。减速比 ~350:1,曲柄轴扭矩 20-60 kN·m,泵排量 Q=1440·n·S·πd²/4 ≈ 37 m³/d。
topics.descEn: A 1,450 rpm motor, belt and gearbox slow to 3-9 min⁻¹ at the crank; the 1.25 m crank drives the walking beam through pitman arms, and the horsehead arc — centered on the saddle bearing — keeps the bridle tangent vertical, sweeping a 1.2-7.6 m stroke. 1,500 m down, a 38-95 mm plunger pump lifts oil with two ball valves: upstroke the standing valve opens and the ~38 kN fluid column loads the rods; downstroke the load transfers to the tubing. Set the counterweight phase right and the motor current smooths from double-humped to symmetric, imbalance <15%; Q = 1440·n·S·πd²/4 ≈ 37 m³/d.

topics.titleZh: 华氏阀动机构与蒸汽分配
topics.descZh: 十字头经合杆一路直驱阀芯,给出与回动手柄无关的固定导程 3-6 mm(提前进气+提前排汽);回动曲柄经回动杆加入相位差 ~90° 的分量,回动手柄滑动支点把阀行程从 ~150 mm 收到 0,停汽点从 ~75% 收到 ~15%——蒸汽在缸内膨胀做功,省汽 20-40%。主轮径 1.6-2 m,活塞阀内进外排,汽口红=进汽、蓝=排汽;阀位移对活塞位移的相位图是一只被 ±余面(28 mm)裁开的椭圆,导程那一点永远不动。
topics.descEn: The crosshead drives the valve directly through the combination lever, giving a 3-6 mm lead that ignores the reverser; the return crank adds a ~90° phase-shifted path via the radius rod, and the reversing lever slides the fulcrum to shrink valve travel from ~150 mm toward 0, pulling cut-off from ~75% to ~15% — expansion does the work, saving 20-40% steam. Drivers 1.6-2 m, inside-admission piston valve, ports red=steam blue=exhaust; the valve-vs-piston phase plot is an ellipse clipped by the ±28 mm lap lines, with the lead point nailed in place.

topics.descZh: 一根纱线自己串套成布:舌针八步循环——退圈、垫纱、闭口、套圈、连圈、脱圈、成圈、牵拉,每步 20-100 ms,机速 1.5-2.5 m/s;E28 针距 = 每 25.4 mm 28 根针(0.91 mm),圈长 ~2.6 mm 决定密度:圈长 −10%,克重与密度约 +20%。旧线圈(金)推舌针活板、新纱(青)被拉过旧线圈;与机织经纬交织不同,针织只靠上一行的串套——断一根纱,整条纵行脱散成一根线。
topics.descEn: One yarn interlocks into fabric all by itself: the latch needle's 8-step cycle — clearing, laying, closing, covering, joining, knocking-over, forming, take-down — each step 20-100 ms at 1.5-2.5 m/s; E28 gauge = 28 needles per 25.4 mm (0.91 mm pitch), and the ~2.6 mm stitch length sets density: 10% shorter loop ≈ 20% heavier, denser cloth. The old loop (gold) flips the latch and draws the new yarn (cyan) through; unlike woven warp-and-weft, a knit holds only by loop-through-loop — break one yarn and a whole wale ladders into a loose thread.

topics.descZh: 偏心圆盘在计量室里不旋转、只章动(倾角 ~30° 的法线进动),把腔体切成四个依次充放的新月腔,相位差 90°;盘的轴颈球在锥形导轨里每章动一周恰好排过固定体积(典型 1 L/转),经槽盘转成轴转动、齿轮系推十进制计数器——只数「过路体积」,与流速、压力无关:精度 ±2%,量程比 R80-R160(Q3=2.5 m³/h,最小到 1/80);代价是 0.1-0.6 bar 压差和表前滤网。
topics.descEn: An eccentric disc in the chamber never spins — it nutates, its normal precessing at ~30° tilt, splitting the cavity into four crescent chambers filling and emptying 90° apart. The spindle ball orbits in a conical track: one cycle passes exactly one fixed volume (~1 L/rev), a slot plate turns orbit into shaft rotation, and a gear train drives the decimal register. It counts volume, not speed — indifferent to flow rate and pressure: ±2% accuracy over R80-R160 rangeability (Q3=2.5 m³/h, down to 1/80) at the cost of 0.1-0.6 bar of pressure drop and an upstream strainer.

topics.descZh: 提纽=支点:钩挂 W、0.5 kg 秤砣滑到力臂 L,平衡即 W·a + 杆矩 = G·L。杆重 0.8 kg(合重心距钩端 4.5 cm)也要计入——空秤平衡点就是「定盘星」,先校零再称重;之后刻度严格均匀,每 kg 间距 = a/G 恒定。两个提纽=两个支点=两个量程:近钩纽 a=0.4 cm 量 0-50 kg,远钩纽 a=4 cm 同一杆同一砣缩到 0-5 kg、分辨率细 6.4 倍——要「称得重」还是「称得准」,换一根绳就行。
topics.descEn: The handle cord is the fulcrum: hook load W on one side, the 0.5 kg poise slid to arm L on the other; balance means W·a + beam moment = G·L. The beam's own 0.8 kg (CM 4.5 cm from the hook) counts too — the empty-beam balance point is the zero mark, checked before weighing; after that the scale is strictly uniform, a/G cm per kg. Two handles = two fulcrums = two ranges: near handle a=0.4 cm for 0-50 kg, far handle a=4 cm for 0-5 kg with 6.4× finer resolution — capacity or precision, just move the cord.

topics.titleZh: 麦克纳姆轮与全向移动
topics.descZh: 轮毂周圈装 10 个与轮轴呈 45° 的桶形辊,地面反力被斜着推:v_x=R/4·Σω(前后)、v_y=R/4(−ω₁+ω₂−ω₃+ω₄)(横移)、ω_z 由对角差动给出;45° 恰使纵/横向能力相等(cosβ=sinβ)。横移=左右轮反转、原地旋转=对角同号、画圆=三者同时——普通轮只会前后推,AGV 与全向轮椅的三自由度全靠这圈斜辊。
topics.descEn: Ten barrel rollers at 45° to each axle push the ground reaction obliquely: v_x=R/4·Σω (forward), v_y=R/4(−ω₁+ω₂−ω₃+ω₄) (strafe), ω_z from diagonal differences; at 45° fore/aft and lateral ability are equal (cosβ=sinβ). Strafe = mirror spin, spin-in-place = diagonal pairs, circle = all three — ordinary wheels only push fore-aft, and AGVs owe their three DOF to this ring of slanted rollers.

topics.descZh: 旋转滚轮把硅胶管压瘪到完全闭合,两滚轮间的「液枕」被机械推着走:Q=V_枕×滚轮数×转速(内径 6.4 mm 管、压扁段 ~30 mm → 0.96 mL/枕,3 滚轮 100 rpm ≈ 290 mL/min);滚轮离开后管回弹、尾部回吸防滴漏;液体只接触管壁——无菌、堵转不坏、可自吸,代价是脉动与管的疲劳(数十万次压缩,精度 ±0.5-2%)。
topics.descEn: Rotating rollers squeeze a silicone tube fully shut and carry trapped slugs mechanically: Q=V_slug×rollers×rpm (6.4 mm bore, ~30 mm crushed length → 0.96 mL/slug; 3 rollers at 100 rpm ≈ 290 mL/min). Behind each roller the tube rebounds and sucks back, sealing against drips. Fluid touches only the tube — sterile, choke-proof, self-priming — at the price of pulsation and tube fatigue (hundreds of thousands of squeezes, ±0.5-2% accuracy).

topics.descZh: 凸轮=把形状存进钢的程序:桃尖把旋转变成精确的升程-定时——升程 ~9-11 mm、持续期 ~230-270° 曲柄角、上止点进排气门重叠 ~40-60°;曲柄 2 转=凸轮 1 转。持续期长=高转呼吸畅但怠速抖(充气效率塌),液压挺柱自动消除 0.1-0.25 mm 冷间隙,气门弹簧预紧 200-300 N,红区转速气门会「飞脱」。
topics.descEn: A cam is a shape compiled into steel: the nose turns rotation into an exact lift-vs-timing program — ~9-11 mm lift, ~230-270° duration, ~40-60° intake/exhaust overlap at TDC; crank twice per cam. Long duration breathes at high rpm but idles rough (VE collapses); hydraulic lifters erase the 0.1-0.25 mm cold clearance; springs preload 200-300 N until valve float.

topics.descZh: 活塞自己就是滑阀:下行先开排气口(~70° BBDC)、再开扫气口,曲轴箱压缩的新气(~1.3)以 Schnürle 回路上卷把废气顶出去,换气只占 ~120° 曲柄角;每转一个做功冲程,功率密度比四冲程高 60-80%,但换气短路让油耗高 20-40%——链锯、摩托、船外机都在为这个取舍买单。
topics.descEn: The piston is its own slide valve: descending it opens exhaust (~70° BBDC) then transfer ports, and crankcase-compressed fresh charge (~1.3) loops up in a Schnürle curl to shove exhaust out — gas exchange takes just ~120° of crank. One power stroke per revolution gives 60-80% higher power density, but short-circuiting costs 20-40% more fuel: the price chainsaws and mopeds pay.

topics.descZh: 蓄压器把锅炉蒸汽攒在 ~30-45 bar,破膜阀毫秒级全开,~90 m 缸内活塞经滑梭拖飞机 2-3 s 拉到 70-97 m/s(250-350 km/h、3-4 g):a=ηpA/m 由蒸汽压力与飞机重量(20-32 t)共同决定,末速不足就是坠海;拖索脱、holdback 释放按时序来,水刹吸收活塞 ~9 MJ 并复位,一次弹射耗汽 ~600 kg。
topics.descEn: Accumulators bank boiler steam at ~30-45 bar; the launch valve snaps full-open in milliseconds and a piston in the ~90 m cylinder drags the aircraft to 70-97 m/s (250-350 km/h, 3-4 g) in 2-3 s: a=ηpA/m, set by steam pressure and weight (20-32 t) — fall short of end speed and you go into the sea. The launch bar drops, the holdback releases on cue, a water brake swallows ~9 MJ and resets, ~600 kg of steam per shot.

topics.titleZh: 轴向柱塞泵与斜盘变量
topics.descZh: 缸体带 7 个柱塞转一圈,滑靴沿斜盘滑一次:行程 s=D·tanβ,半圈吸油半圈压油,配流盘的腰形槽就是旋转换向阀;排量 V=Z·(π/4)d²·D·tanβ,β 0-18° 无级可调——压力补偿变量把流量按需收放,恒功率输出 250-400 bar;奇数柱塞让流量脉动只剩 ~2.5%,滑靴中心小孔引高压油成静压油膜。
topics.descEn: Rotate the cylinder block and each of 7 pistons strokes once along the swashplate: s=D·tanβ, half a turn suction, half discharge — the port plate's kidney slots are a rotary valve. Displacement V=Z·(π/4)d²·D·tanβ with β stepless 0-18°: pressure compensation trims flow on demand for constant-power 250-400 bar; odd piston count keeps ripple ~2.5%, and a center orifice oils each slipper pad.

topics.titleZh: 转子动平衡与配重校正
topics.descZh: 10 g 偏心在 6000 rpm 甩出 197 N——F=mrω²,与转速平方共振;静不平衡给 1× 转频力,动不平衡再加一对力偶让转子弓形回转;在 I、II 两个校正平面加配重合掉不平衡矢量,平衡等级 G=e·ω 给出允许偏心(G2.5@10000 rpm 仅 2.4 μm);现场影响系数法试重一次,α=(A1−A0)/T 直接算出校正量。
topics.descEn: 10 g of eccentric mass at 6,000 rpm flings out 197 N — F=mrω², rising with the square of speed. Static unbalance gives a 1× force; dynamic adds a couple that bows the rotor. Two correction planes sum counterweights against the unbalance vectors, grade G=e·ω sets the allowed eccentricity (G2.5 at 10,000 rpm: 2.4 μm), and the influence-coefficient field method computes the fix from one trial weight: α=(A1−A0)/T.

topics.descZh: 1.5 t 车 56 km/h 带着约 182 kJ 动能,必须在 0.6-0.8 m 行程里被变形力吃掉:F·s=ΔE,300 kN 平均变形力对应 ~20 g 减速度,行程砍半力就翻倍;前端「软」(吸能盒+引导压溃纵梁)、乘员舱「硬」(1500 MPa 热成型钢);力-位移曲线要高而平,波浪折叠比随机弯折多吸 2-3 倍;预紧-限力-气囊在 60-100 ms 内接力。
topics.descEn: A 1.5 t car at 56 km/h carries ~182 kJ of kinetic energy that deformation must eat within 0.6-0.8 m: F·s=ΔE — 300 kN average force means ~20 g; halve the stroke and force doubles. The nose is "soft" (crush boxes plus crash-guided rails), the cell "hard" (1,500 MPa hot-stamped steel); a tall, flat force-stroke curve with corrugated folds absorbs 2-3× more than random buckling; pretensioner, load limiter and airbag run a 60-100 ms relay.

topics.descZh: 气动冲击扳手不跟螺栓硬拧:马达经行星减速把锤甩到 ~1,600-2,000 r/min,阻力大时锤被斜面顶起、空转加速半圈,再以 10-30 J 动能砸回砧面,毫秒脉冲打出 300-2,000 N·m 峰值扭矩,反冲被锤的空转吸收,手上几乎无感。
topics.descEn: An impact wrench refuses the arm-wrestle: a motor and planetary stage spin the hammer to ~1,600-2,000 rpm; under load the ramps lift it free for about half a turn, then it slams back with 10-30 J - a millisecond pulse worth 300-2,000 N·m of peak torque, while the recoil is swallowed by the hammer's free spin.

topics.descZh: 运载索以 5-6 m/s 匀速绕行,车厢在站内以 ~0.5 m/s 慢行:进站轨压开夹板,出站挂索轨重新钳绳,弹簧+楔形自锁给 20-30 kN 抓紧力;驱动轮 ø3.5-4.5 m 包角 180°,液压张紧 100-300 kN,爬坡可达 ~45°。
topics.descEn: The haul rope circles at 5-6 m/s while cabins creep through the station at ~0.5 m/s, decoupled by the detach/attach quadrant: a fixed rail opens the clamp at entry, an attach rail clamps back with spring preload plus wedge self-lock worth 20-30 kN; the ø3.5-4.5 m bullwheel runs a 180° wrap with 100-300 kN of hydraulic tension, and cabins stay plumb up to ~45° grades.

topics.descZh: 共轨让压力与转速解耦:柱塞泵(~2 cm³/转)只管蓄压,ECU 闭环稳住 1,800-2,500 bar,怠速也有 2,000 bar;通电 0.1-0.5 ms、针阀抬 ~0.2 mm,SMD 5-10 μm 细雾,燃烧拆 3-5 段,油量=轨压×脉宽。
topics.descEn: Common-rail frees injection pressure from engine speed: a plunger pump (~2 cm³/rev) only feeds the rail, the ECU holds 1,800-2,500 bar in closed loop - even idle sees 2,000 bar; the solenoid fires for 0.1-0.5 ms, the needle lifts ~0.2 mm, and the holes atomize 5-10 μm droplets across 3-5 shaped segments, with quantity = pressure × pulse width.

topics.descZh: 所有气缸围着单曲轴排一圈:只有主连杆大端套在曲柄销上,副连杆铰接在它周围的凸缘上,副缸行程略异、以主缸为准微调压缩比。四冲程点火按 720°/缸数均分,7 缸相邻点火间隔约 102.9°,点火序 1-3-5-7-2-4-6;奇数缸是硬约束。R-985 九缸 16.2 L 出 450 hp,R-2800 十八缸 46 L 出 2,000 hp。
topics.descEn: A ring of cylinders around a single crankshaft: only the master rod's big end rides the crank pin, with slave rods hung from its flange and slightly different stroke. Four-stroke firing divides 720° evenly - a 7-cylinder radial fires every ~102.9° in the order 1-3-5-7-2-4-6, and odd cylinder counts are a hard constraint. The R-985 (9 cyl, 16.2 L) made 450 hp; the R-2800 (18 cyl, 46 L) made 2,000 hp.

topics.descZh: 卷边膜气囊+铝活塞,内充约 5-8 bar(绝对)空气当弹簧:刚度 k=n·p_abs·A²/V 随载荷温和上升,空载满载固有频率都稳在 1.2-1.5 Hz。300-500 W 压缩机配 ~10 bar 储气罐,高度传感器闭环回平,高速自动降 10-20 mm;满载压过减速带,钢弹簧回弹三次,空气弹簧一次就稳。
topics.descEn: A rolling-lobe sleeve on an aluminum piston holds ~5-8 bar (absolute) of air as the spring: stiffness k = n·p_abs·A²/V rises only gently with load, so the natural frequency stays at 1.2-1.5 Hz empty or full. A 300-500 W compressor feeds a ~10 bar reservoir, height sensors level the body closed-loop, and it drops 10-20 mm at speed; over a speed bump steel springs bounce three times while air settles in one.

topics.descZh: 三只锥形牙轮绕自身轴自转、随钻头公转,像碾子贴着井底滚:钻压 80-250 kN 把牙齿压入岩石压碎、剪碎。三只喷嘴以 60-140 m/s 射出钻井液清岩屑,喷嘴压降 Δp=½ρv² 约占泵压 200-350 bar 的 30-50%。转速 40-150 rpm,机械钻速软层 20-50 m/h、硬层 2-5 m/h;齿磨损按 1/8 齿高分级。
topics.descEn: Three toothed cones spin on their own axes while revolving with the bit, rolling over the hole bottom like crushers: 80-250 kN of weight-on-bit presses the teeth in to crush and shear rock. Three nozzles fire mud at 60-140 m/s to sweep cuttings, the nozzle drop ½ρv² taking 30-50% of the 200-350 bar pump load. At 40-150 rpm, penetration runs 20-50 m/h in soft rock and 2-5 m/h in hard, with tooth wear graded in eighths of tooth height.

topics.descZh: 刀盘以 1-6 r/min、5-50 MN·m 扭矩旋转,17 英寸盘形滚刀每把 250-350 kN 压碎岩石;16-30 组油缸顶着管片环给出 2-6 万 kN 推力,掘进 20-60 mm/min。土压平衡靠推进速度与螺旋机转速双向调节,把土仓压稳在 0.1-0.3 MPa;每环 1.2-2.0 m 拼 6-8 块管片、K 块封顶,同步注浆填 5-10 cm 空隙,最小转弯半径 250-500 m。
topics.descEn: The cutterhead spins at 1-6 r/min with 5-50 MN·m of torque; 17-inch disc cutters crush rock at 250-350 kN apiece while 16-30 jack groups brace on the last ring to push 20-60 mm/min at 20-60 MN. EPB balances advance rate against screw speed to hold chamber pressure at 0.1-0.3 MPa; each 1.2-2.0 m ring takes 6-8 segments with a key block, grouting the 5-10 cm void; min radius 250-500 m.

topics.descZh: 西屋三通阀的失败安全:列车管充风 500-600 kPa 即缓解,司机减压 40-140 kPa,各车滑阀换位、副风缸冲入制动缸推闸瓦;制动波以 250-300 m/s 传播,紧急制动尾部同时排气加速波前,断管即全列急刹。80 km/h 常用制动约数百米;动车组电控空气制动,350 km/h 紧急制动 ≤4,500 m、减速度 ~1.1 m/s²。
topics.descEn: Westinghouse's fail-safe triple valve: charge the pipe to 500-600 kPa to release; a 40-140 kPa reduction shifts every slide valve and reservoir air drives the brake shoes. The brake wave runs at 250-300 m/s, rear venting speeds it up in emergency, and a burst pipe brakes the whole train. A 350 km/h EMU stops within 4,500 m at ~1.1 m/s².

topics.descZh: 44 根字杆埋伏弧形槽,按键经联动杆把字杆甩出击打滚筒上的纸,同一拉杆抬起色带振动器并选红黑;走格棘轮每击放一齿,托架前进 2.54 mm(10 字符/英寸);前杆未落,锁板拦住后键防字杆纠缠;换行杆回车并转 1-3 行距(每行 4.23 mm),QWERTY 把常用字母对分给异侧手指,击键力约 45 N。
topics.descEn: 44 type bars wait in a curved slot; a key lever drives the universal bar that flings one bar onto the platen while lifting the ribbon vibrator (red/black). The escapement releases one tooth per strike, stepping the carriage 2.54 mm (10 cpi); until the bar lands, the interposer blocks the next key. Return lever homes the carriage and turns 1-3 line spaces of 4.23 mm.

topics.descZh: 标准顶角 118°、螺旋角约 30° 的两条刃沟,把切削、排屑、导向装进一根钻头:两主切削刃每转进给 f=2f_z,刃带留 0.2-0.5 mm 棱边导向;横刃前角 −54°~−60° 只挤不切,却扛下 40-50% 轴向力——修磨横刃是定心的关键;高速钢钻 45 钢 vc 20-30 m/min,深孔靠啄钻断屑,两刃不对称孔就扩大。
topics.descEn: Standard 118° point and ~30° helix pack cutting, chip evacuation and guidance into one tool: two lips feed f=2f_z per revolution, margins leave a 0.2-0.5 mm land to guide; the chisel edge at −54° to −60° rake only extrudes yet takes 40-50% of thrust - thinning it is the key to centering; HSS in steel runs vc 20-30 m/min, deep holes peck to break chips, and asymmetric lips open the hole.

topics.descZh: 一张 PTFE/橡胶膜往复变形改变腔容,配合两枚伞形止回阀完成吸入与排出——介质只碰膜与阀,全程零泄漏,腐蚀液、污泥、危化品都能搬;气动双隔膜 1/2-3 英寸流量 20-1000 L/min、限压 8.6 bar,自吸 5-7 m 还能干运行;单泵脉动大,双联错相 180° 平滑;出口堵死压力升到气源即停,不过压。
topics.descEn: A PTFE/rubber membrane flexes to change chamber volume while two umbrella check valves route suction and discharge - the media touches only membrane and valves, so it runs leak-free on corrosives, sludge and chemicals; air-operated doubles move 20-1000 L/min at 1/2-3 in with an 8.6 bar cap, self-prime 5-7 m and run dry; a single pump pulses, twins phased 180° smooth it; deadhead stops at supply pressure, never over-pressures.

topics.descZh: 方向盘拧的是一根扭杆:1-3 N·m/° 刚度把 2-6 N·m 手劲变成 2-8° 转角,转阀把 10-14 MPa 油导入齿条一侧,活塞以 5-12 kN 推齿条;居中时空循环、泵白耗 0.5-1 kW,EPS 按需供电省 0.1-0.3 L/100 km,失效后 25-40 N·m 人力仍能转向。
topics.descEn: Your wheel twists a torsion bar: 1-3 N·m/deg turns 2-6 N·m of effort into a 2-8 deg signal; the rotary valve routes 10-14 MPa oil into one rack chamber, and the piston pushes 5-12 kN so steering takes 2.5-3.5 turns lock to lock. Centered, oil free-circulates while the pump wastes 0.5-1 kW; EPS swaps in an on-demand motor saving 0.1-0.3 L/100 km, and 25-40 N·m of arm power still steers.

topics.descZh: 滚刀剪草机靠「剪」不靠「斩」:6 片 35° 螺旋刃以 1000-2500 rpm 把草按向固定底刀,刃口间隙仅 0.02-0.05 mm;剪切频率 = 叶数×转速/60 ≈ 30-150 Hz,螺旋让任一时刻只有 1-2 刃接触、扭矩平稳;刀钝则撕断发白失水,前进太快漏剪、太慢重剪。
topics.descEn: A reel mower shears, it does not chop: six 35 deg helical blades spin at 1000-2500 rpm, pressing grass against a fixed bedknife across a 0.02-0.05 mm gap - one sheet of paper. Cut frequency = blades x rpm/60, some 30-150 Hz, and the helix keeps only 1-2 edges in contact for smooth torque. Dull edges tear the grass white; ground speed must match blade frequency, or you miss strips or re-cut.

topics.descZh: 纺车用惯量换均匀:大轮经弦带以 6-15:1 速比把锭子带上千 rpm,锭子每转一周给纱加一个捻回,TPI = 锭速÷输出线速;捻回把靠摩擦抱合的平行纤维压成螺旋包缠,越捻越强、过捻打卷断裂(棉纱 α 3.5-4.5);拉出速度同时定细度与捻度,合股反向互锁 S/Z 捻。
topics.descEn: A spinning wheel trades inertia for evenness: the big wheel bands the spindle at 6-15:1 into thousands of rpm, and every revolution adds one twist - TPI = spindle speed / delivery speed. Twist packs friction-held parallel fibers into a helical wrap; strength climbs to a peak, then over-twist kinks and breaks the yarn (cotton alpha 3.5-4.5). Draw speed sets fineness and twist at once; plying Z with S locks the twist.

topics.descZh: 行星滚柱丝杠把滚珠的点接触换成滚柱螺纹的线接触:同直径动载荷 ×3-5、寿命 ×10,效率 ~90%;4-9 根滚柱既自转又公转,行星架锁定同步;导程 1-20 mm,电动缸、注塑机、飞机舵面靠它输出 1000 kN。
topics.descEn: Planetary roller screws swap ball point contact for thread line contact: 3-5x the dynamic load and 10x the life at the same diameter, ~90% efficiency; 4-9 rollers spin and orbit at once, held true by the carrier; 1-20 mm leads feed electric cylinders, presses and aircraft actuators pushing 1000 kN.

topics.descZh: 锁式线迹把底线锁在布层中间,链式让弯针线自己穿自己的环——拉伸 30-300%;包缝再加两件事:切刀削掉 2-3 mm 毛边、4 根线把布边包住;差动送布比 0.7-2.0 治针织物波浪,针速 5000-8500 spm。
topics.descEn: Lockstitch traps a bobbin thread inside the plies; chain stitch loops its own looper thread - stretching 30-300%. Overlock adds two more tricks: a knife trims 2-3 mm of fringe and four threads wrap the edge; differential feed at 0.7-2.0 tames knit rippling at 5000-8500 spm.

topics.descZh: 小电机慢慢把 280 kg 飞轮攒到 27.5 kJ,离合器一合,曲柄滑块在几十毫秒内放出最高 1000 kN 冲裁力;滑块速度 v∝sinθ,下死点附近趋零正好保压;飞轮每次速降 ≤10% 再由电机补回,料太厚时安全剪切销先断。
topics.descEn: A small motor slowly spins a 280 kg flywheel up to 27.5 kJ; snap the clutch and the crank-slider delivers up to 1000 kN of blanking force within milliseconds. Slide speed v∝sinθ dies toward bottom center - perfect for holding pressure. The flywheel gives up ≤10% per stroke and recharges; if the stock is too thick, a shear pin breaks first.

topics.titleEn: Torque Wrench & Ratchet: the Click of Preset Torque
topics.descZh: 扭矩是力乘力臂:T=F·L,45 cm 的杆用 200 N 的手劲就是 90 N·m。click 式扭矩扳手把「测扭矩」变成一次机械事件:滚珠被弹簧顶进凸轮凹槽,扭矩爬到预置值的瞬间滚珠沿肩台爬出、传动链脱开——「咔哒」一声打滑,套筒空转而螺栓停转,打滑本身就是测量完成的信号,重复精度 ±4%。而拧进螺栓的账很残酷:扭矩里约 50% 消耗在螺纹摩擦、40% 在螺帽支承面,只剩约 10% 变成预紧力 F=T/(K·d)(K≈0.2)——M12 螺栓拧到 80 N·m 才换来 33 kN 的预紧;再拧只会撞上屈服(~54 kN),螺栓塑性伸长、预紧力反而下跌。
topics.descEn: Torque is force times lever: T=F·L, so 200 N on a 45 cm handle is 90 N·m. A click-type wrench turns

topics.descZh: 滚筒里翻滚的钢球干的是工业最底层的活:把矿石与水泥熟料砸成微米级细粉,选矿厂约一半电耗花在这里。决定研磨命运的只有一个参数——转速。低速时,衬板提升条把球带到肩部就交还给重力,球沿料床滚滑而下,以磨剥缓慢研磨,叫泻落;升到临界转速的 65-80%,球被抛上抛物线飞越半个筒体,砸在趾部料床上,冲击破碎成为主角,叫抛落——这是所有球磨机的设计工作区;一旦达到临界转速 Nc=42.3/√D(rpm,D 为筒径 m),离心力把整荷压在筒壁上公转,研磨当场停止。拖动「转速」滑杆看三种命运切换,或按「转速巡游」从 20% 缓升到 110% Nc 再回落;填充率 25-40% 与大小球级配(大球砸粗料、小球磨细粉)是另外两门手艺。账本很残酷:真正用于产生新表面的能量不足 5%,其余全变成热与噪声。
topics.descEn: Steel balls tumbling in a rotating drum do the bluntest job in industry: crushing ore and cement clinker to micron powder - milling alone eats about half a concentrator s power bill. One parameter decides the fate of the charge: speed. Below ~60% of critical speed, lifters hand the balls back to gravity and they roll down the bed, grinding by abrasion - cascading. At 65-80% of Nc, balls are thrown clear, fly parabolas across the drum and hammer the toe of the charge - cataracting, the design window of every mill. At the critical speed Nc = 42.3/sqrt(D) rpm (D = inner diameter in m), centrifugal force pins the whole charge to the wall and grinding stops on the spot. Drag the speed slider to switch between the three fates, or press the speed tour to sweep from 20% up to 110% Nc and back; filling (25-40%) and ball grading (large balls smash coarse feed, small ones polish fines) complete the craft. The ledger is brutal: under 5% of the energy makes new surface, the rest becomes heat and noise.

topics.titleEn: Cycloidal Reducer: One Tooth Short, i = Zr-1
topics.descZh: 工业机器人关节、卫星太阳翼驱动与自动机床刀库里,最能扛冲击又停得准的,多半是它:摆线针轮减速器。全部秘密只有一句话——摆线轮比针齿壳内的针齿少一齿。电机驱动输入轴上的偏心套,把摆线轮甩着做半径 a 的圆平移;齿数差 1 逼着它沿针齿圈逐齿错位游走:输入每转一圈,摆线轮相对壳体反向自转恰好一个齿距,速比 i = Zr−1,18 针即 17:1,单级可做到 6-87。自转太慢、轴线又在晃,输出不能硬接,于是 W 机构登场:输出盘的 8 根柱销穿进摆线轮的 8 个孔,孔半径只比销大一个偏心距 a——公转被月牙缝隙吸收,自转原样交给输出轴。多齿同时受力(工程保证 ≥ Zr/3,理论约半数)带来极强的过载与抗冲击能力,背隙可压到 1 角分以内,单级效率 75-92%;两片摆线轮相错 180° 安装,偏心振动互相抵消。1930 年代德国 Loewe 与瑞士 Cyclo 使其实用化,今天的 RV 减速器再叠一级渐开线行星,成为机器人关节标配。按「过载接触分布」看针齿依次点亮应力条,拖「针齿数」滑杆从 9 到 21,速比当场从 8:1 变 20:1;示波器上绿(输入)红(输出)双锯齿的斜率之比就是 i。
topics.descEn: Inside industrial robot joints, satellite solar-array drives and machining-center tool changers, the reducer that shrugs off shock yet stops within an arcminute is usually a cycloidal pinwheel reducer. Its entire secret is one sentence: the cycloid disc has exactly one tooth fewer than the pins in the housing. A motor spins an eccentric sleeve on the input shaft, dragging the disc around a circle of radius a; the one-tooth difference forces the disc to creep tooth by tooth along the pin ring - each input revolution rolls the disc backwards by exactly one tooth pitch, giving ratio i = Zr-1. Eighteen pins mean 17:1; a single stage reaches 6-87. The disc turns too slowly and its axis wobbles, so the W mechanism takes over: eight pins on the output disc pass through eight holes in the cycloid disc, each hole cut larger than its pin by exactly the eccentricity a. The orbital component is absorbed by the crescent gap; only the slow reverse self-rotation reaches the output shaft. Because more than a third of the pins share the load at all times (about half in theory), the drive survives overloads that would strip ordinary gears, with backlash under 1 arcminute and 75-92% single-stage efficiency. Two identical discs mounted 180 degrees apart cancel the eccentric vibration. German Loewe and Swiss Cyclo industrialized it in the 1930s; todays RV reducers stack an involute planetary stage in front and dominate robot joints. Press the overload preset to watch loaded pins light up with stress bars, drag the pin-count slider from 9 to 21 and watch the ratio jump from 8:1 to 20:1; on the scope, the slope ratio of the green input and red output saws is the ratio itself.

topics.titleEn: Peaucellier: Drawing a Perfect Line with Bars
topics.descZh: 蒸汽机时代有一道让人头疼的几何题:活塞必须走绝对直线,否则气缸填料偏磨、漏汽;而把长导轨加工得足够平直,在当时贵得离谱。工程师们于是用铰接杆件「画」直线:瓦特 1784 年的直线机构只是近似——迹点走 8 字形的中段,仍有肉眼可见的弧偏差。1864 年,法国海军军官 Peaucellier 给出数学上精确的答案:菱形四短杆(长 r)加两根等长长杆(长 R),枢轴 O 与两端 P、Q 永远共线,恒等式 OP·OQ = R²−r² 保证 Q 是 P 关于半径 √(R²−r²) 圆的反演点;再用一根曲柄把 P 钉在过 O 的圆上,反演就把圆变成一条真正的直线——第一台精确直线机构,1873 年经法兰西科学院验证。拖「短杆 r」滑杆看直线位置 k/(2p) 随之移动;按「奇异位形」把曲柄推向 OP = R−r 的死点:五杆压成一条线、杆力倍数飙升、Q 当场折返——反演的边界现场演示。1876 年 Kempe 更证明任意代数曲线都能用连杆画出,「平面杆系=几何计算机」由此写进教科书;今天直线任务交给滚动导轨,但反演机构仍在精密仪器与课堂上转动。
topics.descEn: The steam age faced an awkward geometry problem: a piston must move in a perfect straight line or the cylinder packing wears unevenly and leaks steam, yet machining a long truly straight guideway was ruinously expensive. So engineers tried to draw lines with hinged bars. Watts 1784 linkage was only approximate - its trace point rides the middle of a figure eight and still sags visibly. In 1864 the French naval officer Charles-Nicolas Peaucellier found the exact answer: a rhombus of four short bars (length r) hung between two equal long bars (length R), arranged so that the pivot O and the ends P and Q stay collinear while the product OP x OQ stays equal to the constant R2-r2. Point Q is therefore the inversion of P in the circle of radius sqrt(R2-r2), and inversion maps any circle through O onto a straight line. Add a crank that pins P to such a circle and Q must draw a true line - the first exact straight-line mechanism, verified by the French Academy of Sciences in 1873. Drag the short-bar slider and watch the line position k/(2p) move; press the singularity preset and drive the crank to the dead point OP = R-r: five bars flatten into one line, the bar-force factor spikes and Q reverses on the spot. In 1876 Kempe proved that linkages can trace any algebraic curve, and planar bar chains entered textbooks as geometric computers. Rolling guides do the job today, but the inverter still turns in precision instruments and classrooms.

topics.titleZh: 椭圆齿轮与非圆节曲线
topics.titleEn: Elliptic Gears: The Ratio That Breathes
topics.descZh: 圆齿轮的节圆半径处处相等,所以传动比恒定;把节曲线换成椭圆,传动比立刻开始「呼吸」。两枚全等椭圆各绕一个焦点安装、中心距 2a:接触点永远落在连心线上,瞬时传动比 i = r₂/r₁;椭圆的极径 r(θ) = a(1−e²)/(1+e·cosθ) 在 a(1−e) 与 a(1+e) 之间周期变化,速比于是每转摆动一次,在 (1+e)/(1−e) 与 (1−e)/(1+e) 之间来回——e = 0.4 时是 2.33 与 0.43,输出轴快慢肉眼可见。包装机与印刷机正是用这段慢-快-慢:慢段完成裁切与停帧,快段拉开料距。反过来用就是椭圆齿轮流量计:两枚卵形轮每月牙腔排过固定体积,转数直接累加成总量,精度 ±0.2-0.5%,且与粘度基本无关,油品与化工计量仍在用。这一切都服从同一条啮合基本定律——接触点公法线过节点,只是节点不再固定,而沿中心线滑动。拖「偏心率 e」滑杆从 0.02 到 0.6,看速比指针摆幅与输送带上包裹的快慢节拍;按「定容计量」看月牙腔充排与累计流量;按「圆齿轮对照」回到 e≈0 的恒速世界。
topics.descEn: A circular gear has a pitch circle of constant radius, so its ratio never changes; swap the pitch curve for an ellipse and the ratio starts to breathe. Mount two identical ellipses, each pivoted about one focus, with center distance 2a: the contact point always lies on the line of centers and the instantaneous ratio is the inverse ratio of the two pitch radii, i = r2/r1. The polar radius of an ellipse is r = a(1-e2)/(1+e cos), swinging between a(1-e) and a(1+e), so the ratio oscillates once per revolution between (1+e)/(1-e) and (1-e)/(1+e) - that is 2.33 and 0.43 at e = 0.4, and the output shaft visibly speeds up and slows down. Packaging and printing machines exploit exactly this slow-fast-slow cadence: cutting and registration during the slow phase, material advance during the fast one. Run the idea backwards and you get the oval-gear flow meter: two lobed rotors displace a fixed crescent volume per passage, so the revolution count is the delivered volume, good to 0.2-0.5% and nearly independent of viscosity - still standard for fuel and chemical dosing. All of it obeys the same fundamental law of gearing: the common normal at contact passes through the pitch point, which simply slides along the line of centers. Drag the eccentricity slider from 0.02 to 0.6 and watch the ratio needle swing and the parcels pulse; press the metering preset for crescents filling and draining with a running total, or the round-gear preset to return to the constant-ratio world of e = 0.

topics.titleZh: 机械警报器:打孔圆盘与气流斩波
topics.titleEn: The Siren: Chopping Air into Sound
topics.descZh: 警报器里没有振膜,也没有音圈:它把连续气流直接斩成压力脉冲。电机带着打孔圆盘(转子)旋转,贴着它是一块同样开孔的定子盘;气源从背后持续吹气,只有转子孔与定子孔对齐的一瞬气流才被放行——转子每转一圈、每个孔放行一次,连续气流被斩成方波状的压力脉冲串,输出频率 f = 孔数×转速/60。方波调制意味着基频之外还带丰富谐波,人耳对 3-6 kHz 最敏感:转子 60-120 孔、约 3000 rpm 正好落在这一带,配上 1-5 kW 的功率,在 30 m 处仍有 120 dB 以上的声压级,可传 3-5 km;高频在空气中衰减快,大型双转子警报器刻意做出低频主音才传得远。英国双音警报更妙:同一转子开两组孔数不同的孔环,同转产生相差一个小三度的双音,警报一响自带辨识度。没有电的手摇警报器靠 1:30 齿轮增速,摇到 100 rpm 就能输出 3000 rpm。拖「转速」「孔数」滑杆看示波器基频当场变调;按「双音警报」合成双音,按「手摇增速」看 1:30 增速,按「粒子斩波特写」慢看气流被孔盘切成脉冲串。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A siren has no diaphragm and no voice coil: it chops a continuous airstream straight into pressure pulses. A motor spins a perforated disk - the rotor - past an identically drilled stator plate, while air is blown steadily from behind. Only at the instant a rotor hole lines up with a stator hole does the air get through: every revolution releases each hole once, slicing the steady flow into a square-ish train of pressure pulses at frequency f = holes x rpm/60. Square-wave modulation drags a rich set of harmonics along with the fundamental, and human hearing peaks at 3-6 kHz - exactly where a 60-120 hole rotor at about 3000 rpm lands. With 1-5 kW behind it, that is still above 120 dB at 30 m, audible 3-5 km away; because high frequencies fade fast in air, the big dual-rotor sirens deliberately add a low-frequency dominant tone to carry the distance. The British dual-tone siren is cleverer still: two rings of different hole counts on one rotor sound two tones a minor third apart - instantly recognisable. Hand-cranked sirens use a 1:30 gear step-up: crank at 100 rpm and the rotor spins at 3000. Drag the rpm and hole-count sliders to retune the fundamental live; press dual-tone alarm, hand-crank step-up, or the particle-chopping closeup to watch air sliced into pulses. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleEn: Vibratory Bowl Feeder: Parts That Climb
topics.descZh: 自动装配线的第一环往往是一台电磁振动盘:料斗里几百个散乱零件,要被理成单列、姿态一致的队伍交给装配线。它的全部动力来自底部电磁铁与斜装弹簧片板:线圈通入 50/100 Hz 半波脉冲,电磁力把料斗拉起又释放,倾角 15-25° 的弹簧片板把这道垂直冲动偏转成「垂直上抛+切向扭转」的复合振动——零件每次腾空几毫米,沿升角仅 2-4° 的螺旋轨道逐级爬升,在盘径 100-600 mm 的料斗里一圈圈转到顶部出口;送料速度 0-20 m/min,调线圈电流即调振幅、调速度,单件节拍可达每分钟数百件。轨道上装着定向元件:选向槽放行躺倒的正确零件,挡板把站立的错误姿态当场拨回料斗「重浇」,只有姿态合格者才能继续前进——一次合格率直接决定上料效率。最巧的是省功之道:弹簧刚度与料斗质量调谐在激振频率附近(共振),小功率即可撑起大振幅,一旦偏离共振点,振幅骤降、送料近乎停摆。拖「激振频率」跨过共振点看振幅突变,拖「驱动电流」调速度,拖「合格率」看剔除比例;按「共振扫频」看幅频曲线扫过峰顶,按「定向特写」慢放挡板拨落错误零件的瞬间。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The first link of almost every automatic assembly line is a vibratory bowl feeder: a hopper of hundreds of jumbled parts must be refined into a neat, consistently-oriented single file. All of its power comes from an electromagnet and inclined leaf springs at the base. The coil receives 50/100 Hz half-wave pulses; magnetic force lifts the bowl and lets it go, and the spring stack, canted 15-25 degrees, rotates that vertical impulse into a compound vibration of vertical tossing plus tangential twisting. Parts hop a few millimetres at a time up a spiral track whose rise angle is only 2-4 degrees, circling bowls of 100-600 mm diameter until they exit at the top. Feed rate runs 0-20 m/min - coil current sets amplitude, amplitude sets speed - and one track can deliver several hundred parts per minute. Along the track sit orientation elements: a selector slot passes correctly-lying parts, while a baffle flicks wrongly-oriented standing parts straight back into the bowl for re-feeding. Only good orientation continues, so first-pass yield directly decides feeding efficiency. The cleverest trick is economy: spring stiffness and bowl mass are tuned near the excitation frequency, so resonance lets a small coil power sustain a large amplitude; stray off resonance and the amplitude collapses, stalling the feed. Drag the frequency slider across resonance to watch amplitude jump, drag drive current to change speed, drag first-pass yield to change rejections; press resonance sweep to trace the response peak, orientation closeup to slow-motion the baffle flick. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 扭杆弹簧:一根钢杆撑起坦克
topics.titleEn: Torsion Bar: A Steel Rod as a Spring
topics.descZh: 一根一头固定、另一头被摆臂拧转的钢杆,就是坦克的『板簧』:扭转刚度 k = G·J/L,G 是剪切模量(钢约 79 GPa),J = πd⁴/32 是极惯性矩——直径的四次方是命门,直径加倍、刚度翻 16 倍。工作时扭杆在 ±30-50° 转角内反复扭动,表层剪应力高达 800-1000 MPa,只有超高强度钢叠加热处理与喷丸预应力处理才扛得住;储能 U = ½kθ²,一根直径 55 mm、长 2.2 m 的扭杆可存约 6 kJ,撑起数吨重的负重轮。坦克车体里它横向贯穿布置,不占车内空间,同份储能比螺旋弹簧更紧凑;克莱斯勒轿车、雪铁龙 2CV、车库门翻板也都是它的用户。装配时的预扭初始角用来调车身高度,而疲劳或冲击导致的断杆,意味着那个角的悬挂当场塌落。拖「杆径」看刚度按四次方跳变,拖「载荷」看应力沿半径线性加深——表面最大、轴心为零——悬挂被压下;按「坦克布局」看扭杆横贯车体,按「应力剖面」看放大截面,按「与螺旋弹簧对照」比一比紧凑程度;把杆径调小、载荷拉满超过约 1000 MPa,扭杆当场断裂、悬挂塌落。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A steel rod fixed at one end and twisted at the other by a swing arm is a spring - the whole suspension of a main battle tank can hang off a rack of them. Torsional stiffness is k = G*J/L, with G the shear modulus (about 79 GPa for steel) and J = pi*d^4/32 the polar second moment: the fourth power of diameter is the whole game - double the diameter and stiffness jumps sixteen-fold. Working twist spans plus or minus 30-50 degrees and surface shear stress reaches 800-1000 MPa, which only ultra-high-strength steel with heat treatment and shot-peened prestress can survive. Stored energy U = 0.5*k*theta^2: one 55 mm bar, 2.2 m long, holds about 6 kJ and carries a road wheel of several tonnes. Tanks run the bars transversely right through the hull, spending no cabin space - more compact for the same stored energy than coil springs - and Chrysler cars, the Citroen 2CV and garage doors use the same trick. The pre-twist angle set at assembly fixes ride height, and a fatigued or overloaded bar means that corner of the suspension collapses on the spot. Drag the diameter slider and watch stiffness leap with the fourth power; drag the load and watch stress colour deepen linearly from axis (zero) to surface (maximum) while the suspension compresses. Press tank layout to see bars crossing the hull, stress profile for the magnified cross-section, coil comparison to weigh compactness - and push diameter down with load up past about 1000 MPa to snap the bar and drop that corner. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 电火花加工:用火花蚀掉最硬的钢
topics.titleEn: Electrical Discharge Machining: Sparking Away the Hardest Steel
topics.descZh: 车铣啃不动的淬硬钢,电火花加工却能轻松成型——它根本不靠力,而是靠电。工具电极与工件一起浸在工作液(煤油或去离子水)里,伺服系统把两者间隙稳在 10-50 μm;每个微秒级脉冲(脉宽 1-2000 μs、峰值电流 1-100 A)都在间隙最薄处击穿液体,拉出一条瞬时 8000-12000 °C 的火花放电通道,局部金属瞬间熔化汽化;脉冲结束气泡爆裂,加上工作液冲刷,把熔融金属珠整锅抛进液体,工件表面留下微米级蚀坑。放电频率可达每秒数十万次,亿万微坑层层累积成所需型腔。硬度在这里毫无意义,唯一门槛是导电——淬硬钢、硬质合金都能加工,这是它对切削加工的碾压点。工作液身兼四职:平时绝缘、击穿后冷却压缩通道、冲走蚀除物、消电离复原。极性有讲究:短脉冲(脉宽小于约 50 μs)时工件接正极蚀除量更大;重铸层只有几微米厚。伺服一旦检测到短路立即回退,绝不硬顶。线切割是它的变体:移动的钼丝/黄铜丝做电极,能切出任意轮廓。典型指标:表面粗糙度 Ra 0.1-10 μm,去除率 mm³/min 量级。演示里看电极逼近、火花在最薄点爆闪、蚀坑累积成腔;拉高峰值电流看蚀坑变大、表面变粗;按「短路回退」看伺服急退;切「线切割模式」看钼丝切缝贯通落料。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Hardened steel that mills and lathes cannot touch yields to EDM - because it cuts with electricity, not force. The tool electrode and workpiece soak together in a dielectric fluid (kerosene or deionized water) while a servo holds their gap at 10-50 μm; every microsecond pulse (1-2000 μs on-time, 1-100 A peak) breaks down the fluid at its thinnest point and strikes a spark channel at 8000-12000 °C, melting and vaporizing a micro-spot of metal. When the pulse ends the bubble collapses, and together with the flushing flow the molten beads are hurled into the fluid, leaving a micron-sized crater on the surface. Discharges repeat up to hundreds of thousands of times per second, and billions of micro-craters pile up into the cavity you need. Hardness means nothing here - conductivity is the only entry ticket: hardened steel and carbide are all fair game, the very edge EDM holds over cutting. The fluid wears four hats: insulator at rest, channel compressor and coolant after breakdown, chip flusher, and deionizer for recovery. Polarity matters: with short pulses (below about 50 μs) the workpiece goes positive and erodes faster; the recast layer is only a few microns thick. The servo retreats the instant it senses a short - never pushing its luck. Wire EDM is the variant: a traveling molybdenum or brass wire becomes the electrode and cuts any contour. Typical figures: surface roughness Ra 0.1-10 μm, removal rates in the mm³/min class. In the demo watch the electrode approach, sparks flash at the thinnest points and craters grow into a cavity; raise the peak current to see craters deepen and the surface roughen; press short-retract to watch the servo lunge back; switch to wire mode to see the wire slice through and drop the piece. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 齿轮根切与变位:少齿数难题
topics.titleEn: Gear Undercut and Profile Shift: The Few-Teeth Problem
topics.descZh: 滚齿机为什么不直接「刻」出齿形?因为齿轮用的是展成法:刀具齿条与齿坯按啮合关系对滚,刀刃一系列位置的包络线自动形成精确渐开线——换一个齿数只需改传动比,不必换刀具。但展成有条生死线:刀具工作齿廓与基圆相切于啮合极限点 N,齿条刀只能展成到 N 为止;齿数太少(不根切最少齿数 z_min=2ha*/sin²α,α=20°、ha*=1 时约 17 齿),刀具齿顶线越过 N,刀尖就把齿根已展成的渐开线连同根部材料一起犁掉——根切:齿根变弱、重合度下降。解药是变位:刀具沿径向外移 x·m(正变位),x ≥ (17−z)/17 即可避开根切,齿根增厚、抗弯强度提高;代价是齿顶变尖、重合度略降。等变位(x1+x2=0)中心距不变、可配凑速比;角变位 a′=a·cosα/cosα′ 能凑非标中心距;变位还能均衡两轮滑动率、延长磨损寿命——所以变速箱里几乎每只齿轮都标注变位系数。演示:看齿条刀往复冲程+齿坯对滚展成齿形,「画刀尖轨迹」实时画出余摆线,齿数滑到 10 看轨迹挖进齿根;再拉变位滑块,根切消失、齿形变胖;按「对照成品齿轮」叠出标准齿形;按「角变位中心距」看 25 齿配轮如何在 a′ 处啮合。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Why does a hobbing machine not simply carve the tooth shape?
