Because gears use the generating method: the cutter rack and the blank roll together like a meshing pair, and the envelope of the cutting-edge positions automatically forms an exact involute - change the tooth count and you only change the ratio, not the cutter. But generation has a life-or-death line: the working flank of the tool is tangent to the base circle at the limit point N, and a rack cutter can generate only up to N. With too few teeth (the undercut-free minimum is z_min = 2ha*/sin²α, about 17 teeth at α=20°, ha*=1), the tool tip line crosses N and the corner plows away the freshly generated involute together with root material - undercut: a weakened root and reduced contact ratio. The remedy is profile shift: move the cutter outward by x·m (positive shift), and x ≥ (17−z)/17 avoids undercut while thickening the root and raising bending strength; the price is a pointed tip and a slightly lower contact ratio. Equal shift (x1+x2=0) keeps the center distance and helps match ratios; the angle-modified center distance a′ = a·cosα/cosα′ fits non-standard spacings; shift also balances specific sliding and extends wear life - which is why nearly every gear in a gearbox carries a shift coefficient. In the demo watch the rack stroke and roll with the blank to generate the profile; draw the tip trochoid live and slide the tooth count to 10 to see it dig into the root; pull the shift slider to cure the undercut and fatten the teeth; overlay the standard gear for comparison; press angle-shift center distance to see a 25-tooth mate mesh at a′. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 航母电磁弹射:直线电机替掉蒸汽活塞
topics.titleEn: Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch: A Linear Motor Replaces the Steam Piston
topics.descZh: 蒸汽弹射器靠储汽罐里的高压蒸汽在汽缸里猛推活塞:放汽阀门机械调节,力量是「一波流」——开头最猛、越推越衰,能量利用率只有 4-6%,汽缸与储汽系统要占 1100+ m³,还得烧淡水造汽;对 30 吨的重型舰载机勉强够用,对几吨的轻型无人机,开头那一下就容易过载掰坏机体。电磁弹射(EMALS)把活塞整个换成直线电机:弹射槽下沿程埋几百段定子线圈,长约 30 m 的拖曳梭就是「转子」,电力电子只给梭子所在的那几段定子通电——一段行波磁场托着梭子往前跑,空着的段不通电、不发热,能量几乎不浪费。能量由飞轮储能器供给:平时慢慢转着攒动能,单台可输出 120 MJ 级,弹射瞬间经逆变器 3 秒倾泻,把飞机加速到 70-100 m/s,弹一架间隔约 45 s。最关键的红利是闭环可编程:实时测梭子位置与速度,按飞机质量定制推力曲线——5 吨无人机到 30 吨舰载机各自拿到自己的加速度谱,峰值平滑、过载可控;断能即失力,故障段直接跳过。演示里拖动「飞机质量」「目标末速」滑块,看推力与加速度曲线实时重算;按「蒸汽对照」切换锯齿/平滑两种加速度同屏对垒;按「飞轮储能」看储能-倾泻循环;按「段供电透视」看发光定子段追着梭子跑。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A steam catapult uses high-pressure steam from an accumulator to slam a piston down its cylinder: the release valve is mechanical and the force arrives as one big wave - fiercest at the start, fading toward the end. Energy efficiency is only 4-6%, the cylinder and steam train occupy over 1100 cubic meters and needs freshwater boiled into steam; it barely suffices for a 30-ton fighter, but for a light drone of a few tons the opening jolt can overload and snap the airframe. EMALS replaces the piston with a linear motor: hundreds of stator coil segments are buried along the launch groove, and the roughly 30 m shuttle is the rotor - power electronics energize only the segments under the shuttle, so a traveling wave of magnetism carries it forward while empty segments draw no current and make no heat, wasting almost no energy. The energy comes from flywheel accumulators that spin slowly to bank kinetic energy - a single unit outputs on the order of 120 MJ - then dumps it through inverters within 3 seconds, hurling the aircraft to 70-100 m/s with about 45 s between launches. The key dividend is closed-loop programmability: shuttle position and speed are measured in real time and the thrust curve is tailored to the aircraft mass - a 5-ton drone and a 30-ton fighter each get their own acceleration spectrum with smooth peaks and controlled overload; cut the power and the force vanishes; a faulty segment is simply skipped. In the demo, drag the mass and exit-speed sliders to watch thrust and acceleration recompute live; press steam compare to pit sawtooth against smooth acceleration on one scope; press flywheel charge to see the store-and-dump cycle; press segment x-ray to watch lit stator segments chase the shuttle. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 巴贝奇差分机与进位链
topics.descZh: 布莱切利园之前一百年,计算机就是一个黄铜梦:巴贝奇 1822 年设计差分机,只为一件枯燥的事——造航海表。多项式不用乘法也能列表:任何 n 次多项式的 n 阶差分是常数,于是每一列寄存器只需把本列数值加给左邻列,常数差逐级传递,最左列就滚出多项式值——算 x²+x+41 这种「素数制造机」时,41、43、47、53、61、71……全部由纯加法产生。机器的真正难点在进位:个位轮 9 加 1 要拨十位,十位恰好又是 9 时进位会连锁爆发;巴贝奇用斜齿轮「预期进位」——低位进位请求先在斜面上排队瞄准,等本位转完统一一次击发,把最坏情形从逐位串行压缩成两拍。整机为 6 阶差分、31 位数字、25000 个零件,1832 年造出 1/7 样机即惊艳;1991 年伦敦科学博物馆照图纸复刻 15 吨整机,一次摇柄误差为零——证明设计本身就成立。舍茨兄弟 1853 年做出第一台可用的差分机,为英美印了几十年的历表。演示里六列数字轮随摇柄逐列相加、进位涟漪沿位链闪光传递,输出轮滚出素数。拖「步数」连续摇机,拖「差分阶数」换 x²/x³ 或更高阶;按「素数冲刺」连摇 30 步,按「进位特写」慢放 999+1 的连锁,按「预期进位」看斜齿轮排队击发。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A hundred years before Bletchley Park, the computer was a brass dream: Babbage designed the Difference Engine in 1822 for one dull job - tabulating nautical tables. Polynomials can be tabulated without any multiplication: the n-th finite difference of an n-th-degree polynomial is a constant, so each column of registers just adds its own value to its left neighbour, the constant differences cascade upward, and the leftmost column rolls out successive polynomial values - for the "prime factory" x^2+x+41 it churns out 41, 43, 47, 53, 61, 71... all by pure addition. The real difficulty is carrying: adding 1 to a wheel showing 9 must nudge the tens wheel, and if that one also shows 9 the carry erupts into a chain. Babbage solved it with skewed "anticipating carriage" gears - carry requests queue up on the ramps first, then fire in one unified stroke after each wheel finishes, compressing the worst case from digit-by-digit serial propagation into two beats. The full machine was 6th order, 31 digits, 25,000 parts; a seventh-scale section built in 1832 dazzled, and in 1991 the Science Museum built the 15-ton engine from his drawings alone - it runs with zero error, proving the design was sound all along. The Scheutz father-and-son team built the first working machine in 1853 and printed decades of tables for Britain and America. In the demo six columns of figure wheels add column by column with each crank, carry ripples flashing down the digit chain as the output rolls out primes. Drag the steps slider to crank continuously, drag the order slider to switch x^2/x^3 or higher; press prime run for 30 steps, carry closeup to slow-motion 999+1, anticipating carriage to watch the ramp gears queue and fire. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 六列黄铜数字轮(每列一摞位轮,当前值以数字标签显示);摇柄连杆动画;各列向左传数的拨爪;进位时位轮闪光;输出列单独放大;地板是 difference table 网格。

topics.titleEn: The Gyrocompass: Finding True North Inertially
topics.descZh: 磁罗经在钢铁船上是废物:船体磁场能把指针拖偏几十度。1908 年安许茨与斯佩里给出解法——不靠磁,靠惯性:高速陀螺的轴在惯性系里指向不变,而地球在脚下 15°/小时地转,于是站在船上会看到陀螺轴相对地球缓慢漂移,纬度 φ 处的水平漂移速率恰为 15°·sinφ(度/小时)。诀窍是给陀螺挂上摆性配重:轴一旦偏离东-西水平位,地球自转会让轴端翘起或下沉,配重重力随即产生进动力矩,把轴往子午面推——「地球自转当引擎,重力当舵」,轴便围着真北打圈收敛,加上阻尼后几分钟内稳稳指向真北。它指的是真北而非磁北,天然免掉磁差修正,不受任何电磁干扰,潜艇、军舰、远洋巨轮至今仍以它为姿态基准;缺点是要通电启动、纬度高于约 75° 后效果衰减。相位平面上一目了然:无阻尼时轴端绕平衡点画椭圆,加阻尼变成螺旋汇入真北。演示里地球在脚下自转、陀螺仪万向环上轴端轨迹被灯光描出。拖「纬度」看漂移速率按 sinφ 变化,拖「初始偏角」换起点;按「无阻尼振荡」看椭圆,按「阻尼收敛」看螺旋入北,按「铁船对照」看磁罗经在船舱里失灵。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A magnetic compass is useless on a steel ship: the hull's magnetism can drag the needle tens of degrees off. In 1908 Anschuetz and Sperry each offered the fix - no magnetism, inertia instead: a fast gyro's axis holds its direction in the inertial frame while the Earth turns beneath it at 15 degrees per hour, so standing on the ship you see the axis drift relative to the ground at a horizontal rate of 15 deg x sin(latitude) per hour. The trick is a pendulous weight: once the axis leaves the east-west horizontal, Earth's rotation makes its tip rise or dip, gravity on the weight then produces a precession torque that pushes the axis toward the meridian - Earth as the engine, gravity as the rudder - and the axis spirals onto true north, settling within minutes once damping is added. It reads true north, not magnetic, needs no declination correction, and ignores electromagnetic interference; submarines, warships and ocean liners still use it as the attitude reference. Its costs: power-up time, and effectiveness fading above roughly 75 degrees latitude. On the phase plane it is obvious: undamped, the axis tip draws an ellipse around equilibrium; damped, a spiral converging on north. In the demo the Earth rotates beneath while the tip trace lights up on the gimbal. Drag latitude to watch the drift rate follow sin(phi), drag initial offset to change the start; press undamped oscillation for the ellipse, damped convergence for the spiral, iron-ship comparison to watch a magnetic compass fail below decks. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半透明地球(带经纬网)自转;上方悬三环万向架+高速转子(旋转纹理/盘);轴端小灯+拖尾轨迹;摆性配重(金色);地面小船与失效的磁罗经(红针乱摆);轴指北后出现绿色 N 光柱。

topics.descZh: 一台售货机要在三秒内回答三个问题:这是不是钱、是不是足够的钱、货掉下去没有。硬币从投币口滑入后先过「尺寸门」——直径与厚度任一超标当场分流到退币槽;再穿「材质关」:一组电磁传感器测涡流响应与电导率,真币的合金特征曲线对不上就判假币,钢芯镀层币在这一关现形;通过后按面值累加余额。余额够了,按键选中货道:电机的螺旋货道转过整圈,把最前排一件商品推出货架,商品坠入取货口时遮断一道红外光束——「出货确认」只有在光束被遮后才允许找零与结算,光束没断就是卡货,机器自动把钱退回或推下一位。整个闭环里最贵的是信任:日本售货机年流通硬币以千亿枚计,欺诈手段从棉线吊币到游戏币伪造,逼出了「光电确认+重量复核+退币口单向门」这套组合拳。演示里跟着一枚硬币走完鉴别全程,再看螺旋货道转一圈出货。拖「投币节奏」连续喂币,拖「货道圈数」看出货运动学;按「假币攻击」看钢芯币被弹回,按「卡货检测」看光束常通触发的退款,按「找零流程」看硬币雨。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A vending machine must answer three questions in three seconds: is this money, is it enough money, and did the product drop. A coin sliding in first passes the size gate - wrong diameter or thickness diverts it straight to the return slot; then the material test: a bank of electromagnetic sensors measures eddy-current response and conductivity, and a steel-core counterfeit betrays itself by its signature. Only then is the balance credited. With enough credit a button selects a helix rack: the motor turns the coil exactly one revolution, pushing the front item off the shelf; as it falls into the bay it breaks an infrared beam - drop confirmation. Only a broken beam allows the sale to settle and change to be paid; a beam left unbroken means a hang-up, and the machine returns the credit automatically. The expensive part of the loop is trust: Japanese machines alone churn through hundreds of billions of coins a year, and scams from string-tied coins to slugged tokens forced the combination of optical confirmation, weight checks and one-way return slots. In the demo, follow one coin through validation, then watch a helix turn one full revolution to vend. Drag coin cadence to keep feeding coins, drag helix turns to study the dispensing kinematics; press counterfeit attack to watch a steel-core coin bounce back, jam detection to see an unbroken beam trigger a refund, change-making for a rain of coins. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 玻璃柜+三层螺旋货道(弹簧螺线+商品圆柱);投币口→斜坡滚道→尺寸门(两道缝)→传感器线圈(发光环)→储币箱;出货口红外光束(红色光带);退币槽;硬币小球沿轨道滚动的物理。

topics.descZh: 几条弧形钢板摞在一起,就是一台既承重又减振的「叠叠乐」:主片两端卷成卷耳用销轴连到车架,其余各片渐次缩短,中央用中心螺栓夹成一体,骑马螺栓把它捆在车桥上。车轮跳起来,力从卷耳传进来,整叠钢板被压扁——弧高减小、刚度上升,把冲击存成弹性势能;而真正的魔法在片与片之间:钢板受弯时各层要滑移,干燥钢面对钢面的摩擦把一大部分振动能量当场磨成热量,弹簧自己就是自己的减振器——老卡车过坎后「咯吱」作响,正是片间摩擦在干活。片数还是天然的变刚度开关:空载时只有主片与次片受力,刚度小、颠簸轻;满载重压下更多短片参加进弯矩分配,刚度与承载一起涨——一条弹簧同时伺候空车与满载。代价是片间摩擦可能卡滞:小颠簸被摩擦锁住直接传进车身,所以现代轿车改用螺旋弹簧加油压减振器,钢板弹簧留在了货车与硬派越野车上——结构简单、能吃重、坏了换一片就能走。拖「载荷」看弧高与刚度变化,拖「板片数」看谁参加受力;按「过坎冲击」看能量进出的账本,按「卷耳特写」看端部怎么留出滑移空间,按「片间摩擦」看振动被磨成热量。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Stack a few curved steel plates and you have a load carrier and a damper in one: the main leaf rolls into eyes at both ends, bushed on pins to the frame; shorter leaves stack beneath, all clamped by a center bolt and strapped to the axle with U-bolts. When the wheel kicks up, force flows in through the eyes and the pack flattens - arc height shrinks, stiffness rises, storing the bump as elastic energy. The magic is between the leaves: as the pack bends, the layers must slip past each other, and dry steel-on-steel friction burns a large share of the vibration into heat on the spot - the spring is its own shock absorber, which is why old trucks squeak through potholes. Leaf count is a built-in variable-stiffness switch: empty, only the main and first short leaves work, so the ride stays soft; fully loaded, the shorter leaves join the bending game and stiffness climbs with payload - one spring serves both the empty run and the overloaded one. The price is stiction: small jolts get locked by friction and passed straight to the body, which is why modern cars moved to coil springs plus hydraulic dampers, leaving leaf packs to trucks and off-roaders - simple, overload-tolerant, and field-repairable one leaf at a time. Drag the load to watch arc height and stiffness change, drag the leaf count to see who takes the bending; press bump strike for the energy ledger, spring eye closeup for how the ends leave room to slip, interleaf friction to watch vibration burn into heat. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 一叠渐短钢板(主片卷耳+中心螺栓+骑马螺栓)压在车桥上;过坎时整叠压扁、片端滑移闪红发热;弧高-刚度标尺;与螺旋弹簧+减振器方案并排对比。

topics.descZh: 卡盘要回答一个刁钻的问题:三只卡爪怎么保证同时收到圆心?答案是藏在卡爪下面的「盘丝」:一块圆盘正面铣出阿基米德螺旋槽(平面螺纹),三只卡爪背面各镶一排与槽啮合的齿,互相错开 120° 插进同一条槽。扳手转动锥齿轮、带动盘丝旋转,螺旋半径随转角线性增大,于是三只爪在同一瞬间都沿各自径向槽滑动——同一条螺线、同一圈牙距,天生同心:夹毛坯棒料,跳动只有 0.05-0.15 mm,三爪自定心卡盘因此成了车床上用得最多的夹具。它的误差也来自这条螺线:牙距磨损不均、爪背与盘槽之间掉进铁屑、或盘丝分度有误差,跳动就被放大——精度要求高时改用四爪单动卡盘,每只爪独立调整,靠百分表找正到 0.01 mm;或者换软爪在自己机床上车一刀,让爪口长出与主轴完全同心的弧。夹紧力也是账本:扳手放大约 40 倍手力,但离心力随转速把卡爪往外甩,高速车削时夹紧力缩水,重切削必须算转速上限。拖「扳手转角」看三爪同步开合,拖「工件直径」看爪的行程;按「盘丝特写」看螺旋槽与爪齿的啮合,按「装夹误差」看铁屑如何制造跳动。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A chuck must answer a tricky question: how do three jaws all arrive at the exact center at once? The answer is the scroll hidden under them: a disc machined with an Archimedean spiral groove on its face, each jaw carrying a row of teeth engaged with that same groove, spaced 120 degrees apart. Turn the key, a bevel gear spins the scroll, and because the spiral's radius grows linearly with angle, all three jaws slide radially in the same instant - one groove, one tooth pitch, concentric by construction: gripping a raw bar leaves only 0.05-0.15 mm of runout, which is why the three-jaw self-centering chuck is the lathe's default workholder. Its errors come from the same groove: uneven tooth wear, a chip caught between jaw and scroll, or indexing error in the scroll itself all amplify runout - precision work switches to a four-jaw independent chuck tuned against a dial indicator to 0.01 mm, or cuts soft jaws in place so the bore grows truly concentric with its own spindle. Grip force has its own ledger: the key multiplies hand force about fortyfold, but centrifugal force flings the jaws outward as speed rises - at high rpm the grip thins, and heavy cuts demand a speed ceiling. Drag the key angle to open and close all three jaws in sync, drag the workpiece diameter to travel the jaws; press scroll closeup to watch teeth ride the spiral groove, chucking error to see a chip manufacture runout. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 卡盘剖视:盘丝(阿基米德螺旋槽发光)、三只带齿卡爪错开 120°、锥齿轮与扳手孔;中心夹持旋转棒料,跳动表盘实时显示;嵌入铁屑时爪行程异常、跳动变大。

topics.descZh: 液压系统最怕两件事:泵供油忽快忽慢,以及断电时执行器当场瘫痪。蓄能器是这台机器的「充电宝」:一只耐压钢瓶里装着充氮气的皮囊,油口在下——油不可压缩,气可以,于是氮气垫把泵送来的高压油存进瓶里,气体被压缩,压力沿气体定律爬升;等执行器需要大流量的一瞬(合模、刹车、举升),瓶口阀打开,氮气像弹簧一样把油瞬间推出去,一台小泵也能喂出一头猛兽的胃口。它还是系统的稳压器:柱塞泵每转都有流量脉动,蓄能器把波峰存起来补波谷,管路压力的锯齿被削平;泵突然停转或阀突然换向造成的水锤,也被这团可压缩的气垫当场吸收。断电保压是它最硬的用途:电网跳闸,泵停了,蓄能器独自撑住夹具的压力,模具不松、工件不掉;变电站的断路器操作机构、风机的变桨系统,都靠这瓶氮气在灾难时刻做最后一件事。设计账本只有一行:预充氮压通常取系统最低工作压力的 90%,工作压力与预充压之比决定它能吐出多少油——皮囊里存的是能量,账要按气体状态方程算。拖「预充压力」看可排油量的变化,拖「泵流量」看充压节奏;按「蓄能充压」看气体压缩,按「快速释放」看猛兽出笼,按「脉动吸收」看压力锯齿被削平,按「断电保压」看停电瞬间谁在撑住。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A hydraulic system fears two things: a pump whose flow surges and stalls, and a blackout that freezes every actuator mid-stroke. The accumulator is the circuit's power bank: a pressure-rated steel shell holds a nitrogen-filled bladder, oil port at the bottom - oil will not compress, gas will, so the nitrogen cushion banks the pump's high-pressure oil while the gas squeezes down and its pressure climbs the gas law; the instant an actuator wants a gulp - mold clamping, braking, boom lift - the valve opens and the nitrogen spring shoves the oil out in a flood, letting a small pump feed a monster's appetite. It is also the circuit's stabilizer: piston pumps pulse with every revolution, and the accumulator catches the peaks to fill the troughs, shaving the sawteeth off the line pressure; water hammer from a slammed valve or a dead pump is absorbed by the same compressible cushion. Emergency hold is its sternest duty: mains fail, pump stops, and the accumulator alone keeps the clamp pressurized - the mold stays shut, the workpiece stays put; circuit-breaker mechanisms and wind-turbine pitch systems all count on this bottle of nitrogen for their last act. The design ledger is one line: precharge sits near ninety percent of minimum working pressure, and the ratio of working to precharge pressure decides how much oil it can give back - what the bladder stores is energy, billed by the gas equation. Drag precharge pressure to see deliverable oil change, drag pump flow to pace the charge; press charge for the gas squeezing, fast dump for the beast unleashed, pulsation damping to watch sawteeth flatten, blackout hold to see who keeps the pressure when the lights die. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 立式钢瓶剖视:上部黄色氮气皮囊、下部油腔(蓝色)与油口阀;充压时皮囊压缩、压力表爬升;释放时油涌向执行油缸;管路压力示波显示锯齿被削平;断电瞬间泵停、皮囊续压。

topics.descZh: 轮式车辆的死穴是接地压强:六十吨的主战坦克若把重量压在几只轮胎上,烂泥地里早趴了窝,可它碾过的地面只留下与成年人步行同量级的压痕——秘密是把重量摊到两条「自带的道路」上:两条履带接地面积约 5.2 平方米,接地压强=重量÷面积,只有 110 kPa 上下;履带板销接成闭合环,驱动轮(主动轮)并不滚地面,而像一台绞盘,把「道路」从前方卷上来铺到脚下、再从车尾收走——车上所有轮子只在履带里滚动,永远不碰泥土;前端诱导轮靠曲柄张紧机构维持垂度,中部 5 个支重轮经扭杆悬挂把车重传给履带,上支段的托带轮防止履带高速「打鞭」;到了松软地面,光靠接地面积不够,履带板上的横向履齿像船桨一样剪切土体——推力来自「剪断土」,而不是「抓住土」,下陷越深,参与剪切的土体越多;转向是履带的独门绝技:两侧履带差速,一侧停转,车体就绕这条履带画圈,一侧反转,坦克原地旋转——零转弯半径,轮式车做不到;越野的颠簸则被扭杆悬挂吸收,支重轮行程大,车身平稳。拖「车速」看履带卷绕与地面后移,拖「转向差速比」看大半径回转到原地旋转;按「直线行驶」看绞盘铺路,按「原地转向」看零半径掉头,按「软土越野」看履齿剪切与下陷,按「履带卷绕特写」凑近看驱动轮啮合。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
What keeps a sixty-tonne tank from drowning where a wheeled truck buries its axles is ground pressure: spread over two endless tracks totalling about 5.2 square meters of contact, the weight works out to roughly 110 kPa - the same order as a walking adult. Each track is a closed loop of pinned shoes; the drive sprocket never rolls on the ground - it works like a winch, reeling the road up from the front, laying it under the wheels and collecting it at the tail, so every wheel on board rolls inside the track and never touches dirt. A front idler with a crank tensioner keeps the sag out, five road wheels pass the weight down through torsion-bar arms, and return rollers stop the top run from whipping. On soft ground area alone is not enough: transverse grousers shear the soil like boat oars - thrust comes from shearing the ground, not gripping it. Steering is the party trick: slow one side and the hull pivots around that track; reverse it and the tank spins on its own center - a zero turning radius no wheeled vehicle can match. Drag track speed to watch the loop wind and the ground slide back, drag steering ratio to swing from wide arcs to a spin on the spot; press straight drive to see the winch lay road, pivot turn for the zero-radius about-face, soft-soil cross-country for grouser shear and sink, sprocket close-up to watch the teeth mesh. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视底盘:驱动轮+5 支重轮(扭杆曲臂)+诱导轮+2 托带轮,约 60 节带履齿的履带板沿闭合路径循环卷绕,车体半透明悬浮其上;地面纹理随车速后移,软土模式车体下陷、履带尾部扬尘示剪切;两侧履带独立差速,可见原地旋转;特写模式相机凑近驱动轮啮合。

topics.descZh: 焊接普及之前,钢结构靠百万颗铆钉缝合:铆钉烧到 1000–1100 °C 趁红插进对孔,锤击与顶铆把软化的钉杆镦粗、挤满钉孔,钉尾压成闭合头;真正「拧紧」的一步不用工具——冷却:钉杆降温收缩,把两块板死死勒紧,产生约 0.6 倍屈服强度的预紧,此后板面摩擦先扛载荷,铆缝的第一道防线是摩擦力,不是钉杆;载荷超过摩擦上限,板间滑移几丝,钉杆贴上孔壁开始受剪,从「夹具」变成「销子」;设计者同时盯三本失效账:钉杆剪断、孔壁被压出椭圆长孔、板沿孔边净截面拉断——铆距取 3–4 倍孔径、边距取 2 倍孔径,就是给三本账同时留余量;温度是隐藏变量:泰坦尼克的钢板铆着铁铆钉,冰海低温让部分钉子变脆,裂纹沿孔边几乎不吸能地扩展,成了致命一环;航空换了舞台:铝合金一焊就退火变形,波音 747 全机约 300 万颗铆钉,埋头钉把钉头敲进沉孔换蒙皮平整,孔边冷作强化还抗疲劳——裂了换一颗就修好,铆接至今仍是铝结构的默认连接。拖「拉伸载荷」看摩擦→滑移→钉杆受剪的交接班,拖「温度」看低温如何把韧断变成脆断;按「热铆成型」看红热铆钉锤击收紧,按「传力路径」看载荷走哪条路,按「失效三模式」看三种断法,按「低温脆断」看冰海上的那一环。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Before welding took over, steel structures were stitched by millions of rivets: heated to 1000-1100 C, slipped red-hot into aligned holes, hammered until the soft shank swelled and filled them, the tail pounded into a closing head - and the step that really tightens the joint uses no tools at all: cooling. The shrinking shank clamps the plates with a preload near 0.6 times yield strength, so plate friction carries the load first; past the friction limit the joint slips a hair and the shanks go into shear, turning from clamps into pins. The designer keeps three failure ledgers at once: shank shear, hole bearing that ovalizes the hole, and a net-section tear along the rivet line - pitch at 3-4 diameters and edge distance at 2 leave margin on all three. Temperature is the hidden variable: Titanic's plates were riveted with iron, some of which went brittle in ice-sea cold and cracked along hole edges. Aviation gave riveting a second stage: aluminum cannot be welded without annealing and distortion, the Boeing 747 carries about 3 million rivets, countersunk heads vanish into dimpled skin, and cold-worked hole edges resist fatigue - crack one, replace one. Drag tensile load to watch friction hand over to slip and shear, drag temperature to turn a ductile tear brittle; press hot riveting to see a red-hot shank tighten as it cools, load path to follow the force, three failure modes to compare the breaks, brittle fracture for the ice-sea link. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 两块搭接钢板+一排 5 颗铆钉:热铆模式下铆钉红热落下、锤击镦粗、闭合头成形、冷却变蓝并闪光夹紧;加载时界面微光示摩擦传力,越过 60% 载荷板间滑移、钉杆应力色转红;失效模式轮播钉杆剪断/孔壁挤压/净截面断裂;低温加载触发白光脆断、上板分离。

topics.descZh: 钢的热膨胀系数 α≈11.7×10⁻⁶/°C,乘上长度就吓人:100 m 钢梁升温 50 °C 要伸长 59 mm——不留缝,夏天的钢梁会顶裂桥台,轨道会胀成蛇形的「胀轨跑道」。最朴素的对策是「留一格」:桥面装梳齿板缝,老铁路短轨间留约 1 cm 的缝,夏天的「哐当哐当」就是车轮在一格格数缝;无缝线路反着来——钢轨焊成 1–2 km 长轨、用强大扣件锁死在枕木上,温度应力憋在轨内:冬天防拉断,夏天防压胀,超限就「放散」重锁;管道走第三条路:波纹管膨胀节,U 形波纹薄壁管轴向软如金属弹簧,吞掉几十毫米伸缩还扛得住管线内压——位移与承压是它的两本账,波数越多、壁越薄,弹簧越软;高层建筑则在中段设双柱缝,一栋楼切成两栋各自呼吸。约束越强,憋在钢里的力越大:全约束下 F=E·A·α·ΔT,60 kg/m 钢轨每升温 1 °C 多憋约 17 kN,升 40 °C 近 700 kN,离压弯只差一个临界温度。拖「温度变化 ΔT」看桥、轨、波纹管与温度计一起伸缩,拖「约束刚度」看自由伸长如何变成内部憋力;按「桥梁与轨道」看梳齿缝与轨缝开合,按「无缝线路」看锁定轨温下应力积攒,按「波纹管补偿器」看波纹逐个闭合吞位移,按「胀轨失稳」看钢轨被压成蛇形弯。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Steel's thermal expansion coefficient, α ≈ 11.7×10⁻⁶/°C, looks harmless until you multiply it by length: a 100 m steel beam warming 50 °C grows about 59 mm - with no gap, a summer beam shoves the abutment apart and track can snake into sun-kink buckling. The oldest fix is to leave a slot: comb joints on bridge decks, and the ~1 cm gaps between old short rails - the summer 'clack-clack' is wheels counting those slots. Continuously welded rail flips the logic: rails welded into 1-2 km strings, locked to the sleepers by strong fastenings, so thermal stress stays bottled inside - tension in winter (guard against breakage), compression in summer (guard against buckling), with 'stress dispersion' re-locking when it overshoots. Pipelines take a third road: the bellows expansion joint, a thin-walled tube with U-shaped corrugations, axially so soft it works like a metal spring, swallowing tens of millimetres of travel while still holding line pressure - travel versus pressure are its two ledgers, tuned by corrugation count and wall thickness. Tall buildings cut themselves in two with double-column joints mid-height, each half breathing with temperature on its own. The stiffer the restraint, the less the steel can grow and the harder the force bites: fully restrained, F = E·A·α·ΔT - a 60 kg/m rail gains about 17 kN per °C, nearly 700 kN by +40 °C, one critical temperature away from kinking the track. Drag ΔT to watch bridge, rail, bellows and thermometer breathe together, drag restraint stiffness to turn free growth into bottled-up force; press bridge & rail for comb and rail gaps, seamless rail for stress piling up around the locked rail temperature, bellows joint for corrugations closing one by one, track buckling for the rail twisting into a snake. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 三联画式场景:左侧一段带梳齿缝的桥梁(含桥墩与桥台)和一段有缝钢轨,中间波纹管膨胀节特写,右侧温度计;拖动 ΔT 滑块,梁、轨缝、波纹管与液柱同步伸缩;无缝模式换上带扣件的长轨并按温度给应力染色,失稳模式看长轨侧向蛇形弯曲;约束刚度滑块把自由伸长切换成内部温度力。

topics.descZh:
铸造,是让金属液自己长成零件的工艺;砂型铸造则是其中最古老、至今产量最大的一支。先用木头或金属做一个比零件放大了收缩余量的母模,把它埋进「湿型砂」——粒径 0.1–0.5 mm 的石英砂,加 8–12% 膨润土做粘结剂,再加水混匀、压实;分型面把砂箱分成下箱(drag)与上箱(cope),起出母模,砂里留下型腔;要铸内孔,再放进砂芯;合箱后从浇口杯浇入铁水——铸铁约 1400 °C,铝约 700 °C(熔点 660 °C)——30 cm 高的直浇道让铁水按 v≈√(2gh) 加速到约 2.4 m/s,经横浇道、内浇口充满型腔;浇得太快,紊流卷气成气孔,太慢则前沿结皮,焊出冷隔甚至浇不足;凝固时金属收缩(铝约 6.6%,灰铸铁约 3%,石墨析出的膨胀可补偿一部分),于是需要冒口:它必须最后凝固,把缩孔吞进自己肚里,凝固时间由 Chvorinov 定律 t=K(V/A)² 决定,模数越大冷得越慢;最后落砂清理——溃散性好的型砂一振即碎。一套母模加砂箱的成本远低于压铸模具,发动机缸体、机床床身至今仍从砂型里浇出来。拖「浇注温度」看流动性与冷隔,拖「型砂透气率」看气孔涨落;按「起模造腔」看母模如何留下型腔,按「浇注充型」看铁水填腔,按「凝固补缩」看冒口吞下缩坑,按「缺陷透视」看气孔、缩孔与错箱。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 车间地面上一套剖视砂箱:下箱里压实湿型砂,半透明砂块中埋着母模;母模上提起模留下型腔,砂芯落入芯座,上箱带着浇口杯、直浇道与冒口合箱;浇注模式里橙红铁水粒子沿浇口杯 → 直浇道 → 横浇道 → 型腔充填并逐渐变暗,冒口最后凝固、表面结壳缩出小坑;缺陷模式里气泡被困成气孔、厚壁中心露出缩孔,上箱错移示意错箱;落砂时砂块散开,露出灰色铸件。
topics.descEn:
Casting lets liquid metal grow into a part, and sand casting is the oldest and still the most versatile branch of all. Start from a pattern - wood or metal, oversized to allow for shrinkage - and ram it into green sand: quartz grains of 0.1-0.5 mm, 8-12% bentonite binder and water. The parting plane splits the flask into a drag below and a cope above; draw the pattern and the cavity remains; insert a sand core for internal voids; close up and pour - cast iron at about 1400 °C, aluminum at about 700 °C (melting point 660 °C). Falling 30 cm down the sprue, the melt accelerates to about 2.4 m/s by Torricelli (v ≈ √(2gh)), then runs through the runner and ingates to fill the cavity. Pour too fast and turbulence entrains gas into pores; too slow and the front skins over into cold shuts or a misrun. Solidifying metal shrinks - aluminum about 6.6%, gray iron about 3%, partly repaid by expanding graphite - so a riser must freeze last and swallow the shrinkage pipe, with Chvorinov law t = K(V/A)² setting the freezing time by the modulus. Finally shakeout: collapsible sand crumbles away, and because one pattern plus flasks costs far less than a die-casting die, sand casting still pours engine blocks and machine-tool beds today. Drag the pouring temperature to see fluidity and cold shuts, drag sand permeability to watch porosity rise and fall; press pattern draw to see the cavity form, pouring to fill it, solidification to watch the riser swallow the pipe, defects for porosity, shrinkage and mismatch. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 车间地面上一套剖视砂箱:下箱里压实湿型砂,半透明砂块中埋着母模;母模上提起模留下型腔,砂芯落入芯座,上箱带着浇口杯、直浇道与冒口合箱;浇注模式里橙红铁水粒子沿浇口杯 → 直浇道 → 横浇道 → 型腔充填并逐渐变暗,冒口最后凝固、表面结壳缩出小坑;缺陷模式里气泡被困成气孔、厚壁中心露出缩孔,上箱错移示意错箱;落砂时砂块散开,露出灰色铸件。

topics.descZh:
bascule 这个词在英文里就是跷跷板:开合桥的本质,是把半跨桥板(叶)架上一根主铰轴,桥尾用钢架挂上几乎等重的平衡重,让几百上千吨的钢结构变成一架可以整体翻起的天平。主流的芝加哥式 trunnion bascule 中,主铰轴一身二职——既承受桥板加平衡重共几百上千吨的重量,又是翻转的转轴,桥板绕它开启 80–90°。配平是全部秘密:以本页模型为例,400 吨桥板、重心臂 9 米,闭合位重力矩约 3600 吨·米;450 吨平衡重伸出 8 米配重臂,恰好抵掉同样的力矩,于是电机不必举起桥板,只需克服剩余 10–20% 的不平衡力矩,单叶约一分钟就能从 0° 开到 70° 上下。1894 年通车的伦敦塔桥把这套账做到了极致:双叶各约 1000 吨、配重各约 600 吨,一分钟内开启约 86°。配平还是一本动态账:桥板重心臂按 cosθ 随角度缩短,平衡重的力矩轨迹必须全程跟随,工程师把全程不平衡调得又小、方向又一致——刻意欠配平(桥板略重)是安全侧,断电时桥板只会落回支座,不会自行扬起;冰雪、积雪与反复喷漆的增重都会破坏这笔账,所以要定期 trim 调平。闭合后另有锁销把两片叶在跨中互锁,车辆荷载经两叶互传直接入墩,铰轴与齿轮几乎卸载,只管下一次开启。失效模式也全打在这套天平上:配重箱积冰、进水失水、齿条断齿、配重与桥板在井内相撞、大风中的冲击振动。日常运行则是桥务员的世界:航船优先,信号灯拦车、鸣笛警示、确认净空后才按序列开桥。拖「开启角度」看桥板起落与净空刷新,拖「配重平衡度」看力矩曲线与电机负载;按「开启过船」「闭合通车」看完整流程,按「配重透视」看机室齿轮与配重架,按「覆冰故障」看桥板卡在半空。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 双叶开合桥横跨河道:两岸主铰轴各挑一片桥板,翻转 0–90°,塔架间平衡重架随之反向沉浮,覆冰故障时配重增重;机室透视可见电机、减速齿轮与铰点,不平衡力矩箭头随角度伸缩变向。开启模式货船从叶下通过、净空数字实时刷新;闭合模式锁销落座、车辆连续过桥;覆冰故障里电机电流冲入红区,桥板卡在约 50° 半空并震动。
topics.descEn:
Bascule is simply the English word for seesaw: a bascule bridge balances a half-span leaf on a main trunnion and hangs a near-equal counterweight behind it on a steel frame, turning many hundreds or over a thousand tonnes of steel into a beam scale that tips open. In the dominant Chicago-type trunnion bascule the trunnion does two jobs at once - it carries the leaf plus counterweight, and it serves as the rotation axis, letting the leaf swing up 80-90 degrees. Balance is the whole secret: in this page model a 400 t leaf with a 9 m centre-of-gravity arm gives about 3600 tonne-metres of closing moment, and a 450 t counterweight on an 8 m arm cancels exactly that - so the motor never lifts the leaf, it only works against the 10-20 percent that remains, and one leaf can go from 0 to about 70 degrees in roughly a minute. London Tower Bridge, opened in 1894, pushed the ledger far: twin leaves of about 1000 t each with counterweights of about 600 t each, swinging about 86 degrees in one minute. The ledger is dynamic - the leaf moment arm shrinks with the cosine of the angle, so the counterweight torque must track it through the whole travel, and engineers keep the residual unbalance small and one-signed; deliberate underbalance (slightly leaf-heavy) is the safe side, because a power failure just lets the leaf settle onto its rest instead of falling open. Ice, snow and repeated coats of paint all spoil the account, so bridges are weighed and re-trimmed periodically. When closed, locking bars join the two leaf tips at midspan, so traffic loads pass leaf-to-leaf into the piers while trunnion and gears stand almost unloaded. The failure modes all attack the same scale: ice or water in the counterweight box, broken rack teeth, a counterweight striking the leaf in its pit, wind slam. Daily running belongs to the bridge tender: ships first, signals stop the cars, clearance is confirmed, then the sequence. Drag the opening angle to raise the leaves and watch clearance update, drag balance to reshape the torque curves; press open for shipping and close for traffic, x-ray for the machinery room, ice fault to see the leaf stall mid-air. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 双叶开合桥横跨河道:两岸主铰轴各挑一片桥板,翻转 0–90°,塔架间平衡重架随之反向沉浮,覆冰故障时配重增重;机室透视可见电机、减速齿轮与铰点,不平衡力矩箭头随角度伸缩变向。开启模式货船从叶下通过、净空数字实时刷新;闭合模式锁销落座、车辆连续过桥;覆冰故障里电机电流冲入红区,桥板卡在约 50° 半空并震动。

topics.descZh:
弓是人类最古老的储能机器:它不烧燃料、不装火药,只靠肌肉在几秒钟里慢慢做功,把拉弓的力气几乎全部存进弓臂的弹性形变,再在一瞬间交给一支 20 多克的箭。这笔账可以用一条曲线算清:以拉距为横轴、拉力为纵轴,曲线下的面积就是储存的能量 E=∫F(x)dx——奥运反曲弓拉力约 20 kgf(44 lb)、拉距 70–75 cm,存进约 60 J;撒放后约 0.02 秒箭离弦,初速约 55–60 m/s,动能 40–70 J,弓到箭的能量传递效率约 70–80%,其余留在弓臂回弹与弦振动里,化作「嗡」的余音。复合弓用一对偏心轮给曲线整容:先冲上约 30 kgf 的峰值,最后两三厘米猛跌到 7–8 kgf(let-off 70–80%),锁定后从容瞄准,初速却可达 85–95 m/s。最反直觉的是佐券悖论:从搭箭点沿直线望,箭似乎应撞上弓把侧面,却仍能笔直上靶——撒放瞬间箭杆被压弯,像弹簧片一样绕弓把蛇形绕行后回直;箭杆刚度 spine 必须与拉力、箭重、箭长匹配,不匹配就左右摇摆失稳。弓臂材料从木+筋+角的东方复合弓,一路走到玻璃纤维与碳纤维叠层,弹性储能密度越做越高。弹簧也有死穴:空放时弦上没有箭,全部能量留在弓臂里瞬间回弹,常把弓臂直接劈裂;此外还有弓弦打臂与拉力过载。现代射手用撒放器取代手指、用稳定杆吸走余振。拖「拉距」改储能,拖「挠度匹配」看蛇形摇摆;按「拉弓储能」看弓臂由冷变热,按「撒放发射」看 0.02 秒的加速,按「复合弓轮」看偏心轮省力,按「空放故障」看弓臂崩溃。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 侧视反曲弓由支架夹持,弓弦与箭真实联动;拉弓时弓臂逐渐弯曲、色温由冷转热表示储能,示波器同步画出力-拉距曲线且面积渐满;撒放时箭以慢动作离弦,箭杆正弦挠曲绕弓把蛇形通过,弓臂回弹振铃,能量分配条实时显示箭动能、弓臂回弹与弦振动;复合弓模式特写旋转的椭圆双凸轮、力曲线中段下凹;空放模式弓臂剧烈振铃、裂纹发红警告。
topics.descEn:
The bow is humanity's oldest energy-storage machine: no fuel, no gunpowder - just muscles doing work over a few seconds of drawing, storing almost all of it as elastic deformation in the limbs, then handing it to a 20-odd-gram arrow in an instant. One curve settles the account: draw distance on the x-axis, draw force on the y-axis, and the area under the curve is the stored energy E = ∫F(x)dx. An Olympic recurve pulls about 20 kgf (44 lb) over a draw of 70-75 cm, banking roughly 60 J; the arrow leaves the string about 0.02 s after release at 55-60 m/s carrying 40-70 J of kinetic energy - bow-to-arrow transfer efficiency is about 70-80%, and the rest stays behind as limb rebound and string vibration, the familiar hum. A compound bow reshapes the curve with a pair of eccentric cams: force peaks near 30 kgf, then collapses to 7-8 kgf over the last two or three centimetres (70-80% let-off), so the shooter holds calmly at full draw - while arrow speeds reach 85-95 m/s. The strangest fact is the archer's paradox: sighting straight from the nock, the arrow seems aimed into the side of the riser, yet it hits the mark - because at release the shaft buckles, snakes around the riser like a leaf spring, then straightens; spine stiffness must match draw force, arrow mass and arrow length, or the arrow fishtails unstably. Limbs marched from wood-sinew-horn oriental composites to fiberglass and carbon laminates, packing ever more elastic energy per kilogram. The spring has a deadly failure mode: the dry fire - with no arrow mass to receive the energy, it all slams back into the limbs in an instant and often splits them; string slap and draw overload round out the risks. Modern shooters add release aids and stabilizers. Drag draw length to change the storage, drag spine match to watch the snake; press draw storage to see limbs heat from cold to hot, release for the 0.02-second launch, compound cam for the let-off, dry fire for the crack. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 侧视反曲弓由支架夹持,弓弦与箭真实联动;拉弓时弓臂逐渐弯曲、色温由冷转热表示储能,示波器同步画出力-拉距曲线且面积渐满;撒放时箭以慢动作离弦,箭杆正弦挠曲绕弓把蛇形通过,弓臂回弹振铃,能量分配条实时显示箭动能、弓臂回弹与弦振动;复合弓模式特写旋转的椭圆双凸轮、力曲线中段下凹;空放模式弓臂剧烈振铃、裂纹发红警告。

topics.descZh: 背面 180° 进攻、三角双锥过渡态、构型翻转
topics.descEn: Backside 180° attack, trigonal-bipyramidal transition state, inversion of configuration

topics.descZh: 同一种元素五种性格,键法决定一切:sp³ 四面体牢笼=金刚石,Mohs 10、绝缘、透光;sp² 六角蜂窝=石墨,面内导电、层间只靠 van der Waals——铅笔字就是剪切下来的层片;卷起来是纳米管,撑圆是 C60,单层撕开是石墨烯。
topics.descEn: One element, five personalities — bonding decides everything: sp³ tetrahedral cages make diamond, Mohs 10, insulating, transparent; sp² honeycomb makes graphite, conductive in-plane with layers held only by van der Waals — pencil marks are sheared-off sheets; roll it for nanotubes, close it into C60, peel one layer for graphene.

topics.descZh: 镍钛诺有两种晶格:低温马氏体可以「记账不结账」地变形,加热跨过 Af,原子滑回奥氏体原型位置,8% 的应变一次归还;Af 由成分调配到体温以下——支架进血管自动张开;在 Af 以上拉伸则走出超弹性平台,眼镜框掰不坏。
topics.descEn: NiTiNOL has two lattices: low-temperature martensite deforms by detwinning — booking strain without paying; heat past Af and the atoms glide back to the austenite prototype, returning 8% strain in one go; Af is tuned below body temperature so stents open in the vein — and pulled above Af it shows the superelastic plateau that survives eyeglass frames.

topics.descZh: 三段串联:黑火药 75/15/10 爆燃推上 100–300 m,延时引信顶点点火,爆药把数百颗星体同速抛出——动量均匀分布,壳就是球形;星体=金属盐+燃料+氧化剂,焰色来自电子跃迁:锶红、钡绿、铜蓝、钠黄;形状由排布几何决定。
topics.descEn: Three stages in series: black powder 75/15/10 lifts the shell 100–300 m, a delay fuse lights the burst at apex, and the burst throws hundreds of stars out at equal speed — uniform momentum makes the shell spherical; each star is metal salt + fuel + oxidizer, the color an electron jump — strontium red, barium green, copper blue, sodium yellow; pattern comes from packing geometry.

topics.descZh: 平面中间体、两面进攻、外消旋化，与 SN2 成对
topics.descEn: Planar intermediate, two-face attack, racemization — the counterpart of SN2

topics.descZh: 碱摘 β-H、π 键生成、Br⁻ 离去一拍完成，与 SN2 成对；大碱走 Hofmann
topics.descEn: Base takes β-H, π bond forms, Br⁻ leaves — one concerted stroke; bulky base goes Hofmann

topics.titleZh: E1 · 碳正离子分叉路口
topics.descZh: 与 SN1 共享决速步：同一只碳正离子，溶剂抓整基团(SN1)或只拿 β-H(E1)；升温偏向消除
topics.descEn: Shares the RDS with SN1: one carbocation, two exits — grab the group (SN1) or just β-H (E1); heat favors elimination

topics.descZh: N₂O₄ ⇌ 2NO₂ 粒子模拟：扰动如何被「削弱」
topics.descEn: N₂O₄ ⇌ 2NO₂ particle simulation: how a disturbance gets counteracted

topics.descZh: 电子走外电路、离子走内电路，合起来才是回路
topics.descEn: Electrons through the wire, ions through the solution — together they close the loop

topics.descZh: 底物诱导活性中心合拢，催化基团就位断键
topics.descEn: The substrate induces the active site to close, catalytic groups snap into place

topics.descZh: Li⁺ 充放电极间往返 + 浓度热图 + 过充彩蛋
topics.descEn: Li⁺ shuttles between electrodes, with concentration heat map and an overcharge easter egg

topics.descZh: 两支共轭酸碱储备军如何抗酸抗碱，连续滴定交互
topics.descEn: How conjugate acid–base reserves resist pH change, with interactive titration

topics.descZh: 麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布 + Ea 门槛:升温让曲线摊平,催化剂把山削低——速率公式实时计算
topics.descEn: Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution + the Ea threshold: heat flattens the curve, catalysts lower the mountain — Arrhenius computing live

topics.descZh: 半当量点 pH = pKa 的缓冲平台,等当点一滴 pH 冲天——指示剂窗口必须罩住突跃
topics.descEn: The buffer plateau at pH = pKa, the equivalence jump — your indicator window must cover it

topics.descZh: 半透膜只放水过,液面差攒到 Δh = π 平衡;活塞加压越过 π 的瞬间净流反转——海水淡化
topics.descEn: The membrane passes only water until the head balances π; push past π and the flow flips — desalination

topics.descZh: 电解池 = 原电池的逆过程，2:1 集气验证
topics.descEn: Electrolysis as the reverse of a galvanic cell, verified by 2:1 gas collection

topics.descZh: π 电子云伸手抓 H^δ+,π 键打开成平面碳正离子,Br⁻ 补刀——换成丙烯看马氏规则选中碳
topics.descEn: The π cloud grabs H^δ+, the bond opens into a planar carbocation, Br⁻ finishes — propene shows Markovnikov

topics.descZh: 一个紫外光子劈开 Cl₂,Cl· 抽氢、·CH₃ 递棒——计数器看着一盏灯撬动千次转化
topics.descEn: One UV photon splits Cl₂; Cl· abstracts, ·CH₃ hands on — counters show one lamp driving a thousand turns

topics.descZh: R 与 S 互为镜像却无法重叠;交换两个基团就翻转手性——SN2 Walden 翻转的本质
topics.descEn: R and S mirror each other yet never overlap; swapping two groups flips chirality — the Walden inversion

topics.descZh: 六颗 p 轨道肩并肩,电子离域成上下两枚甜甜圈;凯库勒双键闪烁说明画法都不对——4n+2
topics.descEn: Six p orbitals merge into two electron donuts; the flickering Kekulé bonds prove neither drawing is real — 4n+2

topics.descZh: 链越长 HOMO-LUMO 阶梯越矮,吸收从紫外一路红移——补色从无色走到番茄红素的橙红
topics.descEn: Longer chain, smaller gap: absorption slides red from UV to lycopene's 474 nm — the complement paints the tomato

topics.descZh: 引发-增长-终止三幕:聚合度计数器实时跳,材料性质从蜡状走到通用塑料再到高强纤维
topics.descEn: Initiate, propagate, terminate: watch DP climb and the material grade from wax to bottle to fiber

topics.descZh: 底物滑进活性位点形成 ES 复合物再催化放飞;实时 v-[S] 散点贴着米氏曲线,抑制剂把 Km 推大
topics.descEn: Substrate docks into ES, catalysis flies it out; the live v-[S] dot rides the curve — inhibitor pushes Km up

topics.descZh: 氟利昂被紫外劈出 Cl·,催化循环拆 O₃ 而自身原样归来——一个氯拆十万个臭氧,南极春天齐爆
topics.descEn: UV frees Cl· from CFCs; the catalyst recycles intact, one Cl killing ~100,000 O₃ — spring bursts the reservoirs

topics.descZh: 蓝色虚线瞬断瞬结成网络;0°C 晶格反而张开、密度跌 9%——冰浮起来,湖底恒 4°C
topics.descEn: Dashed H-bonds flicker into a network; below 0°C the lattice OPENS, density drops 9% — ice floats, lake floors stay 4°C

topics.descZh: 蓝头橙尾的两亲分子铺满油面;浓度推过 CMC 的瞬间,多余分子自发抱成胶束包裹油污
topics.descEn: Two-faced molecules coat the oil; the instant you cross the CMC, excess molecules self-assemble into grease-swallowing micelles

topics.descZh: 气泡逐塔板富集:塔内温度下高上低、组成下贫上富——石油炼化就是一座 40 层塔
topics.descEn: Bubbles enrich tray by tray: temperature falls and light components climb — a refinery is one 40-tray tower

topics.descZh: 三色染料在「赶路/被扣住」间反复分配,吸附强的后出峰——柱底画出保留时间指纹
topics.descEn: Three dyes alternate between riding and being held; strong adsorbers elute last — the detector writes retention fingerprints

topics.descZh: 过饱和驱动分子落座,凹角台阶位最抢手——晶面像匀速砌起的墙;高温踢出空穴缺陷
topics.descEn: Supersaturation parks molecules; concave kinks fill first — facets rise like steady walls; heat kicks out vacancies

topics.descZh: 放电时两极同生 PbSO₄「雪」、酸变稀浮子下沉;充电逆转——最老的可充电池
topics.descEn: Discharge grows PbSO₄ snow on both plates and the acid thins; charging reverses it — the oldest rechargeable

topics.descZh: 自由基分支一变二、二变四,混合气毫秒爆燃;燃烧三角拆一角即灭
topics.descEn: Radical branching doubles every step — the mixture explodes in milliseconds; remove one leg of the fire triangle and it dies

topics.descZh: SO₂/NOx 在云滴里氧化成强酸,pH 5.6→4.3;大理石冒泡、湖泊酸化、脱硫塔治理
topics.descEn: SO₂/NOx oxidize into strong acids inside cloud droplets, pH 5.6→4.3; marble fizzes, lakes sour, scrubbers recover

topics.descZh: 140 °C 以上糖羰基遇上氨基酸:脱水缩合、Amadori 重排,爆出数百种风味分子
topics.descEn: Past 140 °C a sugar carbonyl meets an amino group: condensation, Amadori rearrangement, then hundreds of flavor molecules

topics.descZh: 半透膜只放水不放盐:自然渗透里淡水自发流向盐水,直到压差 ≈ 渗透压(海水 ≈ 27 bar);泵压一超过它,流向当场反转,盐被截留、淡水渗出;能量回收装置把浓水的压力能回输 95%,吨水能耗压到 2.4 kWh——沙漠国家的水龙头就靠这道压差。
topics.descEn: The membrane passes water but not salt: osmosis runs fresh→salt until the head nears the osmotic pressure (≈27 bar for seawater); pump past it and the flow reverses, salt rejected, fresh permeate out; energy recovery hands 95% of the brine's pressure back, squeezing the cost to 2.4 kWh per tonne — desert taps run on this ΔP.

topics.descZh: 生胶是一把会滑移的面条:受热发黏、受拉永久变形;硫在双键处把链与链架起 C–Sₓ–C 桥,网络一旦成形,拉伸从「拉开面条」变成「拉开弹簧」——回弹、耐磨、耐热一齐到位;交联密度是旋钮:不足发黏、过头脆裂,轮胎卡在中间。
topics.descEn: Raw rubber is a pile of sliding noodles: sticky hot, permanently deformed when stretched. Sulfur bridges C–Sₓ–C link chain to chain; once the network forms, stretching pulls springs instead of sliding noodles — rebound, wear and heat resistance all arrive; crosslink density is the dial: too little is tacky, too much is brittle, tires sit in between.

topics.descZh: 铝对氧的吸引力远胜铁:2Al+Fe₂O₃→Al₂O₃+2Fe,每公斤放热 3.98 MJ,铁水 2500 °C;但铝的致密氧化膜把这条下坡路锁死,要 1000 °C 的镁条来敲活化能的门——点着之后锋面自续,一场用于钢轨焊接的「可控金属火灾」。
topics.descEn: Aluminum outbids iron for oxygen: 2Al+Fe₂O₃→Al₂O₃+2Fe releases 3.98 MJ per kilogram with iron at 2500 °C; yet aluminum's tight oxide locks the downhill road, and only a 1000 °C magnesium flare knocks on the activation-energy barrier — once lit the front self-sustains, a controlled metal fire for rail welding.

topics.descZh: 清晨车流的 NO 被氧化成棕红 NO₂,紫外一照光解出 O,O+O₂→O₃;VOC 与 OH· 的链传递把 NO→NO₂ 而不花掉 O₃,午后臭氧堆出峰值;逆温层像锅盖把一切摁在街谷里——一天拉动一次的化学钟,浓度曲线就是城市的心电图。
topics.descEn: Morning traffic's NO oxidizes to brown NO₂, UV photolyzes it to free O and O₃ builds as O+O₂; VOC-peroxy chain propagation flips NO→NO₂ without spending ozone, stacking a midday peak; a temperature inversion caps the bowl — a chemical clock run once a day, its concentration curves the city's ECG.

topics.descZh: 陶瓷蜂窝涂铂钯铑:铑床先把 NOₓ 拆成 N₂,铂钯床再把 CO/HC 氧化成 CO₂ 与 H₂O——但要过 ≈250 °C 才「点亮」,且 λ 必须锁在 1 附近的窄窗里
topics.descEn: A ceramic honeycomb washed in Pt/Pd/Rh: the rhodium bed splits NOₓ into N₂, the Pt/Pd bed oxidizes CO and HC — but only above ≈250 °C and inside the narrow λ=1 window

topics.descZh: N≡N 三键 945 kJ/mol 是最硬的门,闪电、根瘤菌与哈伯-博施三把钥匙把氮送进生命,反硝化再把它送回天上——推高化肥,回路过载,湖泊窒息
topics.descEn: The 945 kJ/mol N≡N triple bond is the hardest door in biochemistry — lightning, rhizobia and Haber-Bosch hold the three keys; push fertilizer too hard and the loop overloads, choking lakes

topics.descZh: 结冰要先付界面账:ΔG(r)=4πr²γ−(4/3)πr³ΔG_v 有个垒顶 r*=2γ/ΔG_v≈5 nm@10 K,热涨落凑不齐就继续当液体——纯水能冷到 −40 °C;灰尘划痕替你垫付(异相成核),一磕就炸成冰,潜热归还顶回 0 °C 平台
topics.descEn: Freezing must first pay an interface bill: ΔG(r) peaks at r* = 2γ/ΔG_v ≈ 5 nm at 10 K, and until a fluctuation assembles that seed, water stays liquid — pure droplets supercool to −40 °C; dust and scratches pre-pay (heterogeneous nucleation), one tap flash-freezes the bottle, and returned latent heat pins a 0 °C plateau

topics.descZh: 宇宙线把高层大气的氮-14 轰成碳-14,变 CO₂ 混入全球碳库;活体不停换碳,¹⁴C/¹²C 钉在大气水平;死亡瞬间交换关闸,碳钟以 5730 年半衰期倒数;五万年处信号没入统计噪声,树轮-冰芯把碳钟校正成真实日历年。
topics.descEn: Cosmic-ray neutrons turn upper-atmosphere nitrogen-14 into carbon-14, which joins the global carbon pool as CO₂; the living keep trading carbon, pinning ¹⁴C/¹²C to the air; at death the trade shuts off and ¹⁴C counts down with a 5730-yr half-life; past ~50 kyr the signal drowns in noise, and tree rings calibrate the clock.

topics.descZh: 火焰热碰撞把外层电子踢上高能级,高能级站不稳,回落时把能级差一次打成一颗光子 E=hν;能级阶梯每种元素一套,钠永远 589 nm 黄、锂红、锶猩红、铜绿;白光穿过冷原子则被吃出夫琅禾费暗线——焰色与暗线互为正反面。
topics.descEn: Flame collisions kick the outer electron up a level; falling back, it pays the whole gap as one photon, E = hν. Each element owns one quantum ladder — sodium always 589 nm yellow. Pass white light through cold atoms and the same wavelengths go missing: Fraunhofer's dark lines.

topics.titleZh: 过渡金属的颜色·晶体场
topics.descZh: 同一 Cr³⁺ 在红宝石里红、祖母绿里绿:5 条 d 轨道本五重简并,6 个配体围成八面体把 e_g 顶高、t₂g 压低,劈出能隙 Δ;d 电子吃掉一个 Δ 光子,被吃掉的颜色以补色透出——配体与价态拨动 Δ,颜色随之改变。
topics.descEn: The same Cr³⁺ is red in ruby, green in emerald: five d orbitals start degenerate; six ligands in an octahedral field push e_g up and t₂g down, opening a gap Δ; a d electron eats one photon of energy Δ and the absorbed color leaves as its complement — ligands and valence tune Δ, color follows.

topics.descZh: 70 eV 电子束轰掉一个电子,分子离子与碎片被电场加速、磁场弯转 r=√(2mV/q)/B——轻的急弯、重的走外道;扫描磁场让不同 m/z 依次穿过检测缝,谱峰就是分子的质量指纹,¹³C 的 M+1 小峰还能数出碳数。
topics.descEn: A 70 eV beam knocks an electron off each molecule; ions are accelerated then bent by a sector magnet, r=√(2mV/q)/B — light ions corner hard, heavy ones swing wide. Sweeping the field walks each mass across the detector slit: the peaks are the molecule's fingerprint, and the M+1 isotope peak counts its carbons.

topics.descZh: N≡N 三键 945 kJ/mol 被铁催化剂拆开;放热反应想要低温,速率想要高温,450 °C/20 MPa 是两条曲线的交点——喂饱半个地球的工业交易。
topics.descEn: Iron cracks the 945 kJ/mol N≡N triple bond; the exothermic equilibrium wants cold, the rate wants hot — 450 °C at 20 MPa is where the curves cross, the industrial bargain that feeds half the planet.

topics.descZh: 焦炭在风口前烧出 CO₂,又被炽炭夺回氧变成 CO;CO 沿料柱上行把铁矿逐级卸氧 Fe₂O₃→Fe₃O₄→FeO→Fe,石灰石收走脉石成渣——铁水 1500 °C 沉底、渣浮其上,各走各的出口;一座逆流爬行的化学反应器,一开就是二十年。
topics.descEn: Coke burns at the tuyeres into CO₂, then hot coke takes the oxygen back to make CO; rising CO strips the ore stepwise Fe₂O₃→Fe₃O₄→FeO→Fe while limestone collects gangue into slag — 1500 °C iron sinks, slag floats on top, each leaves by its own taphole; a counter-current chemical reactor that runs for twenty years.

topics.descZh: 冰面本是一场进出的拉锯:水分子结进去与融出来一样快;撒盐稀释了界面、拉低结入速率,平衡只能在更低温重建——ΔTf=i·Kf·m;NaCl 撑到 −21 °C 共晶、CaCl₂ 撑到 −51 °C,再冷撒盐就失效;冰盐 3:1 吸热制冷,老法冰淇淋靠它冻成。
topics.descEn: An ice surface is a tug of war: water freezes on and melts off at equal rates; salt dilutes the interface, slows the freeze-on rate, and equilibrium rebuilds only colder — ΔTf=i·Kf·m; NaCl holds to −21 °C eutectic, CaCl₂ to −51 °C, colder than that salting fails; ice-salt 3:1 soaks up heat — the old ice-cream trick.

topics.descZh: 氧化铝的 Al–O 键太顽固,碳硬夺氧要 2000 °C 以上——铝没有高炉。1886 年的解法:溶进 960 °C 冰晶石熔盐通大电流,Al³⁺ 在阴极得 3e⁻ 沉成铝水,O²⁻ 游向阳极把碳阳极一起烧成 CO₂(净耗 ~0.42 kg C/kg Al);吨铝直流电耗 13–15 MWh,铁靠化学还原,铝靠电解。
topics.descEn: The Al–O bond in alumina is too stubborn for carbon below 2000 °C — aluminum never got a blast furnace. The 1886 fix: dissolve Al₂O₃ in 960 °C molten cryolite and pass huge current — Al³⁺ gains 3e⁻ at the cathode, O²⁻ burns the carbon anode away (~0.42 kg C per kg Al); 13–15 MWh DC per tonne. Iron is won by chemistry, aluminum by electricity.

topics.descZh: 乙酸+乙醇在浓硫酸催化下握手成乙酸乙酯——可逆反应,K≈4,平衡时约六成原料变了向;机理是「酸脱羟基、醇脱氢」,¹⁸O 标记一验便知:酯里的烷氧氧来自醇;移动平衡的钥匙在勒夏特列手里:分水器移走生成水,产率从 ~60% 推向 95%;果香就是酯的气味。
topics.descEn: Acetic acid + ethanol shake hands over sulfuric acid into ethyl acetate — reversible, K≈4, equilibrium leaves ~60% converted; the mechanism is "acid loses OH, alcohol loses H", proven with ¹⁸O labeling — the ester's alkoxy oxygen comes from the alcohol; Le Chatelier holds the key: a Dean–Stark trap removes water and yield climbs toward 95%; fruit smell is ester smell.

topics.descZh: Zn/Cu 丹尼尔电池 E°=1.10 V；实际电压由 E=E°−(0.059/n)log Q 决定——[Cu²⁺] 拉到 0.001 mol/L，电压当场降 90 mV；同种电极浓差电池 E°=0，完全靠浓度差做功。
topics.descEn: Daniell cell E°=1.10 V; actual voltage follows E=E°−(0.059/n)log Q — drag [Cu²⁺] to 0.001 mol/L and watch voltage fall 90 mV live; a concentration cell with identical electrodes has E°=0 — voltage from concentration alone.

topics.descZh: 碱夺 α-H 生成烯醇负离子，α-C 进攻第二分子羰基 C，新 C–C 键形成（金色高亮）；加热脱水生成 α,β-不饱和醛——有机合成最核心的碳链延伸手段。
topics.descEn: Base abstracts α-H → enolate; α-C attacks a second carbonyl C — a new C–C bond forms (gold highlight); heating dehydrates to an α,β-unsaturated aldehyde — organic chemistry's key carbon-chain extension.

topics.descZh: OH⁻ 进攻酯羰基→四面体中间体→C–O 断键；生成的羧酸根共振稳定，不可逆；三个酯键依次断裂产出甘油与肥皂，肥皂两亲分子自组装成胶束包裹油污。
topics.descEn: OH⁻ attacks ester carbonyl → tetrahedral intermediate → C–O breaks; the carboxylate is resonance-stabilized, making the reaction irreversible; three ester bonds cleave to give glycerol and soap, whose amphiphilic molecules self-assemble into micelles around oil.

topics.descZh: 粗铜阳极泡进硫酸铜液自己溶解 Cu→Cu²⁺+2e⁻,纯铜在阴极长出来;比铜贵的金银不溶解,沉成「阳极泥」——全球相当一部分白银由此捞得;比铜活泼的锌铁镍溶解了却不沉积;槽压只要 ~0.3 V——不是拆化合物,只是给电子搭桥,吨铜 ~350 kWh,纯度 99.99%。
topics.descEn: Impure copper anodes dissolve themselves in CuSO₄ while pure copper grows on the cathode; nobler gold and silver refuse to dissolve and sink as anode slime — a major share of the world's silver; livelier Zn/Fe/Ni dissolve but never plate out; the cell needs only ~0.3 V — no compound torn apart, just electrons ferried — ~350 kWh per tonne for 99.99% purity.

topics.descZh: 双烯弯成 s-cis,把富电子 HOMO 倒进缺电子亲双烯体的 LUMO;三个弯箭头同向旋转一圈,六个电子一步搬完,两个新 σ 键与一个 π 同时立起,闭合成六元环并放热闪光;吸电子基朝内的 endo 过渡态因次级轨道重叠更稳,动力学占优;反应可逆,加热开环正是环戊二烯的提纯术。
topics.descEn: The diene folds s-cis and pours its electron-rich HOMO into the dienophile's LUMO; three curved arrows spin one turn, six electrons move in a single concerted step, and two new σ bonds plus one π snap shut into a six-membered ring with an exothermic flash; the endo transition state wins by secondary orbital overlap; heat runs it backwards — how cyclopentadiene is cracked and purified.

topics.descZh: 熔体降温到熔点便面临分岔:冷却慢过成核-生长,原子滑进晶格放潜热,体积跳变;冷却更快,粘度沿 VFT 曲线冲过 10¹² Pa·s,乱位形被当场冻住——这就是 Tg;玻璃无晶界散射、带隙宽过可见光所以透明;退火让原子微调位形,表面应力消退,否则一碰就炸。
topics.descEn: At the melting point a cooling melt reaches a fork: cool slower than nuclei can grow and atoms glide onto a lattice, releasing latent heat with a volume drop; cool faster and viscosity rockets past 10¹² Pa·s along the VFT curve, freezing the disorder — that is Tg; glass is transparent because it has no grain boundaries and a band gap wider than visible photons; annealing lets atoms settle and the stressed skin relax, otherwise it shatters at a touch.

topics.descZh: 镁条把电子塞进 C–Br 反键轨道,碳的极性当场从 δ+ 翻成 δ−,变成亲手核试剂;碳负端扑向任何羰基,新 C–C 键「啪」地长出,酸解后羟基点亮——甲醛得伯醇、醛得仲醇、酯挨两刀得叔醇;但它遇水即报废,连呼出的气都不行,必须泡在无水乙醚里。
topics.descEn: Magnesium pushes electrons into the antibonding orbital of C–Br and the carbon flips from δ+ to δ−, becoming a nucleophile; the carbanion pounces on any carbonyl and a new C–C bond snaps into place, the OH lighting up after acid workup — formaldehyde gives 1° alcohols, aldehydes 2°, esters cut twice give 3°; one drop of water kills it, which is why it lives in dry ether.

topics.descZh: 难溶盐的溶解是一场平衡:Ksp=[M⁺][A⁻] 在恒温下是常数;离子积 Q<Ksp 时固体继续溶,Q 一越过 Ksp,整瓶瞬间泛白浊,离子计数从过冲自动回落到平衡线;同离子效应往瓶里暴增一种离子,就把另一种压成沉淀;水垢、肾结石、钡餐、氟化牙全在 Ksp 手里。
topics.descEn: Dissolving a sparingly soluble salt is an equilibrium: Ksp=[M⁺][A⁻] is a constant at a given temperature; while Q<Ksp the solid keeps dissolving, and the instant Q crosses it the whole flask flashes white as the ion counts fall back from overshoot to the equilibrium line; the common-ion effect floods one ion and squeezes the other out as precipitate; scale, kidney stones, barium meals and fluoridated enamel all answer to Ksp.

topics.descZh: 充电时 Li⁺ 穿过隔膜在负极得电子析出;负极从来不平,凸起尖端电场线密集、沉积更快——越凸越长,正反馈把小凸起拉成针状枝晶;针尖一旦碰到隔膜就是内短路,焦耳热点燃热失控;快充与低温都火上浇油,石墨嵌锂把锂藏进层间才是解法。
topics.descEn: On charge, Li⁺ crosses the separator and plates onto the anode; the surface is never flat, so bump tips see denser field lines and grow faster — a runaway feedback pulls them into needle dendrites; the moment a needle touches the separator you get an internal short and joule-heated thermal runaway; fast charging and cold make it worse, and graphite intercalation — lithium tucked between layers — is the fix.

topics.descZh: 光子能量达到带隙才被吃下:电子跳上导带、空穴留在价带;两者分奔两岸——电子在 Pt 上把 H⁺ 还原成 H₂,空穴在氧化位把水氧化出 O₂,气泡 2:1;没人接站它们几纳秒内就复合,发光发热白干;Z 体系让两个较窄带隙接力,双光子铺满太阳光谱。
topics.descEn: Only photons with energy above the band gap get absorbed: the electron jumps to the conduction band, the hole stays in the valence band; they part to opposite shores — electrons reduce H⁺ to H₂ on Pt while holes oxidize water to O₂, bubbling in a 2:1 ratio; left unsinked they recombine within nanoseconds into light and heat; the Z-scheme relays two narrower gaps to cover the solar spectrum.

topics.descZh: H₂ 直接气相加氢要翻 ≈170 kJ/mol 的高墙；落到 Pt/Ni 表面先解离成两个吸附 H（白光瞬间），烯烃 π 键平躺吸附、两个 H 从金属同侧逐个转移成顺式加成，乙烷弹出脱附、表面复原——催化剂把一道高墙换成几级台阶；CO 占位即中毒停摆。
topics.descEn: Direct gas-phase hydrogenation faces a ~170 kJ/mol wall; on Pt/Ni the H2 bond splits into two adsorbed atoms in a white flash, the alkene π bond lies flat on adjacent sites, and two H transfer from the metal side for syn addition before ethane pops off — the catalyst trades one wall for a staircase; CO poisoning the sites stalls everything.

topics.descZh: 芳胺在 0–5 °C 与亚硝酸反应生成 Ar-N₂⁺，超过 5 °C 当场放氮报废；重氮盐作亲电试剂进攻活化芳环偶联成 Ar-N=N-Ar′，偶氮桥把两截共轭系统接成一条长链：HOMO-LUMO 间隙收窄、吸收右移进可见光、补色当场出现；pH 改变推电子基能力即指示剂变色。
topics.descEn: An arylamine diazotizes at 0–5 °C to Ar-N2+ — above 5 °C it fizzles off N2 and is lost; the diazonium attacks an activated ring to couple into Ar-N=N-Ar′, and the azo bridge joins two conjugated systems into one long chain: the HOMO-LUMO gap narrows, absorption slides into the visible, and the complementary color appears; pH tuning the donor group makes the indicator switch.

topics.descZh: 溶质按 Nernst 分配定律 D=c有/c水 在两相间「分家」：分液漏斗一摇一静置，染色粒子比例当场重排；放下层 CCl₄ 再注新液，n 次分批剩 (1/(1+D·r))ⁿ、一次全部剩 1/(1+D·n·r)，对比条上指数差距一目了然；pH 去质子化可把酸性溶质拽回水相。
topics.descEn: The solute splits between phases by Nernst's law D=c_org/c_aq: one shake-settle visibly rearranges the colored particles; drain the CCl4 layer, refill, and n small portions leave (1/(1+D·r))^n behind versus 1/(1+D·n·r) for one big portion — the bars expose the exponential gap; deprotonating an acid at high pH drags it back into the water.

topics.descZh: 两种双官能单体头尾缩合，每成一根键甩出一个水分子：X̄n=1/(1-p)，分子量靠转化率一点点推高；两相界面处尼龙连续生成、一拉成绳（绳魔法）；配比偏离 1:1 时 X̄n 当场封顶 (1+r)/(1-r)，不除水反应就往回走——与自由基加成聚合的瞬间高分子量、无副产物形成对照。
topics.descEn: Two bifunctional monomers condense head-to-tail, ejecting one water molecule per new bond: X̄n=1/(1-p), so molar mass creeps up with conversion. Nylon forms continuously at a two-liquid interface and pulls out as a rope; off-stoichiometry caps X̄n at (1+r)/(1-r), and without water removal hydrolysis runs the reaction backwards — the mirror of instant, byproduct-free chain growth.

topics.descZh: 苯环富电子却极稳：直接加成要拆掉芳香性、能垒如山，于是改走取代——NO₂⁺ 进攻成 σ-配合物（芳香性暂停、决速步），碱随即拔走质子、芳香环瞬间恢复发光；给电子基（CH₃/OH）定邻对位、吸电子基（NO₂/COOH）定间位，硝基一上再硝化能垒陡增、需更狠的条件。
topics.descEn: The benzene π cloud is electron-rich yet ultra-stable: addition would demolish aromaticity, so substitution wins — NO₂⁺ attacks to a σ-complex (aromaticity paused, rate-determining), the base plucks H⁺ and the ring snaps back glowing. EDG groups direct ortho/para, EWG meta, and each nitro makes the next nitration far harder.

topics.descZh: 活动序就是金属丢电子倾向的排行榜（E°：Al −1.66 → Ag +0.80 V）：铁钉入蓝液，Fe→Fe²⁺+2e⁻ 把 Cu²⁺ 压成红铜绒「长」在钉上、溶液由蓝转浅绿；ΔE=E°正极−E°负极>0 才自发，反向纹丝不动；铝被致密氧化膜挡路、打磨后才剧烈置换——其化学本质正是原电池。
topics.descEn: The activity series ranks each metal's tendency to lose electrons (E°: Al −1.66 → Ag +0.80 V): an iron nail in blue CuSO₄ turns Cu²⁺ into red copper fuzz on its surface as the solution fades to green; spontaneous only when ΔE=E°cathode−E°anode>0, the reverse does nothing; aluminum hides behind its oxide film until ground — it is a battery in disguise.

topics.descZh: 一张只放 Na⁺ 过去的全氟磺酸膜，把饱和盐水拆成三样大宗原料：阳极 Cl⁻ 放电出氯气，阴极水放电出氢气与 OH⁻，Na⁺ 穿膜补电性、在阴极室汇成高纯烧碱；Cl⁻ 与 OH⁻ 都过不去，氯气不被碱污染——离子膜法取代石棉隔膜与汞法的三代工业史。
topics.descEn: One membrane that only lets Na⁺ through splits saturated brine into three commodity chemicals: Cl⁻ discharges to chlorine at the anode, water splits to hydrogen and OH⁻ at the cathode, and Na⁺ crosses to keep charge neutral, meeting the OH⁻ as high-purity caustic; neither Cl⁻ nor OH⁻ gets through, so the chlorine stays clean — the ion-exchange era after asbestos diaphragms and mercury cells.

topics.descZh: 2SO₂+O₂⇌2SO₃ 放热：低温平衡才靠右，可低温下催化剂又太慢。工程答案是 V₂O₅ 多段床——每段放热升温后出床冷却再进下一段，一段一段把转化率往上顶；一次转化约 98%，中间吸走 SO₃ 让平衡再挪一步（两转两吸），总转化率 99.7%，尾气才达得了标。
topics.descEn: 2SO₂+O₂⇌2SO₃ is exothermic: only low temperature pushes the equilibrium right, but the catalyst crawls there. The engineering answer is multiple V₂O₅ beds — react hot, cool between beds, convert further each pass; ~98% after one pass, then absorb the SO₃ to shift equilibrium again (double contact) for 99.7% total and a stack that finally complies.

topics.descZh: 指示剂自己就是一对共轭酸碱：HIn⇌H⁺+In⁻，两型结构不同、颜色不同，pH 每变 1，比例变十倍，变色区间恰是 pKa±1；选指示剂就是让变色区间落进滴定突跃；酚酞在碱里开环拉长共轭、吸收红移变红——分子用自己的平衡替你量 pH。
topics.descEn: An indicator is itself a conjugate acid-base pair: HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻, two differently colored structures whose ratio shifts tenfold per pH unit, so the color change lands in pKa±1; choosing an indicator means landing that window inside the titration jump; phenolphthalein's ring opens in base, stretching the conjugation and reddening — a molecule metering pH with its own equilibrium.

topics.descZh: 活化把一克炭雕出上千平米内壁:孔壁的范德华力抓住流过的分子,微孔里两面夹击抓得更牢;吸附带像一条前线往下游推进,抵达出口那天就是换芯之日——升温还能把它吐出来再生。
topics.descEn: Activation carves a gram of carbon into over a thousand square meters of inner wall: van der Waals forces grab passing molecules, and micropores grip even harder from both sides; the adsorption zone advances like a front toward the outlet — the day it arrives is change-filter day — and heat drives molecules back out to regenerate.

topics.descZh: 把压强抽到三相点以下再缓缓加热,冰跳过液态直接跑掉:升华潜热由搁板供给,蜂窝状的孔隙原样保留;另一头的冷阱把水汽冻住维持压差——压强调错了,冰当场化水,结构塌缩。
topics.descEn: Pull the pressure below the triple point and warm gently: ice skips liquid entirely, sublimation heat supplied slowly by the shelf, and the honeycomb pores survive intact; a cold trap freezes the vapor to keep the gradient — botch the pressure and the ice melts on the spot, collapsing everything.

topics.descZh: 掰断玻璃管让双氧水碰上草酸酯:氧化放能顶出高能中间体,把能量塞给荧光染料,染料回落时吐出光子——颜色由染料能隙决定;加热让反应更亮也更快烧完,能量总量守恒。
topics.descEn: Snap the vial so peroxide meets oxalate ester: oxidation spawns a high-energy intermediate that hands its energy to the fluorescent dye, which emits a photon as it relaxes — color set by the dye's gap; heat it and it glows brighter but burns out sooner, total energy conserved.

topics.descZh: 一杯「死」溶液自己变红又变蓝:Br⁻ 是闸门、Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺ 是信使,自催化把小扰动放大成满皿颜色波——搅拌均匀呼吸,关搅拌出螺旋波
topics.descEn: A 'dead' solution turns red and blue on its own: Br⁻ gates, Ce³⁺/Ce⁴⁺ relays, autocatalysis amplifies every nudge into waves of color — stirred, the dish breathes in unison; unstirred, spirals take over

topics.titleZh: 气体离心机与同位素分离
topics.descZh: ²³⁵UF₆ 与 ²³⁸UF₆ 只差 1.3% 质量:高速离心把重的甩向壁、轻的聚轴,轴向逆流再搬成上下差;单级 α≈1.1,上万台级联才能爬到 3–5%
topics.descEn: ²³⁵UF₆ and ²³⁸UF₆ differ by just 1.3% in mass: the rotor flings the heavy to the wall, the light hugs the axis, and a countercurrent turns radial into axial separation — α≈1.1 per stage, so thousands of machines cascade to 3–5%

topics.descZh: 激光穿过真溶液悄无声息,穿过胶体亮出一条光路:颗粒逼近波长,散射效率暴涨;布朗运动顶住重力,一撮盐压薄双电层,当场聚沉
topics.descEn: A laser beam vanishes in true solution but draws a bright path through a colloid: near-wavelength particles scatter violently; Brownian motion beats gravity — until a pinch of salt collapses the double layers and the colloid crashes out

topics.descZh: 碘酸盐慢慢生成碘,硫代硫酸盐见碘就拆:陷阱耗尽的那一瞬,淀粉-碘络合物突然把整杯液体染成蓝紫——变色时间就是一只化学秒表,浓度与温度都在拨它
topics.descEn: Iodate slowly makes iodine while thiosulfate instantly undoes it: the moment the trap runs dry, the starch–iodine complex dyes the whole beaker blue-violet — a chemical stopwatch, wound by concentration and temperature

topics.descZh: 树脂珠抓着 Na⁺ 站岗,硬水里的 Ca²⁺ 一撞上来就被换下:床层从入口逐层用尽,穿透曲线探出耗竭,浓盐水逆流又能把它满血再生——水垢与肥皂渣的终结者
topics.descEn: Resin beads hold Na⁺ on standby; Ca²⁺ in hard water swaps in as it arrives: the bed exhausts layer by layer from the inlet, the breakthrough curve betrays the spent zone, and brine backwash regenerates it — the end of scale and soap scum

topics.descZh: 环氧三元环被张力憋着,伯胺一亲核就开环接链,每个胺伸出两只手把两条链缝成网:凝胶点一到黏度跳崖,配比失衡网就残缺——双组份胶的强度来自交联密度
topics.descEn: The strained epoxide ring opens at the first amine attack; each amine reaches out with two hands to stitch chains into a network: at the gel point viscosity falls off a cliff, and off-ratio mixes leave a defective net — two-part glue's strength is crosslink density

topics.descZh: 目标物溶解度随温度陡升、杂质平缓：沸溶剂里趁热全溶，一降温工作点跌破饱和线，晶体台阶逐层生长、杂质分子撞上晶面被挡回母液——熔距收窄，纯度上台阶
topics.descEn: The product's solubility climbs steeply with temperature while the impurity's stays flat: dissolve everything hot, let the working point fall below saturation — crystal steps grow layer by layer, impurities bounce off the faces, and the melting range narrows.

topics.descZh: 火花塞点燃一张火焰面正常扫缸；压缩比太高时末端混合气被压热、火焰未到就自燃——两道火焰对撞、压力满屏锯齿，敲缸登场：高辛烷值让链式自燃迟到，异辛烷=100、正庚烷=0
topics.descEn: The spark lights one flame front sweeping the cylinder; compress too hard and the end-gas self-ignites before the flame arrives — two fronts collide, pressure rings with sawtooth knock. High octane delays that autoignition: iso-octane = 100, n-heptane = 0.

topics.descZh: 相图上液气边界止于 31 ℃、7.4 MPa 的临界点：越过它液面当场消失，密度仍似液体能溶解、黏度扩散却似气体能钻缝——超临界 CO₂ 灌过豆床带走咖啡因，泄压落下、气体回收
topics.descEn: The liquid–vapor boundary ends at the critical point, 31 °C and 7.4 MPa: cross it and the meniscus vanishes — dense enough to dissolve, agile enough to percolate. Supercritical CO₂ washes caffeine out; depressurize, drop the solute, recycle the gas.

topics.descZh: 磷没有大气库存:岩石慢慢风化、土壤几经周转、最后沉进海底一躺百万年;化肥把这根慢链接快,多余的磷冲进湖泊——藻华与翻池是账单
topics.descEn: Phosphorus keeps no atmospheric account: rock weathers slowly, soil cycles it a while, then the sea buries it for eons; fertilizer fast-forwards the chain and the surplus washes into lakes — algal blooms and dead zones are the invoice

topics.descZh: 铝件接阳极,电解把表面自己氧化成一层多孔氧化铝:硬度、耐蚀、可染色——与电镀相反,镀层长在别人身上,这层长在自己身上;划伤还能自修复
topics.descEn: Make the aluminum the anode and electrolysis oxidizes its own skin into porous alumina: hard, corrosion-proof, dyeable — the opposite of plating, which grows on someone else; scratch it and the passive layer heals itself

topics.descZh: 甘油三酯太稠喷不动油嘴,甲醇在碱催化下把甘油换下来:三步酯交换,油变甲酯沉出甘油——黏度骤降,炒菜的油就能推进柴油机
topics.descEn: Triglycerides are too syrupy for an injector; methanol with a base catalyst swaps out the glycerol: three transesterification steps turn oil into methyl esters, glycerol settles out, viscosity collapses — and frying oil drives a diesel

topics.descZh: 烧红的钢猛地扎进水里:碳原子来不及扩散排队的奥氏体被硬生生憋成马氏体——晶格被撑歪,硬度暴涨;回火再还它一点韧性,刀与弹簧全在这套火候里
topics.descEn: Glowing steel plunged into water: the carbon atoms have no time to migrate, so austenite is trapped as martensite — the lattice is strained hard; tempering lends back a little toughness. Knives and springs live in this fire-timing

topics.descZh: 铝本来太软做飞机:溶质淬进固溶体后,在室温或烘箱里慢慢析出纳米级第二相——位错被这些小钉子死死绊住,强度翻倍;过时效一过,钉子长粗就白忙
topics.descEn: Aluminum is too soft for aircraft: quench the solute into solution, then let nanoprecipitates bloom at room temperature or in an oven — dislocations snag on these tiny pins and strength doubles; over-age and the pins coarsen, all for nothing

topics.descZh: 电容不靠化学反应:电荷贴在电极表面,电解液里异号离子一层层排开成双电层——储能是物理吸附,秒级充放、百万次循环;功率与能量在它和电池之间划清地盘
topics.descEn: No chemistry here: charge sits on the electrode surface while counter-ions line up in the electrolyte — the electric double layer stores energy by physical adsorption, charging in seconds for a million cycles; power and energy split the territory between it and the battery

topics.descZh: 钠交出一个电子、氯收下它,双方凑齐满壳层;静电引力不讲方向,于是谁也不跟谁「配对」——每个钠离子被六个氯离子等距围住;晶格能是拆碎整块晶体要付的总账:远近所有吸引与排斥求和,硬而脆是账目的读法——一错位,同号相见,当场劈开
topics.descEn: Sodium hands one electron to chlorine and both complete their shells; electrostatic pull has no direction, so nobody pairs up — every Na+ sits boxed by six equidistant Cl-; lattice energy is the total bill for shattering the crystal: a sum of attractions and repulsions near and far; hard and brittle is how the ledger reads — one slip of a plane, like meets like, it splits

topics.descZh: 压强是分子撞壁的账单:撞得越频、撞得越狠,压强越大——定温压缩是撞得更频,定容加热是撞得更狠,定压加热是活塞让路给撞得更多的次数;三条气体定律其实是同一本账的三种记法,合起来就是 PV=nRT
topics.descEn: Pressure is the bill molecules hand the walls: more frequent hits or harder hits, higher pressure — isothermal squeezing raises the frequency, constant-volume heating raises the force, constant-pressure heating lets the piston step aside for extra hits; three gas laws are one ledger written three ways, and together they read PV=nRT

topics.descZh: 燃烧有两种速度:爆燃的火焰面亚音速爬行,靠传热点火;爆轰的火焰追上了自己推出的激波,超音速自持——激波压缩替火焰打头阵;同一条管子里,火焰被障碍物揉皱加速,追上激波的那一刻就是 DDT:内燃机防的是它,爆破工程用的是它
topics.descEn: Combustion runs at two speeds: deflagration, a flame front crawling subsonically on heat transfer; detonation, the flame catching up with its own shock and locking in supersonically — the shock compresses and ignites ahead of the fire; in one tube, obstacles crumple and accelerate the flame until it catches the shock: that's DDT — engines spend fortunes preventing it, demolition spends fortunes causing it

topics.descZh: 焓像海拔差,只认起点终点不认路径:C 烧成 CO₂ 的 393.5 kJ/mol 恰等于先烧成 CO 再烧成 CO₂ 两步之和;量热计把落差变成水温计上的几度 Q=mcΔT;测不到的反应,用两条测得到的路径相减
topics.descEn: Enthalpy is an altitude drop that ignores the path: carbon to CO₂’s 393.5 kJ/mol equals exactly the two-step sum via CO; a calorimeter turns the drop into degrees via Q=mcΔT; unmeasurable reactions come from subtracting two measurable ones

topics.descZh: 纯铅 327 °C 一个温度上咔哒凝固;掺锡熔点一路下探到 61.9% 锡的共晶点 183 °C——液体同时析出 α 与 β 长成交替片层;两侧先析初晶、剩液集体转共晶;焊锡选共晶:熔点最低、无糊状区间
topics.descEn: Pure lead snaps solid at 327 °C; tin drags the melt point to the eutectic — 183 °C at 61.9% Sn — where liquid turns α+β lamellae at once; off-eutectic alloys shed primary crystals first, leftovers go lamellar; solder picks eutectic: lowest melt, no pasty range

topics.descZh: 金属离子留空轨道,配体递孤对电子握手成键——单齿配体一只手,随时被水换下;EDTA 六只爪把 Cu²⁺ 环抱进八面体笼,一个分子换下六个水:熵买单,稳定常数暴涨十个数量级
topics.descEn: Metal ions keep empty orbitals; ligands donate lone pairs and bond — monodentate ligands hold one hand and get swapped by water anytime; EDTA’s six claws cage Cu²⁺ octahedrally, one molecule evicting six waters: entropy pays and the stability constant leaps ten orders

topics.descZh: 金属是浸在电子海里的正离子实,键没有方向:受剪时一层滑过一层、电子海当场重新键合——延展性的来源;换成离子晶体,滑半层就同号相斥、当场脆断;导电导热也是这片海的红利
topics.descEn: A metal is cations soaked in an electron sea, bonds that point nowhere: under shear one layer slips and the sea re-bonds at once — ductility; an ionic crystal lines up like charges instead, which repel and crack — brittleness; conduction is the same sea's bonus

topics.descZh: 粉粒不熔化也能长成整块:表面能驱动颈部生长、晶界扫过把气孔赶出去——0.5~0.8 熔点下的致密化;液相助剂替扩散搭高速路;晶粒长得太急,反而把气孔封死在里面
topics.descEn: Powder becomes solid without melting: surface energy grows necks between grains and boundaries sweep pores out — densification at half to four-fifths of melting point; a liquid additive builds the diffusion highway; grains that grow too fast trap pores inside

topics.descZh: 氯入水先歧化,真正干活的是中性小分子 HClO:穿膜氧化巯基、酶当场失活;pH 7.5 是分水岭,越酸越多 HClO、碱性只剩 ClO⁻;漂白是同一步氧化打断发色链;84 液遇酸放出氯气——清洁剂不能混
topics.descEn: Chlorine disproportionates in water; the worker is neutral HOCl, which crosses the membrane and oxidizes thiols — enzymes die on the spot; pH 7.5 is the watershed, acid favors HOCl and alkali leaves OCl⁻; bleaching snaps a dye's conjugated chain; bleach plus acid releases chlorine gas

topics.descZh: 两原子靠近,波函数同相叠加成 σ 成键轨道:电子灌进核间、能量更低、把核拉住;反相叠加成 σ*:核间节面、能量更高;莫尔斯曲线在平衡键长处最低——H₂ 0.074 nm、436 kJ/mol;σ 头碰头、π 肩并肩,双键挡住旋转
topics.descEn: As atoms approach, in-phase wavefunctions make the σ bond — electron density floods between the nuclei, energy drops and the nuclei are drawn together; out-of-phase makes σ* with a nodal plane; the Morse curve bottoms at bond length — H₂ 0.074 nm, 436 kJ/mol; σ head-on, π side-by-side, double bonds block rotation

topics.titleZh: 范德华力与分子间作用
topics.descZh: 电子云量子涨落造出瞬时偶极、感应邻分子偶极——伦敦色散力 −C/r⁶;与泡利硬核排斥合成 Lennard-Jones 势阱,Ar 的阱深仅 ~1 kJ/mol、比共价键弱两个量级;单点弱、数量大:壁虎亿万刚毛凑出攀墙力,石墨层间靠它滑动剥离
topics.descEn: Quantum flicker of electron clouds makes fleeting dipoles that induce their neighbors — London dispersion −C/r⁶; with Pauli repulsion it forms the Lennard-Jones well, a mere ~1 kJ/mol for argon, two orders below covalent bonds; tiny times many: gecko setae sum to wall-climbing, graphite shears layer on layer

topics.descZh: 蜡汽向外扩散、氧气向内扩散,只在薄薄一层反应面相遇:焰心缺氧发暗、中层烟粒白热发黄(~1200 °C)、外缘蓝区 CO 完全氧化;重力对流把火焰拉成泪滴,微重力下缩成球形暗蓝;吹一口气强制混合就变预混、轰地燃旺
topics.descEn: Wax vapor diffuses out, oxygen diffuses in, meeting only in a thin reaction sheet: a dark oxygen-starved core, a yellow mid-flame of white-hot soot (~1200 °C), a blue rim where CO burns out; buoyancy stretches the flame teardrop-shaped, microgravity rounds it to a dim blue ball; one breath turns it to a premixed roar

topics.descZh: C₂₀⁺ 长链在 ~500 °C 提升管撞上沸石酸位:质子化成碳正离子、β 位 C–C 键断一分为二,每断一次多出一段 C₅–C₁₂ 汽油;活化能压到 ≈100 kJ/mol,热裂解要 700 °C+ 自由基路线——同温对照,一个纹丝不断、一个沸腾断链;焦碳盖酸位失活,再生器烧焦复活
topics.descEn: C₂₀⁺ chains hit zeolite acid sites at ~500 °C: protonation makes a carbenium ion, the β C–C bond snaps — each cut adds a C₅–C₁₂ gasoline chunk; catalysis crushes Ea to ≈100 kJ/mol while thermal cracking needs 700 °C+ radicals — same temperature, one barely cracks; coke blinds the sites until the regenerator burns it clean

topics.descZh: 锌(−0.76 V)比铁(−0.44 V)更负:装上锌块,腐蚀电流整体改道,船体被电子淹没极化成阴极、钢电位压进 −0.85 V 免疫区,Fe²⁺ 溶解当场停摆;锌按 ~10.7 kg/(A·年) 消耗、定期更换;ICCP 用整流器+惰性阳极把电位按在 −0.85~−1.1 V,推过 −1.2 V 即析氢;卸下锌块,锈斑复燃
topics.descEn: Zinc (−0.76 V) lies below iron (−0.44 V): bolt on a zinc block and the corrosion current reroutes, flooding the hull with electrons until its potential drops past −0.85 V (CSE) into immunity and Fe²⁺ dissolution stops; zinc burns away at ~10.7 kg per ampere-year; ICCP holds −0.85 to −1.1 V with inert anodes, but past −1.2 V hydrogen evolves; remove the zinc and rust flares instantly

topics.descZh: 每一薄层液体都按相同比例吃掉光,连乘成指数 I=I₀·10^(−εbc),吸光度 A=εbc 与浓度、光程严格线性;已知浓度点拟合工作直线、未知样反插值——水质检测、酶标仪、血氧仪全靠它;把浓度推过 0.6 mM,分子聚集+散射让直线当场压弯、R² 跳水
topics.descEn: Each thin layer eats the same fraction of light, compounding exponentially: I=I₀·10^(−εbc), with A=εbc strictly linear in concentration and path; fit a working line from known points and read unknowns backwards — nitrate tests, plate readers and pulse oximeters all run on it; push past 0.6 mM and aggregation bends the line on the spot, R² sliding

topics.descZh: 电负性差造出键偶极(χ:H 2.20→O 3.44);偶极是矢量,形状当裁判:CO₂ 直线对消 μ=0,CH₄ 四面体归零,H₂O 折角 104.5° 合成 1.85 D,NH₃ 三角锥 1.47 D;压弯 CO₂ 30°,1.19 D 净偶极当场冒出;开 2.45 GHz 旋转电场,极性分子被 τ=μ×E 拖着打转,非极性无动于衷——微波炉原理
topics.descEn: Bond dipoles are born of electronegativity gaps (chi: H 2.20 vs O 3.44), and molecular shape judges their vector sum: linear CO2 and tetrahedral CH4 cancel to mu=0, while bent H2O (104.5°) sums to 1.85 D and pyramidal NH3 to 1.47 D. Bend CO2 by 30° and a 1.19 D dipole appears on the spot; switch on a 2.45 GHz rotating field and only polar molecules chase it via tau=mu x E — the microwave-oven principle

topics.titleZh: 格拉罕姆定律与气体扩散
topics.titleEn: Graham's Law of Effusion & Gas Diffusion
topics.descZh: 同温=同平均动能,v_rms=√(3kT/m):300 K 下 H₂ 1.93 km/s、O₂ 0.48 km/s,速率比 √(32/2)=4;穿多孔壁漏气速率 ∝1/√M,计数比收敛到 4:1;T 300→1200 K 速率只涨 √4=2 倍;UF₆ 分 ²³⁵/²³⁸ 单级只剩 √(352/349)=1.0043,0.72%→3% 约 330 级、→90% 逾千级
topics.descEn: At the same temperature every gas molecule carries the same mean kinetic energy, so v_rms=√(3kT/m) splits by mass: at 300 K H2 runs 1.93 km/s against 0.48 km/s for O2 — a ratio of √(32/2)=4. Effusion through a porous wall inherits that 4:1, and the live wall counters converge on it; heating from 300 K to 1200 K lifts speeds only √4=2×. Swapping in UF6 to split uranium-235/238 leaves a single-stage factor of just √(352/349)=1.0043, so 0.72%→3% takes about 330 stages and 90% over a thousand

topics.descZh: B₀=7 T 把 ¹H 劈成两个塞曼能级,ΔE=γħB₀≈1.2 μeV;拉莫尔进动 ω₀=γB₀=42.58 MHz/T×B₀≈298 MHz,90° 射频脉冲把磁化矢量扳倒,线圈里落下 FID 回波;电子云屏蔽 σ 使 B_eff=B₀(1−σ),吸电子的 Cl 把 CH₂ 从乙烷 0.9 ppm 拉到氯乙烷 3.5 ppm;乙醇三类氢 1.2/2.6/3.6 ppm,峰面积 3:2:1;FID 傅里叶变换出谱
topics.descEn: A 7 T magnet splits 1H spins into two Zeeman levels (ΔE=γħB₀≈1.2 μeV); the magnetization precesses at ω₀=γB₀=42.58 MHz/T×B₀≈298 MHz, and a 90° RF pulse tips it to induce the FID echo. Electron clouds shield by σ so B_eff=B₀(1−σ): electron-withdrawing Cl drags CH₂ from 0.9 ppm in ethane to 3.5 ppm in chloroethane, and ethanol's three groups sit at 1.2/2.6/3.6 ppm with areas 3:2:1. Fourier transform turns the FID into the spectrum

topics.descZh: 密封瓶内 CO₂ 分压 3–4 atm,亨利定律 C=k_H·P 让液体多溶 3–4 倍气体;开瓶瞬间压回 1 atm → 过饱和 3–4 倍,均相成核有能垒,气泡只从划痕等异相成核点冒出,上升途中再长大 3–10 倍;摇晃让成核面大增 → 狂喷;温度越高 k_H 越小,温可乐更喷
topics.descEn: Sealed at 3-4 atm of CO2, Henry's law C=k_H·P dissolves 3-4 volumes of gas; open it and supersaturation hits 3-4x, yet homogeneous nucleation is barred — bubbles escape only at scratches and seeds, growing 3-10x as they rise. Shaking multiplies nucleation sites; heat shrinks k_H, which is why warm cola foams over.

topics.descZh: 石灰石 825–900 °C 煅烧放出 CO₂ 得生石灰(失重 44%);消化放热 63.9 kJ/mol、体积膨胀 1.5–2 倍;砌墙后熟石灰抓空气里的 CO₂ 碳化回 CaCO₃——硬化是把煅烧放走的 CO₂「抓回来」,由表及里推进数月到数年,每步还放出 1 分子水;质量闭环 100→56→74→100
topics.descEn: Calcining limestone at 825-900 °C drives off CO2 — quicklime, 44% lighter. Slaking releases 63.9 kJ/mol and doubles the volume; on the wall, the lime pulls CO2 back from the air and re-carbonates to CaCO₃ — hardening creeps inward over months, releasing a water molecule each step. Mass closes the loop: 100→56→74→100.

topics.descZh: 键是弹簧,ν̃=(1/2πc)√(k/μ):氢便宜,所以 O–H/N–H 高频在 3200–3600 cm⁻¹;刚硬的 C=O 落在 1650–1800;只有让偶极矩变化的振动才吸收红外——CO₂ 对称伸缩偶极抵消,IR 沉默;小于 1500 cm⁻¹ 的指纹区人人不同——官能团定类、指纹定身,一张谱认出一个分子
topics.descEn: Bonds are springs at ν̃=(1/2πc)√(k/μ): cheap hydrogen puts O-H/N-H high at 3200-3600 cm⁻¹; stiff C=O lands at 1650-1800. Only dipole-changing vibrations absorb IR — CO₂'s symmetric stretch cancels its dipole and stays silent. Below 1500 cm⁻¹ the fingerprint is one of a kind: functional groups name the class, the fingerprint names the molecule.

topics.descZh: 平面偏振光是左旋+右旋圆偏振的叠加;手性介质里 n_L≠n_R,两分量跑出相位差,出射偏振面转过 α=[α]·l·c,蔗糖 [α]_D^20=+66.5°·mL/(g·dm);ee%=α_obs/α_pure 直接读出对映体过剩,外消旋体两旋抵消归零;葡萄糖变旋 +112°→+52.7°(t½≈30 min);检偏器转到视场最暗就是"归零"——制糖业的糖度计与药物的 ee 质控
topics.descEn: Plane-polarized light is the sum of left and right circular polarization; in a chiral medium n_L≠n_R, the two components drift out of phase and the polarization plane turns by α=[α]·l·c — sucrose [α]_D^20=+66.5°·mL/(g·dm). ee%=α_obs/α_pure reads enantiomeric excess directly; a racemate cancels to zero. Glucose mutarotates +112°→+52.7° (t½≈30 min). Crossing the analyzer to darkness is the

topics.descZh: 等径球密堆:一层 A、第二层全落凹处 B,第三层叠回 A 得 HCP(ABAB)、落在新位 C 得 FCC(ABCABC)——同一瞬间分岔,配位数都是 12、堆积率 74.05%;BCC 只有 68%、配位 8,铜 a=0.361 nm;碳原子藏在八面体间隙:γ-Fe(FCC)间隙大溶碳 2.11 wt%,α-Fe(BCC)间隙小只溶 0.022 wt%——这个差距正是淬火马氏体的根源
topics.descEn: Pack equal spheres: layer A, layer B drops into every hollow, then the third layer forks — back on A gives HCP (ABAB), onto fresh C gives FCC (ABCABC); either way coordination is 12 and packing hits 74.05%, while BCC manages only 68% with 8 neighbors (copper: a=0.361 nm). Carbon hides in octahedral holes: γ-Fe (FCC) dissolves 2.11 wt% C, α-Fe (BCC) only 0.022 wt% — that gap is the root of quench-hardened martensite

topics.descZh: 1 μm 颗粒被水分子撞得东倒西歪:⟨x²⟩=2Dt,D=kT/(6πηr),0.5 μm 颗粒 20 °C 水中 D≈4.4×10⁻¹³ m²/s、1 秒 rms 位移≈0.94 μm;佩兰把乳浊液装进微米格子,颗粒按高度指数分层 n(h)∝exp(−mgh/kT),数格子数出 k_B → NA=6.7×10²³(今 6.022×10²³,差 11%)——无规游走里称出了原子的存在
topics.descEn: A 1 μm grain is jostled every which way by water molecules: ⟨x²⟩=2Dt with D=kT/(6πηr) — at 0.5 μm in 20 °C water D≈4.4×10⁻¹³ m²/s, a 1 s rms step of ≈0.94 μm. Perrin loaded an emulsion into micron grid squares, watched grains stratify exponentially, n(h)∝exp(−mgh/kT), and counting squares yielded k_B and NA=6.7×10²³ (today 6.022×10²³, within 11%) — atoms weighed from a drunken walk

topics.titleZh: 索尔维制碱与氨碱循环
topics.descZh: NaCl+CaCO₃→Na₂CO₃+CaCl₂ 直接做不成——CaCl₂ 退不出体系。Solvay 兄弟 1863 年让 NH₃ 当「搬运工」:约 24 m 碳化塔内 60→30 °C 温度梯度借溶解度差挤出 NaHCO₃ 结晶,煅烧得纯碱、CO₂ 回收,母液加石灰乳蒸氨回用,氨损失 <1-2 kg/t 碱,钠转化率 ~70-75%,唯一废料 CaCl₂;今日全球 ~2/3 纯碱仍是氨碱法。
topics.descEn: NaCl + CaCO₃ cannot give soda directly - the CaCl₂ has no way to leave the system. Since 1863 the Solvay brothers have made NH₃ the carrier: in a ~24 m carbonating tower, cooling from 60 to 30 °C exploits a solubility gap to crash out NaHCO₃ crystals; calcining yields soda ash and recycles CO₂; lime strips NH₃ from the mother liquor at losses under 1-2 kg per tonne of soda, with ~70-75% sodium conversion and CaCl₂ as the only waste - about 2/3 of world soda ash is still made this way.

topics.descZh: 中心原子的成键对与孤对互相排斥、趋向最大分角:2 域直线 180°,3 域平面三角 120°,4 域四面体 109.5°,5 域三角双锥(赤道 120°/轴 90°),6 域八面体 90°;孤对更胖,把 CH₄ 109.5° 挤到 NH₃ 107.3°、H₂O 104.5°;对称抵消偶极:CO₂ 非极性,H₂O 1.85 D。
topics.descEn: Bonding pairs and lone pairs repel and spread for maximum separation: 2 domains linear 180°, 3 trigonal planar 120°, 4 tetrahedral 109.5°, 5 trigonal bipyramidal (equatorial 120° / axial 90°), 6 octahedral 90°; fat lone pairs squeeze CH4 from 109.5° to NH3 107.3° and H2O 104.5°; symmetry cancels dipoles: CO2 nonpolar, H2O 1.85 D.

topics.descZh: CO 与 H₂ 在 200-350 °C、20-40 bar 下于 Co/Fe 催化剂表面解离、加氢、C–C 偶联,碳链按概率 α 在晶格上爬行生长;每插入一个 CH₂ 放热约 −152 kJ/mol,ASF 分布 Wₙ=(1−α)²nα^(n−1) 决定汽油、柴油与蜡的选择性,产物几乎全直链、柴油十六烷值 >70——从 Sasol 煤制油、Pearl GTL 到今天的绿氢 e-fuel。
topics.descEn: CO and H₂ dissociate, hydrogenate and C-C couple on a Co/Fe catalyst at 200-350 °C and 20-40 bar; chains crawl across the lattice with growth probability α, each inserted CH₂ releasing about −152 kJ/mol, while the Anderson-Schulz-Flory law splits the slate into gasoline, diesel and wax - all straight-chain, diesel cetane above 70 - from Sasol coal-to-liquid and Pearl GTL to today's green-hydrogen e-fuels.

topics.descZh: 氧化剂与还原剂被刻意拆开:火柴头只装 KClO₃(约占一半)+硫/树脂,侧面条只装红磷+玻璃粉,分开储运各自都点不着;以 1-2 m/s 擦划,接触点瞬时 ~180-300 °C,把少量红磷(燃点 ~260 °C)变成白磷蒸气(燃点仅 ~40 °C),撞上 KClO₃ 分解放出的氧瞬间爆燃(P₄+5O₂→P₄O₁₀),头部冲到 1600-1800 °C,再引燃 ~245-300 °C 的石蜡木梗——磷→头→梗三级接力仅 ~50-100 ms;白磷头时代换来 phossy jaw,1906 年伯尔尼公约禁绝白磷火柴,安全火柴从此只在指定侧面才擦得着。
topics.descEn: Oxidizer and reducer are deliberately split: the head carries only KClO₃ (~half by mass) plus sulfur/resin, the box side carries red phosphorus + glass powder — stored apart, neither lights alone. A 1-2 m/s strike spikes the contact spot to ~180-300 °C, converting a trace of red P (ignition ~260 °C) into white-P vapor (ignition ~40 °C) that deflagrates in the oxygen released by hot KClO₃, flashes the head to 1600-1800 °C and lights the paraffin stick (~245-300 °C) — a P→head→stick relay of ~50-100 ms. White-P heads bought workers phossy jaw and the 1906 Berne Convention; a safety match only strikes on its own side.

topics.titleZh: 奥斯特瓦尔德法制硝酸
topics.descZh: NH₃ 与空气 1:10 混合冲过 900 °C、3-8 atm 的 Pt-Rh 催化网,停留仅 10⁻³ s:4NH₃+5O₂→4NO+6H₂O,选择性 96-98%;降温氧化成红棕 NO₂,吸收塔里 3NO₂+H₂O→2HNO₃+NO,放出的 NO 循环回炉,总收率 ~99%。三步全放热,废热锅炉每吨酸副产约 1 t 蒸汽;Pt 网损耗 0.05-0.4 g/t HNO₃。
topics.descEn: NH₃ and air at 1:10 blast through Pt-Rh gauze at 900 °C, 3-8 atm, dwelling 10⁻³ s: 4NH₃+5O₂→4NO+6H₂O at 96-98% selectivity; cooling turns NO into red-brown NO₂, and the absorber runs 3NO₂+H₂O→2HNO₃+NO with the NO recycled back, lifting yield to ~99%. All three steps are exothermic - the boiler exports ~1 t of steam per tonne of acid while the gauze loses 0.05-0.4 g Pt per tonne.

topics.titleZh: 甲烷蒸汽重整与合成气
topics.descZh: 全球 90%+ 的氢来自这里:CH₄+H₂O→CO+3H₂,ΔH=+206 kJ/mol,在 Ni/Al₂O₃ 管内 700-900 °C、20-40 bar 进行,热量靠管外烧天然气以 ~100 kW/m² 灌进去;出口 H₂:CO=3:1,再经 Fe-Cr ~400 °C 与 Cu-Zn ~200 °C 两段变换把残 CO 压到 0.3% 以下,氢喂哈伯法合成氨——每公斤氢排放 9-10 kg CO₂,故称灰氢。
topics.descEn: Where 90%+ of the world's hydrogen is born: CH₄+H₂O→CO+3H₂, ΔH=+206 kJ/mol, over Ni/Al₂O₃ at 700-900 °C and 20-40 bar inside reformer tubes, with natural gas fired outside pushing ~100 kW/m² through the wall. Syngas leaves at H₂:CO=3:1; Fe-Cr (~400 °C) then Cu-Zn (~200 °C) shift beds cut CO below 0.3%, and the H₂ feeds Haber-Bosch - 9-10 kg CO₂ per kg H₂: grey hydrogen.
