topics.descZh: 石英坩埚里多晶硅 1420 °C 熔化,籽晶引晶后先 Dash 缩颈:3-6 mm/min 快拉出 φ3 mm 细颈甩掉位错;放肩到 φ300 mm 后等径生长,拉速 1-2 mm/min、晶转 5-20 rpm 与埚转反向;硼/磷分凝系数 k≈0.3/0.35,先凝的更纯,沿棒长掺杂上坡 3-5 倍。一根晶棒长 ~2 m、重 ~400 kg,要拉数天——全球 90%+ 半导体硅由此而来。
topics.descEn: Polysilicon melts at 1420 °C in a quartz crucible; a seed dips in, then a Dash neck at 3-6 mm/min pulls a 3 mm thread that evicts dislocations. The shoulder flares to 300 mm and body growth runs at 1-2 mm/min with 5-20 rpm crystal rotation against the crucible. Boron/phosphorus segregate at k≈0.3/0.35 - first-frozen is purer, doping climbing 3-5× along the bar. One ingot: ~2 m, ~400 kg, days of pulling - 90%+ of all semiconductor silicon.

topics.descZh: 曝光只在 AgBr 晶粒里攒下 3-6 个银原子的潜影;显影液(米吐尔+对苯二酚)认得这颗开关,把整颗约 10¹⁰ 个离子的晶粒还原成黑色银粒——放大 10⁹-10¹⁰ 倍。显影 ±1 °C 或 ±10 s 就改变反差与密度;醋酸停显 pH 10→4,硫代硫酸钠定影把未曝光 AgBr 络合成 [Ag(S₂O₃)₂]³⁻ 溶走。底片是负像:曝光越多越黑,印相再反转一次。
topics.descEn: Exposure banks just 3-6 silver atoms of latent image in an AgBr grain; developer (metol + hydroquinone) reads that switch and reduces the whole ~10¹⁰-ion grain to black silver - a 10⁹-10¹⁰× amplifier. ±1 °C or ±10 s changes contrast and density; an acetic stop drops pH 10→4; thiosulfate fixer complexes unexposed AgBr into [Ag(S₂O₃)₂]³⁻ and dissolves it. The negative is negative: more light, blacker silver - printing flips it once more.

topics.titleZh: 热致变色与螺吡喃开环
topics.descZh: 闭环螺吡喃的 spiro C-O 键(~290 kJ/mol)把两个环系隔成 90°,共轭不通、只吸收 UV ~350 nm,故无色;加热或 UV 断键翻转成平面部花菁,共轭贯通,吸收挪到 ~560 nm 而显紫红;ΔH≈40-100 kJ/mol、ΔS≈+180 J/(mol·K),升温推平衡开环,Eyring 半衰期从毫秒到小时。变色杯则是结晶紫内酯+酸性显色剂微胶囊,靠 40-65 °C 熔融相变触发。
topics.descEn: Closed spiropyran's spiro C-O bond (~290 kJ/mol) kinks the two ring systems near 90° - conjugation broken, only UV ~350 nm absorbed, so colorless. Heat or UV breaks the bond, flattens merocyanine, and absorption shifts to ~560 nm: magenta. With ΔH≈40-100 kJ/mol and ΔS≈+180 J/(mol·K), heat pushes the equilibrium open; Eyring half-lives run from milliseconds to hours. Color-changing cups use another family: crystal violet lactone + acidic developer microcapsules, switched by a 40-65 °C melting phase change.

topics.descZh: 空气 78.1% N₂(bp 77.4 K)/20.9% O₂(90.2 K)/0.93% Ar(87.3 K),沸点差仅 12.8 K 靠精馏拆:压缩 5-6 bar、分子筛除水/CO₂、主换热器回收 >95% 冷量预冷到 ~100 K,膨胀机(等熵效率 80-85%)比 J-T 节流更能制冷;高压塔(5-6 bar)叠在低压塔(1.3-1.5 bar)上,冷凝蒸发器一块板两用——HP 塔顶 N₂ 液化=LP 塔底富氧液沸腾;O₂ 99.5%、N₂ 99.999%,能耗 0.35-0.5 kWh/kg O₂。
topics.descEn: Air is 78.1% N₂ (bp 77.4 K), 20.9% O₂ (90.2 K), 0.93% Ar (87.3 K) — a 12.8 K spread resolved by distillation: compress to 5-6 bar, strip H₂O/CO₂ on molecular sieves, pre-cool to ~100 K recovering >95% cold in the main HX, and expand (η 80-85%) rather than throttle. The HP column (5-6 bar) sits under the LP column (1.3-1.5 bar) with one block doing two jobs — HP-top N₂ condenses = LP-bottom O₂-rich liquid boils. 99.5% O₂, 99.999% N₂, 0.35-0.5 kWh per kg O₂.

topics.descZh: 2NH₃+CO₂→甲铵快而放热(ΔH≈−117 kJ/mol),甲铵脱水成尿素慢而可逆——180-200 °C、150-250 bar 下单程只转化 ~55-70%;CO₂ 汽提把未反应 NH₃ 赶出来、高压甲铵冷凝打回反应塔,循环闭合把总收率提到 ~98%;每吨尿素固定 0.735 t CO₂,全球年产 ~1.8 亿 t、2/3 进化肥,32.5% 水溶液就是车用 AdBlue。
topics.descEn: 2NH₃+CO₂→ammonium carbamate is fast and exothermic (ΔH≈−117 kJ/mol); carbamate dehydration to urea is slow and reversible — at 180-200 °C, 150-250 bar one pass converts only ~55-70%. CO₂ stripping drives unreacted NH₃ out, the HP carbamate condenser sends it back to the reactor, and the closed loop lifts total yield to ~98%. Each tonne of urea fixes 0.735 t of CO₂; ~180 Mt/yr, two-thirds to fertilizer, and the 32.5% solution is AdBlue.

topics.descZh: CO+2H₂⇌CH₃OH(ΔH=−90.7 kJ/mol)在 Cu/ZnO/Al₂O₃ 上 200-300 °C、50-100 bar 进行:放热+分子数减半,低温高压热力学有利,但低温动力学慢——250 °C 找平衡;单程转化率 5-15%,循环到 >99%,壳程沸水移热副产蒸汽;煤头(CO 为主)与绿醇(CO₂+绿氢,模数 (H₂−CO₂)/(CO+CO₂)≈2.05)进的是同一座塔。
topics.descEn: CO+2H₂⇌CH₃OH (ΔH=−90.7 kJ/mol) runs over Cu/ZnO/Al₂O₃ at 200-300 °C, 50-100 bar: exothermic with half the moles, so low T and high P favor equilibrium — but kinetics crawl when cold, so ~250 °C splits the difference. Per-pass conversion is 5-15%, recycled past 99%, with boiling water removing heat. Coal syngas (CO-rich) and green methanol (CO₂+H₂, module (H₂−CO₂)/(CO+CO₂)≈2.05) feed the same reactor.

topics.descZh: 自由基聚合给支化 LDPE(~105 °C 就烫软),TiCl₄/AlEt₃ 却在常温常压给出线型 HDPE 与等规聚丙烯(1963 年诺奖);Ti³⁺ 活性中心留一个空位,丙烯先 π 配位、再经四元环过渡态插入 Ti–C 键,手性环境强迫每步同面姿——全同度 >95%,等规链排成 3₁ 螺旋结晶(熔点 ~165 °C);无规体进不了晶格,只是蜡。
topics.descEn: Radical polymerization gives branched LDPE (soft at ~105 °C); TiCl₄/AlEt₃ delivers linear HDPE and isotactic polypropylene at ambient pressure (Nobel 1963). The Ti³⁺ center keeps one vacant site: propylene π-coordinates, then migrates into the Ti–C bond through a four-membered transition state, and the chiral site forces the same face every step — >95% isotactic, crystallizing as a 3₁ helix at ~165 °C; atactic chains never fit the lattice, just wax.

topics.titleEn: Pressure Swing Adsorption & Carbon Molecular Sieves
topics.descZh: O₂(3.46 Å)比 N₂(3.64 Å)小一点,碳分子筛 ~3.5 Å 孔口让 O₂ 扩散快 30 倍——短吸附窗口里 O₂ 被孔吃掉,N₂ 穿透成产品;双塔循环充压-吸附-均压-逆放 180° 反相轮转,均压回收把死空间的压力留给对方,回收率 35-50%、纯度 99-99.9%;制氧换成 LiX 沸石走平衡分离;投资是深冷的 1/5-1/10,启停分钟级。
topics.descEn: O₂ (3.46 Å) is a hair smaller than N₂ (3.64 Å); the ~3.5 Å pore mouths of carbon molecular sieve let O₂ diffuse ~30× faster — inside a short adsorption window O₂ is swallowed and N₂ passes as product. Twin beds cycle charge-adsorb-equalize-blowdown 180° out of phase; equalization hands dead-space pressure over, for 35-50% recovery at 99-99.9%. Oxygen uses LiX zeolite (equilibrium separation). Capex 1/5-1/10 of cryogenic, minutes to start.

topics.titleZh: 西门子法与多晶硅提纯
topics.descZh: 冶金级硅 98-99% 距离芯片要的 9N 差着七个数量级:硅粉 +HCl 流化床变成 SiHCl₃(bp 31.8 °C),精馏用这点沸点差切掉硼磷;钟罩炉里 U 形硅芯通电到 ~1100 °C,SiHCl₃+H₂ 在热芯表面还原沉积,100-150 h 长成 φ120-200 mm 致密棒;副产 SiCl₄ 冷氢化闭环;电耗 50-60 kWh/kg 是大头,FBR 颗粒硅省一半但纯度略低。
topics.descEn: Metallurgical silicon at 98-99% stands seven orders short of 9N: fluidized-bed chlorination makes SiHCl₃ (bp 31.8 °C) and distillation cuts out B and P on that narrow gap. In the bell-jar reactor, U-rod silicon cores run ~1100 °C and SiHCl₃+H₂ deposits on the hot surface, growing φ120-200 mm rods in 100-150 h; byproduct SiCl₄ is hydrogenated back in a closed loop. Power, 50-60 kWh/kg, dominates; fluidized-bed pellets halve it at a purity cost.

topics.descZh: 靛蓝 C₁₆H₁₀N₂O₂ 不溶于水,直接泡布挂不上色:先在 pH 11-13 瓮里用还原剂把它还原成可溶的靛白(黄绿色),布浸入吸附;提出液面 1-2 分钟,空气把它氧化回靛蓝,黄→绿→蓝当场显色,颜色沉在纤维内部,牛仔裤要浸 8-12 次。
topics.descEn: Indigo C₁₆H₁₀N₂O₂ is water-insoluble, so dipping cloth directly takes nothing: first reduce it in a pH 11-13 vat into soluble, yellow-green leuco-indigo the fibers absorb; on lifting, air oxidizes it back within 1-2 minutes - yellow to green to blue on the spot, precipitated inside the fiber; jeans take 8-12 dips.

topics.descZh: 高强钢(>1,000 MPa 级)在酸洗、电镀中吸氢,氢原子几天布满螺栓(~10⁻⁹ cm²/s);氢聚到应力集中处,延伸率塌掉一半以上,断口变脆性沿晶;静载下裂纹缓慢扩展,数小时到数年突然断裂——对策是镀后烘烤 190-210 °C × 4-24 h。
topics.descEn: High-strength steel (>1,000 MPa class) absorbs hydrogen in pickling, plating or cathodic protection - H atoms saturate a bolt within days (D ~10⁻⁹ cm²/s); segregated at stress raisers they collapse elongation by more than half, turning fractures brittle-intergranular; under static load a crack creeps for hours to years, then snaps - the fix is baking 190-210 °C for 4-24 h after plating.

topics.descZh: 区域熔炼用物理分凝提纯:杂质 k=C_s/C_l<1 更爱待在熔液里,凝固界面像筛子;窄熔区以 mm/min 级速度扫过锭条,把杂质赶向锭尾切掉弃用,锭头按 e^{−kx/ℓ} 下降,n 次往返指数改善——6-10 次区熔做到 99.9999999%(9N)。
topics.descEn: Zone refining purifies by physical segregation: impurities with k=C_s/C_l<1 prefer the melt and the freezing interface sieves them out; a narrow molten zone sweeps the bar at mm/min speed, herding impurities into a tail that gets cut off. Head impurity falls like e^{−kx/ℓ} and n passes improve it exponentially - 6-10 passes reach 99.9999999% (9N).

topics.descZh: Na⁺ 半径 1.02 Å,比 Li⁺ 大三分之一,挤不进层间距 3.35 Å 的石墨,负极改用层间距 3.7-4 Å 的硬碳(~250-300 mAh/g)。两侧集流体都能用铝(Li 电池负极必须用铜),钠储量约为锂的 1,000 倍。能量密度 100-175 Wh/kg,−20 °C 保容量 >90%(锂电约 70%),循环 3,000-10,000 次。
topics.descEn: Na⁺ is 1.02 Å across - a third bigger than Li⁺ - and cannot fit graphite (3.35 Å layers), so the anode is hard carbon (~3.7-4 Å, 250-300 mAh/g). Both current collectors can be aluminum (Li cells need copper on the anode), and sodium is ~1,000× more abundant than lithium. Energy density is 100-175 Wh/kg, but −20 °C capacity stays above 90% (Li: ~70%) over 3,000-10,000 cycles.

topics.descZh: ABX₃ 晶格:带隙 ~1.55-1.6 eV 随卤素比例可调,吸光系数 ~10⁵ cm⁻¹ 约硅的 10 倍——500 nm 膜吸完可见光,硅要 150 μm。效率从 2009 年 3.8% 涨到单结 ~26.7%(2024),钙钛矿/硅叠层 ~34.6% 已超硅单结理论极限 29.4%;软肋是湿热分解出 PbI₂ 与含铅争议。
topics.descEn: An ABX₃ lattice with a bandgap tunable around 1.55-1.6 eV and an absorption coefficient ~10⁵ cm⁻¹ - about 10× silicon: a 500 nm film drinks the whole visible spectrum where silicon needs 150 μm. Efficiency climbed from 3.8% (2009) to ~26.7% single-junction (2024), and perovskite/Si tandems hit ~34.6%, past silicon's 29.4% theoretical limit; moisture-heat decomposition into PbI₂ and the lead question remain the weaknesses.

topics.descZh: 溶胶-凝胶长出纳米骨架:孔径 2-50 nm、固体只占 0.5-20%。常压干燥的毛细压力 2σ/r 可达 ~10-100 MPa 拉塌骨架,超临界 CO₂(>31.1 °C、7.38 MPa)让气液界面消失、骨架完好。孔径小于空气分子平均自由程 ~70 nm,导热 0.012-0.020 W/(m·K),比静止空气 0.026 还低。
topics.descEn: Sol-gel chemistry grows a nano-framework: 2-50 nm pores with only 0.5-20% solid. Ambient drying pulls with capillary pressure 2σ/r up to ~10-100 MPa and crushes it, while supercritical CO₂ (>31.1 °C, 7.38 MPa) erases the gas-liquid interface and leaves the skeleton intact. With pores smaller than air's ~70 nm mean free path, conductivity falls to 0.012-0.020 W/(m·K) - below still air at 0.026.

topics.descZh: 两只罐各存 1.5-2 M 钒电解液:负极 V²⁺/V³⁺、正极 VO²⁺/VO₂⁺,泵送过碳毡电极,质子膜只放 H⁺;标准电压 1.26 V。功率=电堆面积×节数,能量=电解液体积,彻底解耦;循环 >20,000 次、寿命 ~20 年,库仑效率 ~95%、能量效率 70-80%;短板 25-35 Wh/kg、钒贵,专供 4-10 h 长时储能。
topics.descEn: Two tanks each hold 1.5-2 M vanadium electrolyte - V²⁺/V³⁺ negative, VO²⁺/VO₂⁺ positive - pumped through carbon felt behind a proton membrane; 1.26 V per cell. Power = stack area × cells, energy = electrolyte volume: fully decoupled; >20,000 cycles and ~20 years at ~95% coulombic, 70-80% energy efficiency; at 25-35 Wh/kg with pricey vanadium, it owns 4-10 h grid storage.

topics.descZh: 原油加热到 350-400 °C 进塔,塔板自下而上从 350 °C 递减到 40 °C;每层塔板是一次微型汽液平衡——上升蒸气部分冷凝、板上液体部分再汽化,几十层塔板等效上百次简单蒸馏;按碳链切成塔顶气、汽油 30-180 °C、煤油 150-250、柴油 180-360,塔底重油进减压塔防裂解;回流比是纯度与能耗的旋钮。
topics.descEn: Crude enters at 350-400 °C while trays cool from 350 °C at the bottom to 40 °C at the top; each tray is one micro vapor-liquid equilibrium - rising vapor partly condenses, tray liquid partly revaporizes - so dozens of trays equal hundreds of simple distillations; carbon chain cuts crude into overhead gas, gasoline 30-180 °C, kerosene 150-250, diesel 180-360, bottoms to the vacuum tower; reflux ratio trades purity against energy.

topics.descZh: 燃烧是一条 H·/·OH 自由基链式反应,每步再生更多活性中心;阻燃剂的任务是改写它:卤系释放 HBr 气相截胡自由基,磷系在表面烧成磷酸玻璃与膨胀炭层,氢氧化铝 200-300 °C 吸热放结晶水,协效 Sb₂O₃ 让卤系效率倍增。极限氧指数定生死:空气 21%,PP 17 易燃、PVC 45+ 自熄、PTFE 95;UL-94 V-0 要求 10 s 内自熄无滴落。
topics.descEn: Burning is a chain reaction of H·/·OH radicals regenerating every step; retarders rewrite it: halogens release HBr to scavenge radicals in the gas phase, phosphorus bakes a phosphate-glass intumescent char, alumina trihydrate soaks up heat releasing water at 200-300 °C, and antimony oxide multiplies halogen efficiency. LOI decides: air holds 21% O₂ - PP 17 burns, PVC 45+ self-extinguishes, PTFE 95; UL-94 V-0 means out in 10 s, no drips.

topics.descZh: PPTA 是对位酰胺+苯环的刚性分子棒:拉伸强度 3.6 GPa、模量 70-100 GPa、伸长率仅 3-4%、密度 1.44 g/cm³,比强度约钢 5 倍;浓硫酸液晶纺丝让分子高取向,氢键把棒拉成片层。子弹来袭,应力波以 7-10 km/s 沿纤维把冲击锥形分摊,20-40 层无纬布逐层拉伸断裂,把 9 mm 弹背凸压到 <25 mm,整衣仅 1.2-1.5 kg。
topics.descEn: PPTA is a rigid rod of para-amide links and benzene rings: 3.6 GPa tensile strength, 70-100 GPa modulus, 3-4% elongation, 1.44 g/cm³ - about 5× the specific strength of steel; liquid-crystal spinning in sulfuric acid orients the rods, hydrogen bonds zip them into sheets. Under bullet impact a 7-10 km/s stress wave spreads the load cone-wise, and 20-40 UD plies stretch and break in turn, holding a 9 mm round's back-face deformation under 25 mm at 1.2-1.5 kg a vest.

topics.descZh: 撕开封皮,氧气经微孔膜渗入,铁粉在盐水-活性炭-蛭石体系里电化学腐蚀:Fe→Fe²⁺+2e⁻,电子经炭桥交给 O₂,总反应 4Fe+3O₂+6H₂O→4Fe(OH)₃,放热约 7.4 kJ/g 铁;活性炭富氧导电、盐水提速、蛭石储水。透气膜控制氧扩散,把温度钉在 50-60 °C 平台、持续 10-24 h、平均 5-9 W;重新封袋断氧即停,一片含铁 30-60 g。
topics.descEn: Tear the pouch open: oxygen seeps through a microporous membrane and iron powder corrodes electrochemically in a brine-carbon-vermiculite matrix - Fe→Fe²⁺+2e⁻, electrons cross the carbon bridge to O₂, summing to 4Fe+3O₂+6H₂O→4Fe(OH)₃ at ~7.4 kJ per gram of iron; carbon gathers oxygen and conducts, brine speeds it, vermiculite meters water. The membrane throttles O₂ diffusion, pinning temperature at a 50-60 °C plateau for 10-24 h at 5-9 W; reseal to stop, 30-60 g iron per pad.

topics.descZh: 两段发酵接力:酵母把糖变成 6-12% v/v 乙醇,醋酸菌的膜结合 ADH(PQQ)把乙醇氧化为乙醛、再氧化为乙酸,C₂H₅OH+O₂→CH₃COOH+H₂O 放热 494 kJ/mol;氧是共底物:表面法 4-8 周,深层通气 24-48 h;总酸 ≥3.5 g/100 mL、pKa 4.76,陈化酯化生香,断氧或酒精 <1% 即停产。本质是给酒精再点一把「氧化」的火。
topics.descEn: Vinegar is a two-stage relay: yeast brews sugar into 6-12% v/v ethanol, then Acetobacter's membrane-bound ADH (PQQ cofactor) oxidizes ethanol to acetaldehyde and on to acetic acid — C2H5OH + O2 → CH3COOH + H2O, releasing ~494 kJ/mol. Oxygen is a co-substrate: Orleans surface culture takes 4-8 weeks, aerated Frings submerged runs 24-48 h; total acid must reach 3.5 g/100 mL (pKa 4.76), aging esterifies aroma; cut the air or drop below 1% ethanol and output stops. In essence: striking an oxidation fire under alcohol.

topics.descZh: 纯糖无氨基的热分解(美拉德 ≥140 °C 要氨基酸,别混):果糖 110 °C、蔗糖 170 °C 起,断键→烯醇化异构→脱水生成 HMF、麦芽酚、二乙酰→缩合成焦糖素,共轭变长颜色转褐;阶段表拉丝 110-112 到硬裂 149-154 °C,硬度是温度的存档;柠檬酸催化转化防返砂,过头即碳化。本质是一勺糖的温度阶梯。
topics.descEn: Caramelization is the thermal breakdown of pure sugar with no amino group — unlike Maillard (≥140 °C, needs amino acids). Fructose goes from 110 °C, sucrose from 170 °C: glycosidic bonds cleave, sugars enolize and isomerize, dehydration yields HMF, maltol and diacetyl, then condensation builds caramelan/caramelen — longer conjugation, browner color. Candy stages run thread 110-112 to hard crack 149-154 °C; hardness is archived temperature. Citric acid catalyzes inversion to stop graining; overshoot carbonizes. In essence: a spoonful of sugar on a temperature ladder.

topics.descZh: 前表面 0.15-0.2 mm 掺层里的萘并吡喃是分子开关:UV 320-400 nm 打断 C-O 键,开环醌式拉长共轭、吸收带推进 400-700 nm,透光率从 ~85% 降到 15-40%;关环靠热激活,低温更暗、褪色半衰期 30 s-2 min,循环 >3-5 万次;车窗隔 UV 则开关失灵。本质是一颗会开合的分子开关。
topics.descEn: Photochromic lenses dope naphthopyrans into the front 0.15-0.2 mm layer: a UV photon (320-400 nm) breaks the C-O bond, the ring-opened merocyanine stretches its conjugation into 400-700 nm and absorbs sunlight — transmittance falls from ~85% to 15-40%. Closure is heat-driven, colder is darker and fades slower, half-life 30 s-2 min, over 30-50k open-close cycles. The legacy AgCl route moved electrons; windshields block UV and unplug the switch. In essence: a molecular switch that opens and closes.

topics.titleZh: SCR 选择性催化还原脱硝
topics.descZh: 氨在 V₂O₅-WO₃/TiO₂ 蜂窝上替氮选队友:4NH₃+4NO+O₂→4N₂+6H₂O,温度窗 300-400 °C 脱硝 80-95%;柴油车用尿素热解供氨(AdBlue 32.5%),氨氮比 0.8-1.0——喷少了不达标,喷多了氨逃逸,低于 200 °C 还会析出硫酸氢铵堵孔。
topics.descEn: Ammonia picks its partner selectively on a V2O5-WO3/TiO2 honeycomb: 4NH3+4NO+O2→4N2+6H2O, cutting NOx 80-95% inside a 300-400 °C window. Diesels make NH3 by hydrolyzing 32.5% urea (AdBlue) at an ammonia-to-NOx ratio of 0.8-1.0 - too little misses the standard, too much slips ammonia, and below 200 °C ammonium bisulfate clogs the pores.

topics.descZh: 金的标准电位 +1.5 V,连氧气都啃不动;CN⁻ 把氧化产物锁成 [Au(CN)₂]⁻,电位直落到 −0.4 V,空气中的氧就够把 0.5 g/t 矿石里的金浸出来(24-72 h,pH>10.5 防 HCN),活性炭载金 5-10 kg/t 再解吸电积成金锭,回收率 85-95%。
topics.descEn: Gold sits at +1.5 V - even oxygen can't touch it. CN⁻ locks the oxidation product into [Au(CN)₂]⁻, dragging the potential to −0.4 V so air alone leaches gold out of 0.5 g/t ore in 24-72 h (pH>10.5 keeps HCN down). Carbon loads 5-10 kg Au per tonne, then elution and electrowinning pour bullion at 85-95% recovery.

topics.descZh: 乙醇-水在 95.57 wt%(78.15 °C)处气液同组成、相对挥发度=1,普通精馏几百块塔板也过不去;破墙三法:夹带剂把水打包成三元共沸带走、乙二醇把 α 拉回 2.2 的萃取精馏、3A 分子筛让 2.8 Å 的水进去、4.4 Å 的乙醇进不去——塔顶 99.9% 无水乙醇。
topics.descEn: Ethanol-water hits a wall at 95.57 wt% (78.15 °C): vapor and liquid share a composition, relative volatility = 1, and no number of trays gets past it. Three ways through: an entrainer carries water off as a ternary azeotrope; extractive distillation with ethylene glycol pulls alpha back to 2.2; 3A sieves admit 2.8 Å water and exclude 4.4 Å ethanol - topping out at 99.9%.

topics.titleEn: Chocolate Tempering: the Six Crystals of Cocoa Butter
topics.descZh: 可可脂是三种甘油三酯的混合物,冷却时能排成 I–VI 六种晶格:Form I 熔点 17.3 °C、III 25.5、IV 27.5、V 33.8、VI 36.3 °C——只有 Form V 同时给出镜面光泽、入口即化(熔点略低于体温)、脆断的「咔嚓」声和脱模收缩。调温就是把结晶选择权抢回来:45-50 °C 熔化抹掉全部历史 → 降到 27 °C 让低熔点晶型抢跑成核 → 回升 31-32 °C 把 IV 以下全部熔掉、只留 V 型晶种(0.5-1%)→ 浇模。跳过这一步,凝固的是 IV 型:软塌无光,几天内转型 VI,表面析出灰白脂霜;水汽凝结则是糖霜。储藏 18 °C 恒温,而不是冰箱——取出的冷凝水正是糖霜的原料。
topics.descEn: Cocoa butter is a blend of three triglycerides that can pack into six crystal forms: Form I melts at 17.3 C, III at 25.5, IV at 27.5, V at 33.8 and VI at 36.3 C. Only Form V gives mirror gloss, melt-at-body-heat snap, a clean crack and demolding shrinkage. Tempering is the art of stealing the crystal choice back: melt at 45-50 C to erase all history, cool to 27 C so the low-melting forms nucleate, rewarm to 31-32 C to melt out everything below V, keeping 0.5-1% V-seed, then mold. Skip it and you set Form IV: soft and dull, converting to VI within days, pushing gray fat bloom to the surface; condensed moisture makes sugar bloom. Store at 18 C - a cold fridge sweating on the way out is exactly how sugar bloom starts.

topics.titleEn: Basic Oxygen Steelmaking: Oxygen In, Carbon Burns Off
topics.descZh: 高炉出来的铁水含碳 4-4.5%,还带着 Si、Mn、P、S——铸态组织让它脆如饼干,不能轧制。转炉(LD/BOF)的回答简单粗暴:水冷氧枪从炉口插下,以约 2 马赫的超音速纯氧射流(纯度 99.5%+)打进 200-300 t 铁水,碳被氧化成 CO 气泡掀开熔池,放出的热不但够吹炼使用,还要加 10-30% 废钢当冷却剂——这是不需要燃料的自热过程。Si、Mn、P 入渣,石灰 CaO 造碱性渣拖走 P、S;枪位决定软吹(化渣)与硬吹(脱碳)的取舍;炉口火焰的长短就是老师傅的「碳表」。200-300 t 铁水 15-20 分钟吹到碳 0.05% 以下,一炉顶平炉几天;副产的高温转炉煤气(CO 60-80%)回收发电。1952 年林兹的 LD 转炉就此改写钢铁工业。
topics.descEn: Hot metal leaves the blast furnace at 4-4.5% carbon, carrying Si, Mn, P and S - cast iron, brittle, impossible to roll. The converter (LD/BOF) answers bluntly: a water-cooled lance blows a Mach-2 jet of 99.5%+ pure oxygen into 200-300 t of hot metal; carbon burns to CO, the bath boils, and the reaction heat is so abundant that 10-30% scrap must be added as a coolant - no fuel ever enters the vessel. Si, Mn and P report to a lime (CaO) slag that drags sulfur and phosphorus out of the metal; lance height trades a soft blow (good slagging, dephosphorization) against a hard blow (fast decarburization, violent splashing); the flame at the mouth is the veterans carbon gauge. In 15-20 minutes, 250 t of iron at 4.3% C becomes steel below 0.05% C - one heat equals days of open-hearth work, and the LD process since 1952 has rewritten the steel industry.

topics.descZh: 固、液、气谁说了算,温度与压力一票裁决——相图就是这张裁决地图:每条线都是两相平衡线,斜率由 Clausius–Clapeyron 方程 dP/dT=ΔH/(TΔV) 给出。水最反常:冰的摩尔体积比液态水大 8.3%,ΔV<0,固液线斜率为负(约 −13.5 MPa/K)——加压反而熔冰:冰刀把 90 kg 压在几平方厘米刀刃上,足以挤出微米水膜润滑,冰川底部同理下滑;CO₂ 固液线正常为正,但三相点在 −56.6 °C/5.18 bar,比大气压高 5 倍,常压下液态 CO₂ 没有立足之地,干冰在 −78.5 °C 只会直接升华。三条线交于三相点——水在 0.01 °C/611.657 Pa 冰、水、汽长期共存,开尔文曾由此定义;液气线终止于临界点(水 374 °C/22.06 MPa,CO₂ 31.1 °C/7.38 MPa),越过它气液不分,成为超临界流体。压力还改写沸点:珠峰 0.33 atm 约 71 °C 水就开,高压锅 2 atm 把水顶到 120 °C。拖动「温度」「压力」滑杆移动状态点,看缸中粒子在晶格/流态/弥散间切换;或按「干冰升华」「水三相点」「超临界 CO₂」「珠峰烧水」看四条招牌路线。
topics.descEn: Which phase wins - solid, liquid or gas - is decided by just two dials, temperature and pressure, and the phase diagram is the map of that verdict. Every line on it is a coexistence curve whose slope obeys the Clausius-Clapeyron equation dP/dT = dH/(T dV). Water is the famous rebel: ice occupies about 8.3% more volume per mole than liquid water, so dV is negative, the solid-liquid line leans backwards (about -13.5 MPa/K) and squeezing actually melts ice - a 90 kg skater pressing on a few square centimeters of blade squeezes out a micron-thin water film, and glacier beds slide on the same pressure-melting trick. CO2 has a normal, positive melt slope, but its triple point sits at -56.6 C and 5.18 bar, five times atmospheric pressure, so at 1 atm liquid CO2 has no home at all: dry ice simply sublimes at -78.5 C. The three lines meet at the triple point - water coexists as ice, liquid and vapor at 0.01 C and 611.657 Pa, the state that once defined the kelvin. The boiling line ends at the critical point (water 374 C / 22.06 MPa, CO2 31.1 C / 7.38 MPa); beyond it gas and liquid merge into one supercritical fluid. Pressure also rewrites boiling points: on Everest at 0.33 atm water boils near 71 C, while a pressure cooker at 2 atm pushes it to 120 C. Drag the temperature and pressure sliders to move the state point and watch the particles switch between lattice, flow and dispersion, or press the dry-ice, triple-point, supercritical-CO2 and Everest presets for four signature routes.

topics.titleEn: Gibbs Free Energy: Temperature Decides Spontaneity
topics.descZh: 化学反应往哪边走,能量与熵各投一票,裁判是吉布斯自由能:ΔG=ΔH−TΔS,只有 ΔG<0 的方向才自发。四种组合四种命运:放热又增熵(葡萄糖氧化,ΔH=−2803 kJ/mol、ΔS=+259 J/(mol·K))任何温度都自发;放热但熵减(水结冰)只在 T<273 K 自发;吸热而增熵(冰融化)只在 T>273 K 自发;吸热又熵减(把 CO₂ 和水拼成葡萄糖)永不自发——所以光合作用必须靠光子买单。温度是拨开关的手:CaCO₃→CaO+CO₂ 的 ΔH=+178.3 kJ/mol、ΔS=+160.5 J/(mol·K),转折温度 T=ΔH/ΔS≈1111 K(838 °C),石灰窑必须烧到 900 °C 以上,烧的正是它。ΔG 还是有用功的天花板:氢氧燃料电池 ΔG=−237 kJ/mol,电压上限恰为 237000/(2F)=1.23 V;内燃机走热机路线,把这份红利烧成了废热。ΔG=0 即平衡,ΔG°=−RT ln K 把热力学与平衡常数串成一条线。拖「温度」滑杆越过 1111 K,看 G-ξ 山谷当场翻边、小球滚向新的自发放向;或按「葡萄糖氧化」「冰-水开关」「CaCO₃ 分解」「永不自发」巡游四种命运。
topics.descEn: Which way a reaction runs is voted on by energy and entropy, and the referee is the Gibbs free energy: dG = dH - T dS, and only dG < 0 goes. Four combinations, four fates: exothermic with rising entropy - glucose oxidation, dH = -2803 kJ/mol, dS = +259 J/(mol K) - is spontaneous at every temperature; exothermic with falling entropy (water freezing) only below 273 K; endothermic with rising entropy (ice melting) only above 273 K; endothermic with falling entropy - building glucose out of CO2 and water - never, which is why photosynthesis needs photons to pay the bill. Temperature is the hand on the switch: for CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2, dH = +178.3 kJ/mol and dS = +160.5 J/(mol K), so the crossover temperature dH/dS lands near 1111 K (838 C) - exactly why lime kilns must burn above 900 C. dG is also the ceiling on useful work: a hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell with dG = -237 kJ/mol tops out at 237000/(2F) = 1.23 V, while an internal combustion engine burns most of that dividend away as waste heat. dG = 0 is equilibrium, and dG = -RT lnK ties thermodynamics to the equilibrium constant. Watch the two bars: red is dH, fixed; blue is T dS, growing with temperature - the moment blue overtakes red, dG flips sign. Drag the temperature slider past 1111 K and watch the G-xi valley flip sides as the ball rolls to the new spontaneous direction, or tour the four presets for four fates.

topics.titleEn: Dust Explosions: Surface Area Turns a Pile into a Bomb
topics.descZh: 一根铁棒烧不起来,铁粉却能爆燃——燃烧只发生在表面,反应速率正比于接触面积:1 cm³ 铁块比表面积仅 0.08 m²/kg,75 μm 铁粉约 10 m²/kg,50 nm 铁粉超过 1.5×10⁴ m²/kg,拉大 5 个数量级。悬浮尘云等于固体燃料与空气的预混气,有浓度窗口:下限约 20-60 g/m³,上限 2-6 kg/m³,粒径小于 75 μm 最危险。点火后是爆燃:火焰前锋约 10 m/s,密闭车间内压力冲到 6-9 bar,细粉尘最小点火能仅 10-50 mJ,静电足矣。真正致命的是接力——压力波先于火焰把沉积尘堆整体掀起,形成大得多的二次尘云,再被火焰当场点燃:二次爆炸常在多处同时发生,威力数倍于首次。1987 哈尔滨亚麻厂 58 人遇难、2014 昆山中荣 146 人遇难,元凶都是沉积粉尘的二次接力。对策四件套:泄爆板(超压钳在 0.1-0.2 bar)、毫秒级化学抑爆、氮气惰化(O₂ 压到极限氧浓度 LOC 10-12% 以下)、防沉积(尘层超 0.8 mm 即清理,吸尘不吹扫)。拖「浓度」「粒径」滑杆布景,按四个预设按钮看四种结局;速度滑杆调到 0.2× 看慢镜头。
topics.descEn: A lump of iron will not burn, but iron dust explodes - combustion happens only at the surface, so the rate scales with contact area: one cubic centimeter of iron carries about 0.08 m2/kg of specific surface, 75-micron powder about 10 m2/kg, and 50-nanometer powder beyond 1.5x10^4 m2/kg - five orders of magnitude. A suspended dust cloud is a premixed charge of solid fuel and air with a concentration window: lower limit roughly 20-60 g/m3, upper limit 2-6 kg/m3, and particles under 75 microns are the most dangerous. Ignition gives deflagration: a flame front near 10 m/s and, in a closed workshop, pressures of 6-9 bar, while fine dust needs only 10-50 mJ to light - a static spark will do. The truly lethal part is the relay: the pressure wave of the primary blast runs ahead of the flame and lifts the settled piles wholesale into a far larger secondary cloud, which the flame ignites on arrival - often at several points at once and several times more powerful. The 1987 Harbin flax mill blast killed 58 people, the 2014 Kunshan polishing workshop took 146 - settled dust relays were the killer in both. The engineering answer is a quartet: vent panels that clamp overpressure to 0.1-0.2 bar, millisecond chemical suppression, inerting with nitrogen below the limiting oxygen concentration of 10-12%, and housekeeping - remove layers over 0.8 mm, vacuum rather than blow. Set the concentration and particle-size sliders, then press pile ignition, cloud ignition, relay blast and vented contrast to watch four outcomes; pull the speed slider to 0.2x for slow motion.

topics.titleZh: 络合滴定:最后一滴变蓝
topics.titleEn: Complexometric Titration: The Last Drop Turns Blue
topics.descZh: 测水硬度用的是 EDTA 络合滴定:六齿配体 Y⁴⁻ 用 4 个羧基氧和 2 个氨基氮把一个 Ca²⁺ 或 Mg²⁺ 抱成 1:1 的笼状螯合物,lgK(CaY)=10.7、lgK(MgY)=8.7。但 H⁺ 会跟金属离子抢 Y:酸度越高,条件稳定常数 lgK′=lgK−lgα_Y(H) 塌得越狠——pH 10 时 lgK′(MgY)≈8.25 尚可一用,到 pH 5 只剩约 2.2,所以必须用氨性缓冲液把 pH 钉在 10。指示剂铬黑 T 在碱性下本是蓝色,却先被水样里的 Mg²⁺ 拽成酒红色;滴定中 EDTA 先络合自由金属,临近终点再从 MgIn 里夺走最后的 Mg(它对 Y 亲和力更高),游离指示剂释放,溶液从酒红经紫瞬间翻成纯蓝——「最后一滴变蓝」。硬度以 CaCO₃ 计:0.01 mol/L EDTA 滴 50 mL 水样,每 1 mL 约 20 mg/L;软水<60、硬水>180 mg/L,硬水结水垢、费肥皂。陷阱:Fe³⁺/Al³⁺ 与指示剂结合过牢会「封闭」终点,一直红到底,须先用三乙醇胺掩蔽。拖「pH」从 10 拉到 5,看 lgK′ 塌掉、终点漂移失敏;拖「滴入体积」逼近终点,按「终点慢放」看翻色慢镜头,按「掩蔽对照」三态对比封闭与解救。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Water hardness is measured by complexometric titration with EDTA: the six-dentate ligand Y4- wraps a single Ca2+ or Mg2+ into a 1:1 cage using four carboxylate oxygens and two amine nitrogens, with lgK = 10.7 for CaY and 8.7 for MgY. But H+ competes with the metal for Y: the more acidic the solution, the harder the conditional constant lgK-prime = lgK - lg alpha(YH) collapses - at pH 10 lgK-prime of MgY is about 8.25 and still usable, while at pH 5 only about 2.2 survives, so an ammonia buffer must pin the pH at 10. The indicator eriochrome black T is blue when free in alkaline solution, but the sample's Mg2+ immediately pulls it into a wine-red complex; during titration EDTA first mops up free metal, then near the endpoint snatches the last Mg out of MgIn - Y binds it more tightly - and the liberated indicator flips the solution from wine red through purple to pure blue in a single drop: the last drop turns blue. Hardness is reported as mg/L CaCO3: with 0.01 mol/L EDTA and a 50 mL sample, each milliliter counts about 20 mg/L; soft water is under 60, hard water above 180, and hard water scales kettles and wastes soap. The classic trap: Fe3+ and Al3+ bind the indicator so tightly they block the endpoint - it stays red forever - so triethanolamine is added first to mask them. Drag the pH slider from 10 down to 5 and watch lgK-prime collapse and the endpoint drift and dull; drag titrant volume toward the endpoint, press slow-motion replay for the color flip, or cycle the masking contrast for blocked versus rescued. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 自燃:缓慢氧化的失控账
topics.titleEn: Spontaneous Combustion: When Slow Oxidation Runs Away
topics.descZh: 浸过亚麻油或桐油的抹布随手堆在通风不良的角落,几小时到几天后可能自己烧起来:不饱和脂肪酸的双键与氧气缓慢氧化,每个双键吸氧放热约 40-50 kJ/mol,热量在堆内积聚——产热正比于体积,散热只正比于表面积,堆得越大越散不出去;温度每升高约 10 °C 氧化速率就翻一倍(Arrhenius 指数),升温又加速产热,正反馈一旦越过平衡点便失控:油布堆心实测可从 20 °C 一路爬到 200-400 °C,越过约 200 °C 的着火点当场窜出明火。Frank-Kamenetskii 理论给出临界尺寸:半径小于临界值时产热与散热可以平衡,堆体安全;超过即失控。同一本账适用于煤堆自燃、干草垛(微生物发酵先升温到 60-70 °C 打底,化学氧化接棒)与粮食仓储,干草垛火灾多发生在堆后 2-6 周。防范四招:小堆薄摊让热散掉、保持通风、油布丢进带盖金属容器隔绝空气、及时清走。拖「堆半径」跨过临界半径当场从安全变起火,调「通风率」「含油量」改写结局;按「临界尺寸实验」看两堆同油同风、只差尺寸的不同命运。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Crumple up rags soaked in linseed or tung oil, leave them heaped in a poorly ventilated corner, and hours to days later they can catch fire with no spark anywhere. The unsaturated fatty acids in drying oils oxidize slowly: each C=C double bond takes up oxygen and releases roughly 40-50 kJ/mol, and the heat piles up because generation scales with volume while loss scales only with surface area - the bigger the heap, the harder heat has to escape. Worse, oxidation follows Arrhenius: every 10 degrees Celsius or so doubles the rate, so rising temperature accelerates the very reaction that feeds it. Once the balance point is passed the feedback runs away: measured cores of oiled-rag piles have climbed from 20 C to 200-400 C, and past the ignition point near 200 C flame breaks out on its own. Frank-Kamenetskii theory defines a critical size: below the critical radius generation and loss can balance and the pile stays safe; above it, runaway is certain. The same ledger explains self-heating coal stockpiles, hay stacks - microbial fermentation warms them to 60-70 C first, then chemical oxidation takes the baton - and grain storage, with hay fires clustering 2-6 weeks after baling. Four habits prevent it: spread rags in small thin piles that shed heat, keep air moving, drop oily rags into a closed metal can to starve the reaction, and remove them promptly. Drag the pile-radius slider across the critical radius to flip from safe to flaming on the spot, tune ventilation and oil loading to rewrite the ending, or press the critical-size experiment to watch two piles identical except in size meet different fates. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 高吸水聚合物:尿布里的分子海绵
topics.titleEn: Superabsorbent Polymer: The Molecular Sponge in a Diaper
topics.descZh: 交联聚丙烯酸钠(SAP)是尿布里的分子海绵:长链上密布 -COONa,遇水解离成固定在链上的 -COO⁻ 与自由 Na⁺,链内离子浓度远高于外部,渗透压驱动水大量涌入;羧酸根之间的静电排斥把卷曲的长链互相撑开,网络溶胀;稀疏的交联点再把溶胀拉停——Flory-Rehner 平衡:渗透压进水 = 网络弹性回缩力。纯水里它能吸自重 300-1000 倍;换 0.9% 生理盐水立刻跌到 30-50 倍——外部离子把链内外的浓度差(渗透压的来源)打平了,这正是为什么尿布吸量按盐水标定:一片尿布装 5-10 g SAP,负责 50-100 mL 尿液,受 4-5 kPa 压力(婴儿体重)仍保住大部分水,低回渗不反渗。交联密度是配方旋钮:越高吸水越少、凝胶越硬挺。同款材料还当农业保水剂(旱区植树)和电缆阻水纱(进水即膨胀堵缝)。拖「盐浓度」看吸水倍率当场暴跌,拖「交联密度」「外部压力」改写凝胶的软硬与保水;按「倒杯实验」看一杯水倒进 SAP 后瞬间「冻结」成凝胶、倒扣不洒。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Superabsorbent polymer (SAP), cross-linked sodium polyacrylate, is the molecular sponge inside a diaper: its long chains carry dense -COONa groups that dissociate in water into -COO- ions fixed to the chain and free Na+, so the ion concentration inside the network far exceeds that outside, and osmotic pressure drives water to flood in. Electrostatic repulsion between the carboxylate anions pushes the curled chains apart and the network swells, while sparse cross-link points finally pull the swelling to a stop - Flory-Rehner equilibrium: osmotic inflow balanced by the elastic retraction of the network. In pure water SAP absorbs 300-1000 times its own weight; in 0.9 percent saline it drops to 30-50 times, because external ions flatten the concentration difference that powers the osmotic drive - which is exactly why diaper capacity is rated against saline: one diaper carries 5-10 g of SAP to handle 50-100 mL, and under a pressure of 4-5 kPa, about the weight of a baby, it still keeps most of the liquid locked in with little re-wetting. Cross-link density is the formulation knob: more of it means less absorption but a firmer gel. The same material serves as a soil water-retainer for dryland planting and as water-blocking yarn that swells to seal cable joints. Drag the salt slider to watch absorbency collapse on the spot, tune cross-link density and external pressure to reshape the gel, or press the flip test to pour a beaker of water into SAP and see it freeze into a gel that will not spill when inverted. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: pH 计与玻璃电极:一层玻璃膜测酸碱
topics.titleEn: The pH Meter: A Glass Membrane Reads Acidity
topics.descZh: pH 计测的不是颜色、不是化学反应,而是电位。玻璃电极头部是一层特种玻璃薄膜,厚仅 50-100 μm;泡在水里后表面水化出约 10 nm 的凝胶层,膜两侧凝胶层分别与内、外溶液进行 Na⁺/H⁺ 离子交换——H⁺ 并不真正穿过玻璃膜,但两侧界面的电位随氢离子活度差变化,整膜电位服从能斯特方程 E = E0 − 2.303RT/F × pH:25 °C 时斜率 59.16 mV/pH,温度越高斜率越大。光有敏感膜构不成回路:电极内装已知 pH 的内参比液和 Ag/AgCl 内参比电极,外参比电极经饱和 KCl 盐桥接入被测液,压低液接电位——现代复合电极把内外参比并成一支。每支电极出厂时零点都略有不同(不对称电位),斜率又随老化衰减,所以用前必须两点标定:pH 4.01 与 9.18 缓冲先后入杯,定下斜率与零点;温度改变斜率,由 ATC 温度补偿自动修正。强碱里另有陷阱:pH 大于 12 时玻璃膜对 Na⁺ 也响应,读数偏低——钠误差。它的王牌是普适性:浑浊、有色、黏稠、含氧化剂的溶液都能测,指示剂与试纸做不到;响应秒级、不消耗样品。演示:拖 pH 滑块看离子云与 mV 表针同步偏转,工作点沿 mV-pH 直线滑动;先两点标定,再按「未标定漂移」「钠误差」看读数翻车;拖温度看斜率随温度爬升。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A pH meter measures neither color nor chemical reaction - it measures an electric potential. The tip of a glass electrode is a special-glass membrane only 50-100 μm thick; after soaking, its surface hydrates into a gel layer about 10 nm deep. The gel layers on the two faces exchange Na+/H+ ions with the inner and outer solutions - H+ never actually crosses the glass, yet the interface potential on each side tracks the hydrogen-ion activity of its solution, and the whole membrane obeys the Nernst equation E = E0 - 2.303RT/F × pH: a slope of 59.16 mV/pH at 25 °C, growing with temperature. A sensitive membrane alone makes no circuit: inside sits an inner reference solution of known pH with an Ag/AgCl inner reference; an outer Ag/AgCl reference reaches the sample through a saturated-KCl salt bridge that suppresses the liquid-junction potential - modern combination electrodes merge both into a single stem. Every electrode leaves the factory with its own zero offset (the asymmetry potential), and its slope decays with age, so two-point calibration is mandatory: dip into pH 4.01 then pH 9.18 buffers to pin down slope and zero; temperature changes the slope, corrected automatically by ATC. Strong alkali hides a trap: above pH 12 the glass also responds to Na+ and the reading drifts low - the sodium error. Its trump card is universality: turbid, colored, viscous, oxidizing solutions all read fine - impossible for indicators and test strips; response in seconds, and no sample is consumed. In the demo: drag the pH slider and watch the ion clouds and the mV needle deflect together as the working point slides along the mV-pH line; run the two-point calibration first, then press uncalibrated drift and sodium error to wreck the reading; drag temperature to watch the slope climb. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 碳纤维与复合材料:比铝轻比钢硬的黑色纤维
topics.descZh: 直径只有头发丝十分之一的黑色纤维,凭什么比钢还硬?碳纤维从 PAN(聚丙烯腈)白色原丝出发,经三段热处理变身:200-300 °C 预氧化,氧参与把线形分子链交联成耐热梯形结构,把拉伸取向「冻结」——不定型,下一炉就会熔并烧断;1000-1500 °C 惰性气氛碳化,非碳元素以 HCN/N₂/CO₂ 逸出,只剩 92-99% 的碳,成乱层石墨结构;(可选)2000-3000 °C 石墨化再排齐片层、提高模量。强度来自取向:碳化全程施张力,让石墨片层沿纤维轴向排列——单丝直径 5-7 μm,拉伸强度 3.5-7 GPa(钢约 1.8 GPa)、模量 230-590 GPa,密度仅 1.8 g/cm³(铝 2.7、钢 7.9),比强度约为钢的十二倍。但单丝又细又脆、怕压不耐剪,需与环氧树脂复合:树脂把载荷传进纤维并保护它;铺层各向异性,按受力「定制」——0° 扛拉、±45° 扛剪扭、90° 横向补强;预浸料叠层热压罐固化。断裂时纤维拔出与分层大量吸能,不像玻璃一裂到底。波音 787 机身 50% 是复材,风电叶片、自行车架、F1 车身同理。演示:左侧是原丝→预氧化炉→碳化炉→黑丝的生产线;右侧拖铺层角 0°/±45°/90° 与载荷滑块,看形变与破坏差异;按「纤维拔出慢放」看复合板碎而不散;按「炉温历程」回放温度阶梯。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A black fiber one-tenth the width of a human hair - why is it stiffer than steel? Carbon fiber starts as white PAN (polyacrylonitrile) precursor and transforms through three heat stages: stabilization at 200-300 °C, where oxygen crosslinks the linear chains into a heat-resistant ladder structure that freezes the stretched orientation - without it, the next furnace would melt the filaments together; carbonization at 1000-1500 °C in inert atmosphere, where non-carbon elements leave as HCN/N2/CO2 and 92-99% carbon remains in a turbostratic graphite structure; optionally graphitization at 2000-3000 °C to align the layers further and raise the modulus. Strength comes from orientation: tension is applied throughout carbonization so the graphite layers align with the fiber axis - each filament is 5-7 μm across with tensile strength 3.5-7 GPa (steel about 1.8 GPa), modulus 230-590 GPa, and a density of only 1.8 g/cm3 (aluminum 2.7, steel 7.9) - specific strength about twelve times steel. But single filaments are fine and brittle, weak in compression and shear, so they are combined with epoxy: the matrix transfers load into the fibers and protects them; the layup is anisotropic and tailored to the load - 0° plies carry tension, ±45° carry shear and torsion, 90° brace transversely; prepreg stacks cure in an autoclave. On fracture, fiber pull-out and delamination absorb large amounts of energy - no glass-like sudden cleavage. The Boeing 787 fuselage is 50% composite by weight; wind blades, bike frames and F1 bodies work the same way. In the demo: on the left a production line from precursor through the stabilization and carbonization ovens to black tow; on the right drag the layup angle 0°/±45°/90° and the load slider to see how deformation and failure differ; press fiber pull-out slow motion to see the composite break without shattering; press furnace history to replay the temperature ladder on the scope. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 稀土分离:17 个近亲的百级萃取塔
topics.titleEn: Rare-Earth Separation: Solvent Extraction Cascades for 17 Near-Twins
topics.descZh: 17 个稀土元素(钪、钇加 15 个镧系)是一窝「化学近亲」:都稳定 +3 价,离子半径随原子序数平滑收缩(镧系收缩),相邻两个只差约 1 pm,还总是一大窝共生在氟碳铈矿、独居石里——沉淀分级、蒸馏这些常规手段全拿它们没办法。工业的答案是溶剂萃取串级:有机相(P507 等酸性磷类萃取剂)对每个稀土的分配比有微小而系统的差异,相邻元素单级分离因子 β 只有约 1.5-2.5——一级萃不干净,就把成百个混合澄清槽串起来:水相向一端流、有机相向另一端流,逐级搅拌接触、澄清水相流向另一端分层,微小差异被指数放大(分离度 β^N,N 是级数),上百级 cascade 能把镨钕分到 99.99%-99.999%(5N)。徐光宪的串级萃取理论把「该用多少级、如何回萃」变成可算的公式,让中国以精矿→氧化物一体化流程的成本与纯度领先全球。分出来的东西撑起半壁高科技:钕镨→钕铁硼永磁(风电、电动车电机),镝铽→耐高温磁体,铕钇→荧光粉。单一流程 50-100+ 级,β≈2 时 100 级的放大倍数是 2^100≈10^30。演示里拖动 β、级数、进料配比滑块,看蓝(镨/水相)黄(钕/有机相)两条浓度曲线沿级逐渐拉开、产品纯度按指数跳变;按「单级 vs 串级」看一级的无奈;按「镧系收缩」看 15 根只差毫厘的半径柱。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The 17 rare-earth elements (scandium, yttrium plus 15 lanthanides) are a nest of chemical near-twins: all stable at +3, ionic radii shrinking smoothly with atomic number (the lanthanide contraction) so adjacent pairs differ by only about 1 pm, and always co-occurring as one family in bastnasite and monazite - precipitation grading and distillation are helpless. Industry answers with solvent-extraction cascades: the organic phase (acidic phosphorus extractants such as P507) takes up each rare earth at a slightly different distribution ratio; the single-stage separation factor between neighbors is only about 1.5-2.5, so one stage is never clean - instead hundreds of mixer-settlers are chained together: aqueous flows toward one end, organic toward the other, each stage mixing, contacting and settling, and the tiny difference is amplified exponentially (separation D_A/D_B = beta^N, N the stage count). A cascade of a hundred-plus stages splits praseodymium from neodymium at 99.99-99.999% (5N). Xu Guangxian's cascade extraction theory turned stage counts and scrub reflux into computable formulas, letting China lead the world on an integrated concentrate-to-oxide flowsheet. What comes out props up half of high tech: NdPr into NdFeB permanent magnets for wind turbines and EV motors, DyTb into heat-resistant magnets, EuY into phosphors. A single flowsheet runs 50-100+ stages; at beta of about 2, 100 stages amplify by 2^100, about 10^30. In the demo, drag the beta, stage-count and feed-ratio sliders and watch the blue (Pr/aqueous) and yellow (Nd/organic) concentration curves pull apart stage by stage while purity jumps by orders of magnitude; press single vs cascade to see what one stage manages alone; press lanthanide contraction to see 15 radius columns separated by a hair. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: 1952 年,芝加哥大学一间地下室里,25 岁的米勒把「生命从哪里来」搬进了玻璃器皿:上球充入甲烷、氨、氢与水蒸气——尤里主张的早期地球还原性大气,没有一丝氧;下方烧瓶煮水造雨,中间两根电极持续放出 60 kV 火花,冒充亿万年的闪电。水蒸气带着气体循环穿过电弧,产物被冷凝器淋回水相,「雨」把可溶产物冲进下球,煮开再蒸上去——一个封闭的水循环,让产物躲回水里免遭进一步轰击。一周之后,水变成琥珀色:甘氨酸、丙氨酸等 11 种氨基酸赫然在列,2008 年用现代液相色谱重测封存 54 年的原始样品,竟认出 22 种。化学路径也理清了:火花劈开 CH₄/NH₃/H₂O 产生 HCN 与醛,斯特雷克反应三步把氰、醛、氨缝成氨基酸——生命的基础砖,原来只要还原性大气加一点能量就能自组。实验并非重演生命起源,而是宣判「有机物必须有生命来造」的死刑;真实早期地球的场次可能更多是深海热泉与陨石快递,但「积木易得」这个结论已钉死:卡在西尼号坠入土卫六大气前的质谱里,同类化学仍在发生。拖「放电功率」看产物速率,拖「时间加速」快进一周;按「加氧对照」换现代大气看产物归零,按「产物清单」翻氨基酸名牌,按「一周快进」看琥珀色加深。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
In a University of Chicago basement in 1952, 25-year-old Stanley Miller moved "where did life come from" into glassware: the upper flask held methane, ammonia, hydrogen and water vapour - Urey's proposed reducing early-Earth atmosphere, with not a whisper of oxygen. A lower flask boiled water to make rain; between them a pair of electrodes spat continuous 60 kV sparks, playing lightning for eons. Vapour carried the gases through the arc, the condenser rained the products back into the water phase, and the boil recirculated them - a closed water loop letting products hide from further bombardment. After a week the water turned amber: glycine, alanine and eleven amino acids were in there, and in 2008 a modern liquid-chromatography re-run of samples archived for 54 years counted 22. The chemistry is clear too: the spark splits CH4/NH3/H2O into HCN and aldehydes, and the three-step Strecker synthesis stitches cyanide, aldehyde and ammonia into amino acids - life's basic bricks self-assemble given a reducing atmosphere and some energy. The experiment did not replay biogenesis; it executed "organics require life" as a doctrine. The real early Earth may have run more of this chemistry at hydrothermal vents and via meteorite delivery, but the verdict stands - and Cassini's mass spectrometer found the same chemistry brewing in Titan's haze on the way down. Drag discharge power for product rate, drag time acceleration to fast-forward a week; press oxygen control to swap in a modern atmosphere and watch yield vanish, product list to flip the amino-acid name cards, one-week run to see the amber deepen. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 玻璃装置全 3D:上球(气体分子小球漂浮)、电极火花(闪电动画)、冷凝管(水滴下落)、下球煮水(琥珀色渐深);分子小球用颜色区分 CH₄/NH₃/H₂O/HCN/氨基酸;HUD 产物计数。

topics.descZh: 把「孔径」做成一把精确到 0.1 nm 的尺,就能按大小和形状筛分子——沸石干的就是这件事:硅氧四面体与铝氧四面体共用氧原子,搭成笼套笼的三维骨架;铝比硅少一价,每个铝位留下一个负电荷,吸着钠、钾、钙等阳离子来平衡——这些阳离子正是交换的主角。孔径就是门:3A 孔径 0.3 nm 只放水进(乙醇深度脱水),4A 孔径 0.4 nm 放水与氧氮(空气干燥露点可到 -100 °C),5A 孔径 0.5 nm 还能分开正己烷与支链烷烃(提升汽油辛烷值),13X 孔径 1.0 nm 抓二氧化碳;双塔变压吸附(PSA)制氧机里,13X 晶孔对氮气亲和力稍强,加压时氮被截留、氧冲出,减压再把氮放走——家用制氧机、飞机惰化舱、氢气纯化全是这一对塔的轮唱。洗涤剂里的无磷助剂也是 4A 沸石:钙镁离子被钠交换出来,水就软了;炼油厂里 ZSM-5 的 0.55 nm 十元环孔道是择形催化的经典:只有直链分子进得去孔口被裂化异构,支链烷烃与芳烃太大进不去,汽油辛烷值就这样被一把「分子尺」顶上去。吸水放热是物理吸附,烘焙 200-350 °C 即可再生,循环数千次。拖「孔径」看哪些分子进门,拖「温度」看吸附量曲线;按「PSA 制氧」看双塔轮唱,按「离子交换」看钙钠换位,按「择形催化」看直链进孔异构。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Grind pore size into a ruler accurate to 0.1 nm and you can sieve molecules by size and shape - that is what zeolites do: silicon and aluminum tetrahedra share oxygen atoms into a cage-within-cage framework; aluminum carries one charge less than silicon, so every Al site leaves a negative charge balanced by sodium, potassium or calcium cations - and those cations are the exchange players. Pore size is the door: 3A (0.3 nm) admits only water (deep ethanol drying), 4A (0.4 nm) water plus oxygen and nitrogen (air dried to a -100 C dew point), 5A (0.5 nm) even separates n-hexane from branched alkanes (octane boosting), and 13X (1.0 nm) grabs CO2. In a two-bed PSA oxygen concentrator, 13X favors nitrogen slightly - pressurized, nitrogen is held while oxygen streams through; depressurized, nitrogen leaves - home oxygen concentrators, aircraft fuel-tank inerting and hydrogen purification are all this duet. The phosphate-free agent in detergent is 4A zeolite: calcium and magnesium swap out for sodium and the water softens; in refineries ZSM-5's 0.55 nm ten-member-ring is the classic shape-selective catalyst - only straight chains fit the mouth and crack-isomerize, branched alkanes and aromatics are too big, and octane numbers rise on a molecular ruler. Water uptake is physical adsorption; bake at 200-350 C to regenerate, thousands of cycles. Drag pore size to see which molecules enter, drag temperature along the loading curve; press PSA oxygen for the two-bed duet, ion exchange for the calcium-sodium swap, shape-selective catalysis to watch straight chains enter. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 铝硅酸盐骨架(球棍模型:Si/Al 两种球 + 氧桥),中央大笼与可调孔窗(氧环);各类分子(水/乙醇/氮气/氧气/正己烷/异辛烷/CO₂)飞向孔窗,进门或弹开;骨架中阳离子(金色)可被交换;右侧双塔 PSA(压力表交替);底部洗涤剂场景小图。

topics.descZh: 遥控器里那节 1.5 V 的圆柱,内胆是一场材料接力:负极是锌粉调成的凝胶——不是锌皮,是几百倍表面积的粉末,专为跑大电流;正极是压实的电解二氧化锰环,靠「质子嵌晶格」收电子;两极之间隔一层无纺布,灌满氢氧化钾溶液。放电时锌在碱里氧化:Zn+2OH⁻→ZnO+H₂O+2e⁻;正极 MnO₂ 每收一个电子就嵌进一个质子变成 MnOOH,OH⁻在隔膜里向负极搬家补位——电子不敢走电解液,只能冲出顶盖经过你的遥控器再回来,这条外电路正是 1.5 V 电压的全部意义。比起老式碳性电池,碱性方案的容量大 5-10 倍:导电率极高的 KOH 取代了氯化铵糊,锌粉表面取代了锌筒内壁;代价是密封难题——过放时负极析氢,内压一鼓就顶漏碱液腐蚀触点。1.5 V 的放电曲线又平又稳,接近容量尽头却突然跳水,这就是设备「说没电就没电」的原因。试图给它充电是危险的:锰晶格不可逆、锌粉会长枝晶刺穿隔膜,内压与短路随之而来。拖「放电电流」看大电流下的压降与容量缩水,拖「温度」看低温里电解液变稠;按「解剖视角」分层看四层结构,按「大电流对比」与碳性电池同台,按「过放漏液」看氢气鼓包。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The 1.5 V cylinder in your remote is an internal materials relay: the anode is a zinc-powder gel - not zinc sheet but powder with hundreds of times the surface area, built for high current; the cathode is a compacted ring of electrolytic manganese dioxide that takes electrons by proton insertion into its lattice; between them a nonwoven separator soaked in potassium hydroxide. On discharge zinc oxidizes in the alkali, Zn + 2OH- -> ZnO + H2O + 2e-, while the cathode's MnO2 absorbs one electron plus one proton per step to become MnOOH, and OH- migrates through the separator to keep the books balanced - the electrons themselves refuse the electrolyte and burst out through the top cap, through your remote, and back: that external loop is the whole meaning of 1.5 V. Against the old carbon-zinc cell the alkaline recipe stores 5-10 times the capacity: highly conductive KOH replaces the ammonium-chloride paste, and powder surface replaces the can wall; the price is sealing - overdischarge evolves hydrogen at the anode, pressure builds, and the crimp vents caustic electrolyte onto your contacts. The 1.5 V discharge curve is flat and confident right up to a sudden cliff - which is why devices die without warning. Recharging it is genuinely dangerous: the manganese lattice change is irreversible, the zinc powder grows dendrites that pierce the separator, and internal pressure plus short circuits follow. Drag discharge current to watch voltage sag and capacity shrink, drag temperature to see the electrolyte stiffen; press cutaway to peel the four layers, heavy-current comparison to race a carbon-zinc cell, overdischarge leak to watch the hydrogen bulge. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖开 1/4 的圆柱电池:钢壳、MnO₂ 正极环(深棕)、隔膜、锌膏(银灰颗粒感)、中心集电针、顶盖正极帽;离子小球在隔膜内迁移、电子流沿外电路灯泡跑;MnO₂ 晶格嵌入质子的动画。

topics.descZh: 两条烯烃跳了一场交换舞伴的舞:C=C 双键的两半互相换了对象——A=B + C=D 变成 A=C + B=D,碳原子重新配对而总价电子数不变,这场舞叫烯烃复分解。化学家困惑了二十年:双键那么强,凭什么说换就换?夏尔万 1971 年给出答案:催化剂不是把双键拆开,而是自带一条「金属=碳」双键(金属卡宾),先与烯烃发生 [2+2] 环加成,生成一个四元环(金属环丁烷)中间体;四元环再裂开时,裂的位置换了——金属卡宾带着一半烯烃走了,把另一半留给剩下的碎片,一轮交换就此完成,催化剂复原,进入下一轮。格拉布把催化剂换成钌卡宾:空气里稳定、容忍水与醇,1990 年代起这场舞走进天然产物全合成与药物工厂;施罗克则用钼,活性更高但娇气——2005 年诺贝尔化学奖授予这三人。复分解还有一件绝活:关环复分解——一条链两端各带一个烯烃,分子内换伴,链子首尾相接成环,五、六、七元环信手拈来;石化厂里则用自复分解把丙烯变成乙烯与 2-丁烯,让碳骨架按市场需求搬家。拖「反应进度」看一轮交换的来龙去脉,拖「催化剂负载」看周转数;按「换伴一轮」看四元环的开与合,按「关环复分解」看链子咬尾成环,按「自复分解」看丙烯的重新分配。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Two alkenes dance a partner swap: the two halves of their C=C bonds exchange - A=B plus C=D becomes A=C plus B=D, carbon pairs reshuffled with the electron books exactly balanced. This is olefin metathesis, and for twenty years chemists could not see how a bond that strong could just swap partners. In 1971 Chauvin supplied the answer: the catalyst does not crack the double bond - it arrives carrying its own metal-carbon double bond (a metal carbene), performs a [2+2] cycloaddition with the alkene into a four-membered metallacyclobutane, and when that ring breaks apart, it breaks at the other seam: the carbene leaves with one half of the alkene and hands the other half to the leftover fragment - one exchange done, the catalyst restored, ready for the next round. Grubbs swapped in a ruthenium carbene - stable in air, tolerant of water and alcohols - and from the 1990s the dance moved into total synthesis and drug plants; Schrock's molybdenum versions trade stability for raw activity. The 2005 Nobel Prize in Chemistry went to the three of them. Metathesis has a party trick, ring-closing: a chain wearing an alkene at each end swaps partners within itself and bites its own tail into a five-, six- or seven-membered ring; refineries run self-metathesis to reshuffle propylene into ethylene and 2-butene, moving carbon skeletons to where the market wants them. Drag reaction progress to walk one exchange end to end, drag catalyst loading to count turnovers; press partner swap for the ring opening and closing, ring-closing metathesis to watch a chain bite its tail, self-metathesis for the propylene reshuffle. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 两条彩色烯烃(双键发光)与钌卡宾催化剂(橙色 Ru=);[2+2] 环加成生成四元金属环丁烷(高亮),再开环换伴;产物飞离、催化剂复原循环;侧栏显示周转计数与产物比例。

topics.descZh: 把一摞只让阳离子或阴离子穿过的塑料膜交替叠起来,两端通上直流电,盐水就在膜与膜的夹缝里自己分成淡水与浓水——这就是电渗析:阴离子交换膜只放阴离子,阳离子交换膜只放阳离子,电场当搬运工。钠离子向负极跑,穿过一张阳膜进入隔室,却迎面撞上阴膜过不去,只好留下;氯离子向正极跑,穿过阴膜又被阳膜拦住——于是每隔一室,离子只出不进,成了淡水室;相邻的室只进不出,成了浓水室。与反渗透靠压力挤水过膜不同,电渗析搬运的是盐不是水,所以特别适合中低盐度水(苦咸水、高硬度地下水):盐度越低越省电,能耗大致随脱盐量线性走;而海水淡化仍是反渗透的主场。它的软肋是浓差极化:电流过大时,膜面的离子来不及由主体水补充,水分子被电解析出氢与氢氧根,碱性边界层让钙镁在膜面结垢,脱盐率掉头向下;对策是控制在极限电流以内运行,或者定时倒极(EDR)——让电场每几十分钟反一次向,刚析出的垢被新环境溶解,膜堆自清洁。离子膜还不挑对象:乳清脱盐、氨基酸分离、废水酸碱回收,同一套膜堆换个进料就是另一条产线。拖「工作电压」看离子迁移与脱盐率,拖「进水盐度」看能耗账本;按「脱盐运行」看淡浓分道,按「浓差极化」看结垢如何发生,按「倒极清洗」看垢被反向溶解。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Stack alternating sheets of plastic film - one passable only to cations, one only to anions - apply DC across the pile, and salt water splits itself into fresh and brine in the gaps between membranes. That is electrodialysis: anion-exchange membranes admit only anions, cation-exchange membranes only cations, and the electric field does the hauling. Sodium ions run toward the cathode, pass a cation membrane into a chamber, then hit an anion membrane they cannot cross - stuck; chloride ions run the other way and are stopped by a cation membrane - so alternate chambers leak ions only outward and turn fresh, while their neighbors admit only and turn brine. Where reverse osmosis pushes water through under pressure, electrodialysis hauls salt, not water - which makes it the tool for mid- and low-salinity feeds like brackish water and hard groundwater: the leaner the brine, the cheaper the kilowatt-hours, roughly linear in salt removed; seawater stays reverse osmosis's home turf. The weakness is concentration polarization: push the current too hard and ions arrive at the membrane faster than the bulk can supply them, water splits into hydrogen and hydroxide, and the alkaline boundary layer precipitates calcium and magnesium scale right on the membrane - recovery collapses. The fixes are running below the limiting current, or reversing the polarity every few tens of minutes (EDR): freshly nucleated scale redissolves in the new regime and the stack cleans itself. The membranes are also promiscuous: whey demineralization, amino-acid separation, acid and base recovery from waste streams - change the feed, keep the stack. Drag working voltage to watch ion traffic and recovery, drag feed salinity for the energy ledger; press desalting run to see fresh and brine part ways, polarization to watch scale nucleate, polarity reversal to watch it dissolve away. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 膜堆立体剖视:交替排列的阳膜(蓝)/阴膜(橙)、隔网水流通道;Na⁺(蓝球)与 Cl⁻(绿球)在电场箭头下分道;淡水流与浓水流颜色渐变;极化时膜面闪白结垢,倒极后垢层溶解。

topics.descZh: 防锈最便宜的方案是一条 450 °C 的锌池:除油、酸洗、助镀后的钢件整个浸进熔融锌液,铁与锌在界面上直接反应,长出一层层铁锌合金(Γ、δ、ζ 相层层相扣),提出来时外面再挂一层纯锌——这不是刷上去的漆,是长进去的冶金结合,硬度高、划不穿。锌的聪明之处在于它不靠隔离靠「牺牲」:锌比铁活泼,镀层破损露出的钢切口旁,锌作为原电池的负极率先氧化,电子源源不断喂给铁,让铁的氧化反应无从发生——一块几毫米宽的切口周围,几十微米厚的锌层能站岗十几年;这就是牺牲阳极保护的镀层版。账本也清楚:热浸镀层厚 50-150 μm,户外钢结构寿命 20-50 年,成本只有不锈钢的零头;锌液温度必须压在 480 °C 以下,超过后铁锌反应失控,合金层厚而脆,镀层一敲就掉(硅含量高的钢尤其容易「超长」,须控温并在锌液中加铝抑制)。产量最大的终点是流水线:带钢连续浸镀成的热镀锌板,撑起汽车车身与家电外壳;结构件则一锅一锅浸,护栏、铁塔、灯杆,镀完还能看到锌液冷却流淌的泪痕花。拖「浸镀时间」看合金层怎么长厚,拖「锌液温度」看反应快慢与脆层风险;按「入锅浸镀」看全程,按「镀层剖面」看五层结构,按「切口保护」看锌如何在缺口处牺牲自己,按「红锈对比」看有无镀层的命运分岔。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The cheapest anti-rust recipe is a pool of zinc at 450 degrees Celsius: degreased, pickled and fluxed steel goes in whole, iron and zinc react at the interface and grow a stack of iron-zinc alloy layers (the Gamma, Delta and Zeta phases locked together), and a coat of nearly pure zinc comes out on the surface - not paint laid on top but metallurgy grown in, hard to scratch through. Zinc's cleverness is that it does not protect by blocking but by sacrificing itself: zinc is the more active metal, so at a scratch or cut edge the surrounding zinc becomes the anode, oxidizing first and feeding electrons to the exposed iron until its rusting has no current left - a few millimetres of bare edge can be guarded for a decade or more by a coating only tens of microns thick: sacrificial anode protection, plated. The ledger is equally plain: hot-dip coatings run 50-150 microns, last 20-50 years outdoors, and cost a fraction of stainless; but keep the kettle below 480 degrees - above that the iron-zinc reaction runs away, the alloy layer turns thick and brittle, and the coating flakes at a knock (high-silicon steels are the worst offenders, tamed by temperature control and a little aluminum in the bath). The biggest tonnage is continuous: strip dipped on the fly becomes the galvanized sheet under car bodies and appliance panels, while fabrications - guardrails, transmission towers, lampposts - take the batch route and keep the frozen drip patterns of the zinc as it cooled. Drag dip time to watch the alloy layers thicken, drag bath temperature for reaction speed and brittleness risk; press kettle dip for the full run, coating cross-section for the five-layer stack, cut-edge protection to watch zinc die guarding a scratch, rust comparison for the fork in the road. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 锌池(银灰色液面冒烟)上钢构件吊入浸没;剖面特写:钢基体→Γ/δ/ζ 合金层→η 纯锌层逐层生长;切口处锌层发亮牺牲、电子流动画;对照未镀钢材红锈蔓延。

topics.descZh: 把两个碳片段接成一根 C–C 键,是合成化学里最值钱的手艺——药物分子一大半骨架靠它焊出来,而干这活最多的催化剂是铃木偶联,三位先驱因此分享 2010 年诺贝尔化学奖。催化循环是一支三步舞:第一步氧化加成,Pd(0) 插进芳基溴的 C–Br 键,变成 Ar–Pd(II)–Br,钯从 0 价升到 +2 价;第二步转金属,碱先把苯硼酸的硼酸基去质子化活化,芳基才肯从硼「过户」到钯上,得到 Ar–Pd(II)–Ar;第三步还原消除,两个芳基在钯上牵手成联芳烃,Pd(0) 再生,回到起点接下一轮。碱是隐形功臣:既活化硼酸又中和副产物 HBr,碱量不足,循环就卡在转金属一步,产率立刻趴下。它碾压前辈格氏试剂的地方在「脾气好」:格氏对水与氧赶尽杀绝,要无水乙醚加氮气保护,一滴水闯入就当场报废;铃木却在空气里、甚至水里都能跑,副产物只有无毒的硼酸和盐——制药厂敢把它搬上万吨生产线,沙坦类降压药、抗肿瘤药都有它焊的键,材料厂用它焊 OLED 共轭骨架。拖「碱量」看循环顺畅还是卡壳,拖「温度」看反应快慢;按「催化循环」看三步舞全程,按「碱的作用」看去质子化与中和,按「与格氏对比」看一滴水终结格氏试剂,按「工业规模」看反应釜批量出活。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Stitching two carbon fragments into one C-C bond is the most valuable trick in synthesis chemistry - half the skeletons of drug molecules are welded this way, and the catalyst doing it most often is the Suzuki coupling, which earned Heck, Negishi and Suzuki the 2010 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. The catalytic cycle is a three-step dance: oxidative addition, where Pd(0) slips into the C-Br bond of an aryl bromide to give Ar-Pd(II)-Br, palladium rising from 0 to +2; transmetalation, where the base first deprotonates and primes the boronic acid, and only then will the aryl transfer from boron over to palladium, giving Ar-Pd(II)-Ar; and reductive elimination, where the two aryls join hands into a biaryl and Pd(0) is regenerated, ready for the next round. The base is the invisible hero: it primes the boronic acid and mops up HBr; starve it and the cycle stalls at transmetalation, yield collapsing on the spot. Its edge over the older Grignard reagent is temperament: Grignards tolerate neither water nor air - dry ether, nitrogen blanket, and one stray droplet kills them on the spot - while Suzuki runs in open air, even in water, leaving nothing but non-toxic boric acid and salts behind. That is why pharma runs it on ten-thousand-tonne lines - sartan blood-pressure drugs and anticancer agents carry bonds it welded - and materials chemists use it to weld the conjugated backbones of OLEDs. Drag base amount to keep the cycle flowing or stall it, drag temperature for the tempo; press catalytic cycle for the full dance, base at work for deprotonation and HBr mopping, vs Grignard to watch one droplet kill a Grignard reagent, industrial scale for the reactor turning out batches. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 分子舞台:中央亮球是带空配位的钯催化剂,右侧 Ar–Br 进场被钯插键闪光;下方蓝色碱小球拽走 H 活化苯硼酸,芳基从硼跳到钯、B(OH)₃ 离场,两个芳基牵手发光成联芳烃后离场,钯复位循环,计数器累计 TON;左角是干冰乙醚加氮气的格氏小剧场,水滴闯入即冒火花报废;右下是搅动的工业反应釜。

topics.descZh: 乙烯是化学工业的「粮食」:全球年产超过 2 亿吨,塑料袋、防冻液、PVC 管全从它来,而这些乙烯约九成出自蒸汽裂解炉——石脑油或乙烷混入稀释蒸汽,送进约 850 °C 的裂解炉管,只停留 0.1–0.5 秒:高温让 C–C 键随机断裂、自由基夺氢接力,长链烷烃被剪成乙烯、丙烯这样的短链烯烃。这门手艺的精髓是一组矛盾的三角:温度越高、烯烃收率越高,可停留一长,刚生成的乙烯又会二次裂解成甲烷和焦炭——所以「高温+短停留+急冷」缺一不可:出炉气体要在毫秒级冲进急冷锅炉,降到 400 °C 以下把组成「冻结」,废热顺手回收成高压蒸汽去驱动透平;稀释蒸汽打的是另一副算盘——把烃分压摊薄,压制结焦、抬高选择性;即便如此,炉管烧几周还是会挂焦,得停炉通蒸汽加空气「烧焦」;原料更是一笔大账:乙烷裂解乙烯收率约 80%,是省钱省事的美国页岩气路线;石脑油只约 30%,但联产丙烯、丁二烯与芳烃,是亚洲欧洲路线——一套炉子选什么原料,画出了全球石化版图。拖「炉膛温度」看收率天平,拖「停留时间」看二次裂解;按「裂解反应」看串珠长链被剪断,按「急冷与余热」看毫秒急冷与蒸汽透平,按「结焦与烧焦」看管壁挂焦与烧焦复位,按「原料对比」看乙烷与石脑油的收率差距。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Ethylene is the staple food of the chemical industry - over 200 million tonnes a year, feeding plastic bags, antifreeze and PVC pipe - and about nine tenths of it comes from steam cracking: naphtha or ethane mixed with dilution steam races through furnace coils at about 850 °C for just 0.1-0.5 seconds. Heat snaps C-C bonds at random and radical hydrogen-transfer relays the cuts, chopping long alkanes into short alkenes like ethylene and propylene. The craft is a triangle of trade-offs: hotter favors alkene yield, but linger and the newborn ethylene cracks again into methane and coke - so high temperature, short residence and rapid quench must all hold at once; the effluent must plunge below 400 °C within milliseconds in a transfer-line exchanger, freezing the composition while the waste heat is recovered as high-pressure steam for turbines. Dilution steam runs its own ledger: it thins the hydrocarbon partial pressure, suppressing coke and lifting selectivity; even so coils foul within weeks and get decoked with steam and air. Feedstock is the big account: ethane yields about 80% ethylene, the frugal US shale-gas route; naphtha only about 30% but co-produces propylene, butadiene and aromatics, the Asia-Europe route - one furnace's feed choice sketches the global petrochemical map. Drag coil temperature to tilt the yield balance, drag residence time to watch secondary cracking; press crack reaction to watch beaded long chains get cut, quench & heat recovery for the millisecond chill and the steam turbine, coking & decoking for fouled walls making a fresh start, feed comparison for the ethane-versus-naphtha yield gap. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视裂解炉:底部燃烧器火墙舔着中央蛇形炉管;串珠长链烃分子入管后被剪成发亮的短链烯烃,焦炭黑点慢慢糊上管壁;出炉气体冲过蓝色急冷帘毫秒级降温,余热锅炉推动小蒸汽透平;右侧仪表盘实时统计乙烯/丙烯/甲烷/焦炭,左端另有乙烷与石脑油收率对比柱。

topics.descZh: 电灯普及之前,矿工和洞穴探险者的头灯烧的是一块「石头」:电石——电弧炉里用 2200 °C 把石灰和焦炭强行撮合出的碳化钙,遇水就拆伙:CaC₂+2H₂O→C₂H₂↑+Ca(OH)₂,放出的乙炔从喷嘴冒出,点燃即得一盏亮灯;电石灯的构造是一台滴水定时器:上仓装水,旋钮控制滴阀,水一滴一滴渗进下仓的电石——滴速就是亮度旋钮,滴得快火苗窜高、电石也烧得快;乙炔含碳量高,火焰里满是炽热的碳粒,亮度远超煤油灯且几乎无烟,又是全谱暖光、不像 LED 发蓝,照得清岩壁层次——矿工靠它照了一百年巷道,洞穴探险家靠它画了几十年地图;它也有脾气:乙炔压强超过约 2 个大气压会自分解爆炸,遇铜银还会生成敏感的乙炔铜,所以灯体只靠水封低压供气、气路绝不用铜;最危险的是熄火误操作:水汽把火吹灭而气还在冒,乙炔积聚越过爆炸下限,遇明火就轰燃——所以熄火要先关阀通风,清理熟石灰糊前先冲净残存电石;今天钢板切割车间里约 3100 °C 的氧炔焰,正是这盏矿灯化学反应的高温后代。拖「滴水速率」看火苗涨落,拖「电石余量」看反应家底;按「反应供气」看滴水产气链,按「亮度调节」看火焰随滴速起伏,按「洞穴探险」看光锥扫过钟乳石,按「误操作风险」看熄火积气的轰燃前夜。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Before electric light reached the mines, a miner's headlamp burned a stone: calcium carbide, forged in an arc furnace at 2200 °C from lime and coke, which falls apart on contact with water - CaC2 + 2H2O -> C2H2 + Ca(OH)2 - releasing acetylene that burns at the nozzle with a brilliant flame. The lamp is a drip timer: the upper chamber holds water, a knob-metered valve lets it seep drop by drop onto the carbide below, and drip rate is the brightness dial - drip faster and the flame climbs, but the charge burns sooner too. Acetylene is carbon-rich, its flame full of glowing soot particles: far brighter than kerosene, nearly smokeless, and full-spectrum warm rather than blue-leaning like LED, so rock reads in fine layers - miners lit a century of tunnels with it, cavers mapped decades of caves by its light. But it has a temper: above about 2 atm acetylene decomposes explosively, and with copper or silver it forms shock-sensitive acetylides, so the lamp feeds gas at low pressure through a water seal and its gas path never touches copper. The deadliest error is a blown-out flame: steam snuffs the flame while the wet carbide keeps generating, acetylene accumulates past its lower explosive limit, and one spark brings a flash fire - so shut the valve, ventilate, and flush leftover carbide before cleaning the lime sludge. The hottest descendant of this lamp still works today: the oxyacetylene flame at about 3100 °C cutting steel plate. Drag drip rate to ride the flame, drag carbide level to watch the charge run down; press gas generation for the drip-react-burn chain, brightness dial for flame vs drip, cave exploration for the beam sweeping stalactites, misfire hazard for the blown-flame gas build-up. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视矿灯挂在洞顶:上仓清水经滴阀旋钮一滴滴落入下仓,电石块冒泡缩小,乙炔沿气管到喷嘴点燃;反射罩上火焰随滴速涨落,暖光光锥扫过钟乳石与石笋;误操作模式里水流淹过电石、火焰熄灭,黄绿警示气雾在洞顶积聚,乙炔浓度表越过安全线。

topics.descZh:
头痛、发热、防血栓,人类吃得最多的药片之一诞生于柳树:几千年前人们就嚼柳树皮止痛退热,1828 年从中提取出水杨苷,1838 年制得水杨酸——退热镇痛消炎样样在行,却苦涩伤胃,不少病人因胃痛被迫停药;1897 年拜耳的费利克斯·霍夫曼给水杨酸的酚羟基「戴上乙酰帽」,用乙酸酐一步酯化得到乙酰水杨酸,刺激大减而药效保留,1899 年以 aspirin 之名上市——A 是 acetyl(乙酰),spir 取自绣线菊 spirea,in 是药名后缀;合成本身干净利落:水杨酸 C₇H₆O₃(摩尔质量 138)加乙酸酐(102),浓硫酸催化,水浴 80–85 °C 约 15 分钟,产出乙酰水杨酸(180)与乙酸(60),冷水洗去乙酸,乙醇-水重结晶,熔点 135 °C 是纯度的答卷;它也会倒着走:酯键遇潮气缓慢水解回水杨酸与乙酸,老药片的醋味正是警告,升温与碱性更会加速变质,所以要肠溶衣加干燥保存;进入人体,阿司匹林把环氧酶 COX 活性位点的 Ser530 共价乙酰化,通道锁死、前列腺素断供,痛、热、炎三路减轻;血小板血栓素 TXA₂ 同样断供,于是小剂量 75–100 mg/日长期防血栓——血小板没有细胞核,被不可逆抑制后只能走完 7–10 天的一生;而 300–500 mg 的一片,则是镇痛退热的常规剂量。拖「反应温度」看产率涨落,拖「环境湿度」看水解快慢;按「合成反应」看乙酰基挂上酚羟基,按「重结晶提纯」看晶体生长、杂质沉底,按「水解变质」看酯键断裂、醋雾升腾,按「体内药效」看 Ser530 锁死通道。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 化学实验台全景:锥形瓶坐在 80–85 °C 水浴中,上方悬浮水杨酸与乙酸酐球棍模型;合成模式乙酸酐飞向酚羟基,乙酰基「咔哒」挂上酚氧、乙酸落入瓶口,放热泛橙光;重结晶模式晶体在乙醇-水烧杯中长成规则晶簇,红色杂质沉入母液;水解模式水分子进攻药片酯键,黄色醋雾升腾,纯度与熔点示数下降;体内模式转向右侧 COX 通道剖面,Ser530 被乙酰化封堵,花生四烯酸被挡在门外,PG 产量条掉零。
topics.descEn:
Headache, fever, clot protection - one of the most swallowed tablets in history was born from a willow: people chewed willow bark for pain and fever millennia ago, salicin was extracted from it in 1828, salicylic acid obtained in 1838 - a capable antipyretic, analgesic and anti-inflammatory, but bitter and harsh on the stomach, forcing many patients to quit; in 1897 Felix Hoffmann at Bayer capped the phenol hydroxyl of salicylic acid with an acetyl group using acetic anhydride, one clean esterification giving acetylsalicylic acid with far less irritation while keeping the effect, on the market from 1899 as aspirin - the A is acetyl, spir comes from the meadowsweet genus Spirea, in is the drug suffix; the synthesis itself is tidy: salicylic acid C7H6O3 (molar mass 138) plus acetic anhydride (102), sulfuric acid catalyst, a water bath at 80-85 °C for about 15 minutes, yielding acetylsalicylic acid (180) and acetic acid (60); wash off the acetic acid with cold water, recrystallize from ethanol-water, and a melting point of 135 °C is the purity report; it also runs backwards: the ester bond slowly hydrolyzes in humid air back to salicylic and acetic acid - the vinegar smell of old tablets is the warning - heat and alkali speed it up, so tablets get enteric coatings and dry storage; inside the body, aspirin acetylates Ser530 in the active site of the COX enzyme, locking the channel and cutting off prostaglandins, easing pain, fever and inflammation at once; platelet thromboxane TXA2 is cut off too, so a low daily dose of 75-100 mg guards against clots long-term - platelets have no nucleus and, once irreversibly inhibited, can only live out their remaining 7-10 days; while one 300-500 mg tablet is the usual analgesic dose. Drag reaction temperature to watch yield rise and fall, drag humidity to speed up or slow down hydrolysis; press synthesis to see the acetyl click onto the phenol oxygen, recrystallize for crystals growing while impurities sink, hydrolysis for the ester bond breaking with vinegar fog, and in vivo COX for Ser530 locked shut by the acetyl cap. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 化学实验台全景:锥形瓶坐在 80–85 °C 水浴中,上方悬浮水杨酸与乙酸酐球棍模型;合成模式乙酸酐飞向酚羟基,乙酰基「咔哒」挂上酚氧、乙酸落入瓶口,放热泛橙光;重结晶模式晶体在乙醇-水烧杯中长成规则晶簇,红色杂质沉入母液;水解模式水分子进攻药片酯键,黄色醋雾升腾,纯度与熔点示数下降;体内模式转向右侧 COX 通道剖面,Ser530 被乙酰化封堵,花生四烯酸被挡在门外,PG 产量条掉零。

topics.descZh:
2001 年,Sharpless 给合成化学立了一条新规矩:别再指望碳碳键慢慢「谈判」,直接挑那些像搭扣一样的反应——高产率、近乎零副产物、在水里和空气里都能做、原料好买、产物一滤就纯。这类模块化反应一按即合,2022 年诺贝尔化学奖把它推上领奖台:一半授予 Sharpless 与 Meldal 的铜催化叠氮-炔环加成 CuAAC,一半授予 Bertozzi 的活细胞无铜点击 SPAAC。以核心反应 CuAAC 为例:叠氮 R–N₃ 与端炔 R′–C≡CH 本是两个「老实」的手柄,不加催化剂时要在 80–110 °C 慢煮十几小时,而且 1,4-与 1,5-两种异构体约各占一半,像一把钥匙同时开两把锁;Cu(I) 一登场便改写剧本——它先与炔 π 配位、拔氢生成铜乙炔化物,叠氮末端氮再经六元铜环过渡态精准咬合,速率提升约 10⁷ 倍,产物锁定唯一的 1,4-构型;驱动力是三氮唑环约 30 kcal/mol 的芳香化稳定化,热力学一路下坡,合上就几乎打不开。铜能催化反应,也能杀死细胞:Bertozzi 想给活细胞表面的糖链贴标签,细胞却先被铜毒死;她把炔键弯进八元环,做成环辛炔——环张力替反应预付活化能,无铜也能点击,于是活细胞成像、肿瘤靶向给药、DNA/RNA 标记有了不误伤的「生物正交」工具。这套思想早已工业化:药物片段连接、抗体偶联药 ADC、水凝胶、胶粘剂与聚合物接枝,都是「两个模块各带一个手柄,一按就装」;安全上则要记住叠氮化物的脾气——重金属叠氮易爆、HN₃ 挥发有毒,而反应本身温和、水相、副产物近零,堪称绿色化学的模范生。拖「Cu(I) 浓度」看速率飙升与选择性锁定,拖「温度」看分子布朗运动加快;按「热点击 50%」「铜催化 CuAAC」「活细胞 SPAAC」「聚合物接枝」切换四种演示。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 水相烧杯舞台上,蓝色叠氮模块与金色端炔模块布朗漂浮相遇;热点击模式不加铜,产物五元环以 1,4/1,5 两种朝向随机落座、比例约半;铜催化模式里绿色 Cu(I) 先抓住炔键拉出乙炔亚铜短键,叠氮末端氮再定向咬合,只出 1,4 且速率飙升;活细胞模式切到半透明细胞,带张力弧线的橙色环辛炔与膜上叠氮无铜成环,旁边红色游离 Cu²⁺ 标注细胞毒性;聚合物模式两条珠链端部点合成长链;示波器与公式实时刷新相对速率与 1,4 选择性。
topics.descEn:
In 2001 Sharpless set a new rule for synthesis: stop courting stubborn bonds slowly and pick reactions that work like belt buckles - high-yielding, near-zero byproducts, at home in water and air, cheap feedstocks, products purified by a simple filtration. These modular reactions snap shut at a press, and the 2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry put them on the podium: half to Sharpless and Meldal for the copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition CuAAC, half to Bertozzi for copper-free clicking inside living cells. Take CuAAC: azide R-N3 and terminal alkyne R′-C≡CH are two well-behaved handles, but uncatalyzed they demand 80-110 °C for a dozen hours and deliver 1,4- and 1,5-isomers in roughly equal halves, one key opening two locks. Cu(I) rewrites the script: it first pi-binds the alkyne and strips a hydrogen to form a copper acetylide, then the azide terminal nitrogen bites in through a six-membered copper-ring transition state - rates rise about 10,000,000-fold and the product locks to the single 1,4 isomer, driven by roughly 30 kcal/mol of triazole aromatization, a thermodynamic downgrade all the way, so once shut it hardly opens. Copper catalyzes reactions but also kills cells: when Bertozzi tried to tag glycans on living cell surfaces, the cells died of copper first; she bent the alkyne into an eight-membered ring - cyclooctyne - whose ring strain pre-pays the activation energy, so clicking proceeds without copper, giving bioorthogonal tools for live-cell imaging, tumor-targeted delivery and DNA/RNA labeling. The idea has long left the flask: fragment-based drug design, antibody-drug conjugates, hydrogels, adhesives and polymer grafting all run on two modules, each with one handle - press to assemble. Safety remembers the azide temper: heavy-metal azides detonate at a touch and volatile HN3 is toxic, while the reaction itself stays mild, aqueous and near-zero byproduct - a model student of green chemistry. Drag Cu(I) concentration to watch rates soar and selectivity lock in, drag temperature to speed the Brownian dance; press thermal click, CuAAC, live-cell SPAAC or polymer grafting to switch demos. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 水相烧杯舞台上,蓝色叠氮模块与金色端炔模块布朗漂浮相遇;热点击模式不加铜,产物五元环以 1,4/1,5 两种朝向随机落座、比例约半;铜催化模式里绿色 Cu(I) 先抓住炔键拉出乙炔亚铜短键,叠氮末端氮再定向咬合,只出 1,4 且速率飙升;活细胞模式切到半透明细胞,带张力弧线的橙色环辛炔与膜上叠氮无铜成环,旁边红色游离 Cu²⁺ 标注细胞毒性;聚合物模式两条珠链端部点合成长链;示波器与公式实时刷新相对速率与 1,4 选择性。

topics.descZh:
造纸的起点是拆木头:木头由纤维素纤维(长 1–3 mm、宽 20–50 μm,比发丝还细)被木质素这把「天然胶水」粘成木材,所以第一件事是把木质素拆走、把纤维解散成浆。路线有两条:机械浆用磨石/热磨直接磨散纤维,得率高达 90–95%,木质素留在纸里,新闻纸便宜却会黄变发脆;化学浆走硫酸盐法(kraft),NaOH+Na₂S 的白液在 150–170 °C 高压蒸锅里煮 1–2 小时溶掉木质素,得率只有 45–55%,换来长纤维与高强度,印刷纸、包装纸都靠它;溶出木质素的黑液经蒸发浓缩入炉燃烧,回收碱与热能(白液循环),石灰窑再把 CaCO₃ 煅回 CaO(石灰循环)。残余木质素交给 ClO₂:ECF 无元素氯漂白只氧化木质素、不伤纤维,白度从 60 提到 90 ISO。成形时纸浆被稀释到 0.5–1% 的极稀悬浮液,经流浆箱喷上长网(Fourdrinier),水靠重力加真空从网眼抽走,纤维无序躺平、纵横交织;现代纸机网速可达 1500–2000 m/min,一秒钟织出 30 多米纸。强度从哪来?打浆让磨齿压溃纤维壁、使其分丝帚化,比表面积暴增、接触点成倍增多,这是纸强度的主要来源之一,但打浆过度会让排水变难、纸发紧发硬;而真正把纸「粘」在一起的是氢键——纸里没有胶水,干透后纤维接触点上形成数万个氢键,湿水后氢键被水分子逐个拆开,纸立刻软烂,这就是纸怕水的原因。纸还能回用:每回收一轮,纤维就被切短一分、帚化疲劳一分,一般 5–7 轮后强度不足以成纸,需补充原生浆,全球纸回收率约 60%。旧书发脆则是另一桩化学案:明矾-松香施胶让纸偏酸(pH≈4.5–5.5),纤维素被酸水解断链;现代中性/碱性施胶(CaCO₃ 填料,pH≈7–8.5)能让纸保存几百年。拖「打浆度」看纤维长出毛刷,拖「纸页定量」看纸变厚;按「制浆拆木」看木质素析出飘散,按「成形上网」看纤维交织脱水,按「干燥成纸」看氢键点亮、强度攀升,按「回用循环」看纤维一轮轮变短。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 剖视迷你纸机:流浆箱把青绿纤维稀浆喷上半透明长网,水滴穿网坠入白水坑,纤维无序躺平交织;压榨辊对挤水,大烘缸冒着蒸汽把纸烘干,纸卷缓缓长大。制浆模式里磨石旋转、蒸锅冒汽,浅棕与深棕的木质素粒子析出飘走;干燥模式里氢键在纤维接触点亮起蓝点;回用模式里纤维一轮轮变短、强度条走低。
topics.descEn:
Papermaking starts by taking a tree apart. Wood is a composite of cellulose fibers 1-3 mm long and 20-50 μm wide - finer than a hair - glued into timber by lignin, so the first task is to remove the lignin and disperse the fibers into pulp. Two routes exist. Mechanical pulp grinds chips apart for a yield of 90-95%, but lignin stays in the sheet: newsprint is cheap, yet yellows and turns brittle. Chemical pulping - the kraft process - cooks chips in white liquor of NaOH and Na₂S at 150-170 °C under pressure for 1-2 hours to dissolve lignin; the yield drops to 45-55%, traded for long, strong fibers used in printing and packaging. The black liquor is evaporated and burned to recover alkali and heat (the white liquor cycle), and the lime kiln calcines CaCO₃ back to CaO (the lime cycle). Residual lignin is removed by bleaching with ClO₂ - ECF, elemental chlorine free - which oxidizes lignin selectively without harming fibers, lifting brightness from 60 to 90 ISO. Forming dilutes the pulp to 0.5-1% and squirts it from a headbox onto a Fourdrinier wire: gravity and vacuum pull water through the mesh while fibers, with no time to line up, lie down in a random interlock; modern machines run at 1500-2000 m/min, weaving more than 30 meters of paper every second. Where does strength come from? Beating crushes fiber walls into microfibrils - fibrillation - exploding the surface area and multiplying contact points, a main source of strength, though over-beating slows drainage and makes the sheet hard and tight. What truly binds paper is the hydrogen bond: there is no glue in a dry sheet - tens of thousands of hydrogen bonds form where fibers touch; wet it and water molecules pry the bonds apart, and the sheet goes limp, which is why paper fears water. Paper recycles, but each round cuts fibers shorter and fatigues their fibrils: after roughly 5-7 rounds the sheet is too weak, and virgin pulp must be blended in; the global recycling rate is about 60%. Old books grow brittle by another chemistry: traditional alum-rosin sizing left paper acidic (pH 4.5-5.5) so cellulose hydrolyzed into short chains, while modern neutral-alkaline sizing with CaCO₃ filler (pH 7-8.5) keeps paper stable for centuries. Drag the beating slider to grow brush-like fiber ends, drag grammage to thicken the sheet; press pulping to watch lignin drift away, wire forming to watch fibers weave, drying to watch hydrogen bonds light up, recycling to watch fibers shorten round by round. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视迷你纸机:流浆箱把青绿纤维稀浆喷上半透明长网,水滴穿网坠入白水坑,纤维无序躺平交织;压榨辊对挤水,大烘缸冒着蒸汽把纸烘干,纸卷缓缓长大。制浆模式里磨石旋转、蒸锅冒汽,浅棕与深棕的木质素粒子析出飘走;干燥模式里氢键在纤维接触点亮起蓝点;回用模式里纤维一轮轮变短、强度条走低。

topics.descZh: 复制叉工厂：前导链连续、冈崎片段五步成熟
topics.descEn: The replication-fork factory: continuous leading strand, five-step Okazaki maturation

topics.descZh: 大分子进不了血液——淀粉、蛋白、脂肪必须被拆成单糖、氨基酸、脂肪酸:口腔咀嚼+淀粉酶开头,胃里 pH 2 的盐酸杀菌并激活胃蛋白酶,十二指肠里胆汁把油滴乳化出千倍表面、胰酶总攻,30 m² 的绒毛把单体送进血管,大肠回收水、菌群吃纤维。
topics.descEn: Macromolecules can't enter the blood — starch, protein and fat must be broken into sugars, amino acids and fatty acids: chewing and amylase start it, pH 2 stomach acid sterilizes and activates pepsin, bile emulsifies fat into a thousand times the surface for the pancreatic enzymes, 30 m² of villi absorb the units into the blood, and the colon reclaims water while microbes eat fiber.

topics.descZh: 止血只是第一棒:中性粒细胞清菌、巨噬细胞清场,成纤维细胞铺胶原脚手架、VEGF 长出新血管,上皮以每天 ~0.5–1 mm 从两缘爬行封口;3 周到 1 年胶原 III 换 I、交联重组,张力恢复到 ~80% 封顶——瘢痕没有汗腺和毛囊,附件不复生;湿性环境比结痂快 40%。
topics.descEn: Hemostasis is only the first baton: neutrophils clear bacteria, macrophages clean up, fibroblasts lay collagen scaffolds while VEGF sprouts new vessels, and epithelium crawls ~0.5–1 mm/day to close; from week 3 to a year collagen III swaps to I and crosslinks, strength caps at ~80% — scars never regrow glands or follicles, and a moist environment heals 40% faster than a scab.

topics.descZh: 不递病毒递图纸:脂质纳米颗粒把编码刺突蛋白的 mRNA 送进细胞,核糖体照图施工、刺突顶上细胞膜;免疫系统把这根「假刺突」当成演习——提呈、B 克隆扩张、产抗体;第二针让滴度再跳 10–100 倍;真病毒抵达时,记忆细胞数天内闪电应答。
topics.descEn: Deliver the blueprint, not the virus: lipid nanoparticles carry mRNA coding for the spike into cells, ribosomes print it and the spike studs the cell surface; the immune system runs a drill on this fake spike — presentation, B-cell expansion, antibodies; the second dose lifts titers another 10–100×; when the real virus arrives, memory cells answer within days.

topics.descZh: 突触强度是变量:NMDA 受体是「符合检测器」,要谷氨酸+去极化双条件才弹掉镁塞放钙进来;100 Hz 强直刺激触发 CaMKII、把更多 AMPA 受体顶上膜——同样的测试脉冲,EPSP 从 5 mV 跳到 18 mV 并保持:一起放电的神经元连在一起,这就是记忆的突触写法。
topics.descEn: Synaptic strength is a variable: the NMDA receptor is a coincidence detector — glutamate plus depolarization together pop the magnesium plug and let calcium in; a 100 Hz tetanus triggers CaMKII to park more AMPA receptors in the membrane — the same test pulse now gives 18 mV instead of 5, and it stays: neurons that fire together wire together; that is how memory is written.

topics.descZh: σ 认启动子、解链泡张开、A=U 逐个配对、终止发夹收工——不需要引物
topics.descEn: σ finds the promoter, the bubble opens, A=U pairs one by one, a hairpin stops the show — no primer needed

topics.descZh: EF-Tu 押 tRNA 进 A 位、密码子对上才锁定、肽键转移、EF-G 移位、UAA 落链
topics.descEn: EF-Tu delivers tRNAs, only matching codons lock, peptide transfer, EF-G translocates, UAA drops the chain

topics.descZh: Post-Albers 交替通路：3 Na⁺ 出、2 K⁺ 入、1 ATP
topics.descEn: Post–Albers alternating access: 3 Na⁺ out, 2 K⁺ in, 1 ATP

topics.descZh: 去极化/复极化：示波曲线与通道门控同相位
topics.descEn: Depolarization / repolarization: oscilloscope trace in phase with channel gating

topics.descZh: 电信号→化学信号→电信号：Ca²⁺ 点火、囊泡融合、ACh 受体开门；含肉毒/有机磷两种毒理彩蛋
topics.descEn: Electrical→chemical→electrical: Ca²⁺ trigger, vesicle fusion, ACh receptors; botulinum & organophosphate easter eggs

topics.descZh: 碳固定 → 还原 → RuBP 再生，碳账本逐条点亮
topics.descEn: Fixation → reduction → RuBP regeneration, with the carbon ledger lighting up

topics.descZh: 质子梯度驱动 c 环–γ 轴旋转催化，一圈 3 个 ATP
topics.descEn: Proton gradient spins the c-ring–γ shaft: 3 ATP per revolution

topics.descZh: 电子下坡、质子上坡：Ⅰ/Ⅲ/Ⅳ 泵出梯度，ATP 合酶的燃料从这来；含 DNP 解偶联彩蛋
topics.descEn: Electrons fall, protons climb: Ⅰ/Ⅲ/Ⅳ build the gradient that fuels ATP synthase; DNP uncoupler easter egg

topics.descZh: 两部光子电梯把电子抬起，水裂解放出 O₂——和线粒体同一台 ATP 合酶，反着用；含绿光彩蛋
topics.descEn: Two photon elevators lift electrons as water splits — same ATP synthase as mitochondria, run in reverse; green-light easter egg

topics.descZh: Ca²⁺ 点火 → Power stroke → ATP 松手回位
topics.descEn: Ca²⁺ ignition → power stroke → ATP release and reset

topics.titleZh: 血红蛋白 MWC 别构
topics.descZh: T→R 变构协同运氧 + S 形氧合曲线
topics.descEn: T→R allosteric cooperation in O₂ transport, plus the sigmoid binding curve

topics.descZh: 六碳链花 2 ATP 上膛、对半劈开,两条三碳各自净赚——账本从 −2 爬回 +2,全程不需氧
topics.descEn: The six-carbon chain pays 2 ATP to prime, splits in half, and each piece earns it back — ledger from −2 to +2, no oxygen needed

topics.descZh: 4C 草酰乙酸接 2C 乙酰转一圈回原点:两个碳以 CO₂ 呼出,3 NADH + 1 FADH₂ + 1 GTP 到手
topics.descEn: Oxaloacetate takes a 2C acetyl around one lap: two carbons leave as CO₂, pocketing 3 NADH, 1 FADH₂, 1 GTP

topics.descZh: 拔掉氧,NAD⁺ 池崩塌——丙酮酸变乳酸/乙醇把它一格格买回;面包、酸奶、肌肉酸痛同一条岔路
topics.descEn: Cut oxygen and the NAD⁺ pool crashes; pyruvate becomes lactate/ethanol to buy it back — bread, yogurt and sore muscles share the fork

topics.descZh: 髓袢降支渗水、升支泵盐,逆流倍增把梯度抬到 1200 mOsm;ADH 决定尿有多浓
topics.descEn: The descending limb leaks water, the ascending pumps salt; countercurrent multiplication builds 1200 mOsm — ADH sets the urine

topics.descZh: 3 亿小泡摊开 70 m²;气体只走分压「下坡」,0.5 µm 呼吸膜 0.25 秒完成换气
topics.descEn: 300 million sacs spread 70 m²; gases flow only down pressure gradients across a 0.5 µm membrane

topics.descZh: 房压>室压开二尖瓣、室压>主动泳压开主动泳瓣——Wiggers 三条压力曲线实时联动四扇门
topics.descEn: Atrial over ventricular opens the mitral; ventricular over aortic opens the semilunar — Wiggers plots run live

topics.descZh: 底膜一端硬一端软,每个频率只在对应位置共振——大脑读位置=读频率,耳蜗是机械傅里叶机
topics.descEn: The basilar membrane grades stiff to slack: every frequency peaks somewhere — place equals pitch, a mechanical Fourier machine

topics.descZh: 睫状肌捏橡皮质地的晶状体,把焦点钉回视网膜;拉不动了就是老花,视盘是出厂盲点
topics.descEn: Ciliary muscles squeeze the elastic lens to pin focus on the retina; when squeezing fails — presbyopia

topics.descZh: 两条腿沿微管交替前行:一步一袋 ATP,脚移 16nm、重心进 8nm——分子世界的步行者
topics.descEn: Two legs alternate along the microtubule: one ATP per step, feet 16 nm, body 8 nm — the molecular walker

topics.descZh: 后随链末端永远无法补齐,每代磨掉一截 TTAGGG——海弗里克极限与癌细胞的端粒酶续命
topics.descEn: The lagging end can never be filled: TTAGGG grinds away each generation — the Hayflick limit and telomerase tricks

topics.descZh: 同源配对联会,四分体交叉点红蓝片段物理换段——重组不是洗牌是换段,兄弟姐妹因此不同
topics.descEn: Homologs pair, chiasmata physically trade red and blue segments — recombination is trading, not shuffling

topics.descZh: 阻遏蛋白堵路,乳糖把它掰下来,聚合酶通行——「只在需要时表达」的基因调控第一课
topics.descEn: The repressor blocks, lactose pops it off, polymerase flows — lesson one of expressing only what you eat

topics.descZh: 向导 RNA 扫描,PAM 验票,逐碱基校验,双刀剪断——NHEJ 乱修敲除或 HDR 照模板精修
topics.descEn: Guide RNA scans, PAM checkpoints, base-by-base match, paired cuts — NHEJ blunders or HDR rewrites

topics.descZh: 结合-内吞-脱壳-劫持核糖体-组装-裂解:产线从细胞蛋白翻成病毒零件,工厂易主
topics.descEn: Bind, endocytose, uncoat, hijack ribosomes, assemble, lyse: the production line flips to virus parts

topics.descZh: 提呈→T 放行→B 克隆成军→抗体中和→记忆驻守;二次遭遇滴度又快又高——疫苗的原理
topics.descEn: Present, license, clone the army, neutralize, remember: the second strike is fast and tall — that is vaccination

topics.descZh: 因子逐环点亮 1→10⁶ 指数放大;血小板栓+纤维蛋白网封口;缺 VIII 一环断全链(血友病)
topics.descEn: Factor by factor lights up, 1→10⁶ amplification; plug plus fibrin mesh; lose VIII and the chain snaps

topics.descZh: 胰岛素开门收糖、胰高血糖素逼肝放糖——双闸负反馈把血糖钉在 70-110;糖尿病=闸门失灵
topics.descEn: Insulin opens gates, glucagon raids the liver: two gates pin glucose to 70-110; diabetes is the gate failing

topics.descZh: 纺锤丝搜索-捕获动粒,染色体列队赤道板后姐妹单体同步分离——一套基因组的精确平分
