topics.descEn: Spindle fibers search-and-capture kinetochores; chromosomes line up, then sisters split in sync — one genome halved exactly

topics.descZh: 下丘脑比较核心温度与设定点:冷了颤抖缩血管,热了出汗舒血管,发烧=设定点上移的追逐
topics.descEn: The hypothalamus compares core temperature with the set-point: shiver and constrict when cold, sweat and dilate when hot — fever chases a raised set-point

topics.descZh: 低氧驱动肾脏 EPO 泵、骨髓加速造血——饱和度仍低,氧含量却追平平原
topics.descEn: Hypoxia drives the kidney's EPO pump and marrow output — saturation stays low, yet oxygen content catches up

topics.descZh: 一个气味分子引爆 GPCR→cAMP 放大瀑布直到放电;大脑读 3×4 组合模式码
topics.descEn: One odorant detonates the GPCR→cAMP cascade into a spike; the brain reads a 3×4 combinatorial code

topics.descZh: PER/CRY 按住自己的启动子:自抑制转录环 ≈24h 自生振荡,光脉冲推迟或提前
topics.descEn: PER/CRY repress their own promoters: a self-inhibiting loop oscillates ≈24 h; light pulses delay or advance it

topics.descZh: C4 空间接力浓缩 CO₂,CAM 夜里囤酸白天用——光呼吸归零,水与 ATP 的交换
topics.descEn: C4 relays CO₂ in space, CAM stocks acid at night — photorespiration flatlines, trading water for ATP

topics.descZh: 每个心肌细胞除极时都是一台小电池:整块心肌的偶极子在导联轴上的投影画成 P-QRS-T——P=心房除极、QRS=浦肯野全网点火、T=反向复极;切到房颤看 P 当场消失、RR 间期乱成一团
topics.descEn: Every depolarizing heart cell is a tiny battery: the cardiac dipole projected on the lead draws P-QRS-T — switch to AFib to watch the P wave vanish and the RR intervals fall into chaos

topics.descZh: 抗生素不创造耐药,只做筛选:突变早已把抗性埋进菌群,半途停药是定向培育耐药菌,足量足疗程才能在适应跑赢之前清场
topics.descEn: Antibiotics don't create resistance, they sieve for it — mutation seeds it in advance, stopping early breeds superbugs, and only full dose for the full course clears the field before adaptation wins

topics.descZh: 敲击膝腱,肌梭放电、Aα 纤维以 100 m/s 把信号送进脊髓,一个突触直接接通运动神经元,48 ms 后小腿已弹起——而大脑要到 600 ms 后才知情:脊髓先斩,大脑后奏
topics.descEn: Tap the tendon and the spindle fires: Aα fibers carry the signal into the cord at 100 m/s, a single synapse triggers the kick in ~48 ms — while the brain only learns of it ~600 ms later

topics.descZh: 蓝光被尖端 phototropin 抓住,生长素被横向泵到背光侧——背光侧细胞伸长得更多,茎不是被「拉」向光,是被背光侧「推」弯的;根敏感得多,同一分子在那里是刹车
topics.descEn: Blue light hits phototropins in the tip and auxin is pumped to the shaded side, whose cells elongate more — the stem is not pulled but pushed toward the light, while roots brake and bend away

topics.descZh: 两枚肾形细胞是植物的呼吸阀门:光下 K⁺/Cl⁻ 泵入、苹果酸合成,渗透势把水拽进来,膨压一升,薄外壁伸得多、厚内壁伸得少,细胞弯成弓、气孔张开;干旱时 ABA 一声令下离子外流,几分钟内闭合——CO₂ 通道与水汽出口是同一扇门。
topics.descEn: Two kidney cells are the plant's breathing valve: in light, K⁺/Cl⁻ pump in and malate forms, osmosis drags water in, turgor rises, the thin outer walls stretch past the thick inner ones, cells bow and the stoma opens; drought flips ABA and ions leak out within minutes — the CO₂ door and the water-vapor exit are the same door.

topics.descZh: 每个意图都要翻译一次:动作电位点燃电压门控 Ca²⁺ 通道,囊泡与突触前膜融合,数万分子乙酰胆碱横渡 50 nm 间隙,受体门开、终板电位过阈,肌膜点火经 T 管引爆肌质网钙火花——箭毒占住受体、肉毒掐死融合,肌肉就永远等不到命令。
topics.descEn: Every intention crosses once: the action potential fires voltage-gated Ca²⁺ channels, vesicles fuse, tens of thousands of acetylcholine molecules ferry the 50 nm cleft, receptors open, the endplate potential crosses threshold, and the T-tubule ignites the sarcoplasmic reticulum's calcium spark — curare squats on receptors, botox strangles fusion, the muscle never hears the order.

topics.descZh: 植物没有内耳,靠「石头」导航:淀粉体沉到细胞底侧,PIN 蛋白重新排队把生长素泵向低侧;茎的低侧被催着伸长、向上弯,根的低侧反被抑制、向下弯——同一滴激素、两种相反的答案;造粉体突变体横放着就再也立不直。
topics.descEn: Plants navigate with stones: amyloplasts sink to the cell floor, PIN proteins reshuffle and pump auxin to the lower flank; on shoots the low side elongates and bends up, on roots it is suppressed and bends down — one hormone, opposite verdicts; strip the statoliths and a horizontal seedling never straightens.

topics.descZh: 没有图纸也能长出花纹:激活剂短程自催化,抑制剂跑得更快地远程划界,均匀场上一点噪声就自发裂成斑点/条纹/迷宫——抑制剂的扩散必须快过激活剂(Du/Dv>1),否则图案当场溶解;豹点是斑马条,只是参数不同。
topics.descEn: Patterns without blueprints: a short-range activator self-catalyzes while a faster inhibitor draws long-range borders, and uniform noise cracks into spots, stripes or mazes — the inhibitor must outrun the activator (Du/Dv>1) or the pattern dissolves on the spot; leopard spots and zebra stripes are the same equation with different dials.

topics.descZh: 把水送上百米树冠的不是根在推,是叶在拉:叶片蒸发把导管水柱拽成负压(树冠 −0.5~−3 MPa),氢键内聚让水链拉不断——毛细只能升 0.29 m、根压只能推 2 m;气孔做 CO₂ 进水汽出的买卖,拉太狠空穴「咔」地断链,红杉止步 115 m
topics.descEn: A hundred-metre crown is filled not by root push but leaf pull: evaporation drags the xylem column into tension (−0.5 to −3 MPa) while H-bond cohesion keeps the chain unbroken — capillarity lifts 0.29 m, root pressure 2 m; stomata trade CO₂ in against H₂O out, and pull too hard snaps a column with a click — redwoods stop at 115 m

topics.descZh: 疏水塌缩沉核心、氢键拉出螺旋与折叠片,能量漏斗收束成唯一天然态;错误折叠粘成朊病毒纤维
topics.descEn: Hydrophobes bury, H-bonds zip helices and sheets, the energy funnel squeezes into one native state — misfolds glue into prion fibrils

topics.descZh: 内淋巴凭惯性赖着不走,顶弯壶腹嵴毛细胞——只报角加速度;急停后的眼震就是余波
topics.descEn: Endolymph lags by inertia and bends the crista — reporting angular acceleration; nystagmus is the aftermath of a stop

topics.descZh: N₂ 三键 945 kJ/mol,哈伯法 450 °C/200 atm,固氮酶常温常压就拆、代价 16 ATP/N₂:类黄酮暗号⇄结瘤因子,根毛卷曲、侵染线送菌入皮层;豆血红蛋白把关放氧,切开根瘤是粉红;NH₃ 上、糖下,轮作肥田。
topics.descEn: N₂'s triple bond (945 kJ/mol) needs Haber-Bosch 450 °C/200 atm; nitrogenase cracks it at ambient conditions for 16 ATP per N₂: flavonoid passwords meet Nod factors, root hairs curl, infection threads escort bacteria in; leghemoglobin gates oxygen — cut a nodule and it is pink; NH₃ up, sugar down.

topics.descZh: 骨头不是石头:破骨细胞贴面抛酸挖出陷窝,成骨细胞铺胶原矿化填平,RANKL/OPG 让一拆一补收支平衡;沃尔夫定律按力线增减小梁,失重时天平倒向拆除、每月丢 1–1.5% 骨密度。
topics.descEn: Bone is living tissue, not stone: osteoclasts acidify pits to pH 4.5 and carve them, osteoblasts fill them with mineralised osteoid; RANKL/OPG balances the books, Wolff's law tunes the truss along force lines — weightlessness tips it to −1–1.5% BMD per month.

topics.descZh: 抗体重链基因是片段库:约 40 V、27 D、6 J——RAG 剪刀随机抽拼 V-D-J,剪掉的成环丢弃,接头由 TdT 随机加减碱基;重链×轻链配对冲上 10¹¹ 种接口;抗原一来克隆增殖,超突变逐轮打磨亲和力,记忆归档。
topics.descEn: The heavy-chain gene is a parts bin: ~40 V, 27 D, 6 J segments. RAG scissors deal a random V-D-J, skipped DNA loops away, TdT scribbles random bases at the joints; heavy-light pairing yields ~10¹¹ interfaces; antigen triggers clonal selection, hypermutation polishes affinity, memory archives the win.

topics.descZh: 首次接触安静致敏:IgE 钉满肥大细胞、无症状;再次接触:一颗花粉同时咬住两个 IgE=交联开关,组胺 0 秒爆发——血管渗漏、平滑肌痉挛;全身误报就是过敏性休克,肾上腺素当场反打。
topics.descEn: First exposure quietly arms mast cells with IgE — no symptoms. Second exposure: one pollen grain cross-links two IgE at once, the detonator — histamine erupts in seconds, vessels leak, airways clamp; system-wide, it's anaphylaxis, and epinephrine slams it back.

topics.descZh: 荧光素在酶口袋里氧化,激发态电子落回基态,差价变成一颗光子;萤火虫先花 ATP 装膛,甲藻被浪一搅齐闪蓝光——90% 能量变光不发热。
topics.descEn: Luciferin oxidizes in the enzyme pocket and the excited electron pays its change as one photon; fireflies load with ATP first, stirred dinos flash blue — 90% light, no heat.

topics.descZh: 红细胞背着 A/B 糖抗原名牌,血浆里天然游荡着 anti-A/anti-B;错型输血,IgM 五聚体两头桥连,凝集成串堵死血管——兼容矩阵实时高亮。
topics.descEn: Red cells wear A/B sugar badges while plasma patrols with natural anti-A/anti-B; a mismatched unit gets bridged by pentameric IgM into clumps — the compatibility matrix highlights live.

topics.descZh: 94 °C 解链、55 °C 引物落位、72 °C Taq 延伸——一轮翻倍,30 循环把一根 DNA 放大十亿倍,对数坐标下指数律是一条直线。
topics.descEn: 94 °C melts the duplex, 55 °C docks the primers, 72 °C extends — one cycle doubles, thirty cycles amplify a single molecule a billion-fold; on a log plot the exponential is a straight line.

topics.descZh: 施万细胞裹出的绝缘层把跨膜电容砍两百倍,动作电位只在郎飞氏结再生——同屏赛跑 1 m/s 对 120 m/s;脱髓鞘,传导当场失败。
topics.descEn: The Schwann-cell wrap cuts membrane capacitance two-hundred-fold, so spikes regenerate only at the nodes of Ranvier — 1 m/s vs 120 m/s in a same-screen race; strip the myelin and conduction fails.

topics.descZh: 兔多→狐肥→兔崩→狐饥→兔复——两条 Lotka–Volterra 方程把种群拧成相图上闭合的环,峰谷永远相差约四分之一周期;Hudson Bay 百年皮毛记录同款;加容纳量,环收敛到共存点;扑一把,环换一条继续转。
topics.descEn: Rabbits up, foxes fat, rabbits crash, foxes starve, rabbits return — two Lotka–Volterra equations spin populations around a closed loop in phase space, peaks lagging a quarter cycle; a century of Hudson Bay fur records agrees; add carrying capacity and the loop spirals into coexistence; give it a kick and it hops to another loop.

topics.descZh: 2500 m 深海无光:海水下渗被岩浆房加热到 350–400 °C,携金属与 H₂S 上喷,遇 2 °C 冷水骤冷析出硫化物长成黑烟囱;细菌以 CO₂+O₂+4H₂S→CH₂O+4S+3H₂O 固碳供养群落,密度可达周缘万倍,热液一熄即凋亡。
topics.descEn: At 2,500 m in total darkness, seawater sinks through cracks, is baked to 350–400 °C and rises loaded with metals and H₂S; hitting 2 °C water it quenches into black sulfide smoke that builds chimneys. Bacteria fix CO₂ via chemosynthesis, feeding a community up to 10,000× denser than its surroundings — and it dies when the vent dies.

topics.descZh: 蜂巢为什么是六边形:围出同样面积,六边形铺法总壁长最短——三角形多花 ~23% 蜡、方形 ~7.5%;工蜂在 35 °C 把蜡加工到可塑,先砌圆筒再自动沉成六边,双层错位的菱形尖底 109.47° 再省一截;1 g 蜡约值 8 g 蜂蜜,扇风把花蜜从 80% 水分吹干到 18% 才封盖。
topics.descEn: Why hexagons: enclosing equal area, hex tiling has the least total wall — triangles waste ~23% more wax, squares ~8%; bees work wax at 35 °C, blow circles that settle into hexagons, and back-to-back rhombic bottoms at 109.47° save still more; 1 g of wax costs ~8 g of honey, and fanning dries nectar from 80% water to 18% before capping.

topics.descZh: 外骨骼不能渐长只能换壳:脑 PTTH 令前胸腺分泌蜕皮素 20E,决定何时蜕;咽侧体的保幼激素 JH 决定变成谁——高则仍是幼虫,归零才化蛹;蛹期约 45% 干物质被拆解,成虫盘长成翅足触角,两周后羽化;成虫前胸腺退化,永不再蜕皮。
topics.descEn: A chitinous exoskeleton cannot grow — it must be shed. Brain PTTH tells the prothoracic gland to release ecdysone (when to molt); juvenile hormone decides what you become: high JH re-makes a larva, zero JH makes a pupa. The pupa recycles ~45% of its dry mass as imaginal discs build wings and legs; the adult never molts again.

topics.descZh: 每传一层只剩约 10%:其余被呼吸烧成热、被粪便交给分解者、或压根没被吃到;能量一路漏、一路窄,养 1 kg 顶级捕食者要垫 1 万 kg 生产者——金字塔从不倒:能量不循环,只有物质循环;海洋生物量金字塔可以倒,能量金字塔永不倒。
topics.descEn: Only ~10% survives each hop: the rest is breathed away as heat, lost to decomposers, or never eaten; the funnel narrows step by step — 1 kg of top predator stands on 10,000 kg of producers — which is why the pyramid never inverts: energy doesn't cycle, only matter does; marine biomass pyramids can flip, energy pyramids never.

topics.descZh: 死亡信号激活半胱氨酸蛋白酶瀑布：Fas 受体或线粒体细胞色素 c 触发启动型酶，凋亡小体七元环组装，执行型酶-3/7 切割数百种底物——染色质凝缩、细胞皱缩、膜起泡，最终被巨噬细胞无声吞噬，无炎症。
topics.descEn: Death signal triggers a caspase cascade: Fas receptor or mitochondrial cytochrome c activates initiator caspases; the apoptosome heptamer assembles; executioner caspase-3/7 cleaves hundreds of targets — chromatin condenses, cell shrinks, blebs, and is silently engulfed with no inflammation.

topics.descZh: 下丘脑 TRH→垂体 TSH→甲状腺 T3/T4，升高的 T3/T4 回头抑制下丘脑与垂体——靶腺激素关掉自己的信号源；原发性甲减时 TSH↑ T4↓；Graves 甲亢时自身抗体绕开反馈，TSH 被压到近零。
topics.descEn: Hypothalamus TRH → pituitary TSH → thyroid T3/T4; rising T3/T4 inhibit both — the hormone silences its own signal; primary hypothyroidism: TSH↑ T4↓; Graves' disease: autoantibodies bypass feedback, TSH collapses to near zero.

topics.descZh: DNA 甲基化（CpG 上加 -CH₃→基因沉默）与组蛋白修饰（H3K27me3 压实染色质／H3K9ac 打开）在不改变序列的前提下开关基因；DNMT1 在复制后维持甲基化模式——同一 DNA，肝细胞与神经元的读法截然不同。
topics.descEn: DNA methylation (−CH₃ on CpG → gene silencing) and histone marks (H3K27me3 compacts chromatin; H3K9ac opens it) switch genes without touching the sequence; DNMT1 copies methylation patterns after replication — same DNA, radically different readouts in liver vs. neuron.

topics.descZh: 陆地九成植物的根都包着真菌:菌丝把吸收面积放大 10–100 倍,替根去够磷——磷在土壤里的扩散只有毫米级;植物用约 13% 的净同化碳付账,真菌送回磷、氮和水;菌丝还把几株植物连成网,幼苗建株时从网络里「借」碳启动;全球每年约 130 亿吨碳走这条地下暗渠。
topics.descEn: Nine in ten land plants wrap their roots in fungus: hyphae multiply the absorbing area 10–100× to reach phosphorus roots can't — P diffuses only millimetres in soil; plants pay ~13% of their assimilated carbon, fungi return P, N and water; hyphae even wire plants together so seedlings can borrow carbon — ~13 billion tonnes of carbon flow this underground channel yearly.

topics.descZh: 细胞周期靠原癌基因踩油门、p53/Rb 刹车；DNA 断链激活 ATM/ATR，p53 四聚体积累把细胞按停在 G1/S 检查点修复，修不好就地凋亡；抑癌基因要两击（两个等位基因都失活）才失守，油门卡死加刹车失灵即成失控克隆；放化疗正是靠损伤逼 p53 完好的细胞自杀。
topics.descEn: The cell cycle runs on oncogene gas and p53/Rb brakes; DNA breaks wake ATM/ATR, p53 tetramers pile up and stall the cycle at the G1/S checkpoint for repair or apoptosis; a tumor suppressor needs two hits before the brakes die — stuck gas plus dead brakes yields a runaway clone.

topics.titleZh: 胚胎发育与 Hox 基因
topics.descZh: 形态素梯度 C=C₀·e^(−x/λ) 给每个细胞前后轴坐标，浓度越过阈值 θ 就点亮对应 Hox 基因；基因簇在染色体上的排列顺序=沿身体的表达顺序（共线性），后部显性取最高表达者为身份；表达边界挪一格，整节器官就错位——Antp 挪到头部，触角当场变腿。
topics.descEn: A morphogen gradient C=C₀·e^(−x/λ) gives every cell an A-P coordinate; crossing threshold θ switches on the matching Hox gene. Cluster order on the chromosome equals expression order along the body (collinearity), posterior dominance takes the top active gene as identity — shift one boundary and organs move wholesale: Antp in the head turns antennae into legs.

topics.descZh: 微管正端不断加 GTP-tubulin，亮绿的 GTP 帽在就生长；埋进管壁的 GTP 水解成 GDP，帽一丢整根管像香蕉皮一样剥落塌缩（灾变），偶尔重新加帽叫拯救；浓度越高灾变越少；纺锤体正是靠这套随机试错搜索-捕获染色体，紫杉醇/秋水仙碱则用这一点做化疗。
topics.descEn: GTP-tubulin adds at the plus end: while the bright GTP cap holds, the microtubule grows; once the cap is lost the GDP wall peels away like a banana skin (catastrophe), with occasional rescues. Higher tubulin means fewer catastrophes — and the spindle exploits this trial-and-error to search-capture chromosomes, which taxol and colchicine sabotage.

topics.descZh: Aδ 有髓纤维 ~15 m/s 传快痛、C 无髓纤维 ~1 m/s 传慢痛，先后冲到脊髓背角的"闸门"；粗的 Aβ 触觉纤维激活抑制性中间神经元把闸门半关——揉一揉能止痛；中脑 PAG 下行的内啡肽把闸门全关；闸门常开=痛觉过敏，闸门焊死=先天无痛，感觉不到骨折烫伤。
topics.descEn: Myelinated Aδ fibers (~15 m/s) deliver fast pain, bare C fibers (~1 m/s) the slow burn, both rushing the dorsal-horn gate; coarse Aβ touch fibers fire the inhibitory interneuron and half-close it — rubbing really helps; endorphins descending from the PAG shut it fully. A gate stuck open is hyperalgesia; one welded shut is the dangerous painlessness of CIPA.

topics.descZh: 清醒时皮层各自为政（β/γ 小而碎）；入睡后丘脑-皮层逐渐同步：N1 α 消退、N2 睡眠纺锤波+K 复合波、N3 大振幅 δ 慢波——慢波期海马把白天的记忆回放搬进皮层巩固；REM 脑子像醒着但肌肉瘫痪；腺苷积累=睡眠压力，咖啡因占住受体把它压低。
topics.descEn: Wake is cortical cacophony (small fast β/γ); sleep synchronizes thalamus and cortex: α fades in N1, spindles and K-complexes rule N2, big δ slow waves sweep N3 — replaying the day's memories from hippocampus to cortex; in REM the brain looks awake but the body is paralyzed; adenosine is sleep pressure, and caffeine blocks its receptors.

topics.descZh: 衣被蛋白把供膜弯成球、装货掐断；马达蛋白沿微管把囊泡押运到靶膜，Rab 系留后 v-/t-SNARE 互认、像拉链逐圈盘绕成四螺旋束，把两层膜从 ~8 nm 拉到 ~1 nm 直到自发融合；Ca²⁺ 是最后的扳机——突触前末梢递质释放就是它的全速版。
topics.descEn: Coat proteins bud a vesicle off the donor membrane; motors haul it along a microtubule, Rab tethers it, and v-/t-SNAREs zip into a four-helix bundle pulling the bilayers from ~8 nm to ~1 nm until they fuse — Ca²⁺ is the final trigger, and transmitter release is the full-speed version.

topics.descZh: 饥饿把 mTOR 刹车松开，ULK1 在受损线粒体表面启动一层双层膜；膜像袋子一样一圈圈收口，把货物封进自噬体，再与溶酶体对接注入酸性水解酶；货物被拆成氨基酸运出回收——修得好就回收再用，修不好就释放细胞色素 c 走凋亡，同一颗坏电池的两种命运。
topics.descEn: Fasting releases the mTOR brake and ULK1 nucleates a double membrane around a damaged mitochondrion; the bag closes into an autophagosome, docks with the lysosome, and acid hydrolases break the cargo into recycled amino acids. Repairable means recycled; beyond repair means cytochrome c and apoptosis — one dead battery, two fates.

topics.descZh: 细菌不挥鞭子——基部马达是一台直径 ~45 nm、可正反转的生物涡轮：质子顺电化学梯度挤过 MotA/MotB 定子通道，每颗把转子拧过 ~14°，约 26 步转一圈、转速可达 300 rps；逆时针成束平滑游动，顺时针束散翻滚，感受器经 CheY-P 改换向概率——偏置随机游走让菌体沿浓度梯度上坡。
topics.descEn: Bacteria don't whip their flagella — the base is a ~45 nm, reversible biological turbine: protons squeeze down their electrochemical gradient through MotA/MotB stators, each twisting the rotor ~14°, ~26 steps per revolution at up to 300 rps. CCW bundles into smooth runs, CW shatters into tumbles, and CheY-P bias makes the random walk climb the gradient.

topics.descZh: 剪接体认出内含子两端的 GU 与分支点 A，把内含子弯成套索切下；两步转酯反应把外显子缝成成熟 mRNA，接缝精确到单个核苷酸；拨动选择性剪接开关，同一基因按不同外显子组合拼出多种蛋白——人类约 95% 的基因都靠这一手，剪错一步就是遗传病。
topics.descEn: The spliceosome binds the GU site and branch-point A, loops the intron into a lariat and cuts it out; two transesterifications stitch exons into mature mRNA with single-nucleotide precision. Flip the alternative-splicing switches and one gene yields many proteins — ~95% of human genes do this, and one wrong cut is a genetic disease.

topics.titleZh: 补体级联与膜攻击复合物
topics.descZh: 补体是免疫的点名爆破队:抗原-抗体复合物点亮 C1,C3 转化酶把 C3 切成 C3b 铺满病原体并以 2ⁿ 暴增;C5b 带 C6–C8 锚膜后,C9 逐根插膜拼出 ~10 nm 跨膜孔,水盐涌入细菌胀破;宿主细胞靠 CD59 挡住自家 C9 免于误炸。
topics.descEn: Complement is the immune system's demolition squad: antigen-antibody complexes ignite C1, and C3 convertase carpets the pathogen with C3b that doubles exponentially; C5b anchors C6-C8, then C9 monomers slot in one by one into a ~10 nm transmembrane pore — water rushes in and the cell bursts. Host cells park CD59 on their membranes to refuse the same fate.

topics.descZh: 约 20 亿年前,古菌吞下细菌却没消化:细菌交出 ATP(或糖)换来庇护,二分裂随宿主代代相传;基因组一格格迁入细胞核只留 0.4%,共生体缩小成线粒体/叶绿体;双层膜、环状 DNA、70S 核糖体、二分裂,四条证据链都指向细菌出身。
topics.descEn: Two billion years ago an archaeon swallowed a bacterium and failed to digest it: the bacterium traded ATP (or sugar) for shelter and divided along with its host for generations; its genome migrated bit by bit into the nucleus, keeping 0.4%, while the symbiont shrank into a mitochondrion or chloroplast. Double membrane, circular DNA, 70S ribosomes, binary fission — every clue points back to bacteria.

topics.descZh: 细胞给待销毁蛋白打死亡标签:E1 以 ATP 激活泛素、E2 携带、E3 连接酶认出错误折叠蛋白;串上 ≥4 个泛素的 K48 链被 19S 盖帽认领,蛋白被拉直塞进 20S 空心筒剪成短肽回收;硼替佐米堵筒即停摆,E3 失效则垃圾堆积——大件垃圾走自噬。
topics.descEn: The cell stamps doomed proteins with a death tag: E1 activates ubiquitin with ATP, E2 carries it, and E3 ligases recognise misfolded substrates; a K48 chain of ≥4 ubiquitins is claimed by the 19S cap, and the protein is pulled straight into the hollow 20S barrel to be clipped into peptides for recycling. Bortezomib plugs the barrel and everything stalls; with E3 disabled, garbage piles up — bulky waste goes to autophagy.

topics.descZh: 侦察蜂在垂直巢脾上跳 8 字舞：直线摇摆跑相对垂直线的偏角 = 食物相对太阳的方位角，摇摆时长 = 距离（约 1 秒 ≈ 1 km）；太阳每小时西移 15°，同一朵花上午和下午跳的角度不同——舞蹈钟自动补偿，跟随蜂用触角读完就起飞。
topics.descEn: A scout dances a figure-8 on the vertical comb: the waggle run's angle from vertical equals the food's bearing relative to the sun, and its duration encodes distance (about 1 s per km); as the sun drifts 15° per hour the same flower gets re-angled all day — the dance clock compensates, and followers fly off after reading it with their antennae.

topics.descZh: 细胞把内部蛋白切碎成 8~10 肽、装进 MHC-I 凹槽顶到表面——自检报告上墙；TCR 只认"MHC+肽"整体：正常肽弱黏附即离，异常肽加上 CD8 共受体双识别、胞内信号超阈，杀伤颗粒出手，靶细胞凋亡；自反应克隆早在胸腺被阴性选择删除。
topics.descEn: Cells slice their own proteins into 8–10mers, load them into MHC-I grooves, and pin them to the surface — a self-inspection report on display; TCRs read only the

topics.descZh: 裸岩上只有地衣能扎根；地衣酸解岩石攒出第一撮土，苔藓接力盖住保水，草本抢光快长、灌木乔木随后——每一代物种都在为下一代改造地形，直到优势种不再改变环境，群落停在某气候顶极；火烧把时钟拨回，但土壤还在，次生演替快进。
topics.descEn: On bare rock only lichen grips; it etches the first crumbs of soil, moss takes over and holds water, grasses race for light, then shrubs and trees — each generation reworks the stage for the next until the dominant stops changing it and the community rests at its climax; fire rewinds the clock, but the soil remains, so secondary succession runs fast-forward.

topics.descZh: 变异是随机的,筛选不是:与树皮背景反差大的蛾更容易被鸟吃掉,留下的后代把种群体色整体推移——背景一变,选择方向当场反转;撤掉捕食者,频率就只剩随机漂变。
topics.descEn: Mutation is random, selection is not: moths contrasting most with the bark get eaten first, and the survivors shift the population's color wholesale — flip the background and selection reverses on the spot; remove the predator and only drift remains.

topics.descZh: 花用花蜜雇快递、用色香打广告;花粉在柱头上识别同种才萌发,花粉管沿着花柱钻向胚珠,释放两个精子完成双受精:一个做胚,一个做胚乳——自花花粉管会在半路被拦下。
topics.descEn: The flower pays nectar wages and advertises in color and scent; pollen germinates only on the right stigma, the pollen tube drills down the style toward the ovule, and two sperm complete double fertilization — one makes the embryo, one the endosperm — while self-pollen's tube gets stopped halfway.

topics.descZh: 分化像一张斜坡地图:干细胞在山顶待命,不对称分裂留一个守山、放一个下山,生态位信号的浓度决定滚进哪条山谷——谷底是终末细胞;山中因子能把它抬回山顶,变回 iPS。
topics.descEn: Differentiation is a sloped landscape: stem cells wait on the hilltop, asymmetric division keeps one up top and lets one roll down, and niche signal gradients pick which valley — the valley floor is a terminal cell; Yamanaka factors can haul it back up as an iPS cell.

topics.descZh: 双链小 RNA 被 Dicer 剪成 21 nt 通缉令装进 RISC:完全互补当场剪断靶 mRNA,部分互补扣住翻译——基因沉默是半路拆掉信使
topics.descEn: A short double-stranded RNA is diced into 21-nt guides that arm RISC: perfect pairing slices the target mRNA on the spot, partial pairing just stalls it — silencing is intercepting the messenger

topics.descZh: 隐花色素吸一枚蓝光光子,自由基对在 50 μT 地磁里以不同速率转换自旋,产率差被视网膜读成明暗图案——倾角罗盘只看俯角、不辨南北极
topics.descEn: Cryptochrome absorbs one blue photon; the radical pair converts between spin states at field-dependent rates, and the yield difference paints the retina — an inclination compass that reads dip angle, not poles

topics.descZh: 一公斤细菌替你消化啃不动的纤维:发酵出短链脂肪酸喂上皮、训练免疫、递化学信使;一疗程广谱抗生素让多样性塌方,重建要几星期
topics.descEn: A kilogram of bacteria digests the fiber you can't: fermenting short-chain fatty acids that feed the gut wall, train immunity and signal the brain; one course of antibiotics collapses the diversity, and rebuilding takes weeks

topics.descZh: 转肽酶把糖链的肽尾切缝成网,细菌才扛得住几十个大气压的膨压:青霉素长得像 D-Ala-D-Ala 却让酶切不动——交联停摆,新壁漏风,细胞自己胀破
topics.descEn: Transpeptidase stitches glycan strands into a mesh so the cell can hold tens of atmospheres of turgor: penicillin mimics D-Ala-D-Ala and jams the enzyme — cross-linking stalls, the new wall leaks, and the cell bursts from within

topics.descZh: 转座酶认出两端的反向重复,把一段 DNA 切下来贴进新位,复制粘贴版还会留一份原件:McClintock 在玉米粒上看到的斑点,是人类基因组近一半身份的来源
topics.descEn: Transposase reads the inverted repeats, cuts a stretch of DNA and pastes it elsewhere — the copy-paste kind leaves an original behind: the speckles McClintock saw on maize kernels are how nearly half the human genome got there

topics.titleZh: 蚂蚁信息素与群体寻路
topics.descZh: 每只蚂蚁只管沿信息素浓的方向走、走过就留痕:沉积加蒸发这道简单算式让蚁群在没有指挥的情况下收敛出最短路径——信息素本身就是写在地面上的群体记忆
topics.descEn: Each ant just follows the strongest pheromone scent and leaves some behind: deposit plus evaporation is the whole algorithm, and the colony converges on the shortest path with no manager — the trail is the group's memory written on the ground

topics.descZh: 浮游细菌落表面、分泌基质把彼此黏成城：塔状菌落水道贯穿，信号分子积到阈值的一瞬全城同步点亮——群体感应满城一个口令；抗生素冲走表层，城里休眠菌安然无恙
topics.descEn: Planktonic bacteria land, secrete a matrix and wall themselves into a city of towers and channels; the moment signals cross threshold the whole city lights up in unison — quorum sensing speaks one command. Antibiotics wash the surface while dormant cells inside ride it out.

topics.descZh: 短日照扣下内分泌闸门，体温滑向 5 ℃、代谢按 Q10 逐级腰斩：心跳从 300 掉到个位数，能耗踩上悬崖——每隔数周棕色脂肪点火复温清一遍废物，醒来爬回 37 ℃
topics.descEn: Short days pull the endocrine gate; body temperature slides toward 5 °C and metabolism halves again and again by Q10 — the heart falls from 300 beats to single digits on an energy cliff. Brown fat kindles a brief rewarm every few weeks before the climb back.

topics.titleZh: 遗传漂变与奠基者效应
topics.descZh: 每一代等位基因频率都是一次二项抽样：没有选择，纯随机也把频率推到 0 或 1——种群越小抖得越凶，瓶颈与奠基者把命运押在幸存者的抽签上，多样性单调流失
topics.descEn: Each generation redraws allele frequencies by binomial sampling: with no selection at all, pure chance walks p to 0 or 1. Small populations shake hardest; bottlenecks and founders stake a lineage's fate on the survivors' lottery.

topics.descZh: 组织一受损,肥大细胞撒出组胺:血管扩张渗漏,红肿热痛只是代价单;中性粒细胞顺着趋化梯度爬出血管,把细菌包围消化——炎症不是故障,是抢修
topics.descEn: Injury and mast cells scatter histamine: vessels dilate and leak — redness, heat and swelling are the price tag; neutrophils crawl out along chemotactic gradients to engulf and digest bacteria — inflammation isn't a malfunction, it's emergency repair

topics.descZh: 干种子是上锁的粮仓:吸胀唤醒胚,胚放出赤霉素敲糊粉层的门,α-淀粉酶涌出把淀粉水解成糖——粮仓开仓,胚根顶破种皮;ABA 在旁按着锁
topics.descEn: A dry seed is a locked granary: imbibition wakes the embryo, gibberellin knocks on the aleurone door, α-amylase floods out to hydrolyze starch into sugar — the granary opens, the radicle breaks the coat; ABA holds the lock in the corner

topics.descZh: 乌贼皮肤埋着百万个色素囊,每囊一圈放射肌,神经不拐弯直接接管:半秒整皮换装,连色盲都挡不住它匹配背景——伪装不走激素,走专线
topics.descEn: Squid skin buries millions of pigment sacs, each ringed by radial muscles wired straight to neurons: the whole coat re-skins in half a second, and color-blindness doesn't stop a perfect background match — camouflage runs on a dedicated line, not hormones

topics.descZh: 细胞每天被紫外线、自由基与复制失误打数十万枪:聚合酶边抄边校对,错配修复补抄漏的,切除修复把损伤整段挖掉重写——修复跑不过损伤,才是衰老与癌变的起点
topics.descEn: Every day the cell takes hundreds of thousands of hits from UV, radicals and copy errors: the polymerase proofreads as it goes, mismatch repair fills what slipped through, excision repair cuts damaged stretches out and rewrites them — when repair falls behind damage, aging and cancer begin

topics.descZh: 真菌提供房子与水分,藻类或蓝菌上交光合糖:两个物种焊成一个「物种」——地衣能在裸岩上开荒、在太空舱外活着;共生紧到连名字都是一体的
topics.descEn: The fungus builds the house and holds the water; the alga or cyanobacterium pays photosynthetic sugar: two species welded into one named organism — lichens pioneer bare rock and survive outside a spacecraft; the symbiosis is tight enough to share a name

topics.descZh: 鲨鱼吻部埋着数百个凝胶小管,能嗅出海水中亿万分之一伏的场——猎物藏在沙下,心跳也藏不住;电鳗反过来把电器官当雷达与武器, active 电感应对这套原理的正反两面
topics.descEn: A shark's snout buries hundreds of gel-filled tubes that sense fields of a billionth of a volt in seawater — prey under the sand cannot even hide its heartbeat; the electric eel runs the same physics in reverse, using its electric organs as radar and weapon: passive and active electroreception

topics.titleZh: 造血干细胞与血细胞分化
topics.descZh: 骨髓是血细胞的终身工厂:一颗造血干细胞每天借亿万次分裂既补货自己、又下放三支队伍——丢核的红细胞去扛氧、分叶的中性粒细胞去打感染、巨核细胞碎身成血小板去堵漏;促红细胞生成素与集落刺激因子是车间的调度铃:贫血拉响红系,感染拉响白系
topics.descEn: The marrow is a lifetime factory for blood: one hematopoietic stem cell, through billions of divisions a day, restocks itself and releases three lines — nucleus-dropped red cells to carry oxygen, lobed neutrophils to fight infection, megakaryocytes shredding into platelets to plug leaks; EPO and colony-stimulating factors ring the dispatch bell: anemia calls the red line, infection calls the white

topics.descZh: 乙烯是果实之间的暗号:一颗开始成熟就放出乙烯,乙烯又催醒邻居——正反馈让一整箱苹果同一夜变黄;淀粉转糖、叶绿素退场、果胶软化、香气上桌全是它的下游订单;跃变型果实听这套暗号,柑橘葡萄装聋——一颗烂苹果坏一箱,不是传言是气体
topics.descEn: Ethylene is fruit-to-fruit code: one ripening fruit emits it, the gas wakes the neighbors — positive feedback turns a whole box yellow overnight; starch-to-sugar, chlorophyll bowing out, pectin softening, aroma plating up are all downstream orders; climacteric fruit listens, oranges and grapes play deaf — one bad apple spoils the barrel, not folklore, chemistry

topics.descZh: 胎盘是胎儿暂时的肺、肾、肠道与内分泌腺:母体血与胎儿血各自奔流、永不混合,只隔一层绒毛薄壁做生意——氧气营养顺着梯度交过去,二氧化碳废物顺着梯度交回来;绒毛树把交换面撑到十几平米;hCG 等激素从这里接管母体全身的调度
topics.descEn: The placenta is the fetus's temporary lung, kidney, gut and gland: maternal and fetal blood flow side by side, never mixing, trading across one thin trophoblast wall — oxygen and nutrients cross down their gradient, carbon dioxide and waste come back; the villus tree spreads the trading floor to tens of square meters; hCG and kin take over the mother's whole-body schedule from here

topics.titleZh: 凝胶电泳与 DNA 指纹
topics.descZh: DNA 骨架磷酸基密布负电——通电就向正极游;凝胶是分子筛,短片段钻得快、长片段挪得慢,泳程对数于长度;梯带当标尺,现场与嫌疑人条带对齐就是同一份「指纹」
topics.descEn: DNA’s phosphate backbone is packed with negative charge — switch on the field and fragments swim to the anode; the gel is a molecular sieve where short darts and long shuffles, distance scaling with log length; a ladder is the ruler — matched bands are the same fingerprint

topics.descZh: 呼吸不等缺氧才加速——主驱动是 CO₂:溶进水变 H⁺,脑脊液 pH 微降被延髓读取,膈肌加深加快把 CO₂ 排回 40 mmHg;过度通气把驱动吹没了会暂时忘了喘;低氧要低于 60 mmHg 才由颈动脉体接管
topics.descEn: Breathing doesn’t wait for low oxygen — the drive is CO₂: dissolved it makes H⁺, a whisker of pH drop in CSF trips the medulla, the diaphragm digs until CO₂ is back to 40 mmHg; hyperventilate it away and the drive briefly vanishes; low O₂ takes over only below 60 mmHg

topics.descZh: 噬菌体尾腿认准受体、尾鞘如注射器收缩注入 DNA——之后兵分两路:裂解路线半小时量产百枚破壁而出留下噬斑;溶原路线整合进细菌染色体潜伏,随宿主分裂代代相传,一束紫外线把它唤醒
topics.descEn: Tail fibers find the receptor, the sheath contracts like a syringe, DNA goes in — then two roads: lysis mass-produces a hundred progeny in half an hour and bursts out, pocking the lawn; lysogeny splices into the chromosome and rides host divisions until UV wakes it

topics.descZh: 肠道吸收的东西先被门静脉押送过肝——首过效应;CYP450 相 I 加氧、相 II 缀上糖与谷胱甘肽、相 III 外排进胆汁:毒性越洗越低、水溶性越大;胆盐再把脂肪乳化成胶束,肝肠一手解毒一手开胃
topics.descEn: Everything the gut absorbs is escorted through the liver first — the first pass; CYP450 oxidizes (I), sugars and glutathione are stapled on (II), efflux pumps flush into bile (III): less toxic, more soluble at each step; bile salts emulsify fat — detox and digestion in one organ

topics.descZh: 鲜艳是招灾的牌,也是免死的符:鸟尝过一次苦就记住样式;贝氏拟态让无毒者冒充有毒白捡保护,假货一多信号被稀释;缪勒拟态则是一群有毒者共用同一张告示、把教育捕食者的成本摊薄
topics.descEn: Bright color is a costly banner and a life policy: one bitter taste teaches the bird the pattern; Batesian mimics free-ride — until fakes dilute the signal; Müllerian mimics share one warning style and split the tuition of educating predators

topics.descZh: 蝙蝠用超声喊出世界:回波延迟 Δt=2R/c 就是距离;FM 扫频绘出精细距离像,CF 恒频读出翅膀扑动的多普勒指纹,双耳时差定方向;发声与回波错窗防自掩蔽——而飞蛾也学会了听见与急坠
topics.descEn: A bat shouts the world in ultrasound: echo delay Δt=2R/c is range; FM sweeps draw a fine range image, CF tones read the Doppler fingerprint of wingbeats, two ears time the bearing; calls and echoes window apart — while moths evolve to hear and drop

topics.descZh: 五种基本味各有分子入口:咸是 Na⁺ 直灌钠通道、酸是 H⁺ 涌入封 K⁺ 通道、甜与鲜共用 T1R 家族 GPCR、苦由约 25 种 T2R 把守且阈值最低——毒物警报优先;味蕾 50~100 个细胞埋在上皮,面神经/舌咽/迷走分片接管
topics.descEn: Five tastes, five molecular doors: salt is Na⁺ pouring through ENaC, sour is H⁺ blocking K⁺ channels, sweet and umami share T1R GPCRs, bitter is guarded by ~25 T2R receptors with the lowest threshold — poison alarms first; buds of 50–100 cells report to three cranial nerves

topics.descZh: 杏仁核拉响警报,下丘脑双线并发:交感神经秒级直连、肾上腺素几十秒入血广播——心率心缩力↑、支气管扩张、糖原分解血糖↑、肌肉抢血流;皮质醇再补半小时慢刀维持战备;威胁解除,迷走神经刹车回摆
topics.descEn: The amygdala pulls the alarm and the hypothalamus fires on two wires: sympathetic nerves in seconds, adrenaline flooding the blood in tens — heart rate and contractility up, bronchi open, glycogen becomes glucose, muscles claim the blood flow; cortisol adds a half-hour tail; the vagus brakes it all back

topics.descZh: 孔雀尾屏是累赘也是诚信号:拖累逃生,只有真正健康的个体养得起——劣者伪造不起;费雪失控让雌性偏好与雄性装饰互为因果、代代互相加速;装饰成本对冲求偶收益,净适应度的峰把失控拉停,捕食者在场峰更靠短尾
topics.descEn: The peacock's train is a handicap and an honest signal: it drags on escape, so only truly fit males can afford it — fakes can't; Fisherian runaway makes female preference and male ornament chase each other for generations; survival cost checks mating gain, and predators pull the peak toward shorter tails

topics.descZh: 纯种 AA×aa→F1 全 Aa;造配子时等位基因随染色体分开、各进一枚,随机受精铺满 F2 棋盘:AA:Aa:aa=1:2:1、凡含 A 即高,计数当场收敛 3:1;测交 Aa×aa 得 1:1 直接暴露配子;两对基因独立分配 9:3:3:1;连锁则偏向亲本组合、交叉互换换回少量重组型
topics.descEn: Pure AA×aa forces all-Aa F1; making gametes the alleles split one per gamete at 1:1; random fertilization fills the F2 board, AA:Aa:aa=1:2:1, any A is tall, counts converge on 3:1; the testcross Aa×aa reads 1:1 straight off the gametes; two genes on different chromosomes assort to 9:3:3:1; linkage skews toward parental combos until crossing over lets recombinants back

topics.descZh: 毛细血管每天滤出约 20 L 组织液、静脉收回 17 L,剩下 3 L 由盲端毛细淋巴管回收——叠瓦内皮+单向瓣膜只进不出,骨骼肌与呼吸泵一段段推向心脏;淋巴结是沿途安检站:巨噬细胞吞噬、T/B 细胞侦察,感染时生发中心亮起、淋巴结肿大;淋巴管阻断则 3 L/天积成水肿
topics.descEn: Capillaries filter ~20 L of interstitial fluid a day, veins reabsorb 17 L; the last 3 L drains into blind-ended lymphatic capillaries — shingle endothelium and one-way valves, driven by muscle and breathing pumps; lymph nodes are checkpoints where macrophages devour and T/B cells patrol; on infection the germinal center ignites; block the vessel and 3 L/day pools into edema

topics.descZh: R_eff=R₀×易感占比,≤1 即熄:全员易感时一个病例按 R₀ 燎原;把接种率推过 p_c=1−1/R₀(麻疹 12–18→92–95%),疫情当场点不着;免疫墙间接保护无法接种的婴儿与免疫缺陷者;接种洼地局部 R_eff>1,火从缺口烧穿;疫苗效力 95%→60%,免疫柱够不着临界线、燎原复燃
topics.descEn: R_eff = R₀ × susceptible share, ≤1 means extinction: one index case runs wildfire through a fully susceptible grid; push coverage past p_c=1−1/R₀ (measles 12–18 → 92–95%) and it stops lighting; the immune wall shields those who can't be vaccinated; clustered pockets keep local R_eff>1 and fire burns through the gap; drop efficacy and the column falls short of the line

topics.descZh: 一颗肾上腺素撞上7次跨膜受体,Gα弹出GDP换上GTP并与Gβγ分家;1个受体一生可激活约100个G蛋白,腺苷酸环化酶把ATP成批转成cAMP,单细胞每秒约10⁴个;4个cAMP解锁PKA,催化亚基出笼磷酸化靶蛋白,总增益约10⁶倍;终止靠GTP水解(10–30 s定时器)+PDE降解+β-arrestin脱敏;咖啡因一封PDE,cAMP降不下去,百万倍动员关不掉
topics.descEn: One adrenaline molecule binds a 7-transmembrane receptor; Gα swaps GDP for GTP and splits from Gβγ. One receptor activates ~100 G proteins, adenylyl cyclase pumps out ~10⁴ cAMP per second, and 4 cAMPs free PKA to phosphorylate targets — a ~10⁶-fold total gain. Termination runs on GTP hydrolysis (a 10–30 s timer), PDE, and β-arrestin; caffeine blocks PDE so the signal never shuts off

topics.titleZh: 奖赏回路与多巴胺预测误差
topics.descZh: VTA多巴胺神经元静息3–5 Hz,放电编码预测误差δ=R−V:意外果汁把它轰到20–40 Hz并向伏隔核倾泻多巴胺;提示音先响2秒、果汁必到,TD学习V←V+0.12·δ把价值灌给提示音,约20试次后V≈0.9,尖峰从奖励时刻迁到提示音;此时扣住果汁,δ=−V,放电跌出低于基线的抑制坑;老虎机50%随机奖励不迁移;可卡因封DAT,突缝多巴胺3–10倍堆积,耐受后基线上移
topics.descEn: VTA dopamine neurons idle at 3–5 Hz and fire the prediction error δ=R−V: unexpected juice blasts them to 20–40 Hz. After ~20 trials of a tone predicting juice 2 s ahead, TD learning (V←V+0.12δ) migrates the spike to the cue; withhold the juice once and δ=−V digs a dip below baseline. Random slot-machine rewards never migrate, and cocaine blocks DAT so cleft dopamine stacks 3–10× while tolerance shifts the baseline up

topics.descZh: Pr(吸 660 nm 红)吸红变 Pfr;Pfr(吸 730 nm 远红)在黑暗中缓慢退回;Pfr 是植物的「白天记忆」:短日照植物要连续长夜把 Pfr 降到阈值以下才开花——夜里闪 1 分钟红光就打断长夜,补一道远红又能抹掉,红/远红可逆开关来回拨;植物量的是夜的长度,不是昼的长度
topics.descEn: Pr (660 nm red) turns into Pfr; Pfr (730 nm far-red) slowly reverts in darkness. Pfr is the plant's

topics.titleZh: CO₂ 运输与氯离子转移
topics.descZh: 组织里 7% 的 CO₂ 溶解、23% 挂上血红蛋白、70% 被碳酸酐酶(加速 10⁶ 倍)变成 HCO₃⁻;碳酸氢根流出红细胞,Cl⁻ 经 AE1 换入维持电中性——氯离子转移;到肺里全部反向(Haldane 效应促释放);波尔效应再把 O₂ 交给代谢最旺的地方
topics.descEn: Of tissue CO2, 7% dissolves, 23% rides hemoglobin, 70% becomes HCO₃⁻ via carbonic anhydrase (a 10⁶-fold speedup); as bicarbonate leaves the red cell, Cl⁻ swaps in through AE1 to keep charge — the chloride shift. In the lungs it all runs backward (the Haldane effect helps), and the Bohr effect drops O₂ exactly where metabolism runs hottest.

topics.descZh: 每节电细胞是 0.12 V 的单面电池,静息时朝向一致互相抵消;神经一声令下,数千节同向同刻开门:串联叠出 ~600 V(记录 860 V)、并联成束供 ~1 A,峰值功率约 1 kW;三组器官串成列、并成束;伏打 1800 年的电堆就是人造电细胞塔;水中电流大多走旁路,电鳗靠高频脉冲让猎物运动神经疲劳
topics.descEn: Each electrocyte is a 0.12 V one-sided battery; at rest they cancel. One nerve command and thousands open in line: ~600 V stacked in series (record 860 V), ~1 A from parallel bundles — about 1 kW peak. Three organs wire columns in series, bundles in parallel. Volta's 1800 pile was its man-made copy. Water shunts most current, so rapid trains fatigue the prey's motor nerves.

topics.descZh: 肌肉 ATP 存量只够 1–2 秒,三台引擎实时接力:磷酸原功率 3.6 mmol·kg⁻¹·s⁻¹ 全场最高,撑约 10 秒,百米一半能量靠它;糖酵解功率减半、不进线粒体直供,代价是血乳酸冲到 10–15 mmol/L(400 米后);有氧功率仅 1/4,却凭每分子葡萄糖 30+ ATP 撑起 2 小时马拉松;冲刺停下,氧债 EPOC 开始还账:PCr 半衰期约 30 秒回充、乳酸 30–60 分钟清完
topics.descEn: Muscle ATP stores last only 1–2 seconds, so three engines relay in real time: the phosphagen system delivers the top power (3.6 mmol·kg⁻¹·s⁻¹) for ~10 s — half of a 100 m sprint; glycolysis runs at half power but pushes blood lactate to 10–15 mmol/L after 400 m; the aerobic system supplies just 1/4 the power yet 30+ ATP per glucose for a 2-hour marathon. Stop the sprint and the oxygen debt comes due: PCr refills with a ~30 s half-time while lactate clears over 30–60 min

topics.titleZh: 朊病毒与错误折叠传播
topics.descZh: PrP^C 以 α 螺旋为主、可溶、锚在神经元膜上;错误折叠成 PrP^Sc 后 β 片层从 ~3% 涨到 ~43%,聚成淀粉样纤维——它没有核酸,却靠模板诱导复制:纤维末端抓住正常 PrP^C 把它翻面成自己的构象,断裂又让一条变两条、数量指数增殖;疯牛病、羊瘙痒、克雅病、库鲁病都是它;种属屏障=序列错配,牛→人结合率掉到 ≈3%;134 °C 高压蒸汽 18 min 或 1 mol/L NaOH 才灭活——中心法则的边界案例(1997 诺奖)
topics.descEn: PrP^C is alpha-helical, soluble, membrane-anchored; misfold to PrP^Sc and beta-sheet rises from ~3% to ~43% in amyloid fibrils. With no genome at all it replicates by template induction: the fibril end captures normal PrP^C and flips it into its own fold; breakage turns one fibril into two and counts climb exponentially. BSE, scrapie, CJD and kuru are all this. The species barrier is sequence mismatch (cattle→human binding ≈3%); inactivation needs 134 °C steam for 18 min or 1 mol/L NaOH — the edge case of the central dogma (1997 Nobel)

topics.descZh: 射精 2–5 亿条精子,游过 15–18 cm 输卵管抵达卵旁只剩数百;获能让鞭打更强→透明带 ZP3 触发顶体反应、顶体素溶出 ~15 μm 通道→IZUMO1–JUNO 精卵膜融合→钙波从融合点 5–30 μm/s 扫过全卵(10–30 s)→皮层颗粒外排、透明带硬化谢绝后来者;雌雄原核 24 h 内融合卵裂——多精入卵=三套基因组=发育崩溃
topics.descEn: Of 200–500 million sperm, only hundreds reach the egg after 15–18 cm of oviduct. Capacitation whips the tail harder; ZP3 triggers the acrosome reaction and acrosin drills a ~15 μm tunnel; IZUMO1–JUNO lock the membranes; a calcium wave sweeps the whole egg from the fusion point at 5–30 μm/s (10–30 s); cortical granules harden the zona against latecomers. Pronuclei merge within 24 h — polyspermy means three genomes and developmental collapse

topics.descZh: 源(成熟叶)的伴胞烧 ATP 把蔗糖泵进筛管,筛管液渗透压升到 1–3 MPa、水渗入、膨压升高;壑(根/果实)卸糖泄压;两端 0.5–2 MPa 的压差推动筛管液整体流动 0.3–1.5 m/h——不需要任何泵;筛管元素成熟时自拆细胞核、筛孔开放,伴胞养着它;环剥后切口上方糖堆积肿起、下方饥饿;蚜虫口针是天然压力计,实测膨压 0.5–2 MPa 证实 Münch 压力流动学说
topics.descEn: Companion cells in source leaves burn ATP to load sucrose into sieve tubes; osmotic pressure climbs to 1–3 MPa, water floods in, and turgor rises. At sinks (roots, fruit) sugar unloads and pressure falls. The 0.5–2 MPa difference drives sap 0.3–1.5 m/h — no pump anywhere. Mature sieve elements ditch their own nuclei; companion cells keep them alive. Girdle the bark and sugar swells above the cut while below starves; an aphid stylet is a natural pressure gauge reading 0.5–2 MPa — Münch's pressure-flow confirmed

topics.descZh: 棕榈酸 C16:0 花 2 ATP 活化、过肉碱穿梭,7 轮 β 氧化每轮送出 1 FADH₂(1.5 ATP)+1 NADH(2.5 ATP)+1 乙酰-CoA(TCA 10 ATP),8 个乙酰-CoA 共净得 108−2=106 ATP,约为葡萄糖的 3 倍;饥饿时多余的乙酰-CoA 转产酮体,供脑 60-70% 能量。
topics.descEn: Palmitate (C16:0) pays 2 ATP for activation, crosses the carnitine shuttle, then 7 rounds of beta-oxidation cut out 8 acetyl-CoA - each round pocketing 1 FADH2 (1.5 ATP) + 1 NADH (2.5 ATP), each acetyl worth 10 via TCA - for a net of 108-2 = 106 ATP, about triple glucose; in fasting the surplus turns into ketone bodies that feed the brain 60-70% of its energy.

topics.descZh: 蛋白分解与肠道细菌不断产氨,血氨超 100 μM 即神经中毒。肝细胞用两区室、5 个酶把氨打包成尿素:CPS-1 花 2 ATP 活化 NH₄⁺+HCO₃⁻,OTC 转给鸟氨酸,胞浆再花 1 ATP 缩合天冬氨酸,水解放出尿素——两个氮、4 ATP、每天约 0.5 mol(≈30 g);延胡索酸岔路与 TCA 联成双环。可模拟 OTC 缺陷与苯丁酸钠旁路。
topics.descEn: Protein breakdown and gut bacteria make ammonia nonstop; above ~100 μM it poisons the brain. Across two compartments and five enzymes the hepatocyte packs NH4+ + HCO3- into urea: CPS-1 spends 2 ATP activating ammonia (the AGA switch), OTC hands it to ornithine, the cytosol spends one more ATP condensing aspartate, and hydrolysis releases urea - two nitrogens, 4 ATP, ~0.5 mol (~30 g) per day; a fumarate branch interlocks it with the TCA cycle. Simulate OTC deficiency and the phenylbutyrate bypass.

topics.descZh: 大肠杆菌不会游向高处,只会延长顺坡直跑、缩短下坡——run 与 tumble 的偏置随机游走。受体阵列用甲基化水平记住约 1 秒前的浓度:CheR 恒速加甲基、CheB-P 活跃时才去甲基,积分负反馈在阶跃吸引物后 1-10 秒让活性精确回基线而灵敏度保留;4-5 个甲基化位点就是化学内存,凭它在 0.1% 梯度中也能定向到 nM 级。
topics.descEn: E. coli never steers toward higher concentration — it just extends runs that climb the gradient and cuts short the rest: a biased run-and-tumble walk. Receptor arrays store a ~1 s concentration memory in methylation; CheR methylates at a constant rate while CheB-P demethylates only when the kinase is active, so integral feedback restores activity to baseline 1-10 s after any step, sensitivity intact. With 4-5 methylation sites per receptor as chemical memory, the cell orients in 0.1% gradients down to nM-level changes.

topics.titleZh: 色觉:三视锥与对立通道
topics.titleEn: Color Vision: Three Cones & Opponent Channels
topics.descZh: 视网膜只装三种视锥(L/M/S 吸收峰约 560/530/420 nm),每根只是一个积分器:R=∫S(λ)ρ(λ)dλ——无穷的光谱世界被压成三个响应数的比值。所以光谱完全不同的两束光可以看起来一模一样(同色异谱),显示器用三种磷光体就能调出白点 D65 (0.3127, 0.3290);节细胞再编码为红⇄绿、蓝⇄黄、明⇄暗三对对立通道:「发绿的红」因此说不出口,盯红 30 秒后白墙上浮出青色负后像,约 8% 的男性红绿难分而蓝黄轴保留。
topics.descEn: Your retina packs only three cone classes (L/M/S, peaks near 560/530/420 nm), and each is a mere integrator, R=∫S(λ)ρ(λ)dλ: the infinite world of spectra is compressed into the ratio of three responses. Two lights with utterly different spectra can therefore look identical (metamerism) — a display mixes three phosphors to hit white point D65 (0.3127, 0.3290). Ganglion cells re-encode the trio into opponent pairs — red⇄green (L−M), blue⇄yellow (S−(L+M)), bright⇄dark (L+M) — so 'reddish green' is unsayable, a 30-second stare at red leaves a cyan afterimage, and ~8% of men lose red-green while keeping blue-yellow.

topics.titleZh: DNA 测序与双脱氧链终止
topics.descZh: 聚合酶本会忠实抄完 DNA,但反应里掺入约 1% 的双脱氧核苷酸(ddNTP)缺 3′-OH,被接上后下一个磷酸二酯键无处成键——链在此终止。四种 ddNTP 各带一种荧光、按 1:100–1:1000 掺入,每个模板位置都随机终止出一批「长度=位置、颜色=碱基」的片段;毛细管电泳让短片段先行、按长度排队,检测窗口依次读出荧光:长度的顺序就是位置的顺序,颜色的顺序就是碱基的顺序。单次读长 800–1000 bp,人类基因组计划(1990–2003)靠它读完 31.5 亿碱基对。
topics.descEn: Polymerase would copy DNA faithfully, but ~1% dideoxynucleotides (ddNTPs) mixed into the reaction lack the 3′-OH: once one is incorporated, no next phosphodiester bond can form and the chain stops there. Four fluorescent ddNTPs at 1:100–1:1000 make every template position spawn fragments whose length equals the stop site and whose color is the base there; capillary electrophoresis queues them shortest-first, and the detector reads color order as base order. Reads run 800–1000 bp; the Human Genome Project (1990–2003) sequenced 3.15 billion base pairs with it.

topics.titleZh: 捕蝇草与触发动作电位
topics.descZh: 触毛弯折打开钙通道,一发 ~120 mV 的动作电位沿叶脉以 1-10 cm/s 传到叶身;规则是「两次计数、20 s 窗口」:第 1 发只记账,20 s 内 ≥2 发才关闭——快相 ~100 ms 靠双凸壳几何失稳(snap-buckle)弹合,慢相数小时收紧密封;闭合后累计 ≥5 发才按量开酶,消化一只虫要 5-12 天;每次触发都在耗能,一只捕虫夹一生只关 ~3-5 次。
topics.descEn: Bending a trigger hair fires a ~120 mV action potential that crawls along leaf veins at 1-10 cm/s; the rule is two strikes in a 20 s window - AP #1 is only booked, ≥2 within 20 s close the trap: a ~100 ms snap-buckle shell inversion, then hours of slow sealing. ≥5 cumulative APs dose the glands; one fly takes 5-12 days, and a trap closes only ~3-5 times in its life.

topics.descZh: F⁺ 供体伸出性菌毛(~1 μm)抓住 F⁻ 受体,收缩拉成性桥;relaxase 在 oriT 切开 F 质粒(~100 kb)一条链,5′ 端带头经 IV 型分泌系统以 ~1 kb/s 滚入受体,全程数分钟;两侧同步以旧链为模板合成互补链,受体环化后自己也变 F⁺,又去感染下一个——1→2→4 指数铺开;抗药性质粒 R 走同一条路,这就是抗生素耐药「传染」的机制。
topics.descEn: An F+ donor extends a sex pilus (~1 μm) to catch an F- recipient and reels it into a mating bridge; relaxase nicks one strand of the ~100 kb F plasmid at oriT and the 5' end leads through the type IV secretion system at ~1 kb/s - minutes per plasmid; both sides copy the complementary strand and the recipient turns F+ itself: 1 to 2 to 4, exponential. R resistance plasmids ride the same road - this is how antibiotic resistance is contagious.

topics.descZh: 四步循环爬行:①片状伪足里肌动蛋白丝 + 端聚合(每丝每秒 10-100 个单体)推膜——单丝 ~pN,10³-10⁵ 条丝网络合力 nN-μN;②整合素黏着斑抓住胞外基质,把推力变抓地力(斑寿命 10-100 s);③myosin II 沿应力纤维滑移(ATP,步幅 ~5-10 nm)把细胞体拉向前;④尾部黏附解离、尾缩。Rac 管前缘、Rho 管后尾;成纤维细胞 ~0.5-1 μm/min,中性粒细胞可达 ~20 μm/min。
topics.descEn: The four-step crawl: ① lamellipodial actin +ends polymerize (10-100 subunits/s per filament) pushing the membrane - ~pN per filament, nN-μN for the dense network; ② integrin focal adhesions grip the ECM, turning push into traction (lifetime 10-100 s); ③ myosin II slides along stress fibers (ATP, ~5-10 nm strokes) hauling the body forward; ④ rear adhesions release and the tail retracts. Rac runs the front, Rho the rear; fibroblasts ~0.5-1 μm/min, neutrophils up to ~20 μm/min.

topics.descZh: 抗原免疫小鼠 2-4 周 → 取脾(~10⁸ 个 B 细胞,一色一抗体,体外只活几天)→ 与骨髓瘤(永生、不分泌、HGPRT⁻)按 PEG 融合(效率 ~10⁻⁵)→ HAT 筛选:氨基蝶呤封死从头合成,未融合骨髓瘤死于 HGPRT 缺陷、未融合 B 自然死、杂交瘤「永生+抗体」独活 → 有限稀释一孔一克隆 → 筛出目标孔(常 <1%)→ 扩培上清 1-50 μg/mL 或腹水 1-20 mg/mL;1975 年 Köhler & Milstein,1984 年诺奖。
topics.descEn: Immunize a mouse 2-4 weeks → harvest the spleen (~10⁸ B cells, one color one antibody, dying within days) → fuse with myeloma cells (immortal, non-secreting, HGPRT⁻) using PEG (yield ~10⁻⁵) → HAT selection: aminopterin blocks de novo synthesis so unfused myeloma die, unfused B die naturally, and only hybrids (immortal + antibody) survive → limiting dilution, one clone per well → screen for target wells (often <1%) → supernatant 1-50 μg/mL or ascites 1-20 mg/mL; Köhler & Milstein 1975, Nobel 1984.

topics.descZh: 呼吸肌把声门下压抬到 ~5-10 cmH₂O → 气流按伯努利效应把声带吸拢 → 声门关、压力堆高 → 再冲开:自激振荡,男 ~100-120 Hz、女 ~200-220 Hz,不靠神经逐周期指挥;每周期送出一个气流脉冲,序列 = 基频 + 整倍谐波(~1/n 衰减);喉/口/鼻腔当滤波器,F1/F2 共振峰(如 a 750/1150 Hz)包络选谐波出元音;环甲肌拉伸声带(1.3→2.4 cm)升调 80-300 Hz;气流→声效率 <1%(~10-500 μW)。
topics.descEn: Breathing muscles raise subglottal pressure to ~5-10 cmH₂O → airflow sucks the folds together (Bernoulli) → the glottis seals, pressure rebuilds → it blows open again: self-sustained oscillation, ~100-120 Hz male / ~200-220 Hz female, no per-cycle neural command; one airflow pulse per cycle = fundamental + integer harmonics (~1/n decay); the pharynx/mouth/nose filter shapes F1/F2 formants (e.g. 'a' 750/1150 Hz) into vowels; the cricothyroid stretches the folds (1.3→2.4 cm) for 80-300 Hz; airflow-to-sound efficiency <1% (~10-500 μW).

topics.titleZh: 蛇的鳞片棘爪与四种步态
topics.descZh: 腹鳞叠瓦式排列使向后滑动摩擦约为向前的 1.5-2 倍——一台单向棘爪:侧面波靠钉子/物体找支点(光滑地板推力锐减,玉米蛇推钉实验)、风琴式一段锚一段拉(窄缝)、直线式腹鳞起波(大蟒慢行)、侧绕只留 2-3 个触地段把接触压到最小(60 °C 流沙);速度:侧面波 1-2 体长/s、侧绕 0.3-0.7。
topics.descEn: Overlapping belly scales make backward sliding 1.5-2× harder than forward — a one-way ratchet. Lateral undulation braces against pegs and rocks (on a slick floor thrust collapses — the corn-snake peg experiment); concertina anchors and reaches in burrows; rectilinear rolls belly scales in waves for big slow snakes; sidewinding keeps 2-3 contact patches to cheat 60 °C sand. Speeds: 1-2 body lengths/s undulating, 0.3-0.7 sidewinding.

topics.descZh: 拖丝=纳米晶(β-折叠微晶 ~10 nm)撑强度+非晶区给延展:强度 ~1.0-1.3 GPa(低碳钢 ~0.4)、断裂伸长 30-40%(凯夫拉 <4%)、韧性 ~160 MJ/m³(凯夫拉 ~50、钢 ~6);捕获丝的黏珠是台绞盘——水滴压扁把内丝拉出缓冲冲击;湿态超收缩 30-50% 让网绷紧;2 μm 的丝吊得住 2 g。
topics.descEn: Dragline silk pairs nano-crystals (β-sheet crystallites ~10 nm) for strength with an amorphous phase for stretch: ~1.0-1.3 GPa tensile (mild steel ~0.4), 30-40% elongation (Kevlar <4%), toughness ~160 MJ/m³ (Kevlar ~50, steel ~6). Capture-spiral glue droplets are windlasses that pay out inner thread to cushion impact; wet supercontraction shrinks it 30-50% to re-tension the web; a 2 μm fiber lifts 2 g.

topics.descZh: 气囊容积约为肺的 2-3 倍、不进行气体交换——它们是风箱:两呼吸四相——吸1 新气充后气囊、呼1 推气穿肺(parabronchi)、吸2 肺内气转前气囊、呼2 排空出体;肺永远单向流、吸呼都在换气(哺乳动物潮式死胡同,仅 ~1/3 潮气量到交换区);飞行耗氧 10-20 倍静息,斑头雁 6,000+ m 照样扑翼。
topics.descEn: Air sacs hold 2-3× the lung volume but exchange no gas — they are bellows. Two breaths, four phases: inhale 1 fills posterior sacs, exhale 1 drives it through the parabronchi, inhale 2 moves lung air to anterior sacs, exhale 2 vents it. Flow through the lung is one-way during both phases, while mammals flush a dead-end tidal lung with only ~1/3 of each breath reaching exchange tissue. Flight demands 10-20× resting O₂; bar-headed geese still flap at 6,000+ m.

topics.descZh: 每个细菌持续分泌信号分子 AHL,自由扩散出膜;浓度 ∝ 密度——信号成了数数器:跨过阈值(~1-10 μM,费氏弧菌在乌贼发光器官 ~10¹¹ /mL)LuxR 饱和、lux 操纵子同刻开启、全体发光(luxI 正反馈造成迟滞);调控的不止发光:生物膜成熟、毒力因子、感受态;群体猝灭酶降解 AHL——偷走它们的语言。
topics.descEn: Every cell secretes AHL that diffuses freely across the membrane; concentration scales with density, so the signal is a headcount. Cross the threshold (~1-10 μM; Vibrio fischeri hits it at ~10¹¹ cells/mL in the squid light organ) and LuxR saturates, the lux operon switches on everywhere at once — bioluminescence, with luxI positive feedback making it a switch, not a dial. Biofilm maturation, virulence and competence ride the same channel; quorum-quenching enzymes degrade AHL and steal the language.

topics.titleZh: 树轮年代学与交叉定年
topics.descZh: 形成层每年一圈:早材宽浅、晚材窄深,轮宽记录当年水热;极端干旱年的「指纹窄轮」跨树一致——把钻孔岩芯一段段对齐接回公元,欧洲橡树-松序列已接 ~12,000 年;碳十四校准曲线的骨架就是它;最老活树刺果松 ~4,850 岁。
topics.descEn: The cambium lays down one ring a year: wide pale earlywood, narrow dark latewood, width recording that year's water and heat. Marker narrow rings from droughts match across trees, so cores cross-date back into the calendar — European oak-pine chronologies reach ~12,000 years, and they are the backbone of the radiocarbon calibration curve; the oldest living bristlecone is ~4,850 years.

topics.titleZh: 光遗传学与通道视紫红质
topics.descZh: 电刺激不认细胞、药物做不到毫秒——2005 年把绿藻的 ChR2 装进神经元:470 nm 蓝光让七跨膜螺旋变构、阳离子孔打开,1-5 ms 单脉冲即可去极化;AAV 病毒带细胞型启动子决定「谁被点亮」,光纤植入自由活动动物;黄光 NpHR/ArchT 反向刹车,蓝开黄停双色指挥;2021 拉斯克奖,视网膜假体已进临床。
topics.descEn: Electricity can't target cell types; drugs can't work in milliseconds. In 2005 the algal channel ChR2 was installed in neurons: 470 nm blue light flips its seven transmembrane helices, opening a cation pore — a 1-5 ms pulse suffices to depolarize. AAV vectors with cell-type promoters decide who gets lit; fibers reach freely moving animals; yellow-light NpHR/ArchT brake in the opposite direction. Lasker 2021; retinal prostheses in trials.

topics.titleZh: X 染色体失活与玳瑁猫
topics.descZh: XX 与 XY 差一倍剂量:Lyon 假说(1961)让胚胎早期每个细胞掷骰子随机压一条 X——XIST lncRNA 铺满整条染色体成为 Barr 小体,选择在几千细胞期完成且不可逆地传给所有后代;成年雌性是两种克隆的马赛克,玳瑁猫的橙黑斑块就是 X 染色体的地图;~15-25% 基因(尤其 PAR 区)逃逸,剂量补偿并不完美。
topics.descEn: XX vs XY doubles the dose. Lyon (1961): early in the embryo every cell rolls dice and silences one X — XIST lncRNA blankets the chromosome into a Barr body, the choice made at the few-thousand-cell stage and inherited by all descendants; the adult female is a mosaic of two clones, and a calico cat's orange-black patches are a literal map of X inactivation. ~15-25% of genes (PAR especially) escape — the compensation is imperfect.

topics.titleZh: 反刍动物瘤胃与纤维发酵
topics.descZh: 牛没有纤维素酶,靠瘤胃这个 100-150 L 发酵罐里 10¹⁰-10¹¹ /mL 的微生物把草变成乙酸(60-65%)、丙酸(20-25%)、丁酸(15-20%)——丙酸经糖异生撑起全身血糖;产甲烷菌把发酵氢变成每天 200-500 L 嗝出的 CH₄;唾液每天 100-200 L 缓冲、反刍每天 6-8 h 磨碎纤维;精料一多 pH 跌破 5.5,乳酸堆积就是酸中毒。
topics.descEn: Cows have no cellulase; the rumen — a 100-150 L fermenter holding 10¹⁰-10¹¹ microbes per mL — turns grass into acetic (60-65%), propionic (20-25%) and butyric acids (15-20%), with propionic acid feeding gluconeogenesis for nearly all blood glucose. Methanogens convert fermentation hydrogen into 200-500 L of burped CH₄ a day; saliva buffers 100-200 L daily and rumination chews fiber 6-8 h. Push the concentrate and pH falls below 5.5 — lactic acid, and acidosis.

topics.descZh: 暗电流 30-100 pA 让视杆在黑暗中反而最活跃。一个光子经视紫红质→~800 转导蛋白→PDE6 三级级联放大 10⁵-10⁶ 倍:cGMP 掉落、通道关闭,暗电流被咬掉约 1 pA、峰值延迟 ~20 ms;钙反馈撑起 ~10⁷ 的光适应范围。
topics.descEn: A 30-100 pA dark current keeps rods busiest in darkness. One photon runs rhodopsin → ~800 transducins → PDE6, a 10⁵-10⁶ cascade: cGMP falls, channels close, ~1 pA is shaved off with a ~20 ms peak delay; calcium feedback spans ~10⁷ of light adaptation.

topics.descZh: TRPV1 是超过 43 °C 才开的非选择性阳离子通道——「烫」的分子温度计;辣椒素钻进 S512/Y511 口袋,把 37 °C 的开放概率抬到 90% 以上,Ca²⁺/Na⁺ 涌入、放电 ~28 Hz。Scoville:鬼椒 ~1,000,000、Pepper X ~2,700,000 SHU;持续结合则钙依赖脱敏——辣椒膏止痛、牛奶解辣皆源于此。
topics.descEn: TRPV1 is a nonselective cation channel that opens only above 43 °C — the molecular thermometer for scalding. Capsaicin binds the S512/Y511 pocket, pushing open probability above 90% at 37 °C: Ca²⁺/Na⁺ pour in, fibers fire at ~28 Hz. Scoville: ghost ~1,000,000, Pepper X ~2,700,000 SHU; sustained binding triggers calcium-dependent desensitization — the basis of capsaicin pain creams and milk's relief.

topics.descZh: 胎头压宫颈触发 Ferguson 反射:垂体后叶脉冲释放催产素,孕晚期受体上调 100-200 倍——宫缩→压得更紧→更多催产素,正反馈没有刹车;宫缩间隔从 ~10 min 收紧到 2-3 min、宫口开至 10 cm,初产妇第一产程 6-18 h、第二产程 0.5-2 h;娩出是回路唯一出口,产后同一激素负责复旧与射乳。
topics.descEn: The fetal head pressing the cervix triggers the Ferguson reflex: the posterior pituitary pulses oxytocin, and with receptors upregulated 100-200-fold in late pregnancy the positive feedback has no brake. Intervals tighten from ~10 min to 2-3 min as the cervix reaches 10 cm: 6-18 h first stage, 0.5-2 h second stage for first-time mothers. Birth is the loop's only exit; the same hormone then drives involution and milk ejection.

topics.descZh: 无毛皮肤四路:Merkel(慢适应,感受野 2-5 mm)管纹理与静态形状,Meissner(10-50 Hz)管滑动,Pacinian 100-300 Hz 最灵、250 Hz 阈值 ~0.1 μm,Ruffini 管拉伸;两点辨别指尖 2-3 mm。
topics.descEn: Four parallel channels in hairless skin: Merkel (slow, 2-5 mm fields) for texture and static shape, Meissner (10-50 Hz) for slip, Pacinian peaking at 100-300 Hz with ~0.1 μm thresholds at 250 Hz, Ruffini for stretch; two-point thresholds run 2-3 mm at the fingertip.

topics.descZh: 壁细胞的 H⁺/K⁺-ATPase 烧 ATP 把氢离子泵进胃腔:血液 pH 7.4 → 胃腔 pH 1.5-2.5,浓度提升百万倍,日产 0.1 M 盐酸 1-2 L;胃蛋白酶原酸激活后最适 pH 2,胃壁却靠 0.5 mm 黏液凝胶加 HCO₃⁻ 拉出 pH 2→7 的陡梯度,上皮 3-5 天整体换装;NSAID 切断前列腺素、幽门螺杆菌举氨云定居——溃疡都是防线被拆;PPI 直接封泵。
topics.descEn: The parietal cell's H⁺/K⁺-ATPase burns ATP to pump protons: blood pH 7.4 falls to gastric 1.5-2.5, a million-fold climb making 1-2 L of 0.1 M HCl daily; pepsinogen activates below pH 5 and peaks near 2, yet a 0.5 mm mucus gel with HCO₃⁻ holds a pH 2→7 gradient and the epithelium renews every 3-5 days; NSAIDs cut prostaglandins, H. pylori camps with an ammonia cloud - ulcers are a breached wall; PPIs plug the pump.

topics.descZh: 气道上皮每个细胞约 200 根纤毛以 10-15 Hz 两相摆动:约 0.1 s 的快拍顶进凝胶层,推黏液以 0.5-2 mm/s 上行,慢回复在 7 μm 纤毛周液里复位不回推,相邻纤毛相位差织成异时波;黏液毯上层 MUC5AC/MUC5B 捕获颗粒,下层水量由 ENaC/CFTR 定;24 小时清运 10-100 mL。吸烟麻痹纤毛、囊纤脱水塌毯——咳嗽 100-200 km/h 来救场。
topics.descEn: Airway cells carry ~200 cilia each, beating at 10-15 Hz in two phases: a fast ~0.1 s stroke tips into the gel layer driving mucus at 0.5-2 mm/s, while the slow recovery hides in the ~7 μm periciliary liquid; neighbors phase-lock into a metachronal wave. The gel layer (MUC5AC/MUC5B) traps particles and PCL hydration is set by ENaC/CFTR; 10-100 mL clears daily. Smoke paralyses cilia, CF dehydrates the layer - coughing at 100-200 km/h saves the shift.

topics.descZh: 脑毛细血管用 claudin-5 紧密连接焊死缝隙,足突包裹 ~99% 管壁、总长 ~650 km,挡下 >98% 小分子药物;被动通过要分子量 <400-500 Da 且脂溶不解离,葡萄糖走 GLUT1(~120 g/天),洛哌丁胺被 P-糖蛋白泵回。
topics.descEn: Brain capillaries seal their seams with claudin-5 tight junctions, wrapped by endfeet over ~99% of the wall; ~650 km of vessel blocks >98% of small-molecule drugs. Passive entry needs MW <400-500 Da and lipophilicity; glucose rides GLUT1 (~120 g/day), and loperamide is pumped back by P-glycoprotein.

topics.descZh: 酪蛋白聚成 150-200 nm 胶束,κ-毛发层让它们互不相撞——牛奶的白正是散射的光;凝乳酶素只切 Phe¹⁰⁵–Met¹⁰⁶ 一根肽键,毛发层脱落、Ca²⁺ 桥接,32 °C 下 30-45 min 成凝胶;10 kg 奶约出 1 kg 硬质奶酪。
topics.descEn: Casein micelles ~150-200 nm across are kept apart by κ-casein hairs - the white of milk is their scattered light. Chymosin cuts one peptide bond (Phe105-Met106), the hairs drop, Ca²⁺ bridges the micelles, and a gel sets in 30-45 min at 32 °C; ~10 kg of milk yields 1 kg of hard cheese.

topics.descZh: 骨髓前体迁入胸腺,V(D)J 重排出理论 >10¹⁵ 的 TCR 库;双阳性细胞在皮质受阳选——结合「不弱不空」才活,太弱死于忽视;MHC I→CD8、MHC II→CD4 定型;到髓质被 DC 高亲和阴选删除,AIRE 让上皮异位表达胰岛素等自身抗原;仅 2-5% 毕业入血,青春期后每年退化 ~3%,耐受失守即自身免疫。
topics.descEn: Marrow precursors seed the thymus; V(D)J recombination builds a theoretical TCR library >10¹⁵. Double positives face positive selection - 'just right' binding or death by neglect; MHC I → CD8, MHC II → CD4. In the medulla, DCs delete high-affinity self-reactive clones while AIRE displays tissue antigens; only 2-5% graduate, the gland involutes ~3%/yr after puberty, and tolerance failure means autoimmunity.

topics.descZh: 美西螈断肢后 5-12 h 伤口表皮封口成 AEC,成熟肌骨真皮去分化,与施万细胞聚成 ~10⁴ 细胞的芽基(约 3 周);生长严格依赖神经 nAG,去神经即停滞;芽基细胞带 Hox/视黄酸位置记忆,按近远端值插值重建,RA 剂量越高起点越近端(腕→肘→肩);30-70 天重演发育长出完整前肢,可无限重复不留疤——哺乳动物只剩幼儿指尖 <2 mm 的残缺版本。
topics.descEn: In axolotls the wound epidermis seals in 5-12 h as the AEC; mature muscle, bone and dermis dedifferentiate and, with Schwann cells, gather into a ~10⁴-cell blastema over ~3 weeks. Growth is nerve-dependent (nAG) - denervate and it stalls. Blastema cells carry Hox/retinoic-acid positional memory and interpolate PD values; RA dose proximalizes (wrist→elbow→shoulder). A complete forelimb in 30-70 days, repeatable scar-free - mammals manage only a child's <2 mm fingertip.

topics.descZh: 面部三叉神经触冷水,脑干启动全身保守程序:迷走神经砍心率 10-40%(海豹 100→30 bpm),外周血流压到 10-15% 只保心脑,脾收缩挤红细胞入血(Hct +50-60%);海豹肌红蛋白 5-7 g/100g(人 0.4-0.8)、血容量 12% 体重,三重氧库支撑有氧潜 ~20 min、深达 ~600 m,超限转无氧乳酸硬扛;人类婴儿保留此反射,冷水泼面可终止室上速。
topics.descEn: Cold water on the face fires the trigeminal nerve into a brainstem program: vagal bradycardia cuts HR 10-40% (seal 100→30 bpm), peripheral flow drops to 10-15% reserving blood for heart and brain, and the spleen injects stored red cells (Hct +50-60%). With ~10× human myoglobin (5-7 g/100g) and blood at 12% of body mass, seals dive aerobically ~20 min to ~600 m, then ride anaerobic on lactate; human infants keep the reflex, and a cold splash can break SVT.

topics.descZh: 病原 PAMP→巨噬细胞 TLR→IL-1β/IL-6/TNF-α→诱导 COX-2→PGE₂,经 OVLT 把下丘脑调定点从 37 拧到 39-40 °C:身体反而觉得冷,寒战把产热提到 ×5、血管收缩主动追新目标;解热药降的是设定点,于是反转出汗散热;适度发热助免疫,>41 °C 是蛋白变性红线。
topics.descEn: PAMP → macrophage TLR → IL-1β/IL-6/TNF-α → COX-2 → PGE2, through the OVLT twisting the hypothalamic set point from 37 to 39-40 °C: the body feels cold, shivering lifts heat output to 5x rest and vessels constrict to chase the new target; antipyretics lower the set point, so sweat runs in reverse; moderate fever aids immunity, >41 °C is the denaturation red line.

topics.descZh: 釉质 96% 是羟基磷灰石、厚 2-2.5 mm 且无细胞不可再生;菌斑细菌代谢糖产酸,pH<临界 5.5 时 H⁺ 溶解磷灰石放出 Ca²⁺/PO₄³⁻;唾液(pH 6.5-7.4、Ca²⁺ 1-2 mmol/L,流速 0.3→1.5-2 mL/min)缓冲酸并回填离子;氟替换 OH⁻ 把临界压到 4.5 还抑制烯醇化酶;吃糖频率比总量更毒,失衡即白垩斑→龋洞→牙本质。
topics.descEn: Enamel is 96% hydroxyapatite, 2-2.5 mm thick, and never regrows; plaque bacteria ferment sugar into acid, and below the critical pH 5.5, H+ dissolves apatite and releases Ca2+/PO43-; saliva (pH 6.5-7.4, Ca2+ 1-2 mmol/L, flow 0.3 → 1.5-2 mL/min) buffers and refills ions; fluoride swaps for OH- to push the line to 4.5 and blocks enolase - sugar frequency is more toxic than total amount, and imbalance runs white spot → cavity → dentin.

topics.descZh: 血压/容量下降→球旁细胞、致密斑、交感 β1 三重传感→肾素(酶)切肝源 AGT(452 aa)成 Ang I(10 aa),肺内皮 ACE 再切二肽成 Ang II(8 aa):强力缩血管、促醛固酮开 ENaC 回钠储水(潜伏 ~90 min)、促 ADH 与口渴;血压回升→负反馈关闸;ACEI/ARB/螺内酯堵在环路三处。每日原尿 180 L,99%+ 回收。
topics.descEn: BP/volume falls → JG baroreceptors, macula densa NaCl and sympathetic β1 fire → renin (an enzyme) cuts liver-made AGT (452 aa) into Ang I (10 aa), and lung endothelial ACE clips a dipeptide into Ang II (8 aa): potent vasoconstriction, aldosterone opening ENaC to reclaim Na+ and water (~90 min latency), plus ADH and thirst; rising BP feeds back to shut renin off; ACEI/ARB/spironolactone block the loop at three points. 180 L of filtrate a day, 99%+ reclaimed.

topics.descZh: 闭眼也能摸到鼻子:肌梭并联测长度与速度(Ia 报变化、II 报位置),腱器官串联在肌腱上测张力;敲腱 50 ms 完成单突触牵张反射,过载时 Ib 反手抑制;γ-α 共激活让传感器随时校零,大脑不开眼也知道关节角,误差仅 1-2°。
topics.descEn: Touch your nose with eyes shut: muscle spindles in parallel sense length and velocity (Ia reports change, II position), while Golgi tendon organs in series measure tension. A tendon tap completes its monosynaptic stretch reflex in ~50 ms; overload flips Ib inhibition; gamma-alpha coactivation keeps the sensor zeroed so the brain knows joint angles to 1-2 deg without looking.

topics.descZh: 24 小时细胞周期设三道闸:G1/S 的 p53-p21 挡带伤进入复制,G2/M 查 DNA 复制完没有,SAC 等每条染色体的动粒都挂上双极张力才放行 separase;p53 突变见于约半数肿瘤——审查员失守,细胞带伤闯关,畸变一路累积。
topics.descEn: The 24-hour cell cycle posts three gates: p53-p21 at G1/S bars damaged DNA from replicating, G2/M checks the copy is complete, and the SAC waits until every kinetochore feels bipolar tension before separase cuts. p53 is mutated in about half of all tumors - the inspector falls, the cell cruises through damaged, and lesions pile up.

topics.descZh: 初次应答 5-7 天潜伏、10-14 天达峰、以 IgM 为主;生发中心一轮轮超突变与筛选把亲和力磨高 10-100 倍,记忆 B/T 细胞驻守体内——再次见面 2-4 天、IgG 滴度十倍百倍;麻疹记忆终身,破伤风约 10 年,加强针就是批量预演。
topics.descEn: A first immune response takes 5-7 days to start, 10-14 to peak, mostly IgM. Germinal centers grind affinity up 10-100x through rounds of hypermutation and selection, and memory B/T cells stand guard: on re-encounter, 2-4 days and IgG titers ten- to hundredfold higher. Measles memory lasts a lifetime, tetanus about 10 years - boosters are just rehearsals.

topics.descZh: 清醒的每个小时,腺苷都在基底前脑的账本上累加;它与 A1/A2A 受体结合,把「该困了」的信号写进觉醒回路。咖啡因不删除账本——它是竞争性拮抗剂:三环分子形状恰好卡进结合口袋却不激活受体,把信号挡在门外。口服 ~99% 吸收、约 45 min 达峰,半衰期 ~5 h(肝 CYP1A2 代谢为副黄嘌呤):早晨 8 点的 200 mg,到半夜 0 点体内还剩 ~75 mg——「下午的咖啡毁掉睡眠」是半衰期的算术,不是体质。连续饮用则迫使受体上调代偿(耐受),一旦停用,12-24 h 内腺苷不再有对手:血管舒张性头痛、倦怠持续 2-9 天。吸烟使半衰期减半,口服避孕药使其翻倍——个体差异写在代谢酶里。
topics.descEn: Every waking hour, adenosine piles up in the basal forebrain; binding A1/A2A receptors, it writes

topics.titleEn: Gout: an Inflammatory Storm on Needle Tips
topics.descZh: 嘌呤分解的终点是尿酸:黄嘌呤氧化酶把次黄嘌呤、黄嘌呤两步氧化成尿酸,而人类在中新世丢了尿酸酶基因,它便成了终产物——血尿酸 200-400 μM,恰好悬在溶解度极限 6.8 mg/dL(≈408 μM,37 °C)的边缘。温度是隐藏变量:每降 1 °C 溶解度掉 ~6%,常年 32-34 °C 的第一跖趾关节是全身最冷的大关节——痛风偏爱大脚趾,是溶解度算术,不是玄学。过饱和后析出的单钠尿酸盐是 10-20 μm 的针状结晶;巨噬细胞吞噬结晶 → NLRP3 炎症小体组装 → 半胱天冬酶-1 切出 IL-1β → 中性粒细胞风暴,红肿热痛 12-24 h 达峰。排泄账:2/3 走肾(URAT1 转运体),1/3 走肠。别嘌醇抑制黄嘌呤氧化酶把 500+ μM 拉回 360 μM 以下,但结晶池要以月计才能重溶。
topics.descEn: The end of purine breakdown is uric acid: xanthine oxidase oxidizes hypoxanthine then xanthine, and humans - having lost the uricase gene in the Miocene - stop there. Serum urate sits at 200-400 uM, right on the solubility edge of 6.8 mg/dL (~408 uM at 37 C). Temperature is the hidden variable: each degree cooler shaves ~6% off solubility, and the first metatarsophalangeal joint sits at 32-34 C year-round - the coolest big joint you own - so gout picks the big toe by arithmetic, not mystique. Supersaturated, monosodium urate precipitates as 10-20 um needles; macrophages engulf them, the NLRP3 inflammasome assembles, caspase-1 cuts IL-1beta loose, neutrophils storm in, and a red-hot swollen joint peaks in 12-24 h. Excretion: 2/3 renal (URAT1), 1/3 gut. Allopurinol blocks xanthine oxidase and pulls 500+ uM back under 360 - but the crystal pool takes months to redissolve.

topics.titleEn: Antigenic Drift: Why the Flu Shot Changes Every Year
topics.descZh: 流感病毒表面有两种抗原:血凝素 HA 负责结合细胞上的唾液酸受体、介导入侵,神经氨酸酶 NA 负责切断受体、释放子代——抗体的靶点正是 HA 头部的 5 个表位。流感是 RNA 病毒,聚合酶没有校对功能,出错率约 10⁻³/位点/复制周期,每个新基因组平均带 1 个新突变;HA 每年积累几个氨基酸替换,落在表位上,旧抗体就「认不出」新毒——这是抗原漂移,疫苗一年一针的原因。与之相对的是抗原转变:人、禽、猪病毒重配换掉整条 HA,人群免疫清零,1918、1957、1968、2009 大流行皆是。疫苗株由 WHO 每年 2 月预测、9-10 月接种,匹配时效率 40-60%,错配跌至 10-20%。
topics.descEn: An influenza virion carries two surface antigens: hemagglutinin HA binds sialic-acid receptors to get in, neuraminidase NA cleaves them to let progeny out - and antibodies aim at exactly five epitopes on the HA head. Influenza is an RNA virus whose polymerase has no proofreader: about 10^-3 substitutions per site per replication, one new mutation per genome on average - so HA drifts a few amino acids each year, and once epitopes change, old antibodies no longer recognize the virus. That is antigenic drift, the reason the vaccine is annual. The opposite is antigenic shift: human, avian and swine viruses reassort and swap in a whole HA gene the immune system has never seen - 1918, 1957, 1968 and 2009 were all shifts. WHO picks strains in February for shots by October; a good match protects 40-60% of vaccinees, a mismatch drops to 10-20%.

topics.titleEn: Termite Mound Architecture: Passive Air-Conditioning Without Fans
topics.descZh: 非洲 Macrotermes 白蚁丘内部恒温 ±0.5-1 °C,而外界昼夜波动超过 20 °C——因为丘里养着一大片怕干怕热的菌圃:白蚁「种植」的 Termitomyces 真菌昼夜耗氧产碳,整座丘必须持续呼吸。丘壁布满毛细孔道,中央立着竖直烟囱:白天太阳晒热外壁,周边通道内空气升温、变轻上浮,新鲜空气从丘底被吸入,穿过菌圃带走 CO₂ 与热量,自顶部排出——烟囱效应由日晒驱动;夜晚反转,冷空气沿烟囱下沉,气流不停只换方向,形成约 12 小时一换的「潮汐呼吸」。工蚁实时开孔堵洞调节通风率。一座 3 m 高的丘每天换气可达数百立方米,而全巢白蚁的耗氧量不过与一只兔子相当。津巴布韦哈拉雷的 Eastgate Centre 借此原理不用机械空调,能耗只有同级建筑的 10%。
topics.descEn: A Macrotermes mound in Africa holds its interior within about +/-0.5-1 °C while the outside swings more than 20 °C a day - because the colony farms a living fungus garden that cannot dry out or overheat: the Termitomyces comb burns oxygen and releases CO2 around the clock, so the whole mound must keep breathing. The porous walls carry capillary channels around a central chimney: by day the sun heats the outer wall, air in the peripheral channels warms, lightens and rises; fresh air is drawn in at the base, sweeps the fungus garden clean of CO2 and heat, and leaves at the top - a chimney effect powered by sunshine. At night the flow reverses and cold air sinks down the chimney: not a steady current but tidal breathing, switching direction about every 12 hours. Workers open and plug pores in real time. A 3 m mound exchanges hundreds of cubic meters a day while the whole colony consumes oxygen at the rate of a single rabbit. Harare s Eastgate Centre copied the principle and cut energy use to 10% of comparable buildings.

topics.titleEn: The Growth Plate: Where Height Is Manufactured
topics.descZh: 人从 1 米长到 1 米 8,靠的不是骨干自己抽条,而是长骨两端一条 1-3 mm 的透明软骨带——骨骺生长板。它是一条单行流水线:静止区存着干细胞储库;增殖区软骨细胞成柱状排列,像蒸笼里一屉屉包子,每 12-24 小时分裂一次,把整队人马往干侧推;肥大区细胞体积胀大 5-10 倍,贡献约 60% 的纵向生长,并分泌 X 型胶原与 VEGF 给血管「带路」;钙化区的基质随即被干侧侵入的血管与成骨细胞浇筑成新骨——软骨排队在前,成骨浇筑在后,昼夜不停。节奏由激素拨盘控制:GH-IGF-1 轴维持童年 5-7 cm/年的匀速;青春期性激素先催出女 8-9、男 9-10 cm/年的峰值,又兼任熔断器——雌激素(两性都靠它)让骺板在女 13-15、男 15-17 岁骨化闭合,身高就此封顶。这条生产线也很脆弱:15-30% 的儿童骨折累及骺板(Salter-Harris 分型),压坏生发层可致肢体短缩成角;闭合前 GH 失控则是巨人症。拖动「年龄」滑杆看骨被一格格挤长,把「GH 水平」推到 2.5 倍以上看闸门失灵,或按「骨骼闭合」看白色骨桥扫过骺板、生长当场停止。
topics.descEn: Growing from one metre to 1.8 m, long bones do not stretch along the shaft - they lengthen at each end, inside a 1-3 mm band of translucent cartilage called the growth plate. It is a one-way assembly line: the resting zone banks reserve cells; in the proliferative zone chondrocytes stack in coin-like columns and divide every 12-24 h, pushing the whole queue toward the shaft; in the hypertrophic zone cells swell 5-10 times in volume - about 60% of all longitudinal growth - and secrete type X collagen and VEGF to guide blood vessels in; the calcified scaffold is then invaded from the shaft side by vessels and osteoblasts, which cast it into new bone. Cartilage queues first, bone is poured second, day and night. Hormones set the tempo: the GH-IGF-1 axis holds childhood at a steady 5-7 cm/yr; at puberty sex hormones first drive the peak (girls 8-9, boys 9-10 cm/yr), then act as the fuse - estrogen, which both sexes rely on, fuses the plates at 13-15 in girls and 15-17 in boys, and height is capped for life. The line is fragile too: 15-30% of children s fractures cross the plate (Salter-Harris), and crushing its germinal layer can leave one side permanently stopped, shortening or angling the limb; uncontrolled GH before closure means gigantism. Drag the age slider to watch bone extrude, push GH above 2.5x to jam the gate open, or press plate closure to see the bony bridge sweep across and growth stop on the spot.

topics.titleEn: Vernalization: How a Plant Counts the Weeks of Winter
topics.descZh: 冬小麦秋天播下,若不经历 0-7 °C 的数周低温,来年只长叶、不抽穗——这份「数冬」的能力就是春化作用,计数器就装在 FLC 基因上。FLC 常年表达,按住开花;冷暴露 2-3 周诱导 VIN3,把 Polycomb 复合体 PRC2 招到 FLC 染色质上,此后每多冷一周就多沉积一层 H3K27me3 甲基化,FLC 表达按每层约两成逐级衰减——植物在给冬天计数。关键是回暖不清零:低温标记一旦铺好便终身维持(表观记忆),秋末的短暂暖流骗不过它,只有攒够约 6 周冷,刹车才永久松开。随后长日照接管:光敏素-CO 模块在叶中点亮 FT 蛋白,FT 沿韧皮部开到茎顶,花芽当场启动——冬小麦才能夏初抽穗。拖「冷积周数」看小旗一层层插上染色质、FLC 表达条塌下去;再把「日照时数」拉过 12 小时,左边植株抽穗开花,无冷对照组仍旧一蓬叶子;先冷 8 周再回暖,计数也不清零——按「回暖记忆」亲眼看。农业处处是它:冬小麦 vs 春小麦、白菜胡萝卜越冬抽薹、种子 4 °C 层积催芽数周;1928 年 Lysenko 把春化政治化,真机制 2000 年代才由 Henderson、Dean 等揭开。
topics.descEn: Winter wheat sown in autumn will head in spring only if it first lived through weeks of 0-7 C cold; otherwise it makes leaves and no ears. That ability to count winter is vernalization, and the counter sits on the FLC gene. FLC is expressed all year and holds flowering off; after 2-3 weeks of cold, VIN3 recruits the Polycomb complex PRC2 to the FLC chromatin, and from then on every extra cold week deposits one more layer of H3K27me3 methylation, stepping FLC expression down by roughly a fifth per layer - the plant is tallying the winter. Warming does not erase the count: once laid down, the cold marks persist for the plant s lifetime (epigenetic memory), so a brief warm spell in late autumn cannot fool it; only after about 6 cold weeks is the brake permanently off. Long days then take over: the phytochrome-CO module switches on FT protein in the leaf, FT rides the phloem to the shoot apex, and flowering starts - which is why winter wheat heads in early summer. Drag the cold-weeks slider and watch flags plant one by one on the chromatin while the FLC bar collapses; then push day length past 12 h and the left plant bolts and flowers while the un-vernalized control stays a rosette of leaves; after 8 cold weeks, warming will not reset the count - press warm memory to see it. Agriculture runs on it: winter vs spring wheat, cabbage and carrots bolting after winter, seed stratification at 4 C for weeks. Lysenko politicized vernalization from 1928; the real mechanism was only uncovered in the 2000s by Henderson, Dean and colleagues.

topics.titleEn: Snake Venom: Molecular Tools That Hijack Nerve and Blood
topics.descZh: 蛇毒不是一种毒,而是上百种蛋白的鸡尾酒,大体两派。神经毒(眼镜蛇科):三指毒素 α-bungarotoxin 抢在乙酰胆碱之前占据神经肌肉接头的烟碱受体——结合强度约为 ACh 的一万倍且几乎不解离,终板电位起不来,横纹肌接连罢工,呼吸肌停机是最直接的死因;突触前毒素(β-bungarotoxin,磷脂酶 A₂ 家族)干脆捣毁末梢的递质释放机器。血液毒(蝮蛇/蝰蛇):金属蛋白酶与丝氨酸蛋白酶先在全身异常激活凝血,微血栓遍地、凝血因子被耗竭(DIC),再掉头分解纤维蛋白与血管基底膜——「凝不住」与「漏血」同时发生,PLA₂ 还水解肌膜造成局部坏死肿胀。救治靠抗毒血清:马/羊免疫的多克隆 IgG 只能追捕尚在游离的毒素,黄金窗约 1-4 小时;已被占据的受体救不回,只能等新生。拖「毒液剂量」看分子雨密度,按「神经毒发作」「血液毒发作」切换双舞台,再对比「及时抗血清」与「延迟抗血清」的结局:银环蛇 LD₅₀ 仅 0.1 mg/kg,而单次排毒可达 4-43 mg——时间就是生存。
topics.descEn: Snake venom is not one poison but a cocktail of over a hundred proteins, in two schools. Neurotoxic (elapid) venom: three-finger toxins like alpha-bungarotoxin occupy the nicotinic receptors of the neuromuscular junction before acetylcholine can - binding about ten thousand times stronger, and essentially irreversibly. Endplate potentials fail, skeletal muscles drop out one by one, and respiratory arrest is the most direct cause of death; presynaptic beta-bungarotoxin (a phospholipase A2) wrecks the terminal s transmitter-release machinery outright. Hemotoxic (viper) venom works on logistics: metalloproteases and serine proteases first switch clotting on all over the body - microthrombi spread while clotting factors are consumed (disseminated intravascular coagulation) - then turn around and digest fibrin and the vascular basement membrane, so blood that cannot clot leaks through vessels that cannot hold; PLA2 also hydrolyzes muscle membranes into local necrosis and swelling. Treatment is antivenom: polyclonal IgG raised in horses or sheep can only hunt toxin still floating free - a golden window of about 1-4 h. Receptors already occupied cannot be rescued; you wait for new ones to be built. First aid buys the window: pressure immobilization keeps toxin in place, while cutting, sucking or icing only deepens the damage. Drag the venom-dose slider to thicken the molecular rain, switch stages with neurotoxin strike and hemotoxin strike, then compare early antivenom (0.5 h) against delayed (4 h): many-banded krait venom has an LD50 near 0.1 mg/kg while a single bite can deliver 4-43 mg - time is survival.

topics.titleZh: 肺表面活性物质:小肺泡为什么不塌
topics.titleEn: Pulmonary Surfactant: Why Small Alveoli Don't Collapse
topics.descZh: 肺泡是一群内衬薄薄水液的气囊,而水-气界面天生带着约 72 mN/m 的表面张力——它像一张处处向内收拢的皮,总想把气泡缩到最小。拉普拉斯定律 ΔP=2T/r 说得冷酷:半径越小,把泡撑开需要的跨壁压差越大;半径减半,压差翻倍。更糟的是,若两个肺泡联通,小泡需要的压差更高,气体会径直流进大泡——没有保护机制,呼气末的小肺泡必然一个个塌掉。救场的是 II 型肺泡细胞分泌的 DPPC 磷脂单分子层:它铺在水面上,把表面张力从 72 压到 5 mN/m 以下,而且是「可变」的——呼气时肺泡变小、单分子层被压缩挤紧、发生相变,表面张力骤降到接近零;吸气时膜重新铺开,张力回升。这种「越小越省力」的反向调节,正是大小肺泡能和平共处、整个肺同步充气的稳态核心,也让 P-V 曲线出现开肺压与滞后环。早产儿 II 型细胞尚未成熟,表面活性物质不足,肺泡广泛塌陷与渗出,即新生儿呼吸窘迫综合征(NRDS),曾是早产儿死亡的首位原因;如今产前糖皮质激素促进肺成熟、出生后气管内滴入外源肺表面活性物质,NRDS 死亡率从约 50% 降到 10% 以下。拖动「活性物质浓度」与「跨肺压」滑杆看小肺泡塌陷与复张,按「开肺压实验」看滞后环,按「早产对照」重现 NRDS。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Alveoli are sacs lined by a thin water film, and an air-water interface carries a surface tension of about 72 mN/m - a skin that constantly pulls inward, trying to shrink every bubble. Laplace's law, delta-P = 2T/r, is ruthless: the smaller the radius, the greater the transmural pressure needed to hold the sac open; halve the radius and the required pressure doubles. Worse, if two alveoli share an airway, the smaller one always demands the higher pressure, so air simply flows out of it into its larger neighbour - unprotected, small alveoli must collapse one by one at end-expiration. The rescue is a phospholipid monolayer of DPPC, secreted by type II alveolar cells onto the water surface. It cuts surface tension from 72 to below 5 mN/m, and the cut is variable: during exhalation each sac shrinks, the monolayer is squeezed into tighter packing and undergoes a phase transition, so tension plunges toward zero exactly when the radius is smallest and most dangerous; on inhalation the film spreads out again and tension rises. This inverse regulation - the smaller the sac, the cheaper it gets - is what lets alveoli of very different sizes coexist and fill in step, and it stamps the opening pressure and the hysteresis loop onto the lung pressure-volume curve. When a baby is born prematurely the type II cells are still immature, surfactant is scarce, and alveoli collapse and fill with exudate: neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (NRDS), long the leading cause of preterm death. Antenatal glucocorticoids speed lung maturation, and exogenous surfactant dripped into the trachea after birth has cut NRDS mortality from roughly 50% to under 10%. Drag the surfactant concentration and transpulmonary pressure sliders to collapse and recruit the sacs, run the opening-pressure experiment to trace the hysteresis loop, or press the preterm comparison to reproduce NRDS. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 月经周期:一场激素的振荡电路
topics.titleEn: The Menstrual Cycle: A Hormone Oscillator
topics.descZh: 28 天月经周期不是日历,而是一台由下丘脑-垂体-卵巢轴搭成的激素振荡电路。开局 FSH 催一批卵泡发育,发育中的卵泡分泌雌激素;雌激素在低浓度时执行负反馈,压住 FSH 与 LH——这是电路的常规增益控制。但它藏着整台机器的发条:当优势卵泡把雌激素推到高浓度并持续 36-48 小时,同一个回路翻转成正反馈,LH 暴涨成峰,约在第 14 天顶破成熟卵泡——排卵。破卵之后,残壁变成黄体,分泌孕酮加雌激素:孕酮把内膜改造成可着床的分泌期「床」,同时用负反馈把 FSH/LH 死死压低,防止下一批卵泡抢跑。未受精,黄体在第 22-24 天自行退化,孕酮与雌激素塌方,子宫内膜失去支撑、剥脱出血——月经;刹车一松,FSH 解禁,下一轮振荡启动。内膜全程同步装修:增殖期在雌激素下长厚,分泌期在孕酮下储能。口服避孕药的原理就是从外部供给孕激素,把负反馈钉死在「高位」,LH 峰永不出现,不排卵,也不怀孕。内分泌系统里,这种「浓度依赖的正负反馈翻转」极其罕见,它就是周期的发条。拖动「周期日」看四条激素曲线滚动推进,把「雌激素峰值」削到阈值以下,LH 峰当场消失、排卵不再发生;或按「避孕药对照」看整台振荡器被按停。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The 28-day menstrual cycle is not a calendar but an oscillator built from the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis. At the start, FSH rises from its suppressed low point and recruits a cohort of follicles; the growing follicles secrete estrogen. At low concentrations estrogen exerts negative feedback, pressing FSH and LH down - ordinary gain control. But the circuit hides its own mainspring: when the dominant follicle holds estrogen high for 36-48 hours, the same loop flips into positive feedback, the pituitary releases a massive LH surge around day 13, and roughly 36 hours later - day 14 - the mature follicle ruptures: ovulation. The ruptured follicle becomes the corpus luteum, which pours out progesterone plus estrogen: progesterone remodels the endometrium into a secretory, implantation-ready lining while its strong negative feedback locks FSH and LH down, barring the next cohort of follicles. If no embryo implants, the corpus luteum self-destructs on days 22-24; progesterone and estrogen collapse, the lining loses its hormonal support and sheds - menstruation - the brake comes off, FSH is released, and the next oscillation begins. The lining is renovated in step all month: proliferative phase thickening under estrogen, secretory phase stockpiling under progesterone. The oral contraceptive pill exploits the lock: exogenous progestin pins the negative feedback high so the LH surge never happens - no ovulation - and the endometrium stays thin and stable. Concentration-dependent flipping between negative and positive feedback is rare in endocrinology; here it is the spring that drives the whole clock. Drag the cycle-day slider to roll four hormone curves forward, flatten the estrogen-peak slider below threshold to make the LH peak vanish on the spot, or press the pill comparison to halt the oscillator. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 运动单元与大小原则:力量如何分级
topics.titleEn: Motor Units and the Size Principle: Grading Force
topics.descZh: 抬一杯咖啡和举起杠铃用的是同一套肌肉,神经系统却有一套安静的分级算法。一个 α 运动神经元加上它支配的全部肌纤维,就是一个运动单元:眼外肌一个神经元只管约 10 根纤维,精细得能对准一枚针;股四头肌一个神经元管上千根,为全力蹬踏而生。Henneman 大小原则是分级的骨架:小单元(慢肌 I 型,线粒体密集、抗疲劳)轴突细、阈值最低,任何收缩都最先募集;力量需求增加,单元按体积从小到大依次进场,IIx 型快肌(爆发力强、极易疲劳)永远排在队尾——10-30% 最大力量区间几乎全由慢肌与中间单元完成,写你的名字永远惊动不了大腿的火炮。分级靠两招:募集为主,极端用力也只动用约 90% 的单元;频率编码补足,放电从 10 Hz 爬到 50 Hz,颤搐逐渐融合成平滑的强直收缩,力量再上台阶。疲劳时中枢输出增强,高阈值单元更早被征召,先小后大的队形被打乱;衰老与失神经让运动单元数量减少(老年约减少三分之一),残存单元伸出侧支再支配更大版图,每个单元因此变大、抖动更明显。拖动「目标力量」看神经元池按大小逐个点亮、肌束台阶式爬升,把「激发频率」调低看颤搐抖动、调高看融合成强直,再按「疲劳对照」看队形如何崩坏。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Lifting a coffee cup and heaving a barbell use the same muscles; what changes is a quiet grading algorithm run by the spinal cord. One alpha motor neuron plus every muscle fiber it innervates forms a motor unit, and the ratios span two extremes: an extraocular unit drives only about 10 fibers, fine enough to aim a gaze at a pinhead, while a quadriceps unit drives over a thousand, built for pushing hard. Henneman's size principle supplies the ranking: small units - slow type I fibers, dense with mitochondria and fatigue-resistant - have thin axons and the lowest thresholds, so they are recruited first in any contraction; as demand rises, units join in order from smallest to largest, and the powerful, easily fatigued type IIx fast units always wait at the end of the queue. Between 10 and 30 percent of maximal force is produced almost entirely by slow and intermediate units, which is why writing your name never wakes the heavy artillery in your thigh. Grading uses two levers. Recruitment is the main one - even a maximal effort calls on only about 90 percent of units - and rate coding fills in the rest: firing climbs from about 10 to 50 Hz, individual twitches merge into smooth fused tetanus, and force steps up again. Fatigue scrambles the order: central drive rises and high-threshold units are drafted earlier than usual. Aging and denervation thin out the pool - roughly a third of units are lost in old age - and surviving neurons sprout collateral branches that reinnervate orphaned fibers, so each remaining unit grows larger and its contraction coarser. Drag the target-force slider to watch the neuronal pool light up smallest-first while muscle tension climbs in steps; lower the firing-frequency slider to see unfused twitching, raise it to see smooth tetanus; then run the fatigue comparison to watch the queue fall apart. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 镰状细胞:一个等位基因的双面账
