topics.descZh: 血红蛋白 β 链第 6 位的谷氨酸被换成缬氨酸——DNA 上只是 GAG→GTG 一个碱基的错排,却是教科书级的双面账。缬氨酸的疏水侧链是个「黏斑」:氧合时藏在分子内部;一旦脱氧,黏斑与相邻血红蛋白的互补凹斑结合,分子首尾相连聚成 14 股刚性纤维,把红细胞从柔软圆盘撑成镰刀。镰形细胞失去了挤过窄缝的变形能力:在微血管狭窄处卡死成闸,带来疼痛危象与器官缺氧;它又脆而易碎,被脾脏提前清走——寿命从约 120 天缩到约 20 天,这就是纯合子(SS)的溶血性贫血。但账本还有另一半:在疟疾流行区,杂合子(HbAS,镰状「性状」)的红细胞内环境不利于疟原虫发育,感染细胞也更易被免疫清除,重症疟疾死亡率降约 90%。疟疾这一史上最强的选择压,把 HbS 频率顶在 10-20% 的平衡点:纯合患病是代价,杂合受保护是收益——哈迪-温伯格底盘 p²:2pq:q² 加上选择,平衡点 p*=s/(s+t),正是「平衡选择/杂种优势」的定量版。迁到无疟区后,保护收益归零而纯合代价照付,HbS 频率失去支撑,只随遗传漂变缓慢下滑,SS 患者依旧付出全部代价。演示:左侧看一个碱基聚合成纤维、撑出镰刀;中间调脱氧程度,看微血管从畅通到堵死;右侧 800 人面板调疟疾强度、跑 50 代、开哈迪-温伯格对照,看 AS 频率停在中点或缓缓散场。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Sickle cell disease begins as a single misprint: at codon 6 of the beta-globin gene, GAG becomes GTG, swapping glutamic acid for valine - one base out of three billion, yet a textbook two-sided ledger. Valine's hydrophobic side chain acts as a sticky patch: hidden while oxygen is bound, exposed once hemoglobin gives its oxygen up. Then sticky patch meets the complementary pocket on the next hemoglobin molecule, and the proteins chain into rigid 14-strand fibers that stretch the red cell from a soft disc into a sickle. Sickled cells lose the deformability needed to squeeze through gaps narrower than themselves: at a capillary stenosis they lock into a dam, causing pain crises and organ hypoxia; fragile cells are cleared early by the spleen - a lifespan of about 20 days instead of 120, the homozygote's (HbSS) hemolytic anemia. But the ledger has a second page: where malaria is endemic, heterozygotes (HbAS, sickle trait) carry a red-cell interior hostile to the parasite, and infected cells are cleared by immunity more readily - severe-malaria mortality drops about 90%. Malaria, the strongest selection pressure in human history, therefore pins HbS frequency at a balanced point of 10-20%: homozygous disease is the cost t, heterozygote protection the benefit s, and Hardy-Weinberg supplies the genotype floor p²:2pq:q² beneath an equilibrium p*=s/(s+t) - the quantitative face of balancing selection. Leave malaria behind and the benefit drops to zero while the cost remains: HbS loses its support and slides slowly under genetic drift, while SS patients still pay the full price. In the demo: watch one base build a fiber and bend a disc on the left; tune deoxygenation to jam or clear a capillary in the middle; on the right, set malaria intensity on an 800-person panel, run 50 generations, and open the Hardy-Weinberg overlay to see AS frequency settle at the midpoint or dissolve. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 营养级联:狼回来了,河岸绿了
topics.descZh: 1926 年,黄石公园的最后一头狼被消灭;1995 年,狼被重新引入——中间 69 年,河谷换了模样。没了狼的马鹿不再恐惧,冬天在河谷敞地慢悠悠啃光柳树与白杨幼苗;狼回来后,马鹿不敢在无掩蔽的河岸久留——「恐惧地形学」:风险地图决定取食地点。于是柳丛恢复→河岸固土、河道稳定→鸣禽有了筑巢处→河狸回归,河狸坝再造湿地、养鱼养两栖,甚至改变河流形态:捕食者隔着一级按住了植物,这就是「自上而下」。反例同样锋利:美国东部灭掉美洲狮后白尾鹿爆发,森林下层被啃成修剪过的草坪;阿拉斯加海獭减少,海胆爆发,海带林被啃成「海胆荒漠」——海獭回来,海带林复兴:它生物量占比很小,影响却远超比例,是「关键种」;潮间带的海星 Pisaster 控制贻贝、为十几个物种留空间,同理。Fretwell 的四营养级逻辑:每加一级,下两级受抑与释放交替。营养级联(自上而下)与养分驱动(自下而上),是生态学的两条主轴。演示:左边拖狼数量,看马鹿在河谷的时长、柳树覆盖率、河狸坝与物种计数联动;中间拖海獭数量,看海带林与海胆荒漠互换;右边点「移除关键种」,看贻贝铺满潮间带、物种数从 15 崩到 3。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: In 1926 the last wolf of Yellowstone was killed; in 1995 wolves were brought back - and in the 69 years between, the valley changed its face. Without wolves the elk lost their fear and wintered on open valley floors, slowly browsing willow and aspen seedlings bare; once wolves returned, elk no longer dared linger on exposed banks - the ecology of fear: a map of risk decides where to feed. So willow thickets recovered -> banks held, channels stabilized -> songbirds found nesting shrubs -> beavers returned, and beaver dams rebuilt wetlands that raise fish and amphibians and even reshape river form: a predator restraining plants one level removed - top-down control. The counterexamples cut just as sharp: with cougars gone in the eastern US, white-tailed deer boomed and grazed the forest understory into a mowed lawn; off Alaska, fewer sea otters meant a sea-urchin explosion that mowed kelp forests into urchin barrens - otters back, kelp reborn: a tiny share of the biomass with impact far beyond proportion, a keystone species; the intertidal starfish Pisaster holding mussels in check leaves space for a dozen-plus species, same logic. Fretwell's four-level rule: add a level, and the two below it alternate suppression and release. Trophic cascades (top-down) and nutrient driving (bottom-up) are ecology's two master axes. In the demo: drag the wolf count on the left and watch elk time-in-valley, willow cover, beaver dams and species counts respond; drag otters in the middle to swap kelp forest for urchin barren; on the right, press remove the keystone to watch mussels pave the intertidal as species fall from 15 to 3. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 线粒体与母系遗传:只走母亲这条线
topics.titleEn: Mitochondria & Maternal Inheritance: The Line That Only Runs Through Mothers
topics.descZh: 线粒体是细胞里的供电站,却还留着一套自己的小基因组:人类 mtDNA 长 16569 bp、只有 37 个基因(13 个呼吸链亚基 + 22 个 tRNA + 2 个 rRNA)。这套基因几乎只经卵子的细胞质传给下一代:受精时精子带进去的几十个线粒体会被泛素标记、随后清除,受精卵里只剩卵子的 10 万+ 拷贝——家谱因此只沿母亲这条线走,线粒体夏娃(约 15-20 万年前)就是这么追出来的。每个细胞几百到几千个线粒体、每个 2-10 份 mtDNA,突变型与野生型可以共存,比例叫「异质性」;传给下一代时还要过一道「遗传瓶颈」:卵子发育早期 mtDNA 先从约 10 万拷贝削减到几十-几百个、再重新扩增,抽样噪声让同一位母亲的孩子们突变负荷天差地别——母亲只有 20% 突变,孩子可能 5% 也可能 80%。还有阈值效应:突变占比超过约 60-90%(视突变而定)组织才出症状,耗能大户(神经、肌肉、心肌)先倒下——MELAS、MERRF、Leber 视神经萎缩都是这条链上的病。三亲婴儿/线粒体替代疗法把核 DNA 搬进捐赠者的健康卵浆,就是为掐断这条传递链。演示:看精子线粒体被泛素清场;调母源负荷(5-80%)与瓶颈宽度(20-500 拷贝)后点「繁衍一代」做二项抽样,直方图与四代谱系树随之漂移,超阈值个体亮红。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Mitochondria are the power plants of the cell, yet they keep a small genome of their own: human mtDNA is 16,569 bp long with only 37 genes - 13 respiratory-chain subunits, 22 tRNAs and 2 rRNAs. This genome passes to the next generation almost exclusively through the egg's cytoplasm: the few dozen mitochondria a sperm brings in are tagged with ubiquitin and then destroyed, leaving only the egg's 100,000+ copies in the zygote - so the family tree runs only along the maternal line, which is exactly how mitochondrial Eve (a common maternal ancestor 150,000-200,000 years ago) was traced. Each cell holds hundreds to thousands of mitochondria with 2-10 mtDNA copies each, and mutant and wild-type genomes can coexist - a mixture called heteroplasmy. Passing to the next generation crosses a genetic bottleneck: early in egg development mtDNA is first cut from about 100,000 copies down to a few dozen-hundred, then re-amplified; sampling noise gives children of the same mother wildly different mutation loads - a mother at 20% can have a child at 5% or 80%. There is also a threshold effect: symptoms appear only above roughly 60-90% mutant fraction (depending on the variant), and the biggest energy consumers - nerve, muscle, heart - fail first: MELAS, MERRF and Leber optic neuropathy all sit on this chain. Three-parent babies / mitochondrial replacement - moving nuclear DNA into a donor's healthy egg cytoplasm - exists precisely to cut this transmission chain. In the demo, watch sperm mitochondria get ubiquitinated and cleared; set maternal load (5-80%) and bottleneck width (20-500 copies), then press breed one generation for binomial sampling - the histogram and four-generation pedigree drift, and individuals above threshold light up red. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: 颈前那只蝴蝶形的腺体握着全身代谢的油门,而油门的燃料是一种你每天只吃几毫克的元素:碘。滤泡上皮细胞膜上的 NIS 钠碘同向转运体顶着浓度梯度抓碘——动力来自钠钾泵攒下的钠梯度,这让甲状腺里的碘浓度能蓄到血浆的 20-40 倍;过氧化物酶 TPO 用双氧水把碘离子氧化,一个个挂到甲状腺球蛋白的酪氨酸残基上,两个碘化酪氨酸首尾相接,便得到 T₄(四碘甲腺原氨酸)与活性更强的 T₃,整批储存在滤泡腔的胶体里——这是身体少有的「战略储备」,够用数周。垂体每分泌一分子 TSH,滤泡细胞就把胶体内吞回来水解,释放激素入血;T₃/T₄ 落到靶细胞核受体上,上调 Na⁺/K⁺-ATP 酶与产热解偶联,基础代谢率、心率、体温随之抬升;而血液里 T₃ 一多,又回头压住垂体的 TSH——一个标准的负反馈恒温器。缺碘时 TSH 被迫长期高位,滤泡细胞代偿性增生,脖子肿成地方性甲状腺肿;补碘盐全球推行后,这类「大脖子病」已从公共卫生版图上大面积消失,但全球仍有约 20 亿人碘摄入不足。拖「碘摄入」看 NIS 抓取与胶体储量,拖「TSH 水平」看释放节律;按「缺碘与甲状腺肿」看腺体代偿膨大,按「甲亢模式」看油门卡死,按「负反馈回路」追踪从垂体到靶细胞再回来的整条环。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The butterfly-shaped gland at the front of your throat holds the throttle for your whole metabolism, and its fuel is an element you eat by the milligram: iodine. The NIS sodium-iodide symporter on follicular cells pulls iodide against its gradient, powered by the sodium gradient the Na/K pump maintains - thyroid iodine concentrates to 20-40 times plasma. Thyroperoxidase oxidizes iodide with hydrogen peroxide and hangs it on tyrosine residues of thyroglobulin; two iodinated tyrosines couple to yield T4 and the more potent T3, all stored in the follicle's colloid - one of the body's few strategic reserves, weeks deep. Each pulse of TSH from the pituitary makes follicle cells swallow colloid, digest it, and release hormone into blood; T3/T4 land on nuclear receptors and upregulate Na/K-ATPase and thermogenic uncoupling, lifting basal metabolic rate, heart rate and temperature. And when T3 rises in blood it squeezes the pituitary's TSH back down - a textbook negative-feedback thermostat. Starve it of iodine and TSH is stuck high, follicle cells multiply in compensation, and the neck swells into endemic goiter; with iodized salt now global, that map has largely faded, yet about two billion people still fall short. Drag iodine intake to watch NIS uptake and colloid stores, drag TSH level for release rhythm; press iodine deficiency & goiter to see compensatory swelling, hyperthyroid mode for a jammed throttle, feedback loop to trace pituitary to target cell and back. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半个甲状腺滤泡剖面:胶体球腔、单层滤泡细胞、基底侧毛细血管;NIS 泵闪蓝光抓碘;TPO 在顶端膜氧化;T₄/T₃ 四环分子模型进入血管;远处垂体小人发射 TSH;靶细胞线粒体加速;反馈弧线。

topics.descZh: 一口红烧肉进肚,油在十二指肠里先遇到的不是消化酶,而是乳化剂:脂肪酶只在水油界面上干活,一颗直径 1 cm 的油珠表面积不到半平方厘米,酶站在界外干着急。胆囊挤出的胆汁里装着肝细胞从胆固醇合成的胆盐——两亲分子,亲水的酸头扎进水相,疏水的甾体环面朝油心,几十个分子围一圈把大油珠撕成 1-10 μm 的乳滴,表面积暴涨约一千倍,胰脂肪酶这才抢到工位,辅脂酶帮它锚在界面上,把甘油三酯剪成脂肪酸与单甘酯。产物油性太强,还得再雇车:胆盐与剪切产物拼成 4-8 nm 的混合胶束,载着脂肪碎片穿过肠壁不动层,送到小肠绒毛刷状缘被吸收;而胆盐自己在回肠末端被 ASBT 转运体回收,经门静脉回到肝再合成胆汁——约 95% 的胆盐每天循环 4-12 次,身体只补 5% 的新货。胆囊摘除的人靠肝持续滴漏的稀胆汁也能消化,只是大餐后容易腹泻;胆汁里胆固醇过饱和或钙过多时析出结晶,就是胆结石——堵住胆囊管是油腻疼痛,堵住胆总管则黄疸与胰疱一发齐来。拖「胆盐浓度」看乳化粒径,拖「脂肪量」看酶的排队;按「有无胆汁对照」看脂肪泻,按「胆结石堵塞」看管道断流,按「胶束通勤」跟随一滴脂肪进绒毛。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
When fatty food lands in the duodenum, the first thing oil meets is not an enzyme but an emulsifier: lipase only works at the water-oil interface, and a 1 cm globule offers under half a square centimetre of it - the enzyme waits helplessly outside. Bile squeezed from the gallbladder carries bile salts synthesized from cholesterol by the liver - amphipathic molecules whose acid head dips into water while the steroid rings face the oil core; scores of them ring the globule and tear it into 1-10 micron droplets, multiplying the interface about a thousandfold. Pancreatic lipase finally gets to work, anchored by colipase, snipping triglycerides into fatty acids and monoglycerides. The products are still too oily to travel: bile salts and the sheared products assemble into 4-8 nm mixed micelles that ferry fat fragments across the unstirred layer to the enterocyte's brush border. Meanwhile the salts themselves are reclaimed at the ileum's end by the ASBT transporter and ride the portal vein home - about 95 percent recycled, 4-12 loops a day, with only 5 percent freshly made. After gallbladder removal the liver's steady drip still manages, just with post-feast diarrhea; when cholesterol or calcium oversaturates the bile, crystals grow into gallstones - blocking the cystic duct brings fatty-pain attacks, blocking the common bile duct brings jaundice and pancreatitis together. Drag bile-salt concentration to watch droplet size, drag fat load to see enzymes queue; press with/without bile for steatorrhea, gallstone blockage for a stalled pipeline, micelle commute to follow one fat fragment into a villus. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 十二指肠横剖面:大油球落入、胆盐分子(黄头灰尾两亲)游来包围、油球碎裂成微滴、脂肪酶(绿色)在界面上切割、混合胶束(小圆盘)向绒毛迁移、回肠回收箭头;胆囊与胆总管示意。

topics.descZh: 同一条鱼,放进淡水是一张漏水漏盐的网,放进海水是一块失水进盐的海绵——渗透压永远把水从稀处拉向浓处,淡水鱼与海水鱼对付的是相反的物理题。硬骨鱼体液约 300 mOsm:淡水只有 5-50,水拼命往里渗、盐拼命往外漏——淡水鱼干脆不喝水,肾造出大量稀尿(每天排出约体重 1/3 的水),鳃上氯细胞主动把 Na⁺/Cl⁻ 泵进来补漏;海水约 1000 mOsm,水往外渗、盐往里进——海水鱼大口吞海水(每天约体重的 7-35%),肠子把水与一价盐吸收入血,多余的 NaCl 由鳃氯细胞里的 NKCC 共转运体借 Na⁺/K⁺-ATP 酶打出的电位梯度主动泵出去,二价的镁钙走肾与肠少量排出;鲨鱼走第三条路:保留尿素与 TMAO 把体液提到与海水等渗,不必喝水,鳃只对付 NaCl。洄游的鲑鱼要在两套系统间换挡:入海前鳃氯细胞从「吸盐型」改建为「排盐型」,催乳素与皮质醇在此交接;把淡水鱼苗直接扔进海水会「烧鳃」,正是这套改建需要几天。成体鱼的皮肤几乎不透水,鳃才是渗透战场的主前线——面积只有体表的几分之一,却承担九成以上的离子交换。拖「盐度」看水流方向当场翻转,拖「泵活性」看鳃的排盐速率;按「氯细胞特写」看酶泵如何借电位排盐,按「鲑鱼换挡」看两套系统的切换,按「鲨鱼方案」看尿素策略。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The same fish is a leaky net in freshwater and a drying sponge in the sea - osmosis always pulls water from dilute to concentrated, and freshwater versus saltwater fish face opposite versions of the problem. Teleost blood sits near 300 mOsm: freshwater is 5-50, so water floods in and salts leak out - freshwater fish simply don't drink; the kidney makes copious dilute urine (about a third of body weight per day) and gill chloride cells pump Na+/Cl- back in. Seawater is ~1000: water leaves, salts invade - saltwater fish gulp seawater (7-35 percent of body weight daily), the gut absorbs water plus monovalent salts, and the excess NaCl is actively pumped out by gill chloride cells, where NKCC cotransporters ride the gradient their basolateral Na/K-ATPase builds, while divalent magnesium and calcium trickle out via kidney and gut. Sharks take a third road: they retain urea and TMAO to match seawater osmolality, skip the drinking, and let gills deal with NaCl alone. Migrating salmon shift gears between the two systems: before entering the sea their chloride cells remodel from salt-absorbing to salt-secreting, prolactin and cortisol handing over the keys; drop a freshwater fry straight into the ocean and the gills "burn" while the remodel takes days. Adult fish skin barely passes water - the gills, a fraction of the body surface, run over ninety percent of the ion traffic. Drag salinity to flip the water flux on the spot, drag pump activity for gill salt rates; press chloride cell closeup to watch the enzyme pumps ride their gradient, salmon shift for the two-system changeover, shark plan for the urea strategy. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 一条鱼的侧剖(半透明):鳃丝、肾、肠、氯细胞高亮;环境盐度滑杆切换淡水/海水背景色;水流弧线箭头(进/出)随盐度翻转;氯细胞放大视图:NKCC/Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase 泵闪烁;鲨鱼模式叠加尿素浓度条。

topics.descZh: 内质网送来的蛋白质只是毛坯,高尔基体才是精加工车间:四五层扁平囊(池)平行摞成一座平台,凸面朝内质网叫 cis 面,凹面朝细胞膜叫 trans 面。货物(新合成的蛋白)由 COPII 小泡送到 cis 面入厂,然后像流水线一样逐层穿越:每一层囊膜上住着不同的糖基转移酶,给蛋白的糖链加一个、剪一个、改一个——高甘露糖型被修剪成杂合型再成熟为复杂型,半乳糖、唾液酸按顺序补上;加工完的蛋白在 trans 面被打包分拣:溶酶体酶被标上甘露糖-6-磷酸「地址签」装进网格蛋白小泡寄往溶酶体,默认路线送细胞膜,调节型分泌蛋白则存进分泌颗粒待命。整个细胞器还是动态的:囊泡在 cis 端不断并入、trans 端不断出芽,膜像传送带一样从 cis 流向 trans——它到底是「 stationary 的池子」还是「成熟的传送带」,学界吵了四十年,如今证据偏向后者:每层池自身在成熟,酶被逆行的囊泡一轮轮往回送,才保住各自的分工。高尔基体还是细胞的质检站:折叠错误的蛋白在这里被留住退回,糖链修饰错误的蛋白走不出分泌通路。拖「运输速度」看流水线节奏,拖「酶活性」看糖链加工精度;按「货运全流程」走一遍从入厂到发货,按「糖链加工」看糖链逐站修饰,按「溶酶体分选」看地址签如何决定去向,按「囊泡出芽」看膜如何弯成球。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Proteins leaving the ER are rough stock; the Golgi is the finishing shop: four or five flattened sacs (cisternae) stacked into a platform, its convex cis face toward the ER, its concave trans face toward the membrane. Cargo arrives at cis in COPII vesicles and crosses the stack like a workpiece on a line: each cisterna hosts a different cast of glycosyltransferases that add, trim and edit the sugar chains - high-mannose trimmed to hybrid then matured to complex, galactose and sialic acid bolted on in order. At trans, finished proteins are packed and sorted: lysosomal enzymes get a mannose-6-phosphate address tag and ship in clathrin-coated vesicles, default cargo rides to the plasma membrane, and regulated secretors are warehoused in granules until the signal to fire. The organelle itself moves: vesicles merge at cis while buds leave at trans, and the membrane streams cis-to-trans like a belt - whether the cisternae are stationary stations or a maturing conveyor was argued for forty years, and the evidence now favors the conveyor: each cisterna matures in place while retrograde vesicles ferry the enzymes backward round after round to keep every station's job description intact. The Golgi is also quality control: misfolded proteins are held here and sent back, and wrongly glycosylated ones never leave the secretory path at all. Drag transport speed to set the line's pace, drag enzyme activity for glycan precision; press full cargo route to walk entry to shipping, glycan processing to watch sugars edited station by station, lysosome sorting to see the address tag decide, vesicle budding to watch membrane curl into a sphere. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 4-5 层扁平囊摞成的平台(cis 凸面/trans 凹面),ER 来的 COPII 小泡在 cis 并入;糖链(彩色串珠)逐层被修剪延长;trans 面三种囊泡分道:网格蛋白小泡(M6P 签)去溶酶体、默认小泡去细胞膜、分泌颗粒待命;酶逆行回送箭头。

topics.descZh: 组织缺氧时会拉响一个化学警报:缺氧诱导因子 HIF-1 稳定下来,启动 VEGF 基因,血管内皮生长因子被分泌出来,在组织里铺开一条浓度递增的「面包屑小路」——最近的毛细血管循着梯度长过去,这条路的学名叫血管新生。先头部队是「尖细胞」:它伸出大量丝状伪足当鼻子,沿 VEGF 梯度探路、降解细胞基质开路;后面的「柄细胞」跟着增殖,细胞之间拉开管腔,一条新血管的雏形就成型了;多路新芽最终与既有血管吻合成网(吻合),血流涌入,供氧恢复,HIF 关闭,VEGF 撤号,生长停止——一套精确的负反馈。肿瘤把这个系统劫持了:瘤体内部长期缺氧,VEGF 被持续高表达,新血管疯长但结构混乱——走行扭曲、管壁缺损、血流时而淤滞,它们不为组织供氧,只为肿瘤供货;抗 VEGF 药物(贝伐珠单抗)与后来上市的小分子 TKI 就是把这条警报线掐断,「饿死肿瘤」,如今是结直肠癌、肺癌标准疗法的一部分。伤口愈合、月经周期内膜重建、锻炼后肌肉毛细血管加密,用的都是同一套机制;糖尿病患者视网膜新生血管失控,则用激光封闭缺血区来止损。拖「缺氧程度」看 VEGF 浓度场与新芽速度,拖「药物剂量」看新芽被抑制的程度;按「出芽生长」看尖细胞与柄细胞的分工,按「血管吻合」看两路合龙通血,按「肿瘤血管」看混乱疯长的形态,按「抗血管治疗」看血管退化退缩。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
When tissue runs short of oxygen it raises a chemical alarm: HIF-1 stabilizes, switches on the VEGF gene, and vascular endothelial growth factor spreads through the tissue as a trail of increasing concentration - the nearest capillary reads the gradient and grows toward it. This is angiogenesis. The point of the spear is the tip cell, waving a thicket of filopodia like noses, sniffing the VEGF gradient and digesting matrix to clear the way; stalk cells behind it proliferate, hollow out a lumen between them, and a new vessel takes shape; sprouts from different directions finally fuse with existing vessels (anastomosis), blood flows in, oxygen returns, HIF switches off, VEGF is withdrawn, and growth stops - a precision negative feedback loop. Tumors hijack it: the tumor core is chronically hypoxic, VEGF runs at full blast, and vessels grow wildly but badly - twisted, leaky, stagnant - supplying the tumor rather than the tissue; anti-VEGF antibodies and small-molecule kinase inhibitors cut the alarm wire to starve the tumor, now part of standard therapy in colorectal and lung cancer. Wound healing, rebuilding the uterine lining each cycle, and crowding muscle with new capillaries in training all run the same program; in diabetic retinas the same program runs away, and lasers seal the ischemic zones to stop it. Drag hypoxia level to shape the VEGF field and sprout speed, drag drug dose to watch sprouting suppressed; press sprouting for the tip-and-stalk division of labor, anastomosis for the two-front connection and first flow, tumor vasculature for the chaotic overgrowth, anti-angiogenic therapy for vessels retreating. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 组织块中既有血管(红管)+缺氧核心(紫雾 VEGF 浓度场);尖细胞(发光)伸出丝状伪足探路、柄细胞列队增殖拉出管腔;吻合瞬间血流(红粒子)涌入;肿瘤模式下血管扭曲杂乱;加药后新芽回缩。

topics.descZh: 酒精在身体里走的不是脂肪那条存储路线,而是必须在肝脏里当场销毁的路线:乙醇→乙醛→乙酸,两步氧化,一步都绕不开。第一步由乙醇脱氢酶 ADH 催化,把乙醇氧化成乙醛——乙醛是真正的坏分子:扩张血管(脸红)、损伤 DNA、名列致癌物清单;第二步由乙醛脱氢酶 ALDH2 立刻把乙醛氧化成乙酸,乙酸随后变成乙酰辅酶 A 进能量代谢,或合成脂肪存起来。瓶颈在第二步:约三成东亚人携带 ALDH2 突变(rs671),酶活性只剩百分之几,喝一点乙醛就堆积——脸红、心悸、头痛,这是身体在明说「这台机器处理不了这个负荷」。整个系统的速度表还很小:ADH 的代谢速率近乎恒定,约每小时 7-10 克酒精,多喝也快不了——零级动力学,血浓度只能等;一杯红酒(约 14 克)要一个多小时,酩酊大醉要一整夜。堆积的 NADH 还会把代谢引向歧途:脂肪合成加速、脂肪酸氧化停摆,长期大量饮酒的肝先变脂肪肝、再炎症、再纤维化;诱导出的 CYP2E1 旁路还会产生更多乙醛与自由基。解酒药无法加速这套酶,咖啡因只是让你清醒地醉着;真正有用的是时间与分量。拖「饮酒量」看 BAC 爬升与回落的节奏,拖「ALDH2 活性」看乙醛堆积;按「正常代谢」看两步接力,按「乙醛堆积」看脸红机制,按「长期饮用」看脂肪肝的来路,按「空腹饮酒」看吸收速率差。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Alcohol does not take fat's storage route in the body - it must be destroyed on the spot in the liver: ethanol to acetaldehyde to acetate, two oxidations with no detour. Alcohol dehydrogenase runs the first step, oxidizing ethanol into acetaldehyde - the true villain: it dilates vessels (the flush), damages DNA and sits on carcinogen lists; aldehyde dehydrogenase ALDH2 then oxidizes acetaldehyde to acetate within moments, and acetate enters energy metabolism or becomes fat. The bottleneck is the second step: roughly a third of East Asians carry an ALDH2 variant (rs671) with only a few percent of normal activity - even a small drink piles up acetaldehyde, bringing flushing, palpitations and headache: the body saying outright that this machine cannot process the load. The whole system's speedometer is tiny: ADH works at a nearly fixed rate of 7-10 grams of alcohol per hour no matter how much you pour - zero-order kinetics, blood concentration just has to wait; a glass of wine (about 14 grams) takes over an hour, a serious binge takes a night. The accumulated NADH also derails metabolism: fat synthesis accelerates, fatty-acid oxidation stalls, and the liver of a heavy drinker goes fatty, then inflamed, then fibrotic; the induced CYP2E1 bypass generates extra acetaldehyde and free radicals. No pill speeds these enzymes - caffeine only leaves you awake while drunk; what works is time and dose. Drag drink size to watch BAC climb and creep back down, drag ALDH2 activity to pile up acetaldehyde; press normal metabolism for the two-step relay, acetaldehyde buildup for the flush mechanism, chronic drinking for how fatty liver arrives, empty stomach for the absorption difference. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 肝小叶场景:乙醇(蓝)经 ADH 变乙醛(红,警告光晕)再经 ALDH2 变乙酸(绿);NAD⁺/NADH 天平指针倾斜;脸红人物示意;长期模式肝细胞内脂肪滴增多;BAC 曲线随时间。

topics.descZh: 胎儿的肺是不工作的,替班的是胎盘,所以胎儿心脏最大的工程不是泵血,而是把血绕开肺送出去:脐静脉从胎盘带回氧饱和度约 80% 的血,一进右心房就走捷径——静脉导管让它绕开肝脏直下下腔静脉;卵圆孔让右心房的血直接漏进左心房,优先供给脑和心;动脉导管把本该进肺的右心室血改道进降主动脉,真正进肺的血只占心输出量约 10%。抢氧靠胎儿血红蛋白 HbF:氧解离曲线比成人左移,P50 约 19 mmHg(成人约 27),同样氧分压下硬把氧从母体血红蛋白手里夺过来。出生是血流改道的硬切换:第一口气撑开肺泡,肺血管阻力骤降,肺血流从一成暴涨到接下全部右心输出;血氧飙升让动脉导管平滑肌收缩,24–48 小时内功能闭合;左心房压力反超,把卵圆孔瓣膜像门一样压贴。改道失败就是先天性心脏病:动脉导管未闭(PDA)让主动脉血持续漏进肺动脉,青紫与心衰随之而来——早产儿用布洛芬抑制前列腺素促闭,大龄患儿塞封堵器。拖「肺血管阻力」看肺血流占比怎么随阻力塌缩与暴涨,拖「动脉血氧饱和度」看血色深浅与曲线标记;按「胎儿循环」看三条捷径的默认走线,按「出生切换」看三条捷径依次闪红闭合,按「PDA 病理」看导管持续漏流,按「HbF 氧解离」看两条 S 曲线对比。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The fetus's lungs do no work - the placenta works the shift - so the fetal heart's biggest job is not pumping but routing blood around the lungs. The umbilical vein brings back blood at about 80% oxygen saturation, and on reaching the right atrium it takes the shortcuts: the ductus venosus bypasses the liver straight into the inferior vena cava; the foramen ovale leaks right-atrial blood into the left atrium to feed the brain and heart first; the ductus arteriosus reroutes the right-ventricular blood that should enter the lungs into the descending aorta, so only about 10% of cardiac output perfuses the lungs. Grabbing oxygen at the placenta is fetal hemoglobin HbF's trick: its dissociation curve sits left of the adult's, P50 near 19 mmHg against about 27, so at the same partial pressure HbF strips oxygen from maternal hemoglobin. Birth is a hard rerouting: the first breath inflates the alveoli, pulmonary vascular resistance collapses, lung flow leaps from a tenth to the whole right-heart output; the oxygen surge makes the ductus smooth muscle constrict and functionally closes it within 24-48 hours, while left atrial pressure overtakes the right and presses the foramen ovale's flap shut like a door. When the rerouting fails you get congenital heart disease: patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) keeps leaking aortic blood into the pulmonary artery, bringing cyanosis and heart failure - preterm infants get ibuprofen to block the prostaglandins holding the duct open, and in older children a closure device is implanted into the duct. Drag lung vascular resistance to watch lung flow collapse and surge, drag arterial O2 saturation to shift the blood color and the curve markers; press fetal loop for the default shortcuts, birth switch to see them flash and close one by one, PDA pathology for the persistent leak, HbF curve for the two S-curves side by side. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半透明胎儿剪影内,红色富氧血粒子沿脐静脉—静脉导管—卵圆孔—左心—脑的走线流动,蓝色缺氧血粒子沿上腔静脉—右心室—动脉导管—降主动脉—脐动脉回到胎盘;四腔心节律搏动;出生切换时肺亮起、阻力骤降、三条捷径依次闪红闭合;PDA 模式下导管持续漏流;HbF 模式浮出两条氧解离 S 曲线与实时标记点。

topics.descZh: 让癌症真正致命的往往不是原发瘤,而是转移——约 90% 的癌症死亡由它完成,这段旅程是一连串低概率事件的接力,每棒都淘汰绝大多数选手。肿瘤细胞先在原地挖墙脚:分泌基质金属蛋白酶 MMP 溶解基质,再启动上皮-间质转化 EMT,收起细胞间黏连、长出伪足,变成可迁移形态;接着挤过血管壁「内渗」进血流,以循环肿瘤细胞 CTC 的身份漂流——血流剪切力像砂纸,巡逻的免疫细胞像关卡,两道鬼门关下 24 小时存活率不到万分之一;幸存者在远处器官的毛细血管床被迫急刹(细胞比毛细血管还宽,直接卡住),再「外渗」钻出血管,大多就地休眠数月甚至数年,直到血管新生送来补给才苏醒成显性转移灶。落点不随机:乳腺癌偏爱骨、肺、肝、脑,因为不同器官微环境分泌不同的趋化因子——佩吉特的「种子与土壤」学说 1889 年就写下这个判断;转移灶在病理上仍叫原发癌的名字,乳腺癌的骨转移还是乳腺癌,用药跟着原发走,抗血管新生药则掐断休眠灶的补给线。拖「血流剪切力」看 CTC 被照灭的节奏,拖「免疫活性」看免疫巡逻的杀伤;按「转移全流程」看从挖墙脚到转移灶的完整接力,按「血流生死关」贴近看血管内的追杀,按「种子与土壤」轮看骨/肺/脑三种落点,按「休眠与唤醒」快进血管新生与苏醒。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
What kills most cancer patients is not the primary tumor but metastasis - it completes about 90% of cancer deaths - and the journey is a relay of low-probability events in which every leg eliminates almost all the runners. Tumor cells undermine their neighborhood first: matrix metalloproteinases (MMP) dissolve the surrounding stroma, then epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) packs away cell-cell adhesion and grows pseudopods, turning the cells migratory; next they squeeze through the vessel wall - intravasation - and drift in the bloodstream as circulating tumor cells (CTC), where shear stress grinds like sandpaper and patrolling immune cells run checkpoints: under these two gates fewer than one in ten thousand survives 24 hours. Survivors jam in the capillary bed of a distant organ - a CTC is wider than a capillary, so it arrests - then squeeze back out through the wall (extravasation) and mostly fall dormant for months or years, until angiogenesis delivers supplies and the seeds wake into overt metastases. Landing is not random: breast cancer favours bone, lung, liver and brain because each organ's microenvironment secretes different chemokines - Paget's seed-and-soil hypothesis wrote that down in 1889, and a metastasis keeps the primary's name (a breast-cancer bone metastasis is still breast cancer), so therapy follows the primary while anti-angiogenic drugs try to cut the dormant deposits' supply lines. Drag shear stress to set the kill rate in the stream, drag immune activity to make the patrol deadlier; press full journey for the whole relay from undermining to colony, bloodstream gauntlet to zoom in on the vascular hunt, seed and soil to cycle bone/lung/brain landings, dormancy awakening to fast-forward sprouting and reawakening. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 左侧紫色原发瘤细胞团伸缩搏动,变形细胞伸出伪足爬向血管;中央透明血管内红色血流粒子疾驰示意剪切力,CTC 借流漂移,被红色剪切闪光与绿色免疫细胞逐个照灭;右端毛细血管床让幸存者急刹、钻出血管变成灰色休眠点;红色新生血管线爬入组织,休眠细胞苏醒分裂成紫色转移灶;右侧骨/肺/脑三个器官在「种子与土壤」模式下轮换高亮。

topics.descZh: 秋天树上掉叶子,不是枯死脱落,而是一台由激素计时、提前几周排期的「器官切除手术」。白天变短、温度下降,叶片先做回收:叶绿素被分解,氮和镁顺着叶脉撤回枝干存进过冬账户,被盖住的黄色类胡萝卜素这才显影,液泡里新合成的红色花青素再叠上一层红,秋天于是成了树叶的清算季。真正的开关是激素比值:只要叶片持续向叶柄「汇款」生长素,基部的离层就保持沉默;生长素流一旦断供,离层细胞对乙烯的敏感性暴涨,乙烯驱动细胞分泌果胶酶与纤维素酶,把中胶层和细胞壁一点点溶解,最后只剩几根维管束吊着;风一过,叶落,断口随即被栓化细胞封成一层防水防菌的「叶痕」。为什么必须落叶:常绿叶在冬天要面对蒸腾失水大于光合收益、枝冠积雪超载、气孔结冰三本亏账,一次性撤资比硬扛划算。同一套乙烯-生长素开关还管着果实脱落与花瓣凋零——采后「催熟」用的正是同一条通路。拖「季节进度」看叶绿素撤退与变色,拖「乙烯/生长素比」看离层提前启动;按「季节进程」看整枝换装,按「离层特写」看细胞壁溶解,按「激素开关」看生长素断供,按「常绿对比」看冬季两本账。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Leaves falling in autumn is not withering - it is a hormone-timed organ-removal surgery scheduled weeks in advance. As days shorten and temperatures drop, the leaf first recycles: chlorophyll is dismantled, nitrogen and magnesium pulled back along the veins into the winter account kept in the branch, the yellow carotenoids underneath show through, and newly made red anthocyanins stack one more layer - autumn becomes the accounting season of leaves. The real switch is a hormone ratio: as long as the leaf keeps remitting auxin to the petiole, the abscission layer at its base stays silent. Once the auxin flow dries up, the sensitivity of abscission cells to ethylene skyrockets; ethylene drives them to secrete pectinase and cellulase, dissolving the middle lamella and cell walls bit by bit until only a few vascular bundles hold on. One gust and the leaf is gone; the wound is promptly sealed by suberized cells into a waterproof, germ-proof leaf scar. Why drop leaves at all? An evergreen leaf in winter faces three losing accounts - transpiration water loss exceeding photosynthetic gain, snow overload on the crown, frozen stomata - so a one-time withdrawal beats holding on. The same ethylene-auxin switch also governs fruit drop and petal fall: post-harvest ripening taps the very same pathway. Drag season progress to watch chlorophyll retreat and colors develop, drag ethylene/auxin ratio to trigger the abscission layer early; press season timeline for the full wardrobe change, abscission close-up to watch cell walls dissolve, hormone switch to cut the auxin flow, evergreen ledger for the two winter accounts. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 一根树枝带 7 片叶:季节推进时,绿色叶绿素粒子沿叶脉撤回枝干,叶片由绿转黄转红;叶柄基部离层环由绿转棕并闪白,三根维管束逐根断开;乙烯橙雾随比值升高,蓝色生长素箭头随之消退;阵风把成熟叶片吹落,断口浮现褐色叶痕;右侧常绿小枝挂着冬季收支账本。

topics.descZh:
溶酶体是细胞的回收车间兼胃:一群直径 0.1–0.5 μm 的单膜小泡(自噬溶酶体可胀到 1 μm 级),腔内 pH 4.5–5.0,而细胞质 pH≈7.2——氢离子浓度相差百倍以上,全细胞最危险的消化武器被关进这间酸洗车间。膜上嵌着一排 V 型质子泵(V-ATPase),烧 ATP 把 H⁺ 逆梯度泵进腔内,每水解 1 个 ATP 约泵入 2–3 个质子,氯通道同步放进 Cl⁻ 平衡电荷,泵才不被自己的正电压「憋住」。酸性一石二鸟:激活约 60 种酸性水解酶——组织蛋白酶剪蛋白、脂酶拆膜脂、核酸酶剪核酸、糖苷酶解糖链,活性在 pH≈4.8 登顶;又是安全阀:酶一旦漏进细胞质,中性 pH 让它们瞬间失活,只消化「车间」不消化全屋。酶不在溶酶体现做:内质网合成 → 高尔基体挂甘露糖-6-磷酸(M6P)标签 → M6P 受体在反面高尔基管网(TGN)捉进出芽囊泡 → 沿微管送到早期内体,pH 一降酶-受体分离,受体回炉再用;标签缺失即成 I-细胞病(黏脂贮积症Ⅱ型),酶被错分泌到胞外,细胞堆满未消化包涵体。进货三条路:吞噬包来细菌等大颗粒,受体介导内吞送来 LDL 与信号分子,自噬用双膜自噬体裹住受损线粒体与蛋白聚集体再与溶酶体合流;底物最终降解为氨基酸、单糖、脂肪酸,由跨膜转运体回收,几乎不留废料。膜靠腔侧糖萼自保——LAMP1 等高度糖基化膜蛋白像密集刷子挡住水解酶。任一水解酶缺失即成贮积症:Tay-Sachs 缺己糖胺酶 A,GM2 神经节苷脂堆在脑;Gaucher 缺葡萄糖脑苷脂酶;Niemann-Pick C1 的胆固醇外运通道 NPC1 失灵。氯喹升高腔内 pH 给溶酶体「降速」,是经典药物靶点;堵车时转录因子 TFEB 入核,一把上调全部溶酶体与自噬基因。拖「腔内 pH」看酶活性钟形曲线起落,拖「ATP 供给」看停供后 pH 回升、酶集体失活;按「质子泵供酸」「M6P 投递」「自噬合流」看三条主线,按「贮积故障」看酶缺失的堆积灾难。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 细胞质舞台中央是一颗剖视溶酶体:半透明单膜镶着蓝色 V-ATPase 马达,青色 H⁺ 粒子被泵入腔内,琥珀色水解酶粒子随 pH 点亮并咀嚼腔内废弃线粒体;高尔基堆出芽 M6P 酶囊泡沿微管投递、受体小泡空车返回;双膜自噬体从两侧合拢包住闪红的受损线粒体后与溶酶体合流,绿色氨基酸粒子四散回收;故障模式里酶粒变灰、黄色底物越堆越多、溶酶体胀大并亮起红色警示。
topics.descEn:
The lysosome is the cell's recycling plant and stomach: a population of single-membrane vesicles 0.1-0.5 μm across (autolysosomes can swell to the 1 μm class) whose lumen sits at pH 4.5-5.0 while the cytosol rests near 7.2 - barely two pH units apart, yet a hundred-fold gap in hydrogen ion concentration, and the cell's most dangerous digestive arsenal is locked inside this acid-wash room. Where does the acid come from? The membrane carries a row of V-type proton pumps (V-ATPase) that burn ATP to force H+ into the lumen against the gradient, about 2-3 protons per ATP hydrolyzed, while chloride channels let Cl- follow to balance charge so the pumps never choke on their own positive voltage. Acidity kills two birds: it activates roughly 60 acid hydrolases - cathepsins shear proteins, lipases split membrane fats, nucleases snip nucleic acids, glycosidases unbolt sugar chains - with activity peaking near pH 4.8; it is also the safety valve, because if the membrane leaks and enzymes escape into the cytosol, neutral pH inactivates them almost instantly, digesting the workshop without digesting the house. The enzymes are not made on site: synthesized in the ER → tagged with mannose-6-phosphate (M6P) in the Golgi → caught by M6P receptors in the trans-Golgi network into budding vesicles → shipped along microtubules to early endosomes, where falling pH separates enzyme from receptor and the empty receptor recycles for another round. Lose the tag and you get I-cell disease (mucolipidosis II): enzymes are mis-secreted outside and the cell chokes on undigested inclusions. Cargo arrives by three routes: phagocytosis wraps bacteria and large particles whole; receptor-mediated endocytosis delivers LDL and signaling molecules via endosomes; autophagy encloses damaged mitochondria and protein aggregates in a double-membrane autophagosome that merges with the lysosome. All three roads end the same way: substrates are degraded into amino acids, monosaccharides and fatty acids, and membrane transporters recycle them back to the cytosol with almost nothing left over. Why doesn't the membrane digest itself? A thick glycocalyx of heavily glycosylated proteins such as LAMP1 stands like dense brush bristles against the enzymes. Knock out any one hydrolase and its substrate piles up into a storage disease: Tay-Sachs lacks hexosaminidase A and GM2 ganglioside accumulates in the brain; Gaucher lacks glucocerebrosidase; in Niemann-Pick C1 the NPC1 cholesterol export channel fails. Chloroquine slows the organelle by raising lumen pH - a classic drug target - and when traffic jams, the transcription factor TFEB enters the nucleus and upregulates the entire lysosomal and autophagy program at once. Drag lumen pH to ride the activity bell curve, drag ATP supply to watch pH creep back and the enzymes fall silent; press acid pumping, M6P delivery and autophagy fusion for the three main storylines, and storage disease for the pile-up disaster of a missing enzyme. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh:
食欲不是单纯的「胃空了」,而是一场双层谈判:下丘脑主导的稳态系统只问「能量够不够」,奖赏系统主导的享乐系统只问「想不想要」——甜品第二块与深夜外卖证明,后者经常赢。短期信号的主角是胃饥饿素 ghrelin:胃底黏膜细胞在餐前把分泌推上峰值,信号入血点亮下丘脑弓状核的 NPY/AgRP 神经元,下达「开吃」;进餐后 1 小时内骤降;它的节律还能被习惯训练——总在 12 点吃饭,身体 11 点半就开始爬峰,「到点就饿」是身体被调好的闹钟。食物入肠,级联反转:回肠结肠的 L 细胞分泌 GLP-1 与 PYY,十二指肠的 I 细胞分泌 CCK,胃牵张感受器经迷走神经实时上报,共同点亮 POMC/CART 的「饱」;GLP-1 顺手减缓胃排空、促进胰岛素分泌,但天然 GLP-1 半衰期只有 1–2 分钟(DPP-4 酶降解),于是药物被做成长效类似物——司美格鲁肽半衰期约 1 周,临床试验减重 15–20%。长期账本归脂肪细胞:瘦素 leptin 的分泌量与体脂率成正比,随血流向大脑报告「库存充足」,一边抑制 NPY/AgRP、一边激活 POMC/CART;1994 年 ob 基因被克隆,先天缺瘦素的小鼠暴食肥胖、注射即愈——可普通肥胖者瘦素很高却「听不见」:血脑屏障转运饱和、内质网应激,瘦素抵抗让负反馈失灵。激素账本对生活方式极敏感:一晚睡眠不足,ghrelin 升约 15–20%、leptin 降约 15%,第二天平均多吃约 300–500 kcal。所有信号最终在弓状核汇总,臂旁核与孤束核处理内脏情报,腹侧被盖区的多巴胺管「想吃」;高糖高脂、随手可得的现代食物环境,正是为奖赏回路定制的——享乐一旦压过稳态,饱腹信号就被无视。拖「体脂率」「睡眠时长」重排激素账本;按「餐前饥饿」看胃的慢波蠕动与红粒爬峰,按「进餐级联」看肠道激素接力点亮蓝簇,按「脂库与瘦素」看金粒在血脑屏障门口被弹回,按「熬夜故障」看时钟飞转、食欲条冲破红线。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 剖视人体舞台:顶部大脑内嵌弓状核,绿 NPY/AgRP 与蓝 POMC/CART 两簇神经元对峙,旁有 VTA 奖赏核团、血脑屏障壳与昼夜时钟;左下胃袋慢波蠕动,小肠盘管挂 L/I 细胞,右侧脂库随体脂率胀缩。餐前模式胃收缩、红粒爬峰、绿簇点亮;进餐模式食物落胃、肠道喷出青紫绿激素、蓝簇点亮;脂库模式金粒瘦素流向大脑,体脂率高时被屏障弹回;熬夜模式天色变暗、时钟飞转、摄入冲破红线。
topics.descEn:
Hunger is not merely an empty stomach - it is a two-layer negotiation: the homeostatic layer in the hypothalamus asks 「is there enough」, while the hedonic layer of reward asks 「do I want it」 - and wanting usually wins. The short-term lead actor is ghrelin: fundic cells push secretion to a peak right before a meal, the signal lights the NPY/AgRP neurons of the arcuate nucleus and orders 「eat」; within an hour after the meal it crashes, and the rhythm is trainable - always eat at noon and the body starts climbing at half past eleven. When food enters the gut the cascade flips: L cells release GLP-1 and PYY, I cells release CCK, stomach stretch receptors report up the vagus nerve, and POMC/CART lights the 「full」 sign; GLP-1 also slows gastric emptying and boosts insulin, but natural GLP-1 lives only 1-2 minutes (cleaved by DPP-4), so drugs are built as long-acting analogues - semaglutide, half-life about a week, delivered 15-20% weight loss in trials. The long-term ledger belongs to fat cells: leptin scales with body-fat percentage and reports 「stores full」, braking NPY/AgRP and driving POMC/CART; the ob gene was cloned in 1994, leptin-deficient mice gorge into obesity and are cured by injection - yet in common obesity leptin is high and the brain stops listening: BBB transport saturates, ER stress blunts the signal, and the feedback loop fails. One short night raises ghrelin about 15-20%, drops leptin about 15%, and adds roughly 300-500 kcal of intake the next day. Drag body fat and sleep hours to rebalance the ledger; press pre-meal hunger for MMC waves and the red climb, meal cascade for the gut-hormone relay, fat and leptin to watch gold particles bounced at the barrier, sleep-debt fault to see the clock spin and appetite cross the red line. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视人体舞台:顶部大脑内嵌弓状核,绿 NPY/AgRP 与蓝 POMC/CART 两簇神经元对峙,旁有 VTA 奖赏核团、血脑屏障壳与昼夜时钟;左下胃袋慢波蠕动,小肠盘管挂 L/I 细胞,右侧脂库随体脂率胀缩。餐前模式胃收缩、红粒爬峰、绿簇点亮;进餐模式食物落胃、肠道喷出青紫绿激素、蓝簇点亮;脂库模式金粒瘦素流向大脑,体脂率高时被屏障弹回;熬夜模式天色变暗、时钟飞转、摄入冲破红线。

topics.descZh:
每年春秋,数十亿只候鸟沿着一条从未见过、也无从言传的航线,在繁殖地与越冬地之间往返:北极燕鸥一年飞约 7–9 万公里,30 年寿命累计足够绕月 3–4 个来回;斑尾塍鹬更是从阿拉斯加一口气飞 1.2 万公里到新西兰,连飞 11 天不落地、不进食,靠出发前囤积的体脂硬撑全程——平时鸟类体脂只有 5–10%,出发前会吃到 30–50%,斑尾塍鹬可近 55%,代谢率同时拉到静息的 8–10 倍。没有地图、没有 GPS,它们靠两层系统导航:罗盘层回答「往哪边飞」——太阳罗盘、星罗盘、磁罗盘三套并行互为备份;地图层回答「我在哪」——气味地图、磁异常强度、地标海岸线各出一路。太阳罗盘最吃钟:太阳每小时在天上走 15°,鸟必须用体内生物钟实时补偿方位角;实验把鸟的钟拨差 6 小时,罗盘就整整偏 90°,朝错误方向起飞——罗盘与钟的绑定由此坐实;阴天看不见太阳,它们还能读瑞利散射画在天空的偏振光 E 矢量。星罗盘靠学:靛彩鹀雏鸟在天文馆里盯着绕天极旋转的亮星群,自己推算出极点方向写进记忆;年轻时只看乱转假星的个体,终生罗盘混乱。磁感最神秘:一说视网膜隐花色素 CRY4 在蓝光下产生自旋相关自由基对,磁场微调反应速率,鸟「看见」的是磁倾角——不分南北极,像一张等倾线地图;一说喙与内耳的 Fe₃O₄ 磁铁矿微粒当磁力计;两者可能分工:倾角管方向、强度当地图。飞行高度多在 1–3 km 顺风层,斑头雁翻喜马拉雅可破 8000 m;V 字队形借前鸟翼尖上洗流省 10–20% 能量。而灯光正在撕碎航线:夜间迁徙的鸟被城市灯光吸引,绕光打转无法脱身(灯迷航),罗盘与星图同时失效,仅美国每年约 6 亿只鸟撞建筑死亡。路线另一半写在基因与印随里:幼鸟首飞无人带领也能方向正确,成年后回到出生地繁殖。拖「生物钟相位差」看罗盘被拨歪,拖「磁倾角」看磁场圆盘明暗;按「太阳罗盘」「星罗盘」「磁感之谜」逐层拆解导航,按「灯光迷航」看鸟群受困。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 半透明地球悬在星空里,发光迁徙弧线从北极圈内划到南极洲,纸鸟编队沿弧线飞行并拖出蓝色尾迹,黄海湿地等中途站闪着光点;太阳罗盘模式升起天穹,橙色太阳沿每小时 15° 的弧移动,补偿钟表盘同步旋转,时差滑杆让航向箭头当场偏出误差角;星罗盘模式穹顶星象绕极星旋转、绿色学习轨迹螺旋上升;磁感模式画出偶极磁场线、鸟喙磁铁矿微粒闪烁,屏幕边缘浮现明暗倾角圆盘;灯光迷航模式夜幕降临,城市橙光升起,鸟群绕光打转、受困比例攀升。
topics.descEn:
Twice a year, billions of migratory birds set off along routes they have never seen and cannot be taught. An Arctic tern logs roughly 70,000-90,000 km a year between Arctic breeding grounds and Antarctic seas; over a 30-year lifetime that adds up to 3-4 round trips to the Moon. The bar-tailed godwit does something starker: 12,000 km from Alaska to New Zealand in one nonstop flight of 11 days, without landing, without eating, burning fat packed to nearly 55% of body weight - ordinary birds carry 5-10%, and before departure most species tank up to 30-50% while metabolic rate climbs to 8-10 times rest. With no map and no GPS, they navigate with a two-layer system: compasses answer which way to fly - sun compass, star compass, magnetic compass - while maps answer where am I - odor maps, magnetic-intensity charts, landmarks and coastlines. The sun compass needs a clock: the sun drifts 15 deg per hour, so the bird must compensate continuously with its internal clock; shift that clock by 6 hours and the compass errs by exactly 90 deg, as clock-shift experiments proved. On overcast days birds still read the polarization pattern that Rayleigh scattering paints across the sky. Star compasses are learned: indigo buntings raised in a planetarium memorize the center around which the bright stars turn; birds raised under fake chaotic skies stay lost for life. Magnetoreception is the deepest mystery: one hypothesis holds that cryptochrome CRY4 proteins in the retina form spin-correlated radical pairs under blue light, and the field tweaks their chemistry so the bird sees the magnetic inclination - a compass of dip angle, not of north or south, more like a map of equal-dip lines; the other points to Fe3O4 magnetite crystals in beak and inner ear acting as force meters; the two may divide the work - dip for direction, intensity for the map. Flight itself runs at physiological redline: cruise height sits in the 1-3 km tailwind layer, yet bar-headed geese cross the Himalayas above 8000 m, and a V formation trims 10-20% off the energy bill by riding the upwash off the bird ahead. And artificial light is shredding these routes: nocturnal migrants get trapped circling city glow with compass and star map failing together, and in the United States alone about 600 million birds a year die in building collisions. Part of the route is written in the genes - ringed first-year birds fly the right direction alone - and part is imprinting on the birthplace they return to year after year. Drag the clock offset to bend the compass, drag the dip angle to shade the magnetic disk; press sun compass, star compass, magnetoreception and light entrapment to tour each layer. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半透明地球悬在星空里,发光迁徙弧线从北极圈内划到南极洲,纸鸟编队沿弧线飞行并拖出蓝色尾迹,黄海湿地等中途站闪着光点;太阳罗盘模式升起天穹,橙色太阳沿每小时 15° 的弧移动,补偿钟表盘同步旋转,时差滑杆让航向箭头当场偏出误差角;星罗盘模式穹顶星象绕极星旋转、绿色学习轨迹螺旋上升;磁感模式画出偶极磁场线、鸟喙磁铁矿微粒闪烁,屏幕边缘浮现明暗倾角圆盘;灯光迷航模式夜幕降临,城市橙光升起,鸟群绕光打转、受困比例攀升。

topics.titleZh: 直流电动机 ⇄ 发电机
topics.descZh: 同一台机器的两种身份：通电受力转起来 / 摇把拖动点灯——换向器过中性面把电流翻个身
topics.descEn: One machine, two identities: current spins it, a crank lights the lamp — the commutator flips current at every neutral crossing

topics.descZh: 声音上不了天线,只能写在高频载波上:AM 把音频写进幅度,m>1 包络翻转失真;FM 写进频率,信息不在幅度里——闪电脉冲打来,AM 咔啦炸响,FM 限幅器削平照常播放;宽带宽(200 kHz 对 10 kHz)换来的就是这份干净。
topics.descEn: Audio can't ride an antenna, so it is written onto a carrier: AM writes it into amplitude (m>1 flips the envelope into distortion); FM writes it into frequency — lightning strikes, AM crackles, FM's limiter clips the noise and plays on; that cleanliness is what the wider 200 kHz channel buys over 10 kHz.

topics.descZh: 交换作用让相邻自旋平行,亿万个微观小磁铁结成联邦:未磁化时各畴随机抵消,外场让畴壁移动、畴转向直到饱和;撤场剩下的秩序=剩磁——磁铁为什么是磁铁;回线面积=每周发热,窄回线当铁芯、宽回线当永磁;加热跨过居里点(铁 770 °C、钕铁硼 ~310 °C),热扰动当场瓦解一切。
topics.descEn: Exchange coupling aligns neighboring spins into a federation of microscopic magnets: unmagnetized domains cancel, an external field sweeps domain walls and rotates domains to saturation; the order left behind is remanence — why a magnet is a magnet; loop area is heat per cycle, narrow loops make core steel, wide loops make permanent magnets; cross the Curie point (iron 770 °C, NdFeB ~310 °C) and thermal noise tears it all down.

topics.descZh: 每平方厘米压着约 1 kg 空气——托里拆利倒置水银管只剩 760 mm,管顶是第一份人造真空,换成水要 10.33 m;海拔按标高 8.4 km 指数衰减,珠峰只剩 1/3、沸点降到 ~72 °C;马德堡半球 16 匹马拉不开——没有「吸力」,只有外面的大气在推。
topics.descEn: About 1 kg of air presses on every cm² — Torricelli's inverted tube holds just 760 mm of mercury with the first artificial vacuum above; water would need 10.33 m; pressure decays with a 8.4 km scale height — Everest keeps one third and water boils at ~72 °C; the Magdeburg hemispheres took 16 horses — there is no suction, only the atmosphere pushing in.

topics.titleZh: 量子纠缠与贝尔不等式
topics.descZh: 同角度测量完美反相关,单边却各自 50/50 纯随机——相关性只能在数据对齐后现形,永远传不了信息;贝尔问:若粒子出厂自带答案表,关联有个数学上限;CHSH 实测 S=2√2≈2.83 冲过经典界 2——宇宙不是局域实在的(2022 诺贝尔物理学奖)。
topics.descEn: Measure both sides at the same angle and results anti-correlate perfectly, yet each side alone is pure 50/50 noise — the correlation only shows up when the data are brought together, so no message ever travels; Bell asked what correlations are possible if particles carry answer sheets from the factory, and got a hard ceiling; CHSH experiments measure S=2√2≈2.83, past the classical bound of 2 — the universe is not locally real (2022 Nobel Prize).

topics.descZh: pV 图上的黄金圈:等温吸热、绝热膨胀,η = 1 − T꜀/Tₕ 实时可拖——所有热机的天花板
topics.descEn: The golden loop on a pV diagram: isothermal heat in, adiabatic expansion, η = 1 − T꜀/Tₕ live — the ceiling of every engine

topics.titleZh: 电磁感应 · 楞次定律
topics.descZh: 磁铁插拔线圈:e = −dΦ/dt,感应电流永远「反对」变化——来拒去留
topics.descEn: Push a magnet through a coil: e = −dΦ/dt, the induced current always opposes the change

topics.descZh: 波前被压扁与拉长;马赫 ≥ 1 时全部波前叠成马赫锥——音爆就在锥面扫过时
topics.descEn: Wavefronts squeezed and stretched; at Mach ≥ 1 they stack into a Mach cone — the boom is the cone sweeping by

topics.descZh: 椭圆、等时面积、T²∝a³——金橙扇形现场证明第二定律,近日点飞驰远日点漫步
topics.descEn: Ellipses, equal areas, T² ∝ a³ — the golden sector proves law 2 live: fast at perihelion, slow at aphelion

topics.descZh: 收臂 → I 变小 → ω 暴涨,L = Iω 纹丝不动——滑冰者、太空猫翻身、中子星坍缩,同一条定律
topics.descEn: Tuck in → I shrinks → ω soars while L = Iω never moves — skaters, falling cats and collapsing stars obey one law

topics.descZh: 重力矩与 L 垂直,放不倒陀螺、只让它横着走;拖慢自转,进动反而变快——自行车骑起来才稳
topics.descEn: Gravity's torque ⊥ L can't fell the gyro, only steer it sideways; slow the spin and precession speeds up

topics.descZh: 耗尽层这道自建闸门:正偏复合发光(LED)⇄反偏光照发电(太阳能电池)——一对互逆器件
topics.descEn: The self-built gate: forward bias glows (LED) ⇄ reverse bias + light generates (solar cell) — one inverse pair

topics.descZh: 膜只放 H⁺ 过、电子被逼走外电路做功,阴极合成水——不停加料的原电池,唯一产物是水
topics.descEn: The membrane passes only H⁺, forcing electrons through the load; water is the only exhaust — a cell you keep feeding

topics.descZh: 两缝波前织出明暗条纹,Δy=λL/d 实时可拖;量子模式一颗一颗长出条纹
topics.descEn: Two wavefronts weave fringes, Δy=λL/d live; quantum mode weaves them one photon at a time

topics.descZh: 两端固定的弦只留 λ=2L/n;基频相同、泛音配方不同,音色就不同
topics.descEn: A fixed string only hosts λ=2L/n; same fundamental, different recipe — different timbre

topics.descZh: E 矢量垂直于传播;栅栏只放一边,检偏转 θ 光强按 cos²θ 衰减——正交即黑
topics.descEn: E ⊥ travel; the fence passes one side; rotate the analyzer and intensity falls as cos²θ

topics.descZh: 越过 48.8° 临界角折射消失、全数折返——水面成镜,光纤奠基
topics.descEn: Past the 48.8° critical angle refraction vanishes — the surface turns mirror, fiber optics is born

topics.descZh: 150 颗分子撞活塞:压强=碰撞率,温度=平均动能,冻结一瞬看麦克斯韦分布
topics.descEn: 150 molecules pound a piston: pressure = hit rate, temperature = mean KE, freeze to see Maxwell

topics.descZh: 抽掉隔板自动混匀、时间反演也不分开——不是力,是均匀的排法压倒性多
topics.descEn: Pull the partition and gases mix, never un-mix — not force, just counting: mixed ways outnumber all

topics.descZh: 压缩冷凝节流蒸发,四通阀一换冷暖对调——COP>1:热是搬运的不是制造的
topics.descEn: Compress, condense, expand, evaporate; flip the valve for winter — COP>1 moves heat, never makes it

topics.descZh: 熔化与沸腾时温度打坐——潜热全拿去拆结构;能量曲线在走,温度曲线不动
topics.descEn: At melting and boiling the temperature meditates — latent heat tears the structure down

topics.descZh: 1728 颗核掷同一颗骰子:单个随机,群体走出精确指数——半衰期是统计的节拍
topics.descEn: 1728 nuclei roll identical dice: individuals random, the crowd walks an exact exponential

topics.descZh: 地幔对流是传送带:洋脊生壳、海沟销壳——地震带火山带全长在板块边界上
topics.descEn: Mantle convection is the conveyor: crust born at ridges, destroyed at trenches — quakes live on boundaries

topics.descZh: 短波畅通入射,地表长波被 CO₂ 截胡回辐射——同一太阳,金星 464°C、火星 −63°C
topics.descEn: Shortwave streams in, longwave is caught by CO₂ and beamed back: one sun, Venus 464°C, Mars −63°C

topics.descZh: 赤道上升、30° 下沉,科里奥利把南北风拧成信风——撒哈拉为什么长在 30°
topics.descEn: Rise at the equator, sink at 30°, Coriolis twists the winds into trades — why the Sahara sits at 30°

topics.descZh: 电荷分离、梯级先导摸黑下探、地面迎接、回击 3 万安培亮屏——避雷针是预定通道
topics.descEn: Charge separation, a stepped leader groping down, an upward answer, a 30 kA return stroke — the rod books it

topics.descZh: 磁层把太阳风导进两极,撞氧发绿 557.7nm、撞氮发红——原子的能级荧光灯
topics.descEn: The magnetosphere funnels solar wind to the poles; oxygen glows green, nitrogen red — atomic neon signs

topics.descZh: P 波先推、S 波后摇,时差算距离;三站圆弧一交点,震中无处逃
topics.descEn: P pushes first, S shakes later; the lag measures distance and three arcs pin the epicenter

topics.descZh: 硅多则粘、粘则憋压:夏威夷温柔溢流 vs 维苏威猛爆喷柱,一颗滑块切换两种命运
topics.descEn: More silica, more stick, more pressure: Hawaii flows gently, Vesuvius explodes — one slider, two fates

topics.descZh: 冷咸水在北大西洋下沉,深海千年爬一圈;注淡水停摆,北欧掉进冰窖
topics.descEn: Cold salty water sinks in the North Atlantic and crawls for a millennium; fresh melt stalls it — Europe freezes

topics.descZh: 湿气团爬坡绝热降温,摸到露点就凝在尘埃上成云;背风坡一片雨影沙漠
topics.descEn: A wet parcel climbs, cools adiabatically, condenses on dust at the dew point — and the lee side turns desert

topics.descZh: 偏心+轴倾+岁差三条曲线叠加成高纬夏日日照计——冰盖随游标进退,冰期就是算出来的
topics.descEn: Eccentricity, tilt and precession stack into a summer-insolation gauge — ice ages fall out of the arithmetic

topics.descZh: 化石碳库两百多年倒灌回大气:一半留天上、四分之一进海洋变酸——Keeling 曲线现场积分,净零后仍有惯性
topics.descEn: Fossil carbon poured back into the sky in two centuries: half stays aloft, a quarter sours the ocean — the Keeling curve integrated live, with inertia after net zero

topics.descZh: 信风一松,暖水东回、冷舌下沉:上升流断、渔场塌、雨带搬家——Bjerknes 正反馈一拖就到强厄尔尼诺,过冲成拉尼娜
topics.descEn: Slack the trades and warm water sloshes east, the cold tongue sinks: upwelling and fisheries collapse, rains relocate — the Bjerknes feedback runs to full El Niño, then overshoots into La Niña

topics.descZh: 90° 扭曲的向列相把偏振拧过正交偏振片;加电压分子立正、光被锁死——每个像素一扇百叶窗
topics.descEn: A 90°-twisted nematic rotates polarization through crossed polarizers; voltage stands the rods up and locks light out — one blind per pixel

topics.descZh: 三条特殊光线定位像;拖物距穿过 1f,实像⇄虚像翻转;眼睛=自动变焦的透镜
topics.descEn: Three special rays locate any image; cross 1f and real flips to virtual; the eye is an auto-zoom lens

topics.descZh: 泵浦反转+种子光子,谐振腔里滚雪球——相干光束从部分透射镜漏出
topics.descEn: Pump to inversion, seed the cascade — the cavity snowballs coherent light out of the coupler

topics.descZh: 变化的 E 生 B、变化的 B 生 E——自己喂养自己以光速奔跑;光只是家族一员
topics.descEn: Changing E makes B makes E — the wave feeds itself at light speed; light is family

topics.descZh: 驱动扫到固有频率,振幅暴涨;两支近频音叉叠加出慢包络——拍频=频率差
topics.descEn: Sweep the drive to resonance and amplitude explodes; two close forks weave a slow envelope

topics.descZh: 三组绕组织出旋转磁场,鼠笼被安培力拖着跑;断一相看启动失败——转差就是动力
topics.descEn: Three phases weave a rotating field that drags the cage; cut one phase and it just hums — slip is the push

topics.descZh: 铁芯磁通隔空传能,V₂=(N₂/N₁)·V₁;电压抬 10 倍、线损降 100 倍——拉到 12 kV 看导线烧红
topics.descEn: Flux crosses the core, V₂=(N₂/N₁)·V₁; ×10 voltage, ÷100 loss — drag to 12 kV and watch the wires glow

topics.descZh: 同一只动圈头:通电受力是喇叭,被声波推动生电是话筒——互逆器件第三对
topics.descEn: One moving-coil head: fed current it speaks, pushed by sound it listens — inverse pair No.3

topics.descZh: 空气芯变压器:耦合随偏移间隙衰减;扔一枚硬币看涡流把它烧红——FoD 停机
topics.descEn: An air-core transformer: coupling decays with offset; drop a coin and eddy currents cook it — FoD cuts off

topics.descZh: 线圈送磁通进锅底,涡流 I²R 就地发热——锅自己烧自己;铝锅涡流更大却热不起来
topics.descEn: Flux into the base, eddies heat it with I²R — the pot cooks itself; aluminum swirls harder yet stays cold

topics.descZh: 锈是一块短路了的原电池:电子走金属、离子走海水;焊上锌块,锌溶铁安
topics.descEn: Rust is a shorted galvanic cell: electrons through metal, ions through sea; zinc takes the beating

topics.descZh: 付电费把腐蚀倒过来放:阳极补液、Cu²⁺ 渡河、阴极长镀层——接反极性当场翻车
topics.descEn: Corrosion in reverse, paid for: the anode feeds, ions ferry, the coat grows — swap poles and it all undoes

topics.descZh: 一次裂变放出 2~3 个中子点燃下一代:1→3→9→27 的雪球,慢化剂与控制棒把 k 钉在 1
topics.descEn: Each fission frees 2–3 neutrons to ignite the next generation: a 1→3→9→27 snowball pinned at k=1 by moderator and control rods

topics.descZh: 水滴把白光色散成扇形,出射方向在 42°/51° 极值处堆积成虹;二次反射的霓色序反转,中间是暗带
topics.descEn: A raindrop fans white light into colors; exit rays pile up at the 42°/51° extrema — the secondary bow is reversed, with a dark band between

topics.descZh: 回波计时 ×c/2 得深度,换能器横扫把一个个脉冲拼成 B 超断面;多普勒频移测血流
topics.descEn: Echo time × c/2 gives depth; a sweeping transducer assembles pings into a B-mode cross-section; Doppler shift reads blood flow

topics.descZh: 过 Tc 库珀对相干凝聚,电阻精确归零;磁场被逐出体外,磁体被场梯度托起悬浮
topics.descEn: Below Tc, Cooper pairs condense and resistance hits exactly zero; the field is expelled and the magnet levitates

topics.descZh: 风切变抬出中气旋,上升气流拉伸旋涡——角动量守恒让半径收缩、转速暴涨;EF 等级只认破坏
topics.descEn: Shear lifts a mesocyclone; the updraft stretches it — angular momentum shrinks the radius and spins it up; the EF scale only reads damage

topics.descZh: 爬山的湿气团把雨下在迎风坡,干透的背风下沉回暖成焚风——同一座山,一边雨林一边沙漠
topics.descEn: A climbing air mass spends its rain windward; the bone-dry lee warms into a foehn — one mountain, rainforest and desert

topics.descZh: 暖海面蒸发是锅炉、凝结潜热是烟囱、科里奥利是飞轮——把海温拖过 26.5 °C,看散乱的扰动在 WISHE 正反馈里自组织成台风:眼墙收紧、气压骤降、风速暴涨;登陆即断燃料熄火
topics.descEn: The warm sea is the boiler, latent heat the chimney, Coriolis the flywheel — drag SST past 26.5 °C and watch a ragged disturbance spin itself into a typhoon; landfall cuts the fuel and it dies

topics.descZh: F=−kx 让质量在 T=2π√(m/k) 的节拍上往复,动能与势能每四分之一周期换手一次;相图上简谐是一枚绕能量环转圈的点——阻尼让它盘旋坠回原点,驱动扫过 ω₀ 时共振暴涨
topics.descEn: F = −kx makes a mass shuttle to the beat T = 2π√(m/k), trading kinetic and potential energy every quarter period; on the phase plane it is a point circling the energy ring — damping spirals it in, and resonance explodes at ω₀

topics.descZh: 在旋转的地球上「直线」是错觉:惯性系里笔直的路径在转台参考系被 a=2Ω×v 掰弯,北半球右偏、南半球左偏,偏转率 ∝ sinφ 随纬度增大;浴缸漩涡是谣言,气旋不是——向低压汇聚的气流被偏转成旋转,飓风因此都长成涡。
topics.descEn: On a spinning Earth, straight is an illusion: a path straight in the inertial frame bends as a=2Ω×v in the rotating one — rightward north, leftward south, ∝sinφ with latitude; the bathtub vortex is a myth, the cyclone is not — inflow toward low pressure is deflected into spin, and that is why hurricanes are vortices.

topics.descZh: 两种膨胀系数不同的金属焊成一片,受热就再也躺不平:黄铜 α=19、钢 α=12(×10⁻⁶/K),高 α 侧伸得更长,整片弯向钢侧,曲率 ∝ Δα·ΔT;卷成螺旋是烤箱温度计,装上触点就是温控开关与断路器的热脱扣——80 °C 弹开、60 °C 复位的滞回防抖。
topics.descEn: Two metals with different α welded into one strip can never lie flat when heated: brass α=19 vs steel α=12 (×10⁻⁶/K) bends it toward the steel, curvature ∝ Δα·ΔT; wound into a coil it reads oven temperatures, dressed with contacts it becomes the thermostat and the breaker's thermal trip — snap at 80 °C, reset at 60 °C, hysteresis kills chatter.

topics.descZh: 一颗 20 km/s 的陨石按 v² 记账:接触压缩把石英震成冲击石英;开挖阶段喷出物幕沿 45° 锥掀起,二次坑链洒出去;改造阶段坑壁坍成阶地、大坑中央回弹出峰——巴林杰 1.2 km、希克苏鲁伯 180 km,地球坑少只因风化在加班。
topics.descEn: A 20 km/s impactor spends energy ∝v²: contact-compression shocks quartz into high-pressure forms; excavation flips an ejecta curtain at 45°, scattering secondary crater chains; modification slumps walls into terraces and rebounds a central peak — Barringer 1.2 km, Chicxulub 180 km; Earth keeps erasing the evidence.

topics.descZh: 摆面只忠于惯性方向,转的是你脚下的地板——进动 15°×sin φ:巴黎 31.8 小时一圈、北极 24 小时、赤道永不;双视角看「地球在你脚下转」
topics.descEn: The swing plane stays loyal to inertia while the floor turns beneath it — precessing 15°×sin φ: 31.8 h a circle in Paris, 24 h at the pole, never on the equator; two frames reveal Earth spinning underfoot

topics.descZh: 直流⇄交流的翻译官:H 桥把直流翻成方波,SPWM 用 10 kHz 三角波量出正弦的脉宽,LC 把毛刺磨成干净正弦;整流模式同一座桥反向跑——一切充电器的芯
topics.descEn: The DC⇄AC translator: an H-bridge flips DC into a square wave, SPWM measures out sine-shaped pulse widths, an LC filter grinds them into a clean sine — and in rectifier mode the same bridge runs backward: the heart of every charger

topics.descZh: 一对 N/P 半导体腿身兼二职:烧底部则载流子往冷端跑、U=α·ΔT 点亮灯泡;通电流则电子空穴当热力搬运工抽热制冷——电流一反向冷热面几秒互换,只是 ZT≈1 让卡诺在嘲笑
topics.descEn: One pair of n/p legs with two jobs: heat the bottom and carriers flee to the cold end lighting a bulb; drive a current and they haul heat as porters — reverse it and hot/cold faces swap in seconds, humbled by Carnot at ZT≈1

topics.descZh: 同一块晶体两个方向:挤压让正负电荷中心错开、表面堆出 kV 级电压——打火机的火花就是晶体挨的那一拳;喂交流电压它又按同一系数 d 伸缩,把石英音叉切在 32768=2¹⁵ Hz 每秒一跳
topics.descEn: One crystal, two directions: squeezing splits the charge centers and piles kV-level voltage on its faces — a lighter's spark is the punch the crystal took — while AC makes it strain by the same coefficient d, ticking quartz at 32768 Hz

topics.titleZh: 瑞利散射:天空为什么是蓝的
topics.titleEn: Rayleigh Scattering: Why the Sky Is Blue
topics.descZh: 空气分子把阳光「弹」得到处都是,蓝光拿 4.4 倍优先券(σ∝1/λ⁴)——天空就是被弹进眼睛的阳光;太阳贴地时要穿过 29 倍大气,蓝在路上被抢光,只剩红橙满天;云走 Mie 路线不看波长,所以白
topics.descEn: Air molecules bounce sunlight every which way and blue holds a 4.4× priority ticket (σ∝1/λ⁴) — the sky is bounced sunlight; at sunset the beam crosses 29 atmospheres, blue is stripped en route and red survives; clouds scatter Mie-style, wavelength-blind, hence white

topics.titleZh: 薄膜干涉:肥皂泡的彩虹
topics.descZh: 一层膜两个反射面,顶面反射带 π 翻转:光程差 2nt·cosθ 合拍变亮、错半拍变暗——白光里三色各算各账,彩虹是「厚度地图」不是颜料;重力排液让顶部变薄变黑,马兰戈尼涡旋打旋转彩
topics.descEn: One film, two reflecting faces, and a π flip at the top: path difference 2nt·cosθ decides bright or dark — in white light each color keeps its own ledger, so the rainbow is a thickness map, not pigment; drainage thins the top to black while Marangoni swirls churn the colors

topics.titleEn: Glacier Flow: the Ice That Flows
topics.descZh: 冰是会屈服的固体:Glen 定律 ε̇=A·τ³,应力 ×10 变形 ×1000——表面快床底慢,像一条极慢的传送带;积累区降雪、消融区化水,冰舌停在拔河平衡点上;裂缝长在拉张处,身后留下冰碛,顺便把山谷刨成 U 形
topics.descEn: Ice is a solid that yields: Glen’s law ε̇ = A·τ³ means stress ×10 gives deformation ×1000 — fast on top, seized at the bed, a conveyor in slow motion; accumulation feeds, ablation melts, and the snout parks where the tug-of-war balances; crevasses open in tension, moraines trail behind, and the valley gets carved into a U

topics.descZh: 螺旋磁面把一亿度等离子体裹在环里,D-T 聚变 α 自加热、中子带能出墙;劳森三乘积差一点就熄火
topics.descEn: Helical flux surfaces wrap 100-million-K plasma; D-T alphas self-heat while neutrons carry power out — miss Lawson and it dies

topics.descZh: 能量不够就得回头?量子世界说不:粒子由波函数描述,撞上有限势垒时墙内不归零,只按 ψ∝e^(−κx) 指数衰减;墙薄到纳米级,另一侧仍有尾巴,粒子以 T≈e^(−2κa) 直穿过去。α 衰变、STM、闪存、太阳发光都在为这条指数买单。
topics.descEn: Not enough energy? Turn back — classically yes. A quantum particle is a wavefunction: inside a finite barrier it is not zero, just exponentially damped as ψ∝e^(−κx); through a nanometre-thin wall a tail survives and the particle passes with T≈e^(−2κa). Alpha decay, STM, flash memory and sunshine all pay this exponential bill.

topics.descZh: 氦-4 零点能太大,常压冻不住;2.17 K 之下部分原子集体落入同一量子态,液体分成有粘正常相与无粘超流相:超流微缝漏光、爬壁漏空烧杯、被温差顶成喷泉,旋转只能量子化涡丝,氦-3 要配对才超流。
topics.descEn: Helium-4's zero-point energy keeps it liquid to absolute zero; below 2.17 K a fraction of atoms collapses into one quantum state, splitting the liquid into a viscous normal part and a frictionless superfluid that superleaks, climbs out of its beaker as a Rollin film, erupts as a fountain, and rotates only as quantized vortices; He-3 must pair up first.

topics.descZh: 交流电在芯部感应出「对着干」的涡流(楞次),芯被掐灭,电流密度被挤进表面 δ=√(2ρ/ωμ) 薄层:铜 50 Hz 9.3 mm,1 MHz 仅 66 μm;交流电阻随 √f 上涨,对策是空心管、李兹线、镀银,电磁炉则反向利用它。
topics.descEn: AC current induces eddies in the core that fight the change (Lenz), choking it off; current density is squeezed into a surface layer of depth δ=√(2ρ/ωμ): 9.3 mm in copper at 50 Hz, a mere 66 μm at 1 MHz; AC resistance climbs as √f — hence hollow tubes, Litz wire and plating, while induction cooktops put it to work.

topics.descZh: 万物都按温度发光:普朗克谱、维恩位移 λmax=2898 μm·K/T、斯特藩-玻尔兹曼 σT⁴;烧铁 800 K 暗红、1500 K 炽白,人体发 9.3 μm 红外——热成像就是看见这段光谱的眼睛,CO₂ 截住的正是地表 10 μm 长波。
topics.descEn: Everything glows according to its temperature: Planck's spectrum, Wien's λmax=2898 μm·K/T, Stefan-Boltzmann σT⁴. Iron at 800 K glows dull red, at 1500 K white hot; your body emits 9.3 μm infrared — a thermal camera is just an eye for that band, the same band CO₂ intercepts from Earth.

topics.descZh: 光是一颗颗光子 E=hf:电子逃出金属先付功函数 W,频率不够再亮也没有电子;频率够了,多余的变成动能 K_max=hf−W,遏止电压量出来,直线斜率就是 h——太阳能电池与 CCD 都是它的后代。
topics.descEn: Light arrives as photons E=hf: an electron must pay the work function W to escape — below threshold, no brightness helps; above it, the surplus becomes K_max=hf−W, measured by the stopping voltage. The line's slope is h. Solar cells and CCDs are its descendants.

topics.descZh: 地下窄喉+深腔是天然锅炉:12 m 水柱把底压抬到 2.2 bar,沸点跟着涨到 ~121 °C 仍不沸;热流逼到过热点,一颗气泡顶起水柱、压强骤降,整柱过热水瞬间闪蒸 ×1500——白汽冲天;排空重灌,周期重启。
topics.descEn: A narrow throat over a deep chamber is nature's pressure cooker: a 12 m water column pushes the bottom to 2.2 bar, where water boils at ~121 °C — so it doesn't. Pushed past superheat, one bubble lifts the column, pressure collapses, and the whole superheated core flashes to steam ×1500. Eject, refill, repeat.

topics.descZh: 雨水卷着土壤 CO₂ 变弱酸,沿裂隙溶出洞厅;洞顶水滴逸出 CO₂,平衡左移析出钙华,长成钟乳石——快进十万年,看顶板塌成天坑。
topics.descEn: Rain steals soil CO₂, turns acid and carves chambers along the joints; ceiling drops outgas CO₂ and precipitate calcite into stalactites — fast-forward millennia to a sinkhole collapse.

topics.descZh: 卷云里的六棱柱冰晶把阳光折两次,偏向角在 21.8° 出现谷底,附近光线全堵在这里;随机翻滚拼出 22° 晕环,晶体躺平缩成幻日——内红外外,与彩虹相反。
topics.descEn: Cirrus prisms bend sunlight twice; deviation bottoms at 21.8° where rays pile up. Tumbling crystals paint the 22° ring, settled plates focus it into sundogs — red inside, blue out.

topics.descZh: 水中光速只有 0.75c;粒子越过它的瞬间,惠更斯波前相干成锥——光学的马赫锥,cosθ=1/(βn),蓝紫光谱点亮核水池。
topics.descEn: Light crawls at 0.75c in water; the instant a particle beats it, Huygens wavelets snap into a cone — an optical Mach cone, cosθ=1/(βn), its blue-violet glow lighting reactor pools.

topics.descZh: 水 4.2、陆地 0.8 kJ/(kg·K)——夏天大陆先热成低压,风从海上拖着雨进来;冬天整个掉头。孟买 6–9 月下掉全年九成的雨。
topics.descEn: Water stores 4.2 kJ/(kg·K), land barely 0.8 — summer overheats the continent into a low that drags rain in from the sea; winter flips it all. Mumbai takes ninety percent of its rain in four months.

topics.descZh: 颜色来自共生虫黄藻,光合供能九成;水温 +1.5 °C 排藻白化;CO₂ 溶海生 H⁺ 吃掉 CO₃²⁻,Ω 从 4.0 跌向 3.3,造骨越来越难。
topics.descEn: The color is borrowed algae supplying 90% of the energy; +1.5 °C expels them and the reef bleaches; dissolved CO₂ makes H⁺ that eats carbonate, Ω sags 4.0→3.3, and building skeleton gets harder.

topics.descZh: 大气压下电子自由程太短,没加速到位就撞掉能量,灯点不亮;抽到几托,自由程拉长、电离雪崩自持——阴极辉光、法拉第暗区、正柱各就各位;氖发红、氩发紫、汞蒸气加荧光粉发白:颜色是原子的身份证,帕邢曲线上工作点一越线就「啪」地点亮。
topics.descEn: At atmospheric pressure an electron’s free path is too short — it dumps its energy before reaching ionization speed and the lamp stays dark; pump to a few torr, the path stretches, the avalanche sustains itself — cathode glow, Faraday dark space, positive column in place; neon glows red, argon violet, mercury plus phosphor white: color is the atom’s ID, and one step across the Paschen curve snaps the tube alive.

topics.titleZh: 全息 · 把相位刻进条纹
topics.descZh: 照片只记亮度、把相位全扔了,所以没有深度;全息用参考光与物光干涉,把相位编成微米条纹刻进乳剂;重建时条纹当光栅,把原始波前原样衍射回来——遮住半张干板,像不缺一半,只是从更窄的窗口里看。
topics.descEn: A photograph records only brightness and throws phase away — no depth; a hologram interferes a reference beam with object light, encoding phase as micron fringes in the emulsion; at replay the fringes act as a grating and diffract the original wavefront back — cover half the plate and the image loses nothing but viewing angle.

topics.descZh: 吸一个紫外光子跳上激发态,抖掉一点热、把余下的以更长波长还回去——纳秒完成的叫荧光,关灯即灭;有些电子拐进自旋禁戒的三重态,窄门慢出,秒级到小时级的余辉叫磷光——夜光表靠它亮过整夜;关灯一瞬:荧光死、磷光留。
topics.descEn: Absorb a UV photon, jump up, shed a little heat and return the rest at a longer wavelength — done in nanoseconds that’s fluorescence, dark the instant the lamp dies; some electrons detour through the spin-forbidden triplet, a narrow slow exit measured in seconds to hours — phosphorescence, the afterglow that carries a watch dial through the night; kill the light: fluorescence dies, phosphorescence lingers.

topics.descZh: 竖直磁场把质子弯成圆,窄缝射频电场每半圈踢一脚、每圈增能 2qV;因 f=qB/(2πm) 与速度无关,B=1.5 T、100 kV 下 37 圈、真实 1.6 μs 加速到 6.8 MeV;相对论质量令频率掉队、滑相 90° 撞壁,同步加速器接棒。
topics.descEn: A vertical magnetic field bends protons in circles while the RF gap kicks twice per turn, adding 2qV each revolution; since f=qB/(2πm) ignores speed, at 1.5 T and 100 kV a proton reaches 6.8 MeV in 37 turns — 1.6 μs of real time. Relativistic mass makes it slip and crash, which is why synchrotrons took over.

topics.descZh: 中脊下方地幔上涌熔融,玄武岩以半速率(大西洋 ~2、东太平洋 8–10 cm/yr)向两侧退行;钛磁铁矿冷过 580 °C 居里点把地磁场方向锁进洋壳,地磁每 20–30 万年倒转一次,正反极性便拉成与中脊镜像对称的条带;1963 年 Vine–Matthews–Morley 用一条锯齿磁异常曲线同时证明扩张与倒转;洋底最老仅 ~1.85 亿年。
topics.descEn: Mantle upwells and melts beneath the ridge; basalt rides away at the half-rate. As titanomagnetite cools through its 580 °C Curie point the field direction is locked into the crust; with reversals every 200–300 kyr, mirror-symmetric polarity stripes form. In 1963 Vine–Matthews–Morley proved both spreading and reversals with one sawtooth profile — the oldest seafloor is only ~185 Myr.

topics.descZh: 平行光穿过一排等距狭缝,每个缝都是新波源;只有 d·sinθ=mλ 的方向上,几百个波前同相叠加成明亮主极大,其余方向彼此抵消——缝数 N 越多,主极大越细越亮,次极大被压没;白光展开成连续彩虹,二级光谱与一级重叠;CD 刻痕距 740 nm,本身就是反射光栅;光谱仪靠 R=mN 分开钠双线。
topics.descEn: Parallel light meets an array of equal slits, each a new wave source; only where d·sinθ=mλ do hundreds of wavefronts add in phase into a bright principal maximum — more slits mean sharper, brighter lines while secondaries drown; white light fans into a continuous rainbow with second order overlapping the first; a CD's 740 nm grooves make it a grating; R=mN splits the sodium doublet.

topics.descZh: 电流×磁场→洛伦兹力把载流子推向一侧，对面积累异号电荷→横向电压 V_H=IB/(nqt)；n 型（电子）V_H 为负，p 型（空穴）V_H 为正；无刷电机换向感知、ABS 轮速传感、电流钳的核心原理。
topics.descEn: Current×B-field → Lorentz force pushes carriers sideways, opposite face charges up → V_H=IB/(nqt); n-type (electrons) gives negative V_H, p-type (holes) positive; the core principle behind BLDC commutation sensing, ABS wheel-speed detection, and clamp ammeters.

topics.descZh: 视界附近虚粒子对生灭：负能粒子入内、正能粒子逸出成真实辐射；T_H∝1/M，质量越小温度越高；蒸发末期正反馈爆发——信息是否守恒至今是未解之谜。
topics.descEn: Virtual pairs near the horizon: the negative-energy partner falls in, the positive one escapes as real radiation; T_H∝1/M — smaller black holes are hotter; near the end, runaway evaporation produces a final burst — whether information is conserved remains unsolved.

topics.descZh: 高压气体被逼过多孔塞,没对外做功——焓不变;真实气体分子被拉开间距要付内位能,账单从动能扣:温度应声而落;常温下氮氧二氧化碳节流降温,氦氢反而升温——要预冷到反转温度以下(N₂ 621 K、H₂ 202 K、He 45 K);林德循环把空气液化到 −196 °C;理想气体 μ=0——效应是分子间力的指纹。
topics.descEn: Force a gas through a porous plug: no work is done, enthalpy stays put; real-gas molecules pulled apart pay potential energy out of kinetic — the temperature falls. N₂/O₂/CO₂ cool at room temperature while H₂ and He warm — pre-cool them below their inversion temperatures (N₂ 621 K, H₂ 202 K, He 45 K); the Linde cycle liquefies air at −196 °C; an ideal gas gives μ=0 — the effect is a fingerprint of intermolecular forces.

topics.titleZh: 断层弹性回跳与地震周期
topics.descZh: 断层弹性回跳 板块以每年几厘米持续推挤、断层被摩擦锁死,跨断层道路几十年弯成 S 形;应力越过断层强度瞬间整段错动几米＝地震,道路当场折断、地震波荡开;强断层大震稀疏、弱断层小震频繁,1906 旧金山错动约 6 米
topics.descEn: Elastic rebound & the seismic cycle: plates push a few cm per year while friction locks the fault, bending roads across it into S curves over decades; the instant stress passes fault strength, the whole segment slips meters — an earthquake: the road snaps, seismic waves ripple out; strong faults quake rarely and big, weak ones often and small — 1906 San Francisco slipped about 6 m.

topics.descZh: 摩擦与黏滑 真实接触只是微凸体点点的总和,面积小到名义面积万分之一、压强巨大发生冷焊;静摩擦＞动摩擦,弹簧攒力到峰值瞬间跳滑、拉力骤降再攒再跳——黏滑振荡就是地震的最小模型
topics.descEn: Friction & stick-slip: real contact is a scatter of asperity spots, about 1/10000 of nominal area, so the pressure cold-welds them; static friction beats kinetic, the spring winds up, breaks away and the force collapses — stick-slip is the tabletop model of earthquakes.

topics.descZh: 热传导与声子 固体不流动也能传热:晶格振动能量量子化成声子,从热端一颗颗接力散射跑向冷端,金属还多一条自由电子快递通道(所以摸着凉);傅里叶定律 q=−k·dT/dx,复合墙热阻串联、界面温度呈阶梯,泡沫锁住空气隔热
topics.descEn: Heat conduction & phonons: solids move heat without flowing — lattice vibrations quantize into phonons that relay and scatter from the hot end to the cold, and metals add a free-electron express lane (why they feel cold); Fourier's law q=−k·dT/dx, composite walls add thermal resistances in series so interface temperatures step down, and foam insulates by trapping air.

topics.descZh: 不确定性原理 ΔxΔp≥ħ/2 不是仪器精度问题而是波的本性:把波包压窄就要叠加更多波长、动量散开——缝越窄衍射扇摊得越宽;把电子压进核尺度,动能∝1/Δx² 暴涨顶住库仑吸引,原子因此不塌缩
topics.descEn: The uncertainty principle: ΔxΔp≥ħ/2 is wave nature, not clumsy instruments — squeezing a wave packet means superposing more wavelengths, so momentum spreads; narrow the slit and the diffraction fan widens; squeeze an electron to nuclear scale and its kinetic energy blows up as 1/Δx², holding the atom open.

topics.titleZh: 泡利不相容与元素周期表
topics.descZh: 泡利不相容与周期表 费米子不能共享同一量子态,每壳层只装 2n² 个电子,按能量逐个填壳、壳层结构周期重复——碱金属最外 1 个电子暴躁、稀有气体满壳慵懒,电离能与半径的锯齿曲线就是铁证;白矮星也靠它撑住
topics.descEn: Pauli exclusion & the periodic table: fermions never share a quantum state, each shell holds 2n² electrons, filled bottom-up and repeating periodically — alkali metals with one lone valence electron are fiery, noble gases with full shells are lazy, and the sawtooth ionization-energy curve is the proof; white dwarfs lean on the same principle.

topics.descZh: 应力应变与材料强度 σ-ε 曲线就是材料的传记:弹性区原子键当弹簧、卸载回零,屈服后位错滑移卸载回不去,颈缩-断裂收尾;脆性玻璃从弹性直接弹断,韧性钢靠大塑性区吸能——安全系数就住在弹性区里
topics.descEn: Stress, strain & strength: the σ-ε curve is a material's biography — bonds act as springs in the elastic zone and unload to zero, dislocations slip past yield so unloading never returns to zero, then necking and fracture; brittle glass snaps straight from elastic, ductile steel absorbs energy in its big plastic zone — and the safety factor lives in the elastic region.

topics.descZh: 等离子体把磁力线冻结在自己身上，光球对流把反向磁拱越压越近；电流片薄到临界，X 点处磁力线剪断重搭——磁张力像断弦一样把等离子体弹开，磁能一次转化为动能、热与高能粒子雨，这就是耀斑与日冕物质抛射；地球磁层白天侧重联装填磁尾，夜间侧释放点亮极光亚暴。
topics.descEn: Plasma freezes field lines to itself as convection drives antiparallel coronal loops together; when the current sheet thins past critical, lines cut and rejoin at the X-point — magnetic tension snaps like a broken string, converting stored energy into kinetic jets, heat, and particle rain: the flare and CME. In Earth's magnetosphere, dayside reconnection loads the tail; nightside release lights the auroral substorm.

topics.descZh: 叠加态 |ψ⟩=cos(θ/2)|↑⟩+e^{iφ}sin(θ/2)|↓⟩ 的两个幽灵箭头同时在场，概率就是系数的模方；单次测量随机坍缩到一个本征值，连发直方图当场累积出 cos²((θ−β)/2) 曲线，转动测量基分布跟着转；调高环境偷看率，干涉项被抹平——量子分布熔回经典混合，猫不再既死又活。
topics.descEn: In |ψ⟩=cos(θ/2)|↑⟩+e^{iφ}sin(θ/2)|↓⟩ both ghost arrows coexist and probability is |coefficient|². Single measurements collapse randomly, and a rapid-fire histogram builds the cos²((θ−β)/2) curve — rotate the basis and it rotates. Raise the eavesdropping rate, the interference term dies, and the quantum histogram melts into a classical mixture.

topics.descZh: 银原子束穿过非均匀磁场，经典物理预言屏上一条连续亮带——实测只有上下两个斑点：电子自旋只取「上/下」两个取向；过滤后的纯态再过同轴磁铁不再分裂，但插入一台 x 向磁铁，z 记忆被抹掉、两斑重现——测量即制备，一次测量只留一个答案。
topics.descEn: A silver beam crosses an inhomogeneous field; classically the screen should glow in one continuous band — it shows exactly two dots: spin has only up and down. Filtered pure states pass a second aligned magnet unsplit, but insert an x-oriented analyzer and the z memory is erased: two spots reappear — measurement prepares the state.

topics.descZh: 两块极板夹绝缘介质,C=ε₀κA/d:充电时介质分子被极化,束缚电荷部分抵消板间场,同电压塞下 κ 倍电荷;断电插入介质电压掉到 V₀/κ,带电插入则电荷补足 κ 倍;τ=RC 定充放快慢,电容快充快放却储能少,场强超耐受即击穿。
topics.descEn: Two plates sandwich an insulator, C=ε₀κA/d: the field polarises the dielectric and bound charges partially cancel the field, so the same voltage stores κ times more charge. Insert the slab with the battery off and the voltage sags to V₀/κ; battery on, and the charge tops up κ-fold. τ=RC sets the pace — capacitors charge and discharge fast but store little — and excess field sparks through.

topics.descZh: 雨水渗过包气带抵达潜水面,砂砾含水层像海绵储水;达西定律 v=K·i 驱动慢流,黏土 K 小万倍成隔水层;抽水拉出降落漏斗,超采让水位逐年下降、黏土压密致地面沉降;承压水头高于地表便自流井自喷,污染物顺流弥散数十年难净。
topics.descEn: Rain percolates through the vadose zone to the water table; sandy aquifers hold water like a sponge. Darcy's law v=K·i drives the slow crawl, and clay — ten thousand times tighter — seals aquitards. Pumping carves a cone of depression; overdraft drops the water table year by year and compacts clay into subsidence. Where the confined head tops the surface, artesian wells flow; contaminants creep and disperse for decades.

topics.descZh: 德布罗意 λ=h/p:电子也有波长,加速电压越高 λ 越短;一颗颗电子穿过双缝,屏上落点随机,斑点却渐渐累积出 cos² 条纹——概率波的统计显影;换多晶薄膜得同心衍射环,which-path 探测一开条纹立即消失;电镜正是用短波长看清原子。
topics.descEn: de Broglie: λ=h/p — electrons have wavelengths, shorter at higher accelerating voltage. Electrons cross the double slit one at a time; each landing is random, yet the dots accumulate into cos² fringes — statistics make the probability wave visible. A polycrystalline foil yields concentric rings; switch on which-path detection and the fringes vanish instantly. Electron microscopes spend exactly this short wavelength to see atoms.

topics.descZh: 一束光被分束器劈成两半，一半走向参考镜、一半走向待测镜，回来叠加：待测镜每移动 λ/2，两臂光程差变化 λ，条纹明暗循环一次——数条纹就是数半波长，红光下每条纹 316 nm；LIGO 把臂拉到 4 km，量出千分之一质子直径的引力波颤动。
topics.descEn: A splitter cuts one beam in two — one half to a reference mirror, one to the moving mirror — and recombines them: each λ/2 of travel cycles the fringes once, so counting fringes is counting half-wavelengths, 316 nm per fringe in red light; LIGO stretches the arms to 4 km to feel a wobble a thousandth of a proton wide.

topics.descZh: 外电场一压上来，导体里的自由电子瞬间重排：正面堆负电荷、背面留正电荷，感应电荷自己的场与外场在笼内逐点相消——合场为零；闪电劈在汽车上人没事，不是轮胎的功劳，是金属壳的；微波炉门网的孔径远小于波长，同样挡得住。
topics.descEn: Apply an external field and the conductor's free electrons rearrange instantly — negatives pile on the near face, positives on the far — and the induced field cancels the external one point by point inside: net zero; lightning strikes a car and the occupant walks away thanks to the metal shell, not the tires; a microwave door mesh works the same way because its holes are far smaller than the wavelength.

topics.descZh: X 射线光子撞上近似自由的电子：交出一部分能量动量、被弹开 θ 角，波长变长 Δλ=(h/mₑc)(1−cosθ)——θ=90° 时恰为一个康普顿波长 2.43 pm；位移只看散射角、与材料无关，经典波理论给不出它：这是光子携带动量的直接证据。
topics.descEn: An X-ray photon strikes a nearly free electron, hands over part of its energy and momentum, and bounces off at angle θ with a longer wavelength, Δλ=(h/mₑc)(1−cosθ) — exactly one Compton wavelength of 2.43 pm at 90°; the shift depends only on angle, never on material, which wave theory cannot produce: direct proof that light carries momentum.

topics.descZh: 换能器和反射器把 40 kHz 的超声叠成驻波,声辐射压在节点处压出一个个势阱:小水滴被托进节点与重力平衡;间距每变半个波长节点数就变,失谐或液滴过大,当场掉落。
topics.descEn: Transducer and reflector fold 40 kHz ultrasound into a standing wave whose radiation pressure dents potential wells at each node: small droplets settle in and balance gravity; every half-wavelength of spacing change reshuffles the nodes, and detune or oversize a drop and it falls.

topics.descZh: 把铷原子激光冷却再蒸发冷却到 170 nK:热德布罗意波长追上原子间距的瞬间,一大群玻色子挤进同一个基态——速度分布的宽馒头峰上突然长出中央尖峰,一锅原子凝成一个波。
topics.descEn: Laser-cool then evaporatively-cool rubidium atoms to 170 nK: the moment the thermal de Broglie wavelength matches the atomic spacing, a mob of bosons collapses into one ground state — a sharp central peak rises out of the broad Maxwell hump, and the cloud becomes a single wave.

topics.descZh: 光子要变成物质得先攒够 1.022 MeV——两个电子的静质量,还必须在原子核旁边分出动量;正负电子相遇湮灭,吐出两个 511 keV 的光子背靠背飞走——PET 就是靠符合探测把这两条光画成线。
topics.descEn: A photon needs 1.022 MeV — two electron rest masses — to become matter, and a nucleus nearby to take up momentum; when electron and positron meet they annihilate into two 511 keV photons flying back-to-back — PET reconstructs images by catching those pairs in coincidence.

topics.descZh: 结合成核放出的能量就是消失的质量:碳-12 比自由核子轻 0.8%;比结合能在铁处登顶,轻核聚、重核裂都在往铁爬;湮灭 100% 兑付
topics.descEn: The binding energy released when nucleons merge is exactly the missing mass: carbon-12 is 0.8% lighter than its parts; binding per nucleon peaks at iron, so fusion and fission both climb toward it — annihilation alone pays out 100%

topics.descZh: 显微镜是衍射仪器:d=λ/2NA 划下分辨红线,两点像斑一粘连细节就糊;油浸把 NA 抬到 1.4、紫外把 λ 砍半,再往后只能换电子
topics.descEn: A microscope is a diffraction instrument: d=λ/2NA draws the resolution line, and detail blurs the moment two Airy disks touch; oil immersion lifts NA to 1.4, UV halves λ — past that, only electrons go smaller

topics.descZh: 振动铜板上的沙子自己排队:波腹抖得凶、波节纹丝不动,沙全被抖离波腹、汇入节线——每个固有频率锁出一副几何沙画
topics.descEn: Sand on a vibrating plate lines up by itself: antinodes shake hard, nodes stay still, and the sand migrates off the antinodes into the nodal lines — each natural frequency locks out one geometric painting

topics.descZh: 两样东西贴在一起,界面上的电荷就重新分配;再猛地扯开,一对异号电荷当场对峙:电压可以上万伏而电量少得可怜,一粒火花就把账结清
topics.descEn: Press two materials together and charge reshuffles at the interface; rip them apart and opposite charges stand facing each other: tens of thousands of volts yet pathetically little charge — one spark settles the account

topics.descZh: 电感是电流的飞轮:电流想变它就用反电动势顶回去;把充电电容接上电感,电场能和磁场能就荡起秋千,ω=1/√(LC)——全世界的收音机靠它选台
topics.descEn: An inductor is the flywheel of current: try to change it and the back-EMF pushes back; wire a charged capacitor to a coil and field energy swings between them at ω=1/√(LC) — every radio dial in the world tunes this way

topics.descZh: 电子/μ/τ 三种味并不是三种质量:味是质量本征态的叠加,一路飞行相位各走各的,探测器里撞见的味随距离周期变脸——太阳中微子失踪三分之二,答案就是这一手
topics.descEn: The three flavors are not three masses: flavor is a superposition of mass states whose phases drift apart in flight, so the flavor a detector catches cycles with distance — the missing two-thirds of solar neutrinos was this sleight of hand

topics.descZh: 磁场一推，原子能级按 m_j 劈成梯：一条谱线当场裂成 π 与 σ± 三重，偏振各归其位——裂距正比磁场，反过来量裂距就能称出太阳黑子的场强
topics.descEn: Apply a field and atomic levels split into an m_j ladder: one spectral line cracks into a π and σ± triplet, each with its own polarization — and since splitting scales with B, measuring it weighs the fields of sunspots.

topics.descZh: 激光打进样品，千万分之一的光子把一份振动量子留给分子、自己红移成 Stokes 线；频移只认化学键的振动、不认光源颜色——换波长峰不动、换分子峰搬家，这就是分子指纹
topics.descEn: Fire a laser in and one photon in tens of millions leaves a vibrational quantum with a molecule and returns red-shifted as a Stokes line. The shift reads the bond, not the laser: swap wavelength, peaks stay; swap molecule, they move — a fingerprint.

topics.descZh: 密闭电梯里你分不清引力与加速度：缆绳一断，苹果、秤与电梯同步坠落，秤读数当场归零——自由落体系局部就是惯性系；光路同样下弯，只有大箱里的潮汐差才露馅
topics.descEn: Inside a sealed elevator you cannot tell gravity from acceleration: cut the cable and apple, scale and cabin fall together, the scale zeroing out — a free-fall frame is locally inertial. Light bends the same; only tidal differences give the field away.

topics.descZh: 两只摆用弹簧耦合,再乱的动作都是两个「简正模」的叠加:同相模弹簧不受力、反相模弹簧使劲——单拉一只,能量就以拍频来回摆渡
topics.descEn: Two pendulums on a spring: however you start them, the motion is a sum of two normal modes — in-phase leaves the spring idle, antiphase leans on it; pluck just one and energy ferries back and forth at the beat frequency

topics.descZh: X 射线打进晶面族,相邻两层的反射差一段 2d·sinθ 的路:凑成整数波长就相长成亮斑——转动晶体扫峰位,面间距与原子排布当场交底;DNA 双螺旋就是这么照出来的
topics.descEn: X-rays enter a lattice and reflections from neighboring planes differ in path by 2d·sinθ: hit a whole wavelength and a bright spot forms — sweep the crystal, read the peak positions, and the interplanar spacing and atomic layout give themselves up; the DNA double helix was photographed exactly this way

topics.descZh: 皂膜不管线框什么形状,一律自动张成面积最小的曲面:三片膜相遇必成 120°、四线相聚必成四面体角——没有谁在优化,只是张力不许浪费
topics.descEn: Whatever the wire frame, a soap film snaps to the least-area surface: three sheets always meet at 120°, four lines at the tetrahedral angle — nobody is optimizing, tension simply refuses to waste itself

topics.descZh: 没有活塞没有曲轴:声波压缩气体时放热、稀疏时吸热,与换热器一配合,温差就把自己唱成声,声再驱动线性电机发电——热与声本是同一股分子的拥挤与疏散
topics.descEn: No pistons, no crankshaft: a sound wave compresses gas where it heats and rarefies where it cools, and with heat exchangers in step a temperature difference sings itself into sound — then the sound drives a linear alternator. Heat and sound are the same molecules crowding and spreading

topics.descZh: 折射率由结构而不是化学决定:把开口环与金属棒排成亚波长晶格,磁导率与介电常数可以同时为负——光沿「错误」一侧偏折,平板透镜突破衍射极限成像,隐身斗篷让波绕着走
topics.descEn: Refraction set by structure, not chemistry: arrange split rings and rods into a sub-wavelength lattice and permeability plus permittivity can both go negative — light bends the wrong way, a flat lens beats the diffraction limit, and a cloak routes waves around what they should have hit

topics.descZh: 两个铅球把扭丝拧转不到 0.01°:光的杠杆把这一丝偏转放大到肉眼可见——人类第一次「称」出地球的密度与引力常数 G,在地下室里摸到了太阳系的秤
topics.descEn: Two lead spheres twist a fiber by less than 0.01°: a beam of light levers that sliver into visibility — the first time anyone weighed the Earth and measured G, feeling the scale of the solar system from a garden shed

topics.descZh: 梁被压弯的一瞬,一侧在拉长、一侧在缩短,中间必有一层不伸不缩——中性轴;应力沿截面高度线性爬升,离中性轴越远责任越大,所以好材料要搬到远处上班:工字梁、箱梁、空心竹竿都是同一个搬家逻辑;跨度翻倍,挠度翻十六倍
