topics.descEn: Bend a beam and one side stretches while the other shortens, with one layer neither — the neutral axis; stress climbs linearly away from it, so the farthest fibers do the heavy lifting: I-beams, box girders and hollow bamboo all move material out to where the work is; double the span and deflection multiplies sixteen-fold

topics.descZh: 电压是推动、电流是流量、电阻是拦路:I=U/R 一句话立规矩;串联是一条独木桥——电流处处相同,电压按电阻分账;并联是多车道——电压人人相同,电流按电导分流,总电阻比最小的一支还小;家里电器并联的道理,圣诞灯串联一串全灭的悲剧,都是这本账
topics.descEn: Voltage pushes, current flows, resistance blocks: I=U/R sets the rule; series is one log bridge — the same current everywhere, voltage split by resistance; parallel is a multi-lane — the same voltage for all, current split by conductance, and the total resistance smaller than the smallest branch; why home appliances run in parallel and why one dead bulb kills a string of Christmas lights is the same ledger

topics.descZh: 水滴在荷叶上站成珠:微米乳突负责把水撑离叶面,纳米蜡晶负责让分子懒得贴上去——双重粗糙之下,接触角冲过 150°,水珠一滚就带走灰尘;自清洁不是叶子爱干净,是空气垫不许水铺床;一旦被压进缝隙浸了 Wenzel 态,再疏水的叶子也会湿身
topics.descEn: On a lotus leaf water stands in beads: micron papillae hold the drop off the surface, nanowax makes molecules too lazy to stick — under the double roughness the contact angle passes 150° and a rolling drop sweeps dust away; self-cleaning isn't tidiness, it's an air cushion refusing to make the water a bed; press the drop into the gaps — the Wenzel state — and even the lotus gets soaked

topics.descZh: 炮弹一出膛,运动拆成两条互不打扰的账:水平匀速直线、竖直匀加速,合起来是抛物线;射程 R=v²·sin2θ/g,45° 拿满分,θ 与 90°−θ 同射程;月球上飞得更远,空气阻力把弹道折成坠弧
topics.descEn: A shell’s motion splits into two independent ledgers: uniform horizontal drift, uniform vertical acceleration — together a parabola; range R=v²sin2θ/g peaks at 45°, θ and 90°−θ tie; on the Moon it flies farther, air drag folds the arc into an asymmetric plunge

topics.titleEn: Moment of Inertia & the Rolling Race
topics.descZh: 同质量同半径的球、圆柱、圆环一起放坡,永远球先到圆环垫底——胜负只看 I=kmr² 的 k:0.4、0.5、1.0;转动是能量的隐形税,a=g·sinθ/(1+k);质量半径全不重要,不滚的滑块不交税第一个冲线
topics.descEn: A sphere, cylinder and hoop of equal mass and radius race downhill: the sphere always wins, the hoop trails — only the k in I=kmr² matters: 0.4, 0.5, 1.0; rotation is a hidden energy tax, a=g·sinθ/(1+k); mass and radius are irrelevant, and the non-rolling block pays none and wins

topics.titleZh: 麦克斯韦–玻尔兹曼分布
topics.descZh: 碰撞把几百个分子的速度反复洗牌,平衡后分布却唯一:峰在最概然速度;升温不是平移而是尾巴指数拉长——化学住在尾巴里,越过活化能的那撮分子成事,+10 K 速率翻倍;轻分子同温整体更快,氢因此逃出地球
topics.descEn: Collisions shuffle hundreds of molecular speeds endlessly, yet equilibrium has one shape with a peak at the most probable speed; heating stretches the tail exponentially — chemistry lives in the tail beyond Ea, which is why +10 K doubles rates; lighter molecules run faster, so hydrogen leaks off Earth

topics.descZh: 光在冷空气中走得慢:热路面之上 n 随高度增大,光线连续弯向冷侧画成弧——蓝天的光被弯进眼里成了「水潭」,远方景物被冷海面抬上半空;月亮贴近地平线被压扁,也是同一笔折射账
topics.descEn: Light bends toward cold, dense air: over hot pavement n grows with height, rays curve into arcs, and skylight lands in your eye as a phantom pool; over cold sea distant objects ride lifted and doubled; the flattened low moon is the same refraction bill

topics.descZh: 两端固定的弦只肯驻下整数倍半波:基频定音高,泛音列各占一份幅度——同一音高,吉他和钢琴听起来两样,差别全在这张频谱指纹;拨弦点越靠桥高泛音越亮,拨在中点偶次全消
topics.descEn: A string fixed at both ends hums only whole half-wavelengths: the fundamental sets pitch, overtone amplitudes draw each instrument's spectral fingerprint; pluck near the bridge for bright highs, pluck the midpoint and even harmonics vanish

topics.titleZh: 希格斯机制与质量起源
topics.descZh: 真空里浸着非零的希格斯场:与之耦合的粒子穿行时被场拖拽,惯性就是质量 m=g·246 GeV;光子零耦合、恒速 c;W/Z 因此获得质量、电磁与弱力分家;敲一记场,涟漪就是 125 GeV 的希格斯玻色子
topics.descEn: The vacuum is soaked in a Higgs field: particles coupled to it are dragged as they move, and that inertia is mass m=g·246 GeV; photons couple zero and keep c; W/Z gain mass and the forces split; tap the field and the ripple is the 125 GeV Higgs boson

topics.descZh: 光是波,孔径边缘必然衍射:点源成像成爱里斑,分辨极限 θ=1.22λ/D——λ=550 nm 时 10 cm 口径 1.4″,口径翻倍极限减半;超过 ~2×D(mm) 的放大率只是把斑放大;干涉阵列用基线 B 拼出 D=B 的分辨本领
topics.descEn: Light is a wave, so every aperture diffracts: a point star images as an Airy disk and resolution stops at θ=1.22λ/D — 1.4″ for a 10 cm aperture at 550 nm; double the mirror, halve the limit; magnification past ~2×D(mm) only magnifies the blob; interferometry stakes baseline B out as one giant aperture

topics.descZh: 质子上上下、中子上下下,胶子弦把三个色荷夸克捆住:拉得越远力越大(~1 GeV/fm、张力≈14 吨),能量攒到 ~2 GeV 弦崩断、断口生出正反夸克对——夸克禁闭;极短距上渐近自由;质子 938 MeV 里夸克静质量只占 ~1%
topics.descEn: A proton is up-up-down, a neutron up-down-down, glued by gluon strings: pull and the force grows (~1 GeV/fm, ~14 tonnes of tension) until at ~2 GeV the string snaps and a quark–antiquark pair is born — confinement; at vanishing range the force weakens — asymptotic freedom; quark rest mass is ~1% of 938 MeV

topics.descZh: 光圈缩小、光锥变细、焦外弥散圆变小,可接受清晰范围拉长;f 值每小一档进光 ×2;景深 ~∝ N·s²/f²,超焦距对焦把远景也拉进景深;大光圈+长焦把背景化成奶油虚化,虚化圆直径 ∝ 光圈口径
topics.descEn: Stop down and each point's light cone narrows, blur circles shrink, the acceptably sharp span stretches; each f-stop doubles the light; DoF ~∝ N·s²/f², and the hyperfocal distance pulls infinity into focus; wide open with a long lens the background melts to cream — bokeh diameter scales with aperture

topics.descZh: 磁铁落进铜管:磁通变化→感生电动势→涡流,楞次定律令其反抗相对运动——F=k·v 涨到恰好等于 mg,20 g 磁铁以 0.35 m/s 匀速滑行;动能全烧成焦耳热,铜温 400 °C 时电阻率×2.5、末速近乎翻倍;开槽切断涡流回路当场落地——火车过山车无接触刹车,但 v=0 时 F=0、不能驻车
topics.descEn: A magnet dropped into a copper pipe changes flux → induced EMF → eddy currents that oppose the motion by Lenz's law; F=k·v grows until it equals mg, so 20 g glides at 0.35 m/s and re-accelerates on exit; the energy becomes Joule heat — at 400 °C resistivity ×2.5 and terminal speed nearly doubles; slots cut the loops and it slams down — contactless braking, yet F=0 at v=0 can never park you

topics.descZh: 中子里一个 d 夸克经弱作用翻成 u,放 W⁻ 裂成 e⁻+ν̄ₑ;若只有电子,守恒要求单一 156 keV,实测谱却 0→156 keV 连续——泡利 1930 请出第三者补平能量账本、费米立论、1956 捉到;N=N₀e^(−λt),碳-14 半衰期 5730 年测年;中微子截面 ~10⁻⁴⁴ cm²、穿地球如穿雾
topics.descEn: Inside a neutron a d quark flips to u via the weak force, emitting W⁻ which splits into e⁻ + ν̄ₑ; with only the electron, conservation would force a single 156 keV line — yet the spectrum runs 0→156 keV continuously; Pauli summoned the invisible third particle to close the ledger, Fermi formalized it, reactors caught it in 1956; neutrinos cross Earth like fog

topics.descZh: 人耳从 20 µPa 到 20 Pa 跨一百万倍压强,线性尺当场爆表、对数 L=20log₁₀(p/p₀) 一把尺量完;压强×2 只 +6 dB、点源距离×2 −6 dB、两个相同声源只 +3 dB;A 计权照人耳灵敏度压低低频:55 Hz 要 ~90 dB 才等于 1 kHz 的 40 dB;85 dB 长期暴露伤毛细胞、每 +3 dB 允许时间减半
topics.descEn: Hearing spans a million-fold pressure range — a linear scale pegs instantly while L=20log₁₀(p/p₀) fits it on one ruler; doubling pressure adds +6 dB, doubling distance −6 dB, two identical sources only +3 dB; A-weighting encodes the ear's 1–5 kHz peak; above 85 dB chronic exposure kills hair cells for good and every +3 dB halves the safe time

topics.descZh: 量子比特是 Bloch 球上一点,α|0⟩+β|1⟩;H 门造 50/50 叠加,CNOT 纠缠两比特 → n 比特携带 2ⁿ 个振幅;计算=精心设计的干涉:错路相消、对路相长,测量坍缩只留大概率答案;Grover 平方加速跑 π√N/4 次迭代;退相干与门错误(99–99.9%)是瓶颈,一个逻辑比特要上千物理比特
topics.descEn: A qubit is a point on the Bloch sphere, α|0⟩+β|1⟩. H makes a 50/50 superposition; CNOT entangles a pair — n qubits carry 2ⁿ amplitudes. Computing is engineered interference: wrong paths cancel, right paths add, and measurement collapses onto the amplified answer. Grover squares the search cost in π√N/4 rounds; decoherence and gate error (99-99.9%) are the bill — one logical qubit wants a thousand physical ones.

topics.descZh: 酒精蒸气扩散出过饱和层,带电粒子沿途电离气体分子,离子成了凝结核——雾迹 10 ms 内拉出;α 粒子粗直短(2–6 cm)、β 细而多弯、γ 只剩零星火花、宇宙线 μ 子贯穿全场;加磁场按 r=p/(qB) 读动量;源棒一点,满盘「下雪」
topics.descEn: Alcohol vapor diffuses into a supersaturated layer; charged particles ionize the gas and the ions seed droplets — tracks bloom within 10 ms. Alphas run thick, straight and short (2-6 cm); betas wind thin; gammas leave sparks; cosmic-ray muons cross the whole chamber. A magnetic field bends tracks by r=p/(qB) to read momentum. Light the source: snow falls.

topics.titleZh: 亥姆霍兹共振与倒相音箱
topics.descZh: 瓶腔空气是弹簧、瓶颈空气柱是质量:f=(c/2π)√(A/(V·L_eff)),500 mL 瓶吹出 ~130 Hz,加水音调升高;音箱倒相管是「人造瓶颈」:调到单元谐振之下,背面反相辐射在管内翻转 180° 与正面同相叠加,低频下潜延伸近一个倍频程;调谐点锥盆位移最小、倒相管出力;代价是 Fb 以下 24 dB/oct 加 17 m/s 风噪
topics.descEn: Cavity air is a spring, neck air a mass: f=(c/2π)√(A/(V·L_eff)) — a 500 mL bottle blows ~130 Hz, water raises the pitch. A bass-reflex port is the artificial bottleneck: tuned below the driver, rear radiation flips 180° in the tube and adds in phase, stretching bass nearly an octave. At Fb the cone barely moves while the port works; the price is 24 dB/oct below Fb and hiss past 17 m/s.

topics.titleZh: 泊松亮斑与菲涅尔衍射
topics.descZh: 圆盘影子正中央必有一点最亮:盘缘各点到轴上等光程,边缘次波同相叠加;菲涅尔数 F=a²/(λz)≈1 时亮斑最醒目,1.5 mm 盘、2 m 屏、532 nm 激光得 F≈2.1;亮斑半径≈0.38λz/a≈0.27 mm,中心强度≈85–100% 入射;半波带记账:盘挡住前 k≈F 个带,轴上振幅≈第 k+1 带之半,永不自消;对照圆孔中心 I=4sin²(πF/2) 随屏距明暗交替,F≈2 时正中反黑;推远屏 F≪1 则影子糊掉、亮斑淡出——1818 年泊松以此讥讽波动说,阿拉果当场做出实验
topics.descEn: The center of a disc's shadow must glow: every rim point is equidistant from the axis, so edge wavelets add in phase. The spot is most striking near Fresnel number F = a²/(λz) ≈ 1 — a 1.5 mm disc at 2 m under 532 nm light gives F ≈ 2.1, painting a spot of radius ≈ 0.38λz/a ≈ 0.27 mm that holds 85–100% of incident intensity. The disc blocks the first k ≈ F half-period zones, leaving the axis amplitude ≈ half of zone k+1, which never self-cancels; a matching aperture's center I = 4sin²(πF/2) flickers bright and dark with distance. In 1818 Poisson mocked wave theory with this 'absurd' spot — Arago produced it, and the wave theory won

topics.descZh: 电子只许待在角动量量子化的整数轨道上,rₙ=n²×0.0529 nm,能级 Eₙ=−13.6/n² eV;跃迁把落差一次打成一颗光子:3→2 付 1.89 eV=656.3 nm 红 Hα,4→2=486.1 nm 青,2→1 付 10.2 eV=121.6 nm 紫外;里德伯公式 1/λ=R(1/n₁²−1/n₂²)(R=1.097×10⁷ m⁻¹)一条不漏;电离需一次付清 13.6 eV;点能级梯箭头,看电子坠落、光子点亮光谱条
topics.descEn: Bohr's electron may only occupy orbits with integer angular momentum — rₙ = n²×0.0529 nm, Eₙ = −13.6/n² eV — and each downward jump pays its whole gap as one photon: 3→2 gives 1.89 eV = 656.3 nm red Hα, 4→2 gives 486.1 nm, 2→1 gives 10.2 eV = 121.6 nm UV. The Rydberg formula 1/λ = R(1/n₁²−1/n₂²), R = 1.097×10⁷ m⁻¹, catches every line, and ionization costs 13.6 eV in one payment. Click arrows on the energy ladder and watch the electron drop while a photon lights the screen in its own color

topics.descZh: 重流体压在轻流体上,界面任何微扰都按 γ²=A·k·g−σ·k³/ρ 指数生长,A=(ρ₂−ρ₁)/(ρ₂+ρ₁) 衡量反差,水/空气 A≈0.99;微扰每 0.33 s 振幅翻 2.7 倍;表面张力砍短波,最快生长波长 λ*≈2.9 cm;扰动卷成圆蘑菇冠与下插尖钉;翻成重下轻上则 γ²<0 只晃不长;超新星抛射、ICF 靶丸、蘑菇云、盐丘都是它;一键翻转容器,当场对照
topics.descEn: Heavy-over-light is a loaded spring: any interface ripple grows exponentially as γ² = A·k·g − σ·k³/ρ, with Atwood number A = (ρ₂−ρ₁)/(ρ₂+ρ₁) ≈ 0.99 for water/air, so amplitude multiplies by 2.7 every 0.33 s. Surface tension cuts off short waves — the fastest-growing wavelength is λ* ≈ 2.9 cm — and the ripple rolls up into round mushroom crowns and falling spikes. Flip to heavy-under-light and γ² < 0: it only sloshes; the same law shreds supernova shells and ICF capsules, and drives mushroom clouds and salt domes

topics.descZh: 电场线密度=场强;∮E·dA=Q_enc/ε₀:高斯球撑大 1 倍,面密度 ÷4、穿出的总通量不变——通量只数里面有几份电荷;均匀带电球壳内部精确为零,壳外等效点电荷,壳外电荷怎么晃壳内纹丝不动;线电荷 E=λ/(2πε₀r)(1 μC/m 在 1 cm 处 1.8×10⁶ V/m),无限平面 E=σ/(2ε₀) 与距离无关;导体静电平衡电荷全挤表面——法拉第笼
topics.descEn: Field-line density is field strength; ∮E·dA=Q_enc/ε₀ — double the Gaussian sphere and surface density quarters while total flux stays put, because flux counts only the charge inside. A uniformly charged shell is exactly zero inside, point-like outside, and an external charge wiggling around leaves the interior untouched. A line charge gives E=λ/(2πε₀r) (1 μC/m at 1 cm: 1.8×10⁶ V/m), an infinite plane E=σ/(2ε₀) regardless of distance; on a conductor charge crowds to the surface — the Faraday cage

topics.descZh: 单摆是规整的准周期世界;挂上第二根摆臂、把能量抬过门槛,轨迹开始乱舞——混沌不是随机:方程确定、能量守恒(RK4 漂移<0.1%),但初值误差按 δ(t)=δ₀·e^{λt} 放大,λ≈1.5 s⁻¹、每 0.46 s 翻一倍,10⁻⁶ rad 的起点差约 9 s 后长到 1 rad;低能量时仍是近周期运动——混沌有能量门槛;庞加莱截面:规则是闭合环,混沌是碎云
topics.descEn: A single pendulum is tidy and quasi-periodic; hang on a second arm, raise the energy past a threshold, and the motion turns wild — chaos is not randomness: the equations are exact and energy conserved (RK4 drift <0.1%), yet initial error grows as δ(t)=δ₀·e^{λt} with λ≈1.5 s⁻¹, doubling every 0.46 s; a 10⁻⁶ rad head start separates to 1 rad in ~9 s. At low energy the dance stays near-periodic — chaos has an energy gate. Poincaré sections: rings for regular, shred for chaotic

topics.titleZh: 卡西米尔效应与真空涨落
topics.descZh: 量子场论的真空是所有模式的零点振动(每模式 ½ħω);间距 d 的两块板间只容许 λ=2d/n 的驻波,板外模式连续——板间被"删掉"的模式更少,内外压差把板推向彼此:F/A=π²ħc/(240d⁴),d=1 μm→1.3 mPa、100 nm→13 Pa、10 nm→0.13 MPa≈1.3 atm,缩 100 倍距离压强大 1 亿倍;1997 年扭秤在 0.6–6 μm 实测、吻合到 5%;MEMS 微机件间距 <100 nm 被当场吸死(stiction)
topics.descEn: In quantum field theory the vacuum seethes with zero-point jitter (½ħω per mode); plates a distance d apart admit only standing waves λ=2d/n while outside the continuum is dense — the modes

topics.descZh: 方解石 n_o=1.658、n_e=1.486,Δn=0.17:一束光射入各向异性晶体,劈成遵守 Snell 的 o 光与随方向变的 e 光,透过 1 cm 晶体看书出现约 6° 分离的双像,沿光轴传播时双折射消失;石英 Δn=0.009,589 nm 的 λ/4 片仅厚 16 μm,把线偏振变圆偏振;受力塑料在偏振光下现彩色应力条纹。
topics.descEn: Calcite has n_o=1.658 and n_e=1.486, Δn=0.17: one beam entering an anisotropic crystal splits into an ordinary ray obeying Snell and an extraordinary ray whose index varies with direction; through 1 cm of calcite print shows a double image ~6° apart, and the effect vanishes along the optic axis. With quartz Δn=0.009 a λ/4 plate for 589 nm is only 16 μm thick, turning linear into circular polarization; stressed plastic reveals colorful stress fringes under polarized light.

topics.descZh: 红失谐对射激光靠多普勒频移「迎面」拦截原子:每吸收一个光子动量 ħk、减速 ~6 mm/s,自发辐射随机、平均无净推力;三轴六束形成速度依赖的黏滞力——光学黏胶,把铷-87 从 300 m/s 冷到多普勒极限 T_D≈146 μK,再经偏振梯度 ~3 μK、磁光阱与蒸发冷却到 ~100 nK,直至玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚。
topics.descEn: Red-detuned counter-propagating lasers ride the Doppler shift to head off oncoming atoms: each absorbed photon carries momentum ħk and slows the atom ~6 mm/s, while random spontaneous emission averages to no push. Six beams make a velocity-dependent drag — optical molasses — cooling rubidium-87 from 300 m/s to the ≈146 μK Doppler limit, then polarization-gradient ~3 μK, a MOT and evaporation down to ~100 nK, all the way to Bose-Einstein condensation.

topics.titleZh: 麦克斯韦妖与兰道尔原理
topics.descZh: 1867 年麦克斯韦设想小妖守门挑拣快慢分子,不费功便造出温差;1929 年 Szilard 指出每次开门需 1 bit 信息,恰换 kT·ln2 功;1961 年兰道尔证明擦除 1 bit 至少耗散 k_B·T·ln2≈2.87×10⁻²¹ J(300 K);1982 年 Bennett 证明擦除还账、第二定律保全,实验已逼近极限 0.003 kT。
topics.descEn: Maxwell's 1867 demon sorts fast from slow molecules at a trapdoor, raising a temperature gradient for free; Szilard (1929) showed each gate-opening costs 1 bit worth kT·ln2 of work; Landauer (1961) proved erasing one bit dumps at least k_B·T·ln2 ≈ 2.87×10⁻²¹ J at 300 K; Bennett (1982) balanced the books - the Second Law stands, and experiments reached within 0.003 kT of the limit.

topics.titleZh: 长度收缩与谷仓-杆佯谬
topics.descZh: 「多长」取决于「同时」:20 m 的杆以 0.866c(γ=2)冲进 10 m 谷仓——谷仓系里杆缩成 10 m,前后门同一时刻关上恰好装下;杆系里谷仓却缩成 5 m,20 m 根本放不下。解药是同时的相对性:t′=γ(t−βx/c²) 的 −βx 项让前门早关 17.3 m/c ≈ 57.8 ns,两套时序各自自洽,洛伦兹变换把它们衔接;μ 子看 10 km 大气缩成 ~1 km,加速器粒子束被纵向压扁 γ 倍。
topics.descEn: Length depends on simultaneity: a 20 m pole at 0.866c (γ=2) enters a 10 m barn — in the barn frame it contracts to exactly 10 m and both doors shut at the same instant; in the pole's frame the barn shrinks to 5 m and 20 m can never fit. The cure is the relativity of simultaneity: the −βx/c² term of t′ = γ(t − βx/c) makes the front door lead by 57.8 ns, keeping both ledgers self-consistent. Real world: muons see 10 km of air shrink to ~1 km.

topics.descZh: 一列波包是许多频率相近的正弦波叠加:波峰以相速度 c_p=ω/k 前进,包络(能量所在)却以群速度 c_g=dω/dk 前进——深水 ω=√(gk) 恰好 c_g=c_p/2,10 s 周期的浪 c_p≈15.6 m/s、c_g≈7.8 m/s,波峰从包络尾部出生、穿过中心、在头部消亡;色散还把波包拉宽拉矮,涌浪跨洋按周期分选:2000 km 外风暴的 20 s 长涌约 36 h 先到,10 s 涌约 71 h,6 s 碎浪约 5 天;真空光 ω=ck,c_g=c_p,波包永不变形
topics.descEn: A wave packet is the sum of many near-frequency sine waves: crests advance at the phase speed c_p=ω/k while the envelope carrying energy follows at the group speed c_g=dω/dk — deep water ω=√(gk) gives exactly c_g=c_p/2 (T=10 s: c_p≈15.6 m/s, c_g≈7.8 m/s), so crests are born at the packet's tail, sweep through and die at its head. Dispersion also stretches packets, sorting swell by period: from a storm 2000 km offshore, 20 s swell (~15.6 m/s) arrives in ~36 h, 10 s in ~71 h, 6 s chop in ~5 days. Vacuum light ω=ck is non-dispersive: c_g=c_p and the packet never deforms.

topics.titleZh: 布儒斯特角与偏振反射
topics.descZh: 反射光其实是界面分子偶极的「再辐射」:平行入射面的 p 分量在 tanθB=n₂/n₁(玻璃 56.3°,水 53.1°)时振荡轴恰好指向反射方向,偶极沿轴不辐射,p 归零,反射光只剩 s;此时反射线⊥折射线,但单面仍带走 ~15% 的 s(Rs≈14.8%),堆叠 10 面才近乎全偏振;偏振太阳镜用竖直透光轴滤水平眩光,吃的就是这个角的红利。
topics.descEn: Reflected light is re-radiated by molecular dipoles at the surface. At tanθB=n₂/n₁ (glass 56.3°, water 53.1°) the p dipole axis points straight down the reflected ray — a dipole radiates nothing along its axis, so p dies and the beam goes pure s; reflection ⊥ refraction. One surface still steals ~15% s (Rs≈14.8%); a 10-plate stack gets near-total polarization. Polarized sunglasses filter horizontal glare with exactly this dividend.

topics.descZh: 电荷一加速,远处场线就被扯出一道以光速 c 外传的横向皱褶——无线电波。半波偶极子(总长 λ/2)电流呈驻波、腹点在中心馈电口,谐振时输入阻抗 ~73 Ω 纯阻;方向图是甜甜圈:侧向最强 2.15 dBi、沿轴为零;近场每周期往复储能,远场以光速自持外行,分界 ~λ/2π;相邻波前间距恰一个波长——WiFi 2.4 GHz 半波仅 31 mm。
topics.descEn: Accelerate a charge and distant field lines tear out a transverse kink that races away at c — radio. A half-wave dipole (λ/2 total) carries a standing-wave current, antinode at the feed; at resonance the input impedance is ~73 Ω pure resistance. The pattern is a donut: 2.15 dBi broadside, null on axis. The near field sloshes energy each cycle, the far field detaches beyond ~λ/2π, and wavefronts sit exactly one wavelength apart — WiFi's half-wave is just 31 mm.

topics.descZh: ~32 kHz 驻波负压相把 R₀≈5 μm 的气泡核拉到 ~50 μm,正压相 Rayleigh 坍缩把泡壁加速到 >1.5 km/s(约水中声速),气体近绝热压缩到 ~10⁴ K、电离发光:每周期一个 ~150 ps 闪光,紫外占比不小;驻波势阱把泡锁在腔心,稳定发光数小时;能量密度聚焦 ~10¹²,而机理(激波加热/惰性气体电离复合)九十年未定论。
topics.descEn: The rarefaction half of a ~32 kHz standing wave stretches a bubble from R₀≈5 μm to ~50 μm; Rayleigh collapse then drives the wall past 1.5 km/s (about the sound speed in water), squeezing the gas to ~10⁴ K — hot enough to ionize and flash: one ~150 ps flash per cycle, rich in UV. The standing-wave trap pins the bubble for hours; energy density is focused ~10¹² — yet the mechanism (shock heating vs ionization-recombination) is still unsettled after ninety years.

topics.titleZh: 惯性约束聚变与靶丸内爆
topics.descZh: NIF 用 192 束激光(2.05 MJ、~4 ns)打进 1 cm 金黑腔,变成 ~300 eV 均匀 X 射线烤炉→毫米级 DT 冰靶丸表面以 ~350 km/s 烧蚀喷出,火箭方程反冲内核达 ~400 km/s→半径收敛 ~30×,密度升至固态千倍,ρR≥0.3 g/cm² 拦住 α→热点 ~1 亿 K,α 自热超过损耗即点火、燃烧波扫过冰层;2022-12-05 首次 Q>1:输出 3.15 MJ,靶增益 1.5;与托卡马克是同一目标的两条路。
topics.descEn: NIF fires 192 beams (2.05 MJ, ~4 ns) into a 1 cm gold hohlraum, re-radiated as a uniform ~300 eV X-ray oven; the DT ice capsule ablates at ~350 km/s and rocket recoil drives the core to ~400 km/s; radius converges ~30×, density hits ~1000× solid, ρR≥0.3 g/cm² traps the alphas; the ~100 MK hotspot ignites when α self-heating beats losses and the burn sweeps the fuel layer. Dec 5, 2022: first Q>1 — 3.15 MJ out, target gain 1.5. Tokamaks are the other road to the same goal.

topics.titleZh: 惠更斯同步与耦合振子
topics.descZh: 几只频率略异的节拍器放在能滚动的平台上:摆的反作用力推平台、平台的加速度又推回每只摆——耦合把频差一点点拉齐。Kuramoto:dθᵢ/dt=ωᵢ+(K/N)Σsin(θⱼ−θᵢ),临界耦合 K_c≈2σ,K<K_c 永发散、K>K_c 序参量 r 0→1;同相与反相(惠更斯 1665)是两个稳态——电网同频、萤火虫同闪、千禧桥人浪同一套数学。
topics.descEn: Metronomes with slightly different frequencies sit on a platform that can roll: each pendulum shoves the platform, the platform's acceleration feeds back to every pendulum — coupling that reels the frequency spread in. Kuramoto: dθᵢ/dt=ωᵢ+(K/N)Σsin(θⱼ−θᵢ); critical coupling K_c≈2σ — below it phases stay scattered, above it the order parameter r climbs to 1. In-phase and anti-phase (Huygens, 1665) are both stable states; grid frequency, firefly flashes and the Millennium Bridge wobble share the math.

topics.titleZh: 孤子与色散-非线性平衡
topics.descZh: Russell 1834 年在联合运河看到一座水丘跑了几英里:色散把波包拉宽、非线性把波峰挤陡,KdV 方程 u_t+6uu_x+u_xxx=0 的平衡点让波形定型为 sech² 孤子——宽度 ∝1/√A、速度 ∝(1+A/3)c₀(c₀=√(gh));高孤子追上低孤子,碰撞后各自毫发无损穿出、只挪相位(Zabusky-Kruskal 1965);海啸是线性长波,不是孤子。
topics.descEn: In 1834 Russell watched a single hump run miles down a Union Canal: dispersion spreads a wave packet while nonlinearity steepens crests, and the KdV balance u_t+6uu_x+u_xxx=0 locks the shape into a sech² soliton — width ∝1/√A, speed ∝(1+A/3)c₀ with c₀=√(gh). A tall soliton overtakes a short one and both emerge intact, shifted only in phase (Zabusky-Kruskal 1965). A tsunami, being a linear long wave, is not one.

topics.descZh: 光有动量——折射偏折把动量反冲传给微珠:均匀光束只剩散射力推着走,聚焦后梯度力把珠拉向光强极大处,轴向阱点在焦点略外(~λ/2);阱刚度 ~0.01-0.1 pN/nm、阱力 1-100 pN,恰好吊住细胞而不伤(Ashkin,2018 年诺贝尔奖);布朗抖动就是温度计;拖动分子马达,量出 8 nm 步幅。
topics.descEn: Light carries momentum, and refraction kicks an equal-and-opposite recoil onto a bead: a uniform beam only pushes (scattering force), but a focused beam adds a gradient force pulling the bead toward peak intensity, with the axial trap just past focus (~λ/2). Stiffness ~0.01-0.1 pN/nm, forces 1-100 pN — enough to hold a cell without harm (Ashkin, Nobel 2018). Brownian jitter reads as a thermometer; drag a kinesin and resolve its 8 nm steps.

topics.descZh: 强光下介质不再是线性弹簧:P=ε₀(χ⁽¹⁾E+χ⁽²⁾E²+…),E² 里藏着 2ω 项——但中心对称晶体 χ⁽²⁾=0 被禁,只有 KTP/KDP/BBO 这类非中心对称晶体行;想沿途同相叠加长大必须相位匹配(Δk=2k_ω−k_2ω=0),失配则每 ~10-20 μm 打回原形;绿激光笔=1064 nm 经 KTP 变 532 nm。
topics.descEn: Under intense light the medium stops being a linear spring: P=ε₀(χ⁽¹⁾E+χ⁽²⁾E²+…) hides a 2ω term in E² — forbidden (χ⁽²⁾=0) in centrosymmetric crystals, allowed in KTP/KDP/BBO. To grow along the crystal the harmonics must stay in step (phase matching, Δk=2k_ω−k_2ω=0); mismatch rolls the energy back every ~10-20 μm. A green laser pointer is 1064 nm frequency-doubled through KTP to 532 nm.

topics.titleZh: 缪子成像与金字塔透视
topics.descZh: 宇宙线在大气里造出 μ 子:本征寿命只有 2.2 μs,GeV 能量的时间膨胀却送它们穿过 10 km 大气,海平面每分钟每平方米落下 ~1 万颗;10-100 GeV 缪子能穿 1-10 m 岩石,各方向通量衰减就是密度投影——免费的深穿透 X 光;2017 年三组独立探测器在胡夫金字塔找出 ~30 m 的「大空腔」;散射成像还能给福岛燃料残渣定位。
topics.descEn: Cosmic rays breed muons in the atmosphere: proper lifetime 2.2 μs, yet GeV time dilation carries them through 10 km of air — ~10,000 per m² per minute at sea level. 10-100 GeV muons pierce 1-10 m of rock; directional flux loss is a density projection — a free, deep-penetrating X-ray. In 2017 three independent detectors found the ~30 m "Big Void" in Khufu's pyramid; scattering tomography now locates fuel debris at Fukushima.

topics.titleZh: 环形激光陀螺与萨格纳克效应
topics.titleEn: Ring Laser Gyro & the Sagnac Effect
topics.descZh: 旋转盘上顺、逆时针的光走的路程不同:环形激光腔的谐振频率随之劈裂 Δf=4A·Ω/(λP)——A=100 cm²、P=60 cm、633 nm 时每 °/h 换 0.51 Hz 拍频,地球自转就是 7.6 Hz;低速时背散射锁模出死区,机械抖动偏频(400 Hz)让它重新线性;三只正交环就是捷联惯导的心脏,导航级漂移 0.001-0.01°/h。
topics.descEn: On a rotating turntable the clockwise and counter-clockwise beams travel different paths: the ring laser cavity splits resonance by Δf=4A·Ω/(λP) — with A=100 cm², P=60 cm, 633 nm that is 0.51 Hz per °/h; Earth's spin alone reads 7.6 Hz. At low rates backscattering locks the modes into a dead band; mechanical dither (~400 Hz) restores linearity. Three orthogonal rings are the heart of a strapdown INS with 0.001-0.01°/h drift.

topics.titleZh: 稀释制冷机与毫开尔文
topics.descZh: 量子比特要 kT ≪ hν(4-8 GHz 对应 16-33 μeV),10 mK 时 kT 仅 0.86 μeV;唯一连续工作的 mK 制冷机靠 ³He/⁴He 在 0.87 K 以下分层:抽走稀相的 ³He,浓相原子越过相界面补充——界面就是蒸发液面,跨越要吸焓;蒸馏釜 0.7 K、混合室 10-20 mK,脉冲管 4 K 预冷,电缆衰减+热锚守住每一微瓦。
topics.descEn: A qubit needs kT ≪ hν (4-8 GHz is 16-33 μeV); at 10 mK, kT is just 0.86 μeV. The only continuous millikelvin refrigerator exploits ³He/⁴He phase separation below 0.87 K: pumping the dilute phase makes concentrated ³He cross the interface — an evaporation surface that costs enthalpy and cools. Still at 0.7 K, mixing chamber at 10-20 mK, pulse-tube precool to 4 K, attenuators and heat anchors guard every microwatt.

topics.descZh: 3-6 GeV 电子(γ~10⁴)在弯铁急转弯:相对论光行差把辐射锁进沿切线方向、半角仅 1/γ≈0.1 mrad 的窄锥,每圈扫亮各实验站;E_c=0.665·E²·B≈7-29 keV,波荡器把亮度再提 10⁸-10¹⁰,每圈损失 0.9-7 MeV 由射频腔补回;亮度 ~10²⁰,约为太阳表面 10⁹ 倍。
topics.descEn: 3-6 GeV electrons (γ~10⁴) whip around bending magnets: relativistic aberration locks the emission into a tangent cone of half-angle 1/γ≈0.1 mrad, sweeping every beamline each lap. Critical energy E_c=0.665·E²·B≈7-29 keV; undulators add 10⁸-10¹⁰ in brilliance; 0.9-7 MeV per lap is repaid by RF cavities; brilliance ~10²⁰, about 10⁹ times the Sun's surface.

topics.descZh: 1956 年前宇称被默认普遍守恒;θ-τ 之谜促使李政道、杨振宁重审:β 衰变从未被检验。吴健雄把 ⁶⁰Co 冷到 ~0.003 K 磁化定向:极化 ~60% 时两路 β 计数约 2:8——电子偏好逆自旋(左手性)出射,镜像过程在自然界不存在;1964 年 CP 也破坏。
topics.descEn: Before 1956 parity was assumed universally conserved; the θ-τ puzzle pushed Lee and Yang to re-examine the record: beta decay had never been tested. Wu Chien-Shiung cooled ⁶⁰Co to ~0.003 K and magnetized the nuclei: at ~60% polarization the two β directions counted roughly 2:8 — electrons prefer anti-spin (left-handed) emission, the mirror process does not exist in nature; CP fell in 1964.

topics.descZh: 铁磁体由磁畴组成:外场 H 推畴壁、转磁矩,B 永远慢半拍——画出的磁滞回线记下剩磁 Br 与矫顽力 Hc,回线面积就是每循环的损耗。软磁(硅钢 Hc 30-60 A/m)回线窄,做变压器铁芯;硬磁(钕铁硼 Hc 8×10⁵ A/m、(BH)max 320-400 kJ/m³)回线宽,做永磁;硬盘介质靠剩磁存 0 和 1;铁烧过 770 °C 居里点,热扰动拆掉磁序。
topics.descEn: Ferromagnets are made of domains: field H shoves walls and rotates moments, and B lags - the hysteresis loop records remanence Br and coercivity Hc, and the loop area is the loss per cycle. Soft magnets (silicon steel, Hc 30-60 A/m) loop narrow for transformer cores; hard magnets (NdFeB, Hc 8×10⁵ A/m, (BH)max 320-400 kJ/m³) loop wide for permanence; disk media store bits in remanence; past iron's 770 °C Curie point, heat tears the order apart.

topics.descZh: 玻璃折射率随波长变:蓝 486 nm 折得比红 656 nm 狠,单凸透镜蓝焦点近 1.5-2%,像面出现紫边;牛顿以为无解改推反射镜;1757 年 Dollond 用消色差双合:冕牌凸加火石凹,焦度相加而色散相消(φ₁/V₁+φ₂/V₂=0),两主波长共焦、残余二级光谱约 f/2000;APO 三片再收三线;利克 91 cm 折射镜因此背了 18 m 镜筒。
topics.descEn: Glass bends blue more than red: at 486 vs 656 nm a singlet focuses blue ~1.5-2% nearer and edges fringe violet; Newton thought it incurable and turned to mirrors; in 1757 Dollond paired crown convex with flint concave - powers add while dispersion cancels (φ₁/V₁+φ₂/V₂=0), bringing two wavelengths to one focus with secondary spectrum ~f/2000; an APO triplet pulls in the third; the 91 cm Lick refractor paid with an 18 m tube.

topics.descZh: 大气折射把地平线太阳抬升 ~0.5°(34′)且分层进行:蓝光比红光多折 ~1%,太阳成一叠彩盘(蓝上红下),红绿分离仅 20-30″;瑞利散射截走蓝光,日落最后 1-2 秒只剩一抹绿——绿闪;逆温把色散放大成绿光柱,高纬导管绿闪可达十几秒。
topics.descEn: Refraction lifts the horizon Sun by ~0.5° (34′), layer by layer: blue bends ~1% more than red, so the Sun is a stack of colored disks, blue above red, truly separated by only 20-30″. Rayleigh scattering strips the blue; the last 1-2 s of sunset leave a sliver of green — the green flash. An inversion magnifies it into a green pillar, and high-latitude ducted flashes can last past ten seconds.

topics.descZh: 针尖悬在样品上方 0.5-1 nm,隧穿电流 I ∝ V·exp(−2κs)(κ≈1 Å⁻¹)随间距每变 1 Å 变 ~7.4 倍——纵向分辨率 0.01 nm 的来源;压电扫描+恒流反馈画出原子地形,1986 年诺奖;35 个氙原子拼出 IBM。
topics.descEn: A tungsten tip hovers 0.5-1 nm above a sample; a tunneling current I ∝ V·exp(−2κs) changes ~7.4× per Å of gap - the origin of 0.01 nm vertical resolution. Piezo scanning plus current feedback maps atoms; Nobel 1986, and 35 Xe atoms spelled IBM in 1990.

topics.descZh: 二维电子气加垂直强磁场,能谱量子化成朗道能级:霍尔电阻 R_xy=h/(νe²) 精确钉在 25,812.807 Ω 的整数分之一上,R_xx 在平台处归零——与样品形状杂质无关,精度 10⁻⁹,1990 年起是电阻计量标准;分数态出现 e/3 准粒子。
topics.descEn: A 2D electron gas in a strong perpendicular field quantizes into Landau levels: the Hall resistance locks onto h/(νe²) - h/e²=25,812.807 Ω over an integer - while R_xx vanishes on plateaus, precise to 10⁻⁹ and the resistance standard since 1990; fractional states host e/3 quasiparticles.

topics.descZh: 垂直振动液面,加速度 Γ=a(2πf)²/g 超过阈值(硅油 ~2-3 g)时液面失稳,长出条纹→方块→六边形,响应频率恰为 f/2(次谐波),波长由 ω²=gk+(σ/ρ)k³ 解出;液滴被自己过去的波推着以 5-15 mm/s 行走,还能重演双缝散射。
topics.descEn: Vibrate a fluid vertically past Γ≈2-3 g and the surface destabilizes into stripes, squares and hexagons oscillating at half the drive frequency (a subharmonic parametric resonance); wavelength follows ω²=gk+(σ/ρ)k³. A bouncing droplet is steered by waves of its own past, walking at 5-15 mm/s and mimicking double-slit scattering.

topics.descZh: 氖灯变压器 5-15 kV 给 C1 充电,火花隙达空气击穿 ~3 MV/m 即导通;初级 LC 与千匝次级双谐振,每半拍 ~7 μs 泵入能量,V₂=V_gap·√(C1/C2) 放大 50-100 倍,顶环存到 200 kV-1 MV,表面场强超 30 kV/cm 时流光射出 0.5-3 m;火花隙过零熄弧,每秒打火 100-500 次,DRSSTC 用 IGBT 桥替代。
topics.descEn: A 5-15 kV neon transformer charges C1 until the spark gap hits air breakdown (~3 MV/m); the primary LC double-resonates with the ~1000-turn secondary, pumping energy across each ~7 μs half-beat; V₂=V_gap·√(C1/C2) amplifies 50-100x, the toroid stores 200 kV-1 MV, and past 30 kV/cm streamers lash out 0.5-3 m; the gap quenches at current zero, 100-500 breaks/s - DRSSTCs swap it for an IGBT bridge.

topics.descZh: 电容器组 MJ 级储能毫秒内注入 1-6 MA,轨间磁场与电流叉乘得安培力 F=½L'I²(L'≈0.4-0.6 μH/m):3 MA 约 2 MN,6 m 炮管把 3 kg 弹丸推到 2-3 km/s,炮内 ~5 ms、瞬时过载 ~10⁵ g;出膛电弧烧蚀轨面,单对轨寿命仅几发;化学发射药被气体膨胀 ~2 km/s 封顶,电磁把推进剂换成电流。
topics.descEn: An MJ-class capacitor bank injects 1-6 MA in milliseconds; the rail field crossed with current gives F=½L'I² (L'≈0.4-0.6 μH/m): 3 MA ≈ 2 MN, driving a 3 kg slug to 2-3 km/s in ~5 ms at ~10⁵ g; the muzzle arc erodes the rails, a pair lasting a few shots; chemical propellant caps at ~2 km/s gas expansion - the railgun swaps propellant for current.

topics.descZh: 电晕线加 40-70 kV,线端场强超 30 kV/cm 电离空气,离子撞上尘粒荷电(>1 μm 电场荷电 ~10⁻¹⁴ C,<0.2 μm 靠扩散);带电尘以 w=qE/(3πμd)≈0.05-0.2 m/s 迁移上接地收尘板,振打锤敲板清灰入灰斗;德意希公式 η=1−exp(−wA/Q),燃煤电厂实绩 99.5-99.9%、压降仅 100-300 Pa;高比电阻灰 >10¹⁰ Ω·cm 反放电晕致效率崩塌。
topics.descEn: A 40-70 kV corona wire ionizes air past 30 kV/cm; ions charge the dust (>1 μm field-charged to ~10⁻¹⁴ C, <0.2 μm by diffusion); charged grains migrate at w=qE/(3πμd)≈0.05-0.2 m/s onto grounded plates, rapped into hoppers; Deutsch η=1−exp(−wA/Q) gives coal plants 99.5-99.9% at 100-300 Pa; ash above 10¹⁰ Ω·cm sparks back-corona and efficiency collapses.

topics.descZh: 中心钨丝 φ25-100 μm 对管壁加 400-900 V,充 Ar/Ne 加 10% 淬灭气:入射辐射只电离出 1-10 对离子,电子在近丝 10⁶ V/m 强场触发 Townsend 雪崩、紫外光子横扫全管,增益 10⁸-10¹⁰——脉冲幅度与初始电离无关,只数不测能;死时间 50-300 μs 靠淬灭气牺牲自己阻断连放,工作点钉在坪区。本质是把一个电子放大成一声「咔」。
topics.descEn: A grounded tube wall and a 25-100 um tungsten wire anode run at 400-900 V in Ar/Ne plus 10% quench gas: an incident beta or gamma ray frees only 1-10 ion pairs, yet each electron triggers a Townsend avalanche near the wire (~10^6 V/m) and UV photons sweep the whole tube - gain 10^8-10^10, so pulse height is independent of the initial ionization: it counts, never measures energy. The ion sheath's slow drift makes a 50-300 us dead time, and the quench gas dies to stop re-discharge. In essence: one electron amplified into one countable click.

topics.descZh: 底部电晕梳以针尖 ~10⁸ V/m 的强场把电荷喷上绝缘皮带,电机拖带 ~10 m/s 上行;球壳内 E=0(高斯定理),顶部梳齿无阻收电、电荷摊到外表面,电位以 ~MV/s 爬升,直到表面场强触到空气击穿 3 MV/m——V_max≈3×R;头发竖起是同号相斥的现场课,串列加速器用剥离膜把能量翻成 2qV。本质是让电荷搭电梯上楼。
topics.descEn: A corona comb sprays charge onto an insulating belt from needle tips at ~10^8 V/m; a motor runs the belt up at ~10 m/s, and inside the shell, where Gauss's law keeps E=0, a second comb collects it unopposed - charge spreads over the outer surface and the potential climbs at ~MV/s until the surface field reaches air breakdown at 3 MV/m, so V_max is about 3xR. Hair stands by like-charge repulsion; tandem accelerators double it to 2qV. In essence: an elevator for electric charge.

topics.descZh: 水下火花隙在椭球第一焦点 F1 爆出单周期冲击波:正压峰 40-80 MPa、脉宽 ~1 μs、尾随 −5 MPa 负压相;F1→壁→F2 处处等路径,波前同相汇聚到体内结石成 ~10 mm 焦斑,皮肤入口已扩散到 <0.2 MPa;压缩波在结石远端反射成拉伸——抗拉仅 0.2-0.5 MPa 的石头成片剥落,空化微射流(~100 m/s)继续侵蚀。本质是用椭球几何把爆点搬进体内。
topics.descEn: An underwater spark gap fires a single-cycle shock at F1, first focus of a brass ellipsoid: a 40-80 MPa peak ~1 us wide, trailed by -5 MPa of tension. Every path F1->wall->F2 is equal, so the front converges in phase onto the stone as a ~10 mm spot while the skin entry stays below 0.2 MPa. The compressive wave reflects at the stone's far side as tension - tensile strength is only 0.2-0.5 MPa - spalling it; cavitation microjets near 100 m/s erode the rest. In essence: geometry moves the blast into the body.

topics.descZh: 锁模激光器的等间隔脉冲串在频域必然是等间隔梳齿:f_n = n·f_rep + f_CEO,f-2f 自参考测出偏移量后,几十万根梳齿全部钉到原子钟上——单齿线宽 <1 Hz、不确定度 10⁻¹⁵ 以下,光钟、飞秒测距、系外行星视向速度都靠这把光学尺子(2005 年诺贝尔奖)。
topics.descEn: A mode-locked laser's evenly spaced pulses must transform into evenly spaced comb teeth: f_n = n·f_rep + f_CEO. Once f-2f self-referencing pins the offset, hundreds of thousands of teeth lock to the atomic clock - each line under 1 Hz wide, uncertainty below 10⁻¹⁵. Optical clocks, femtosecond ranging and exoplanet radial velocities all read from this optical ruler (2005 Nobel).

topics.descZh: 库珀对隧穿绝缘层,零电压也能流超流 I=Ic·sinφ;加上电压就按 f=2eV/h≈483.6 GHz/mV 振荡——这正是电压基准;两结并联成环,临界电流随磁通以 Φ₀=2.07×10⁻¹⁵ Wb 为周期干涉,磁通灵敏度 10⁻⁶ Φ₀/√Hz,足以读出脑磁的 10⁻¹⁵ T。
topics.descEn: Cooper pairs tunnel through a thin insulator and supercurrent flows at zero voltage, I=Ic·sinφ; apply voltage and it oscillates at f=2eV/h, 483.6 GHz per millivolt - the volt standard. Pair two junctions in a loop and critical current interferes with flux period Φ₀=2.07×10⁻¹⁵ Wb; at 10⁻⁶ Φ₀/√Hz a SQUID reads the brain's 10⁻¹⁵ T fields.

topics.descZh: 叠加态没有被谁打碎——环境光子一次次「偷看」,把相位信息抄进环境,密度矩阵非对角元按 e^(−t/τ_D) 衰减,叠加在微秒内自己变成经典混合;超导比特 τ_D 10-500 μs、离子阱达分钟级;量子纠错用上千个物理比特给一个逻辑比特续命。
topics.descEn: Nothing smashes a superposition - ambient photons keep peeking, copying phase into the environment, and the density matrix's off-diagonals decay as e^(−t/τ_D): the quantum state turns classical within microseconds. Superconducting qubits last 10-500 μs, trapped ions minutes; error correction spends a thousand physical qubits to buy one logical one time.

topics.descZh: 给光乘上一个相位因子 e^{iℓφ}:绕轴一周,相位积累 2πℓ——等相位面从平面拧成 ℓ 瓣螺旋;轴心处相位无定义,光必须在那里为零,光强剖面变成中心带暗核的「甜甜圈」。每个光子因此携带轨道角动量 ℓħ——与自旋角动量(圆偏振的 ±ħ)相互独立、可取任意整数,拓扑荷 ℓ 的正负决定螺旋手性。让涡旋光与平面波干涉,干涉图上出现分叉数恰为 |ℓ| 的叉形条纹——数叉纹就能「读出」拓扑荷。梯度力把微米粒子抓在亮环里,切向动量流再把粒子拧着转:一束光成了光扳手,转速可达百赫兹。应用随手一数:OAM 复用让一束光跑多路信道、STED 用环形暗点实现超分辨、涡旋日冕仪给系外行星遮星。
topics.descEn: Multiply light by a phase factor e^{i(l)phi}: one loop around the axis stacks up 2pi of phase times l, so the wavefront twists from a plane into an l-started helix. On the axis the phase is undefined, and the field must vanish there - the intensity becomes a donut with a dark core. Each photon now carries orbital angular momentum l*hbar, independent of spin angular momentum (+/-hbar of circular polarization) and unbounded in l; the sign of the topological charge sets the handedness. Interfere the vortex with a plane wave and the fringes fork exactly |l| times - count the forks and you have read the charge. Gradient forces trap micron beads on the bright ring, and tangential momentum flow spins them - a beam of light as an optical wrench, up to hundreds of Hz. Applications line up: OAM multiplexing, STED donut beams, vortex coronagraphs.

topics.titleEn: GMR & the Read Head: Resistance Stretched by Spin
topics.descZh: 1988 年,Fert 与 Grünberg 在铁/铬多层膜里发现:相邻铁磁层磁化反平行时,电阻比平行态高出最多 ~50%——传导电子的自旋决定它被哪些界面散射,这个效应被称为巨磁阻(GMR),两人因此分享 2007 年诺奖。把它做成「自旋阀」:钉扎层被反铁磁层交换偏置锁死,自由层随外场翻转;盘面记录位的磁化过渡区漏出杂散场,飞过仅 5-10 nm 高度的读头时把自由层磁化拽偏,电阻变化被传感电流读成 0/1。1997 年 GMR 磁头装机,面密度从 ~1 Gbit/in² 一路推过 100 Gbit/in²,后继的 TMR(MgO 隧穿结,2004+)做到 ~200-500%——数据中心的每一块硬盘,都在用「自旋当阀门」读世界。
topics.descEn: In 1988 Fert and Grunberg found that Fe/Cr multilayers with neighboring ferromagnetic layers antiparallel carry up to ~50% more resistance than the parallel state - conduction electrons are scattered by spin at the interfaces. The effect, giant magnetoresistance, won them the 2007 Nobel. Built into a

topics.titleEn: Faraday Rotation: A Magnetic Field Twists the Plane of Polarization
topics.descZh: 1845 年法拉第发现:线偏振光穿过磁场中的重火石玻璃,偏振面会转过 θ=V·B·L——人类第一次看到光与磁直接对话,1865 年它把法拉第引向电磁场理论。微观图像:磁场让介质中电子的左旋/右旋圆偏振模折射率分家(n₊≠n₋),线偏振是两束圆偏振的等幅叠加,速度不同、相位差累积,合成出的偏振面便拧过一角。最反直觉的是非互易性:旋转方向只由磁场决定,光被反射原路返回时继续同向转,往返合计 2θ 而非抵消——糖水这类自然旋光是互易的,往返恰好归零。把 θ 做成 45°,配两枚偏振片就是光隔离器:激光器的回光被挡在腔外,光纤通信每台激光器出口一枚;反过来,光纤绕上高压导线测 θ 可无接触测电流;太阳磁场成像、脉冲星信号穿过电离层的偏振旋转,用的也是同一条方程。
topics.descEn: In 1845 Faraday found that linearly polarized light crossing a magnetized flint-glass block has its plane of polarization rotated by theta = V·B·L - the first observed dialogue between light and magnetism, and the road that led to field theory. Microscopically, the magnetic field splits the refractive indices of the left- and right-handed circular modes (n+ differs from n-); linear polarization is an equal mix of the two, they race at different speeds, the phase gap accumulates, and the recombined plane has turned. The counter-intuitive core is non-reciprocity: the sense of rotation follows the field, not the ray - reflected light retracing the medium gains another theta, totaling 2theta instead of canceling, unlike the reciprocal rotation of sugar solution which undoes itself on the way back. Set theta to 45 degrees between two polarizers and you have an optical isolator shielding laser cavities from back-reflections - one sits at the output of every telecom laser diode. Run the same equation backwards for sensing: fiber loops on high-voltage lines measure current contact-free, solar magnetographs map active regions, and pulsar signals get their planes twisted by the ionosphere.

topics.titleEn: Photonic Crystals: Rules for Light Made of Periodicity, Not Pigment
topics.descZh: 肥皂泡的彩虹、甲虫的金属绿、欧泊的变彩、大蓝闪蝶的电蓝——这些颜色不来自任何色素,而来自亚波长尺度的折射率周期:光子晶体。布拉格条件 2d·sinθ=mλ 决定哪个波长被相干相消地反射出去,其余照常通过——被「开除」的波段形成光子带隙,好比半导体对电子的能隙。结构色有三大特征:色随视角变(彩虹色,角度一改 cosθ 就换波长)、饱和明亮(能量全进一条窄带而非靠吸收)、永不褪色(是结构不是化学)。天然欧泊是 200-300 nm 的 SiO₂ 小球按面心立方堆积;大蓝闪蝶靠树状脊的多层干涉选出 460 nm,再用 10-20% 的多尺度无序把角度依赖抹平,换来任意角度都成立的蓝。工程上,无毒结构色颜料、光子晶体光纤、永不褪色的汽车涂料与织物都已上路。
topics.descEn: Soap-bubble rainbows, metallic-green beetles, the play of color in opal, the electric blue of Morpho butterflies - none of these come from pigment. They come from refractive index patterned at sub-wavelength scale: photonic crystals. The Bragg condition 2d·sinθ=mλ picks which wavelength is coherently canceled out by reflection while the rest passes - the expelled band forms a photonic band gap, the optical twin of a semiconductor gap. Structural color has three signatures: it shifts with viewing angle (iridescence - tilt and cosθ swaps the chosen wavelength), it is saturated and bright (all the energy lands in one narrow band instead of being absorbed), and it never fades (geometry, not chemistry). Natural opal is 200-300 nm silica spheres stacked face-centered cubic; the Morpho butterfly uses tree-like ridge multilayers to select 460 nm, then flattens angle dependence with 10-20 percent multi-scale disorder so the blue holds from every view. Engineering is following: pigment-free colors, photonic-crystal fiber, never-fading coatings and textiles.

topics.titleEn: Photoelasticity: Making Stress Visible in Polarized Light
topics.descZh: 透明的受力材料会自己「报告」应力:1816 年 Brewster 发现,受力的玻璃在正交偏振片间显出彩色条纹——应力使折射率各向异性,主应力方向两个偏振分量的折射率之差正比于主应力差:n₁−n₂=C(σ₁−σ₂),环氧树脂 C 约 10⁻¹¹ m²/N 量级。线偏振光入射即分解成两支沿主应力方向的偏振模,速度不同,出射时累积相位差 δ=2πCt(σ₁−σ₂)/λ;过检偏器,相位差变成明暗干涉——等差线条纹就是主应力差的等值线,相邻条纹差一个材料条纹值 fσ=λ/(Ct),本页试件约 9.6 MPa/级,条纹越密,应力越凶。带孔板受拉,孔边应力是远场的 3 倍(Kt≈3,Kirsch 解):1954 年彗星客机两连坠,疲劳裂纹正起于窗开口角部,此后舷窗一律圆角;裂纹尖端的蝴蝶状条纹则能反推应力强度因子 KⅠ,是断裂力学的实验尺子。拖「载荷」滑杆,看孔边彩色条纹一圈圈生长——条纹最密处就是最危险点;拖「检偏角」在暗场亮场间切换;勾掉「白光」换单色光,数条纹定级。切四个预设看:无孔均匀、圆孔集中、裂纹尖端、钢化玻璃残余应力(边缘压应力,出厂必检)。
topics.descEn: A loaded transparent material reports its own stress: in 1816 Brewster noticed that squeezed glass shows colored bands between crossed polarizers - stress makes the refractive index anisotropic, and the index difference between the two polarization modes along the principal stress directions is proportional to the principal stress difference: n1 - n2 = C(s1 - s2), with C near 1e-11 m2/N for epoxy. Incoming linearly polarized light splits into two modes traveling at different speeds and re-emerges with a phase lag d = 2 pi C t (s1 - s2) / lambda; the analyzer converts that phase into bright and dark - the isochromatic fringes are contour lines of principal stress difference, spaced one material fringe value f = lambda/(C t) apart, about 9.6 MPa per fringe on this page. The denser the fringes, the fiercer the stress. A stretched plate with a hole carries 3 sigma at the hole edge (Kt ~ 3, the Kirsch solution): after the two 1954 Comet crashes, with fatigue cracks starting at window corners, aircraft windows have been rounded ever since; the butterfly fringes at a crack tip read back the stress intensity factor KI - the experimental ruler of fracture mechanics. Drag the load slider and watch colored fringes grow ring by ring at the hole - the densest ring marks the danger point; drag the analyzer angle to trade dark field for bright; untick white light to count fringes in monochrome. Four presets: uniform plate, hole concentration, crack tip, and tempered-glass residual stress (edge compression, a mandatory factory check).

topics.titleEn: Quantum Dots: Tuning Color by Size Alone
topics.descZh: 把同一块半导体(CdSe)切到 2 nm,它发蓝光(~480 nm);切到 6 nm,同一材料发红光(~650 nm)——颜色不靠化学成分,只靠尺寸,这就是量子点。原理是量子限域:激子(电子-空穴对)在 CdSe 里天然想摊开到玻尔半径 a_B≈5.6 nm;晶粒更小,电子就被关进三维深井,连续能带碎成分立能级,带隙随尺寸缩小而拉开(深井极限 E∝1/L²):粒径从 9 nm 缩到 2 nm,带隙从 ~1.8 抬到 ~2.6 eV,发射从深红扫到蓝紫。发射谱还极窄(半高宽 25-30 nm,比有机荧光分子窄 2-3 倍),吸收却连续——泵浦容易、颜色纯正。裸晶表面悬挂键会吃掉载流子,量子产额仅 15-30% 且闪烁;包上约 0.5 nm 的 ZnS 壳钝化后,QY 冲到 90% 以上、抗漂白。1993 年 Bawendi 胶体注入法让尺寸可量产,2023 年诺贝尔化学奖授予 Ekimov、Brus、Bawendi。今天它在你家电视里(QD 增强膜/QLED)、在生物标记里(比有机染料亮 10-20 倍)、在光伏下转换里。拖「粒径」滑杆看驻波舒展、光谱条当场移动,或按「尺寸巡游」从蓝游到红;开「核壳钝化」看闪烁当场停住。
topics.descEn: Cut the same semiconductor - CdSe - into a 2 nm grain and it glows blue (~480 nm); cut it to 6 nm and the very same material glows red (~650 nm). Color set by size alone: that is the quantum dot. The physics is quantum confinement. An electron-hole pair (exciton) in CdSe naturally spreads to the exciton Bohr radius, about 5.6 nm; a grain smaller than that cages the electron in a 3D deep well, continuous bands shatter into discrete levels, and the gap widens as the crystal shrinks (deep-well limit E proportional to 1/L^2): from 9 nm down to 2 nm the gap climbs from about 1.8 eV to about 2.6 eV, sweeping emission from deep red to violet-blue. Emission is also extremely narrow - a FWHM of 25-30 nm, two to three times tighter than organic dyes - while absorption stays broad: easy to pump, pure in color. Bare dots waste carriers on surface dangling bonds: quantum yield only 15-30%, with annoying blinking; cap the crystal with a ~0.5 nm ZnS shell and the yield jumps past 90%, with far better photostability. Bawendi s 1993 colloidal hot-injection made sizes mass-producible, and the 2023 Nobel Prize in Chemistry honored Ekimov, Brus and Bawendi. Today quantum dots sit in your TV (QD-enhanced films and QLED), in bio-imaging (10-20x brighter than organic dyes and resistant to bleaching) and in solar down-conversion. Drag the size slider to watch the standing wave stretch and the spectrum line slide, run the size tour from blue to red, or press core-shell passivation to watch blinking stop on the spot.

topics.titleEn: Impedance Matching: Why Wires Refuse to Cooperate at High Frequency
topics.descZh: 线长超过波长的 1/10,导线就是传输线。100 MHz 时 λ≈2 m(v_p≈0.66c),1 米视频线已是「长线」;Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz 下 3 cm 就够。电压电流沿线以波传播,分布电感 L′ 与电容 C′ 决定特性阻抗 Z₀=√(L′/C′)——同轴 50/75 Ω、双绞线约 100 Ω,只由几何与介质决定,与长度无关。波到达负载,只要 Z_L≠Z₀ 就有一部分折返:Γ=(Z_L−Z₀)/(Z_L+Z₀),短路 −1、开路 +1、匹配 0;入射与反射叠加成驻波:腹点电压最高到入射的 (1+|Γ|) 倍,纯驻波 2 倍,击穿打火都在这里;节点永远无信号。VSWR=(1+|Γ|)/(1−|Γ|) 给失配记账,天线馈电要求 1.5 以内;回波损耗 −20lg|Γ| dB,Γ=0.1 即 20 dB。巧解是 λ/4 变换器:插一段 Z_T=√(Z₀·Z_L) 的 λ/4 线,把负载折射成匹配,驻波当场塌平成行波,代价是窄带。天线馈电、射频功放、DDR 端接与 22-33 Ω 消振铃靠它;音频线(λ≈15000 km)完全不用担心。试一试:把「负载阻抗」拧离 50 Ω 看驻波立起;按「λ/4 变换器」看它塌平。
topics.descEn: A wire does not always cooperate: once its length exceeds a tenth of a wavelength it becomes a transmission line. At 100 MHz lambda is about 2 m (polyethylene fill, v_p about 0.66c), so a 1 m video cable is already long; at Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz, 3 cm is enough. Voltage and current then vary along the line, and the distributed inductance L' and capacitance C' set the characteristic impedance Z0 = sqrt(L'/C') - coax 50/75 ohm, twisted pair about 100 ohm - fixed by geometry and dielectric alone, independent of length. When the wave reaches the load, any Z_L different from Z0 sends part of the energy straight back: Gamma = (Z_L - Z0)/(Z_L + Z0), with short = -1, open = +1, match = 0. Incident plus reflected waves form a standing pattern: voltage peaks reach (1+|Gamma|) times the incident wave - twice for pure standing waves, where breakdown and arcing happen - while nodes never see any signal at all. Engineering keeps score with VSWR = (1+|Gamma|)/(1-|Gamma|), ideally under 1.5 for antenna feeds, and return loss of -20 lg|Gamma| dB (Gamma = 0.1 means 20 dB). The elegant fix is the quarter-wave transformer: insert a section with Z_T = sqrt(Z0*Z_L) and the load is refracted into a match - the standing wave collapses into a traveling wave, at the price of narrow bandwidth. All of this holds up antenna feeds, RF power amplifiers, DDR termination and the series 22-33 ohm resistors that kill ringing; audio cables (lambda about 15,000 km) never need to care. Try it: drag the load impedance away from 50 ohm and watch the standing wave rise; press the quarter-wave transformer and watch it flatten.

topics.titleZh: 菲涅尔透镜：把厚度拆掉的透镜
topics.titleEn: The Fresnel Lens: A Lens with the Bulk Removed
topics.descZh: 大口径厚透镜又重又吸光,自重还会压变形——1822 年 Fresnel 为灯塔给出解法:把透镜按同心环带切开,每环只保留折光所需的斜率,抽掉环与环之间「无用」的平行板块,光程等价而厚度从米级降到毫米级。一级灯塔透镜口径 1–3 m 却轻到能在水银浴上旋转,把灯火聚成 0.9° 闪束射到 30 km 外。代价藏在细部:环壁不导光只散射,刀口衍射给放大镜留下环纹,分辨率仍被刀口封顶;好处是每环可独立修面,球差逐环校正。今天 PIR 感应靠模压 HDPE 菲涅尔透镜把 9.5 μm 体热聚焦到热释电,投影电视与太阳能聚光同理。拖动「环带数」「透镜口径」看剖面与重量比变化;按「环带剖切」看厚透镜被同心切开、楔块飞走而焦点纹丝不动;再按「球差对照」「灯塔聚光」「PIR 红外聚焦」走进应用现场。3D 交互演示 · 拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A large-aperture thick lens is heavy, eats light and sags under its own weight - in 1822 Augustin Fresnel gave lighthouses the way out: slice the lens into concentric zones, keep in each zone only the slope needed to bend light, and delete the parallel slab between zones. Optical path stays equivalent while thickness drops from meters to millimeters: a first-order lighthouse lens spans 1-3 m yet floats on a mercury bath and turns, concentrating lamplight into a 0.9-degree flash carrying over 30 km. The price: ring walls only scatter, and each knife-edge diffracts light aside - the ring pattern on a magnifier is the direct evidence; resolution stays capped by those edges. Bonus: every ring can be refigured independently, fixing spherical aberration zone by zone. Today a molded HDPE Fresnel lens in each PIR sensor focuses 9.5-micron body heat onto a pyroelectric element; projection-TV screens and solar concentrators use the same trick. Drag the zone-count and aperture sliders; press Carve to watch the wedges fly while the focus holds still, then tour the aberration comparison, the sweeping lighthouse beam and the PIR focus. 3D interactive - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 焦耳桨轮：热与功的汇率
topics.titleEn: Joule's Paddle Wheel: The Exchange Rate between Heat and Work
topics.descZh: 1840 年代,焦耳用一套简单到极致的装置逼问自然:下坠的重物带动桨轮搅水,温度计读出水在升温——机械功精确地变成了热,1 cal = 4.186 J,焦耳当年反复测得 4.15–4.2。这一锤敲碎了「热质说」:热不是一种自流流体,而是能量的一种形式;摩擦与粘性耗散都是功→热的兑换窗口。对账很简单:m kg 重物下落 h 米做功 mgh,水升温 ΔT=mgh/(c·M)——可 1 kg 水从 77 m 瀑布落下也只升 0.18 °C,热功当量在自然里藏得极深,焦耳靠 Bunsen 温度计 0.003 °C 的读数毅力才把它抓出来。当量恒定意味着能量既不会凭空产生也不会凭空消失,1847 年亥姆霍兹据此立论能量守恒定律;今天刹车片、减震器、电水壶与每一处电阻发热,兑换的仍是同一条汇率。拖动「重物质量」「落差」「水量」,按「实验复现」看左右两张账本实时对平;按「瀑布对账」算 77 m 落差,按「热质说辩论」看两种热观的对决。3D 交互演示 · 拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: In the 1840s James Joule interrogated nature with an almost absurdly simple rig: a falling weight spins a paddle wheel that stirs water, and the thermometer shows the water warming - mechanical work turning precisely into heat, one calorie = 4.186 joules (Joule himself kept measuring 4.15-4.2). The result crushed the caloric theory: heat is not a self-flowing fluid but energy in another form, and friction or viscous dissipation is just the window where work converts into heat. The ledger is simple: a mass m falling a height h does work mgh, and the water warms by dT = mgh/(cM). But the rate hides deep in nature - 1 kg of water dropping 77 m down a waterfall warms by only 0.18 C, so Joule needed a Bunsen thermometer read to 0.003 C and stubborn repetition to catch it. A constant equivalence means energy is neither created nor destroyed, only exchanged - Helmholtz raised the conservation of energy on this stone in 1847, and every brake pad, damper and heating coil still trades at the same rate. Drag the weight, drop-height and water-mass sliders, press Rerun to watch the work and heat ledgers balance in real time, press Waterfall to audit the 77 m drop, or press Debate to watch caloric and kinetic theories argue it out. 3D interactive - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 永动机：永远差一步的账本
topics.titleEn: Perpetual Motion: The Ledger That Never Balances
topics.descZh: 八百年来最执着的发明,全部败在两条定律上。第一类永动机想凭空造能,撞死在热力学第一定律:重心偏置轮(Bhaskara 轮,1150 年)每侧力矩看似不等,实为对称配置力矩和为零,摩擦让它必然停摆;磁力斜面让钢球被磁铁吸上坡、坠洞回落,败在保守场——沿闭合路径做功为零,碰撞还偷走动能。第二类永动机想从单一热源吸热全变功,撞死在开尔文表述:不可能从单一热源取热使之完全变为有用功而不产生其他影响;麦克斯韦妖想靠信息分拣翻盘,兰道尔原理收走擦除记忆的能耗——每比特至少 kT·ln2。毛细陷阱更冤:把水抽上去的是表面张力,在管口按住不放的也是它。本页把五台著名设计在 3D 里转起来,逐台查账:输入恒为 0、输出恒为 0、损耗只增不减,转速衰减、当场停摆,每台挂着「违反哪条定律」的判词。拖动「摩擦系数」「初转速」看停得更快或更慢;按「四台巡游」看完整审计,或逐台按下「重心轮查账」「磁力斜面查账」「毛细陷阱」亲自过堂。3D 交互演示 · 拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: For eight hundred years the most persistent invention in history has been beaten by just two laws. Perpetual motion machines of the first kind try to make energy from nothing and die on the first law of thermodynamics: Bhaskara's offset-weight wheel (1150) looks like each side carries more torque, but the symmetric arrangement sums to exactly zero and friction stops it; the magnetic ramp pulls a steel ball uphill and drops it through a hole to return, and dies on conservative fields - work around any closed path is zero, and every impact steals a little kinetic energy. Machines of the second kind try to turn heat wholly into work drawn from a single reservoir and die on Kelvin's statement: it is impossible to take heat from a single reservoir and convert it completely into work with no other effect. Maxwell's demon tries to win by sorting molecules with information, and Landauer's principle hands it the bill - erasing one bit of memory costs at least kT ln2. The capillary trap is crueler still: the same surface tension that lifts water up holds it at the mouth. This page spins five famous designs in 3D and audits each: input stays 0, output stays 0, losses only grow, rotation decays to a stop, and every machine wears its verdict - which law it violates. Drag the friction and initial-speed sliders; press the grand tour for the full audit, or put the wheel, the ramp and the trap on the docket one by one. 3D interactive - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 基尔霍夫定律:电流与电压的守恒
topics.titleEn: Kirchhoff's Circuit Laws: Conservation of Current and Voltage
topics.descZh: 任何集总电路,只靠两本账加一条欧姆定律就能完全求解。第一本 KCL 电流定律:流入任一节点的电流之和等于流出之和——电荷守恒,稳态下节点不囤积电荷,进来多少必须出去多少。第二本 KVL 电压定律:沿任一闭合回路绕一圈,电位升降的代数和为零——能量守恒,单位电荷绕行一周静电力净做功为零,否则绕圈就能白赚能量、配上导线就是永动机。两本账配上 V=IR,电路变成线性方程组:节点电压法以节点电位为未知数,对每个节点列一条 KCL,即解出全部支路电流——本页就在实时解一个 2×2 方程组。经典应用:串联电阻按阻值比例分压,12 V 电源下 V=12·R₂/(R₁+R₂);并联电阻反比分流,电流表并联小电阻扩量程;惠斯通电桥四臂满足 R₁/R₂=R₃/R₄ 时对角检流计电流精确为零,可精密测电阻——应变片、热敏电阻测量电路都靠它。边界:集总近似要求电路尺寸远小于信号波长,3 GHz 时波长约 10 cm,同尺寸走线已是传输线,KVL 逐段失效。演示:12 V 电源带四臂电桥,拖动电阻滑块,方程组即时重解——粒子密度=电流大小、粒子速度=电流方向,导线按电位蓝→红着色;点击节点看 KCL 账本,开「账本透视」看每条回路的 KVL 实账;按「惠斯通电桥模式」看检流计归零。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: However tangled a lumped circuit looks, two ledgers plus one law solve it completely. Ledger one, KCL (Kirchhoff's current law): the sum of currents flowing into any node equals the sum flowing out - charge conservation; in steady state a node stockpiles no charge, one ampere in means one ampere out. Ledger two, KVL (Kirchhoff's voltage law): going around any closed loop, the algebraic sum of potential rises and drops is zero - energy conservation; the net electrostatic work on a unit charge after one full lap is zero, otherwise each lap would mint free energy and a wire loop would be a perpetual motion machine. With V=IR the circuit becomes a linear system: the node-voltage method takes node potentials as unknowns, one KCL equation per node yields every branch current - this page solves a live 2x2 system as you watch. Classic applications: series resistors divide voltage in proportion to resistance, V=12·R2/(R1+R2) from a 12 V source; parallel resistors divide current inversely, and an ammeter shunts with a small parallel resistor to extend its range; a Wheatstone bridge balances when R1/R2=R3/R4 so the diagonal galvanometer reads exactly zero - precision resistance measurement, the basis of strain-gauge and thermistor instrumentation. Limits: the lumped approximation demands a circuit much smaller than the signal wavelength; at 3 GHz the wavelength is about 10 cm, traces of that size are already transmission lines, and KVL fails segment by segment. Demo: a 12 V source drives a four-arm bridge; drag any resistor slider and the equations re-solve instantly - particle density = current magnitude, particle speed = current direction, wires colored blue to red by potential; click a node for its KCL ledger, turn on ledger x-ray for the live KVL ledger of every loop, press Wheatstone mode to watch the galvanometer null. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 伊辛模型:小磁针如何集体转向
topics.titleEn: The Ising Model: How Little Spins Turn Together
topics.descZh: 一块铁为什么自己有磁性?伊辛模型给出最简答案:格点上每个自旋只取 ±1,能量 E=−J·Σ⟨ij⟩ sᵢsⱼ−h·Σsᵢ——求和只对相邻格点,J>0 时同向能量低(铁磁)。温度与相互作用在拔河:kT 大,熵赢,自旋乱指,净磁化为零(顺磁相);kT 小,能量赢,自旋抱团成畴再吞并成整块,自发磁化出现(铁磁相)。二维正方格子有精确解(Onsager,1944):临界温度 Tc=2J/(k·ln(1+√2))≈2.269 J/k,此处磁化率与比热发散、关联长度无穷大——二级相变;团簇什么尺度都有、边界分形。模拟用 Metropolis 蒙特卡洛:随机挑一枚自旋算翻转代价 ΔE,ΔE≤0 直接受,否则按 exp(−ΔE/kT) 的概率受——温度越高越敢犯错。淬火(急冷)把高温的混乱冻成红蓝相间的磁畴花斑;退火(慢冷)则聚成大块单畴。外场 h 拉偏天平,低于 Tc 来回扫外场还能看到磁滞——硬磁材料「记忆」的来源。同一套数学还描述格气、合金有序化、Hopfield 神经网络——相变的普适性:细节不重要,只看对称性与维度。演示:24×24=576 枚双色小立方实时演化(平面格子:精确解仅在二维成立),温度/外场/J 滑块即拖即变,散点图累积 (T,|M|) 并与 Onsager 竖线对比;试「淬火」「退火」「外场翻转」三连。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Why does a piece of iron magnetize itself? The Ising model is the minimal answer: put a spin on every lattice site, each taking only ±1, with energy E=−J·Σ⟨ij⟩ s_i·s_j − h·Σs_i - the sum runs over nearest neighbors, and for J>0 aligned neighbors cost less energy (ferromagnetic). Temperature and coupling play tug-of-war: large kT and entropy wins - spins point every way, net magnetization is zero (paramagnetic phase); small kT and energy wins - spins clump into domains that swallow each other into one block, and spontaneous magnetization appears (ferromagnetic phase). The 2D square lattice has an exact solution (Onsager, 1944): critical temperature Tc = 2J/(k·ln(1+√2)) ≈ 2.269 J/k, where susceptibility and specific heat diverge and the correlation length becomes infinite - a continuous phase transition; clusters of every scale, fractal boundaries. Simulation uses Metropolis Monte Carlo: pick a random spin, compute the flip cost ΔE; accept if ΔE≤0 outright, otherwise accept with probability exp(−ΔE/kT) - hotter means more willing to err. Quenching (rapid cooling) freezes the high-temperature mess into a mottled red-blue domain pattern; annealing (slow cooling) gathers it into one large domain. An external field h tips the balance, and sweeping h back and forth below Tc reveals hysteresis - the origin of hard-magnet memory. The same mathematics describes lattice gases, order-disorder in alloys, even Hopfield neural networks - universality: details do not matter, only symmetry and dimension. Demo: 24×24 = 576 two-color cubes evolving live (a flat lattice because the exact solution holds only in 2D, making the comparison rigorous); temperature, field and J sliders act instantly; the scatter plot accumulates (T,|M|) against the Onsager line; try quench, anneal and field flip in sequence. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 磁制冷与磁热效应:让磁场当压缩机
topics.titleEn: Magnetocaloric Cooling: Let the Magnetic Field Do the Compressing
topics.descZh: 磁制冷不压缩气体,它打熵这张牌:给磁热材料加磁场,自旋磁矩集体顺场排列、磁熵骤降——绝热条件下总熵不能凭空消失,晶格熵只好补位,材料自己升温;撤掉磁场,自旋重新乱化、从周围吸热,材料又凉回去。可惜单级温升只有几 K:金属钆的居里温度恰在室温附近(约 293 K),1 T 磁场绝热温升约 2.5-3 K。家用靠 AMR 主动磁回热循环放大:磁化(向回热器放热)→ 热端换热 → 退磁(从回热器吸热)→ 冷端换热,工质带在冷热两端之间往返,回热器像梯子一样把小温升逐级叠成 20-30 K 跨度,循环频率 0.5-4 Hz。磁场源用 Halbach 永磁阵列(1-1.5 T),旋转内筒即可切换工位强弱场——不用超导、不用压缩机、不用 HFC 制冷剂,安静且效率可达卡诺 30-60%;工质按温区选:Gd₅Si₂Ge₂ 巨磁热、La(Fe,Si)₁₃、锰基合金。2016 年起饮料冷却器已有商用试点,家用冰箱在试。演示里看工质链节进强场区自旋排齐、发红放热,退出后乱化发蓝吸热;拖磁场强度(0.5-1.5 T)、循环频率(0.5-4 Hz)与冷端负载,看冷/热端温度曲线爬向稳态;点「Halbach 旋转透视」「自旋慢放」「T-S 循环图」分别看三门道。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Magnetic refrigeration never compresses a gas - it plays the entropy card: put a magnetic field on a magnetocaloric material and the spin moments align with the field, so magnetic entropy plunges; under adiabatic conditions total entropy cannot simply vanish, so lattice entropy fills in and the material heats itself up. Remove the field, the spins re-randomize, heat is absorbed from the surroundings and the material cools back down. The catch: a single stage only shifts a few kelvin - gadolinium happens to have its Curie point right near room temperature (about 293 K), and 1 T buys an adiabetic rise of just 2.5-3 K. Household machines amplify it with an active magnetic regenerator (AMR) cycle: magnetize (heat rejected to the regenerator) - hot-end exchange - demagnetize (heat absorbed from the regenerator) - cold-end exchange; the belt of working material shuttles between the cold and hot ends while the regenerator works like a ladder, stacking the small steps into a 20-30 K span at 0.5-4 Hz. The field comes from a Halbach permanent-magnet array (1-1.5 T): spinning the inner cylinder switches the bed between strong and weak field - no superconductors, no compressor, no HFC refrigerants, quiet, with efficiency up to 30-60% of Carnot. Working materials are picked per temperature range: Gd5Si2Ge2 giant magnetocaloric, La(Fe,Si)13, Mn-based alloys. Beverage coolers have been in commercial pilot since 2016 and household fridges are in development. In the demo, watch chain links enter the strong field - spins line up, the link glows red and dumps heat - then leave, disorder, glow blue and soak heat up; drag field strength (0.5-1.5 T), cycle frequency (0.5-4 Hz) and cold-side load and watch the cold/hot temperature curves climb into steady state; open the Halbach x-ray, spin slow-motion and T-S diagram for the three inner views. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: 电子带多少电?1909 年密立根的答案是:拿一滴油跟它对峙。喷雾器把油滴喷进平行板电容器,油滴带电(摩擦或 X 射线电离空气所赐),在重力下先做终端速度下落——斯托克斯阻力按半径算,量出下落速度就锁定了油滴的质量;再打开电场,微调电压让油滴悬停不动,此刻电场力恰好压平重力,qE = mg,一带入就得到油滴携带的总电荷。密立根反复测了几千滴,把电压、下落速度、悬停电压全部记录,发现所有电荷都是 1.59×10⁻¹⁹ C 的整数倍——1909-1913 年间他发表了 58 滴的完整数据,电子电荷 e 与质量 m(配合荷质比)就此定案,1923 年诺贝尔奖。这场实验的美在于把「量子」变成了肉眼可见的演出:整数的倍数列在对数纸上排成等距阶梯;但争议随之而来:历史学者后来的审读发现密立根发表时筛除了部分数据,而他在论文里声称「全部数据都在」——科学史上关于数据伦理最著名的案例之一。今天油滴实验仍在大学物理课里运转,不过是作为标定空气尘埃粒子的经典手法。拖「板电压」看油滴起落,拖「油滴选择」换一颗;按「悬停校准」看 q=mgd/V 现场解出,按「X 射线脉冲」看电荷跳台阶,按「数据表回放」翻 1909 年的记录本。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
How much charge does an electron carry? Millikan's 1909 answer: challenge it with a drop of oil. An atomizer mists oil droplets into a parallel-plate capacitor, where they pick up charge from friction or X-ray-ionized air. First let a droplet fall at terminal velocity - Stokes drag scales with radius, so the fall speed nails the droplet's mass. Then switch on the field and tune the voltage until the droplet hangs motionless: electric force has flattened gravity, qE = mg, and one substitution yields the droplet's total charge. Millikan repeated this thousands of times, logging voltage, fall speed and hover voltage, and found every charge an integer multiple of 1.59e-19 C; his 58-drop dataset published 1909-1913 fixed both e and, with the charge-to-mass ratio, the electron's mass - Nobel Prize, 1923. The beauty is that quantization becomes visible: multiples line up on a log plot as evenly spaced stairs. The controversy came later: historians found he published only selected runs while claiming "all the data" - one of the most-cited cases in data ethics. The oil drop still runs in undergraduate labs, now as the classic way to calibrate airborne dust particles. Drag plate voltage to lift and lower drops, drag droplet select to change one; press hover calibration to solve q = mgd/V live, X-ray pulse to watch charge jump stairs, data-table replay to leaf through the 1909 notebook. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 两块平行板电容器(可剖视),喷雾器喷出油滴;油滴上下运动受重力/阻力/电场力;悬停时金色光环;电荷整数倍阶梯图 HUD;X 射线管侧照。

topics.descZh: 短波电台功率不过几百瓦,却能从北京喊到阿根廷——靠的不是绕地球爬,而是天上那面「镜子」。太阳紫外线与 X 射线把 60-500 km 的高层大气打成等离子体:电子被从原子剥下,形成 D(60-90 km,只在白天存在)、E(90-150 km)、F(150-500 km,白天裂成 F₁/F₂)三层;等离子体的关键参数是等离子体频率 f_p≈9√N_e(Hz,N_e 为电子密度/m³),低于它的电磁波会被整体推回来——频率像选门:长波碰 D 层就折返,短波 3-30 MHz 穿透 D、折返于 F,频率再高则直接穿出去进太空。于是地面波贴地爬百公里,天波却在地面与 F 层之间打水漂,一次跳跃 2000-4000 km,三跳就横跨大洋;发射仰角决定跳距,天线仰角抬高近跳、压低远跳。昼夜是短波的呼吸:D 层是吸收层,白天吃掉中波,太阳一落它瞬间消散,中波广播夜里的「台多得数不清」正是 D 层下班;而太阳耀斑会在几分钟内把 D 层吹浓,短波全频段骤哑——1859 年卡林顿事件让电报员被电弧烧伤,1989 年风暴让魁北克电网九秒崩溃。GPS 同样付电离层账:信号穿过时被延迟,双频修正就是用两个频率的时差反推总电子含量。拖「频率」看哪个层收留你,拖「当地时间」看昼夜层高变化,拖「发射角」调跳距;按「静区演示」看天波飞过头顶落在远处、近处反而收不到,按「太阳风暴」看 F 层扰动与通信中断,按「昼夜切换」看中波电波夜行千里。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A shortwave transmitter of a few hundred watts talks from Beijing to Argentina - not by crawling around the globe but by bouncing off a mirror in the sky. Solar UV and X-rays ionize the upper atmosphere between 60 and 500 km into plasma: electrons stripped from atoms form the D layer (60-90 km, daytime only), E (90-150 km), and F (150-500 km, splitting into F1/F2 by day). The key plasma number is the plasma frequency, f_p = 9 x sqrt(N_e) Hz with N_e in electrons per cubic metre; waves below it get pushed back as a whole - frequency picks your door: longwave reflects off D, shortwave 3-30 MHz punches through D and folds back at F, and anything higher escapes to space. Ground waves hug the earth for a hundred kilometres while skywaves skip between ground and F layer, 2000-4000 km per hop - three hops cross an ocean; launch elevation sets the hop distance. Day-night is shortwave's breathing: D is an absorber that eats medium wave by day and evaporates at sunset, which is why AM radio blooms at night. A solar flare thickens D within minutes and the whole HF band goes silent - the 1859 Carrington event arced telegraph keys, and a 1989 storm collapsed Quebec's grid in ninety seconds. GPS pays the ionosphere too: signals are delayed in transit, and dual-frequency correction uses the differential to back out total electron content. Drag frequency to see which layer takes you, drag local time for the layer heights, drag launch angle for hop distance; press skip zone to watch the skywave fly overhead and land far away while the near field hears nothing, solar storm for F-layer disruption, day-night switch for medium wave's midnight run. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半透明地球+同心壳层(D/E/F 三层标注);发射塔与射线束:低频折返 D、中频穿 D 折 F、高频穿出;昼夜分界线扫过,夜间 D 层淡出;太阳在背景。

topics.descZh: 音乐厅里最后一个音落下后,声音不是戛然而止,而是指数衰减的尾巴——混响。它由三部分叠成:直达声先到,决定定位与清晰度;50 ms 内的早期反射从墙面、天花板折回,人耳把它们与直达声融合,提供空间感与「房间的大小」;之后的上千次反射来回碰撞,能量按吸声量指数衰减,衰减到百万分之一(−60 dB)所需的时间就是混响时间 RT60。赛宾 1898 年给出经典公式 RT60=0.161 V/A:哈瓦那大学一讲厅体积 9000 m³、总吸声量按系数加权,混凝土墙吸声系数仅 0.02、厚幕布 0.5、消声室劈尖 0.99,同样的体积吸声翻倍,混响时间就砍半。不同场合的目标完全不同:教堂与交响乐要 1.8-2.2 s 的尾巴让声音「糊」成一体,话剧院与教室要压到 0.8-1.2 s 保语音清晰,录音棚要 0.3 s 以下;教室超标是听讲效率的隐形杀手。两条平行墙之间还会来回反射出「颤动回声」;而回声与混响的分界在 50 ms:延迟超过它且是单个强反射,人耳就能分辨出「两声」——所以剧院后墙要么做吸声要么做扩散。拖「房间体积」与「吸声材料」看 RT60 实时重算,拖「听音位置」看直达/早期/晚期能量比;按「教室 vs 音乐厅」一键切换,按「平行墙颤动」听双重声音,按「脉冲衰减」看 −60 dB 曲线。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
In a concert hall the last note doesn't stop - it decays exponentially, a tail called reverberation, built in three layers: the direct sound arrives first and sets localization and clarity; early reflections within 50 ms bounce off walls and ceiling and fuse perceptually with the direct sound, supplying spaciousness and a sense of the room's size; then thousands of later reflections crisscross, energy decaying exponentially with the room's absorption. The time to decay to one millionth (-60 dB) is RT60. Sabine's 1898 classic says RT60 = 0.161 V/A: concrete absorbs just 0.02, heavy curtains 0.5, anechoic wedges 0.99 - double the absorption in the same volume and the reverb time halves. Targets differ completely: churches and symphony halls want 1.8-2.2 s tails that smear sound into one; theaters and classrooms squeeze to 0.8-1.2 s for speech; studios go below 0.3 s - an over-reverberant classroom is a hidden tax on learning. Two parallel walls bounce a flutter echo back and forth; the echo/reverberation boundary sits at 50 ms, where a single strong reflection becomes audible as "two sounds" - which is why theater rear walls are treated with absorption or diffusion. Drag room volume and absorption materials to recompute RT60 live, drag listener position for the direct/early/late split; press classroom vs concert hall to switch presets, parallel-wall flutter for the doubled sound, impulse decay for the -60 dB curve. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖开的厅堂:舞台声源发出声线束(直达绿/早期黄/晚期红),墙面材质色块(吸声系数标注);能量-时间衰减曲线 canvas;听音位置小人。

topics.descZh: 一根没有活动部件的管子,接上压缩空气,一端出热风(可达 100 °C 以上)、一端出冷风(可低到 -40 °C)——涡流管(Ranque-Hilsch 管)是热力学里最像魔术的装置:压缩空气切向喷进管子,以每分钟百万转量级的速度贴壁旋转着冲向热端;中心部分的气流被迫反向,从中央小孔流出——就是这股中心流变冷了。能量是怎么分开的?解释至今仍在打笔墨官司,主流图像是:贴壁高速旋转的外层气流与内层强烈剪切,把能量重新分配;外层气流的切向速度沿管衰减时经历绝热膨胀与「声流」效应——结果是外层更热、内芯更冷,同一根管子内温差可达 50-70 °C。它效率不高(等熵效率只有百分之几到十几),但胜在零活动部件、即开即用、工质只有空气没有制冷剂:点焊枪头局部冷却、高温车间的岗位送冷风、气体分析仪的取样降温、矿井里的便携冷源,都是它的岗位。热端那枚小阀是唯一的调节钮:拧进拧出改变热流背压,从而分配冷热流比例(冷流分数 20%-80%),温差与冷量在滑杆两端此消彼长。拖「进气压力」看旋涡转速与温差,拖「热端阀开度」看冷热分配;按「冷热分流」看两股流分道,按「温度剖面」看管内径向温度分布,按「调节冷流比」看阀如何再分配,按「与冰箱对比」看效率的差距。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A tube with no moving parts, fed compressed air, blowing heat above 100 degrees out one end and cold down to -40 out the other - the vortex tube (Ranque-Hilsch) is thermodynamics' closest thing to a magic trick: air jets in tangentially and spins against the wall at on the order of a million rpm toward the hot end, while the core flow is forced to reverse and escapes through the central orifice - that core is the cold stream. How does energy split? Explanations are still argued, but the accepted picture is shear: the fast outer vortex rubs hard against the inner layers, redistributing energy while its tangential speed decays along the tube through adiabatic expansion and acoustic streaming - the shell ends up hotter, the core colder, and within one tube the two ends differ by 50-70 degrees. Its efficiency is humble (a few to a dozen percent isentropic), but it wins on having nothing to wear out, instant start, and air instead of refrigerant: spot-cooling weld torch tips, personal cooling at hot workstations, sample conditioning for gas analyzers, portable cooling down mines. The little valve at the hot end is the only knob: screw it in or out to change the hot-flow backpressure and split the cold fraction anywhere from 20 to 80 percent - temperature difference and cold output trade off across its travel. Drag inlet pressure for swirl speed and ΔT, drag the hot-valve for the split; press cold-hot split to watch the streams part, temperature profile for the radial gradient inside, cold-fraction tuning to see the valve redistribute, versus refrigerator for the efficiency gap. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 卧式管剖视:切向喷嘴(蓝)进气、贴壁红色高速旋涡流向热端、中央蓝色冷流从左端小孔反向流出;热端锥形阀可伸缩;管内粒子按温度着色(红热/蓝冷);两端温度计与 ΔT 表。

topics.descZh: 给一根镍钛记忆合金棒用力一拉,它自己会发热;松手回弹,它自己会变冷——这不是错觉,是「弹热效应」:应力诱发的相变。奥氏体相(高温相)被拉伸到临界应变时,一瞬间转变为马氏体相(低温相),相变潜热当众释放,材料温度跳升几摄氏度;反过来,卸载时马氏体逆转为奥氏体,潜热被吸收,材料骤冷。把「拉伸放热→向热端排热→回弹吸热→从冷端吸热」串成一个循环,就是一台没有压缩机的冰箱:工作介质是一根固体金属棒,不含任何制冷剂气体(不破坏臭氧、不排放温室气体),可逆温差可达 10-20 °C,样机制冷功率已达几十到上百瓦。它的对手是自己的寿命:每次相变都要在马氏体变体间来回剪切,微裂纹与局域化变形逐渐累积,数千到数万次循环后性能衰减——「疲劳稳定化」训练(先跑几万次让材料进入稳定状态)与新型单晶、纳米晶合金正在把这个数字往上抬。磁制冷、电卡制冷与弹热制冷是固态制冷的三兄弟,弹热效应最强、驱动最简单(一台电机拉一根棒),被认为最有希望率先走进冰箱与空调。拖「拉伸应变」看相变潜热的释放与吸收,拖「循环频率」看制冷功率;按「拉伸放热」看温度跳升,按「回弹吸热」看骤冷,按「制冷循环」看四步热泵,按「疲劳稳定化」看性能如何衰减与恢复。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Yank a nickel-titanium shape-memory rod hard and it warms by itself; let it snap back and it chills by itself - not an illusion but the elastocaloric effect: stress-induced phase transition. Stretch austenite past a critical strain and it flips to martensite in a flash, dumping latent heat and jumping several degrees; unload it and martensite reverses, soaking the latent heat back up and dropping cold. Chain the four moves - stretch and reject heat to the hot side, relax and absorb heat from the cold side - and you have a refrigerator with no compressor: the working medium is a solid metal rod, with no refrigerant gas at all (nothing to deplete ozone or warm the planet), reversible temperature spans of 10-20 degrees, and prototypes already pumping tens to a hundred watts. Its opponent is its own lifetime: every cycle shears martensite variants back and forth, microcracks and strain localization accumulate, and performance fades over thousands to tens of thousands of cycles - fatigue stabilization (running tens of thousands of cycles up front until the material settles) and new single-crystal and nanocrystalline alloys are pushing that number up. Elastocaloric, magnetocaloric and electrocaloric are solid-state cooling's three brothers; the elastic one has the biggest effect and the simplest drive - a motor stretching a bar - and is the likeliest to reach a fridge or an air conditioner first. Drag applied strain to watch latent heat released and reabsorbed, drag cycle frequency for cooling power; press stretch heats for the temperature jump, relax cools for the chill, cooling cycle for the four-beat heat pump, fatigue stabilization for how performance fades and recovers. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 一根金属棒被夹头拉伸(相变前沿以颜色扫过:奥氏体金→马氏体青);放热时棒身发红波纹、吸热时结霜发蓝;热端/冷端换热器风扇;循环四步示意图;循环次数计数与衰减曲线。

topics.descZh: 微波炉的心脏是一枚手掌大的真空管,里面没有栅极没有偏转板,只有电场、磁场与一团会自己组织成轮辐的电子云——磁控管。结构像一朵铜花:中心是发射电子的阴极,四周环着偶数个谐振腔(每腔一个缝隙口),外加磁场沿轴向穿过。灯丝加热阴极,电子在径向电场的驱动下往外跑,却同时被轴向磁场用洛伦兹力掰弯:电场推它向外,磁场让它打转,两股力量的合力让电子只能绕着阴极做摆线运动——正交场(E⊥B)把直线运动锁成了旋转。旋转的电子云很快失稳成几条「轮辐」,像车轮辐条一样跟着场同步旋转;轮辐扫过谐振腔缝隙时,把能量交给腔里的电磁振荡,激起的频率由腔的尺寸决定——尺寸对准 2.45 GHz,效率高达 60-70%,一管输出千瓦级微波。π 模(相邻腔相位相反)是主力工作模式:恰好停在腔缝之间的电子处在减速场里,把动能如数上交;水分子吸收这个频段效率极高(偶极子跟不上每秒 49 亿次场翻转,热被直接写进食物),这也是频率被选中的原因之一。拖「阳极电压」看电子云与轮辐转速,拖「磁场强度」看摆线半径;按「电子轮辐」看旋转模式形成,按「谐振腔 π 模」看相邻腔反相振荡,按「微波输出」看天线把能量送进波导,按「整机耦合」看炉腔里的驻波与转盘。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
The heart of a microwave oven is a vacuum tube the size of your palm with no grids and no deflection plates - just an electric field, a magnetic field, and an electron cloud that organizes itself into spokes: the magnetron. Structurally a copper flower: an electron-emitting cathode at the center ringed by an even number of resonant cavities, with a magnetic field threaded along the axis. The filament heats the cathode, electrons start outward under the radial field, and the axial field bends them sideways with the Lorentz force - pushed out while curled around, they can only trace cycloids around the cathode: crossed fields (E perpendicular to B) lock straight motion into rotation. The rotating cloud quickly destabilizes into a few spokes that revolve in step with the field; as each spoke sweeps past the cavity gaps it hands energy to the cavities' oscillation, at a frequency set by their dimensions - tuned to 2.45 GHz, with efficiency of 60-70 percent and a kilowatt of microwaves from one tube. The pi mode - adjacent cavities oscillating in opposition - is the workhorse: electrons parked between cavities sit in the decelerating phase and surrender their kinetic energy in full. Water absorbs this band superbly (dipoles cannot keep up with 2.45 billion field reversals a second, writing heat directly into the food), which is part of why the frequency was chosen. Drag anode voltage for cloud and spoke speed, drag field strength for the cycloid radius; press electron spokes to watch the rotating pattern form, pi mode for cavities oscillating in opposition, microwave output for the antenna feeding the waveguide, oven coupling for standing waves and the turntable. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 俯视铜阳极(花瓣状谐振腔)+中心阴极灯丝;电子(蓝点)从阴极螺旋外抛、聚成 4-6 条发光轮辐同步旋转;腔口闪亮表示振荡;轴向磁场用环形箭头表示;波导引出到食物剖面加热动画。

topics.descZh: 摇一罐混合坚果,最大的巴西坚果总会浮到顶上——可颗粒世界里没有浮力:颗粒床是力链撑住的「固体」,压强分布偏离静水压,阿基米德在这里当场失效。上浮其实靠三台机器。其一,振动让床活过来:无量纲加速度 Γ=a·ω²/g 大于 1,床面才开始流化,并卷出一对「对流环」——中央颗粒缓缓上升、沿罐壁下滑,大颗粒被这条传送带送到顶部,却因个头太大,钻不进沿壁下滑的窄流,上去就回不来。其二,「空隙填充」:每次振动把床面抬起,大颗粒下方张开的空隙,几乎总被随机钻动的小颗粒抢先填占——大颗粒一步一个脚印,只进不退。其三,大颗粒底部更容易成拱,留下的空隙更大,被填得也更快。参数走到极端剧情会反转:频率高到床面局部流化,或两种颗粒密度差反号,大颗粒反而随流化床下沉——这就是反转巴西坚果效应。工程上它一半是灾难一半是工具:药片混料越摇越不均,滑坡体自动把巨石分选到表面,隼鸟二号的着陆实验还在小行星表面拍到砾石随振动迁移的现场证词。拖「振动频率」调床的活性,拖「振幅」看每次抬起的空隙;按「对流抬升」看传送带卷大球,按「空隙填充特写」看小球钻缝,按「反转效应」看大球掉头下沉,按「工程案例」看药片越摇越不均。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Shake a jar of mixed nuts and the biggest Brazil nuts always end up on top - yet the granular world has no buoyancy: the bed is a solid propped by force chains, its pressure profile strays from hydrostatic, and Archimedes fails on the spot. The rise runs on three machines. First, vibration brings the bed alive: once the dimensionless acceleration Γ=a·ω²/g exceeds 1 the surface fluidizes and rolls a pair of convection cells - grains rise slowly in the center and slide down the walls, a conveyor that delivers big grains to the top, where they are too large to re-enter the narrow downward lane - up, and no way back. Second, void filling: every shake lifts the bed, and the gap that opens beneath a big grain is almost always claimed first by randomly jostling small grains - the big one ratchets up, never down. Third, big grains arch more easily underneath, leaving bigger voids that fill faster. Push the parameters to an extreme and the story flips: when the frequency is high enough for local fluidization - or the density contrast reverses sign - the big grains sink instead: the reverse Brazil-nut effect. In engineering it is half disaster, half tool: pill blends unmix the more you shake, landslide bodies sort boulders to their surface, and the Hayabusa2 landing experiment caught gravel migrating under vibration on an asteroid. Drag vibration frequency to set how alive the bed is, drag amplitude to see the void opened by each shake; press convection lift to watch the conveyor carry big grains up, void-filling close-up to watch small grains dive under, reverse effect to see big grains turn around and sink, engineering case for a pill blend shaking itself uneven. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 透明圆罐坐在振动台上:约 12 颗暗橙大球与 400 颗青色小球;振动驱动床内对流环(中央上升、沿壁下滑的箭头场),大球被抬到顶部卡住;空隙填充特写用慢镜头看小球钻进大球下方;高频时大球掉头下沉;工程案例把小球换成红白药片,越摇分层越明显。

topics.descZh: 把一串珠链放进高杯,拎出一端让它垂落,链条不会乖乖贴着杯沿滑下来,而是先向上拱起一段违反直觉的「喷泉」,悬空段最高能高出杯口十几厘米。2014 年剑桥的 Biggins 与 Warner 给出解释:链条不是被「拖拽」出杯子的,而是被「发射」出去的——每节链环被拉起时,它的另一端会顶在杯里的链堆上发生一次小「踢击」,链堆给它一个向下的反冲,牛顿第三定律的另一半就把离杯的链段向上推;等效效果是链条离杯时自带向上的初速度,重力还没来得及把它压弯,它已经冲出一道抛物拱——拱顶高度约等于链速的平方除以两倍重力加速度,所以杯口越高、链速越快,拱就拱得越高。这套「从静止源发射」的图像还能反过来用:金属链落到地面时,链堆给落段的反冲会让下落端比自由落体更快,「下落的链条、秤的读数超过总重」这道百年悖论与喷泉同源;慢放与数值模拟都证实了踢击模型,它的工程回声藏在缆索系统与太空电梯的释放动力学里。拖「释放高度」看杯口越高链速越快、拱顶随之升高,拖「时间缩放」看慢放下链环一节节被踢出杯口;按「完整下落」看从垂落到稳态喷泉的全过程,按「踢击反冲」看杯内链堆闪红反冲的特写,按「无踢击对照」看拱顶消失、链条贴沿而下,按「参数实验」看释放高度连续扫描时拱顶的变化。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Drop a bead chain into a tall beaker, lift one end over the rim and let it fall - the chain does not slide obediently over the edge; it first arches upward into a counter-intuitive fountain, the hanging section peaking more than ten centimeters above the rim. In 2014 Cambridge's Biggins and Warner explained why: the chain is not dragged out of the beaker, it is launched. As each link is pulled up, its other end pushes once against the link pile in the cup - a small kick; the pile recoils downward, and Newton's third law, the other half of the bargain, pushes the departing section upward. Net effect: the chain leaves the rim already carrying upward speed, so gravity bends it only after it has thrown a parabolic arch - apex height about v squared over 2g, which is why a higher rim means a faster chain and a higher fountain. The same launch-from-rest picture runs in reverse: when a falling chain piles onto the ground, the recoil from the pile makes the falling end drop faster than free fall - the century-old paradox of the chain whose scale reading exceeds its own weight is the fountain's twin. Slow-motion footage and numerical simulations both confirm the kick model, and its engineering echo lives in the release dynamics of cable systems and space elevators. Drag release height to see a taller rim mean a faster chain and a higher arch, drag time scale to watch links get kicked out of the rim at 0.05x speed; press full fall for the whole run from droop to steady fountain, kick recoil for a close-up of the pile flashing red, no-kick check to see the arch vanish as the chain hugs the rim, param sweep to scan release height continuously. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 玻璃杯架在可调高度的立柱上,杯底盘着约 200 节珠链;播放后链条从杯口被「发射」,拱起抛物喷泉再自由落体,落地卷成链堆;杯底随踢击闪红、红色反冲箭头向下指,青色速度矢量沿拱标注,示波器同步画出踢击与无踢击两条拱形纵剖面;无踢击模式下链条贴杯沿折转、拱顶消失。

topics.descZh: 壁虎能在玻璃上倒挂,靠的不是胶水也不是吸盘,而是一场纳米尺度的数量级游戏:每只脚约 50 万根刚毛,直径只有约 5 微米,每根刚毛末端再分出几百根 200 纳米的匙形纤毛——接触面积被切到极限,纤毛尖离表面只差几纳米,范德华力这种「平时懒得理你」的短程吸引,亿万根加起来就是每平方厘米十牛级的黏附。它的聪明全在「方向性」:只有沿剪切方向向后拉,亿万根纤毛才被剪切力压贴到表面、黏附瞬间暴涨;垂直拔起只要先转个角度让纤毛卷离,黏附几乎归零——所以壁虎跑墙时脚掌是「贴上去、拉回来、卷下来」的三拍节奏,每次只需要拉脱一小片。它还自清洁:灰尘只粘纤毛不粘皮肤,几步之后污物自己转移到表面上;整套把戏不需要任何胶介质,真空气氛照常工作。人类已经照方抓药:碳纳米管阵列和 PDMS 微结构做出的「壁虎胶带」能让人在玻璃上攀爬,机器人抓取太空碎片指望的正是这套无残留的抓法。拖「拉力方向角」看从垂直拔起到剪切贴附、黏附力条如何暴涨,拖「纤毛接触密度」看参与合唱的纤毛越多、总黏附越强;按「四级缩放」看从脚掌到纳米尖端的连续放大,按「剪切贴附」看纤毛排排压平,按「剥离脱附」看纤毛逐排卷起、力条骤降,按「自清洁」看灰尘粒子被甩到表面。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A gecko hangs upside down on glass with neither glue nor suction - it runs a numbers game at the nanoscale: each foot carries about half a million setae roughly 5 micrometers across, and each seta branches into hundreds of 200-nanometer spatulae; contact is split to the limit, tips hovering just nanometers above the surface, where van der Waals attraction - the short-range force that normally cannot be bothered - summed over billions of hairs adds up to something like 10 newtons per square centimeter. The clever part is directionality: only a backward pull along the shear direction presses the spatulae flat against the surface and makes adhesion spike; to let go, the gecko just rotates the angle so the hairs curl off, and adhesion collapses to nearly zero - hence the three-beat rhythm of running a wall: press on, pull back, curl off, releasing only a small patch at a time. It is self-cleaning too: dirt sticks to the spatulae, not the skin, and transfers to the surface after a few steps; no medium is involved, so the trick works in vacuum - handy for robotic arms in space. Humans have copied the recipe: carbon-nanotube arrays and PDMS microstructures make a gecko tape that lets a person climb glass, and robots grasping space debris are counting on exactly this residue-free grip.
