Drag pull angle from vertical peel to shear grip and watch the adhesion bar surge, drag spatula density to add more hairs to the chorus; press four-level zoom to dive from foot pad to nanotips, shear grip to flatten the spatulae, peel-off to curl them off the glass, self-clean to watch dust get dumped onto the surface. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 半透明脚掌倒挂在玻璃板下,伞状刚毛阵列随「拉力方向角」压平或竖起;放大区里单根刚毛分出帚状纤毛,再放大可见匙形尖端与玻璃之间发蓝的范德华吸引晕;橙色拉力箭头随方向角旋转,黏附力条随之涨落;自清洁模式下棕色灰尘粒子沿弧线被甩到玻璃表面。

topics.descZh:
1909 年,曼彻斯特。卢瑟福安排助手盖革与马斯登,用镭系放出的 α 粒子(氦核 He²⁺,约 5 MeV)轰击一片数百纳米厚的金箔,再以硫化锌闪烁屏逐点计数。当时的主流是汤姆逊「枣糕模型」:正电荷均匀摊满直径约 10⁻¹⁰ m 的原子球,α 一路只遇微弱电场,偏折只能多次小角累加,单次大角散射概率约 10⁻³⁵ 量级——按理绝不可能被弹回。实验却偏偏弹回了:约每 8000 个 α 中就有 1 个偏转超过 90°,个别原路返回;卢瑟福形容:「这是你用 15 英寸炮弹打一张薄纸,炮弹却被弹回来打到你。」定量反推:库仑排斥下轨迹是双曲线,迎头碰撞的最近距离 r_min = (1/4πε₀)·Z₁Z₂e²/E ≈ 4.6×10⁻¹⁴ m(约 45 fm),正电荷必须集中在这个尺度以内——实际核半径约 7 fm,只占原子直径的十万分之一,原子几乎全空。由此得出散射公式 dN/dθ ∝ 1/sin⁴(θ/2),且 ∝ Z²、∝ 1/E²、∝ 箔厚;1913 年第二轮实验逐条验证,由计数反推出 Z≈79,与金的化学性质一致——原子核物理自此开篇:1911 行星模型 → 1913 玻尔量子化;散射至今仍是探针,卢瑟福背散射谱(RBS)仍在测薄膜成分与深度剖面。拖「α 能量」「靶核电荷 Z」看轨迹与曲线随物理量变化;按「枣糕模型」「金箔实验」「单核特写」「公式验证」切换四种视图。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 左侧镭源射出青色 α 束,穿过金箔原子阵列(半透明云球内藏金色小核),右侧 ±110° 弧形硫化锌屏逐点爆出绿色闪烁;枣糕模式里原子化作粉色云球,束流只轻微抖动、几乎直行;金箔模式偶发红色大角弹回轨迹;单核特写逐步积分绘出双曲线,标注渐近线、散射角 θ 与最近距离 r_min;公式验证模式直方图按 1/sin⁴(θ/2) 累积,与理论超越比例曲线重合。
topics.descEn:
In 1909 in Manchester, Rutherford had his assistants Geiger and Marsden fire alpha particles from a radium series - helium nuclei He2+ at about 5 MeV - at a gold foil a few hundred nanometers thick, counting the flashes dot by dot on a zinc-sulfide screen. The reigning Thomson plum-pudding model spread positive charge evenly through a sphere about 10^-10 m across: an alpha should meet only feeble electric fields, its deflections piling up as many tiny nudges, with the odds of a single large-angle kick around 10^-35 - a bounce-back should be impossible. Yet the foil bounced them: about 1 in 8000 alphas deflected by more than 90 degrees, a few straight back; Rutherford said it was as if you fired a 15-inch shell at tissue paper and it came back and hit you. The arithmetic: under Coulomb repulsion the path is a hyperbola, and a head-on collision closes to r_min = (1/4*pi*eps0)*Z1*Z2*e2/E of about 4.6e-14 m (45 fm), so the positive charge must fit inside an even smaller sphere - the real nuclear radius is about 7 fm, one hundred-thousandth of the atomic diameter: the atom is almost entirely empty. Hence the scattering law dN/d-theta proportional to 1/sin^4(theta/2), also proportional to Z squared, to 1/E squared and to foil thickness; a second campaign in 1913 verified it clause by clause and the counts yielded Z of about 79, matching the chemistry of gold - nuclear physics begins here: the 1911 planetary model, Bohr 1913 quantization, and scattering still probes matter today, with Rutherford backscattering spectrometry measuring thin-film composition and depth profiles. Drag alpha energy and target charge Z to move trajectories and curves; press plum pudding, gold foil, nucleus close-up and formula check to switch views. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 左侧镭源射出青色 α 束,穿过金箔原子阵列(半透明云球内藏金色小核),右侧 ±110° 弧形硫化锌屏逐点爆出绿色闪烁;枣糕模式里原子化作粉色云球,束流只轻微抖动、几乎直行;金箔模式偶发红色大角弹回轨迹;单核特写逐步积分绘出双曲线,标注渐近线、散射角 θ 与最近距离 r_min;公式验证模式直方图按 1/sin⁴(θ/2) 累积,与理论超越比例曲线重合。

topics.descZh: 自行车是一台会自己转向的倒立摆:静止时它必然倒下——重心悬在接地点正上方,稍偏一点,重力力矩就把倾倒越放越大;但只要车速进入窗口,向左倾的车会自动把前轮「向左转」,支撑点随之移到重心下方,车不倒反而回正。自稳定问题因此归结为一句话:倾斜能否自动引起正确方向的转向。促成它的机制有三个:一是陀螺进动,前轮自旋角动量约 1–2 kg·m²/s,侧倾施加力矩 τ,车轮按 τ=dL/dt 绕转向轴进动,恰好转向倾侧一侧;二是拖曳距 trail,转向轴延长线与地面的交点在接地点之前约 3–6 cm,接地点像购物车轮一样被拖在后面,侧倾时重力分量把前轮转向倾斜一侧;三是前置质量,前轮轴前方的质量下坠同样推动转向——2011 年 Kooijman 等人造出既无陀螺效应(反向小轮抵消)又无 trail(接地点在轴之前)的两质量车,布置得当依然自稳,证明二者都不是必需,必需的是「倾→转→回正」整个闭环的特征值全为负。窗口有边界:静止必倒;低于约 4–5 m/s 重力发散占优;高于约 20–25 m/s 出现缓慢的 capsize 发散与 weave 摆振,慢到手一扶就回。反打(countersteering)是这套动力学的主动用法——想右转,先向左轻推把手让车身先向右倾。前倾角约 70–75°、trail、轴距与质量分布共同裁剪窗口:载货车前载置于前轴之前,低速稳、高速抖。拖「车速」「拖曳距」滑杆亲手划出稳定窗口;按「撒把回正」看 S 形回正轨迹,按「拖曳距」看几何标注,按「陀螺进动」看三支矢量,按「实验对照」看无陀螺无 trail 的两质量车与改坏的车当场倒下。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A bicycle is an inverted pendulum that steers itself. At rest it must fall: the center of mass hangs right above the contact points, and any offset lets gravity amplify the lean. But once speed enters the window, a bike tipping left automatically turns its front wheel to the left, the support point slides under the center of mass, and the bike straightens up instead of falling. Self-stability therefore boils down to one question: can lean automatically cause steering in the correct direction? Three mechanisms cooperate. First, gyroscopic precession: the spinning front wheel carries angular momentum of about 1-2 kg·m²/s along its axle; a roll of the frame applies a torque, and by τ = dL/dt the wheel precesses about the steering axis, turning exactly toward the falling side. Second, trail: the steering axis meets the ground ahead of the front contact patch by roughly 3-6 cm, so the contact patch is dragged along behind like a shopping-cart castor, and when the bike leans, gravity steers the wheel toward the lean. Third, front mass: weight ahead of the front axle also pushes the steering - in 2011 Kooijman and colleagues built a two-mass bike with no gyro effect (canceled by a counter-rotating wheel) and no trail (contact patch ahead of the axis), yet properly arranged masses still self-stabilize, proving neither gyro nor trail is essential: what matters is that the whole lean-steer-correct loop has all-negative eigenvalues. The window has edges: at rest the bike always falls; below about 4-5 m/s gravity wins; above about 20-25 m/s a slow capsize divergence and weave oscillation appear, gentle enough to correct by hand. Countersteering is the active use of the same dynamics - to turn right, nudge the bars left first. Head angle around 70-75°, trail, wheelbase and mass distribution together shape the window: cargo bikes put load ahead of the front axle, stable at low speed, twitchy at high speed. Drag the speed and trail sliders to map the stability window yourself; press hands-free recovery for the S-shaped path, trail for the geometry, gyroscopic precession for the three vectors, and experiment for the two-mass bike and the deliberately broken one toppling over. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视自行车停在滚动路面上:前叉转向轴以蓝色虚线延长到地面,黄色线段量出 trail;撒把模式轻拍车身,前轮自动转向倾侧,青色幽灵轨迹拖出 S 形回正;陀螺进动模式在轮轴上叠加自旋 L、力矩 τ 与进动响应三支箭头和小陀螺仪;实验对照模式切换无陀螺无 trail 的两质量骨架车(照常回正)与故意改坏的车(trail 为负,当场倾倒);示波器实时描绘侧倾角与主特征值实部两条曲线。

topics.descZh:
回旋镖是被扔上天的一排旋转机翼:两叶(或三叶)V 形排列,截面像机翼一样上凸下平,出手后高速自转,每叶各自产生升力;奥妙在两叶看到的相对气流不同——出手转速约 8–12 转/s,叶尖线速 v_tip=ω·r 可达 40–50 m/s,前进侧叶尖顺着飞行方向,合速约 v+v_tip,后退侧相减只剩 v−v_tip,升力随速度平方放大,前进侧明显更壮;这道不对称升力合成净力矩 τ,而高速自旋给了镖很大的角动量 L,力矩扳不倒它,只能按 τ=dL/dt 让镖盘绕竖直轴缓慢进晚会——升力方向持续偏转,飞行路径弯成半径约 10–20 m 的圆弧,进晚会速率 Ω_p=τ/L,自旋越快弯得越缓;能量账同样精巧:阻力按线性与平方两档花掉动能,升力倾角的水平分量充当向心力,后半程前进速度耗尽,镖靠剩余自旋滑翔下飘,好镖回旋完成时几乎悬停落掌;出手要领三条:镖面与竖直方向夹 15–30°(掷一枚竖着的盘子,而非飞盘)、俯仰抬约 20°、大力甩腕给自旋,平甩的飞盘式只会直飞不回;别被电影骗了:澳大利亚原住民的主力是重而直飞的狩猎镖,能掷出上百米,会回家的返回镖较轻,多用于游戏与仪式;自旋不足会弯不过来,出手太平会爬升失速,风太大回路会被吹变形——拖「自旋速率」「出手倾角」亲手复现翻车;按「飞行回路」看一圈回家,按「进晚会特写」看 L 与 τ 如何共舞,按「出手要领」对比三种出手,按「失效:转速不足」看直坠出界。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 开阔草原上先画出预测回路虚线与落点环;双叶 V 形镖以近竖直姿态出手、高速自旋,前进侧叶亮橙、后退侧叶暗蓝,两支升力箭头一长一短,渐变光带轨迹绕一大圈后滑翔回手;进晚会特写中镖盘慢转,橙色 L 矢量与红色 τ 矢量互相垂直,绕竖直轴扫出圆锥弧;出手要领并排三条轨迹:近竖直返回、平甩直飞、太平爬升失速;失效模式里镖直冲出界坠地,扬起尘土并亮出「转速不足」警示。
topics.descEn:
A boomerang is a row of spinning wings thrown into the sky: two blades (sometimes three) set in a V, each cross-section an airfoil, convex above and flat below; spinning fast after release, every blade makes lift. The trick is that the two blades see different relative airflow: at a release spin of about 8-12 revolutions per second the tip speed v_tip = ω·r reaches 40-50 m/s, the advancing blade adds its tip speed to the flight speed - roughly v+v_tip - while the trailing side subtracts, leaving only v-v_tip; lift grows with the square of airspeed, so the advancing side clearly wins and the asymmetry adds up to a net torque τ. Fast spin gives the disc a large angular momentum L, so the torque cannot knock it over - by τ=dL/dt it can only swing L slowly around the vertical axis: the disc precesses, the tilt direction keeps rotating, the lift vector turns with it, and the flight path bends into an arc of roughly 10-20 m radius; with Ω_p = τ/L, faster spin means a gentler bend. The energy ledger is just as neat: drag spends the launch energy on two brackets, linear plus quadratic, the horizontal part of the tilted lift acts as centripetal force, and in the second half, forward speed spent, the boomerang glides down on its remaining spin - a good one nearly hovers into your palm. Three rules for throwing: keep the disc only 15-30° from vertical (throw a standing plate, not a frisbee), pitch about 20° above horizontal, and snap the wrist hard for spin - a flat frisbee-style throw just flies straight and never returns. And do not trust the movies: the working tool of Australian Aboriginal hunters was a heavy, straight-flying stick thrown over a hundred metres; the returning boomerang is the lighter one, used for games and ceremonies. Too little spin and it cannot bend; too flat a release and it climbs, stalls and falls; strong wind deforms the circuit. Drag spin rate and release tilt to replay the failures; press flight circuit to watch a full round trip, precession close-up to see L and τ dance, throwing styles to compare three releases, and insufficient spin to watch it dive out of bounds. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 开阔草原上先画出预测回路虚线与落点环;双叶 V 形镖以近竖直姿态出手、高速自旋,前进侧叶亮橙、后退侧叶暗蓝,两支升力箭头一长一短,渐变光带轨迹绕一大圈后滑翔回手;进晚会特写中镖盘慢转,橙色 L 矢量与红色 τ 矢量互相垂直,绕竖直轴扫出圆锥弧;出手要领并排三条轨迹:近竖直返回、平甩直飞、太平爬升失速;失效模式里镖直冲出界坠地,扬起尘土并亮出「转速不足」警示。

topics.descZh: 三体视角:日-地-月夹角决定朔望弦;白道 5° 夹角让食年只两三次——日月食不是月月都有
topics.descEn: Sun-Earth-Moon angle drives the phase; the 5° tilt is why eclipses are twice a year, not twice a month

topics.descZh: 空间站 400 km 高度上引力还有地表的 89%——失重不是没有引力,是整个空间站一直在自由落体;牛顿大炮:横向速度拉到 7.9 km/s,抛物线弯过地平线闭合成圆,每 92 分钟「掉」一圈而永远掉不到地上;点火与再入才是超重,东西落向舱尾。
topics.descEn: At 400 km the station still feels 89% of surface gravity — weightlessness is not absent gravity, it is the whole station in perpetual free fall; Newton's cannon: push muzzle speed to 7.9 km/s and the parabola bends past the horizon into a circle, falling once every 92 minutes and never hitting the ground; burns and reentry are the real heaviness, when things fall toward the tail.

topics.descZh: 铁芯越过 1.4 M☉,电子简并压扛不住,电子被压进质子成中子——半径 12 km、一茶匙 25 亿吨;自转与磁通被守恒定律放大:毫秒周期、10⁸–10¹¹ T 磁场;磁轴歪着扫过地球=脉冲灯塔;拖过 ~2.3 M☉ 的 TOV 极限,连中子简并压也退场——黑洞。
topics.descEn: Past 1.4 M☉ the iron core wins, electrons are pressed into protons — a 12 km star where a teaspoon weighs 2.5 billion tonnes; conservation amplifies spin to milliseconds and flux to 10⁸–10¹¹ T; the tilted magnetic axis sweeps Earth — a pulsar lighthouse; drag past the ~2.3 M☉ TOV limit and even neutron degeneracy exits — black hole.

topics.descZh: 早期宇宙是等离子体雾,光子走不远;38 万岁、T≈3000 K 时质子抓电子成中性原子,雾散了——宇宙第一缕光自由飞行 138 亿年,波长被空间拉长 1100 倍,今天只剩 2.725 K 的完美黑体微波;±0.001% 的温度斑点,是所有星系的设计图。
topics.descEn: The early universe was a plasma fog photons could not cross; at 380,000 years old and T≈3000 K, protons captured electrons into neutral atoms, the fog cleared — and the first light has flown free for 13.8 billion years, stretched 1100× into a 2.725 K near-perfect blackbody of microwaves; its ±0.001% temperature blotches are the blueprint of every galaxy.

topics.descZh: 月球引力差把近远两侧都「拉离」地球,一天两潮;日月同线大潮,90° 小潮——月球每年后退 3.8 cm
topics.descEn: Differential pull lifts both near and far bulges — spring at alignment, neap at 90°; Moon retreats 3.8 cm/year

topics.descZh: 不是距离——是 23.5° 倾角让正午太阳高度角和昼长都跟着变;0° 无四季,45° 加倍
topics.descEn: Not distance but the 23.5° tilt that swings altitude and day length — 0° kills seasons, 45° doubles them

topics.titleZh: 火箭与齐奥尔科夫斯基
topics.descZh: Δv = ve·ln(m0/mf) 指数惩罚,燃料比从 70% 到 99.9% 指数化——3 级火箭才能跑那么远
topics.descEn: Δv = ve·ln(m0/mf): logarithmic penalty, 70% to 99.9% fuel — staging is the only way to the moon

topics.descZh: 光在斜线上变慢,γ = 1/√(1-v²/c²);0.995c → γ=10(μ 子能到地面),GPS 每天快 38 μs
topics.descEn: Light goes diagonal in a moving clock, γ = 1/√(1-v²/c²); muons reach ground because γ≈10, GPS gains 38 µs/day

topics.descZh: 质量让网格下陷,行星沿测地绕行;光也被弯——1919 爱丁顿日食验证 1.75″ 偏折
topics.descEn: Mass dents the mesh, planets follow geodesics; even light bends — Eddington measured 1.75″ at the 1919 eclipse

topics.descZh: 星系钉在网格上不跑,空间本身在涨:光子途中被拉长,v=Hd 现场量出;红移≠多普勒
topics.descEn: Galaxies sit on the grid while space itself grows: photons stretch en route, v=Hd measured live — redshift is not Doppler

topics.descZh: 1/r³ 梯度把恒星拉成面条;小黑洞先撕碎,大黑洞先穿过;外部看冻结变暗
topics.descEn: The 1/r³ gradient noodles a star; small holes shred first, giant ones let you cross; frozen and dimmed from outside

topics.descZh: 双星旋进搅出四极涟漪,Michelson 两臂此长彼消,把 10⁻²¹ 画成啁啾
topics.descEn: An inspiral stirs quadrupole ripples; Michelson arms breathe in quadrature and draw the 10⁻²¹ chirp

topics.descZh: 行星掠过母星挡住千分之一的光:深度 δ=(Rp/R★)² 给半径、周期经开普勒Ⅲ给距离、密度断岩石或气——但只有恰好侧向的轨道才看得见,倾角拖过 89.7° 行星就此消失
topics.descEn: A crossing planet blocks a sliver of starlight: depth δ=(Rp/R★)² gives the radius, Kepler III turns the period into distance, density settles rock vs gas — but only edge-on orbits are ever seen; tilt past 89.7° and it vanishes

topics.descZh: 潮汐不是「拉大」而是「拉差」——近端拉得多远端拉得少且 ∝1/d³,越过 2.44R(ρ_p/ρ_m)^⅓ 自引力失守,冰月被拉成雪茄、炸成珠链,再被差速旋转抹平成环
topics.descEn: Tides don't stretch, they differentiate — near side pulled more than far side, ∝1/d³; inside the Roche limit self-gravity loses, an icy moon bursts into a bead chain that shear smears into a ring

topics.descZh: 随地球旋转的坐标系里,重力+离心合成有效势地形:五个拉格朗日点是三座鞍与两座山顶——L1/L2 要像 JWST 那样站位保持,L4/L5 靠科里奥利这双隐形护栏接住特洛伊小行星的蝌蚪舞
topics.descEn: In Earth's co-rotating frame, gravity plus centrifugal draws an effective-potential landscape of three saddles and two hilltops — L1/L2 need station-keeping, while Coriolis catches Trojan asteroids dancing at L4/L5

topics.descZh: 一颗会喘气的星就是一把自带刻度的尺——量出光变周期 P 得到绝对星等 M,与视星等 m 一比距离到手,哈勃靠它在仙女座打开了宇宙尺度的大门
topics.descEn: A breathing star is a ruler with its own scale — measure the pulsation period to get the absolute magnitude, compare with the apparent magnitude to get the distance; with it Hubble opened the cosmic scale

topics.descZh: 月亮永远同一面不是巧合:潮汐隆起被自转带着「抢前」δ 角,行星的引力回拉形成 ∝sin2δ 的刹车扭矩,直到自转=公转、扭矩归零——动量不灭,自转变慢喂给轨道,月球正以 3.8 cm/yr 远离;水星的 3:2 是椭圆轨道的变奏
topics.descEn: The Moon’s fixed face is no coincidence: spin drags the tidal bulge ahead by δ, and the planet’s pull brakes it with a torque ∝ sin2δ until spin equals orbit and the torque dies — angular momentum isn’t lost, it widens the orbit as the Moon recedes at 3.8 cm/yr; Mercury’s 3:2 is the eccentric variation

topics.descZh: 引力与辐射压顶牛百亿年;烧到铁聚变不再放能,0.1 秒坍缩反弹成超新星——重元素与我们的来源
topics.descEn: Gravity and radiation pressure lock arms for eons; at iron fusion stops paying, collapse rebounds as a supernova — where heavy elements come from

topics.descZh: 质量弯曲时空,光线掠过大质量天体便跟着弯;对准成一线,像被拉成完整的爱因斯坦环;差一点裂成双像与十字;星系团是天然望远镜,把 130 亿年前的星系拉成放大弧,集体剪切画出暗物质地图。
topics.descEn: Mass curves spacetime, so grazing light bends; with source, lens and observer lined up, the image stretches into a full Einstein ring; slightly off-axis it splits into doubles and crosses; clusters act as natural telescopes, turning 13-billion-year-old galaxies into giant arcs, while collective shear maps dark matter.

topics.descZh: 从低圆轨道上高轨,最省燃料的不是硬爬而是两脚切向点火:第一脚把远点恰好顶到目标高度,滑行半个椭圆让引力免费干活,远点第二脚圆化入列;Δv 总账比连续推力省约 16%——去火星同理,但得等 44° 相位角,26 个月一班车。
topics.descEn: Climbing to a high orbit costs least not by brute thrust but two tangential burns: the first raises apogee exactly to the target radius, you coast half an ellipse while gravity works for free, then a second burn at apogee circularizes; the ledger beats continuous thrusting by ~16% — and the same trick flies to Mars, one window every 26 months at 44° phase angle.

topics.descZh: 月球拖着锥形影公转,轨道却斜了 5.14°——大多数新月影子都扫空,只有新月撞上交点(每 ~173 天的食季)才成食:本影横扫出百余公里宽的全食带,白昼变夜;223 个朔望月=242 个交点月≈239 个近点月,18 年 11 天 8 小时后同款日食重演,影带西移 120°。
topics.descEn: The Moon drags a cone of shadow, but its orbit is tilted 5.14° — most new moons miss; only when new moon meets a node (eclipse seasons every ~173 days) does the shadow land, sweeping a 100+ km totality path where day turns to night. 223 synodic = 242 draconic months, so the same eclipse repeats after 6,585.32 days, shifted ~120 deg west.

topics.descZh: 脏雪球冲向太阳,升华出 coma;两条尾当场分家——离子尾笔直背阳,尘埃尾被辐射压甩成金弧;地球穿过旧轨道尘埃带就是流星雨。
topics.descEn: A dirty snowball dives sunward and sublimates a coma; the tails part company — ions blown straight downwind, dust bent into a golden arc by radiation pressure; Earth through the debris stream: a meteor shower.

topics.descZh: 角动量守恒不许气体直落,先绕成盘;差速加湍流把角动量向外搬、质量向内送,引力势能变成光——内缘白热,效率是核聚变的近十倍。
topics.descEn: Angular momentum forbids a straight fall, so the gas spins into a disk; differential rotation plus turbulence trades mass inward for angular momentum outward, turning gravity into light — white-hot at the inner edge, nearly ten times fusion's efficiency.

topics.descZh: 行星参考系里掠双曲线,进出一样快只是方向被掰弯;但行星自己正以 13 km/s 奔日——矢量合成后,从背后掠过就偷到它的轨道动量:日心速度 13→24 km/s,行星反冲却只有 10⁻²¹ m/s;旅行者就这样巡游外行星。
topics.descEn: In the planet's frame a flyby is symmetric — same speed in and out, just bent. But the planet itself runs at 13 km/s; compose the vectors and a trailing flyby steals orbital momentum: heliocentric speed jumps 13→24 km/s while the planet recoils by ~10⁻²¹ m/s. That's how Voyager toured the giants.

topics.descZh: 出发后双方都看对方的钟变慢——对称;重逢却只有一个结果:旅行者更年轻。不对称藏在转身:换了惯性系是绝对的,同时面一跳就吞掉地球世界线上的一大段岁月;4 光年 0.99c:地球过 8.08 年,旅行者只长 1.14 岁;μ子与 GPS 每天都在验证。
topics.descEn: After departure each sees the other's clock run slow — perfectly symmetric; yet the reunion has one verdict: the traveler is younger. The asymmetry hides in the turnaround: switching inertial frames is absolute, and the jumping simultaneity plane swallows a chunk of Earth's worldline; 4 ly at 0.99c: Earth logs 8.08 years, the traveler ages 1.14; muons and GPS verify it daily.

topics.titleZh: 星系旋转曲线与暗物质
topics.descZh: 太阳系里越远转得越慢(v∝1/√r),星系却不是:氢 21 厘米线量到外缘转速几乎不落——与开普勒预期之间的缺口,是一个占总量近九成、至今看不见的晕;把暗物质拉到零,曲线当场塌回开普勒下坠,外缘恒星像脱缰甩出。
topics.descEn: In the solar system, farther means slower (v∝1/√r) — galaxies disagree: measured by the hydrogen 21-cm line, rotation stays flat to the edge; the gap to the Keplerian expectation is a halo of near 90% of the mass, still unseen; drag dark matter to zero and the curve collapses back to Kepler, flinging the outer stars.

topics.descZh: 赤道 25 天、极区 35 天的差速自转把太阳磁场越缠越紧,磁浮力把绞紧的磁流管顶出光球——成对黑子随纬度迁移;极向场被翻转、22 年复原:11 年一个活动周;蒙德蝴蝶图上,黑子带向赤道行军的脚印。
topics.descEn: Differential rotation — 25 days at the equator, 35 at the poles — winds the Sun’s field ever tighter; magnetic buoyancy floats the twisted flux tubes through the photosphere as sunspot pairs marching in latitude; the polar field flips and restores over 22 years: one activity cycle per 11; the Maunder butterfly maps the march.

topics.descZh: 毫秒脉冲星自转稳定性 ~10⁻¹³，是最精准的天然时钟；引力波使地球–脉冲星距离交替伸缩，导致脉冲到达时间提前或推迟；计时阵列的 Hellings-Downs 空间相关是引力波背景的特征指纹——NANOGrav 2023 年报告首批证据。
topics.descEn: Millisecond pulsars have rotational stability ~10⁻¹³ — the most precise natural clocks; gravitational waves alternately stretch and compress Earth–pulsar distances, shifting pulse arrival times; the Hellings-Downs spatial correlation of a PTA is the GW background's fingerprint — NANOGrav reported first evidence in 2023.

topics.descZh: 氢氦锂来自大爆炸；主序星 p-p 链合成氦；红巨星三阿尔法合成碳氧；大质量恒星洋葱层依次烧到铁核坍缩；超新星与中子星并合 r 过程锻造金铀——GW170817 的千新星光谱里检测到了黄金谱线。
topics.descEn: H/He/Li from Big Bang; main-sequence p-p chain makes He; red giant triple-alpha makes C/O; massive stars burn onion layers to an iron core collapse; supernova and neutron-star merger r-process forge gold and uranium — GW170817's kilonova spectrum showed gold lines.

topics.descZh: 星系旋转曲线平坦（非开普勒下降）→暗物质晕；背景星系引力透镜弯曲量超出可见质量；子弹星系团碰撞后气体（电磁阻力）与暗物质（无碰撞）分离——三条独立证据指向占宇宙物质能量 27% 的不可见物质，候选粒子至今未被直接探测。
topics.descEn: Galaxy rotation curves are flat (not Keplerian) → dark matter halo; gravitational lensing bends background galaxies more than visible mass predicts; Bullet Cluster collision separates X-ray gas (EM drag) from dark matter (collisionless) — three independent lines of evidence pointing to 27% of cosmic mass-energy, with no candidate particle directly detected yet.

topics.descZh: 行星不绕恒星转——两者都绕共同质心转,只是恒星那一圈小得多;把它侧过来,谱线随恒星靠近远离周期性红移蓝移,像在呼吸;K=(m_p·sin i)/M_*·(2πG/P)^{1/3} 只给质量下限 m·sin i;1995 年 51 Pegasi 的 4.23 天、57 m/s 摆动敲开热木星的大门;倾角拉到 0°,信号当场消失。
topics.descEn: Planets don't orbit stars — both orbit their common barycenter, the star in a much smaller circle; tipped sideways, its spectral lines breathe red and blue as the star drifts toward and away; K=(m_p·sin i)/M_*·(2πG/P)^{1/3} yields only a lower bound m·sin i; 51 Pegasi's 4.23-day, 57 m/s wobble opened the hot-Jupiter door in 1995; tip the inclination to 0° and the signal vanishes.

topics.descZh: 复合之后宇宙陷入约 1 亿年的黑暗时代，只剩氢氦冷雾；暗物质晕里聚出零金属的蓝白巨星，紫外光子在雾中烧出电离泡，泡一圈圈扩张、吞并，到 z≈6 全宇宙重新透明。拖时间轴看第一颗恒星点亮、电离分数爬满——JWST 深场与 21cm 射电正在读这一页。
topics.descEn: After recombination the universe sinks into ~100 million years of darkness with only a cold hydrogen fog; zero-metal blue giants ignite inside dark halos, ultraviolet photons carve expanding ionization bubbles that swallow their neighbors, and by z≈6 the cosmos turns transparent again. Scrub the timeline to watch the first star flare and the Q bar fill — JWST deep fields and 21cm radio are reading this page now.

topics.descZh: CMB 里 ±10⁻⁵ 的密度涨落在引力放大下滚雪球：3 万颗粒子按 Zel'dovich 近似从近均匀流进细丝、节点与空洞，密处拧成星系团逐个点亮，稀处被掏成巨泡；暗物质先搭骨架，气体沿丝流进节点点亮星系。拖时间滑块快进 138 亿年，把引力增强拨到 0 就得到永远均匀的对照宇宙。
topics.descEn: Density ripples of ±10⁻⁵ in the CMB snowball under gravity: 32,768 particles, displaced by a Zel'dovich field, pour themselves out of near-uniformity into filaments, knots and voids; the densest nodes light up as galaxy clusters while dark matter builds the skeleton gas streams along. Scrub 13.8 billion years, or set the gravity gain to zero for a forever-uniform control universe.

topics.descZh: 1998 年两个团队用 Ia 型超新星测哈勃图，发现远端样本比「减速膨胀」预期更暗——膨胀在加速；爱因斯坦的 Λ 项复活：真空自带恒定能量密度，负压强产生斥力；拖动 Ω_m/Ω_Λ/w 三个滑块，a(t) 曲线当场由凸翻凹，命运在热寂、大撕裂与大挤压之间改判。
topics.descEn: In 1998 two teams measuring Type Ia supernovae on the Hubble diagram found distant ones dimmer than any decelerating model — expansion is speeding up. Einstein's Λ returned: vacuum carries a constant energy density whose negative pressure pushes. Drag Ω_m/Ω_Λ/w and watch a(t) curl from concave-down to concave-up, re-judging the fate between heat death, big rip and big crunch.

topics.descZh: 星系内恒星间距是恒星直径的千万倍：两个星系互穿，恒星几乎零碰撞，潮汐力却甩出两条镜像长尾；气体云迎头相撞、耗能压缩成星暴点亮新恒星，动力学摩擦把轨道能量一圈圈耗掉，第三次穿心后并成一颗椭圆星系——恒星相撞计数器全程纹丝不动。
topics.descEn: Stellar spacing is ten million stellar diameters: when two galaxies pass through each other, stars almost never collide — tides fling out two mirror tidal tails, gas clouds slam head-on and compress into a starburst, and dynamical friction bleeds orbital energy until the cores spiral in and relax into one elliptical — while the star-collision counter never leaves zero.

topics.descZh: 公转周期成小整数比时，摄动每次都在同一相位叠加：柯克伍德空隙里木星把共振带的小行星一次次拽飞；冥王星 3:2 锁相反而成了保护伞，会合永远避开海王星；木卫一被 4:2:1 反复揉搓，潮汐热撑起活火山。拖周期比滑块扫过 2:1，轨迹当场被「犁」成摆动甩出。
topics.descEn: When orbital periods form small integer ratios, perturbations stack at the same phase every pass: Jupiter ejects asteroids from the 2:1 and 3:1 Kirkwood gaps, Pluto's 3:2 lock becomes a guardian that keeps every conjunction far from Neptune, and Io, kneaded by the 4:2:1 Laplace resonance, glows with tidal volcanism. Drag the period-ratio slider across 2:1 and watch a trajectory get plowed into ejection.

topics.descZh: 轨道力学最反直觉的一课：想追上前方的目标不能加速——前喷抬轨、周期变长反而落后；正确动作是后喷降轨，用高度差换角速度悄悄逼近。相对距离、接近速度与轨道高度差 Δa 三条读数同时讲清「刹车才是油门」；末段把速度压进 0.5 m/s 内才算软对接，太快判坠毁。
topics.descEn: Orbital mechanics' most counterintuitive lesson: to catch a target ahead you must brake — a prograde burn raises your orbit and lengthens your period, while a retro burn trades altitude for angular rate and sneaks you closer. Range, closing rate and Δa readouts tell one story ("braking is the accelerator"); only sub-0.5 m/s contact counts as docking — any faster is judged a crash.

topics.descZh: 前景星恰好从背景星前经过，引力把星光弯进爱因斯坦环，亮度对称隆起 20 倍再落回；透镜若带行星，主峰旁再叠一个几小时到几天的窄尖峰；放大率只由投影间距与爱因斯坦半径之比决定，事件不重复——所以要看住千万颗背景星。
topics.descEn: A foreground star drifts across a background star: gravity bends the light into an Einstein ring and brightness humps 20x, symmetrically; if the lens carries a planet, a narrow hours-to-days spike stacks beside the peak. Magnification depends only on separation in Einstein radii, events never repeat — so millions of stars must be watched at once.

topics.descZh: 45 亿年前火星大小的忒伊亚斜撞原地球：铁核并入地核，硅酸盐幔碎屑热溅入轨道，在洛希极限外吸积成月球；月球的低密度、与地幔一致的同位素指纹、地月角动量预算，三条证据都指向这一次大碰撞；潮汐演化再把月球从 3.8 R⊕ 推到今天的 60 R⊕。
topics.descEn: 4.5 Gya a Mars-sized Theia struck the proto-Earth obliquely: iron merged into the core, silicate mantle splashed into orbit, and matter beyond the Roche limit accreted into the Moon; lunar low density, Earth-mantle isotope fingerprints and the angular-momentum budget all point to this single blow; tides then pushed the Moon from 3.8 to 60 Earth radii.

topics.descZh: 火星在星空上大多向东走，每隔约 26 个月却减速、停留、倒退几周再恢复；地心说要本轮套本轮才解释得了，日心模型只需一句话——地球在内圈跑得快，超车时火星在背景上相对倒退；同一份观测，切个视角就换了一种宇宙观。
topics.descEn: Mars drifts east among the stars, yet every ~26 months it slows, stations, backs up for weeks and resumes; geocentrism needed wheels upon wheels, heliocentrism needs one line — Earth runs faster on the inside lane, so Mars slides backward during the overtake. Same data, one viewpoint switch, two cosmologies.

topics.descZh: 标准大爆炸有三桩悬案：宇宙为何平坦（Ω≈1）、天区两侧为何温度一致、磁单极哪去了；暴胀一次全解——大爆炸后 ~10⁻³⁶ 秒空间指数膨胀 e⁶⁰ 倍，褶皱被当场拉平（|Ω−1|∝e^(−2N)）、因果相连的区域被拉开、单极被稀释到 e^(−3N)；被拉到宇宙尺度的量子涨落，冻结成 CMB 的 ΔT/T≈10⁻⁵ 温度斑点。
topics.descEn: The hot Big Bang leaves three puzzles: why the universe is flat (Ω≈1), why opposite skies share one temperature, where the magnetic monopoles went. Inflation solves all three at once: at ~10⁻³⁶ s space stretched e⁶⁰-fold, flattening wrinkles (|Ω−1|∝e^(−2N)), pulling causally connected regions apart, and diluting monopoles by e^(−3N) — while quantum fluctuations stretched to cosmic scale froze into the CMB's ΔT/T≈10⁻⁵ spots.

topics.descZh: 环是洛希极限内的碎屑海：潮汐力太陡，粒子永远聚不成卫星；内圈快、外圈慢的开普勒差速把一条放射状"染色线"剪成螺旋，碰撞再把环摊成万公里宽、几十米薄；牧羊卫星扫出缝隙，卡西尼缝正落在与土卫一 2:1 共振处，F 环被两只牧羊犬夹成细线。
topics.descEn: Rings are a debris sea inside the Roche limit: tides are too steep for accretion. Keplerian shear (inner laps outer) winds a dyed radial line into a spiral while collisions flatten the ring; shepherd moons sweep gaps, the Cassini Division rides a 2:1 resonance with Mimas, and the F ring is pinched by two shepherds.

topics.descZh: 金星与地球同尺寸同密度，只因离太阳近 30%、日照 1.9 倍便步步失控：海洋蒸发→水汽增浓温室→更热蒸发更多的正反馈越过阈值，整片海洋蒸入大气；紫外把水光解、轻氢逃逸太空（D/H 达地球百倍），无板块埋碳、CO₂ 积成 92 bar、465 °C——宜居带边缘不在星际远方，就卡在 0.72 AU。
topics.descEn: Venus is Earth's twin — same size, same rock — only 30% closer to the Sun. With 1.9× the sunlight the feedback runs away: oceans evaporate, vapor thickens the greenhouse, heat drives more evaporation past the point of no return. UV splits the water and the hydrogen escapes (D/H 100× Earth); with no tectonics to bury carbon, CO₂ piles up to 92 bar and 465 °C. The habitable edge lies not in deep space but between 0.72 and 1.0 AU.

topics.descZh: 地球公转给你一条 2 AU 的可移动基线：半年前后各拍一张，近星在遥远背景上挪出一个角秒级的小角 p；p=1″ 恰为 1 秒差距 3.26 光年，角度减半距离翻倍——视差只够量几百秒差距，更远换造父与 Ia 超新星接力；1838 年贝塞尔测出天鹅座 61。
topics.descEn: Earth's orbit hands you a movable 2 AU baseline: shoot six months apart and a nearby star shifts by a tiny angle p against the distant background; p = 1″ means exactly 1 parsec, 3.26 light-years, and halving the angle doubles the distance — parallax runs out a few hundred parsecs out, where Cepheids and Type Ia supernovae take over; Bessel made the first cut in 1838 with 61 Cygni.

topics.descZh: 光子没有质量也要守恒量：从恒星表面爬到远处，势能升高，只能从频率上扣账——ν 变小、波长变长、颜色偏红；太阳红移 2×10⁻⁶，白矮星 10⁻⁴，1959 年庞德-雷布卡在 22.5 m 楼梯间测出地球版；GPS 卫星每天快 38 μs，一半账来自这里。
topics.descEn: Even massless photons must balance energy: climbing out of a gravity well raises potential, and the frequency pays — ν drops, wavelength stretches, color reddens; the Sun shifts light by 2×10⁻⁶, white dwarfs by 10⁻⁴, and Pound–Rebka measured Earth's own across a 22.5 m stairwell in 1959; half of GPS's 38 μs/day gain comes from exactly this.

topics.descZh: 潮汐锁定让月球永以同一面对地，但三重"晃"让我们一生能看 59%：自转轴倾斜 6.7° 的纬天平动；椭圆轨道上自转匀速、公转忽快忽慢的经天平动 ±7.9°；再加上视差——边缘环形山轮流登场，背面直到 1959 年才被 Luna 3 拍到。
topics.descEn: Tidal locking keeps one face Earthward forever, yet three wobbles let us see 59% in a lifetime: a 6.7° axial tilt swings latitude, the elliptical orbit makes rotation uniform while revolution speeds and slows to give ±7.9° of longitude, and parallax adds the rest — limb craters take turns appearing, and the far side waited for Luna 3 in 1959.

topics.descZh: 光子动量乘两倍砸在镜面上:1 AU 处每平米 9 微牛,小却不停——面积质量比决定加速度;光压与引力都随距离平方衰减,比值 β 恒定,β 大于 1 连太阳引力都按不住;调帆角就能爬轨或降轨。
topics.descEn: Photons land double momentum on a mirror: 9 micronewtons per square meter at 1 AU — tiny, but nonstop — and area per mass sets the acceleration; sunlight and gravity both fade with r², so their ratio β is constant, and past β=1 even the Sun can't hold the sail; tilt it to climb or descend.

topics.descZh: 木星的潮汐力把木卫一拖成橄榄,偏心轨道让揉捏一秒不停,摩擦把每秒十万亿焦耳塞进内部——400 座火山就是这么点着的;欧罗巴、盖尼米德的 1:2:4 共振负责不让轨道圆化。
topics.descEn: Jupiter's tide stretches Io into an olive and the eccentric orbit never stops kneading, with friction pumping ten trillion watts inside — that's what lights 400 volcanoes; Europa and Ganymede's 1:2:4 Laplace resonance keeps the orbit from circularizing.

topics.descZh: 彗星每次回归都往轨道上撒一层尘,地球每年同一天撞进同一条带:平行的尘埃在透视里汇成辐射点;一粒沙以 60 km/s 撞上大气,靠冲击压缩而非摩擦烧蚀发光——速度和粒径决定亮度。
topics.descEn: Each comet return lays down a fresh layer of dust along its orbit, and Earth punches through the same band the same week each year: parallel trails converge into a radiant by perspective; a sand grain at 60 km/s glows by shock compression, not friction — speed and size set the brightness.

topics.descZh: 光球 5500 ℃,上空的日冕反而上百万度:磁重联与波耗散把能量倒进等离子体,粒子挣脱引力吹成 450 km/s 的风——彗尾与极光都是它签的名
topics.descEn: The 5500 °C photosphere sits under a million-degree corona: reconnection and wave dissipation pour energy into the plasma until particles escape as a 450 km/s wind — comet ion tails and auroras are its signatures

topics.descZh: 轨道面侧对我们就掩食:光变曲线的深谷是温度差、周期是距离;加上谱线多普勒一摆,质量不用猜——开普勒替你算
topics.descEn: Edge-on orbits eclipse: the light curve's deep dip is the temperature gap, the period is the distance, and the Doppler sway of the spectral lines hands over the masses — Kepler does the bookkeeping

topics.descZh: 光度对温度一撒点,九成的星排成对角主序:位置就是质量,质量就是寿命;蓝巨星烧得凶死得快,红矮星熬千亿年,太阳钉在带中
topics.descEn: Scatter luminosity against temperature and ninety percent of stars fall on a diagonal band: position is mass, mass is lifespan — blue giants burn fast and die young, red dwarfs outlive the universe, and the Sun sits mid-band

topics.descZh: 核火烧尽后引力还想再压,可泡利不相容不许电子挤同一格:压得越狠费米海越高,简并压与温度无关地顶住引力;质量加到 1.4 M☉ 连它也失守——钱德拉塞卡极限
topics.descEn: After the nuclear fire dies gravity keeps squeezing, but Pauli exclusion forbids electrons from sharing a cell: squeeze harder and the Fermi sea rises — degeneracy pressure holds regardless of temperature until 1.4 solar masses, where even it fails: the Chandrasekhar limit

topics.descZh: 木星的潮汐力每圈把冰卫星揉捏一遍,形变摩擦的热在十几公里冰壳下焐出一片液态海洋:裂痕、混沌地形和喷向太空的羽流,都是内海写给外面的信
topics.descEn: Jupiter's tides knead the icy moon every orbit, and friction from that flexing warms a liquid ocean beneath kilometers of ice: fractures, chaos terrain and plumes jetting to space are the hidden sea's letters out

topics.descZh: 微米尘埃在气盘里沉降粘连滚成鹅卵石,向心漂移中聚成星子,寡头吸积让大者恒大:气巨必须在盘的气体耗散前抢下自己的氢氦大气——剩下的盘就是行星的出生证明
topics.descEn: Micron dust settles, sticks and rolls into pebbles that drift inward into planetesimals, and oligarchic accretion lets the biggest eat: gas giants must grab their hydrogen before the disk gas is gone — the leftover disk is the birth certificate

topics.titleZh: 小行星带与柯克伍德空隙
topics.descZh: 木星每隔几圈把共振轨道上的小行星同方向踹一脚：偏心率被泵高、轨道闯进火星以内，主带被掏出一道道缝——3:1、5:2、7:3、2:1，这些空隙是木星清场的签名
topics.descEn: Jupiter kicks resonant asteroids the same way every few orbits: eccentricities get pumped until orbits cross Mars, and the main belt is carved into gaps — 3:1, 5:2, 7:3, 2:1 — signatures of Jupiter sweeping the floor.

topics.descZh: 一颗 TeV 宇宙线撞进大气，核级联逐级倍增：π⁰ 分出电磁枝、μ 子直穿到底——数百万粒子织成薄毯扫过地面阵列，反推能量与方向，一颗粒子讲出一场雨的来历
topics.descEn: One TeV cosmic ray slams into the air and the cascade doubles generation after generation: π⁰ spawns the electromagnetic branch while muons punch through — millions of particles sweep the ground, and arrays read back energy and direction.

topics.titleZh: 近日点进动与广义相对论
topics.descZh: 牛顿引力给出闭合椭圆，水星近日点却每百年多进动 43 角秒：太阳压弯的时空等效出 −1/r³ 修正项，椭圆不再闭合、画成花瓣——574=531+43，这是广义相对论的第一场胜仗
topics.descEn: Newton closes the orbit as an ellipse, yet Mercury's perihelion drifts 43″ per century beyond all planetary tugs: curved spacetime adds a −1/r³ term and the rosette refuses to close — 574 = 531 + 43, general relativity's first victory.

topics.titleZh: 日冕物质抛射与空间天气
topics.descZh: 扭缠的磁绳在日面蓄力,失稳一抛就是十亿吨等离子体冲向地球:一天半后撞上磁层顶,重连开闸——电网感应电流、卫星翻滚、极光低纬可见,太阳打了个喷嚏,地球重感冒
topics.descEn: A twisted flux rope stores up on the Sun and erupts: a billion tonnes of plasma rides toward Earth, hits the magnetosphere a day and a half later, reconnection opens the gate — grid currents, tumbling satellites, auroras at low latitudes. The Sun sneezes; Earth catches the flu

topics.descZh: 白矮星趴在伴星身上吸氢,表面壳层越积越热:攒到千万开就 runaway 炸壳——星星不毁,亮度暴涨再回落,过些年再来一次;攒-炸循环是双星的呼吸
topics.descEn: A white dwarf siphons hydrogen from its companion; the surface shell thickens and heats until, at ten million kelvin, it detonates in a runaway — the star survives, brightness soars and fades, and years later it happens again: accrete-and-blow is the binary's breathing

topics.descZh: 气体分子速度有分布,高斯尾巴总有一撮超过逃逸速度:行星太轻或太热,大气就一点一点漏光——火星丢了磁层被太阳风剥,金星蒸干的水只剩重水作证
topics.descEn: Molecular speeds spread out, and the Gaussian tail always has a few over escape velocity: too light or too hot a planet leaks its air a molecule at a time — Mars lost its magnetic shield and was stripped by the solar wind; Venus boiled its water away and the leftover deuterium testifies

topics.descZh: 旋臂不是固定的星群而是交通堵塞:恒星穿行而过,在稠密处减速聚集又驶离——密度波慢转,星星快行,旋臂因此永不散架; compression 还顺手点亮恒星育婴室
topics.descEn: Spiral arms are not fixed memberships but traffic jams: stars cruise through, bunch up where it's dense and sail on — the wave rotates slowly while the stars move fast, so the pattern never winds up; the compression lights stellar nurseries on the way

topics.descZh: -179 °C 的土卫六把甲烷当地球的水:甲烷云、甲烷雨、甲烷河湖与蒸发循环一应俱全——重力小大气厚,人挥动胳膊就能飞;唯一已知有液体循环的另一颗世界,只是液体不是水
topics.descEn: At −179 °C Titan runs its weather on methane the way Earth runs it on water: methane clouds, methane rain, rivers, lakes and evaporation in a full cycle — with weak gravity and thick air, a human could fly by flapping; the only other world with a surface liquid cycle, except the liquid isn't water

topics.descZh: 阿波罗宇航员留下的五面反射镜,至今仍在替月球报距离:激光往返 2.5 秒测到毫米级——月球正以 3.8 cm/年漂离,地球自转随之变慢;潮汐在给地月系「记账」
topics.descEn: Five reflectors left by Apollo astronauts still file the Moon's distance report: laser pulses make the 2.5-second round trip to millimeters — and the Moon drifts away 3.8 cm per year while Earth's spin slows; the tides keep the books for the Earth-Moon system

topics.descZh: 木星没有地面,只有风:几千条纬向急流把云梳成平行条纹,自转 9.9 小时把一切拧成横向;大红斑是一场比地球还宽的反气旋,吹了至少 350 年——没有陆地摩擦、没有昼夜温差,风暴就没有散场的理由;它如今在缩小,却依旧是最长寿的天气
topics.descEn: Jupiter has no ground, only wind: zonal jet streams comb the clouds into parallel bands, and a 9.9-hour spin flattens everything sideways; the Great Red Spot is an anticyclone wider than Earth that has raged for at least 350 years — no land to rub against, no day-night swing, no reason for the storm to close; it is shrinking now, yet still the longest-running weather there is

topics.descZh: 海王星之外,几十万颗冰质残片散布在 30–50 天文单位的环带里——行星没长成的地方、彗星的冷库;冥王星、阋神星们住在其中,因为清不干净各自的邻居而被请出行星名单;2:3 轨道共振让冥王星与海王星永远错峰见面:最远的邻居,也是最有默契的邻居
topics.descEn: Beyond Neptune, hundreds of thousands of icy shards litter a ring 30–50 AU out — where a planet failed to grow, and the comet deep-freeze; Pluto and Eris live there, demoted from the planet list for never clearing their neighbors; the 2:3 resonance means Pluto and Neptune can never meet: the farthest neighbors, and the best-choreographed

topics.descZh: 银河系中心藏着一团 430 万倍太阳质量的「空无」:恒星 S2 用 16 年一圈的狂奔轨道替它称重——近心点掠过时速度冲到 7600 km/s;轨道不会撒谎:2020 年诺贝尔物理学奖把证据钉在了这一点上
topics.descEn: At the Milky Way's center hides a 4-million-solar-mass nothing: the star S2 weighs it for us with a 16-year orbit that whips past at 7,600 km/s at closest approach; orbits don't lie — the 2020 Nobel Prize pinned the evidence right there

topics.descZh: 轨道高度决定周期,与地球自转同步的只有一条:35786 km——低一点东逃、高一点西退,只有这里从地面看钉死不动;倾角让地面轨迹画 8 字,年年烧燃料做位置保持;赤道上空这一圈是通讯卫星的黄金地段
topics.descEn: Altitude sets the period and only one ring matches Earth’s spin: 35,786 km — lower flees east, higher lags west; only here does a satellite pin to one spot; inclination turns the ground track into a figure-8 that burns station-keeping fuel; the equatorial ring is comsat gold real estate

topics.descZh: 天王星越走越偏离牛顿引力算出的轨道——勒维耶断定是远处未知行星在拽,用残差反推它的质量与方位;1846 年 9 月 23 日柏林朝预言位置望去,海王星就在不到 1° 的地方——一颗先在纸上跑起来的行星
topics.descEn: Uranus kept straying from its Newtonian orbit — Le Verrier bet an unseen planet was tugging and worked the residuals into a mass and position; on Sept 23, 1846 Berlin looked where the numbers pointed and found Neptune within 1° — a planet that ran on paper first

topics.titleZh: 地轴岁差与北极星轮换
topics.descZh: 地球像倾斜的陀螺,赤道隆起被日月引力拽着,自转轴在天上画一个 25772 年的圆——北极星只是暂时租客:从前是天龙座 α,如今勾陈一,12000 年后织女星;春分点西移,回归年因此短了 20 分钟
topics.descEn: Earth is a tilted top whose equatorial bulge the Sun and Moon tug, so the axis draws a 25,772-year circle — the North Star is a temporary tenant: Thuban once, Polaris now, Vega in 12,000 years; equinoxes slide west, and the tropical year runs 20 minutes short

topics.descZh: 两体有圆锥曲线的精确解,三体一般没有:庞加莱证明初值敏感——两份只差百万分之一的初始条件,几圈后分道扬镳;8 字与等边三角是侥幸的周期解;确定性方程照样不可长期预测,这就是混沌
topics.descEn: Two bodies have exact conic solutions; three generally don't: Poincaré showed sensitive dependence — states differing by one part in a million part ways after a few orbits; the figure-8 and Lagrange triangle are lucky exceptions; deterministic equations, unpredictable futures — chaos

topics.descZh: 宇宙最亮的爆炸一半靠能量一半靠准:核坍缩或并合把能量装进 Γ~100 的两极相对论喷流,对准你时多普勒聚束增亮上亿倍;偏轴只见暗淡余辉;瞬时 γ 秒级、余辉跨波段按幂律衰减——短暴附赠千新星与引力波
topics.descEn: The universe's brightest flashes owe as much to aim as to energy: collapse or merger loads Γ~100 relativistic jets, and beaming brightens them a hundred-million-fold when pointed at you; off-axis sees a dim afterglow; short bursts add a kilonova and gravitational waves

topics.titleZh: 系外行星大气与透射光谱
topics.descZh: 凌星的星光会擦过行星大气边缘一圈:H₂O、CH₄、CO₂ 各在波长上咬出深浅不一的坑,凌内减凌外就是透射谱;特征大小 ∝ 标高 H=kT/μg——氢大气的巨行星坑深,重大气岩质行星只有几~几十 ppm;高层云能抹平一切特征
topics.descEn: Starlight skims the atmosphere's rim during transit: H₂O, CH₄ and CO₂ bite distinct dips by wavelength, and in-transit minus out-of-transit is the transmission spectrum; features scale with scale height H=kT/μg — puffy hydrogen worlds bite deep, rocky atmospheres only ppm

topics.titleZh: 黑洞阴影与事件视界望远镜
topics.descZh: 引力把光弯成透镜:光子球在 1.5 rs 挤出光子环,阴影直径 √27·rs≈2.6 rs——比视界大一圈半;吸积盘多普勒束流让转向我们的一侧亮几倍;EHT 把 8 台毫米波望远镜合成地球巨镜(230 GHz、~20 µas),2019 年照出 M87*
topics.descEn: Gravity lenses light itself: the photon sphere at 1.5 rs rings the shadow, which spans √27·rs ≈ 2.6 rs — half again bigger than the horizon; Doppler beaming brightens the approaching side of the disk; the EHT ties eight millimeter telescopes into an Earth-sized mirror (~20 µas) and photographed M87* in 2019

topics.descZh: 大质量恒星坍缩,磁通守恒加发电机把磁场放大到 10¹⁴–10¹⁵ 高斯(脉冲星的百倍以上);磁能缓慢扭曲 2–12 s 慢转的星壳,超限就星震——磁力线重排、闪光;2004 年 SGR 1806-20 巨耀发 0.2 s 释放 ~2×10³⁹ erg,伽马射线从 4.5 万光年外打到地球电离层;磁场约 10⁴ 年耗尽,转入普通 X 射线脉冲星
topics.descEn: Core collapse, by flux conservation plus a dynamo, amplifies the field to 10^14-10^15 gauss — hundreds of a pulsar's. The field slowly twists the crust of a 2-12 s spinner until it starquakes and the lines snap: the 2004 SGR 1806-20 flare poured ~2×10³⁹ erg in 0.2 s, its gamma front denting Earth's ionosphere from 45,000 ly. In ~10⁴ years the field dies into an ordinary X-ray pulsar.

topics.descZh: 同批出生 → 同龄同距同成分;质量越大烧得越快(t∝M^−2.5),主序在转折点拐向巨星支——转折点越低星团越老:昴星团 ~1 亿年、毕星团 ~7 亿、M13 ~120 亿;一张 HR 图称出一个星团的年龄,最老的一批称出宇宙的下限
topics.descEn: A cluster's stars share one birth — same age, distance, chemistry. Massive stars burn out first (t∝M^-2.5), so the main sequence peels away at the turnoff: the lower the turnoff, the older the cluster — Pleiades ~100 Myr, Hyades ~700 Myr, M13 ~12 Gyr. One HR diagram weighs a cluster's age, and the oldest weigh the universe.

topics.titleZh: 火星车 EDL 与天空起重机
topics.descZh: 火星大气只有地球 0.6%:稀薄到气动刹不死、稠密到纯火箭太浪费——5.8 km/s 进热盾扛 ~10 g 峰值,马赫 1.7 开 21.5 m 伞把 400 m/s 磨到 ~100,2 km 抛伞换 8 台变推力发动机,最后 20 m 天空起重机悬停、0.75 m/s 匀速放缆 7.5 m 把火星车放到轮子接地,随后自己飞离坠毁——419 秒,一次机会
topics.descEn: Mars air is 0.6% of Earth's — too thin to brake on, too thick to ignore: 5.8 km/s entry under a ~10 g peak, a 21.5 m chute opening at Mach 1.7 to grind 400 m/s to ~100, engines taking over at 2 km, and the last 20 m to the sky crane — hovering, paying out the rover on 7.5 m bridles at 0.75 m/s, then flying itself away to crash. 419 seconds, one shot.

topics.descZh: pp 链预言的电子中微子,戴维斯氯探测器只测到 1/3、超级神冈约 1/2——太阳模型没错,是中微子在飞行途中变味:三味混合 θ₁₂≈33°、MSW 物质效应推波助澜;SNO 重水三通道齐测,总流量与预言精确吻合(2002)
topics.descEn: Electron neutrinos predicted by the pp-chain arrived at one third strength in Davis's chlorine tank, half in Super-K — the Sun was right; the neutrinos changed flavor in flight: three-type mixing at θ₁₂≈33°, boosted by the MSW matter effect; SNO's heavy water counted all flavors and matched the Sun exactly (2002)

topics.titleZh: 火星稀薄大气与全球尘暴
topics.titleEn: Mars: Thin Air & Global Dust Storms
topics.descZh: 火星地表气压 6.4 hPa、只有地球的 0.6%:液态水几 °C 就沸,降落伞不够用、毅力号靠天空起重机吊放;没有全球磁场,太阳风几十亿年剥蚀大气;全球尘暴自我放大——扬尘吸光升温、风更大、扬更多尘,数周裹住整颗星球
topics.descEn: Surface pressure is 6.4 hPa, 0.6% of Earth's: water boils at a few °C and parachutes alone can't land you, so Perseverance dangled from a sky crane; with no global magnetic field the solar wind has stripped the air for eons; global dust storms feed themselves — dust absorbs sunlight, winds grow, more dust lifts

topics.descZh: 星系中心 10⁶–10¹⁰ M☉ 黑洞以 ~10% 质能效率吸积(聚变仅 0.7%),10⁸ M☉ 即可发出 ~10⁴⁰ W、比整个星系亮千倍;爱丁顿极限是辐射压天花板、超线供给被吹走;盘+宽线区+尘埃环+窄线区+喷流是同一台引擎,视线角滑块当场把它翻成类星体、BL Lac 或 2 型射电星系;燃料耗尽回归普通星系
topics.descEn: A 10⁶–10¹⁰ M☉ black hole accretes at ~10% mass-to-radiation efficiency (fusion: 0.7%) — 10⁸ M☉ alone emits ~10⁴⁰ W, a thousand times its host; the Eddington limit is the radiation-pressure ceiling; disk, broad/narrow-line regions, torus and jets are one engine — the viewing-angle slider flips it between quasar, BL Lac and Type-2 radio galaxy; out of fuel it fades to a normal galaxy

topics.titleZh: 自适应光学与激光导星
topics.descZh: 大气湍流搅碎波前,星像糊成 ~1″ 视宁度斑——8 m 镜衍射极限 0.014″ 被大气没收;夏克–哈特曼阵列测波前斜率、变形镜每秒 ~1000 次打出共轭面形,闭环合上瞬间残差从 ~3 μm 压到 ~0.2 μm、Strehl 比跳上 50%+,糊斑收成衍射环、双星当场一分为二;589 nm 激光在 ~90 km 钠层造人工导星
topics.descEn: Turbulence crumples wavefronts into the ~1″ seeing blob — an 8 m mirror's 0.014″ diffraction limit is confiscated by the air; a Shack–Hartmann array reads wavefront slopes, a deformable mirror reshapes ~1000×/s, and the instant the loop closes the blob snaps into diffraction rings and a binary splits in two; a 589 nm laser forges a guide star in the sodium layer at ~90 km

topics.descZh: 天王星自转轴倾角 97.8°,几乎躺进轨道面——主流解释是形成晚期被地球大小天体斜撞;84 年公转让两极轮流指日、每极 42 年极昼极夜;27+ 卫星与 13 条环全在赤道面跟着躺倒,轨道面即撞击物证;磁轴偏 59° 且偏心,磁层像歪灯泡翻滚;对照地球 23.5° 宜居、金星 177° 近倒转
topics.descEn: Uranus spins at 97.8°, nearly flat in its orbit — best explained by a late Earth-sized impact; the inertially locked axis gives each pole 42 years of midnight sun, then 42 of night; all 27+ moons and 13 rings ride the tipped equator, the impact's fingerprint; the magnetic axis leans 59° off-center, tumbling like a crooked bulb; Earth lives at 23.5°, Venus nearly flipped at 177°

topics.descZh: 外核 2260 km 液态铁(4000–6000 K)对流;自转把热柱拧成螺旋柱;导电流体切割磁感线感生新磁场,Re_m≈700≫临界 50,自激 35 亿年;偶极场 25–65 μT,磁压平衡太阳风把磁层顶撑在 10 R⊕;78 万年前翻极,海底条带镜像记录;关掉自转当场看磁场指数衰减、磁层塌到 1.1 R⊕
topics.descEn: A 2,260 km-thick outer core of liquid iron at 4,000–6,000 K convects; Coriolis coils the flow into helical columns; conducting fluid slicing field lines induces new field, and with Re_m≈700 far above the critical 50 it has self-sustained for 3.5 billion years. The dipole holds 25–65 μT at the surface and balances the solar wind, holding the magnetopause at ~10 R⊕. Switch the spin off and the field decays exponentially, collapsing the shield to 1.1 R⊕

topics.titleEn: Big Bang Nucleosynthesis & the Helium Abundance
topics.descZh: 1 s 时 T≈10¹⁰ K,弱作用掉队把中子/质子冻结在 1/6;自由中子以 τ≈880 s 衰减,到点火只剩约 1/7;T≈10⁹ K(约 3 min)2.2 MeV 的氘瓶颈才守得住,D→³He→⁴He 链式抢烧;几乎所有中子锁进 ⁴He,Y_p=2(n/p)/(1+n/p)≈25%,其余 75% 是氢;残留 D/H=2.5×10⁻⁵ 反推重子密度 Ω_b h²=0.022;推偏密度滑块,太快几乎全变氦、太慢连氘都不剩
topics.descEn: At 1 s the universe sat at T≈10¹⁰ K and weak interactions froze the neutron/proton ratio at 1/6; free neutrons decay with τ≈880 s, leaving ~1/7 by ignition. When T≈10⁹ K (~3 min) the 2.2 MeV deuterium bottleneck finally holds, D→³He→⁴He chain-burns, and nearly all neutrons lock into ⁴He — Y_p=2(n/p)/(1+n/p)≈25%, the rest 75% hydrogen. Leftover D/H=2.5×10⁻⁵ back-solves the baryon density Ω_b h²=0.022; push the density slider and a universe that burns too fast turns almost entirely to helium while one too slow never even makes deuterium

topics.descZh: 570 kg 的 DART 以 6.1 km/s 撞上 160 m 的 Dimorphos,动量 p=mv=3.5×10⁶ kg·m/s 只是底仓;真正干活的是反喷的碎屑羽流,动量增强因子 β 冲到 3.6;Δv=βp/M≈2.7 mm/s,双星周期当场从 11:55 缩到 11:23(−32 min);偏移=Δv×预警时间:提前 10 年,1 cm/s 攒出 3,200 km——半个地球半径;按下撞击,看 β 爬升、周期读数当场缩短
topics.descEn: DART's 570 kg body hits 160 m Dimorphos at 6.1 km/s, carrying p = mv = 3.5×10⁶ kg·m/s, but the ejecta plume is the real engine: it lifts the momentum enhancement to β ≈ 3.6, so Δv = βp/M ≈ 2.7 mm/s shortened the binary period from 11:55 to 11:23. Miss distance = Δv × warning time: ten years of lead turns 1 cm/s into 3,200 km, half an Earth radius. Press Impact and watch β climb while the period readout drops live

topics.descZh: 太阳表面以 ~5 分钟周期起伏(p 模驻波),已证认模式超过 10⁶ 个——每个模式的穿透深度由空间尺度决定:小模式待浅层、大模式穿核心,百万模式的频谱就是太阳的"CT";反演出声速剖面与标准模型在 0.713 R☉(对流层底)的细小偏差;频率分裂读出内部差旋:赤道 25 d、极区 34 d,而辐射区近乎刚体 27 d——tachocline 剪切层是磁场发电机的摇篮;远侧全息术甚至能"听"出背面黑子
topics.descEn: The sun's surface ripples with ~5-minute p-modes — over a million identified oscillations form an internal

topics.titleZh: 核坍缩超新星与中微子暴
topics.descZh: 大质量恒星的铁芯攒到 1.4 M☉,电子简并压失守:0.2 秒内从数千 km 塌到 30 km;质子俘获电子中子化,中微子洪流先冲出来;反弹激波冲到一半被铁核解离吃光、卡住变暗,靠中微子加热增益机制二次点火——超新星是被中微子炸开的;总结合能 3×10⁴⁶ J 的 99% 交给 10 秒中微子暴,光只占 0.01%;SN 1987A:神冈 11/IMB 8/Baksan 5 共 25 个中微子先到 13 秒,3 h 25 min 后才见光;⁵⁶Ni(t½ 6.1 d)→⁵⁶Co(77 d)衰变撑起光变尾巴
topics.descEn: When the iron core of a massive star reaches 1.4 M☉ electron degeneracy fails: in 0.2 s it collapses from thousands of km to 30 km. Neutronization floods the star with neutrinos first; the rebound shock stalls halfway, eaten by iron dissociation, and is re-ignited by neutrino heating — the supernova is blown up by neutrinos. Of 3×10⁴⁶ J released, 99% leaves in a 10 s neutrino burst and only 0.01% as light. SN 1987A: Kamiokande 11, IMB 8, Baksan 5 — 25 neutrinos arriving 3 h 25 min before the light; ⁵⁶Ni (6.1 d) → ⁵⁶Co (77 d) powers the light-curve tail

topics.descZh: 量天没有卷尺,全靠四级接力:①三角视差——地球轨道当基线,Gaia 精度 0.02 mas、撑到几万光年;②星团主序拟合;③造父变星周光关系——周期即光度,哈勃 1923 年在仙女座找到造父、宇宙岛屿确立;④Ia 型超新星 M_B≈−19.3,标准炸弹均匀到百亿光年,撑起哈勃流 v=H₀d;每一级用上一级校准、误差逐级传递;今天的裂缝:近梯 73.0±1.0 vs CMB 推 67.4±0.5——"哈勃张力"约 5σ
topics.descEn: Measuring the sky takes a four-rung relay: parallax uses Earth's orbit as a baseline (Gaia: 0.02 mas, tens of thousands of light-years); cluster main-sequence fitting bridges the galaxy; Cepheid period–luminosity — period is brightness — let Hubble find one in Andromeda in 1923 and end the

topics.titleZh: 行星状星云与恒星末路
topics.descZh: 0.8-8 M☉ 的恒星走不到超新星:AGB 热脉冲抛出 0.1-0.3 M☉ 包层(10-30 km/s),露出 0.6 M☉、3 万-15 万 K 的白矮星,紫外电离前沿点亮星云,O III 500.7 禁线曾被误认成元素 nebulium;可见期仅约 1 万年。
topics.descEn: Stars of 0.8-8 solar masses never reach supernova: AGB thermal pulses shed 0.1-0.3 solar masses of envelope at 10-30 km/s, baring a 0.6 solar-mass white dwarf at 30,000-150,000 K whose UV front lights the nebula in forbidden [O III] 500.7 - once mistaken for the element nebulium - visible for only ~10,000 years.

topics.titleZh: 奥尔特云与长周期彗星
topics.descZh: 太阳系最外缘的冰库:2,000-100,000 AU(0.03-1.6 光年,1 ly≈63,241 AU)悬浮着数万亿(10¹²-10¹³)颗冰体,总质量仅约 2-5 个地球;它们是行星形成头 1 亿年被巨行星引力弹弓甩出的「本地货」,银河潮汐与约百万年一次的过路恒星两台「泵」把部分彗星近日点踹回内太阳系,造就几乎各向同性的长周期彗星。
topics.descEn: The Sun's outermost ice reserve: trillions (10¹²-10¹³) of icy bodies drift at 2,000-100,000 AU (0.03-1.6 ly) yet weigh only ~2-5 Earth masses. Natives scattered by the young giant planets, they are pumped sunward by the galactic tide and passing stars, feeding the near-isotropic long-period comets.

topics.descZh: 氙离子被静电加速到 v_e≈30-50 km/s(Isp 3,000-5,000 s),比化学火箭约高 10 倍——同样推进剂质量换回约 10 倍 ΔV,代价是 20-700 mN 的小推力(1 kW 电≈25-40 mN)与数月耐心。剖面演示空心阴极电离、+1,100/−200 V 双栅加速与中和器补电子;轨道图对照 Hohmann 双脉冲与螺旋缓抬——Dawn 用 4 年洒出 11 km/s ΔV。
topics.descEn: Xenon ions are electrostatically accelerated to v_e≈30-50 km/s (Isp 3,000-5,000 s), ~10x a chemical rocket — the same propellant buys ~10x the ΔV, at the price of 20-700 mN thrust (1 kW ≈ 25-40 mN) and months of patience. The cutaway shows hollow-cathode ionization, +1,100/−200 V dual-grid acceleration and the neutralizer; the orbit map contrasts Hohmann impulses with the slow spiral Dawn used to spread 11 km/s of ΔV over 4 years.

topics.titleZh: 千新星与多信使天文学
topics.descZh: 两颗 1.3-1.5 M☉ 的中子星旋近数百万年,最后 100 s 引力波频率从 ~30 Hz 啁啾到 ~1.5 kHz,LIGO 4 km 臂长变化仅 ~10⁻¹⁸ m;2017-08-17 GW170817 并合,抛出 ~0.01-0.06 M☉ 富中子物质,r-过程 1 秒内合成金、铂、铕、铀;+1.7 s 费米看到短伽马暴,+11 h 找到光学对应体 AT 2017gfo(40 Mpc);千新星第 1 天 ~10⁴ K 蓝亮、2-7 天镧系遮挡转红,峰值 ~10⁴² erg/s——比新星亮千倍、比超新星暗百倍,多信使天文学从此开端
topics.descEn: Two 1.3-1.5 solar-mass neutron stars spiral in for millions of years; in the final 100 s the GW frequency chirps from ~30 Hz to ~1.5 kHz while LIGO's 4 km arms strain by ~10⁻¹⁸ m. On 2017-08-17 GW170817 merged, ejecting ~0.01-0.06 M☉ of neutron-rich matter: r-process capture forged gold, platinum, europium and uranium within ~1 s. Fermi saw a short gamma-ray burst 1.7 s later; optical counterpart AT 2017gfo surfaced 11 h on at 40 Mpc. The kilonova shone blue (~10⁴ K) on day 1 and reddened over days 2-7 as lanthanides swallowed blue light, peaking near ~10⁴² erg/s — 1000× a nova, 1/100 of a supernova. Multi-messenger astronomy began.

topics.descZh: 星光以 c 迎面而来、地球以 29.8 km/s 横跑,望远镜必须像迎雨奔跑那样前倾 tanθ=v/c=20.5″(κ):星视位置沿周年椭圆移动,长半轴恒 20.5″、短半轴 20.5″·sinβ。Bradley 1727 年找视差时意外撞见它——幅度大 ~20 倍、相位差 90°,由此证明地球公转,还反推出 c≈3.1×10⁸ m/s(与罗默法一致);行差与距离无关,视差 ∝1/d。
topics.descEn: Starlight arrives at c while Earth runs sideways at 29.8 km/s, so the telescope leans forward like a runner in rain: tanθ=v/c=20.5″ (κ). Apparent positions trace an annual ellipse with semi-major axis always 20.5″, minor 20.5″·sinβ. Bradley found it in 1727 while hunting parallax — ~20× larger and 90° out of phase — proving Earth's orbit and yielding c≈3.1×10⁸ m/s (matching Rømer). Aberration is distance-free; parallax scales as 1/d.

topics.descZh: 太阳型恒星闯入 10⁶ M☉ 黑洞:距离小于潮汐半径 r_t≈R_*(M_BH/M_*)^{1/3}≈100 R☉(0.47 AU)时,两端引力差压过自引力,整星被拉成面条;约一半碎片超逸甩出,另一半绕回、碰撞圆化成吸积盘,摩擦升温 ~10⁵ K,紫外/软 X 耀发 10⁴³-10⁴⁵ erg/s,按 t^{-5/3} 衰减数月;每星系 10⁴-10⁵ 年吃一颗星。可拖黑洞质量滑块看 r_t 与视界伸缩,含撕裂慢放与实时光变曲线。
topics.descEn: A sun-like star drifts inside the tidal radius r_t≈R_*(M_BH/M_*)^{1/3}≈100 R☉ (0.47 AU) of a 10⁶ M☉ black hole; differential gravity beats self-gravity and the star is spaghettified. Half the debris exceeds escape velocity; the rest circularizes into an accretion disk heated to ~10⁵ K, flaring in UV/soft X-rays at 10⁴³-10⁴⁵ erg/s and decaying as t^-5/3 for months. Every galaxy eats a star every 10⁴-10⁵ yr. Drag the mass slider to rescale r_t; includes slow-mo disruption and the live light curve.

topics.titleZh: 空间碎片与凯斯勒综合征
topics.descZh: LEO 里 >10 cm 编目碎片约 3.6 万、1-10 cm 约 100 万、毫米级上亿;相对速度 10-15 km/s——1 cm 铝珠(1.4 g @10 km/s≈70 kJ)动能≈一枚手榴弹,10 cm(≈70 MJ≈17 kg TNT)能碎一颗卫星。碰撞再产碎片:2007 反卫星试验与 2009 铱星相撞各注入 ~3000 片;密度超临界后「碰撞→碎片→再碰撞」自持级联即凯斯勒综合征;<400 km 数年再入,>800 km 停留百年。点击碎片模拟碰撞、开级联模式看雪崩、拖高度滑块读衰减时间。
topics.descEn: LEO holds ~36,000 cataloged fragments >10 cm, ~1 million at 1-10 cm, 100+ million millimeter-scale. Closing speeds of 10-15 km/s make a 1 cm aluminum sphere (1.4 g, ≈70 kJ) a grenade and a 10 cm piece (≈70 MJ ≈ 17 kg TNT) a satellite-killer. Collisions breed debris — the 2007 ASAT test and 2009 Iridium-Cosmos crash each added ~3,000. Past critical density, 'collision→debris→collision' becomes self-sustaining: the Kessler syndrome. Below 400 km drag cleans up in years; above 800 km debris lingers a century.

topics.descZh: 两台相距 B 的望远镜看同一波前,到达时差 τ=B·sinθ/c;两路信号相关得到一条干涉条纹——天空的一根傅里叶采样。分辨率由 λ/B 决定而非镜面直径:EHT 基线 ~1.1 万 km、λ=1.3 mm → ~20 μas,才拍出 M87* 与 Sgr A* 的光子环(单面 12 m 望远镜仅 ~0.33 mas,差 4 个量级)。地球自转让基线一夜扫出一条 uv 弧,ALMA 66 面=2145 条基线,uv 覆盖越满,逆傅里叶反演的图像越清晰。拖基线滑块看条纹变细、uv 填充与双源逐步显形。
topics.descEn: Two telescopes separated by B see one wavefront with delay τ=B·sinθ/c; correlating the two signals yields a fringe — one Fourier sample of the sky. Resolution scales as λ/B, not dish diameter: EHT's ~11,000 km baselines at 1.3 mm reach ~20 μas, enough for the photon rings of M87* and Sgr A* (a lone 12 m dish: only ~0.33 mas, 4 orders worse). Earth's rotation sweeps one uv arc per night; ALMA's 66 dishes give 2,145 baselines at once — the fuller the uv plane, the sharper the inverse-Fourier image. Drag the baseline slider to watch fringes tighten, uv fill in, and the double source resolve.

topics.titleEn: Van Allen Belts & the Magnetic Mirror
topics.descZh: 带电粒子在地磁场里三重运动:绕场线拉莫尔回旋(ms 级)、沿场线在南北镜点间弹跳(~0.1-3 s,第一绝热不变量 μ 守恒,强场处 v∥→0 反弹)、经度漂移绕地球(~5-30 min);内带(~1,000-6,000 km)质子、外带(~13,000-60,000 km)电子;偶极偏心造成南大西洋异常区、内带下凹至 ~200 km;投掷角小于损失锥就坠入大气。
topics.descEn: Charged particles perform three nested motions in the geomagnetic field: Larmor gyration about a field line (ms), bouncing between mirror points north and south (~0.1-3 s, first adiabatic invariant μ conserved so v∥→0 in stronger B), and longitude drift around Earth (~5-30 min). The inner belt (~1,000-6,000 km) holds protons, the outer (~13,000-60,000 km) electrons; the offset dipole dips the inner belt to ~200 km over the South Atlantic Anomaly; pitch angles inside the loss cone crash into the atmosphere.

topics.descZh: 550 km/53° 的壳层(Starlink 一代 72 面×22 星 ~4,400 颗)把地平圆铺成无缝覆盖;单星过顶可见 ~4 分钟、连接不停切换;RTT 20-40 ms 对 GEO 的 480+ ms;星间激光 100-200 Gbps 走真空捷径(比光纤快 ~1.5 倍);大气阻力让失控卫星 ~5 年自清洁再入——GEO 一颗顶天的,LEO 一群管地。
topics.descEn: A 550 km, 53° shell (Starlink gen1: 72 planes × 22, ~4,400 sats) tiles horizon circles into seamless coverage; each pass is visible ~4 minutes and links hand over continuously. RTT 20-40 ms versus 480+ ms for GEO; inter-satellite lasers carry 100-200 Gbps through vacuum (~1.5× faster than glass fiber). Drag self-cleans: a dead satellite reenters in ~5 years. GEO is one satellite for the whole arc; LEO is a crowd for the ground.

topics.titleZh: 快速射电暴与磁星耀斑
topics.descZh: 毫秒内倾泻太阳几天的能量:2007 年在旧数据里翻出首个 FRB,色散量 375 pc/cm³——低频迟到,扫出彩虹;Δt∝DM/ν²,自由电子成了距离计,大部分 DM 来自星系际;2020 年银河系磁星 SGR 1935+2154 爆出 FRB 200428,实锤磁星是一种来源;CHIME 每天逮几个,全天率 10³-10⁴,辐射机制仍未定论。
topics.descEn: A few milliseconds can outshine the Sun for days: the first FRB surfaced in 2007 archival data with DM 375 pc/cm³ — low frequencies arrive late, sweeping a rainbow. Δt∝DM/ν² makes interstellar electrons a distance gauge, most of the DM from intergalactic space. In 2020 the Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154 fired FRB 200428 — magnetars are one source confirmed. CHIME catches several a day; the all-sky rate is 10³-10⁴, and the engine is still debated.

topics.titleEn: The Heliosphere & the Edge of the Solar System
topics.descZh: 太阳风(400-800 km/s)吹出一个等离子体泡:80-100 AU 处终止激波把风降到亚声速,~120 AU 日球层顶与星际介质压力持平;旅行者 1 号 2012 年穿过(121.6 AU)、2 号 2018 年跟上(119 AU),测到电子密度跳升与银河宇宙线陡增;太阳 11 年周期让泡泡呼吸,IBEX 的中性原子像却暗示它更像「羊角面包」而非彗尾。
topics.descEn: The solar wind (400-800 km/s) blows a plasma bubble: the termination shock subsonics it at 80-100 AU, and the heliopause at ~120 AU balances interstellar pressure. Voyager 1 crossed in 2012 (121.6 AU), Voyager 2 in 2018 (119 AU), catching the electron-density jump and the surge of galactic cosmic rays. The 11-year solar cycle makes the bubble breathe, and IBEX's neutral-atom portrait hints at a croissant, not a comet tail.

topics.titleZh: 撞击坑计数与表面定年
topics.descZh: 没有岩石样本也能读年龄:单位面积上 ≥D 的坑密度随暴露时间增长,N(D)-D 曲线叠上等时线就能读出表面年龄;刻度由阿波罗样品钉死(月海 3.5-4.0 Gyr);陷阱有三——太老的表面饱和封顶、二次坑冒充、风化与火山抹平小坑;冥王星斯普特尼克平原一个坑都没有:<10 Myr。
topics.descEn: Age without samples: the density of craters ≥D per area grows with exposure time, and overlaying a counted N(D)-D curve on isochrons dates the surface. Apollo samples pin the scale (lunar maria 3.5-4.0 Gyr). Three traps: saturation caps ancient surfaces, secondaries pose as primaries, and weathering or volcanism erases small craters. Pluto's Sputnik Planitia has none at all: younger than 10 Myr.

topics.descZh: 舱外服是一人飞船:舱内 101 kPa 空气、服内 30 kPa(4.3 psi)纯氧——压差小关节才能弯,氧分压仍补到约 20 kPa;出舱前吸氧排氮防减压病;真空无对流,向阳 +120 °C 背阴 −100 °C,TMG 五层隔热加水冷服带走 300-600 W 代谢热;LiOH 洗掉 CO₂;EMU 地面重 120 kg,在轨靠手移位,SAFER 背包 24 喷嘴备 3 m/s 逃逸;真空中 30-90 秒清醒,绝不能憋气。
topics.descEn: An EVA suit is a one-person spacecraft: cabin 101 kPa of air, suit 30 kPa (4.3 psi) of pure oxygen - the small pressure difference keeps joints bendable while oxygen partial pressure stays ~20 kPa; pre-breathe purges nitrogen. Vacuum has no convection: +120 °C sunlit, −100 °C shadow; TMG layers insulate and water tubes carry off 300-600 W; LiOH scrubs CO₂; the EMU weighs 120 kg on Earth, moves by hand in orbit, and the SAFER pack holds 24 thrusters for a 3 m/s rescue; in vacuum you stay conscious 30-90 s - never hold your breath.

topics.descZh: 红巨星核心 0.45 M☉ 的氦球被电子简并压撑住——压强只认密度不认温度,加热不膨胀不降温;三α产能 ε∝exp(−44/T₈) 超敏感,T₈ 从 1.0→2.0 产能 ×3.6×10⁹,几分钟内以 ~10¹⁰ L☉ 引爆 ~10⁴¹ J——却几乎全被外包层膨胀吃掉,表面只晃 10%,天文台看不见;简并被掀开,恒星落回水平支。
topics.descEn: The 0.45 M☉ helium core of a red giant hangs on electron degeneracy - pressure reads density, not temperature, so heating never expands it. Triple-alpha burns at ε∝exp(−44/T₈): from T₈ 1.0→2.0 output jumps ×3.6×10⁹, detonating ~10⁴¹ J at ~10¹⁰ L☉ within minutes - yet the envelope absorbs nearly all of it, the surface flickers ~10%, and telescopes see nothing. Degeneracy lifts; the star settles on the horizontal branch.

topics.descZh: 地球扁率 J₂≈1.083×10⁻³ 使轨道面进动;选倾角 97-99°、高度 600-800 km,让进动恰好 +0.9856°/day 抵消太阳视运动——每次过顶都是同一当地时间(如 10:30),光照一致、供电稳定;普通极轨半年漂 12 小时。
topics.descEn: Earth's oblateness J₂≈1.083×10⁻³ torques the orbital plane; pick inclination 97-99° at 600-800 km so precession equals +0.9856°/day, canceling the Sun's apparent motion - every pass crosses at the same local time (e.g. 10:30 AM) with steady lighting and power, while a plain polar orbit drifts 12 hours in half a year.

topics.descZh: 木星型行星比恒星暗 10⁸–10⁹ 倍,衍射又把恒星光糊成爱里斑铺到行星位置;日冕仪用焦面/瞳面掩模+变形镜造出暗区,对比度 10⁻⁸–10⁻¹⁰——掩模落位瞬间恒星环熄灭,行星浮现;HR 8799 四行星已拍出「行星电影」。
topics.descEn: A Jupiter-like planet is 10⁸-10⁹ times fainter than its star, and diffraction smears starlight over the planet's position; a coronagraph combines focal/pupil masks with a deformable mirror to carve a dark hole at contrast 10⁻⁸-10⁻¹⁰ - the instant the mask drops, stellar rings extinguish and planets surface; HR 8799's four planets already star in a planetary movie.

topics.descZh: 南极 2.5 km 深冰下,5,160 个数字光模块围出 1 km³ 望远镜;1 TeV 中微子穿过仅 ~10⁻⁶ 作用概率,撞核子才甩出切伦科夫蓝光,数百 DOM 纳秒时间戳定向——2018 年 ~290 TeV 事件回指耀变体 TXS 0506+056。
topics.descEn: Beneath the South Pole ice, 5,160 digital optical modules turn a cubic kilometre of ice into a telescope: a 1 TeV neutrino crossing 1 km of ice has only a ~10⁻⁶ chance of interacting, and a rare hit on a nucleus casts Cherenkov blue light that hundreds of DOMs timestamp to the nanosecond — in 2018 a ~290 TeV neutrino was traced back to the blazar TXS 0506+056.

topics.descZh: 光球 5,772 K,日冕却烫到 1-3 MK——越离热源越烫;维持它要净加热 100-300 W/m²(活动区 ~10⁴),能量靠磁场从 ~1 km/s 的米粒对流输运。纳耀斑(每次 ~10²⁴ erg,每秒数万次)与阿尔文波两大候选至今难分。
topics.descEn: The photosphere is 5,772 K while the corona blazes at 1-3 MK (10 MK in active regions) — hotter the farther you go. Sustaining it takes ~100-300 W/m² for the quiet Sun and ~10⁴ W/m² in active regions; nanoflares (~10²⁴ erg reconnection bursts, tens of thousands per second) and Alfvén-wave dissipation are still tied, as loops swing like socks and kink waves climb a 25 Mm loop in ~25 s.

topics.titleEn: Day Length and the Leap Second
topics.descZh: 原子钟定义的秒稳定到 10⁻¹⁶,地球自转却每世纪慢 ~2 ms:潮汐摩擦让月球以 3.8 cm/年退行,泥盆纪珊瑚生长纹显示 4 亿年前一年约 400 天;1972 年起已插 27 次闰秒,2029 年前后或需史上首个负闰秒。
topics.descEn: The atomic second is stable to 10⁻¹⁶, yet Earth's rotation slows ~2 ms per century: tidal friction drives the Moon away at 3.8 cm/yr, and Devonian corals record ~400 days per year 400 million years ago. Since 1972 twenty-seven leap seconds have been inserted; around 2029 the first negative one may be needed.

topics.descZh: 回归年 365.2422 天不是整数,历法只能分期还贷:儒略历每 4 年一闰、年均 365.25 天,128 年偏 1 天,1582 年已偏 10 天被删;格里高利规则世纪年须被 400 整除,年均 365.2425 天、约 3,030 年偏 1 天,2100 年不闰;朔望月 29.53 天,阴阳合历十九年七闰(默冬章差 2 小时),农历以无中气之月置闰。
topics.descEn: The tropical year is 365.2422 days, so calendars repay the remainder in installments: the Julian calendar adds a leap day every 4 years (mean 365.25 d, 1 day off per 128 yr - 10 days deleted in 1582); the Gregorian rule requires century years to divide by 400 (mean 365.2425 d, ~1 day per 3,030 yr; 2100 is not leap); lunar months of 29.53 d need 7 leap months per 19 years (the Metonic cycle, ~2 h off), which the Chinese calendar implements as the month without a zhong-qi.

topics.descZh: 2017-10-19 泛星巡天发现 1I/ʻOumuamua:偏心率 1.2>1,双曲线轨道不束缚于太阳,v∞≈26.3 km/s 远超太阳系天体,近日点 0.255 AU、掠日速度 ~87 km/s;无彗发无尾,光变振幅 2.5 mag 推出长宽比 ≥6:1、长轴百余米;却测出 ~5×10⁻⁶ m/s² 的非引力加速且无 CN 出气——辐射压假说;2I/Borisov(2019)带彗发是标准彗星;任一时刻木星轨道内都有数枚访客。
topics.descEn: Pan-STARRS found 1I/ʻOumuamua on 2017-10-19: eccentricity 1.2>1, a hyperbola unbound to the Sun, v∞≈26.3 km/s - impossible for solar-system bodies - perihelion 0.255 AU at ~87 km/s. No coma or tail, yet a 2.5-mag lightcurve implies axis ratio ≥6:1 and a 100+ m length; non-gravitational acceleration of ~5×10⁻⁶ m/s² with no CN outgassing points to radiation pressure. 2I/Borisov (2019) came with a coma - a standard comet. Several visitors lurk inside Jupiter's orbit at any time.

topics.descZh: 宇宙膨胀把 Lyα 121.6 nm 拉长 ×(1+z),z=13 时达 1.7 μm,只有低温太空红外望远镜能看见;JWST 主镜 6.5 m 由 18 块镀金铍六角拼成 48 m²(红外反射率 ~98%),波前传感把 19 片镜调到误差 <100 nm(~λ/20);五层 Kapton 遮阳板 21×14 m 把 ~10 kW/m² 衰减到 <10 mW/m²,镜面 <50 K、MIRI 7 K;驻留日地 L2(150 万 km)halo 轨道,年耗 2-4 m/s 维持,分辨率 1.22λ/D。
topics.descEn: Cosmic expansion stretches Lyα 121.6 nm by (1+z): at z=13 it becomes 1.7 μm, visible only to a cold space infrared telescope. JWST's 6.5 m primary is 18 gold-plated beryllium hexagons totaling 48 m² (~98% IR reflectivity), phased by wavefront sensing to <100 nm error (~λ/20); its 21×14 m five-layer Kapton sunshield cuts ~10 kW/m² to <10 mW/m², mirrors below 50 K, MIRI at 7 K; it lingers at Sun-Earth L2 (1.5 M km) on a halo orbit costing 2-4 m/s per year, resolution 1.22λ/D.

topics.descZh: 球粒陨石占坠落 ~86%,毫米球粒(0.5-2 mm)是 4565-4567 Ma 淬冷的星云液滴,CAI 在 4567.3±0.16 Ma 凝固为最老固体与定年零点;无球粒与铁陨石来自分异母体的壳幔与核;11-72 km/s 入大气烧蚀 ~90% 质量熔出 ~1 mm 黑玻璃熔壳,魏德曼花纹带宽反推母体大小与冷却速率——本质是一枚没被熔炉改写的时间胶囊。
topics.descEn: Chondrites are ~86% of falls: millimeter chondrules (0.5-2 mm) are nebula droplets quenched at 4565-4567 Ma, and CAIs solidified at 4567.3±0.16 Ma - the oldest solids and the zero of every dating clock. Achondrites and irons come from the crust, mantle and core of melted parents; entry at 11-72 km/s ablates ~90% of the mass into a ~1 mm fusion crust, and Widmanstätten band widths back-solve the parent's size. In essence: an un-rewritten time capsule.

topics.descZh: 赤经 RA(0-24 h)+赤纬 Dec 钉在天球上,alt/az 却随时刻地点旋转;HA = LST − RA,恒星日 23h56m04.09s 比太阳日快 3m56s。赤道仪把极轴对准天极、倾角等于纬度,跟踪只剩绕极轴 15.041″/s 单轴匀速,长曝星点不拖线;地平式要双轴变速加视场旋转器;北极星距真极 0.7°、岁差 50.2″/yr——本质是给一片会转的天写一套钉死的门牌。
topics.descEn: RA (0-24 h) and Dec are pinned to the celestial sphere; alt/az rotates with time and place, and HA = LST - RA on a sidereal day of 23h56m04.09s. An equatorial mount points its polar axis at the pole with tilt equal to the latitude, so tracking becomes one axis at 15.041 arcsec/s and stars stay round in long exposures; alt-az mounts need two variable axes plus a derotator. Polaris sits 0.7° off the pole, drifting 50.2 arcsec/yr. In essence: street addresses for a sky that must not turn with Earth.

topics.descZh: 星光按 1/r² 衰减但每层壳恒星数 ∝r²——每层贡献相同,静态无限宇宙的夜空应亮如 5800 K 恒星表面(10⁵×白昼);实测夜空只有 10⁻⁴。三条腿撑住黑暗:13.8 Gyr 有限年龄以 r_H≈ct₀ 截断积分,膨胀红移按 (1+z)⁴ 压暗(H₀≈67.4),恒星寿命 ~10¹⁰ 年且宇宙仍在点亮——本质是夜空的黑暗证明了宇宙有开端。
topics.descEn: Starlight dims as 1/r² but each shell holds r² more stars, so every shell contributes equally and a static infinite sky should glow like a 5800 K stellar surface - 10⁵ times daylight; measured night is 10⁻⁴. Three legs hold the dark: the 13.8 Gyr age truncates the sum at the horizon r_H≈ct₀, expansion dims by (1+z)⁴ (H₀≈67.4), and stellar lifetimes of ~10¹⁰ yr with new stars still lighting. In essence: the dark night is evidence the universe had a beginning.

topics.descZh: 太阳-木星旋转系的 L4/L5 两个 60° 营地是稳定岛:只要 μ<0.0385,偏离的小行星就被引力拉回,围着营地画蝌蚪;木星营地里已编号特洛伊 >12000 颗,3753 Cruithne 则和地球跳着 770 年一圈的马蹄舞;露西号 2027 年起逐一拜访。
topics.descEn: In the Sun-Jupiter rotating frame, the two 60-degree camps L4 and L5 are stable islands: as long as μ<0.0385, perturbed asteroids get pulled back, tracing tadpoles around camp. Jupiter hosts 12,000+ numbered Trojans; 3753 Cruithne instead dances a 770-year horseshoe with Earth. Lucy begins visiting them one by one in 2027.

topics.descZh: 土星北极一条宽 100 km、风速 100 m/s 的急流失稳后选了波数 6:六边形边长 14500 km、周长 29000 km,随 10 h 39 min 自转同步走,一转 30 多年;实验室旋转水槽加转速差也能复现出 3-8 边——一条急流的自画像。
topics.descEn: A 100 km-wide, 100 m/s jet at Saturn's north pole went unstable and chose wavenumber six: a hexagon with 14,500 km sides and a 29,000 km perimeter, locked to the 10 h 39 min spin, still turning 30 years on. Spin a laboratory tank with a shear and you get 3-8 sides too - a jet stream drawing its own portrait.

topics.descZh: 毫秒脉冲星的自转稳定度 ~10⁻¹⁹,是挂在天上的原子钟:X 射线光子按 1.5578 ms 节拍到达,与太阳系质心的相位模型一比,位置误差就现形;单脉冲太弱要折叠累积数百秒,三星交汇把误差收到 7-12 km——2018 年空间站 SEXTANT 演示跑通,深空不再依赖地面站。
topics.descEn: Millisecond pulsars spin with ~10⁻¹⁹ stability - atomic clocks hung in the sky. X-ray photons arrive on a 1.5578 ms beat; compare against the phase model at the solar-system barycenter and your position error shows. Single pulses are too faint, so hundreds of seconds fold into a profile; three pulsars converge the fix to 7-12 km. SEXTANT proved it on ISS in 2018 - deep space without ground stations.

topics.titleEn: The 21 cm Hydrogen Line: the Galaxy's Heartbeat
topics.descZh: 氢原子基态里,电子与质子的自旋可以平行也可以反平行,两者差 5.9 μeV——对应 1420.40575177 MHz、波长 21.106 cm 的超精细跃迁。这个跃迁慢到单原子平均要 10⁷ 年才自发翻一次( A₁₀=2.85×10⁻¹⁵ s⁻¹),但银河系中性氢有约 10⁹ 倍太阳质量,无数原子同时翻,21 cm 反而成了宇宙里最亮的「手电筒」。尘埃挡得住可见光,挡不住 21 cm:1951 年探测成功后,银河旋臂第一次被完整画出。更妙的是差速自转:不同半径的氢云以不同速度绕行,多普勒把一条谱线拉成 ±100 km/s 的多峰驼峰——每个峰对应一条旋臂,一段光谱当场翻译成一张银河地图。近年 EDGES 更以 78 MHz 吸收轮廓触碰宇宙黎明。
topics.descEn: In the hydrogen ground state the electron and proton spins sit parallel or antiparallel, split by 5.9 ueV - the hyperfine transition at 1420.40575177 MHz, 21.106 cm wavelength. A single atom waits ~10^7 years to flip spontaneously (A10 = 2.85e-15 /s), but the Milky Way holds ~10^9 solar masses of neutral hydrogen: countless atoms flip at once, and 21 cm becomes the brightest flashlight in the universe. Dust blocks visible light but not 21 cm - after the 1951 detection, the spiral arms of our Galaxy were mapped for the first time. And differential rotation sweetens it: clouds at different radii orbit at different speeds, so Doppler smears one line into a multi-peaked ridge spanning +/-100 km/s - each peak one spiral arm, a spectrum translated on the spot into a map of the Galaxy. EDGES recently touched cosmic dawn with a 78 MHz absorption profile.

topics.titleEn: Space Elevator: A Cable That Stands an Orbit on the Equator
topics.descZh: 太空电梯的答案是让地球自己出钱:从赤道海面向上伸出一条缆绳,越过地球静止轨道(35786 km),末端挂上配重(捕获的小行星,或再延伸数万公里的尾缆),让整条绳的质心落在 GEO 之外——地球自转一周 24 h,多余的离心效应便把绳像悬索桥主缆一样「甩」紧绷直。GEO 以下重力赢、绳被往下拉;以上离心赢、绳被往外甩;净合力为零的恰是 GEO,而最大张力也恰出现在那里——绳的截面要在 GEO 最粗(锥形绳),锥度比由材料比强度决定:钢只有 ~0.5 Myuri,Kevlar ~3.6,碳纳米管理论 ~50,电梯因此卡在材料上,不在物理上。爬升器沿绳上行,免费继承地球自转的角动量:GEO 处 3.07 km/s 恰是静止轨道速度,松手即入轨;再往上抛,离心占优,反而甩向月球、火星——上行容易下行难。
topics.descEn: A space elevator makes the planet pay the launch bill: run a cable from an equatorial sea anchor up past geostationary orbit (35786 km), hang a counterweight (a captured asteroid, or tens of thousands of km of tail cable), and keep the whole assembly center of mass beyond GEO - then one 24 h turn of Earth slings the cable taut like a suspension-bridge main cable. Below GEO gravity wins and the rope is pulled down; above GEO centrifugal wins and it is flung outward; net force crosses zero exactly at GEO - and peak tension sits there too, so the cable must be thickest at GEO (a tapered rope whose taper ratio is set by material specific strength: steel only ~0.5 Myuri, Kevlar ~3.6, carbon nanotube ~50 in theory - the elevator is stuck on materials, not physics). A climber rides up and inherits Earth spin angular momentum for free: at GEO it moves at 3.07 km/s, exactly geostationary orbital speed - let go and you are in orbit; release higher and centrifugal flings you toward the Moon and Mars - going up is the easy direction.

topics.titleEn: Halo Orbits: Parking Where Gravity Balances
topics.descZh: 在日地连线上、距地球 150 万 km 的 L2 点,太阳与地球的引力加起来恰好凑出一个和地球同步公转的轨道——但这是个鞍点:垂直连线方向稳定,沿连线方向极不稳定,偏移 1 km 约 22 天就放大 e 倍,翻倍只需 15 天。所以「停在 L2」从来不是停车,而是绕着 L2 画一条 6 个月周期、幅度 25-80 万 km 的晕轨道,再靠定期站控把漂移掐灭:JWST 每 21 天点火一次,年均 ΔV 仅 2-4 m/s,一罐燃料按 20 年以上配给。选 L2 图的是三件互锁的好事:日-地-L2 永远共线,一面遮阳板同时挡住太阳、地球、月亮三个红外源;热环境波动不足 1 K,镜面与仪器稳在 50 K 以下;天线永远对准地球,通信单程约 5 s。代价也写在合同里:哈勃能修五次,JWST 一块镜片坏了只能靠算法补偿,不可维修。场景按真实的线性化三体动力学计算(鞍点谱 λ=√(2c₂−1)):拖动「注入偏移」看轨迹如何沿红色不稳定方向指数发散,再按「站控修正」看点火如何把航天器温柔押回晕圈——右下曲线记录每一次漂移与锯齿状的救援,「失控漂移」按钮则交还那 22 天的倒计时。
topics.descEn: 1.5 million km behind Earth, at the L2 point of the Sun-Earth system, solar and terrestrial gravity add up to exactly the orbit that keeps pace with Earth around the Sun - but the point is a saddle: stable perpendicular to the Sun-Earth line, violently unstable along it. A 1 km offset grows by a factor of e every 22 days, doubling every 15. Parking at L2 therefore never means stopping: the spacecraft rides a halo orbit around L2, roughly six months per revolution with an amplitude of 250,000-800,000 km, and periodically kills the drift with station-keeping burns - JWST fires every 21 days, the whole budget is only 2-4 m/s per year, and one tank of fuel is rationed for 20+ years. L2 buys three interlocking perks: Sun, Earth and L2 stay forever collinear, so a single sunshield blocks the infrared of the Sun, Earth and Moon at once; the thermal wobble stays under 1 K and the optics below 50 K; and the antenna always faces Earth, about 5 s one-way. The price is in the contract: nothing out there can be serviced - Hubble was repaired five times, while a flawed JWST mirror can only be compensated in software. The scene integrates the real linearized three-body dynamics (saddle spectrum lambda = sqrt(2c2-1)): drag the offset slider to watch the trajectory peel away along the red unstable direction, then press station-keeping to watch a burn gently escort the craft back onto the halo - the scope logs every drift and every sawtooth rescue, and the runaway button hands you the 22-day countdown.

topics.titleEn: Pluto Revealed: New Horizons at 14 km/s
topics.descZh: 2015 年 7 月 14 日,新视野号以 13.8 km/s 掠过冥王星,最近 12,500 km——为这半天,它飞了 9 年半、50 亿 km:史上最快的发射 16.26 km/s,再借木星助推加约 4 km/s。32.9 AU 外阳光只有地球的千分之一,信号单程 4.5 小时,下行 1-2 kbps,50 GB 传了 15 个月。人类第一次看清这颗 2376 km 的矮行星,而它推翻了「死冰球」预期:1000 km 宽的心形氮冰平原 Sputnik Planitia 没有一座陨石坑,表面不到 1000 万年——44 K 的氮冰像冰川般缓慢对流,20-30 km 的蜂窝对流胞边缘上涌发亮,流速 1-2 cm/年,冰厚 3-10 km,底下可能还有水冰海洋;水冰在此温度硬如岩石,堆出 3-6 km 高山;高空 20 多层蓝色 THOlin 霾下,氮气以约 10²⁷ 分子/秒逃逸,拖着彗星式尾巴。卡戎大到与冥王星互绕公共质心(在冥王星表面之外),潮汐锁定让这对双矮行星永远面对面。拖动「日心距」看阳光继续变暗,把「时间加速」拉满看对流胞像熔岩灯翻卷,或按「卡戎双星共舞」看 6.39 天一圈的探戈。
topics.descEn: On July 14, 2015, New Horizons swept past Pluto at 13.8 km/s, missing the dwarf planet by only 12,500 km - the payoff of a 9.5-year, 5-billion-km flight that began with the fastest launch in history, 16.26 km/s, plus about 4 km/s borrowed from a Jupiter gravity assist. Out at 32.9 AU sunlight is 1/1000 of Earth s, the signal takes 4.5 hours each way, and the downlink crawled at 1-2 kbps: 50 GB took 15 months to send home. Humanity finally saw the 2,376-km world up close, and it demolished the dead-iceball expectation: the 1,000-km heart-shaped nitrogen-ice plain Sputnik Planitia carries not a single impact crater - a surface less than 10 million years old, where at 44 K nitrogen ice flows like a glacier. Polygonal convection cells 20-30 km wide churn like a lava lamp, edges upwelling and bright, at 1-2 cm per year through ice 3-10 km thick, possibly floating on a buried water ocean. Water ice at this temperature is rock-hard and piles into 3-6 km mountains; overhead, 20+ layers of blue tholin haze veil a nitrogen atmosphere leaking into space at about 10^27 molecules per second, trailing a comet-like tail. Charon is so large that the pair orbits a barycenter outside Pluto itself, and mutual tidal locking keeps the two dwarf planets face to face forever. Drag the heliocentric distance to dim the Sun, push time acceleration to watch the cells churn, or press the binary preset for their 6.39-day waltz.

topics.titleEn: Roemer 1676: The First Measurement That Light Takes Time
topics.descZh: 木卫一 Io 以 42 小时 28 分绕木星一圈,每圈钻进木星影锥一次,熄灭又复现——一只误差不足一秒的宇宙秒表。1671 年起巴黎天文台用它校准木卫表,却发现:地球远离木星的半年,掩食一次比一次晚,累计推迟约 16-17 分钟;靠近的半年又逐次提前。钟没坏,坏的是假设——1676 年 9 月罗默在法兰西科学院给出解释:光速有限。推迟 = 光多飞的距离 ÷ 光速;从最近到最远离,距离差恰是地球轨道直径 2 AU,16.6 分钟正是 2 AU/c 的现代值。他当场预言:按 8 月的表外推,11 月 9 日的掩食将迟到约 10 分钟——当晚兑现,误差不到 1 分钟,这是人类第一次精确预言「光的迟到」。1678 年惠更斯据此算出 c ≈ 2.2×10⁸ m/s(败于当年 AU 偏小),1983 年起 c=299792458 m/s 成为定义值,连「米」都由秒定义。场景按真实周期推进(地球 365.25 天、木星 11.86 年、Io 1.769 天):拖「时间流速」跑完一年看时差涨到 16.6 分钟,拖「光速缩比」让光爬得可见,按「无限光速对照」看时差当场归零,或按「1676 预言复现」回 8 月等那次迟到。
topics.descEn: Io circles Jupiter every 42 hours 28 minutes and slips into the shadow of Jupiter once per orbit, blinking out and reappearing - a celestial stopwatch accurate to under a second. From 1671 the Paris Observatory used these eclipses to calibrate the tables of the moons of Jupiter, and kept finding trouble: in the half-year when Earth recedes from Jupiter, each eclipse runs later than the last, adding up to about 16-17 minutes; in the approaching half-year they run early. The clock was fine - the assumption was not. In September 1676 Roemer told the French Academy of Sciences: light travels at finite speed. The delay equals the extra distance divided by that speed, and from closest approach to farthest separation the gap is exactly the diameter of the orbit of Earth, 2 AU - 16.6 minutes by modern values. He staked a prediction: by the August tables, the eclipse of November 9 would run about 10 minutes late - and it did, to within a minute: the first precise forecast that light would be late. In 1678 Huygens did the division and got c ~ 2.2x10^8 m/s, held back by an undersized AU; since 1983 c = 299792458 m/s is a defined constant, with the meter itself derived from the second. The scene runs on true orbital periods (Earth 365.25 d, Jupiter 11.86 yr, Io 1.769 d) with eclipses and light pulses computed from live geometry: run a year at speed and watch the delay climb to 16.6 minutes, slow the light down until the pulses crawl, press the infinite-speed control to watch the delay collapse to zero, or replay 1676 and wait for the late eclipse of November 9.

topics.titleZh: 旋转人工重力:把离心力当重力
topics.titleEn: Artificial Gravity: Spinning Your Way to 1 g
topics.descZh: 长期失重是太空医学的头号敌人:骨钙每月流失 1-1.5%,肌肉萎缩,体液涌向头部,每天 2 小时锻炼也只能减缓、不能阻止——去一趟火星三两年,骨骼未必还得回来。解药只有一个方向:旋转,让 a=ω²r 的离心效应替你当重力。代价是一张半径-转速菜单:r=100 m 只要 3 rpm,r=10 m 要 9.5 rpm,r=4.5 m 要 14 rpm;可人耳前庭对旋转很敏感,超过 2-3 rpm 就有一部分人晕船。小半径还有重力梯度 Δa/a=h/r:站在 r=4.5 m 的舱里,头比脚轻约 15%(坐姿;站姿可达 38%),而 r=100 m 的大转轮整条梯度只有 1.7%。科里奥利效应补完日常的怪事:转身丢出的球走弧线,顺自转方向跑步变重、逆跑变轻,倒咖啡都对不准杯口。工程方案想了三类:600 m 长绳拴两舱、以 2 rpm 转 1 g;旋转环空间站;短臂末端离心舱——全卡在火箭整流罩尺寸、对接与展开难度上,至今没有一艘载人飞行器真的转起来。场景里两个设计并排:左侧 r 可调(默认 10 m、9.5 rpm ≈ 1 g),右侧 r=100 m、3 rpm 的舒适参照;拖「半径」「转速」看重力计读数当场变化,按「丢球实验」看小球在惯性系走直线、在旋转系走弧线,按「跑步对照」感受 ±2ωv 的轻重差,按「系绳方案」看最接近可行的工程路线。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Long-term weightlessness is enemy number one of space medicine: bone calcium drains at 1-1.5 percent per month, muscles waste away, body fluids surge into the head - and two hours of daily exercise only slows the loss. There is exactly one cure, and it points outward: spin, and let the centrifugal effect a = omega-squared times r stand in for gravity. That buys a menu of radius-versus-speed trade-offs: 100 m of radius needs only 3 rpm, 10 m needs 9.5 rpm, 4.5 m needs 14 rpm - but the human vestibular system rebels above 2-3 rpm, where a good fraction of any crew starts to get motion sick. Small radii add a gravity gradient, delta-a over a = h/r: seated in a 4.5 m cabin your head weighs about 15 percent less than your feet, and standing closer to 38 percent; on a 100 m wheel the whole gradient is a forgettable 1.7 percent. Coriolis completes the list of everyday oddities: a ball tossed across the cabin flies in a curve, running with the spin makes you heavier and against it lighter, and pouring coffee becomes a skill. Engineers have sketched three families of fixes: two capsules swung on a 600 m tether at 2 rpm for a full g, rotating ring stations, and short-arm centrifuge modules - all stalled on fairing diameters, docking complexity and deployment risk, and to this day no crewed spacecraft has ever spun for its gravity. In the scene two designs sit side by side: on the left a station you resize (default 10 m at 9.5 rpm, about 1 g), on the right a 100 m, 3 rpm comfort reference. Drag the radius and spin-rate sliders and watch the gravimeter react, press the ball toss to see a straight inertial line become a curved path in the rotating frame, try the running test for the plus-or-minus 2-omega-v weight swing, or the tether concept for the nearest thing to a buildable machine. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 六分仪与天文导航:星星替你定位
topics.titleEn: Celestial Navigation: The Stars Fix Your Position
topics.descZh: 不看 GPS,一片星空加一只六分仪就能定位:用六分仪测天体相对水平面的高度角 h(好手能测到 0.1-0.2 角分),天体的星下点 GP——它正下方那一点的地球坐标,由赤纬 δ 与格林尼治时角 GHA 从星历表查出;高度 h 越高,船离 GP 越近,角距恰为 z=90°−h。以 GP 为圆心、z 为角半径在地球面上画一个圆,船必在圆上;测两颗星得两个圆,交点就是船位——这是 1843 年萨姆纳船长发表「位置线」以来远洋航海的标准做法。时间是一切的命门:地球每 15°/小时自转,GHA 随之狂奔,钟差 1 秒就是经度差 0.25 角分≈0.46 公里——这正是 18 世纪「经度之战」的赌注:1714 年英国议会悬赏 2 万英镑,哈里森历时 40 余年造出 H1 到 H4,H4 在 1761 年 81 天的牙买加航程里只慢 5 秒(约合经度 1.25′),把远洋导航从「猜」变成「算」。现代 GPS 用的是同一套几何:卫星就是人造天体,伪距就是等距球面,四个球面交于一点;而六分仪至今仍是海军与远洋航空的备份手段——不依赖任何电源、卫星与网络。拖「高度测量误差」与「钟差」滑块,看两个等高圆当场错开、船位漂走多少海里;按「定位全过程」看两圆缓缓合拢到交点,按「钟差灾难」体验没有航海钟的年代,按「与 GPS 对照」看同一几何的现代版。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: You can fix your position with no GPS at all - a sextant and the stars will do it.
