topics.descZh: 冰抗压 3–5 MPa、抗弯只有 0.5–1 MPa——破冰船不撞冰,而是爬上去:水线外飘 ~20° 的船艏骑上冰缘,几万吨自重变成悬臂梁根部弯矩 σ=6Wl/(bh²);臂长过了 l*=σ_b·bh²/6P 冰盖就放射状裂开、扇形块翻落;以 2–3 节恒速循环,开出 20–30 m 航道;平头船只会压溃自己的艏柱
topics.descEn: Ice crushes at 3-5 MPa but bends at 0.5-1 — so an icebreaker climbs instead of ramming: a bow raked ~20° at the waterline rides onto the edge and its weight becomes a root moment σ=6Wl/(bh²); when the arm passes l*=σ_b·bh²/6P the sheet cracks radially and the sector capsizes. Cycle at 2-3 knots and the channel runs 20-30 m wide; a blunt bow only crushes its own stem.

topics.descZh: 阻力 F=½ρv²C_dA:收身自由落体逼近 200 km/h,开伞瞬间迎风面积从 0.7 m² 冲到 30 m²、阻力先冲峰值再回稳态——人体耐受 3~6 g;引导伞拉伞包、滑套抑制冲载、伞衣逐室充气;圆伞摆动、冲压方伞滑翔比 3:1
topics.descEn: Drag F=½ρv²C_dA: tucked freefall nears 200 km/h, then canopy area leaps from 0.7 to 30 m² and the load spikes past its steady value — bodies tolerate 3–6 g; the pilot chute extracts the bag, a slider tames the surge, cells inflate in sequence; round canopies swing, ram-airs glide 3:1

topics.descZh: 发动机烧出的高温湿排气与 −50 °C 环境空气沿混合线掺混,穿过冰饱和线便在烟尘核上凝华成冰晶——翼展后即见白线;环境干燥几秒蒸发、本就冰过饱和则存留数小时被撕成卷云;白天反射阳光降温、夜间截留红外增温
topics.descEn: Hot, humid exhaust mixes with −50 °C air along a mixing line; cross the ice-saturation line and vapor desublimates on soot nuclei — the white line behind the wing; dry air sublimates it in seconds, ice-supersaturated air keeps it for hours, sheared into cirrus; by day it cools, by night it traps infrared

topics.descZh: 跃移是引擎:风掀起沙粒、落地低角反弹溅起更多,撞碎的细尘被湍流卷上千米;冷锋出流推出墙高 1~2 km 的黑风墙;尘柱吸收阳光加热自身、维持热低压环流——沙尘暴自我维持;尘卷风是热斑上的旋转烟囱
topics.descEn: Saltation is the engine: wind launches sand grains, they rebound low and splash up more, and the shattered fines ride turbulence kilometers high; a cold front's outflow walls up a haboob 1–2 km tall; the dust column absorbs sunlight, heats itself and keeps its own low spinning — dust devils are the local edition

topics.descZh: 海水按温盐分层,界面内波的恢复力 g′=g·Δρ/ρ 只有 g 的千分之几——波速 ~1 m/s、振幅却可达 ~100 m(南海孤立内波);1903 Fram 号遭遇死水:同一油门,动力被泵进界面内波、船速掉到 1/5;内波在海面留下卫星可见的明暗条带,破碎驱动垂向混合、把营养盐泵上透光层
topics.descEn: Seawater is stratified; the restoring force on the density interface is g′=g·Δρ/ρ, a few permille of g — internal waves crawl at ~1 m/s yet stand ~100 m tall; in 1903 Fram hit dead water: on the same throttle, power was pumped into the interface wave and speed fell five-fold; the waves stripe the surface for satellites and their breaking pumps nutrients upward

topics.descZh: 湿空气爬坡:云底以下干绝热 9.8 °C/km 降温,凝结放潜热后放缓到 ~5.5 °C/km;翻顶后沿背风坡一路按干绝热回温——同一高度背风侧比迎风侧暖 5–10 °C、干 20%+:焚风一夜化雪、火险飙升;布拉风无潜热补贴,落地仍是寒冷密度流;山谷风昼夜翻转,白天抽风上山、夜间冷坡泄流
topics.descEn: A mountain forces moist air uphill — dry-adiabatic 9.8 °C/km below cloud base, ~5.5 °C/km once condensation releases latent heat; past the crest descent re-warms at the full 9.8 °C/km: same altitude, the lee side is 5–10 °C hotter and 20%+ drier — snow-melting, fire-prone foehn; the bora lands cold; valley winds flip day and night

topics.descZh: 船首推开的水荡出横波+散波,兴波阻力占总阻力 30–40% 且按 v⁴·⁵ 暴涨;球鼻艏=水线下的隐形小船头,自带一套波源靠前的波系,设计航速下与首波反相位、相消干涉当场压平首波,总阻力掉 ~14%;但相位随 Fr 变,只在 Fr≈0.25–0.32 窗口有效,低速白赔湿面积反而吃亏
topics.descEn: The bow shoves water into transverse and diverging waves; the energy they carry is wave-making resistance — 30–40% of total drag, growing as v⁴·⁵; the bulbous bow is a mini-bow below the waterline whose own wave system arrives anti-phase at design speed and flattens the first crest, cutting drag ~14%; but phase scales with Fr, so only Fr≈0.25–0.32 works — at low speed it's a net loss

topics.descZh: 70° 后掠的尖前缘在大迎角把剪切层卷成一对脱体涡,涡核低压在翼面抽出一层涡升力 C_Lv=2.6·sin²α·cosα,α=30° 时 ≈0.56、占总升力约四成,失速迎角从平直翼的 ~15° 拖到 33°–39°;代价是升力线斜率只有 ~0.042/°(平直翼 ~0.096/°),低速全靠昂着头——协和号以 10.5° 迎角进近;迎角推过临界值,涡核滞止、螺旋当场爆散,升力塌掉
topics.descEn: A 70°-swept sharp leading edge rolls the shear layer into a pair of detached vortices; their low-pressure cores add vortex lift C_Lv = 2.6·sin²α·cosα — ≈0.56 at α = 30°, about 40% of total lift — dragging the stall from ~15° to 33–39°. The price is a lift slope of only ~0.042 per degree (straight wing ~0.096), so deltas fly nose-high at low speed: Concorde approached at 10.5°. Push past the critical angle and the cores stagnate and burst, shedding lift on the spot

topics.descZh: 满舵 35° 时,舵叶在 9.3 m/s 来流下像机翼一样产生 1.8 MN 侧向升力;升力作用在重心后约 108 m 的力臂上,形成约 198 MN·m 转船力矩,推尾不推头;船先向外漂 5°–15°,绕船首后约 L/3 的枢心进入旋回,定常旋回直径约 2.4 倍船长(≈576 m);平板舵 C_L 峰值 1.3 恰在 35°,多压舵当场失速、力不升反降;舵力∝v²,航速从 15 kn 降到 5 kn 只剩 1/9,低速港内要靠拖轮
topics.descEn: At full rudder 35°, the blade meets a 9.3 m/s flow like a wing and makes 1.8 MN of side lift; acting 108 m behind the centre of gravity, that is a ~198 MN·m turning moment that pushes the stern, not the bow. The ship drifts out 5–15° first, pivots about a point ~L/3 aft of the bow, and settles into a steady circle ~2.4 ship lengths (≈576 m) across. Past 35° a flat rudder stalls — C_L peaks at 1.3 then collapses, and since lift goes as v², 5 kn leaves only 1/9 of the force

topics.descZh: 湿球温度计裹着湿纱布:水蒸发每 kg 抽走约 2.45 MJ 潜热,把示数拉到蒸发耗热与空气补热恰好相抵的湿球温度,30 °C、50% RH 时约 21.9 °C;露点 18.4 °C 是等压降温撞到 RH=100% 的温度,再冷一丝就结露;排序恒为露点≤湿球≤干球,饱和时三线合一;干湿差越大干燥力越强,湿球升到 35 °C 汗液蒸发失效,是人体生存红线
topics.descEn: A wet-bulb thermometer is wrapped in wet gauze: evaporation draws ~2.45 MJ of latent heat per kg of water, dragging the reading down to where evaporative cooling exactly balances heat from the air — about 21.9 °C at 30 °C and 50% RH. The dew point, 18.4 °C here, is where isobaric cooling first hits RH=100%; one more degree and dew forms. Order is always dew ≤ wet ≤ dry, merging at saturation, and a 35 °C wet bulb shuts down human sweating — the survival red line

topics.descZh: 海水密度由温度与盐度共同裁决,而热的扩散率 κT≈1.4×10⁻⁷ m²/s 是盐的 100 倍;把暖咸水压在冷淡水之上:界面 ~1 mm 薄层吸热快、得盐慢,一块块变重下沉,长出 2–5 cm 宽、20–50 cm 长的"盐指",像垂钓一样把上层热与盐持续搬进深渊;地中海溢流(38 PSU)经过直布罗陀在北大西洋铺出千米级盐指场——全球混合与气候传送带的一环;反过来"冷咸在暖淡上"则长出阶梯状温盐层
topics.descEn: Seawater density is set by temperature and salinity together, but heat diffuses ~100× faster than salt (κT≈1.4×10⁻⁷ m²/s). Press warm salty water over cold fresh: the ~1 mm interface gains heat fast and salt slowly, pockets turn heavy and sink — fingers 2–5 cm wide and 20–50 cm long dangle down, fishing heat and salt into the abyss. Mediterranean outflow (38 PSU) spills past Gibraltar into a kilometer-scale salt-finger field — a cog in global mixing and the climate conveyor. Reverse the layers and stair-step thermohaline layers grow instead

topics.descZh: 海水结冰时纯冰先析、盐被赶进卤水:冰隙卤水盐度可达海水的 3–5 倍(150 PSU)、冰点随盐度降到 −8.1 °C,极夜 −30 °C 时卤水冷到 −20 °C;这股又冷又咸的重卤水(ρ≈1120 kg/m³)沿冰缝下泄,通道壁周围 −1.9 °C 的海水被冻附,越冻越厚长成一条向下生长的冰管——数小时下探数十米;触底后卤水铺开、冻圈扩散,海星海胆当场冻僵(2011 年 BBC 延时名场面);南极冰架下放大成海底冰花
topics.descEn: As sea ice forms, pure ice freezes first and salt is expelled into brine: ice-gap brine reaches 3–5× seawater salinity (150 PSU), dropping its freezing point to −8.1 °C — polar winter chills it to −20 °C. This cold, dense brine (ρ≈1120 kg/m³) pours down cracks, freezing the surrounding −1.9 °C seawater into a growing ice tube that reaches tens of meters in hours. Touching bottom, brine spreads and the freeze-ring kills sea urchins and starfish where they stand (BBC's 2011 time-lapse); under Antarctic ice shelves the same mechanism scales up to under-ice flower beds

topics.descZh: 深水波每米波峰线功率 P/B=ρg²H²T/(64π),H=2 m、T=9 s 就有 ≈18 kW/m,大西洋外海 20–70 kW/m;振荡水柱装置(OWC)把气室当音响箱体:波浪把水柱当活塞往里压,气室空气往复推动 Wells 涡轮——对称翼型让任意方向的气流都朝同一边转,海浪的往复在轴上成了"直流";气室固有周期 8–12 s 与波浪共振调谐显著增益;苏格兰艾莱岛 LIMPET 500 kW 并网;代价是大攻角易失速,全链效率 30–50%
topics.descEn: Deep-water waves carry P/B=ρg²H²T/(64π) per meter of crest — ≈18 kW/m at H=2 m, T=9 s, and 20–70 kW/m offshore Atlantic. An oscillating water column turns the chamber into a loudspeaker box: waves pump the water column like a piston and the reversing air spins a Wells turbine, whose symmetric blades turn the same way whichever way the air flows — reciprocation becomes

topics.descZh: 风平行海岸吹,埃克曼输送把表层水搬离岸;深层老水以每天 1-10 米的慢速上涌补位,带来 10-30 μM 硝酸盐,喂养浮游植物爆发成卫星可见的绿带。五大上升流系统占洋面积不足 2%,却支撑全球约五分之一的渔获,秘鲁鳀鱼曾年产 1200 万吨;厄尔尼诺年信风一弱,涌升断供,鳀鱼崩溃、海鸟挨饿。
topics.descEn: Alongshore winds drive Ekman transport that skims surface water offshore; old deep water rises at just 1-10 m per day, carrying 10-30 μM nitrate that fuels phytoplankton blooms visible from space as green belts. Five upwelling systems cover under 2% of the ocean yet yield about a fifth of the world's catch - Peru's anchoveta once hit 12 million tonnes a year. When El Niño stalls the trades, the supply line snaps.

topics.descZh: 凝汽式电厂效率约 40%,每发 1 kWh 电就要排约 1.5 kWh 废热(30-40 °C 温水)。冷却塔用蒸发潜热吃掉它:1 kg 水蒸发吸热 ~2,430 kJ,是 10 K 显热(42 kJ)的 58 倍,故 40→30 °C 每公斤水只需蒸发 0.7-1%;湿空气轻 1-2%,Δρ·g·H 乘 100-200 m 塔高驱动百万吨气流免风机;出塔水温逼近湿球 +3-6 K,1 GW 电厂日蒸发 6-8 万 m³。
topics.descEn: A condensing plant is ~40% efficient: every kWh of electricity rejects ~1.5 kWh of waste heat as 30-40 °C warm water. The tower eats it with latent heat - evaporating 1 kg of water absorbs ~2,430 kJ, 58x the 42 kJ of a 10 K warming, so cooling 1 kg from 40 to 30 °C costs just 0.7-1% as vapor; humid air only 1-2% lighter than ambient drives a mega-ton draft up a 100-200 m shell, no fans needed; outlet water approaches the wet-bulb within 3-6 K, and a 1 GW plant evaporates 60-80 thousand m³ of water a day.

topics.descZh: 鳟鱼身上跑着一个后向行波:侧向摆幅从头部 0.05-0.1 体宽放大到尾柄 0.8-1.0 体宽,波速须大于游速(c/U≈1.2-1.5)才推得出水;尾迹是反向卡门涡街,向后射流反冲推进;St=fA/U 落在 0.2-0.4 高效窗时巡航效率达 70-90%,远超早期螺旋桨约 60%;C 形起动 0.1 s 内爆出 10-50 g。
topics.descEn: A trout carries a backward-running wave whose amplitude grows from 0.05-0.1 body width at the head to 0.8-1.0 at the peduncle; the wave must outrun the fish (c/U ≈ 1.2-1.5) to push water. Its wake is a reverse Kármán street pumping a backward jet; at St = fA/U of 0.2-0.4, cruising efficiency hits 70-90% - far beyond early propellers (~60%) - and a C-start pulls 10-50 g within 0.1 s.

topics.titleEn: Rip Currents: A River in the Sea
topics.descZh: 浪一遍遍把水推上岸,这些水必须回去:碎波带内水位被抬高 0.1-0.3 m(约碎波高的 10-20%),回流被水下沙洲堵住,只能从 10-30 m 宽的缺口集中喷出——离岸流,一条水中的河,流速常见 0.5-1 m/s、强时 2-2.5 m/s,比奥运百米自由泳的平均速度还快。通道里水深流急、波浪不碎,平静的暗色水面恰是最危险的伪装:美国约 80% 的救生员救援、年均约 100 人死亡由它造成。别硬顶——平行海岸游 20-30 m 出通道再回岸,或仰漂呼救。
topics.descEn: Waves shove water up the beach and it must come back: sea level inside the surf zone rises 0.1-0.3 m (10-20% of breaker height), and the return flow, dammed by sandbars, funnels through a 10-30 m gap as a rip current running 0.5-1 m/s, up to 2-2.5 m/s - faster than the Olympic 100 m freestyle average. The deep, fast channel stops waves from breaking, so the calmest dark water marks the deadliest spot: rips cause ~80% of US lifeguard rescues and ~100 deaths a year. Swim 20-30 m parallel to shore, or float and signal.

topics.descZh: 水母靠脉冲喷推游泳:环肌收缩把伞腔的水从口径挤出 → 反冲前进(F=ρA v_j²),喷口剪切层同时卷出起始涡环;窄口快喷(v_j 可达 ~70 cm/s)推力大但能量耗于涡,宽口慢喷把动能留给「整包水」——Aurelia 取后者,效率 ~20-30%(η≈2u/(u+v_j));舒张相伞缘垂下、负压回充,几乎不产生倒退推力;游速仅 ~2 cm/s,每 N·s 冲量成本 ≈v_j/2——慢而省的极简推进机。口径比滑块对比窄喷/宽喷,含喷流粒子、涡环显形与位移曲线。
topics.descEn: Jellyfish swim by pulsed jet: circular muscles squeeze water from the bell (F=ρA v_j²) while the lip's shear layer rolls up a starting vortex ring. Narrow fast jets (~70 cm/s) give big thrust but burn energy in vortices; wide slow jets leave it in the 'whole package of water' — Aurelia's choice, at ~20-30% efficiency (η≈2u/(u+v_j)). Relaxation droops the rim and refills by suction with almost no reverse thrust. Cruising at just ~2 cm/s costs only ≈v_j/2 joules per newton-second — the minimal slow-and-cheap propulsion machine. Compare narrow vs wide apertures with the slider; jet particles, vortex rings and the displacement trace are all live.

topics.descZh: 鲨鱼皮不光滑:每片盾鳞都是 ~0.2-0.5 mm 的小牙,拼成 50-150 μm 顺流向 V 沟槽;riblet 把贴壁的反向旋转展向涡「架」离壁面约半个槽距,又钉住湍流猝发的横向摆动,摩擦阻力降 ~5-10%。最优无量纲槽距 s⁺=s·u_τ/ν≈15,过密无效、过疏反增阻;速比津泳衣借此狂刷 2008 奥运纪录后被禁,空客/瑞航贴膜省油 1-2%。
topics.descEn: Shark skin isn't smooth: each denticle is a ~0.2-0.5 mm tooth packed into 50-150 μm streamwise V-grooves. Riblets prop the near-wall vortex pairs half a spacing off the wall and pin the spanwise wiggle of bursts, cutting skin friction 5-10%. Optimum wall-unit spacing s⁺≈15: finer does nothing, coarser adds drag. Speedo's Fastskin rode it to the 2008 records before FINA banned it; Airbus/SWISS riblet films save 1-2% fuel.

topics.titleZh: 调谐质量阻尼器与高楼抗风
topics.descZh: 超高层被涡激振动推着横摇:一阶频率仅 ~0.1-0.2 Hz(台北 101 约 0.15 Hz、周期 6.6 s),顶层加速度超标让人晕、幕墙疲劳。TMD=楼顶挂一颗大钢球(台北 101:5.5 m、660 t,悬在 87-92 层间)+ 油压阻尼器,调谐到与楼频率差 <7%,反相位惯性力把风的能量「吸」过来再搅成热:顶位移峰值削 40-60%,附加阻尼比从 0.5-1% 升到 3-6%;调不准则拍振帮倒忙。
topics.descEn: Vortex shedding rocks supertalls at a first mode of just ~0.1-0.2 Hz (Taipei 101: ~0.15 Hz, 6.6 s period); excess top acceleration sickens occupants and fatigues curtain walls. A TMD slings a huge ball in the crown (Taipei 101: 5.5 m, 660 t between floors 87-92) plus oil dampers, tuned within 7% of the building frequency: the anti-phase inertia force drinks the wind's energy and the dampers burn it - peak drift cut 40-60%, added damping 0.5-1% to 3-6%. Mistune it and beating bites.

topics.descZh: 物体撞水:先压出冲击波+冠溅,冲击力 F≈½ρCsV²πR² 只持续 ~10 ms;Fr=V/√(gR) 越过临界几,身后就被拉出充满空气/蒸汽的空腔——低速「冠式」闭合、高速「深闭合」:腔在深处收腰、闭合,闭合点向上下射出两股射流,上行可高过冠溅。跳水者指尖先破水、身体沿腔轴跟进:10 m 台入水 ~14 m/s,过载数十 g 但只有 ~0.1 s;潜射导弹出入水都得躲这个瞬态载荷。
topics.descEn: An object hits water: shock ring plus crown splash first, slam force F≈½ρCsV²πR² lasting ~10 ms. Past a Froude number Fr=V/√(gR) of a few, an air/vapor cavity is dragged behind the body - low speed pinches at the crown, high speed closes deep: the cavity necks, pinches, and fires jets both ways, the upward one outjumping the crown. Divers enter fingertips-first and ride the cavity axis: 10 m platform ≈14 m/s, tens of g for only ~0.1 s; SLBM launches dodge the same loads.

topics.descZh: 水轮机突甩负荷、导叶快关,长引水管里水柱动量无处安放:压力波以 c=√(K/ρ)≈1200 m/s 来回,ΔP=ρcΔv——2 m/s 的流速变化就是 ~24 bar,足以压瘪/胀裂钢管,负半周还会拉断水柱。调压井=在隧洞近厂端开一口竖井:压力波到井口即「泄压」,水流涌入井中把动能存成势能,再经 50-100 s 振荡缓释;井同时反射负压波防真空断流。井径有托马下限(本例 A_t≈2.6 m²),太细振荡发散。
topics.descEn: Load rejection slams the guide vanes and the water column's momentum has nowhere to go: the pressure wave runs at c=√(K/ρ)≈1200 m/s, and ΔP=ρcΔv turns a 2 m/s flow change into ~24 bar - enough to crush steel pipe; the negative half can tear the column apart. A surge tank is a shaft near the powerhouse: the wave vents into it, water surges up banking kinetic energy as elevation, released over a 50-100 s oscillation; it also reflects suction waves against vacuum separation. Thoma sets a minimum area (≈2.6 m² here) - too slender and the oscillation diverges.

topics.descZh: M6 以上若把气流减速到亚声速燃烧,离解损失与温升不可承受——超燃不减速:两级斜坡激波压缩、隔离段激波串缓冲进气道喘振,氢横向射流在 ~1-2 m 燃烧室里 0.5-1 ms 完成混合点火(气流 ~2-3 km/s);壁面热流数十 MW/m² 靠燃料再生冷却;没有压气机、没有涡轮,要助推到 M4.5+ 才能点火——X-43A 2004 年 M9.6 飞了 11 秒。
topics.descEn: Past M6, slowing the flow to subsonic combustion costs more than it buys — so the scramjet never slows it: ramp shocks compress, an isolator shock train buffers the inlet from the combustor, and hydrogen jets mix and burn in ~0.5-1 ms inside a 1-2 m duct (flow at 2-3 km/s). Walls take tens of MW/m² and are regeneratively cooled by the fuel. No compressor, no turbine; it needs a boost past M4.5 to light — X-43A flew M9.6 for 11 seconds in 2004.

topics.descZh: 出口压力高于环境,射流先经普朗特-迈耶膨胀扇外翻,再被大气压回成斜激波——一拉一压往复出菱形;强欠膨胀时中心立起正激波(马赫盘,直径 ~0.36D√(pₑ/pₐ));胞格间距 L≈1.3D√(p₀/pₐ),数钻石就能读压比;钻石间的亮蓝是剪切层里富燃气体的复燃;代价是 kHz 啸叫与推力损失。
topics.descEn: With exit pressure above ambient, the jet fans out through Prandtl-Meyer expansion, then ambient pressure squeezes it back through oblique shocks — stretch and squeeze repeat as diamonds. In strong underexpansion a normal shock stands up midstream: the Mach disk, ~0.36D√(pₑ/pₐ) across. Cell spacing L≈1.3D√(p₀/pₐ) — count the diamonds, read the pressure ratio. The bright blue between cells is afterburning in the shear layer; the price is kHz screech and lost thrust.

topics.descZh: 船闸用一连串小落差代替一堵大坝:关门-调水-开门四步,闸室水位经输水廊道与上下游齐平(三峡五级总落差 113 m、每级 23 m);人字门两扇合掌成指向上游的三铰拱,水压越压越紧——自密封,拱推力沿闸墙传入墙体;充水 8-15 min,出口消能盖板防系缆受冲;每次过闸耗一腔水 V=A×ΔH≈22 万 m³,省水池回收 60%。
topics.descEn: A lock trades one great dam for a stair of small falls: close, equalize, open - the chamber level follows the culverts to meet up- or downstream (Three Gorges totals 113 m over five flights, 23 m each); two miter leaves palm into a three-hinged arch pointing upstream, squeezed ever tighter by head - self-sealing, thrust flowing into the walls; filling takes 8-15 min and dissipator covers calm the jets; each transit spends V=A×ΔH ≈ 220,000 m³, and saving basins recycle 60%.

topics.descZh: 摇臂喷头让射流自己推动自己:水流打在摇臂偏流板上,冲量把摇臂推开 60-120°,弹簧带回时挡片敲击喷管——每次「嗒」给喷头约 1° 步进,1-3 Hz 敲击攒出 0.5-2 r/min 的慢转,慢转才匀;压力 200-400 kPa、射程 10-20 m;换向销加反向棘爪切出扇形;每次敲击是一次微型水锤,管道压力波动不足 10%。
topics.descEn: An impact sprinkler drives itself from its own jet: water strikes the arm's deflector, the impulse swings it 60-120° aside, and the returning spring taps the body - each tick steps the head ~1°, and 1-3 Hz ticks accumulate into a slow 0.5-2 r/min sweep, slow enough to be uniform; 200-400 kPa throws 10-20 m; a reversing trip and pawl cut arcs; every tap is a tiny water hammer, piping pressure wobbles under 10%.

topics.descZh: 1995 年元旦 Draupner 平台实测 25.6 m 单波(Hs≈12 m 的 2.1 倍),水手传说变成仪器记录;定义是波高超过 2×Hs——线性高斯海里概率 ~10⁻¹⁵,现实却常见:长波追短波同相叠加、洋流与海底当聚波透镜、窄带波列的 Benjamin-Feir 调制不稳定造出 Peregrine 呼吸子(局部 3 倍背景);卫星普查显示开阔海域每年数千次。
topics.descEn: On New Year's Day 1995 the Draupner platform measured a single 25.6 m wave — 2.1× the 12 m sea state — turning sailor lore into instrument record. A rogue wave exceeds 2×Hs; Gaussian seas predict odds of ~10⁻¹⁵, yet the ocean delivers: long waves overtake short ones in phase, currents and banks act as lenses, and Benjamin-Feir modulation instability grows Peregrine breathers three times the background. Satellite altimetry counts thousands a year in open water.

topics.titleZh: 旋翼挥舞与后行桨叶失速
topics.descZh: 前飞时前行桨叶 200+ m/s、后行桨叶可能只剩几十——升力差数倍,刚性旋翼会当场翻覆;挥舞铰让桨叶「呼吸」:前行侧上扬减小迎角、后行侧下沉增大迎角,负反馈把升力拉平,而响应滞后进动 90°,周期变距踩着相位补偿;速度再高,后行侧迎角越过 ~12-15° 失速——这是直升机的速度天花板(280-330 km/h),出路是后掠桨尖与复合推进。
topics.descEn: In forward flight the advancing blade sees 200+ m/s while the retreating one sees a fraction — lift differs several-fold and a rigid rotor flips. The flapping hinge lets blades breathe: advancing rises, cutting its angle of attack; retreating droops, raising its own — feedback that levels lift, delayed 90° by precession, which cyclic pitch anticipates. Push faster and the retreating side passes ~12-15° into stall: the helicopter's 280-330 km/h ceiling, eased by swept tips and compound propulsion.

topics.descZh: 搅拌杯里主环流是准刚体涡,壁比心压强高 Δp=½ρΩ²R²(1.2 转/s≈58 Pa);杯底艾克曼层(δ≈0.5–1 mm)离心不足、压差还在——底层被压向中心,闭合成二次流,茶叶聚在杯心;爱因斯坦 1926 年用它解释河湾冲刷与堆积。
topics.descEn: The stirred cup's main flow is a quasi-rigid vortex with wall-over-center pressure Δp=½ρΩ²R² (≈58 Pa at 1.2 rev/s); in the bottom Ekman layer (δ≈0.5-1 mm) the centrifugal balance fails while the pressure gap persists - the bottom flow is squeezed inward, closing a secondary circulation that piles the leaves at the center. Einstein used it in 1926 to explain river-bend scour and deposition.

topics.descZh: 液体静压 p=ρgh 线性;颗粒柱靠摩擦把重量分给筒壁,竖向压强指数饱和 p=ρgλ(1−e^{−z/λ}),λ≈2-4 倍筒半径——2 m 与 20 m 底压差不多(约 8 对 11 kPa),水为 20 对 196 kPa;卸料动压反超 20-30%。
topics.descEn: Hydrostatic pressure grows linearly (p=ρgh); a granular column diverts its weight into the walls by friction, so vertical pressure saturates exponentially, p=ρgλ(1−e^{−z/λ}) with λ=R/(2μK)≈2-4 silo radii - bottom pressures at 2 m and 20 m are nearly equal (~8 vs 11 kPa) where water gives 20 vs 196 kPa; discharge adds 20-30% dynamic overshoot.

topics.descZh: 液滴接触线被粗糙度钉扎,蒸发时只变矮不变小;边缘通量 J∝(R−r)^{−1/2} 在边缘发散,r=0.9R 处已是中心 3.2 倍——补流毛细流把颗粒全押到周界,干成一圈深环;去钉扎/表面活性剂/马兰戈尼回流可消除。
topics.descEn: A droplet's contact line is pinned by roughness, so it evaporates flatter, not smaller; the edge flux J∝(R−r)^{−1/2} diverges - already 3.2x the center at r=0.9R - so the make-up capillary flow convays every particle to the boundary and dries into a dark ring. De-pinning, surfactants or Marangoni recirculation erase it.

topics.descZh: ~10 nm 的 Fe₃O₄ 颗粒+表面活性剂+载液:热运动使其永不沉降、整体超顺磁;外场过阈(~15-30 mT)液面咔地立起尖刺,波长 λ=2π√(σ/ρg)≈9.8 mm,磁压在波峰顶住重力;磁液密封零泄漏零磨损,扬声器 ~0.5 g 磁液提升功率承受。
topics.descEn: ~10 nm single-domain Fe₃O₄ particles + surfactant + carrier: Brownian motion keeps them from ever settling and the fluid is superparamagnetic. Past a ~15-30 mT threshold the surface snaps into spikes of wavelength λ=2π√(σ/ρg)≈9.8 mm, magnetic pressure balancing gravity at each peak; hard-disk spindles and vacuum feedthroughs seal with zero leakage, and ~0.5 g in a tweeter's voice gap boosts power handling.

topics.descZh: 腿上密布 ~3 μm 针状刚毛(每 mm² 数千根),水只架在毛尖之间(接触角 >150°);~10 mg 体重把水面压出 ~3 mm 凹坑不破膜,单腿极限 ~1.5 mN ≈ 15 倍体重;划水把动量交给反向对涡,冲刺 ~1 m/s。
topics.descEn: The legs bristle with ~3 μm needle setae (thousands per mm²), water-repellent past 150°: water sits only between the hairs (Cassie state). A ~10 mg strider presses ~3 mm dimples without breaking the film — up to ~1.5 mN per leg, some 15× its weight — and rows its mid/hind legs to hand momentum to counter-rotating vortex pairs, sprinting near 1 m/s.

topics.descZh: 空化数 σ=(p∞−pv)/(½ρv²):100 m/s 时 σ≈0.01-0.03;空化器让蒸气泡包住弹体,只剩一圈碰水,湿面积 8.7→0.1 m²,阻力降约一个数量级;Shkval 火箭动力 ~100 m/s(约 200 节)= 常规鱼雷 4-5 倍。
topics.descEn: Cavitation number σ=(p∞−pv)/(½ρv²): at 100 m/s the dynamic pressure nears 5 MPa and σ≈0.01-0.03 — water boils on its own. A nose cavitator lets the vapor bubble swallow the whole body: only a ring touches water, wetted area falls from 8.7 to ~0.1 m², and total drag drops by roughly an order of magnitude. Rocket-powered Shkval was tested at ~100 m/s (about 200 knots), 4-5× a conventional torpedo.

topics.descZh: 25 t 舰载机以 240 km/h 着舰,尾钩挂上 φ35 mm 编织钢索:甲板下十字滑轮组推动油缸活塞,恒行程阀按凸轮曲线挤油——重量速度越大阀孔越大,减速却恒定,15 t 与 30 t 都在 ~70 m、约 2.1 s 停住,平均减速度 v²/2s ≈ 3.3 g;56 MJ 动能全变油热,AAG 可回收发电,索寿命 100-125 架次。
topics.descEn: A 25 t jet traps at 240 km/h, its tailhook snagging a 35 mm braided pendant: below deck, crossheads drive the rams while a constant-runout valve meters oil through a cam-shaped port - the heavier the load the wider the port, yet deceleration stays constant, stopping 15 t and 30 t alike in ~70 m and ~2.1 s at v²/2s ≈ 3.3 g; all 56 MJ becomes oil heat, AAG regenerates part of it, each wire lasts 100-125 traps.

topics.descZh: 浮力羽流把环境涡量吸入火区,涡管被拉伸变细:角动量守恒使切向速度随半径收缩暴涨(v∝1/r),涡核收到 0.5-2 m;旋转像离心泵把空气螺旋卷入焰心,卷吸骤增使火焰拉长 2-3 倍、燃烧速率升到池火的 3-7 倍、焰心 ~1,100 °C;旋数 S>~0.5 才成旋,2018 年 Carr Fire 火龙卷地面风速 ~230 km/h、高度过千米。
topics.descEn: The buoyant plume sucks ambient vorticity into the fire, and continuity stretches the vortex tubes: angular momentum conservation makes tangential speed explode as radius shrinks (v∝1/r), tightening the core to 0.5-2 m; rotation pumps air spirally into the flame like a centrifugal pump - entrainment surges, flames stretch 2-3× taller, burning runs 3-7× a pool fire at a ~1,100 °C core; S>~0.5 to form one, and the 2018 Carr Fire whirl hit ~230 km/h over a kilometre tall.

topics.descZh: 喷发柱失稳部分塌落,100-800 °C 的碎屑+气体体密度 100-1,000 kg/m³(空气百倍以上),成重力流贴地奔涌:头部 10-100 m 超驰卷吸,前缘 v≈0.35·√(2gHc) 达 10-100 m/s(云仙 1991 ~100 km/h,圣海伦斯 ~350 km/h);谷地导流、山脊部分翻越,能量锥 H/L≈0.2 预测泛滥半径(Hc=1 km → ~5 km);庞贝居民死于 ~400 °C 热冲击+窒息,数秒内。
topics.descEn: An unstable eruption column partially collapses into a mix at 100-800 °C with bulk density 100-1,000 kg/m³ (100× air), racing as a gravity current: a 10-100 m head overrides and entrains, the front runs at v≈0.35·√(2gHc) of 10-100 m/s (Unzen 1991 ~100 km/h, St Helens ~350 km/h); valleys funnel it, low ridges are partly overtopped, and the energy cone (H/L≈0.2) forecasts runout (Hc=1 km → ~5 km); Pompeii died of ~400 °C thermal shock + asphyxia within seconds.

topics.descZh: 燃机 Brayton 占高温端:TIT 1500-1600 °C、η≈40%,排气犹有 550-650 °C;HRSG 烟气下行、水汽逆流爬坡,排烟 ~100 °C;汽机冷凝于 30-40 °C。η_cc≈61-64%,启停 30-60 min 调峰。本质是两条热机在温度轴上首尾接力。
topics.descEn: The Brayton half owns the hot end: TIT 1500-1600 C, ~40% simple-cycle efficiency, exhaust still 550-650 C. The HRSG burns nothing - gas descends through superheater, evaporator, economizer while water-steam climbs counter-current, stack at ~100 C; the Rankine half harvests the cold end, condensing at 30-40 C. eta_cc = 61-64%, well above coal's 45-47%, with 30-60 min starts for peaking. In essence: two heat engines relaying butt-to-butt on the temperature axis.

topics.descZh: 气流上穿颗粒床:低速是固定床,Δp 随 u 涨;Δp 等于床重时床层悬浮——umf(0.1-1 mm 约 0.05-0.5 m/s)。此后余气聚成气泡,床如沸液膨胀 20-100%、温度均匀 ±5 °C、换热 200-500;CFB 旋风回送颗粒。本质是让颗粒相流体化,气泡驱动全床混合。
topics.descEn: Air rises through a particle bed: at low speed it is a fixed bed and dp climbs; when dp balances bed weight the bed levitates at umf (0.05-0.5 m/s for 0.1-1 mm sand). Past umf, extra gas gathers into bubbles: the bed expands 20-100% like boiling liquid, holds 5 C uniform, exchanges 200-500 W/m2K at walls; a CFB cyclone returns entrained solids several loops per second. In essence: fluidizing the solids so bubbles churn the whole bed into one mixed, isothermal reactor.

topics.descZh: 顺流同向而行,冷流出口永远低于热流;逆流迎面而行,冷流出口可反超——90 °C 热水把 20 °C 冷水送到 77 °C,自己只剩 47 °C。逆流 LMTD 更大:NTU=3 时 ε≈0.82,顺流仅 0.36(上限 57%)。板式人字波纹强制湍流,U 3000-7000 vs 管壳 500-1500。本质是温差剖面决定换热上限。
topics.descEn: Parallel flow runs the streams together and the cold outlet can never exceed the hot one; counterflow walks them into each other - 90 C hot water pushes 20 C water to 77 C while falling to 47 C. A uniform profile means larger LMTD and more heat per area: at NTU=3 counterflow reaches 0.82 while parallel stalls at 0.36 (ceiling 57%). Chevron plates trip turbulence for U 3000-7000 vs 500-1500; fish gills run the same trick. In essence: the temperature profile sets an exchanger's ceiling.

topics.descZh: 跨音速波阻不认机翼机身,只认轴向总截面积分布:翼根处面积陡增,激波扰动互相叠加,阻力峰发散;Whitcomb 面积律把机身在翼根掐出蜂腰,面积曲线平滑如 Sears-Haack 体,M=1.2 波阻立减一半——F-102 改一次机身,从此突破声障。
topics.descEn: Transonic wave drag doesn't care about wing or fuselage - only the axial total cross-section area. A spike at the wing root lets shock disturbances reinforce and drag explode; Whitcomb's area rule pinches the fuselage into a Coke-bottle waist so the area curve smooths toward a Sears-Haack body, halving wave drag at M1.2. F-102 got one new fuselage and broke the sound barrier.

topics.descZh: 把机翼斜放,只有垂直前缘的分量 V·cosΛ 参与造升压,等效马赫数降低,M_crit 从 0.78 抬到 0.85+(35° 后掠 +22%);代价是展向流把边界层推向翼尖,大迎角翼尖先失速、机头上仰——前掠翼反过来翼根先失速,安全却要防气动弹性发散。
topics.descEn: Sweep the wing and only the component V·cosΛ perpendicular to the leading edge builds pressure: effective Mach drops, M_crit climbs from 0.78 past 0.85 (35 deg of sweep = +22%). The price: spanwise flow shoves the boundary layer outward, tips stall first at high angle of attack, and the nose pitches up. Forward sweep stalls at the root - safe, but aeroelastic divergence must be engineered away.

topics.descZh: 水锤泵不烧油不接电:2 m 落差的水加速到 1 m/s 后被阀门拍死,水击压强 Δp=ρcΔv 飙到静压十几倍,顶开止回阀把 5-20% 的水扬到 10-20 倍高处;一次循环五幕戏(加速/冲关/水击/扬水/回位)每秒重复一次,能连跑百年无人值守。
topics.descEn: A hydraulic ram needs no fuel or wire: water falling 2 m accelerates to 1 m/s, the waste valve slams shut, water-hammer pressure Δp=ρcΔv spikes to a dozen times static, and the check valve lifts to raise 5-20% of the flow 10-20x higher. Five acts per cycle - accelerate, slam, hammer, pump, reset - repeating about once a second, unattended for a century.

topics.titleEn: Rossby Waves & Western Intensification: the Asymmetry Spun by Earth
topics.descZh: 行星涡度 f=2Ωsinφ 随纬度变化:水柱南北漂移,为了守恒 f+ζ 必须就地旋转——位移即恢复,扰动因此一路向西传播。大洋斜压罗斯贝波慢到 cm/s,横穿太平洋要 10-30 年(TOPEX/Poseidon 卫星实测);大气罗斯贝波则直接指挥天气。西岸的窄急流是这套动力学的收银台:内区 Sverdrup 平衡把风应力旋度积分成向南的缓慢输送,而信息(罗斯贝波)只向西走,西边界必须用一条摩擦薄层把水送回去——Stommel 1948 年解出西向强化:湾流/黑潮宽 ~100 km、流速 ~2 m/s,内区数千 km、只有 cm/s,不对称 100:1。把西边界关掉,整个副热带环流当场散架。
topics.descEn: Planetary vorticity f = 2Ω·sin(phi) changes with latitude: nudge a water column and it must spin in place to conserve f+zeta - displacement becomes restoration, and the disturbance walks west. Baroclinic ocean Rossby waves crawl at cm/s, taking 10-30 years to cross the Pacific (as TOPEX/Poseidon measured); atmospheric ones steer weather outright. The narrow western boundary current is where this dynamics checks out: interior Sverdrup balance integrates wind-stress curl into slow equatorward drift, and since information (Rossby waves) only travels west, the western wall must return the water in a thin frictional layer - Stommel solved western intensification in 1948: Gulf Stream / Kuroshio ~100 km wide at ~2 m/s against an interior thousands of km wide at cm/s, a 100:1 asymmetry. Switch the western boundary off and the whole subtropical gyre falls apart on the spot.

topics.titleEn: The Muffler: Making Sound Waves Fight Themselves
topics.descZh: 四缸四冲程发动机每两转排两次气,800-6000 rpm 对应点火基频 27-200 Hz 加谐波——排气噪声是一条宽频轰鸣。消声器用三招拆它:扩张腔靠截面突扩的阻抗失配把声波反射回源头,传递损失 TL=10·lg(1+¼(A₂/A₁−A₁/A₂)²·sin²kl),在四分之一波长整数倍处给出梳状峰;Helmholtz 旁支共振腔调到轰鸣主频,把那一窄带的能量「吸」进颈腔——TL 曲线上又高又窄的手术刀峰;吸声芯(钢棉/玻璃纤维)把高频声能摩擦成热,削平宽带毛刺。代价是背压:残余排气阻力让功率损失 1-3%。组合拳下来总消声 25-40 dB——排气的「安静」是三件声学兵器轮流上阵的结果。
topics.descEn: A four-cylinder four-stroke exhausts twice per two revolutions: 800-6000 rpm maps to firing fundamentals of 27-200 Hz plus harmonics - one broadband roar. A muffler dismantles it with three tools. The expansion chamber reflects waves back at the source by impedance mismatch, with transmission loss TL = 10·lg(1+1/4(m-1/m)^2 sin^2(kl)) peaking in a comb at odd quarter-wavelengths. The Helmholtz side-branch resonator is tuned to the drone, swallowing that narrow band - a tall, narrow surgical spike on the TL curve. The absorbent core (steel wool / fiberglass) grinds high-frequency energy into heat. The bill is backpressure: 1-3% of power. Together the three take 25-40 dB out - exhaust

topics.titleEn: Birth of Wind Waves: From Centimeter Ripples to Ocean Swell
topics.descZh: 绝对平静的水面上,风怎么造出第一道波?先靠 Phillips 共振:大气湍流的压强起伏含有各种波长成分,与水面微扰共振的分量把能量线性注入——最先长出波长 ~1.7 cm 的毛细波,那里表面张力当恢复力,相速度正处 23 cm/s 的谷底。毛细波一出现,镜面作废,Miles 切流不稳定接管:波峰上方的临界层把风的动量按周期泵进与波速同频的分量,波幅以指数生长。波长越滚越长,恢复力从表面张力换岗给重力,波龄 c/U₁₀ 从 0.2 的尖陡幼波长到 1 的圆润老波;显著波高沿风区按 F^0.5 走 JONSWAP 包络,充分发展海况由 U₁₀ 封顶。陡度 H/L≈1/7 是破碎上限,一过就卷出白帽;风停之后,老波跑出风区成为涌浪——色散把长波排到最前面,冲浪者等的就是这份比风更老的余生。
topics.descEn: How does wind raise the first wave on a mirror-flat sea? Start with Phillips resonance: turbulent pressure fluctuations carry every wavelength, and the components resonating with tiny surface disturbances inject energy linearly - capillary waves near 1.7 cm grow first, where surface tension is the restoring force and phase speed sits at its 23 cm/s floor. Once ripples roughen the mirror, Miles shear-flow instability takes over: a critical layer above each crest pumps wind momentum, cycle by cycle, into the component traveling with the wave, and amplitude grows exponentially. Wavelengths lengthen, gravity replaces surface tension, and wave age c/U10 climbs from 0.2 (sharp young seas with whitecaps) to 1 (rounded old seas); significant height grows along the fetch like F^0.5 under the JONSWAP envelope, capped by fully developed sea for a given U10. Steepness H/L = 1/7 is the breaking limit - past it, whitecaps shed the excess; when the wind stops, old waves leave the fetch as swell, dispersion putting the longest waves in front.

topics.titleEn: Urban Heat Island: A Man-made Warm Hill That Peaks at Night
topics.descZh: 城区气温比郊区高 1-7 °C,而且夜里最强——反直觉,但道理全在能量收支里:白天混凝土与沥青反照率低(0.1-0.2,植被 0.2-0.3)、热容又大,把太阳辐射存进墙体与路面;入夜,郊区晴空直通 3 K 的宇宙背景,靠长波辐射快速冷却,城市却把白天存的热缓慢吐回街谷,楼墙还遮住天空(天空视因子小),再叠上空调外机与车流的人为热(20-100 W/m²)。城区上空于是鼓起一座「暖山」:暖空气受浮上升,郊区冷空气贴地回流补位——海陆风的城市版,叫乡村风环流;它把边界层抬成穹顶,把气溶胶与臭氧闷在城里,下风侧雷暴 +15-25%,制冷能耗每升温 1 °C 涨 5-10%。解法两招:冷屋顶提反照率,绿屋顶与行道树用蒸腾把显热换成潜热。
topics.descEn: City air runs 1-7 C hotter than the suburbs, and the gap peaks at night - counterintuitive, but it is all in the energy budget: by day, concrete and asphalt have low albedo (0.1-0.2 vs 0.2-0.3 for vegetation) and huge heat capacity, banking solar radiation in walls and pavement; after dark, open suburbs radiate straight to the 3 K cosmic background and cool fast, while the city slowly pours its stored heat back into street canyons whose walls block the sky (small sky view factor), topped up by anthropogenic heat from AC units and traffic (20-100 W/m2). A warm dome balloons over town: warm air rises over the city, cooled country air slides back along the ground - an urban cousin of the sea breeze called the rural-breeze circulation; it lifts the boundary layer into a lid that traps aerosols and ozone, boosts downwind thunderstorms by 15-25%, and adds 5-10% cooling energy per +1 C. Two remedies: raise albedo with cool roofs, and swap sensible heat for latent heat with green roofs and street trees.

topics.titleEn: The Pulsejet: Combustion as a Metronome
topics.descZh: 没有压气机、没有涡轮,脉冲喷气发动机用点火的节拍硬凑出压缩:簧片阀放进新鲜混合气,燃油点燃,压力骤升的瞬间把阀片拍死,燃气只能冲进长尾管喷出;排气气柱靠惯性继续外冲,在燃烧室里拉出负压,阀片再度弹开回吸下一口——一个循环就此闭合。这就是 V-1 飞弹的心脏 Argus As 014:静态推力 270 kg,循环频率 45-50 Hz,伦敦人听到的『嗡嗡』声正是每秒五十次爆燃,于是叫它 buzz bomb。尾管是定调的谐振管,频率 f≈c/2L:拖动「尾管长度」滑杆,3.5 m 时约 49 Hz,缩到 0.5 m 会飙到 340 Hz,音调与推力一起改变。按「单循环慢放」以 1/50 速看完整一拍:阀开—点火—阀关—尾喷—回吸,示波曲线上每根尖刺对应一声嗡鸣。账本同样极端:成本只有涡轮喷气的约 1/20,极速 640 km/h;代价是油耗近 26 L/min、续航仅 22-25 min、振动撕扯机身、高空易熄火——约有 10200 枚 V-1 掠过欧洲天空。按「供油过猛失谐」看燃烧节奏与尾管不合拍时,哑火连环、推力当场跳水。
topics.descEn: No compressor and no turbine - a pulsejet buys its compression from the rhythm of ignition itself. Reed valves admit the fresh mixture; the fuel ignites; the pressure spike slams the valves shut in the same instant, so the burning gas has nowhere to go but down the long tailpipe; the inertia of the exhaust column keeps the flow moving outward and stretches a partial vacuum behind it, the petals spring open, and the next charge is inhaled - one loop closed. That heartbeat powered the V-1 flying bomb: the Argus As 014 gave 270 kg (2.65 kN) of static thrust at 45-50 cycles per second, and the famous London buzz was fifty detonations a second - hence buzz bomb. The tailpipe is the tuning fork: f is about c/2L. Drag the tailpipe-length slider - 3.5 m hums near 49 Hz while 0.5 m shrieks toward 340 Hz - and watch thrust move with the pitch. Press single-cycle replay to watch one full beat at 1/50 speed: valves open, ignition, valves slam, exhaust surge, suction - every spike on the scope trace is one buzz. The ledger is just as extreme: roughly 1/20 the cost of a turbojet and 640 km/h top speed, paid for with about 26 L/min of fuel, only 22-25 minutes of endurance, vibration that shook airframes apart, and flameout at altitude; about 10,200 V-1s crossed these skies. Press over-fuel detune to watch thrust collapse the moment the burn rhythm falls out of step with the pipe.

topics.titleEn: Ship Squat & Bank Suction: The River Squeezes Back
topics.descZh: 浅水会改变一切:船向前走,必须把同体积的水往后送,河床就在船底几米处,过流断面被船身卡掉一大半——水只能加速钻过船底,压强随之下降(连续性+伯努利),船体被整体往水面下按,这就是船体下沉 squat,而且船尾比船头沉得多,形成尾倾。经验式 δ≈Cb·V²/100(米,V 用节,方型系数 Cb≈0.8):12 节在开敞浅水约沉 1.15 m,进运河这类受限水域还要再乘 ~2;水深吃水比小于 1.2 时最危险。它随速度平方增长:速度加倍、下沉四倍——港区限速 8-12 节不是噪音规定,是龙骨保命线。贴近岸壁或与邻船并行时,内侧水道更窄、流速更快、压强更低,船会被『吸』过去,1911 年 Olympic 就这样被巡洋舰 Hawke 撞出大洞,法院判定元凶正是船吸。拖动「航速」滑杆看船身当场下沉、龙骨下剩余水深(UKC)读数闪红;拖「水深/吃水」与「岸距」看流线由绿转红。按「两船并行」复现互吸场面。
topics.descEn: Shallow water changes everything. A ship must push its own volume of water astern, and when the seabed lies only a few meters below the keel the flow section is pinched to a fraction - the water accelerates under the hull and its pressure drops (continuity plus Bernoulli), pressing the whole ship deeper: squat, with the stern usually dipping more than the bow. The working rule is delta = Cb x V2/100 in meters with V in knots and Cb about 0.8 - at 12 knots in open shallow water that is about 1.15 m, and confined canals roughly double it; the danger peaks when depth-to-draft falls under 1.2. Squat also trims the stern, so air draft and helm response are always computed at the tail, and every canal pilot carries a speed-squat table. Squat grows with the square of speed: double the speed, four times the sinkage - which is why harbor limits of 8-12 knots are keel-survival rules, not noise ordinances. Hug a bank or run abeam of another ship and the inner channel narrows further, flows faster, pushes pressure further down, and the hulls are sucked together, stern first - in 1911 Olympic was holed by the cruiser Hawke, and the court blamed precisely this suction. Drag the speed slider and watch the hull sink while the under-keel clearance readout flashes red; drag depth/draft and bank distance to turn the flow lines from green to red; press two ships abeam to replay the mutual attraction.

topics.titleEn: BLEVE: When the Fire Gets Inside the Tank
topics.descZh: BLEVE(沸腾液体膨胀蒸气爆炸)是一场被火焰『策划』的定时局:液化气储罐常温下靠自身蒸气压平衡——20 °C 的丙烷罐内 8.4 bar,罐里大半是液体。火焰舔上罐体时,命运开始分岔:浸在液体里的罐壁被沸腾高效冷却,壁温≈液温;而液位以上的气相段罐壁没有任何保护,数百秒内烧到红热——钢在 600 °C 只剩 1/3 强度,8-20 bar 的内压当场把罐壁撕开。降压瞬间,过热液体失去压强支撑整体闪蒸,膨胀比约 1:270,白雾云吞掉视野;零点几秒后被火源点燃,火球直径 D≈29·M^(1/3) 米(15 吨 LPG → 近 72 m,持续约 10 s),叠加冲击波与数百米抛射的罐体碎片。1984 年墨西哥城 San Juan Ixhuatepec 连环 BLEVE,500+ 人遇难。拖「火焰功率」与「液位」滑杆走完整个进程;按「破裂瞬间慢放」看三幕:红热—裂开闪蒸—火球吞没画面;按「冷却保护对照」看水幕如何把气相壁温摁住——消防铁律由此而来:先冷却罐体,绝不站在罐端或安全阀正下,火势失控立即撤 800 m。
topics.descEn: BLEVE - Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion - is a catastrophe staged by fire itself. An LPG tank lives in equilibrium with its own vapor pressure: propane at 20 C holds 8.4 bar, and most of the tank is liquid. When flames lick the shell, fate splits in two: the wall wetted by liquid is cooled efficiently by boiling and stays near liquid temperature, while the wall above the liquid line - the vapor space - has no such protection and glows red hot within minutes. Steel at 600 C keeps only a third of its strength, and 8-20 bar of internal pressure tears the overheated patch open. The instant pressure releases, the superheated liquid flash-boils as one body, expanding about 1:270; the white cloud swallows the view and ignites a fraction of a second later. Fireball diameter follows D = 29 x M^(1/3) meters - 15 tonnes of LPG gives a 72 m fireball lasting about 10 seconds - plus a shockwave and tank fragments hurled hundreds of meters. The 1984 San Juan Ixhuatepec disaster chain in Mexico City killed over 500 people. Drag the flame-power and liquid-level sliders to run the whole process; press rupture slow-motion for the three acts - red heat, tearing flash, fireball swallowing the frame; press cooling protection to see a water curtain pin the vapor-wall temperature down - the origin of the firefighter doctrine: cool the tank, never stand at the ends or under the relief valve, and retreat 800 m once fire is out of control.

topics.titleZh: 风幕机:一条看不见的门帘
topics.titleEn: The Air Curtain: An Invisible Doorway
topics.descZh: 商超大门顶上那条不起眼的窄缝,是冬天门口最值钱的设备:风机把空气从约 30 mm 的扁缝里以 8-25 m/s 喷出,形成一道贴着门框直下的扁平射流——一条看不见的门帘。门内外温差与风压都在驱赶空气穿门:热浮力让外面的空气从门顶涌入、里面的冷气沿门底漏走;而射流靠动量把它们顶回去——穿透流撞上射流被偏折,门被分成两层:外层回流带走渗入的热,内层保持恒温,热量传递被抑制 80% 以上,人却可以随便进出。成败全在动量对峙:射流动量必须压过浮力对流加风压,门越高、温差越大,需要的出口动量越大——超过 3 m 的高门要用双排喷口或更强的风机;安装角 0-30° 前倾让射流斜着顶住穿透流,卷吸的环境空气让射流沿程变宽变重,覆盖更满。它守着商超的门,也守冷库的低温与洁净室的尘埃;对比 PVC 软帘,风幕无障碍、通行体验好,账要按能耗与舒适一起算。按「开关对照」看红蓝粒子在门口对撞、风幕一开穿透流当场被吹弯折返、热通量表骤降,一关热浪滚进;按「风扰失败案例」看一阵横风如何把它吹穿;按「冷库模式」体验 40 K 级温差下的高强度对峙;拖动「射流速度」与「内外温差」滑杆,找到刚好压住穿透流的最低动量。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The unremarkable slot above a supermarket door is the most valuable equipment at the entrance in winter: a fan blows air through a ~30 mm wide slot at 8-25 m/s, laying down a flat, door-frame-hugging jet - an invisible curtain. Temperature difference and wind pressure both push air through the doorway: buoyancy makes warm outside air spill in over the top while cold inside air leaks out along the floor; the jet answers with momentum - the penetrating flow hits it and gets deflected, and the doorway splits into two zones, an outer return flow that carries the leaked heat away and an inner layer that holds its temperature, cutting heat transfer by more than 80 percent while people walk through freely. Everything hangs on the momentum duel: jet momentum must beat buoyant convection plus wind, and the taller the door and the bigger the temperature difference, the more exit momentum is needed - doors over 3 m call for double nozzle rows or stronger fans. An installation angle of 0-30 degrees lets the jet lean into the penetrating flow, and the ambient air it entrains widens and thickens the sheet down the door for fuller coverage. It guards shop entrances, cold-store temperatures and cleanroom dust control; against PVC strip curtains it offers a barrier you walk through without hands, and the account must be settled in energy and comfort together. Press the on-off A/B to watch red and blue particles collide at the door, the penetrating flow bent back the instant the curtain opens and the heat-flux gauge plunge - switch it off and the heat rolls in; press the wind case to see a crosswind blow it through; press cold-store mode for the high-stakes duel at a 40 K difference; drag jet velocity and temperature difference to find the least momentum that still holds the line. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 水下滑翔机:不用螺旋桨横渡大洋
topics.titleEn: The Underwater Glider: Crossing Oceans without a Propeller
topics.descZh: 水下滑翔机是大海里最慢的潜航器,也是续航最长的:它干脆没有螺旋桨,靠改变自己的净浮力前进。外油囊充油,排水体积变大而总质量不变,浮力转正,机体比水轻;放油则变重——阿基米德定律成了发动机。配重块前后移动调俯仰角:『比水重 + 低头』斜向下滑,『比水轻 + 抬头』斜向上滑,锯齿状剖面一路横穿大洋。它像滑翔机不像船:不向后推水,而是把浮力势能当作滑翔机的高度,机翼把垂直运动折算成前进。代价是慢:典型航速只有 0.3-0.5 m/s(0.6-1 kn),滑翔角 20-30°,一个 200-1000 m 的剖面要花 3-9 小时;回报是省:推进功率只要数瓦,而同尺度的 AUV 螺旋桨要千瓦,一罐电池足以续航 3000-6000 km、海上数月到一年。它只在上浮冒头时伸出天线,用 GPS/卫星定位并回传数据,其余时间完全沉默。Seaglider、Slocum 与 6000 m 级深海滑翔机正在 Argo 类观测网服役,源源不断送回温盐剖面——气候研究最基础的口粮。拖动「净浮力」看滑翔角变缓变陡,拖「俯仰配平」找最省力的姿态;按「完整剖面」看油囊充放油、俯仰翻转与锯齿轨迹;按「滑翔角优化」与「6000 m 深潜」分别体验最平缓滑翔与深海剖面——能量条全程停在『瓦』级。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The underwater glider is the slowest submarine in the ocean and the one with by far the longest endurance: it has no propeller at all, and moves by changing its own net buoyancy. Pump oil into the external bladder and the displaced volume grows while total mass stays fixed, so buoyancy turns positive and the vehicle becomes lighter than water; release the oil and it grows heavy - Archimedes' law becomes the engine. A trim weight slides fore and aft to set pitch: heavy-and-nose-down glides obliquely down, light-and-nose-up glides obliquely up, and the sawtooth profile marches across an ocean. It flies like a glider, not a boat: it never pushes water backward, it spends buoyancy potential energy the way a sailplane spends altitude, and its wings fold vertical motion into forward motion. The price is speed: typically just 0.3-0.5 m/s (0.6-1 kn) at a 20-30 degree glide angle, with a single 200-1000 m profile taking 3-9 hours. The reward is thrift: a few watts of propulsion against the kilowatts an AUV propeller burns, so one battery stack covers 3000-6000 km and months to a year at sea. The glider only surfaces to poke its antenna out for GPS fixes and satellite data return, then goes silent again. Seaglider, Slocum and deep-sea gliders rated to 6000 m now serve in Argo-style observing networks, returning temperature-salinity profiles - the staple diet of climate research. Drag net buoyancy and watch the glide angle flatten or steepen; drag pitch trim to find the thriftiest attitude; press full profile to see the bladder pump, the pitch flip and the sawtooth trail; press glide-angle optimization and the 6000 m dive for the flattest glide and the deep section - while the energy bar never leaves the watt class. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 水火箭:能量交给谁最划算
topics.titleEn: The Water Rocket: Who Should Carry the Momentum?
topics.descZh: 一只 2 L 汽水瓶打到 40-80 psi,发射的瞬间,压缩空气把水从 21 mm 瓶口高速推出——反冲把瓶子送上 30-80 m 高空。整台『发动机』只悬在一个问题上:动量守恒 F = ṁ·v_e + (p−p_a)·A 里,反应质量该选谁?答案藏在水与空气约 800 倍的密度差里:空气质量太小,喷得再快,ṁ·v_e 也凑不出像样的推力;水在 60 psi 下能给出 100-200 N 峰值推力、20-30 m/s 出口水速、5-15 g 量级的发射过载,不到半秒就把全部动量交割完毕。但齐奥尔科夫斯基的账本同时警告:水也是死重,带太多,大半能量花在抬水上。两条枷锁往相反方向拉,夹出最优解——水量约 1/3 筒容:太少推力不足,太多重力吃掉加速。发射全程罐内气体近似绝热膨胀(p·V^1.4≈常数),压力与推力一路衰减到水尽为止,腾空后只剩弹道与阻力的老故事;竞赛级多级水火箭把『甩掉空罐』做到极致,纪录已破 500 m。按「发射」看水雾锥喷出、推力条冲高回落、高度表爬升;拖「水量」滑杆当场找 1/3 最优——过多过少都飞不高;拖「初始压强」看推力随压强抬升;按「纯空气对照」验证没有质量就没有动量;按「最优水量巡游」让机器连射五发,高度在 1/3 处隆起成峰。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A 2 L soda bottle pumped to 40-80 psi makes one of the cheapest rockets in the world: the instant of launch, compressed air blasts the water out of the 21 mm mouth, and recoil carries the bottle 30-80 m into the sky. The whole engine hangs on one question in F = mdot x ve + (p - pa) x A: who should carry the reaction mass? The answer hides in the roughly 800-fold density gap between water and air: air is far too light - however fast you squirt it, a tiny mdot cannot stack up meaningful momentum; water delivers 100-200 N of peak thrust at 60 psi with exit speeds of 20-30 m/s and launch overloads of the 5-15 g class, spending the entire momentum budget in under half a second. But Tsiolkovsky's ledger warns the other way: water is also dead weight, and carry too much and most of the energy goes into lifting water, not rocket. The two chains pull in opposite directions and pinch out an optimum near one third of the bottle: too little and thrust starves, too much and gravity taxes every newton. Through the whole burn the gas expands almost adiabatically (p x V^1.4 = const), so pressure and thrust decay together until the water is gone; once clear of the pad it is a plain ballistic-plus-drag story, and competition multistage water rockets push the throw-away-your-empty-tank trick past 500 m. Press Launch for the spray cone, the thrust spike and the climbing altimeter; drag the water slider to find the one-third optimum live - both too much and too little fly low; drag pressure and watch thrust rise with it; press pure-air to prove that without mass there is no momentum; press the optimal-water tour and the machine fires five rounds, altitudes humping into a peak at one third. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 微流控与液滴芯片:把实验室缩进指甲盖
topics.titleEn: Microfluidics: A Lab on a Fingernail-Sized Chip
topics.descZh: 把通道刻到 10-500 微米,流体的规则就被改写:雷诺数 Re=ρvd/μ 掉到 0.01-100,黏性完胜惯性——流动永远是层流,红蓝两股并肩前进、界面笔直,互不打漩;代价是混合只剩分子扩散,t≈w²/2D,100 μm 通道约 5 s、几百微米要几十秒,太慢;工程师把通道折成蛇形,用拉伸-折叠的「混沌对流」把混合压到亚秒。层流的可预测也是礼物:T 型口里油相按流量比把水相剪成单分散液滴(变异系数 CV 小于 2%),一颗液滴就是一个 pL-nL 反应器,液滴 PCR 每秒可生成上千颗;表面张力在小尺度反超体积力,毛细自己驱动流体——纸基侧向流试纸(L∝√t)就是验孕棒原理;电润湿 EWOD 用电压改接触角,把液滴逐极拖走,叫数字微流控。比表面巨大还带来秒级换热(PCR 变温)与单细胞捕获,喷墨打印头是它的工业表亲。演示:滑块调流速/通道宽/水相占比,联动看 Re、扩散时间与液滴尺寸频率;按钮切「直道对照」「T 型液滴」「电润湿」。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Etch a channel down to 10-500 micrometres and the rules of fluid flow are rewritten: the Reynolds number Re=ρvd/μ falls to 0.01-100, viscosity beats inertia outright - flow is always laminar, the red and blue streams advance side by side with a razor-straight interface, never swirling into each other; the price is that mixing is left to molecular diffusion alone, t≈w²/2D, about 5 s for a 100 μm channel and tens of seconds for a few hundred - far too slow. So engineers fold the channel into a serpentine and use stretch-and-fold chaotic advection to crush mixing to sub-second. Laminar predictability is also a gift: at a T-junction, oil shears the water into monodisperse droplets (coefficient of variation under 2%), and one droplet is one pL-nL reactor - droplet PCR platforms generate thousands per second. At small scale surface tension outruns body forces: capillarity pumps fluid by itself - the paper lateral-flow strip (L∝√t) is exactly how a pregnancy test works; electrowetting (EWOD) shifts the contact angle with voltage and drags droplets pad by pad, called digital microfluidics. The huge surface-to-volume ratio also buys second-scale heat exchange (PCR thermal cycling) and single-cell capture, and the inkjet printhead is its most successful industrial cousin. In the demo: sliders set flow velocity / channel width / water fraction, linked live to Re, diffusion time and droplet size & frequency; buttons switch straight-channel comparison, the T-junction droplet line and electrowetting. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 活性污泥法:吃掉污水的微生物军团
topics.titleEn: Activated Sludge: The Microbe Legion That Eats Wastewater
topics.descZh: 城市污水的 BOD(可生化降解有机物)约 200-300 mg/L,排河前要压到 10 以下——干活的不是化学品,而是一池微生物军团。污水先过格栅拦漂浮物、沉砂池除沙,初沉池靠重力沉掉 50-70% 可沉固体;真正的主角在曝气池:0.1-1 mm 的菌胶团絮体一边吸附氧化有机物、一边合成新细胞,鼓风机经微孔曝气盘同时供氧(氧转移效率仅 10-30%,占全厂电耗 40-60%)与搅拌。关键参数:污泥负荷 F/M 0.2-0.5 kgBOD/(kgMLSS·d)、水力停留 4-8 h、污泥龄 SRT 10-20 d——SRT 必须大于硝化菌的倍增时间,才保得住这些慢郎中。二沉池靠重力沉降絮体,污泥回流 50-100% 维持池内浓度,多出来的当剩余污泥排走:增殖多少排多少。脱氮要两步接力:好氧硝化 NH₄⁺→NO₂⁻→NO₃⁻,再缺氧反硝化 NO₃⁻→N₂ 逸出(碳源用原水 BOD),A/O 工艺把缺氧区前置+内回流;除磷靠聚磷菌先厌氧释磷、后好氧超量吸磷(A²/O)。丝状菌一旦过量繁殖就糟了:污泥膨胀、絮体拉丝、二沉池翻泥、出水超标。演示:调曝气量看 DO 崩溃与电耗,调回流比与污泥龄,按「内回流 A/O」「污泥膨胀」「氮路径」看工艺切换。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Municipal wastewater carries a BOD (biodegradable organic matter) of about 200-300 mg/L, which must be pressed below 10 before discharge to the river - and the workforce is not chemicals but a tankful of microbes. Screens first catch floating rags, a grit chamber settles out sand, and the primary clarifier removes 50-70% of settleable solids by gravity; the real protagonists work in the aeration tank: flocs of 0.1-1 mm bio-aggregates adsorb and oxidize organics while synthesizing new cells, and blowers push air through fine-bubble diffusers to supply oxygen (transfer efficiency only 10-30%, yet 40-60% of total plant power) and stir. The key parameters: food-to-mass ratio F/M of 0.2-0.5 kgBOD/(kgMLSS·d), hydraulic residence 4-8 h, sludge age SRT 10-20 d - SRT must exceed the nitrifiers' doubling time or these slow growers wash out. In the secondary clarifier flocs settle by gravity; return sludge at 50-100% keeps the tank concentration up, and the surplus leaves as waste sludge: grow as much as you remove. Nitrogen takes a two-leg relay: aerobic nitrification NH₄⁺→NO₂⁻→NO₃⁻, then anoxic denitrification NO₃⁻→N₂ escaping to air (carbon sourced from raw BOD); the A/O process puts the anoxic zone first plus internal recycle. Phosphorus relies on PAOs that release P anaerobically then take up luxury amounts aerobically (A²/O). And when filamentous organisms overgrow, it all breaks: sludge bulking, stringy flocs, clarifier blanket washout, effluent violations. In the demo: drag aeration to watch DO collapse and power burn, tune return ratio and sludge age, and toggle internal recycle A/O, the bulking event and the nitrogen path. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 地铁活塞风:列车自己造的风
topics.titleEn: Piston Wind: The Train Makes Its Own Breeze
topics.descZh: 列车在隧道里就是一枚紧密贴合的活塞:车头把前方空气一路推成压缩区,车尾拖出一条负压尾涡,而真正干活的是车体与隧道壁之间那圈 10-25 cm 的环状间隙——被挤压的空气从环隙高速泻出,像环形射流一样把动量整层整层交给隧道空气。车速 80 km/h 时,隧道内的风速可以冲到 5-10 m/s;一列车通过,等于给几公里隧道换了半口气——全线每天的活塞换气量以百万立方米计。这阵风既是麻烦也是恩人:麻烦在站台——列车进站前,活塞风先撞进站台,席卷候车人群、吹飞帽子(站台风速瞬间可达 10 m/s 级),所以要在车站两端开「活塞风井」提前泄压;恩人在隧道——列车自己就是全隧道最大的通风机,隧道里的热(刹车电阻、牵引电机、空调冷凝热)靠它一列车一列车搬出去,很多线路的日常通风不靠风机、全靠活塞效应,能省下大笔电费。现代地铁又给这阵风加了两道开关:站台屏蔽门(PSD)把站台与隧道完全隔开——候车更安全,站台冷量不再漏进隧道,空调能耗可省 30-40%,但隧道散热就得另请隧道风机;列车头型流线化(长细比加大)则把出洞瞬间的「微气压波」压下去——压缩波在隧道口突然释放,会发出低沉的 boom(日本隧道为此把车头造到 10 m 级长细比)。演示里拖「车速」与「阻塞比」看隧道风速与站台风压怎么飙;开关「屏蔽门」与「活塞风井」对比站台的两种命运;按「微气压波」看列车冲出洞口那一声低爆。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A train in a tunnel is a close-fitting piston: the nose shoves the air ahead into a compression zone, the tail drags a negative-pressure wake, and the real work happens in the 10-25 cm annular gap between car body and tunnel wall - squeezed air jets out of this ring at high speed, handing momentum to the tunnel air layer by layer like an annular jet. At 80 km/h the tunnel wind can hit 5-10 m/s; one passing train exchanges half the air of kilometers of tunnel, and a whole line moves millions of cubic meters a day on piston action alone. The wind is both nuisance and benefactor: a nuisance on platforms - before a train arrives the piston wind slams in and can gust to 10 m/s across the waiting crowd, so piston relief shafts at both station ends vent the pressure early; a benefactor in the tunnel - the train is the biggest ventilation fan of the whole system, hauling brake-resistor, traction and air-conditioning heat out trainload by trainload, and many lines run their daily ventilation on piston effect alone, saving serious electricity. Modern metros added two switches: platform screen doors (PSD) seal the platform from the tunnel - safer waiting and 30-40 percent less cooling energy, though tunnel heat then needs dedicated fans; and streamlined noses (high fineness ratio) tame the micro-pressure wave released when the compression wave exits the tunnel - the low boom that made Japanese engineers stretch bullet-train noses to ten meters. In the demo, drag speed and blocking ratio to watch tunnel wind and platform pressure climb; toggle screen doors and relief shafts to compare the platform fates; press micro-pressure wave for the boom at the portal. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 汽轮机:蒸汽的多级接力
topics.descZh: 全球一半以上的电,最后一步都靠同一种机器:锅炉里 540-600 °C、16-28 MPa 的过热蒸汽冲进汽轮机,叶轮把热变成转轴上的扭矩。它的工作只有一句话——让蒸汽一步一步泄压,每一级都把一小份压力能变成速度能再变成机械能:静止喷嘴先把蒸汽加速到几百米每秒,动叶片把动能转成叶轮的旋转,冲动式的叶片只负责「拐弯」,反动式的叶片自己还当半个喷嘴,蒸汽在动叶通道里继续膨胀再推一把。难点是体积:压力逐级跌落、蒸汽比容暴涨上千倍,低压缸末级叶片长到 1-1.5 m,叶尖圆周速度逼近 600 m/s——超过音速,材料要跟离心力与湿蒸汽水滴的冲蚀同时赛跑。末级之后蒸汽落到冷凝器,5 kPa 的深度真空把可用焓再压榨一截:凝结出来的不是废热而是「许可」——没有低压的终点,前面的膨胀根本推不完。再热与回热把效率从朗肯理想一路顶到 45%:高压缸排汽回炉重新过热,抽汽加热给水,少烧的每一克煤都是钱。拖「主蒸汽压力/温度」看各级压降重排,拖「冷凝背压」看末级叶片变化;按「速度三角形」慢放叶片里的动量交换,按「末级水蚀」看水滴打叶尖,按「真空对照」看效率账。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
More than half of the world's electricity takes its final step through the same machine: superheated steam at 540-600 C and 16-28 MPa blasts into a steam turbine, and bladed wheels convert heat into shaft torque. The job is one sentence - let steam relieve its pressure step by step, each stage converting a small slice of pressure energy into velocity, then into mechanical work: stationary nozzles accelerate steam to hundreds of metres per second, moving blades turn that kinetic energy into rotation; impulse blades only redirect, reaction blades act as half-nozzles themselves, expanding the steam further as it passes. The hard part is volume: as pressure falls stage by stage, specific volume swells a thousandfold, last-stage blades grow to 1-1.5 m, and tip speed approaches 600 m/s - past the speed of sound, with materials racing both centrifugal load and wet-steam droplet erosion. After the last stage, steam lands in the condenser at 5 kPa of deep vacuum, squeezing out more available enthalpy: the condensate is not waste but permission - without a low-pressure endpoint, the upstream expansion cannot be completed. Reheat and regeneration push efficiency to 45 percent: HP exhaust returns to the boiler for a second superheat, extraction steam preheats feedwater, and every gram of coal saved is money. Drag main-steam pressure/temperature to reshuffle stage drops, drag condenser backpressure to resize the last blades; press velocity triangle to slow-motion the momentum swap inside a blade row, last-stage erosion to watch droplets chew the tips, vacuum comparison for the efficiency ledger. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖开的汽轮机轴系:高压/中压/低压缸一串,叶片列由小到大;蒸汽路径按温度/压力着色;喷嘴+动叶速度三角形动画;末级长叶片与水滴;冷凝器端。

topics.descZh: 声音在海水里跑得又远又怪:近海面因水温高声速约 1500 m/s,随深度降温一路跌,到约 1000 m 处跌到谷底 1480 m/s;再往下温度不再降、压力接棒,声速以每百米 +1.7 m/s 回升。这条 U 形曲线造就了天然波导:声线永远向低速区弯折——向上跑进快声区被折回来,向下跑进快声区也被折回来,只要声源放在谷底附近,声音就被困在约 1000 m 深的「深海声道」(SOFAR,Sound Fixing And Ranging)里来回震荡,几乎碰不到海面与海底,扩散只有柱面二维而已。低频衰减又极低(几十 Hz 每 2000 km 只损几个 dB),于是一头蓝鲸的低吟可以横跨 3000 公里被同类听见;冷战时期美军在声道轴布下水听器阵 SOSUS,苏联潜艇出港的声音在几千公里外就能被辨认;二战的搜救手段更直接——落水飞行员引爆一枚「SOFAR 炸弹」,声源沉到声道轴爆炸,千里外的岸站听声定位,这是黑匣子水下定位信标(37.5 kHz)工作的同一条物理;今天气候学家反向使用它:声速对温度极其敏感,精确测量声道里声脉冲的到达时间就能给大洋算体温(ATOC 实验)。拖「声源深度」看射线被放出或困住,拖「频率」看衰减;按「射线追踪」看声线在声道里荡秋千,按「会聚区」看声能每 50-60 km 冒头一次,按「鲸歌传讯」看一条鲸的声音走完全球。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Sound travels through seawater far and strangely: near the surface, warm water gives about 1500 m/s; as temperature drops with depth the speed falls to a floor near 1480 m/s at roughly 1000 m; below that temperature stops changing, pressure takes over, and speed climbs back at about +1.7 m/s per 100 m. This U-shaped profile makes a natural waveguide: sound rays always bend toward slower water - heading up into fast water folds them back down, heading down into fast water folds them back up - so a source near the axis stays trapped in the Deep Sound Channel (SOFAR, Sound Fixing And Ranging) around 1000 m, oscillating between surface and floor, spreading only cylindrically. Low frequencies barely attenuate - a few decibels per 2000 km - so a blue whale's moan crosses 3000 km to a distant herd; during the Cold War the Navy planted SOSUS hydrophone arrays on the axis and picked up Soviet submarines leaving port thousands of kilometres away; in WWII, downed pilots dropped a "SOFAR bomb" that sank to the axis and detonated, and shore stations triangulated the rescue - the same physics that puts 37.5 kHz pingers on black boxes. Climatologists now run it in reverse: sound speed is exquisitely sensitive to temperature, so timing pulses along the channel takes the ocean's temperature (the ATOC experiment). Drag source depth to release or trap the rays, drag frequency for attenuation; press ray tracing to watch the rays swing in the channel, convergence zone for sound surfacing every 50-60 km, whale call to follow one voice across an ocean. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 大洋剖面(海面/1000 m 谷底/海底);侧面声速-深度曲线联动;声源与射线束(困在声道内来回弯折);鲸与水听器;会聚区亮带。

topics.descZh: 棒球打者最怕的不是 160 km/h 的火球,而是 100-120 km/h 几乎不转的蝴蝶球:球缝线扰动着边界层,两侧分离点不对称,产生一个侧向力——但这力不是恒定的,随着球慢慢转过四分之一圈,受力方向缓缓换边,球走出一条谁也预判不了的蛇形轨迹,末段横向偏移可达三四十厘米,捕手都接不稳。排球的飘球是同款物理:不旋转发球,球体表面的边界层从层流转捩到湍流,分离点来回跳动,尾流左右摆动,球在空中「呼吸」般晃动,接发球方集体扑空;足球的「电梯球」也是它——C罗的任意球几乎不旋,球到门前突然下坠加侧飘,门将形容「像看到球被关了电源」。原理是雷诺数卡在敏感区:约 1-2×10⁵ 附近,光滑球面的边界层转捩正在发生,缝线或气流扰动随时改变哪一侧先分离;旋转球的马格努斯力是恒定的所以轨迹可预期,而不转球的非对称力随姿态漂移,唯有缝线角度随机才会产生这种混沌。实验风洞数据显示侧向加速度可达 3-5 g,等效于打者面对一颗「途中变道」的球。拖「球速」扫过敏感雷诺区,拖「自旋」看 0 与 1 转/秒的天壤之别;按「旋转对照」看马格努斯的可预期弧线,按「尾流开关」慢放分离点换边,按「排球飘球」换一场比赛。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
What batters fear is not the 160 km/h fastball but the 100-120 km/h barely-spinning knuckleball: the seams perturb the boundary layer, separation points go asymmetric, a side force appears - but not a constant one. As the ball rolls a quarter turn, the force slowly swaps sides and the flight turns serpentine, drifting 30-40 cm late in its path; even catchers drop it. Volleyball's float serve is the same physics: a no-spin serve hits the Reynolds range where the boundary layer flips from laminar to turbulent, separation hops back and forth, the wake swings, and the ball wobbles as if breathing - receivers everywhere commit the wrong way. Football's knuckle free kick is its cousin: Cristiano Ronaldo's near-spinless shots dive and drift at the goal like the power was cut. The principle is a sensitive Reynolds band around 1-2x10^5, where transition is mid-flight and a seam decides which side separates first; a spinning ball's Magnus force is steady and predictable, while a non-spinning ball's asymmetry wanders with attitude - pure chaos from seam orientation alone. Wind-tunnel data put the lateral acceleration at 3-5 g: a ball that changes lanes mid-flight. Drag ball speed across the sensitive band, drag spin to feel the gulf between 0 and 1 rev/s; press spin comparison for a predictable Magnus arc, wake flip to slow-motion the separation swap, volleyball float for another sport's version. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 球(带缝线纹理)飞向本垒板;尾流粒子与分离点标记;侧向力箭头随姿态缓慢换向;轨迹对比:旋转弧线 vs 蛇形漂移;Re 数标尺。

topics.descZh: 一座拦河坝对洄游鱼是一道绝壁:鲑鱼能爆发跳出 2 米,却跳不上 20 米的坝;鱼道的思路是把一道大墙拆成一百个小台阶——逐级水池用短坝或竖缝相连,每级落差只有 10-25 厘米,鱼一跃而过,歇一口气,再跃下一级。设计要迁就鱼的能力账本:鱼有「冲刺速度」(鲑鱼 6 m/s 以上,只能维持几秒)与「巡航速度」(1-2 m/s,可维持很久)之分;竖缝流速必须落在巡航速度的舒适区间,落差要小于鱼的跳跃与耗氧极限,池室还要给鱼留出低流速的休息角。竖缝式鱼道(北欧主流)整条缝全水深过流,适合游泳能力差别大的混养鱼群;池堰式(北美经典)靠溢流堰跌水,水声大、吸引流强;自然式鱼道(仿建石滩溪流)对景观友好。最容易被忽视的是入口:鱼在坝下游转圈找路,鱼道口若没有足够的「吸引流」(鱼道流量常只占河道 1-5%),鱼根本找不到门——许多失败的鱼道,败在门牌不够亮,而不是台阶。通过效率的验收很直接:装 PIT 标记与摄像头数鱼,优秀的鱼道全程通过率能到 80% 以上,差的不到 20%。拖「水位差」看需要的台阶数,拖「单池落差」看流速与鱼的极限;按「逐池上溯」看鱼群分批跳跃,按「竖缝特写」看速度场,按「吸引流」看入口如何引鱼,按「坡度过陡」看流速超限、鱼群被冲回。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A dam is a sheer wall to a migrating fish: a salmon can burst-jump two metres but not twenty, and the fish ladder's idea is to cut one wall into a hundred steps - pools linked by weirs or vertical slots, each drop only 10-25 centimetres, one jump, one rest, then the next. Design bows to the fish's ability ledger: burst speed (salmon over 6 m/s, sustainable for seconds) and sustained speed (1-2 m/s, sustainable indefinitely) are different budgets; slot velocity must stay comfortably under the sustained figure, drops under the jump and oxygen-debt limits, and each pool must hold a slow corner to rest in. Vertical-slot ladders (the Nordic standard) pass flow over full depth and suit mixed communities of swimmers; pool-and-weir (the North American classic) uses plunging water with a loud attraction flow; nature-like rock-ramp ladders trade efficiency for landscape. The most neglected part is the entrance: fish circle below the dam hunting a way in, and if the entrance lacks a strong attraction flow (ladder discharge is often only 1-5 percent of river flow) they never find the door - many failed ladders failed at the signpost, not the stairs. Acceptance is blunt: PIT tags and cameras count the fish, and good ladders pass over 80 percent end to end while poor ones manage under 20. Drag head difference to set the number of steps, drag drop per pool for velocity against fish limits; press ascent to watch shoals leap pool by pool, slot closeup for the velocity field, attraction flow for how the entrance advertises itself, too steep to see fish turned back by overrun velocity. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 大坝下游侧剖:阶梯池室与竖缝;鱼(发光体)逐级上跳、池角歇息;速度场矢量箭头在缝口聚焦;入口吸引流(亮色流线)沿坝脚铺开;失败模式:流速超标红闪、鱼被冲回下游。

topics.descZh: 暴雨把一条干沟变成一辆泥浆坦克,只需要四个条件凑齐:陡峭的沟床(坡度常在 10-30°)、大量松散固体物(崩塌、滑坡、老堆积体)、短时间内的高强度降雨、以及把它们搅在一起的水。泥石流的密度能到 1.8-2.3 t/m³——接近混凝土,它的力学完全是另一套账本:粗颗粒互相碰撞形成「分散应力」,把巨石「浮」在泥浆里(巨石在浪头上像软木塞一样随波逐流);细颗粒(黏土、粉砂)让浆体屈服强度暴涨,停下来的泥石流像面团一样整体搁在沟里,而不是摊成一片水。运动呈「阵性」:一场泥石流常由十几个到上百个阵波组成,龙头高 2-5 米、大石块在浪脊上翻滚,流速 5-15 m/s,冲击力是同速洪水的十几倍——1 米见方的石块以 8 m/s 撞上拦挡坝,冲击力上百吨。治理是三层防御:上游稳(固坡护沟,少给固体物)、中游拦(格宾坝、梳齿坝拦大放小,把能量分级耗掉)、下游排(排导槽把残余流顺利送进主河,不淤不堵);监测预警则以雨量阈值与次声(龙头摩擦沟床发出的低频声)做最后一道保险。拖「降雨强度」看起动门槛,拖「沟床坡度」看龙头发育;按「起动过程」看雨水如何撬动坡体,按「阵性龙头」看大石块浮在浪头,按「拦挡坝」看拦大放小,按「与洪水对比」看密度带来的冲击力差。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Rain turns a dry gully into a mud tank when four ingredients line up: a steep channel bed (10-30 degrees), plenty of loose solid material (old slides, colluvium), high-intensity rain in a short window, and the water to mix them. Debris flow density reaches 1.8-2.3 tonnes per cubic metre - close to concrete - and its mechanics run on a different ledger: coarse grains colliding generate dispersive stress that floats boulders in the slurry (rocks ride the crest like corks), while clay and silt balloon the slurry's yield strength, so a stopped flow sits in the gully like dough instead of spreading thin like water. Motion comes in surges: one event may carry dozens to hundreds of waves, the head 2-5 metres tall with boulders tumbling along the crest, at 5-15 m/s and an impact force ten-odd times a flood of the same speed - a one-metre block striking a check dam at 8 m/s delivers a hundred tonnes. Defense is three layers: stabilize upstream (pin the slopes, starve the solids), trap midstream (gabion and slot dams catch the coarse, pass the fine, bleeding off energy in stages), drain downstream (a discharge channel hands the residue to the main river without silting); monitoring adds a last alarm with rainfall thresholds and infrasound - the rumble the flow's head makes grinding down the gully. Drag rainfall intensity for the initiation threshold, drag channel slope for head growth; press initiation for rain prying the slope loose, surging head for boulders afloat on the crest, check dam for catch-the-big-pass-the-small, versus flood for what density does to impact. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 山谷沟道剖面:雨云降雨→坡面崩塌补料→沟内泥浪阵波下泻(龙头大石块、红棕色);拦挡坝剖面:大石被拦、泥浆过孔;冲击力计数值;右侧对照:同速清水洪水轻松过坝。

topics.descZh: 侧风着陆是每个飞行员的必修考试:跑道横着吹来 10-15 节的风,飞机既要往前飞,又不能被吹离跑道中线。主流方法是「蟹形进场」:把机头偏向上风方向,让飞机斜着身子飞——机头偏角恰好抵住侧风漂移,航迹却笔直对准跑道;接地前的最后一刻蹬舵把机头摆正,同时压盘(副翼)向上风侧,机翼一低一平完成「de-crab」,主轮先着地。蟹形角有个好记的近似:侧风分量每 5 节约 3 度。第二种方法是「侧滑法」:全程压坡度向上风、蹬舵保持机头对准跑道,机翼略低直接滑下去——姿态稳定但乘客会感到持续倾斜,且大坡度会蹭到发动机吊舱,民航多用蟹形进场。极限是一笔明白账:每型飞机都有「演示侧风限制」(如 35-40 节),它是试飞演示过的最大值而非硬性结构极限;真正的物理约束是接地瞬间的「侧向载荷」——起落架轮胎要在一瞬间吸收全部侧向动能,以及副翼在大侧风下抵消滚转的剩余权限。风切变与阵风会让修正量不断变化,所以好飞行员在最后 30 米里持续微调,而不是一次修正到位。拖「侧风风速」看蟹形角与漂移,拖「侧风角」看分量分解;按「蟹形进场」看斜身飞行,按「侧滑修正」看双操纵配合,按「接地瞬间」看侧载与主轮单边着地,按「侧风极限」看修正能力耗尽。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Crosswind landing is every pilot's final exam: ten to fifteen knots blowing across the runway, and the aircraft must fly forward without drifting off the centerline. The mainstream method is the crab: point the nose upwind so the plane flies slightly sideways - the nose offset exactly cancels the drift and the track stays straight down the runway; at the last instant before touchdown, rudder straightens the nose while aileron drops the upwind wing - the de-crab - and the main gear kisses down first. A handy approximation: about three degrees of crab per five knots of crosswind component. The alternative is the sideslip: wing held low into the wind with opposite rudder the whole way down - stable, but passengers feel a continuous bank and large angles risk scraping an engine pod, so airlines favor the crab. Limits are an honest ledger: every type has a demonstrated crosswind limit (say 35-40 knots), a maximum shown in certification rather than a structural wall; the real physics is the side load at touchdown - the tires must absorb the entire lateral kinetic energy in an instant - plus how much roll authority the ailerons have left against the wind. Gusts and shear keep changing the correction, so a good pilot trims continuously through the last hundred feet instead of fixing it once. Drag wind speed for crab angle and drift, drag wind angle for the component split; press crab approach to see the sideways flight, sideslip for the paired controls, touchdown instant for side load on one main gear, crosswind limit for correction running out. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 跑道俯视+侧视双视角;风矢量箭头横向吹;飞机斜身进场(机头偏角标注)、接地瞬间蹬舵摆正、上风主轮先着地;漂移轨迹与跑道中线对比;侧载荷表盘与侧风分量标尺。

topics.descZh: 直升机悬停时,旋翼往下打出一根稳定的下洗流柱,升力账本干净利落;可一旦飞行员带功率做大下降率、又几乎没有前飞速度,旋翼就会一头扎进自己刚排出的下洗里:桨尖涡来不及被带走,在桨盘外缘卷成一个环状回流——外缘的空气被重新吸上桨盘、再从中心喷下去,升力分布乱成一团,总距拉满也只换来下降率自我加剧,飞机「掉进自己制造的漩涡」,越补总距掉得越快;触发窗口有公式可查:垂直下降速度超过诱导速度的一半(Vv > ~0.5·Vi)、而前飞速度比 μ < 0.25 时最危险——功率下降区就是它的家门口;改出的正解反直觉:不是拉总距,而是前推驾驶杆获得 15–20 节以上的平飞速度,让新鲜的来流把涡环整个吹散(或干脆降总距进自转);桨尖涡环可视化、风洞与试飞数据共同画出了这张「涡环危险包线」,它被写进每一本直升机教材与每一次山地/吊挂作业的简报里。拖「下降率」看旋翼扎进自己的下洗,拖「前飞速度」看来流如何吹散涡环;按「悬停基准」看干净下洗柱,按「进入涡环」看桨尖涡卷成回流,按「危险包线」看工作点漂进红区,按「改出动作」看前推杆脱困。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
When hovering, a helicopter's rotor pumps out a stable column of downwash and the lift ledger is clean; but once the pilot commits to a high rate of descent with power on and almost no forward speed, the rotor flies straight into the downwash it just made: tip vortices have no time to be carried away and curl into a ring of recirculation at the disc edge - air at the rim is sucked back up through the disc and sprayed down the middle, the lift distribution falls apart, and pulling full collective only buys a self-reinforcing descent rate - the aircraft has fallen into the vortex of its own making, and the more collective you pull, the faster it falls; the trigger window has a formula: it is most dangerous when vertical descent speed exceeds about half the induced velocity (Vv > ~0.5·Vi) while the forward-speed ratio μ < 0.25 - the power-required trough is right at its doorstep; the correct recovery is counter-intuitive: not pulling collective but pushing the cyclic forward to gain level speed above 15-20 knots, letting fresh airflow blow the ring apart (or dropping collective into autorotation); tip-vortex visualization, wind tunnels and flight tests together drew this VRS avoidance envelope, and it is written into every helicopter textbook and every mountain and sling-load briefing. Drag sink rate to watch the rotor fly into its own downwash, drag forward speed to watch fresh airflow shred the ring; press hover baseline for the clean downwash column, press enter vortex ring to watch the tip vortices curl back, press danger envelope to see the working point drift into the red zone, press recovery maneuver to watch the push-forward escape. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 简单机体+旋翼盘的直升机悬在半空,蓝色粒子柱为稳定下洗;红色环形粒子在桨盘外缘卷成涡环,淡蓝回流粒子沿外缘上升补入桨盘;黄色前飞来流从机头方向扫过;涡环越强,机体摇晃下沉越厉害;示波器画出下降率-前飞速度平面的危险包线与工作点漂移轨迹。

topics.descZh: 把一口钟倒扣着压进水里,空气被水压压得只剩一半体积,却仍在钟顶撑出一间「气房」——亚里士多德记下了这个观察,1535 年德·洛雷纳已经靠它在打捞作业里下潜。它的一切账目都是波义耳定律:深度每加 10 米多压一个大气压,气穴体积就按 V₂=V₁P₁/P₂ 缩水,下到 30 米只剩四分之一——人挤进一间越潜越小的房子。两大生死问题随之而来:钟里空气有限,氧在耗尽、CO₂ 在积聚(浓度过 3% 就头痛恶心),所以 1789 年斯米顿用空气泵从水面持续补气,钟才真正变成「可住在里面」的工具;更隐蔽的是人只要游出钟口作业,身体就暴露在环境水压下,上浮若不减压,溶解在血里的氮会沸腾成气泡——减压病,打捞工叫它「弯屈症」。现代湿钟、干钟加饱和潜水的整套系统,本质仍是这口钟:用「人适应压力」换「水压进不来」,只是把补气、减压与住宿全做成了工程。拖「深度」看气穴缩水,拖「补气速率」看气泡涌入;按「下沉压缩」看水位爬升,按「持续补气」看钟内换气,按「出钟作业」看潜水员出钟,按「上浮减压」看体内气泡警示。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Lower an upside-down bell into the water and the trapped air is squeezed to half its volume, yet still holds a habitable pocket under the crown - Aristotle noted the sight, and by 1535 Guglielmo de Lorena was already salvaging with one. Every line of its accounting is Boyle's law: every 10 m of depth adds another atmosphere, so the cavity shrinks as V2 = V1·P1/P2 - at 30 m only a quarter remains, a house that gets smaller the deeper you go. Two life-or-death budgets follow: the sealed air is a finite stock, oxygen depleting while CO2 accumulates (past 3% come headaches and nausea), which is why John Smeaton's 1789 air pump, feeding fresh air down from the surface, finally made the bell a tool people could live in; and subtler, the moment a diver swims out of the mouth his body takes the full ambient pressure - surface without decompression and the nitrogen dissolved in the blood boils into bubbles: decompression sickness, the bends. Modern wet bells, dry bells and saturation diving are all still this bell at heart: trade 'adapt the human to the pressure' for 'keep the water out', with gas supply, decompression and habitation engineered end to end. Drag depth to watch the cavity shrink, drag air-supply rate to feed the stream of bubbles; press sink and compress to see the water level climb, continuous supply to see the pocket ventilated, bell exit to send the diver out, rapid ascent for the bubble warning. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视潜水钟由吊链沉入水中:深度增大时钟内水位爬升、黄色气穴被压缩,补气管从水面持续送气、白色气泡涌入钟顶;钟内小人呼吸使 O₂/CO₂ 指标漂移;出钟模式潜水员游出钟口并标注体外水压;快速上浮时体内红色氮气泡点亮警示;侧边深度标尺与气穴/压强曲线联动。

topics.descZh: 一架 160 吨的客机以 280 km/h 触地,动能大到刹车盘会烧红,于是发动机在着陆后帮一把:反推装置把本来向后喷的风扇气流——大涵道比发动机约八成推力来自风扇——通过一圈可滑移的栅格门折向前方约 45°,产生 30–50% 的反向推力分量。主流设计是栅格式:涵道外壳向后滑移,露出导流格栅,气流从格栅折向前,湍流白雾扑过机翼;为什么只折「冷」的风扇流而不动滚烫的核心流:让 1000 °C 的燃气掉头,结构吃不消。反推还有三重账:缩短湿滑跑道的滑跑距离、给碳刹车降温省寿命(刹车是按热库设计的)、在积水/雪面上提供轮刹之外的稳定制动力;它的红线是「空中绝对不能开」——1991 年劳达航空 003 号班机在爬升中反推意外展开,飞机失速坠毁,此后所有反推都加了空地逻辑与多重机械锁;运行规矩也细:干跑道一般 idle 反推即可,噪声与磨损都最小,max reverse 只留给湿滑与紧急。拖「反推力度」看反向推力涨落,拖「跑道状态」看滑跑距离变化;按「展开动画」看栅格门滑出,按「气流折转」看粒子折向前方,按「着陆减速对比」看刹车温度计,按「空中锁定」看红线警示。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A 160-tonne airliner touches down at 280 km/h with enough kinetic energy to glow its brake stacks, so after landing the engines lend a hand: the thrust reverser folds the fan stream - on a high-bypass engine roughly eighty percent of thrust - forward through a ring of sliding cascade doors at about 45 degrees, worth 30-50% of reverse thrust. The mainstream design is the cascade type: the bypass outer sleeve slides aft, exposes the grilles, the flow turns forward through them and white turbulence washes over the wing. Why fold only the 'cold' fan flow and never the scorching core flow: making 1000 °C gas turn around is structurally hopeless. The reverser also keeps three books: it shortens the rollout on wet runways, keeps carbon brakes cooler so they live longer (brakes are designed as heat sinks), and stays a stable braking force on slush and snow where wheels would skid. Its red line is 'never in the air' - in 1991 Lauda Air Flight 003 lost control when a reverser deployed in the climb and the jet stalled; since then every reverser carries air/ground logic plus multiple mechanical locks. Ops are nuanced too: on dry runways idle reverse usually suffices - least noise and wear - while max reverse is saved for contaminated or critical landings. Drag reverse thrust to watch the retarding force rise, drag runway state to see the rollout change; press deploy cycle to watch the doors slide, flow reversal to see the flow turn forward, landing rollout for the brake thermometer, in-air lockout for the red line. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 发动机短舱大剖视:风扇盘旋转,青色风扇流粒子沿涵道后喷、橙色核心流直排;外罩后滑露出 45° 导流格栅,风扇流粒子被折向前方并变色;红绿推力矢量箭头随开度翻转;跑道上的飞机按干/湿/雪状态减速,刹车盘随温度发红;空中锁定模式红色警示灯闪烁。

topics.descZh:
化油器是一台用空气自己给自己称油的机器:活塞下行吸气,空气涌入喉管;喉管把通道直径缩到约一半,按连续性原理流速立刻升到约 4 倍,而伯努利方程 Δp=½ρ(v₂²−v₁²) 甩出的账单是——流速暴涨处静压大跌,巡航时喉口真空可达 5–20 kPa。浮子室经通气孔保持大气压,汽油就被这股压差沿主量孔压上喉口,被上百公里时速的气流撕碎成雾,混成可燃混合气进缸。天才之处在账目自洽:量孔油量 ∝ √Δp ∝ 流速,空气量也 ∝ 流速,分子分母同涨同跌,混合比自动锁在汽油理论空燃比 14.7:1 附近,全程无需油泵与传感器。但它有个软肋:低速气流慢,喉管压差小到吸不上油,于是怠速量孔、过渡孔、加浓阀(功率量孔)、加速泵组成一套「小孔网络」接力;浮子+针阀用马桶水箱原理把油面钉在喷口下方一两毫米,保证吸油压差只看喉管真空、不看剩油多少。冷启动靠「以浓补挥」:低温汽油饱和蒸气压低、不肯挥发,关小阻风门让真空暴涨、吸出过量的油,空燃比掉到 3–5:1,富油易点,排气管先喷几秒黑烟,暖机后阻风打开,回到约 14.7:1。高原上空气密度从 1.225 kg/m³ 跌到约 0.82(4000 m),油却照旧,混合气过稀到 18+:1,动力下降甚至回火,得换小号主量孔。最终判它出局的是环保:三元催化器要求 λ 锁死在 1±0.5% 的窄窗,开环做不到——1980 年代起氧传感器闭环+电磁喷油器的电喷接管汽车;但凭零电子件、一桶油就能修好,化油器至今仍在割草机、摩托车和小航模发动机上服役。拖「节气门开度」看油随气走,拖「海拔高度」看混合气变稀;按「主油路」看压差吸油链,按「冷启动」看阻风加浓与黑烟,按「怠速过渡」看小孔接力,按「高原稀薄」看空燃比飘红、进气回火。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 剖视化油器装在试验台上:青色空气粒子从进气口涌入,过阻风门、被文丘里喉管加速收束;橙色油粒子从浮子室沿油道爬上喉口、撕成雾滴混入气流;混合气经歧管进入剖视气缸,活塞往复、缸内按混合比点火闪橙光,尾管冒烟。冷启动模式阻风只留缝、浓雾进缸、排管喷黑烟,暖机后缓缓打开;怠速模式节气门近关、怠速与过渡量孔接力;高原模式山峦升起、空气变稀、空燃比飘红、火焰变弱、进气回火;示波器画出真空度与空燃比曲线。
topics.descEn:
A carburetor is a machine that weighs its own fuel with air. As the piston descends it sucks air into the venturi: the bore narrows to about half its diameter, so by continuity the flow speeds up roughly 4x, and the Bernoulli bill Δp = ½ρ(v2² − v1²) lands where velocity peaks - static pressure crashes, leaving throat vacuum of about 5-20 kPa at cruise. The float chamber stays at atmospheric pressure through a small vent hole, so this pressure difference pushes gasoline up the main jet, where airflow at highway speed shreds it into a mist that mixes into a combustible charge for the cylinder. The genius is that the ledger balances itself: fuel through an orifice scales with the square root of the pressure drop, that is, with air speed, and the air itself scales with air speed - numerator and denominator rise and fall together, so the mixture ratio holds itself near the stoichiometric 14.7:1 for gasoline, with no pump and no sensor. The weak spot is low speed: flow too slow, venturi signal too weak to lift fuel, so idle jet, transition ports, power valve and accelerator pump form a relay of small orifices; a float and needle valve, working like a toilet tank, pin the level a millimeter or two below the nozzle so suction depends only on throat vacuum, never on remaining fuel. Cold starts compensate poor vaporization with richness: partly close the choke, intake drops, vacuum soars, far too much fuel is drawn out - air-fuel ratio falls to 3-5:1, rich enough to ignite easily, a few seconds of black smoke, then the choke opens as the engine warms and it returns to about 14.7:1. Up high, air density falls from 1.225 to about 0.82 kg/m³ at 4000 m while fuel barely changes, the mixture goes lean past 18:1, power drops, the intake can backfire, and the main jet must be resized. Emissions delivered the final verdict: a three-way catalyst needs lambda locked at 1 plus or minus 0.5 percent, impossible open-loop - from the 1980s closed-loop EFI with an oxygen sensor and injectors took over the car; yet with zero electronics and a one-bucket repair, carburetors still serve on lawnmowers, motorcycles and model engines. Drag the throttle to watch fuel follow air, drag altitude to watch the mixture go lean; press main circuit for the suction chain, cold start for choke enrichment and soot, idle transition for the relay of small jets, high altitude for the AFR drifting into the red and an occasional backfire. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视化油器装在试验台上:青色空气粒子从进气口涌入,过阻风门、被文丘里喉管加速收束;橙色油粒子从浮子室沿油道爬上喉口、撕成雾滴混入气流;混合气经歧管进入剖视气缸,活塞往复、缸内按混合比点火闪橙光,尾管冒烟。冷启动模式阻风只留缝、浓雾进缸、排管喷黑烟,暖机后缓缓打开;怠速模式节气门近关、怠速与过渡量孔接力;高原模式山峦升起、空气变稀、空燃比飘红、火焰变弱、进气回火;示波器画出真空度与空燃比曲线。

topics.descZh:
满挂弹药的战斗机,起飞重量被跑道长度卡死:多带一枚弹就得多烧一份油,作战半径在火力最足时反而最短;外挂副油箱又添阻力、占挂点——这个死结在机场解不开,只能到空中解。空中加油把「航程」变成「接力」:轰炸机跨洲奔袭无需中途降落,战斗机靠加油机接力能留空八小时以上,救援直升机也能跨海远征;而起降一次费时费钱还暴露行踪,加油机在安全空域一次就能给数架受油机「续杯」。1923 年 6 月 25 日,两架 DH-4B 双翼机靠手工传递软管完成首次空中加油;20 世纪 40 年代英国发展出绕管软管、美国推出伸缩硬管,如今 KC-135、KC-46 与 A330 MRTT 值班万米高空,一架 KC-135 约可携带 8.3 万公斤燃油。两大体系各司其职:软管-锥套从机尾或翼下吊舱放出 14–18 米柔性软管,气流把小降落伞状的锥套撑开扶稳,受油机飞行员操纵受油杆主动插接,输油率约 200–400 加仑/分钟,还能多吊舱同时喂多架;硬管由操作员操纵伸缩套管对接背部接受舱,输油率高达 600–1200 加仑/分钟。对接是精细活:受油机要以不足 1 米/秒的相对速度追上尾流里漂移的锥套,接触冲击由软管弯曲或套管伸缩吸收,受力超限立即自动断开(breakaway);输油时加油机变轻、受油机变重,配平实时变化。风险同样真实:翼尖尾涡会把误入的受油机向下压,急加减速会让软管鞭甩打伤机体,燃油还会移动重心——所以每个动作都必须待在「包线」里。拖「相对距离」与「接近速度」练对接,按预设切换软管、硬管、包线与故障演示。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 万米高空,加油机匀速平飞、云海后移;软管模式:14–18 米软管后摆下垂,锥套微幅漂移,受油机前伸受油杆插接,绿色光环亮起,黄色燃油粒子沿管流动,两机燃油条此消彼长;硬管模式:伸缩套管带小舵面微调,对接背部接受舱,输油率数字翻倍;包线模式:方位/仰角/伸缩三维窗口,越界泛红告警;故障模式:尾涡下压与软管鞭甩后的应急断开。
topics.descEn:
Fully armed fighters are pinned by runway length: more weapons means less fuel, so combat radius shrinks exactly when firepower grows, and external tanks add drag while occupying hardpoints - a knot no airfield can untie, only mid-air. Aerial refueling turns range into relay: bombers strike across continents without landing, fighters stay airborne eight hours or more through tanker relays, rescue helicopters cross the sea; every extra takeoff and landing costs time, money and surprise, while one tanker over safe airspace tops up several receivers in a single sortie. On 25 June 1923 two DH-4B biplanes passed a hose by hand to complete the first aerial refueling; in the 1940s Britain developed the looped hose and the USA the flying boom, and today KC-135, KC-46 and A330 MRTT stand watch, a KC-135 carrying about 83,000 kg of fuel for several receivers per sortie. Two systems divide the work: probe-and-drogue reels out a 14-18 m flexible hose from the tail or wing pods, airflow holds the small parachute-shaped drogue steady, the receiver pilot flies the probe into it at about 200-400 gallons per minute, and multiple pods can feed multiple jets at once; the flying boom is telescoped by an operator into a receptacle on the receiver spine at 600-1200 gallons per minute. Docking is delicate: the receiver chases a drogue drifting in the wake with only a fraction of a metre per second of closure, contact shock is absorbed by hose bend or boom telescope, and excess force trips an automatic breakaway; during offload the tanker lightens as the receiver heavies and trim changes in real time. The risks are real: wingtip vortices push a receiver that strays into them downward, abrupt speed changes whip the hose into the airplane ahead, and fuel shifts the centre of gravity - so every move stays inside the envelope.
