Drag relative gap and approach speed to practise docking; press the presets for drogue, boom, envelope and fault demos. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 万米高空,加油机匀速平飞、云海后移;软管模式:14–18 米软管后摆下垂,锥套微幅漂移,受油机前伸受油杆插接,绿色光环亮起,黄色燃油粒子沿管流动,两机燃油条此消彼长;硬管模式:伸缩套管带小舵面微调,对接背部接受舱,输油率数字翻倍;包线模式:方位/仰角/伸缩三维窗口,越界泛红告警;故障模式:尾涡下压与软管鞭甩后的应急断开。

topics.descZh:
飞机还没造出来,工程师就先在计算机里把风「吹」了一遍——这就是 CFD 数值风洞。流体力学有三根支柱:理论是一组 Navier–Stokes 方程(动量方程:惯性 + 压力 + 黏性;连续性方程:散度为零),实验是风洞,数值模拟是第三条路:把连续流体切成上百万个小控制体(finite volume),对每个格子守恒记账——进出通量 + 源项 = 变化率,再用时间步一步步推进。压力和速度没有各自的现成方程,靠 SIMPLE/PISO 迭代拧到自洽;显式时间步还受 CFL 条件 Δt ≤ Δx/(u+c) 约束——格距越小、流速越快,步子必须越小,否则解直接发散。网格是 CFD 的地基:近壁边界层按 y+ 加密(气动计算通常要求 y+≈1),钝体后缘加密捕捉分离,网格的正交性与长细比决定解的可信度。最贵的是湍流:DNS 直接算所有涡,网格量按 Re^(9/4) 增长,雷诺数百万级的绕流要 10¹⁵ 量级格子——不可能;工程折中是 RANS(k-ε/k-ω 模型把脉动打包成涡黏性,一次稳态解、几百万网格)与 LES(直接算大涡、只建模小涡,成本高 10–100 倍)。粗网格还会「骗人」:它把涡街抹得对称、把阻力算低近两成——所以要用粗-中-细三套网格做收敛外推,再与风洞、飞行试验对表,升阻差常见 2–5% 才算过关。同一套数学,今天也在算飞机全机气动、汽车风阻与噪声、洁净室气流、血管血流和天气预报;一台翼型优化要跑上千个工况,云上算力替吹风分担了一半。最后别忘了「看图」:流线、涡量、Q 准则涡核、压力云图是 CFD 的一半——数据不画出来,等于没算。拖「来流速度」跨雷诺数 10³–10⁶,拖「网格密度」从 1 万格加到 300 万格;按「网格剖分」看网格生成与 y+ 加密带,按「粒子输运」看示踪粒子绕过钝体、尾流拉出卡门涡街,按「涡量涡街」看旋涡交替脱落的周期与斯特劳哈尔数,按「加密对比」看粗网格伪解与细网格真解并排对质。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 线框计算域标注入口、出口与无滑移壁面,中央钝体圆柱,结构网格随「网格密度」滑杆从 1 万格加密到约 300 万格,y+ 近壁带与尾流加密区橙色高亮;示踪粒子按速度蓝→红着色绕流,尾流交替脱落卡门涡街;涡量模式显示红蓝涡量云带并实时标注脱涡周期与 St≈0.20;加密对比模式并排细网格非对称涡街与粗网格对称伪解,CFL 超限时红色发散报警亮起。
topics.descEn:
Engineers fly an aircraft in a computer before the aircraft exists - that is the CFD numerical wind tunnel. Fluid dynamics stands on three pillars: theory in the Navier-Stokes equations (momentum: inertia + pressure + viscosity; continuity: zero divergence), experiment in the wind tunnel, and simulation as the third road: chop the continuous fluid into millions of small control volumes and keep a conservation ledger for every cell - fluxes in and out plus sources equal the rate of change - then march forward in time steps. Pressure and velocity have no standalone equations, so SIMPLE/PISO iterations lock them together; an explicit time step obeys the CFL condition Δt ≤ Δx/(u+c) - the finer the spacing and the faster the flow, the smaller the step must be, or the solution blows up. The mesh is the foundation: near-wall boundary layers are clustered by y+ (aerodynamic jobs usually demand y+ of about 1), wakes behind blunt bodies are refined to capture separation, and mesh orthogonality and aspect ratio decide how trustworthy the answer is. Turbulence is the expensive part: DNS resolves every eddy at a cell count growing like Re^(9/4) - a million-Reynolds flow would need on the order of 10^15 cells, which is impossible; the engineering compromises are RANS (k-epsilon / k-omega models pack the fluctuations into an eddy viscosity: one steady solve on a few million cells) and LES (resolve the large eddies, model the small ones, 10-100 times the cost). Coarse meshes also lie: they smear the vortex street symmetric and under-predict drag by nearly a fifth - so run coarse, medium and fine meshes, extrapolate, then check against wind-tunnel and flight data; lift and drag within 2-5% is the passing grade. The same mathematics today computes full-aircraft aerodynamics, car drag and wind noise, cleanroom airflow, blood flow and weather forecasts; one airfoil optimization sweeps thousands of cases, with cloud compute sharing the blowing. And do not skip the pictures: streamlines, vorticity, Q-criterion vortex cores and pressure maps are half of CFD - data you never plot is data you never really computed. Drag inlet speed to sweep Reynolds numbers from 10^3 to 10^6, drag mesh density from 10 thousand to 3 million cells; press meshing to watch the grid grow with its y+ band, particle flow for tracers rounding the cylinder and a Karman street in the wake, vorticity street for the shedding period and Strouhal number, grid convergence for the coarse pseudo-solution facing the fine-mesh truth. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 线框计算域标注入口、出口与无滑移壁面,中央钝体圆柱,结构网格随「网格密度」滑杆从 1 万格加密到约 300 万格,y+ 近壁带与尾流加密区橙色高亮;示踪粒子按速度蓝→红着色绕流,尾流交替脱落卡门涡街;涡量模式显示红蓝涡量云带并实时标注脱涡周期与 St≈0.20;加密对比模式并排细网格非对称涡街与粗网格对称伪解,CFL 超限时红色发散报警亮起。

topics.descZh: 每颗钉一次 50/50,单颗球无法预测;几百颗落完,正态钟形自己浮现
topics.descEn: Every peg is a coin flip no one can predict; after a few hundred balls the bell emerges

topics.descZh: 相邻像素高度相关,直接存极浪费——8×8 分块做 DCT,把像素翻译成 64 个频率成分,自然图像的能量扎堆在低频;量化把高频除以大数、大量归零,这一步有损且不可逆;zigzag 把零连成串、游程+哈夫曼收尾;质量滑块拖到 8,方块与振铃当场现形。
topics.descEn: Neighbouring pixels are highly correlated, so storing them raw is wasteful — split into 8×8 blocks, DCT them into 64 frequency coefficients, and natural images pile their energy into the low frequencies; quantization divides the highs by big numbers, zeroing most — the lossy, irreversible step; zigzag lines up the zeros for run-length and Huffman coding; drag quality to 8 and blocking plus ringing appear on the spot.

topics.descZh: 全连接把 28×28 摊平接 100 个神经元=78,400 个参数且位置一换就失灵;卷积用一个 3×3 核(9 个参数)扫全图——权重共享+局部感受野;特征图经 ReLU 截负,2×2 max 池化换平移容差;层级堆叠:边缘→纹理→部件→物体——训练不过是用反向传播把那些核学出来。
topics.descEn: Flattening 28×28 into 100 neurons costs 78,400 parameters and breaks at the slightest shift; a convolution sweeps one 3×3 kernel (9 weights) across the whole image — shared weights, local receptive fields; feature maps pass through ReLU, 2×2 max pooling buys translation tolerance; stacked layers go edges → textures → parts → objects — training is just backprop tuning those kernels.

topics.descZh: 本轮圆叠出方波/锯齿/三角——谐波越多越像;方波角上的吉布斯振铃永不消失
topics.descEn: Epicycles stack into square / sawtooth / triangle — more harmonics, closer fit; Gibbs ringing never dies

topics.descZh: 换还是不换?主持人「知道答案」把胜率改写成 2/3 vs 1/3——大数定律现场作证
topics.descEn: Switch or stay? The host KNOWS — rewiring the odds to 2/3 vs 1/3, proven by the law of large numbers

topics.titleZh: 神经网络 · 梯度下降
topics.descZh: 3D 损失曲面上下山:学习率太小磨蹭、太大发散,动量滚过小坑谷——点击曲面放小球
topics.descEn: Rolling downhill on a 3D loss surface: tiny η crawls, huge η explodes, momentum clears the bumps — click to drop the ball

topics.descZh: 明天的天气只看今天:一张转移矩阵 P,几百个小行者按概率跳边,几步之后分布稳定在 π=πP 的平稳解——从晴天出发和从雨天出发,殊途同归;无记忆是全部假设,平稳分布就是 P 的特征向量,箭头越粗概率越大。
topics.descEn: Tomorrow's weather asks only about today: one transition matrix P, hundreds of walkers hopping by probability, and within a few steps the distribution settles onto the stationary π=πP — from sunny or from rainy, everyone converges; memorylessness is the whole assumption, and π is just P's eigenvector; thicker arrows, higher odds.

topics.descZh: Dijkstra 老实,从起点均匀漫灌 790 格才碰到终点;贪婪只朝目标冲,38 格就到——却被沼泽骗到代价翻倍;A* 用 f=g+h 把洪水拧成定向波,304 格拿到与 Dijkstra 相同的最优路:只要启发不高估(可采纳),快而不骗。
topics.descEn: Dijkstra floods uniformly from the start — 790 cells to reach the goal; greedy beelines in 38 — and pays double crossing the swamp; A* focuses the flood with f=g+h, finding the same optimal path in 304 cells: as long as the heuristic never overestimates, fast and never cheated.

topics.descZh: 没有领队、没有队形图,上千只椋鸟的絮群只靠三条局部规则:分离别撞、对齐随大流、凝聚别掉队——每只鸟只看身边几只邻居,群体秩序整体涌现;权重一调,鸟群变鱼群再变蝗虫带;猛禽扎进来,闪避波一圈圈荡开。
topics.descEn: No leader, no formation chart: a starling murmuration runs on three local rules — separate, align, cohere — each bird watching only a few neighbors, order emerging whole; tune the weights and the flock turns school, then locust band; strike a raptor in and shockwaves ripple outward.

topics.descZh: 冒泡/选择/插入/快排/归并同一乱序同屏开跑:白闪=比较、红闪=写入,计数器见分晓
topics.descEn: Five algorithms, one shuffle, one track each: white = compare, red = write — the counters settle it

topics.descZh: 小数字全流程真算:模钟绕圈跳步,试拆计数器一秒命中——真实 2048 位要试 10³⁰⁸ 次
topics.descEn: Real math on tiny numbers: the mod clock jumps, trial division hits instantly — real 2048-bit takes ~10³⁰⁸ tries

topics.descZh: 单步随机,万人成规律:密度摊成高斯,σ∝√t——香味飘满房间的数学
topics.descEn: One step random, a crowd lawful: density melts into a Gaussian, σ ∝ √t

topics.descZh: Dijkstra 等时波纹逐圈点亮城市路网,一键切 A* 直奔目标少探一大半,实时路况当场改道
topics.descEn: Dijkstra's isochrone ripple floods a city grid; one click adds the A* heuristic — same route, far fewer nodes explored

topics.descZh: 四百粒子扮演冲浪者沿链接随机点击,驻留份额收敛出网页重要性;死胡同让概率漏水
topics.descEn: Hundreds of surfer particles click random links; their dwell share converges to PageRank — unless a dead end drinks the probability

topics.descZh: 消息切成带序号的包,各自选路、乱序到达按序重组;丢包超时重传,对照电路交换专线独占
topics.descEn: Numbered packets pick their own paths, arrive out of order, reassemble by seq #; lost ones time out and resend

topics.descZh: 二维码破损也能扫:校验码字兜住 ≤t=(n−k)/2 处损伤,超限瞬间解码失败
topics.descEn: Why broken QR codes still scan: check codewords rescue ≤ t=(n−k)/2 damage; past the limit, decoding fails

topics.descZh: 频次决定合并顺序,合并顺序决定码长——同一句话 232 bit 压到 109 bit,省 53%
topics.descEn: Frequency sets merge order; merge order sets code length — 232 bits squeezed to 109, 53% saved

topics.descZh: 患病率 0.1% 时筛查阳性者真患病不到 2%——1000 格方块看基率如何碾压灵敏度
topics.descEn: At 0.1% prevalence, under 2% of positive screenings are real — watch the base rate beat a 99% test

topics.descZh: 简单规则×无限递归:科赫雪花周长发散面积有限,曼德博无限放大
topics.descEn: Simple rules × endless recursion: Koch perimeter diverges while area converges; zoom Mandelbrot forever

topics.descZh: 在 x₀ 处逐阶仿造函数:切线长成整条曲线,误差带随 N 收缩;ln(1+x) 一出收敛圈就飞走
topics.descEn: Rebuild a function order by order from one point: tangents grow into the curve, ln(1+x) flies off past its radius

topics.descZh: 每个新人要躲开所有已占生日:配对数按 n(n−1)/2 爆炸,23 人碰撞过半——蒙特卡洛当场作证
topics.descEn: Each newcomer must dodge every occupied birthday: pairs explode as n(n−1)/2, collisions pass 50% at 23 — Monte Carlo testifies live

topics.descZh: 首位数字住在对数圆周上:1 占 30.1%、9 只剩 4.6%;×3.7 换单位分布不动,假账本被 χ² 当场拒绝
topics.descEn: Leading digits live on a log circle: 1 owns 30.1%, 9 just 4.6%; ×3.7 changes nothing, fake books get rejected by χ²

topics.descZh: 纸带+读写头+规则表,每步只会读写移换状态;换一张表,同一台机器从加法器变成复制机
topics.descEn: Tape + head + rule table; each step only reads, writes, moves, restates — swap the table and the same machine becomes a copier

topics.descZh: 信息=意外 −log₂p,熵 H=Σ−p log₂p 是任何无损编码的平均码长下限——拖概率滑杆看哈夫曼树现场重建,平均码长贴着金色熵曲面下滑,却永远压不过它
topics.descEn: Information is surprise −log₂p; entropy H = Σ −p log₂p is the floor under every lossless code — drag the sliders and watch the Huffman tree rebuild live, its average code length hugging the golden entropy surface it can never cross

topics.descZh: 每个格子只数 8 个邻居——死格恰 3 邻复活、活格 2–3 邻续命,B3/S23 两行规则长出滑翔机、时钟与逻辑门,一块图灵完备的板子;换个出生表就是另一个宇宙
topics.descEn: Each cell only counts its neighbours — born on exactly 3, alive on 2–3; from B3/S23 emerge gliders, clocks and logic gates on a Turing-complete board, and one changed rule line builds another universe

topics.descZh: 往立方体里均匀撒点数命中,π≈6·N_in/N 从随机频率里自己浮现,误差只认 1/√N——从蒲丰投针、中子输运到光渲染与期权定价,全是同一个循环
topics.descEn: Rain uniform random points into a cube, count the hits, and π ≈ 6·N_in/N emerges from raw frequency with error obeying 1/√N — the one method behind Buffon's needles, reactors, renderers and pricing

topics.subtitleEn: P · I · D on a hovering drone
topics.descZh: P 即时顶、I 攒残差、D 预判刹车——三个增益的配比把响应从懒散/振荡调到干脆利落
topics.descEn: P pushes now, I banks the leftover, D brakes early — the ratio of three gains turns lazy or oscillatory into crisp

topics.descZh: 芯片是印出来的:沉积→涂胶→掩模曝光→显影→刻蚀→离子注入→剥胶,每层走一遍流水线,几十轮叠出亿级晶体管的三维迷宫;衍射把线宽掐死在 CD≈k₁·λ/NA,436→13.5 nm 的波长竞赛就是摩尔定律本身。
topics.descEn: Chips are printed: deposit, coat, expose, develop, etch, implant, strip — one lap of the line per layer; dozens of cycles stack billions of transistors into a 3-D maze, and diffraction pins linewidth at CD≈k1·λ/NA — the 436-to-13.5 nm race is Moore's law itself.

topics.descZh: 传感器会抖、模型会歪,谁都不能全信:滤波把状态记成高斯分布——预测一步方差膨胀,测量一来按增益 K 融合、方差收缩;K 自动权衡信模型还是信测量。盯误差椭圆的呼吸,再切 GPS+IMU 双频。
topics.descEn: Sensors jitter, models err — trust neither alone. The Kalman filter holds the state as a Gaussian: predict and the variance inflates; measure and gain K fuses, variance shrinks; K weighs model vs measurement automatically. Watch the error ellipse breathe, then try GPS+IMU fusion.

topics.descZh: 解空间是起伏山地:贪心只下坡,卡死在最近的小山头;退火先加热让解乱跳,变差的步按 p=e^(−ΔE/T) 放行,再按 T₀·αᵏ 缓慢降温,最终沉入全球最深谷——淬火得缺陷,慢冷得晶体。
topics.descEn: The search space is rugged terrain: greedy descent freezes on the nearest hilltop; simulated annealing roams hot, lets worse moves pass with p=e^(−ΔE/T), then cools by T0·alpha^k until the ball settles into the deepest valley — quench for defects, slow-cool for the crystal.

topics.descZh: 每个区块盖上「上一块哈希」的指纹,SHA-256 雪崩让改一位就面目全非;挖矿=大海捞 nonce,哈希前导零达标才有效,算力占比=胜率;篡改旧块,身后整条链当场烧红断裂——改写历史必须赛过全体诚实矿机。
topics.descEn: Each block seals the previous block's hash; SHA-256's avalanche means flipping one bit rewrites the fingerprint. Mining is a lottery for a nonce whose hash starts with d zeros — your share of hashrate is your share of wins. Tamper with an old block and everything after it burns red: rewriting history means out-racing every honest miner.

topics.descZh: 洞穴里一扇魔法门:随机选边、听令出口、永远兑现——知道者每轮必过,骗子每轮 50% 被抓;置信 1−2⁻ᴺ 爬升,泄露知识 0 bit。
topics.descEn: A cave with one magic door: commit at random, exit on demand, always deliver — a knower passes every round, a bluffor is caught half the time; confidence climbs as 1−2⁻ᴺ, leaking 0 bits.

topics.descZh: 三条确定性方程画出蝴蝶双翼;初值差 10⁻⁶ 的双轨迹如影随形十秒,随后指数分道——李雅普诺夫 λ≈0.906,预报存在极限。
topics.descEn: Three deterministic equations draw the butterfly; twin trajectories 10⁻⁶ apart shadow each other for ten seconds, then part exponentially — Lyapunov λ≈0.906, and forecasting has a horizon.

topics.descZh: 哈希函数把任意键拍进桶里,查找 O(1);鸽笼注定冲突:链地址把同桶键串成链,开放寻址往隔壁找位、越挤越聚;装载因子过线就扩容重哈希;布隆过滤器用 k 个哈希置 k 个位——「一定不在」从不骗人,「可能在」偶尔误报,1 bit 换一次内存查询。
topics.descEn: A hash function slaps any key into a bucket: lookup in O(1); pigeons must collide — chaining strings same-bucket keys into lists, open addressing steps next door and clusters as it fills; past the load-factor line, rehash and grow; a Bloom filter sets k bits with k hashes — “definitely absent” never lies, “possibly present” sometimes does, one bit per element buys the whole memory check.

topics.descZh: 浏览器只认 IP,人只记得住名字:递归解析器替你爬域名树,问根、问 .com、问权威 NS,拿回 93.184.216.34,全程 UDP/53 约 116 ms;应答带着 TTL 沿途点亮各级缓存,30 秒内再查同一名字只要约 1 ms,快约 100 倍;TTL 归零缓存熄灭重爬——命中率常超 90%,13 个根地址任播成 1500+ 实例。
topics.descEn: Browsers speak IPs, humans remember names: a recursive resolver climbs the domain tree — root, .com, authoritative NS — returning the IP over UDP/53 in ~116 ms. The reply carries a TTL and lights every cache on the way back, so the same name answers in ~1 ms, ~100x faster; at zero the caches go dark — hit rates exceed 90%, and 13 anycast root addresses guard it all.

topics.descZh: 把进化做成搜索:轮盘赌按 fᵢ/Σf 抽亲代,交叉让子代落在两亲代之间,变异随机跳步或整球重采样;μ=0 时种群锁死在 f=0.66 的局部峰,恢复变异后一颗重采样球越过山谷落到 f=1.00 的全局峰,种群再度爬升——探索与收敛的平衡就是全部秘密。
topics.descEn: Evolution as search: roulette selection samples parents with P=fᵢ/Σf, crossover places children between two parents, mutation hops or wholly resamples. With μ=0 the population locks onto a local peak; restore mutation and one resampled ball crosses the valley to the global peak, and the population climbs again — balancing exploration and exploitation is the whole game.

topics.descZh: 旅行商问题要经每城恰一次的最短回路:10 城已有 362 万条候选排列,15 城达 1.3 万亿;最近邻贪心 O(n²) 秒出解却自我打结;三角不等式证明交叉必非最优,2-opt 拎起红 X、反转中段、落下新边,阶梯式压到参考最优 5% 以内。
topics.descEn: The TSP asks for the shortest tour through every city exactly once: 10 cities span 3,628,800 permutations, 15 cities 1.3 trillion. Nearest-neighbor is O(n²) but ties knots; the triangle inequality forbids crossings, so 2-opt lifts the red X, reverses the middle and drops uncrossed edges, stair-stepping to within ~5% of optimal.

topics.descZh: 两个人当着窃听者凭空造出同一把钥匙,钥匙从未上过信道:公开 p、g,Alice 发 g^a mod p、Bob 发 g^b mod p,各自再过一遍自己的秘密——g^ab 两边相等;窃听者握着 g、g^a、g^b,却要解离散对数才能前进一步——2048 位下算到宇宙热寂也算不完;颜色类比:混开容易,分回去没人会。
topics.descEn: Two people forge the same key under an eavesdropper's nose, and it never touches the wire: p and g are public, Alice sends g^a mod p, Bob sends g^b, each re-applies their own secret — g^ab matches on both sides; the eavesdropper holds g, g^a, g^b but must solve discrete log to take one step — at 2048 bits, past the heat death of the universe; in paint: mixing is easy, un-mixing is the part nobody can do.

topics.titleZh: 神经网络正向与反向传播
topics.descZh: 输入×权重过激活函数逐层前向传播；交叉熵损失对每层权重求导由链式法则反向传播；W←W−η·∂L/∂W 迭代更新；ReLU 在正区梯度=1，避免 sigmoid 梯度消失——可视化权重与损失曲线的同步演变。
topics.descEn: Input × weights through activation functions forward layer by layer; cross-entropy loss gradients flow backward by the chain rule; W←W−η·∂L/∂W iterates; ReLU keeps gradient=1 for z>0, avoiding sigmoid's vanishing gradient — watch weights and the loss curve evolve together.

topics.descZh: 滑动窗口编码器在已见内容里找最长匹配，输出(偏移,长度,下一字符)三元组；自引用复制让单个 a 扩展为 aaaaaaa；令牌再经霍夫曼编码→DEFLATE，ZIP 与 PNG 的核心。
topics.descEn: A sliding window encoder finds the longest match in previously seen content and emits (offset, length, next char) triples; self-referential copies extend a single 'a' into 'aaaaaaa'; tokens are then Huffman-coded → DEFLATE, the core of ZIP and PNG.

topics.descZh: 左小右大不变量让查找每步排除一半——O(log n) 平均，但有序插入退化为 O(n) 链表；删除双子节点用中序后继替换；中序遍历直接输出有序序列——可视化退化过程让 O(n) vs O(log n) 的差距触目惊心。
topics.descEn: Left-smaller right-larger invariant halves the search space at each step — O(log n) average, but sorted inserts degenerate to an O(n) chain; delete a two-child node by swapping with its in-order successor; in-order traversal outputs sorted keys directly — watching degeneration makes the O(n) vs O(log n) gap visceral.

topics.descZh: 取指、译码、执行、访存、写回——一条指令拆成五站,流水满载时五条指令同时在工位上,理想情况每周期完工一条:吞吐率 ×5,单条延迟一点没变;下一条要用上一条的结果(RAW)就前递或停一拍,分支预测错就冲刷整条流水;最慢的一站决定主频——洗车房由最慢的工位决定。
topics.descEn: Fetch, decode, execute, memory, write-back — one instruction split across five stations; at full flow five instructions occupy five stations and ideally one finishes every clock: ×5 throughput, per-instruction latency unchanged; when the next needs the last one's result, forward it or stall; a mispredicted branch flushes the pipe; the slowest station sets the clock — a car wash runs at its slowest bay.

topics.descZh: 完全二叉树不配指针、直接住进数组：父 i、子 2i 与 2i+1；插入时新元素与父比较一路问题上浮，取顶时尾元素换顶后一路下沉，都只要 O(log n)；自底向上建堆更是只要 O(n)，堆排序就是建堆加反复取顶——Dijkstra 与 A* 的优先队列全是它在后台撑着。
topics.descEn: A complete binary tree lives in a bare array with no pointers: parent i, children 2i and 2i+1. Insert bubbles a new element up past its parents; extract-max swaps the tail to the top and lets it sink — both O(log n). Bottom-up heapify costs just O(n), heapsort is build-heap plus repeated extraction, and Dijkstra and A* run on exactly this engine.

topics.descZh: 朴素递归的斐波那契是一棵指数爆炸的调用树，fib(35) 要调用 29,860,703 次，重叠子问题被反复重算；记忆化让每个子问题只算一次，调用数骤降到 2n−1，剪掉的子树灰在半空；自底向上填表连递归栈都省了——最优子结构＋重叠子问题在，背包与编辑距离都是同一招。
topics.descEn: Naive recursion turns Fibonacci into an exponentially exploding call tree — fib(35) makes 29,860,703 calls while overlapping subproblems are recomputed millions of times. Memoization computes each subproblem once, collapsing the count to 2n−1 with pruned subtrees hanging gray in mid-air; bottom-up filling drops the recursion stack entirely. Optimal substructure + overlapping subproblems, and knapsack and edit distance follow the same recipe.

topics.descZh: 直接算 N 点 DFT 要 N² 次复数乘法；FFT 按偶/奇下标把序列劈半递归，再用旋转因子 W 逐级蝶形合并——每层 N 次运算、共 log₂N 层；N=1024 时 1,048,576 次乘法当场折成 10,240，JPEG、音频与 5G 的频谱都是这条蝶形电路算出来的。
topics.descEn: A naive N-point DFT costs N² complex multiplications; the FFT splits the sequence into even/odd halves recursively and merges with twiddle factors through butterflies — N ops per stage, log₂N stages. At N=1024, 1,048,576 multiplications fold into 10,240 on the spot; the spectra behind JPEG, audio and 5G all run through this circuit.

topics.titleZh: 强化学习与 Q 学习
topics.descZh: agent 在网格世界里瞎撞，每步按 Q 表（状态×动作的价值）选动作、以 ε 概率保留探索；拿到奖励就按 Bellman 方程把误差写回 Q(s,a)，终点的价值沿时间反向往回漫；训练几百回合后，乱撞轨迹变成笔直绕开陷阱的最优路，热图点亮成路标、箭头场汇向终点——全部艺术在探索与利用的权衡。
topics.descEn: An agent flails through a grid world, picking actions by its Q-table (state×action values) while keeping an ε chance to explore; each step a Bellman update writes the reward error back into Q(s,a), letting the goal's value seep backward through time. A few hundred episodes later the flailing becomes a straight path around the traps, the heatmap lights up as signposts and the arrow field converges on the goal — the whole art is the explore/exploit trade-off.

topics.descZh: 最小二乘回归线是让残差平方和最小的那条线，拖动任意点都能看它实时「让」；一个离群点就能把整条线拽歪；Anscombe 四重奏证明相同的 r≈0.82 背后是完全不同的四种数据；把隐藏的「气温」拉出来，冰激凌销量与溺水的伪相关当场消失——相关永远不等于因果，高尔顿的「回归均值」正是这一切的起点。
topics.descEn: The least-squares line is the one minimizing squared residuals — drag any point and watch it yield in real time; a single outlier can yank the whole fit. The Anscombe quartet shows identical r≈0.82 hiding four different truths. Pull out the hidden "temperature" and the ice-cream–drowning spurious correlation melts into flat within-band fits — correlation is never causation, and Galton's regression to the mean is where the word was born.

topics.descZh: 把词频从大到小排队，第 k 名的频率≈第 1 名/k，双对数图上是一条斜率≈−1 的直线；幂律没有特征尺度，头 20% 拿走 80%；生成机制是优先连接——新词、新居民、新链接按现有规模加权落下，富者愈富；城市人口、网页入度、地震能量与财富分布都是它，和伽尔顿板的正态世界是两种不同的增长逻辑。
topics.descEn: Rank word frequencies and the k-th is ≈ 1/k of the first — a slope ≈ −1 line on log-log axes. Power laws have no characteristic scale: the top 20% take 80%. The mechanism is preferential attachment — new words, residents and links land weighted by existing size, the rich get richer — and city populations, web in-degree, earthquake energies and wealth all follow it, a growth logic utterly unlike the Galton board's normal world.

topics.descZh: 贝塞尔曲线是伯恩斯坦多项式加权的控制点：de Casteljau 逐层线性插值，t∈[0,1] 扫一遍，控制多边形套娃式收缩成一个流动的笔尖；曲线被中间点「拉」但只过首尾，阶数越高越难控，工程上只用 2–4 阶；两段三次在接缝拼成长曲线，滑块把 Q1 转到切镜方向得 G¹、等长得 C¹，曲率梳照出残余的曲率跳变。
topics.descEn: A Bézier curve is its control points weighted by Bernstein polynomials: de Casteljau lerps layer by layer, and as t sweeps 0→1 the control polygon nests down into a roaming pen tip. The curve is pulled by its middle points but passes only the ends, and engineering sticks to degree 2–4; two cubics joined at a seam get G¹ when the handle rotates onto the tangent and C¹ when lengths match — the curvature comb still exposes the jump.

topics.descZh: 缓存集群扩容时 hash % N 让几乎所有键换位，N 从 3 到 4 就有约 75% 的缓存失效；把哈希空间首尾相接成环，键与节点都落在环上、键归顺时针第一个节点——加删一台只搬约 1/N 的键；再给每台节点配一堆虚拟节点撒在环上，负载不均度当场骤降，这就是 Dynamo 与 CDN 分片的地基。
topics.descEn: When a cache cluster grows, hash % N remaps almost every key — going from 3 to 4 servers invalidates ~75% of the cache. Bend the hash space into a ring where keys and nodes both land and each key belongs to the first node clockwise: joining or leaving moves only ~1/N of keys, and a pile of virtual nodes per machine flattens the load — the foundation of Dynamo and CDN sharding.

topics.descZh: 正则经 Thompson 构造译成 NFA：a|b 是分叉、ab 是串联、a* 是回环；集合模拟每步同时走所有分支，步数线性；回溯引擎逐条路径试探，(a+)+b 每吃一个 a 路径数翻倍——30 个 a 累计上亿条、指数爆炸，同一条正则两种引擎命悬一线；泵引理证明有限状态连 aⁿbⁿ 都数不了。
topics.descEn: Thompson's construction compiles a regex to an NFA: a|b forks, ab chains, a* loops back. Subset simulation advances all branches at once in linear steps; a backtracking engine tries path by path, and (a+)+b doubles its path count with every 'a' — thirty a's mean hundreds of millions of paths, exponential blowup on one pattern with two engines, while the pumping lemma shows finite states can't even count aⁿbⁿ.

topics.descZh: 微分方程写得出却常常解不出:数值方法用「小步递推」代替求解。同一颗弹簧振子,显式欧拉沿切线外推、每步悄悄注入能量,能量条一圈圈上涨、相位图螺旋外扩;中点法先探半步降为 O(h²),RK4 四斜率加权达 O(h⁴) 纹丝不动;h 减半误差按 1/2ᵏ 下降,双对数图的斜率就是方法的阶;换轨道预设,欧拉把卫星一路甩出太阳系。
topics.descEn: Differential equations you can write but rarely solve: numerics replaces solving with small recursive steps. On one spring, explicit Euler extrapolates along the tangent and secretly injects energy every step — the energy bar climbs, the phase portrait spirals outward; midpoint peeks half a step for O(h²), RK4 averages four slopes for O(h⁴) and never drifts. Halve h and error falls by 2^k — the log-log slope is the method's fingerprint. Switch to the orbit preset and Euler ejects the satellite from the system.

topics.descZh: 要「压缩」一云散点,先找方差最大的方向——它恰是协方差矩阵的特征向量:幂迭代 v←Cv/|Cv| 让随机箭头被反复拉伸、自己旋到主轴上,PC2 垂直补位;特征值 λ 就是该方向的方差,λ₁/(λ₁+λ₂) 是 PC1 解释的占比;砍掉 PC2 把二维压成一维,红残差线段长出的正是被丢掉的信息。
topics.descEn: To "compress" a scatter cloud, first find the direction of maximum variance — it is exactly an eigenvector of the covariance matrix: power iteration v←Cv/|Cv| repeatedly stretches a random arrow until it swings onto the principal axis, with PC2 filling in orthogonally. Each eigenvalue λ is the variance along its axis, and λ₁/(λ₁+λ₂) is the share PC1 explains. Drop PC2 to collapse 2-D onto 1-D — the red residual segments are precisely the information thrown away.

topics.descZh: 「这两点连通吗」不必搜整张图,问根即可——union 把一棵树整棵挂到另一棵根下;乱挂会让树退化成链、find 变 O(n),按秩合并+路径压缩两个启发式把均摊代价压到 O(α(n));看脉冲沿链爬到顶、整条链「哗」地拍扁挂根,再用 8×8 格点渗流实验逼近 p_c≈0.593 的贯通阈值。
topics.descEn: "Are these two connected?" needs no graph search — just ask the root: union hangs one whole tree under the other's root. Careless merging degenerates trees into chains and find becomes O(n); union-by-rank plus path compression crush the amortized cost to O(α(n)). Watch a pulse climb a chain and the whole path snap flat onto the root, then push a site-percolation experiment toward the spanning threshold p_c≈0.593.

topics.descZh: 把 n 个村庄连成一张网、总电缆最短：Kruskal 把边按权重排序，从最便宜的开始拿——两端不在同一连通块就要，成环就扔，并查集一步判断；收够 n−1 条即停。Prim 是同一棵树的另一种长法：从一点起每次勾最短的邻边，殊途同归。
topics.descEn: Wire n villages with the least total cable: Kruskal sorts edges cheapest-first and takes each unless both ends are already in one component — one union-find query spots the loop — stopping at n−1 edges; Prim grows the same tree the other way, always hooking the cheapest edge on the frontier; two roads, one minimal tree.

topics.descZh: Transformer 读句子不排队：每个词发出 Query 去和所有词的 Key 对暗号，softmax 把相似度变成一组和为 1 的权重，再按权重把各词的 Value 汇总进来——"它"会一把抓住房前最近的名词；多头就是几组 Q/K/V 各看各的角度，最后拼接。
topics.descEn: Transformers read in parallel, not in line: each token sends a Query to match every Key, softmax turns the similarities into weights summing to 1, and the Values blend accordingly —

topics.descZh: 想画分布的形状却算不出归一化常数：Metropolis 让行走者提议一步、按密度比值决定去留——上坡必走、下坡以概率走，偶尔下山防卡死；走久了落脚点的直方图自己收敛成目标分布。它不画等高线，它把自己活成等高线。
topics.descEn: You want the distribution's shape but can't normalize it: Metropolis lets a walker propose steps and accept by the density ratio — always uphill, sometimes downhill to keep mixing — and given time the histogram of visited points converges to the target; it doesn't draw contours, it becomes them.

topics.descZh: 插入时 k 个哈希函数点亮 k 个位,查询时任一位是 0 就「肯定没见过」,全是 1 只是「可能见过」——偶尔误报;最优哈希数 k=(m/n)ln2,用十分之一的内存换一个「绝不错杀」的快速初筛。
topics.descEn: Insertion lights k bits via k hash functions; a query with any 0 bit is 'definitely unseen,' all-1s is only 'probably seen' — the occasional false positive; optimal k=(m/n)ln2 trades a tenth of the memory for a fast pre-filter that never misses.

topics.descZh: 0.1 在二进制里是写不完的循环小数,只能舍入着存:1 符号+11 指数+52 尾数,分辨率 ε=2.2e-16;0.1+0.2 的两次舍入叠出 5.5e-17 的差,大数加小数时小数直接被对齐吃掉,溢出叫 Inf,0/0 叫 NaN。
topics.descEn: 0.1 is an endless repeating fraction in binary, so it's stored rounded: 1 sign + 11 exponent + 52 mantissa bits, resolution ε=2.2e-16; 0.1+0.2 stacks two roundings into a 5.5e-17 gap, big-plus-small swallows the small term during alignment, overflow is Inf, and 0/0 is NaN.

topics.descZh: 光栅化问「三角形盖住哪些像素」,光追反过来:每个像素发一根反向光线,找最近交点、问光源、在镜面和玻璃间递归弹射——倒影、折射、阴影都不用再「画」,它们本来就是光线追出来的。
topics.descEn: Rasterization asks which pixels a triangle covers; ray tracing flips it: fire a ray per pixel, find the nearest hit, ask the light source, and bounce recursively off mirrors and glass — reflections, refraction and shadows aren't painted on, they fall out of the rays.

topics.descZh: 一枚骰子是平的,两枚起了弧,五枚已像钟:不管单个分布长什么样,加得够多,和总是挤向同一条正态曲线,σ 按步子 √n 收拢
topics.descEn: One die is flat, two make an arc, five already ring like a bell: sum enough of any distribution and the total crowds the same normal curve, with σ shrinking by the √n stair

topics.descZh: 画切线、落到横轴、再重来:x−f/f′ 每步把误差平方甩掉——四位小数三步到手;初值选错就振荡跑路,多初值染色开出牛顿分形
topics.descEn: Draw the tangent, drop to the axis, repeat: x−f/f′ squares the error away each step — four digits in three moves; a bad seed oscillates, and coloring every seed grows the Newton fractal

topics.descZh: 流水线遇到 if 就赌下一拍取哪条路:赌对零损失,赌错整段作废清空;两位饱和计数器把「大概率跳」练成肌肉记忆,命中 99% 像白赚
topics.descEn: At every if the pipeline bets which way to fetch: right is free, wrong flushes a dozen slots; a two-bit saturating counter drills 'probably taken' into muscle memory — 99% hits feel like free speed

topics.descZh: 以 f_s 每秒抓样,频谱就以 f_s 为周期无限复制:信号频率越过 f_s/2,Nyquist 界外的音调就顺着折叠线伪装成假低频——车轮倒转、条纹乱爬,全是混叠的戏法
topics.descEn: Sample at f_s and the spectrum repeats with period f_s: once the signal passes f_s/2, tones beyond the Nyquist line fold into fake low frequencies — wagon wheels spinning backward are aliasing's oldest trick

topics.descZh: 把一小时切成几万个小格,每格命中概率微小而独立:总命中数的分布就是泊松,方差恰好等于均值——从放射性计数到排队来电,稀有事件都长这张脸
topics.descEn: Slice the hour into tens of thousands of tiny slots, each a rare independent hit: the total follows the Poisson distribution, variance equal to the mean — from radioactive counts to call queues, rare events all wear this face

topics.descZh: 网络堵不堵,靠丢包说话:发送方从 1 开始指数试探,过了阈值改线性爬,一丢包就砍回原点或减半——AIMD 的锯齿,是效率与公平反复讨价还价的价格曲线
topics.descEn: The network speaks congestion through lost packets: the sender probes exponentially from one, goes linear past a threshold, then cuts to half or restarts on loss — the AIMD sawtooth is a price curve haggling between efficiency and fairness

topics.descZh: 傅里叶知道有哪些频率、却丢了何时；小波用同一母波伸缩平移：高频压缩细看定位突变、低频拉伸粗看量准周期——chirp 在时频图上画斜线、断点亮成竖线
topics.descEn: Fourier lists the frequencies but loses the when; wavelets stretch and shift one mother wave — squeezed to read transients sharply, stretched to pin slow periods — until the chirp draws a slanted line and the discontinuity lights a vertical one.

topics.descZh: 顾客泊松到达、服务时长随机：利用率 ρ 爬到 0.9 队长翻倍、0.99 百倍——等待在 1/(1−ρ) 处爆炸；加一扇窗比提速十倍划算，利特尔定律 L=λW 把队长与等待串成一笔账
topics.descEn: Arrivals land by Poisson, service times wander: at ρ=0.9 the queue doubles, at 0.99 it explodes like 1/(1−ρ). One extra server beats tenfold speedup, and Little's law L=λW ties queue length and waiting into one ledger.

topics.descZh: 磁盘一次读一页，二叉树十亿行要 30 次随机 IO；B 树把节点摊平成页、扇出≈100，树高 4–5 层、根常驻内存：满了就地分裂中键上浮，范围查询沿叶子链顺序扫——树形迁就存储介质
topics.descEn: Disks read a page at a time; a billion-row BST costs 30 random I/Os. B-trees flatten nodes into pages with fanout ≈100 — 4–5 levels tall, root in RAM: full nodes split and push a middle key up, range scans ride the leaf chain. The shape bows to the storage.

topics.descZh: 计算机不会掷骰子,只会算 x′=(ax+c) mod m:给定种子,序列一百亿位后仍会重演;直方图看着均匀,三维取点却排成整齐格线——伪随机是确定性穿的戏服
topics.descEn: Computers don't roll dice, they compute x′=(ax+c) mod m: plant a seed and the sequence replays identically a billion terms later; the histogram looks flat but plot points in 3D and they line up on neat lattice planes — pseudo-randomness is determinism in costume

topics.descZh: 一个 2×2 矩阵就是把整张网格掰弯的双手:旋转、剪切、缩放都是它的方言;行列式是面积汇率,负号意味着空间被翻了面——复合变换不过是矩阵乘法
topics.descEn: A 2×2 matrix is a pair of hands bending the whole grid: rotation, shear and scaling are its dialects; the determinant is the area exchange rate, a minus sign means space got flipped — and composing transforms is just matrix multiplication

topics.descZh: 每一刀都问「哪个特征能把混乱降得最多」:熵是混乱的计量,信息增益是刀的功劳;贪心长树、深了过拟合,剪枝与森林投票是后悔药
topics.descEn: Every split asks which feature lowers the confusion most: entropy is the measure of mess, information gain is the cut's résumé; grow greedily, overfit deep, then prune or vote with a forest

topics.descZh: 给有序链表抛硬币建高架桥:每个元素以一半概率升一层,查找从顶层一路下坡——期望 O(log n),抛硬币的随机性替代了红黑树的旋转;掷骰子掷出了秩序
topics.descEn: Flip coins over a sorted linked list to build overpasses: each element climbs a layer with probability one half, and a search skis downhill from the top — expected O(log n), coin flips standing in for red-black rotations; randomness minting order

topics.descZh: 随手撒 K 个质心,两步舞循环到天亮:每个点认领最近的质心,每个质心挪到自己的平均值——没有标签也能长出结构;收敛是局部的,K 的选择与初始位置决定结局
topics.descEn: Scatter K centroids and dance two steps until dawn: every point claims its nearest centroid, every centroid moves to its members' mean — structure grows without labels; the convergence is local, and the choice of K and start decides the ending

topics.descZh: 用一千个「可能的我」描述不确定性:每个粒子带着一个假设位置,预测时乱走、观测时按相似度加权,再重采样让赢家繁衍——跟踪不再一条轨道,而是一团会思考的云
topics.descEn: Describe uncertainty with a thousand possible selves: each particle carries a hypothesis, prediction scatters them, observation weights them by fit, and resampling lets the winners breed — tracking is no longer one orbit but a thinking cloud

topics.descZh: 管网从源到汇能送多少水?每条管有容量,每个节点流量守恒——沿还有余量的路一次次推流,直到无路可推;最大流与最小割是同一笔账的两面:把网络剪成两半的瓶颈容量,恰好等于已经流过的总量;堵与流,在图上写的是对偶
topics.descEn: How much water can the network push from source to sink? Each pipe has a capacity, every node conserves flow — keep pushing along any path with slack until none is left; max-flow and min-cut are two faces of one bill: the bottleneck capacity of the best cut equals exactly the total pushed; blockage and flow, duals on the same graph

topics.titleZh: 倍周期分岔与混沌之路
topics.titleEn: Period Doubling & the Road to Chaos
topics.descZh: x→rx(1−x),一行方程装下整个种群:参数 r 一点点上调,稳定值先纹丝不动,然后一分为二、二分为四——分岔越来越密,间距按费根鲍姆常数 4.669 收缩,越过 3.57 就是混沌:确定性方程写下不可预测的年景;乱中还有 3 周期的秩序窗口,乱与序在同一张图上共存
topics.descEn: x→rx(1−x): one line holding a whole population; raise r slowly and the fixed point holds, then splits in two, then four — bifurcations crowd in, spacing shrinking by Feigenbaum's 4.669, until past 3.57 chaos takes over: a deterministic equation writing unpredictable years; and inside the chaos, a period-3 window keeps a pocket of order — mess and order sharing one chart

topics.descZh: 每个进程都以为自己独占整条地址空间——那是 MMU 变的魔术:虚拟页号查页表翻译成物理页框,TLB 把高频翻译缓存成条件反射;没映射的页一访问就缺页中断,OS 挑一个牺牲者写回磁盘、把要的页调进来;局部性原理替这场魔术买单,一旦程序乱翻内存,换页抖动让机器比算术还忙
topics.descEn: Every process believes it owns the whole address space — a trick by the MMU: the virtual page number looks up the page table for a physical frame, and the TLB caches hot translations into reflexes; touch an unmapped page and a page fault interrupts, the OS picks a victim, writes it back, and flies the wanted page in; locality pays for the magic, but thrash the memory and paging gets busier than the arithmetic

topics.descZh: 每条资源约束都是切掉半张纸的直线,半平面之交是可行域;目标函数一族平行等值线沿梯度平移,离开可行域前最后碰到的点——几乎总在顶点——就是最优;单纯形沿边跳顶点,几步即达
topics.descEn: Each constraint is a line slicing away half the plane; the half-planes meet in a feasible polygon; slide the objective’s iso-lines along the gradient and the last touch before leaving — almost always a vertex — is optimal; simplex hops edges vertex to vertex and lands in a few steps

topics.descZh: 谁生谁死不看引用数,看能否从根走到:三色标记从根出发——灰排队、黑幸存、白是垃圾,清扫回收白色;程序边跑边改引用,写屏障保新引用不漏;引用计数见不得循环引用,一环扣一环永远清不掉
topics.descEn: Life isn’t a count, it’s reachability from the roots: tri-color marking sweeps out — grey queued, black alive, white garbage, then the sweep reclaims whites; write barriers keep mutating refs honest; reference counting can’t stomach cycles — a ring of one keeps them all immortal

topics.descZh: 依赖是有向边,图无环才存在合法顺序:Kahn 入度法弹出零入度节点、拆掉出边、新零入度入队;最长链是关键路径——长度即工期,压缩它才管用;一旦有环,谁也无法先走,排序当场无解
topics.descEn: Dependencies are directed edges; a legal order exists only if no cycle: Kahn pops zero-in-degree nodes, deletes their edges, queues the freed; the longest chain is the critical path — its length is the schedule, compress only it; a cycle means nobody can start: no solution

topics.titleZh: 极小极大与 Alpha-Beta 剪枝
topics.descZh: 博弈树一层取最大、一层取最小,叶子值回传找最优;朴素穷举 b^d 个叶子(国象深 6 = 18 亿);维护 α(MAX 下界)与 β(MIN 上界),α≥β 的瞬间对手绝不会走进来——整棵子树剪掉;走法排序越好剪得越狠,最好 O(b^(d/2)),同算力看深一倍——深蓝与 AlphaGo 都站在它上面
topics.descEn: On the game tree one side maximizes, the other minimizes, and leaf values backpropagate to the best move; naive search costs b^d leaves (1.8 billion at chess depth 6). Track α (MAX's floor) and β (MIN's ceiling); the moment α≥β the opponent never lets the play get there — cut the whole subtree. Good ordering prunes hardest: O(b^(d/2)), twice the depth for the same compute. Deep Blue and AlphaGo stand on this.

topics.titleZh: 拜占庭容错与叛徒将军
topics.descZh: 叛徒会对不同人发不同命令——Lamport 1982:f 个叛徒要 n≥3f+1 个诚实节点、交换 f+1 轮消息:每人把收到的原样转告所有人,最后逐节点取多数,诚实的 2f+1 票淹没叛徒的 f 张假票;2/3 容错上限是硬界;PBFT 用三阶段把它做进工业,比特币用工作量证明换个概率版本
topics.descEn: Traitors send different orders to different people — Lamport 1982: against f traitors you need n≥3f+1 honest nodes and f+1 rounds of messages: everyone relays what they received, every node finally takes a majority, and the honest 2f+1 drown the traitors' f fakes. The 2/3 ceiling is hard; PBFT industrialized it in three phases, and Bitcoin swapped in a probabilistic version.

topics.titleZh: 密码学哈希与雪崩效应
topics.descZh: 任意长输入 → 固定 256 位摘要(本页算真实 SHA-256);分块后 64 轮移位/异或/模加把 1 位搅进全部状态;雪崩:输入差 1 位,输出翻 ~128 位(50%),两个摘要毫无亲缘;生日界碰撞 ≈2¹²⁸ 次尝试;密码入库要加盐 + bcrypt/argon2 慢函数,把 GPU 每秒 10¹⁰ 次猜测打回原形
topics.descEn: Any input in, a fixed 256-bit digest out (real SHA-256 on this page); 64 rounds of shift/XOR/mod-add stir 1 bit into the whole state. Avalanche: one input bit flips ~128 output bits (50%) — the digests look unrelated. Birthday-bound collisions cost ~2^128 tries; passwords need salt plus bcrypt/argon2 to blunt a GPU's 10^10 guesses a second.

topics.descZh: 无摩擦下滑 A→B,最快路径不是直线而是倒摆线:v=√(2gy),早降早得速度,先陡后平的摆线把时间积分压到最小——变分法的第一场胜仗;它还有等时性:不同起点同时到底,惠更斯照此造钟
topics.descEn: Slide frictionlessly from A to B and the fastest path is not the straight line but an inverted cycloid: v=√(2gy) rewards dropping early, and the steep-then-flat cycloid minimizes the time integral — the calculus of variations' first victory; also tautochrone: every start arrives together

topics.descZh: 互斥、持有并等待、不可剥夺、循环等待——四个条件凑齐,进程就抱团卡死;银行家算法在批准请求前先假装借出:还能排出一个全部完成的顺序才算安全,排不出就挂起;死锁预防不过是拆掉四个条件之一
topics.descEn: Mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption, circular wait — all four together and processes lock up for good; the banker's algorithm grants a request only after pretending to: if a safe sequence exists, lend; otherwise wait; prevention simply breaks one of the four

topics.descZh: 模型太笨漏掉信号,太聪明连噪声也背下来:训练误差随阶数单调下降,测试误差却走出 U 型;高阶多项式把每个噪声点都穿在曲线上;L2 正则用 λ 把系数往零拉、让曲线钝下来——偏差与方差的跷跷板,靠验证集找平衡点
topics.descEn: A model too dull misses the signal; one too clever memorizes the noise: training error falls monotonically with degree while test error makes a U; a high-degree polynomial threads every noisy point; L2 regularization pulls coefficients toward zero with λ — the bias-variance seesaw

topics.titleEn: Law of Large Numbers & the Gambler's Fallacy
topics.descZh: 样本越多,频率越收敛到概率——带宽像 1/√n 的漏斗收紧;但硬币没有记忆,连开 10 次正面后第 11 次仍是 50%;赌场把期望设成负(轮盘 47.37% 对 52.63%),大数定律替庄家把 5.26% 磨成稳定利润
topics.descEn: More samples, tighter frequency — the band narrows like a 1/√n funnel; yet coins have no memory: after ten heads the eleventh is still 50/50; casinos set every game's expectation negative (47.37% vs 52.63% on red), and the law of large numbers grinds the 5.26% edge into steady profit

topics.titleZh: 支持向量机与最大间隔
topics.descZh: 分类不只求分对,还要离两边最远:最大化间隔的边界由贴边的少数点唯一决定——支持向量,删掉其余样本边界纹丝不动;软间隔用 C 容忍穿插,核技巧把同心圆环抬进高维摊开;γ 控制弯曲度、过大会孤岛化
topics.descEn: A classifier should not just separate — it should separate with the widest margin: the boundary is fixed by the few points touching it, the support vectors; delete the rest and nothing moves; soft-margin C tolerates overlap, kernels lift interlocked rings into separable dimensions; γ sets the curl, too high and it islands

topics.titleZh: Raft 共识与领导者选举
topics.descZh: 任期单调递增+随机化选举超时,谁先拿到多数票谁当主;写请求只进主,日志并行发给从属、多数确认才提交;主宕机任期 +1 重选,「日志不比我新的不投」保证已提交数据永不丢;分区愈合后高任期获胜、未提交条目被截断
topics.descEn: Terms only climb and randomized timeouts avoid split votes — a majority wins the leader seat; writes go to the leader, log entries fan out to followers and commit on majority ack; a dead leader means term+1 and a new race, and “your log isn't newer, no vote” keeps committed data safe; after healing, the higher term wins

topics.descZh: A 组 62%>56%、34%>28%,每一层都赢;加总却成 41%<49%,反输——混杂变量藏在权重里:谁在低录取率严层占比大,合计就被拖下水;权重滑块越过临界值 46.4%,合计胜者当场易主;Berkeley 1973 女生 25.2% vs 男生 44.6%、肾结石手术 78% vs 83% 同款剧本;解法:分层看或随机化
topics.descEn: Group A wins 62%>56% and 34%>28% in every stratum, yet loses 41%<49% overall — the confounder hides in the weights; push the weight slider past 46.4% and the aggregate winner flips live; Berkeley 1973 (25.2% vs 44.6%) and kidney-stone surgery (78% vs 83%) replay the trick; the fix is stratification or randomization

topics.descZh: AES-128 把明文排成 4×4 状态:SubBytes 查 S 盒做唯一非线性混淆,ShiftRows 移行、MixColumns 在 GF(2⁸) 上混列把 1 字节变化撒满整块,10 轮 SPN;翻 1 位,两轮内约 64/128 位翻转=雪崩;ECB 相同明文块→相同密文、企鹅当场显形,CBC 链入前块只剩雪花;HTTPS 由 RSA/DH 递会话密钥、AES 干重活
topics.descEn: AES-128 lays plaintext into a 4×4 byte state: SubBytes applies the only non-linear S-box, ShiftRows and MixColumns spread one changed byte across the block over GF(2⁸), ten rounds total; flip 1 bit and ~64/128 bits flip within two rounds — the avalanche; ECB maps identical blocks to identical ciphertext and the penguin appears; CBC chains into pure snow; RSA/DH hand over the session key, AES does the lifting

topics.descZh: 两条线程同时对 count++ 而 ++ 是读-改-写三步:调度器把三步交错,两次 LOAD 读到同一旧值、一次更新凭空蒸发——最终 8≠期望 10;互斥锁把临界区焊成串行,拿锁者进、后来者睡;自旋锁忙等烧 CPU;锁序相反撞出 AB-BA 死锁、统一锁序即解;CAS 写回前核对旧值、被抢就重试——无锁也不丢
topics.descEn: Two threads run count++ and ++ is read-modify-write: the scheduler interleaves the steps, both LOADs read the same old value and one update evaporates — 8 instead of 10; a mutex welds the critical section serial; a spinlock burns CPU busy-waiting; opposite lock orders collide into AB-BA deadlock; CAS checks the old value before writing back and retries — lock-free and lossless

topics.descZh: 哥尼斯堡 4 块陆地架 7 座桥,度数为北岸 3、大岛 5、小岛 3、南岸 3;一笔画要求每桥恰走一次,中途点进出必须成对,奇度顶点多于 2 个即无解;全城 4 个顶点全是奇度,1736 年欧拉判决无解,图论由此诞生;拆掉一座桥,奇度 4→2,判定当场翻绿,Hierholzer 以 O(E) 线性时间拼出游程;可手动走桥,重复过桥当场警告
topics.descEn: Königsberg's 7 bridges give four landmasses degrees 3, 5, 3 and 3; an Euler path (each bridge exactly once) needs every intermediate visit to pair an entry with an exit, so more than 2 odd vertices means no path. All 4 vertices here are odd — Euler's 1736 verdict: impossible; demolish one bridge, odd count drops 4→2, the verdict flips green, and Hierholzer splices the full tour in O(E) linear time. Walk bridges by hand and repeat crossings warn on the spot

topics.titleZh: 椭圆曲线密码与点加法
topics.descZh: 曲线 y²=x³+ax+b 上点加法是一把直尺:过 P、Q 作直线 λ=(y₂−y₁)/(x₂−x₁),三次方程第三个根 x₃=λ²−x₁−x₂,交点关于 x 轴翻折得 R;P=Q 取切线得 2P;切到 mod 17,289 格点只剩 18 个曲线点加 O,群阶 19,除法换成乘模逆元照样跳格;13G=1101₂ 仅 3 倍 2 加,反解 k 是 ECDLP:17 位域 √19≈4 步可破,256 位域需 2¹²⁸ 次运算,256 位 ECC ≈ 3072 位 RSA
topics.descEn: On the curve y²=x³+ax+b, adding points is a ruler act: the line through P and Q with slope λ=(y₂−y₁)/(x₂−x₁) meets the cubic at a third root x₃=λ²−x₁−x₂, reflected across the x-axis into R; P=Q uses the tangent for 2P. Mod 17, only 18 of 289 lattice cells sit on the curve plus O — group order 19 — and division becomes multiplying by a modular inverse. Forward, 13G=1101₂ takes 3 doublings plus 2 additions; backward, ECDLP falls in ~√19≈4 tries here but costs ~2¹²⁸ operations at 256 bits — 256-bit ECC ≈ 3072-bit RSA

topics.descZh: 每核私有 L1 命中只要 4 拍,DRAM 要 200+ 拍,差 50 倍,热数据各存各的;但一行 64 B 若被两核同时要写,每次写都得先上总线广播 Invalid 作废对方副本、抢到独占 M,一次往返 60–120 拍;两个计数器挤在同一行,状态灯 M↔I 乒乓闪烁,48 次写撑到约 4000 拍,比行对齐慢 4–6 倍;把 b 挪进下一行,总线当场安静,写写都是 4 拍命中——伪共享就此消失
topics.descEn: A private L1 hit costs 4 cycles while DRAM takes 200+ — a 50x gap. When two counters share one 64-byte line, every write must broadcast an invalidation (60–120 cycles) to seize the M state, so 48 writes balloon to ~4000 cycles, 4–6x slower than aligned lines. Move b to its own line and the bus falls silent: silent E-to-M upgrades, zero invalidations, back to 4-cycle hits

topics.descZh: Alice 用随机基矢(+ 或 ×)把随机比特编进光子偏振,Bob 用另一组随机基矢去测:基对则结果准、基错则 50% 乱;公开比较基矢(不公开比特)后只留基对的 sifted key;窃听者 Eve 一旦截获测量,50% 概率选错基、引入 ≈25% 误码率——对账一小段 QBER 冲过 11% 阈值,整条密钥当场作废;不可克隆定理封死"抄一份再放回去";工程上光纤 ~100 km 级,"墨子号"2017 年实现 1200 km 星地分发
topics.descEn: Alice encodes random bits in photon polarization using a random basis (+ or ×); Bob measures in another random basis — right basis, right bit; wrong basis, a coin flip. Publishing bases (never bits) leaves the sifted key. An eavesdropper must measure, picks the wrong basis half the time and injects ≈25% errors — compare a sample and QBER blowing past the 11% threshold kills the key on the spot. The no-cloning theorem forbids

topics.descZh: 都闭嘴各判 1 年、都招供各判 8 年、一招一闭 0/10 年——无论对方怎样,背叛都更划算,于是(背叛,背叛)成了唯一的纳什均衡(单方偏走必亏),却劣于人人更好的(合作,合作);这不是道德问题,是均衡的几何;重复博弈让合作长出来:Axelrod 1980 计算机锦标赛里 tit-for-tat 两届夺冠;匹配硬币各 50% 随机化是混合策略均衡,期望值对等;价格战、军备竞赛、公地悲剧全是同构
topics.descEn: Both stay silent: 1 year each. Both confess: 8 each. One confesses: 0 and 10. Whatever the other does, defecting pays more — so (defect, defect) is the only Nash equilibrium (no one gains by moving alone), yet it loses to (cooperate, cooperate) for both. Not a morality problem — the geometry of equilibrium. Repeated play grows cooperation: tit-for-tat won Axelrod's 1980 tournament twice. Matching pennies at 50/50 is the mixed-strategy equilibrium with level odds. Price wars, arms races and the tragedy of the commons are the same matrix

topics.titleZh: 假设检验与 p 值
topics.descZh: H₀:硬币公平(p=0.5);抛 10 次得 9 正,p=P(这么极端或更极端|H₀)=2×11/1024≈2.15%<0.05 → 拒绝 H₀;p 值不是"H₀ 为真的概率"——它假设 H₀ 为真,量的是数据有多反常;α=0.05 判决线上两类错误此消彼长:第一类冤枉好币(率=α)、第二类放过坏币(率=β),样本量把功效 1−β 从 p=0.7/n=10 的 15% 拉到 n=200 的 99%;20 枚独立硬币各测一次,至少一枚"显著"的概率 1−0.95²⁰≈64%——多重比较总有一枚躺枪
topics.descEn: H₀: the coin is fair (p=0.5). Nine heads in ten flips give p=P(this extreme or worse|H₀)=2×11/1024≈2.15%<0.05 → reject. But the p-value is not

topics.descZh: n 男 n 女各持严格偏好序,随机配对几乎必现「阻断对」而瓦解;Gale-Shapley 1962 求婚算法:未配对方按名单轮流求婚,最多 n² 次(n=8 ≤ 64 次)必终止、必稳定,谁提议谁占优——男提则男优女劣。NRMP 住院医匹配(年约 4 万人)、学校分配与肾脏交换链皆用它;Roth 与 Shapley 获 2012 诺贝尔奖。
topics.descEn: n men and n women each hold a strict, complete ranking of the other side; a random pairing almost surely contains blocking pairs and collapses. The 1962 Gale-Shapley algorithm: unmatched proposers ask down their lists, at most n² proposals (64 for n=8), always terminates, always stable - and the proposer wins: men-proposing is men-optimal, women-pessimal. Used by the NRMP residency match (~40,000/yr), school choice and kidney-exchange chains; Roth & Shapley, Nobel Memorial Prize 2012.

topics.descZh: 哈夫曼每符号至少付 1 整 bit:p=0.9/0.1 的信源熵仅 0.469 bit,最优哈夫曼冗余仍达 113%。算术编码把整条消息压进 [0,1) 的一个子区间,按概率嵌套缩窄、逐符号精确记 −log₂p,逼近香农熵极限——6 符号消息由 6 bit 压至 5.51 bit,CABAC 与 zstd 的 ANS 皆源于此。
topics.descEn: Huffman pays at least 1 whole bit per symbol: a p=0.9/0.1 source carries just 0.469 bit of entropy, so even optimal Huffman runs 113% redundancy. Arithmetic coding squeezes a whole message into one subinterval of [0,1), nesting it by probability and booking −log₂p exactly per symbol to approach Shannon's entropy limit — 6 symbols compressed from 6 to 5.51 bit, the engine behind CABAC and zstd's ANS.

topics.descZh: 单棵深决策树换 10% 训练样本就大变——偏差小、方差大。Breiman(2001)的随机森林:bootstrap 有放回抽 B 份(每份约 63.2% 唯一样本、36.8% 袋外 OOB)各训一棵,每次分裂只看 mtry≈√p 个随机特征让树间去相关,B 棵投票/平均;方差由 Var=ρσ²+(1−ρ)σ²/B 给出,OOB 误差≈交叉验证,并可对照 Boosting 降偏差。
topics.descEn: One deep decision tree flips its whole shape when just 10% of training samples change - low bias, huge variance. Breiman's 2001 random forest: bootstrap B same-size samples (~63.2% unique per bag, 36.8% out-of-bag), one tree each; each split sees only mtry~sqrt(p) random features so trees decorrelate; B trees vote or average. Var = ρσ² + (1−ρ)σ²/B; the OOB error tracks cross-validation; contrast with boosting cutting bias.

topics.descZh: 普通二叉搜索树顺序插入 1..7 就退化成 7 层链表,查找从 O(log n) 崩到 O(n);1962 年 Adelson-Velsky 与 Landis 发明第一棵自平衡 BST:每个节点记平衡因子 bf=左高−右高并强约束 ∈{−1,0,1},祖先一旦 ±2 就地旋转——LL 右单旋、RR 左单旋、LR/RL 双旋,插入至多 2 旋、删除至多 O(log n) 旋,高度恒 ≤1.44·log₂(n+2)−0.328:n=10⁶ 至多 28~29 层,查找稳定 O(log n)。
topics.descEn: Insert 1..7 in order into a plain BST and it degrades into a 7-level chain — search collapses from O(log n) to O(n). In 1962 Adelson-Velsky and Landis built the first self-balancing BST: each node stores bf = height(left) − height(right), clamped to {−1, 0, +1}; the moment an insert or delete pushes an ancestor to ±2, rotations fire — LL right spin, RR left spin, LR/RL double — at most 2 per insert, O(log n) per delete. Height stays ≤ 1.44·log₂(n+2) − 0.328: a million keys fit in 28–29 levels with rock-solid O(log n) search.

topics.titleZh: 希尔伯特曲线与空间填充
topics.descZh: 一条一维的线,怎么塞满一块二维的地?希尔伯特 1891 年给出递归:一阶 ∏ 形折线穿过 4 个格子,每阶缩小一半复制四份、旋转镜像后缝合,n 阶走遍 4ⁿ 格、画 4ⁿ−1 段——8 阶即 65 536 格、65 535 段,且相邻编号的格子永远共边。总长 (4ⁿ−1)/2ⁿ = 2ⁿ−2⁻ⁿ 倍边长趋于无穷而面积不变,豪斯多夫维数 = 2。实测:读取对齐 8×8 图块,行扫描切成 8 段、跨度 458 格,希尔伯特恒为 1 段、跨度恰 64 格——正是 GeoHash 与 Hilbert R-tree 的查询优势。
topics.descEn: How does a 1-D line fill 2-D land? Hilbert's 1891 recursion: a ∏-shaped stroke through 4 cells, shrunk and copied four ways each order with rotations and a mirror; order n visits 4ⁿ cells in 4ⁿ−1 segments — order 8 draws 65,535 segments over 65,536 cells, consecutive numbers always sharing an edge. Length (4ⁿ−1)/2ⁿ = 2ⁿ−2⁻ⁿ side-lengths diverges while area stays fixed: Hausdorff dimension 2. Measured live: an aligned 8×8 tile shatters into 8 row-scan runs spanning 458 cells yet stays ONE Hilbert run of exactly 64 cells — the edge behind GeoHash and Hilbert R-trees.

topics.descZh: 给平面撒 n 个站点,每个点只问一句「离谁最近」,答案就把平面切成 n 个凸胞:胞边界必在两站中垂线上,顶点是三站公共外心,外接圆内空无一站(空圆性质);把共享胞边的站点两两相连,得到对偶的 Delaunay 三角剖分,n 点边数 ≤ 3n−6;拖动任一站点,两侧胞实时重算。Lloyd 松弛把每站挪到自己胞的质心,迭代 10-20 次后质心偏差 <0.01,站点近乎均匀——免费的蓝噪声;基站服务区、气象站插值、蜂窝结构、机器人路径全是它。
topics.descEn: Scatter n sites, ask every point who is closest, and the plane splits into n convex cells: edges lie on perpendicular bisectors, vertices are circumcenters where three sites tie with an empty circle. Linking sites that share a cell edge gives the dual Delaunay triangulation, m ≤ 3n−6. Drag a site and both cells re-clip live. Lloyd relaxation moves each site to its centroid: after 10-20 iterations the offset drops below 0.01 — blue noise for free. Tower coverage, weather interpolation, honeycomb, robot planning.

topics.descZh: 相邻节点不许同色,最少色数记 χ。任何平面地图 4 色必够——四色定理(Appel-Haken 1976:计算机枚举 1936 个不可约构形、约 1200 小时机时);证明自带算法:平面图必有度 ≤5 的顶点,递归拆掉再回填,冲突就做 Kempe 链换色,任何平面图 5 色手工可证。贪心着色单遍 O(m):最大度优先通常 4-5 色收敛,顺序差则可能烧到 6 色;48 节点平面地图实时演示冲突闪红、Kempe 链整体换色、χ 读数与各色计数。排课冲突、寄存器分配、频率指配都是它;判定 χ≤3 是 NP 完全。
topics.descEn: Neighbors must differ; the minimum count is χ. Every planar map needs ≤4 colors — the Four-Color Theorem (Appel-Haken 1976: 1,936 reducible configurations, ~1,200 machine hours) — and the proof is an algorithm: planar graphs always have a degree ≤5 vertex, peel and refill, fixing clashes with Kempe chain swaps; 5 colors always work by hand. Greedy is one O(m) pass: max-degree-first lands on 4-5 colors, a bad order burns 6. A live 48-node planar map flashes conflicts, flips Kempe chains, and tracks χ. Timetabling, register allocation, frequency assignment; χ≤3 is NP-complete.

topics.descZh: 两人同时改同一份文档,不靠服务器仲裁行不行?CRDT 让合并本身满足交换律、结合律、幂等:每个字符出生带唯一 ID(站点号+计数/位点路径),插入只记「在两个邻居之间」,消息乱序、迟到、重放三遍,所有站点仍收敛到同一序列;删除不抹字符、只立墓碑,并发删除天然幂等;离线编辑任意久,上线自动合并。两台设备同时打字、延迟线 0-3000 ms 可调、随时断网,看两边文档逐字符收敛一致;Google Docs 走 OT(服务器重排),Figma/Yjs/Automerge 走 CRDT。
topics.descEn: Two people edit one document with no arbiter server? CRDTs make merging commutative, associative, idempotent: every character is born with a unique ID (site + counter / position path), an insert just records 'between these two neighbors' — out-of-order, late, or replayed messages still converge every replica; deletes plant tombstones, so concurrent deletes are idempotent; offline forever, merge on reconnect. Two devices type at once over an adjustable 0-3000 ms delay line with a cut-offline toggle. Google Docs uses OT; Figma/Yjs/Automerge use CRDTs.

topics.descZh: 前向过程把图泡进高斯噪声:x_t=√ᾱ_t·x₀+√(1−ᾱ_t)·ε,cosine 调度下 T=1000 步后 ᾱ→0、SNR 崩到约 −27 dB,只剩雪花;训练只学一件事:网络 ε_θ(x_t,t) 预测混进来的噪声是哪一份,损失就是 MSE。采样从纯噪声出发,每步扣掉预测的噪声、再按方差表 σ_t 加回随机性,反向链走 1000 步(蒸馏可压到 20 步)得到一张全新图;560 点云演示三个盆地,不同种子落进不同形状。Stable Diffusion/Midjourney 的「思考」就是这条链;换数据域即得视频、分子构象、蛋白质设计。
topics.descEn: The forward process soaks an image in Gaussian noise: x_t=√ᾱ_t·x₀+√(1−ᾱ_t)·ε; under the cosine schedule ᾱ→0 after T=1000 steps and SNR collapses to about −27 dB. Training learns one thing: a network ε_θ(x_t,t) predicts which noise was mixed in, with plain MSE loss. Sampling starts from pure noise, subtracts predicted noise, re-injects σ_t randomness, and walks 1,000 reverse steps (distillable to 20) into a new image; a 560-point cloud shows three seed-chosen basins. This chain is what SD/Midjourney 'think' with; swap the domain for video, molecules, proteins.

topics.titleZh: 蚁群算法与信息素正反馈
topics.descZh: 真实蚂蚁的双桥实验:初始 50:50 上桥,几分钟后 >85-90% 走短桥——靠的只是信息素正反馈+挥发;人工蚁群按 P_ij∝τ^α·η^β(η=1/距离)构造回路,走完按 1/L 沉积、按 ρ 挥发(α=1、β=2-5、蚂蚁数=城市数);TSP 50-100 城常落在最优 1-2% 内,但不保证全局最优——这是元启发式的位置。
topics.descEn: In the real double-bridge experiment ants start 50:50 and minutes later >85-90% take the short bridge — nothing but pheromone feedback plus evaporation. Artificial ants build tours with P_ij∝τ^α·η^β (η=1/distance), deposit 1/L per tour and evaporate at rate ρ (α=1, β=2-5, ants=cities); on 50-100-city TSP they land within 1-2% of optimal but prove nothing — that is what a metaheuristic is.

topics.descZh: 1080p 原始码流 ~1.5 Gbps,H.264 只要 4-8 Mbps——省的是时间冗余:16×16 宏块在参考帧里找最匹配块,运动矢量+残差(DCT+量化+熵编码)只编码「剩下的少量差异」;I 帧独立(~10×P 帧)、P 帧向前预测、B 帧双向再省 15-30%,GOP 30-250 帧;QP 滑块当场看块状伪影与码率的交换。
topics.descEn: Raw 1080p streams at ~1.5 Gbps; H.264 needs 4-8 Mbps — the savings is temporal redundancy: 16×16 macroblocks find their best match in a reference frame, and only the motion vectors plus the small residual (DCT, quantize, entropy-code) are written. I-frames stand alone (~10× a P-frame), P-frames predict forward, B-frames interpolate for another 15-30%, in GOPs of 30-250. Slide the QP and watch blockiness trade against bitrate live.

topics.descZh: 编码器把文本图像映射成 384-1536 维向量,语义相近变成距离相近——归一化后点积即相似度;暴力检索十亿向量要 7680 亿次乘加,ANN 三板斧:IVF 先聚类、查询只扫邻近簇(10× 加速、召回 0.95),HNSW 分层图长边粗跳、短边细找(约 log N),PQ 乘积量化把 768 维 3 KB 压到 64 B;召回、速度、内存是个三角。
topics.descEn: Encoders map text and images into 384-1536-dim vectors where similar meaning sits close - after normalization the dot product is the similarity; brute force over a billion vectors costs 768 billion multiply-adds, so ANN plays three cards: IVF clusters and scans only nearby cells (10x speedup, recall 0.95), HNSW layers a graph - long edges gallop, short edges search (~log N) - and PQ compresses 768-dim 3 KB vectors to 64 B; recall, speed and memory form a triangle.

topics.descZh: 《雷神之锤》三行算 1/√x:把 float 位型当整数 i=0x5f3759df−(i>>1)——指数域除 2 恰是对数域开方,魔法常数补上基准 127 的账,初值差 3.4%;再一行牛顿迭代 y←y(1.5−0.5xy²),两次后误差 0.047%;当年省下 4-8 倍周期,如今 rsqrtss 一周期完成,但「位型当整数做对数近似」的思想还在快速 log 与半精度训练里。
topics.descEn: Quake III computed 1/√x in three lines: reinterpret the float bits as an integer, i=0x5f3759df−(i>>1) - halving the exponent field is a square root in log space, and the magic constant rebalances the 127 bias to land within 3.4%; one Newton step y←y(1.5−0.5xy²) sharpens twice more to 0.047%; it bought 4-8x fewer cycles then, hardware rsqrtss does it in one now, but bits-as-integers log-domain linearization still lives in fast logs and half-precision training.

topics.descZh: 单线程厨房只有一摞调用栈:定时器交给 Web API,事件循环一次取一个宏任务(setTimeout 实际钳到 ≥4 ms),随后把微任务队列整条清空(Promise.then),渲染夹在两批任务之间;经典顺序题 sync→promise→timeout 现场跑;微任务风暴让渲染永久饥饿、页面卡死——60 fps 的帧预算只有 16.7 ms。
topics.descEn: A single-threaded kitchen with one stack of plates: timers go to the Web APIs, the loop takes one macrotask per turn (setTimeout clamps to ≥4 ms), then drains the entire microtask queue (Promise.then) before rendering between batches. Run the classic ordering puzzle live — sync, promise, timeout — then start a microtask storm and watch rendering starve: a 60 fps frame budget is 16.7 ms.

topics.titleZh: 乱序执行与寄存器重命名
topics.descZh: 流水线最怕等:RAW 真依赖躲不掉,但 WAR/WAW 只是 16/32 个架构寄存器名字不够用的假依赖——Tomasulo(1967)用保留站+重命名表把每个结果映射到 180-300 个物理寄存器,操作数一到就乱序发射;ROB 让它们按程序顺序提交,异常也精确;IPC 从 0.9 抬到 2-4,代价是 Spectre:瞬态计算把秘密留在缓存里。
topics.descEn: Pipelines hate waiting. RAW dependencies are real, but WAR/WAW are fake — artifacts of 16/32 architectural names. Tomasulo (1967) added reservation stations and renaming that map each result onto 180-300 physical registers; instructions fire out of order the moment operands land. The ROB retires them in program order with precise exceptions. IPC climbs from 0.9 to 2-4; the bill is Spectre — transient computation leaves secrets in cache.

topics.descZh: 随机森林并行降方差,Boosting 串行降偏差:AdaBoost 给错分样本加权,α_t=½ln((1−ε_t)/ε_t) 按错误率定话语权;梯度提升直接拟合残差,学习率 ν 0.05-0.1 + 浅树 3-8 层慢慢逼近——XGBoost 加二阶泰勒与正则;表格数据上 GBDT 至今常胜神经网络,还自带特征重要性。
topics.descEn: Random forests cut variance in parallel; boosting cuts bias in series. AdaBoost up-weights mistakes, with learner say α_t=½ln((1−ε_t)/ε_t); gradient boosting fits residuals outright, nudging with learning rate ν 0.05-0.1 and shallow trees of depth 3-8 — XGBoost adds second-order Taylor terms and regularization. On tabular data GBDTs still routinely beat neural nets, with feature importance for free.

topics.titleZh: Shamir 秘密共享与门限重构
topics.descZh: 密钥交给一个人是单点故障,抄 n 份是 n 倍攻击面:Shamir(1979)把秘密 S 藏进 t−1 次多项式的常数项,每人拿一个点;t 个点拉格朗日插值唯一复原 f(0),t−1 个点却对秘密零信息——所有可能性等概率,连计算假设都不需要;还有同态加法与可验分发;核按钮、HSM 主钥、SLIP-39 都用它。
topics.descEn: One keyholder is a single point of failure; n copies are n attack surfaces. Shamir (1979) hides the secret S as the constant term of a degree t−1 polynomial and hands out one point each. Any t points restore f(0) by Lagrange interpolation; t−1 points leak zero information — every secret equally likely, no computational assumptions. Homomorphic addition and verifiable dealing come free; nuclear triggers, HSM roots and SLIP-39 rely on it.

topics.descZh: 每轮四拍「选择→扩展→模拟→回传」,按 UCT=Q/N+C·√(ln N父/N_i) 选枝,C≈1-1.7 调探索-利用;19×19 围棋每步 ~250 种着法无法穷举,MCTS 不打分只试下,好分支自然变粗,数万次模拟即可在 9×9 棋盘接近业余水平。
topics.descEn: Each round runs four beats - select (UCT=Q/N+C·√(ln N_parent/N_i) with C≈1-1.7), expand, simulate randomly, back up. Go has ~250 legal moves per turn on 19×19, far beyond enumeration; MCTS never scores positions, the tree grows thick where wins are, and tens of thousands of playouts reach amateur strength on 9×9.

topics.descZh: TLS 1.3 用 1-RTT 谈成机密性、完整性、认证:ClientHello 带 X25519 临时公钥,证书链三级逐级验签,ECDHE 各算出同一会话密钥,私钥将来泄露也解不开历史(前向保密),Finished 用 HMAC 盖指纹。
topics.descEn: TLS 1.3 settles confidentiality, integrity and authentication in one round trip: ClientHello carries an X25519 ephemeral key share, the chain root CA←intermediate←site is verified level by level, ECDHE lets both sides compute the same session keys separately - a future private-key leak cannot decrypt past traffic (forward secrecy) - and Finished HMACs the whole transcript. TLS 1.2's RSA transport is retired.

topics.descZh: 低优先级 L 持锁,高优先级 H 等锁被挡,不需要锁的中优先级 M 反复抢占 L——H 被 M 间接压制。1997 年火星探路者号因此反复复位;默认剧本里 H 等锁 4.2 s、被插队 5 次,开启优先级继承后缩到 2.2 s、0 次;另一解法是优先级天花板。
topics.descEn: Low-priority L holds a mutex, high-priority H stalls on it, and lock-free medium-priority M keeps preempting L - so M indirectly throttles H. Mars Pathfinder (1997) kept resetting over exactly this; in the default script H waits 4.2 s across 5 preemptions, and priority inheritance cuts that to 2.2 s and 0 - the alternative fix is the ceiling protocol.

topics.descZh: B+ 树每写一条原地改页,随机 IO 不断;LSM 把写追加进 WAL 与 64-256 MB memtable,冻结成 SSTable 顺序落盘;leveled 压实每层 10× 上层、写放大 10-30×,布隆 ~9.6 bit/key 换 1% 误报。
topics.descEn: A B+ tree rewrites pages in place with random IO everywhere; an LSM tree appends to a WAL, accumulates in a 64-256 MB memtable and flushes immutable SSTables sequentially. Leveled compaction gives each level 10x the capacity of the one above at 10-30x write amplification, and a bloom filter spends ~9.6 bits/key for a 1% false-positive rate.

topics.titleZh: 麦克风阵列与波束形成
topics.descZh: 同一波前到达各麦克风差 τ=d·cosθ/c(d=2 cm 最大 58 μs);延迟对齐再相加,N 只麦白赚 10·log₁₀N dB;−3 dB 主瓣宽 ≈0.89λ/L,7 麦 12 cm 孔径在 4 kHz 约 36°;d>λ/2 出栅瓣。
topics.descEn: A wavefront reaches each microphone τ = d·cosθ/c apart (up to 58 μs at d=2 cm). Delay-align and sum: N mics buy 10·log₁₀N dB for free (4 mics → 6 dB). The −3 dB beamwidth is ≈0.89λ/L — 7 mics over a 12 cm aperture give ~36° at 4 kHz — and d>λ/2 invites grating lobes.

topics.descZh: 长期财富由几何平均决定:涨 50% 再跌 50% 只剩 0.75。凯利给出最优押注 f*=(bp−q)/b——p=0.6、b=1 时押 20%、约 2%/局;押过 ~2f*(≈0.39)增长转负,赢面再好也必输;半凯利只牺牲 1/4 增长率,方差砍半以上。
topics.descEn: Long-run wealth follows the geometric mean: up 50%, down 50%, and 0.75 remains. Kelly's optimal fraction is f*=(bp−q)/b — at p=0.6, b=1, bet 20% for ~2% per round; past ~2f* (≈0.39) growth turns negative no matter the edge, while half-Kelly sacrifices only a quarter of the growth and more than halves the variance.

topics.descZh: 1943 年统计研究组看返航机弹孔图:机翼/机身密、发动机/座舱稀,军方想哪弹多补哪;沃耳德反转:返航机是筛选样本,要害中弹的没回来,P(部位|返航)≠P(部位|被击中),稀疏区才是要害。演示四区弹幕坠毁判定、返航 vs 全样本热图与两种装甲配对对照;基金剔除清算者,年收益虚高 0.5-1.5pp。
topics.descEn: In 1943 the Statistical Research Group studied returning bombers' hole maps: wings and fuselage riddled, engines and cockpit clean - armor the dense spots, said the Army. Wald reversed it: returnees are a filtered sample, the fatally hit never came back; P(zone|returned) ≠ P(zone|hit), the sparse spots are the vital areas. Watch four-zone flak with kill rolls, returned vs full-sample heat maps, and paired intuition-vs-Wald armor tests; funds that liquidated are dropped, inflating survivor returns 0.5-1.5pp/yr.

topics.descZh: 模型每步给整张词表打分,softmax p=exp(z/T)/Σexp(z/T) 归一:T<1 变尖、T>1 摊平、T→0=argmax 死循环;top-p 取累计 ≥0.9 的最小集切长尾;采样=u~U(0,1) 落在累积分布;惊讶度=−log₂p,困惑度 2^H≈8.7;含温度重排演示。
topics.descEn: Each step the model scores the whole vocabulary; softmax p=exp(z/T)/Σexp(z/T) normalizes: T<1 sharpens, T>1 flattens, T→0=argmax loops; top-p keeps the smallest set with cumulative ≥0.9 and cuts the tail; sampling = where u~U(0,1) lands on the CDF; surprise=−log₂p, perplexity 2^H≈8.7; includes temperature reshaping and penalty-break demos.

topics.descZh: 码点 0-0x10FFFF 切 1-4 字节:0xxxxxxx=ASCII,110/1110/11110 自报长度,续字节 10 开头→≤3 字节重同步;中 U+4E2D=E4 B8 AD,😀=F0 9F 98 80;非法 → U+FFFD;「Hello你好😀!」16B vs UTF-16 20B。
topics.descEn: Code points 0-0x10FFFF split into 1-4 bytes: 0xxxxxxx=ASCII, the 110/1110/11110 prefixes self-report length, continuation bytes start with 10 → re-sync within ≤3 bytes after a cut; 中 U+4E2D=E4 B8 AD, 😀=F0 9F 98 80; invalid → U+FFFD; Hello你好😀! is 16B vs UTF-16 20B.

topics.descZh: KMP 线性匹配:先花 O(m) 给模式串自算失配函数 π——前缀的最长相等真前后缀(ABABACA→[0,0,1,2,3,0,1]);匹配时主串指针永不回头,失配处 j 跳到 π[j−1]:已匹配段的后缀=前缀,跳过的起点必然失配。总比较 ≤2n,π 还白送最小周期 p=m−π[m−1]。本质是预处理把回头重读换成一查即得的跳转表。
topics.descEn: KMP (1977) matches strings in linear time: pay O(m) once for the failure function π — the longest proper border of each prefix (ABABACA → [0,0,1,2,3,0,1]); then the text pointer never backs up — on mismatch j falls to π[j−1], because the matched segment's suffix equals the pattern's prefix, so every skipped start must fail. Total comparisons ≤ 2n, and π hands you the smallest period p = m − π[m−1] free. In essence: preprocessing turns rereading into a jump table.

topics.descZh: 普通 RNN 梯度沿时间连乘,0.9^100≈3×10⁻⁵,长期依赖学不到(Bengio 1994);LSTM(1997)给细胞状态开加法传送带 C_t=f⊙C+i⊙g̃,梯度直通不经连乘。三道 σ 阀门:遗忘门 f 定保留(σ(5)=0.993,百步剩 51%)、输入门 i 管写、输出门 o 管读 h=o⊙tanh C;记 40 步实测 RNN 读出 0.01、LSTM 0.6,GRU 3 组权重 −25%。本质是门控把记/忘/说变成可学的流量阀。
topics.descEn: Plain RNNs multiply gradients across time: 0.9^100 ≈ 3×10⁻⁵, so long-term dependencies vanish (Bengio 1994). LSTM (1997) routes memory on an additive conveyor belt C_t = f⊙C_{t−1} + i⊙g̃_t, and gradients ride it untouched. Three σ valves: forget gate f sets retention (σ(5)=0.993 keeps 51% after 100 steps), input gate i meters writes, output gate o meters reads, h = o⊙tanh(C). On a 40-step memory task the RNN readout is 0.01 versus LSTM 0.6; GRU merges 4 weight groups into 3, −25%. In essence: gates turn remember/forget/say into learnable flow valves.

topics.descZh: 锁方案读写互斥,报表 30 秒、更新排队 30 秒;MVCC 把更新改成版本链追加(xmin 创建者、xmax 删除标记、prev 指旧版),读=按快照从链头挑第一个可见版本——写不阻塞读。可见⟺xmin 已提交且 ≤ 快照、未被快照前删除;写-写冲突先提交者赢;SI 防脏读/不可重复读,防不住写偏斜(双医生双双离岗),SSI 拆 rw-反依赖环;长事务钉旧版→表膨胀,VACUUM 回收。本质是用时间切片换掉读写排队。
topics.descEn: Locking makes readers and writers exclude each other: a 30-second report queues every update for 30 seconds. MVCC turns updates into version-chain appends (xmin creator, xmax delete marker, prev pointer) and reads into picking the first visible version from the chain head per snapshot — writers never block readers. Visible ⟺ xmin committed ≤ snapshot and not deleted before it; write-write conflicts go first-committer-wins; SI stops dirty and non-repeatable reads but not write skew (two doctors both leave), which SSI breaks via rw-antidependency cycles; long transactions pin old versions into bloat, reclaimed by VACUUM. In essence: time slices replace read-write queues.

topics.descZh: 不知道点属于谁、也不知道簇长什么样:EM 先按当前参数算每个点的责任 γ(zₙₖ)(E 步),再用加权数据闭式重估 π/μ/Σ(M 步),对数似然每轮单调爬升直到不动点;KMeans 是它的等方差硬分配特例,坏初始化会锁进局部最优,随机重启+BIC 选 K。
topics.descEn: You don't know who owns which point or what the clusters look like. EM first computes each point's responsibility γ(zₙₖ) under current parameters (E-step), then re-estimates π, μ, Σ in closed form from the weighted data (M-step); log-likelihood climbs monotonically to a fixed point. KMeans is its equal-variance hard-assignment special case; bad init locks in local optima - restart randomly and pick K by BIC.

topics.descZh: 香农 1948 年写下通信的宪法:C=B·log₂(1+S/N)——码率低于 C 就存在误码任意小的编码,高于 C 谁也不行;星座把比特摆进振幅相位,QAM 越密越靠近容量但需要更高信噪比;Turbo/LDPC 已做到距极限 0.04-0.5 dB,电话线 38 kbps 到 5G 都在还这笔账。
topics.descEn: In 1948 Shannon wrote the constitution of communication: C=B·log₂(1+S/N). Below C, codes exist with arbitrarily few errors; above C, nothing works. Constellations lay bits into amplitude and phase - denser QAM edges toward capacity but demands more SNR. Turbo and LDPC codes sit 0.04-0.5 dB from the limit; everyone from 38 kbps modems to 5G pays this bill.

topics.descZh: kitten→sitting 要几步?Wagner-Fischer 把答案填进 (m+1)×(n+1) 矩阵:每格只问三个邻居(上=删、左=插、斜=换/匹配),右下角就是编辑距离 3,回溯路径就是最优对齐;同一套数学换个打分制就是基因比对的 Needleman-Wunsch。
topics.descEn: How many steps from kitten to sitting? Wagner-Fischer fills an (m+1)×(n+1) matrix where each cell asks three neighbors - up = delete, left = insert, diagonal = match/substitute. The corner holds the distance, 3; tracing back gives the optimal alignment. Rescore the same math and it's Needleman-Wunsch for genes.

topics.titleEn: Convex Hull & Monotone Chain: a Rope Pulled Taut
topics.descZh: 凸包是包含全部点的最小凸多边形——把钉子钉在平面上绷一根橡皮筋,绷直后的形状就是它。Andrew 单调链算法把「绕圈」变成「扫两遍」:先按 x 排序(O(n log n),也是全部复杂度的所在),再从左到右扫一遍建下链、从右到左建上链——每加入一个点,用叉积 (B−A)×(C−B) 检验栈顶的转向:右转(叉积 ≤0)就弹栈,直到左转才压入。上下两链首尾相接就是凸包,总复杂度 O(n log n),而且已证明这是下界——凸包不可能快过排序。共线点保不留、重复点怎么算,这些脏细节在叉积的 ≤ 与 < 之间一字千金。
topics.descEn: The convex hull is the smallest convex polygon containing every point - nail the dots to a board, stretch a rubber band around them, and the taut band is the hull. The Andrew monotone chain turns

topics.titleEn: Merkle Tree: One Root Hash Summarizes Ten Thousand Records
topics.descZh: 把一万笔交易缩成 32 字节还能随时验证,靠一棵自底向上的哈希树:N 个数据块各自哈希作叶子,相邻两个哈希拼接再哈希成父节点,层层向上直到只剩一个根哈希——根变了,树里任何一处都变了。三大性质:改一片叶子,雪崩效应让它到根路径上 log₂N 个节点全部变样,比对根即可发现;证明某条数据在树里,只需路径上的兄弟哈希——一万笔交易约 14 个、~0.5 KB,验证者自己重算一遍看根是否一致;两台机器各自算根,根不同则数据必不同,根相同则几乎必然相同。比特币轻节点因此只存 80 字节区块头而不下载区块体;Git 提交、BT 分片、IPFS 寻址、证书透明日志与 NoSQL 反熵对账,全是同一招:先比根,再沿分叉路径下探。
topics.descEn: Compress ten thousand transactions into 32 bytes and still verify any of them on demand - that is a bottom-up hash tree: N data blocks are each hashed into leaves, adjacent pairs concatenate and hash into parents, level by level until one 32-byte root remains - change the root and something in the tree changed. Three properties: tamper one leaf and avalanche flips every one of the log2N nodes on its path to the root, so comparing roots exposes it; proving a record belongs costs only the sibling hashes along that path - about 14 hashes, ~0.5 KB for 10,000 transactions - and the verifier recomputes to check the root; two machines that compute equal roots hold almost certainly equal data. Bitcoin light nodes store just the 80-byte block header instead of block bodies; Git commits, BT pieces, IPFS addressing, Certificate Transparency logs and NoSQL anti-entropy all run the same play: compare roots first, then walk the fork.

topics.descZh: 机械陀螺仪用三个环给飞行器定向:外环偏航、中环俯仰、内环滚转,三个转轴互相垂直,各管一个自由度。但当俯仰转到 90°,内环轴被翻到垂直方向,与外环轴共面重合——三个环瞬间只剩两个独立运动方向,第三自由度当场「消失」,这就是万向锁。数学根源写在欧拉角的速率方程里:p = φ̇ − ψ̇·sinθ,q = θ̇cosφ + ψ̇·sinφ·cosθ,r = −θ̇sinφ + ψ̇·cosφ·cosθ;θ = 90° 时 cosθ = 0,偏航与滚转只能以 φ̇ ∓ ψ̇ 的组合出现,雅可比矩阵降秩。阿波罗时代为此给中环设了 ±70° 禁区。四元数 q = w + xi + yj + zk(1843 年 Hamilton 在布鲁姆桥刻下 i² = j² = k² = ijk = −1)用四个数表示姿态,单位四元数落在 3-球面 S³ 上:乘法一次复合两个旋转、无奇点;插值走 SLERP 大圆——恒角速、最短路径,而欧拉插值会翻滚绕远、矩阵插值会丢失正交性。代价只是 4 个数对 3 个数。拖「俯仰角」滑杆推向 95°,看三环缓缓对齐、自由度 3→2 的瞬间;按「SLERP 对照」比较绿色大圆与红色畸变路径。
topics.descEn: A mechanical gyroscope aims a spacecraft with three rings: outer yaw, middle pitch, inner roll, three hinges on mutually perpendicular axes, one degree of freedom each. But drive the pitch to 90 degrees and the inner axis swings up to vertical, coplanar with the outer axis - three rings are left with only two independent motions, and the third degree of freedom vanishes on the spot: gimbal lock. The root sits in the Euler rate equations: p = phi_dot - psi_dot sin(theta), q = theta_dot cos(phi) + psi_dot sin(phi) cos(theta), r = -theta_dot sin(phi) + psi_dot cos(phi) cos(theta). At theta = 90, cos = 0, yaw and roll enter only through phi_dot plus or minus psi_dot, and the Jacobian drops rank. Apollo era therefore fenced the middle gimbal at 70 degrees, and Collins joked about a fourth gimbal for Christmas. Quaternions - w + xi + yj + zk, with Hamilton carving i2 = j2 = k2 = ijk = -1 on Broom Bridge in 1843 - represent attitude with four numbers. Unit quaternions live on the 3-sphere S3: one multiplication composes two rotations, with no singularity anywhere, and SLERP interpolates along great circles at constant angular speed over the shortest path, while Euler interpolation tumbles and matrix interpolation loses orthogonality. The price is four numbers instead of three and a per-frame renormalization. Drag the pitch slider to 95 degrees to watch the rings align and the freedom drop from 3 to 2; press the SLERP preset to compare the green great circle with the red distorted path.

topics.titleEn: Lattice Crypto: Hard Math for the Quantum Age
topics.descZh: 格是最低调的数学:基向量的整数组合 i·b₁+j·b₂ 铺成无限点阵;同一张格有无穷组基,好基(近正交)与坏基(瘦长)的计算鸿沟,是后量子密码的地基。用好基找最近格点(CVP)是送分题:除以基再取整,一步落进邻域;用坏基,微小舍入被瘦长向量放大成跨格跳跃——一跳撞错门,错出近 5 格;二维还能爬回,几百维就回不去。1996 年 Ajtai 证明格问题最坏情形 NP-难,1982 年的 LLL 只能在约 50 维里挣扎:高维几何成了护城河。Regev 2005 的 LWE 更进一步:公开方程组 s·aᵢ+eᵢ mod q,每条掺一点噪声,方程再多也剥不出 s,量子也无速通。2024 年 8 月 NIST 把 Kyber 定为 ML-KEM(FIPS 203):公钥像坏基描述,私钥是能消噪的好基陷阱门;Kyber-768 公钥 1184 字节、密文 1088 字节,毫秒级,解密靠舍入。Shor 拆得动 RSA/ECC,对 SVP/CVP 无从下手——「先存后解」的今天,格密码就是量子时代的保险柜。点阵纹丝不动:按「CVP 取整搜索」看小球撞错门,拖「基病态」加重剪切、拖「噪声 σ」看错误率从 10⁻¹⁵ 涨到两位数百分比。
topics.descEn: A lattice is the quietest structure in mathematics: take two basis vectors and all their integer combinations i*b1 + j*b2 tile an infinite point grid. The same lattice has infinitely many bases, and the gap in difficulty between a good basis (nearly orthogonal, short) and a bad basis (long, skinny, skewed) is the foundation of post-quantum cryptography. With a good basis, finding the nearest lattice point (CVP) is a gift: divide coordinates by the basis and round, landing next door. With a bad basis, tiny rounding errors are amplified by the skinny vectors into jumps across several cells - the search ball slams into the wrong neighbor, nearly five cells off; in two dimensions it can still crawl back, in a few hundred dimensions it never does. Ajtai proved in 1996 that lattice problems are NP-hard in the worst case, and the 1982 LLL algorithm still struggles beyond about 50 dimensions: high-dimensional geometry is the moat. LWE (Regev 2005) goes further: publish equations s*ai + ei mod q, each salted with a little noise - however many equations you gather, s stays hidden, and no quantum shortcut is known. In August 2024 NIST standardized Kyber as ML-KEM (FIPS 203): the public key works like a bad-basis description, the private key is a noise-canceling good-basis trapdoor; Kyber-768 uses a 1184-byte public key and 1088-byte ciphertexts with millisecond operations, and decryption simply rounds the noise away. The Shor algorithm breaks RSA/ECC by period finding but gets no grip on SVP/CVP - and in the era of harvest-now-decrypt-later, lattices are the safe of the quantum age. In the scene the point grid never moves: switch good and bad bases to watch the ball hit the wrong door, drag the shear slider to worsen the basis, and push the noise sigma to watch the decryption error rate climb from 10^-15 to double-digit percent.

topics.titleEn: Delaunay Triangulation: The Best Way to Join the Dots
topics.descZh: 把一堆散点连成三角形网格,连法多到天文数字,而坏的连法布满细长三角形:插值把邻域拉歪,有限元刚度矩阵病态,渲染表面撕裂。1934 年苏联数学家 Boris Delaunay 给出好网格的判据:每个三角形的外接圆内部不含任何其他点——空圆准则,它等价于在所有连法中最大化最小角,数值稳定性最好。怎么建?增量插入(Bowyer–Watson):新点落下,凡外接圆被它入侵的三角形当场塌陷,空腔边界与新点重连成星形,随机插入序下期望 O(n log n);四点共圆出现平局时,Lawson 翻转交换凸四边形对角线即可修复。它与 Voronoi 图互为对偶:相邻领地共边的两点连起来就是 Delaunay 边,三角形外心正是对偶顶点。按「增量插入全流程」看新点下落、空圆一闪、星形重连;按「边翻转修复」先故意把好对角线全换成坏的,红色细长三角形泛滥,再看翻转一次次把平均最小角顶回去;拖「点数」重建网格,把「点扰动」拉到 0 体会规则格点的共圆退化;「Voronoi 对偶」把对偶图抬到空中对照。地形 TIN、有限元前处理、自然邻域插值、地图渲染与三维重建,全是它的工地。
topics.descEn: Join a scatter of points into a triangle mesh and the ways to do it explode astronomically - and bad joins are full of slivers: interpolation stretches across crooked neighborhoods, finite-element stiffness matrices turn ill-conditioned, rendered surfaces tear. In 1934 the Soviet mathematician Boris Delaunay stated the criterion of a good mesh: the circumcircle of every triangle must contain no other point - the empty-circle rule - equivalent to maximizing the minimum angle over all possible joins, hence the best numerical behavior. How is it built? Incremental insertion (Bowyer-Watson): a new point lands, every triangle whose circumcircle it invades collapses at once, and the cavity boundary is reconnected to the point as a star; with a random insertion order the expected cost is O(n log n). When four points turn out cocircular, a Lawson flip swaps the diagonal of the convex quad to repair the tie. The structure is dual to the Voronoi diagram: connect the two points whose territories share a boundary and you have drawn a Delaunay edge; each triangle circumcenter is a Voronoi vertex. Press incremental insertion to watch points drop, invaded circles flash and stars reconnect; press flip repair to first replace every good diagonal with a bad one - slivers flood in red - then watch Lawson flips push the mean minimum angle back up. Drag the point-count slider to rebuild, set jitter to zero to see the cocircular degeneracy of regular grids, and lift the Voronoi dual into the air to compare. Terrain TINs, FEM preprocessing, natural-neighbor interpolation, map rendering and 3D reconstruction all work on this construction.

topics.titleZh: 辗转相除:两千三百年前的算法之王
topics.descZh: 「gcd(a,b)=gcd(b, a mod b)」——欧几里得《原本》卷七命题 1,约公元前 300 年,是至今仍在每个数学库深处运转的最古老算法:余数一定小于除数,大数当场缩小,几步到 0,最后一个非零余数就是 gcd。几何直观:在 a×b 的矩形里反复裁出最大正方形,裁到整除为止,最后一块正方形的边长就是 gcd——能整铺整个矩形的最大正方形。1844 年 Lamé 证明最坏情形是相邻斐波那契数:每步商都是 1,余数按黄金比例 φ≈1.618 缩,步数 ~log_φ(min(a,b)),55×34 恰好 8 步——这是历史上第一个真正的复杂度定理,两千多年无人超越,直到 1960 年代才出现只快一个常数因子的近似 gcd。贝祖等式 ax+by=gcd(a,b) 保证整数解总存在:扩展欧几里得把每步余式回代,顺手解出 x、y;当 gcd(e,φ(n))=1 时 x 就是模逆元——RSA 生成密钥正是这一步:选 e 与 φ(n) 互素,再用它解出 d=e⁻¹ mod φ(n),公钥加密、私钥解密,靠的全是这条两千三百年前的老算法;连分数展开 [1;2,2] 也是同一条余数链;lcm(a,b)=ab/gcd 与它成对出现。场景左侧 a×b 地砖被一层层裁起、余数条肉眼可见变窄,右侧坐标平面上整点 (x,y) 沿等值线一步步滑向 ax+by=g 的直线。拖「a」「b」自选输入,按「铺砖演示」看裁砖,按「扩展欧几里得」看回代滑动,按「最坏情形(斐波那契)」跳到 55×34 数步数。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a mod b) - Elements Book VII, proposition 1, around 300 BC - is the oldest algorithm still running deep inside every math library: the remainder is always smaller than the divisor, so the big number shrinks on the spot, a few steps reach zero, and the last nonzero remainder is the gcd. The geometric picture: cut the largest possible squares out of an a x b rectangle, again and again, until one divides evenly - the side of the last square is the gcd, the largest square that tiles the whole rectangle. In 1844 Lame proved the worst case is consecutive Fibonacci numbers: every quotient is 1, the remainder shrinks by the golden ratio phi = 1.618 each step, and the step count is ~log_phi(min(a, b)) - 55 x 34 takes exactly 8 steps. It was the first genuine complexity theorem in history, unbeaten for two millennia until approximate gcds appeared in the 1960s, faster only by a constant factor. Bezout's identity ax + by = gcd(a, b) guarantees integer solutions always exist: the extended Euclidean algorithm back-substitutes every remainder on the way down and hands you x and y for free. When gcd(e, phi(n)) = 1, x is the modular inverse - and RSA key generation is exactly this step: pick e coprime to phi(n), then solve d = e^-1 mod phi(n); the public key encrypts, the private key decrypts, all on a twenty-three-hundred-year-old workhorse. The continued fraction [1; 2, 2] is the same remainder chain, and lcm(a, b) = a*b/gcd comes paired with it. In the scene the a x b tile floor is cut up layer by layer, the remainder strip visibly narrowing, while on the coordinate plane to the right the integer point (x, y) glides along contour lines toward the line ax + by = g. Drag the a and b sliders to choose your own input, press tiling demo to watch the cutting, press extended Euclid to watch the back-substitution glide, and press worst case (Fibonacci) to jump to 55 x 34 and count the steps. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 线段树:区间提问的对数答案
topics.titleEn: The Segment Tree: Log-Time Answers for Range Questions
topics.descZh: 「数组区间 [l,r] 的和或最大值」逐个累加是 O(n),改一个元素又要重算;前缀和把查询压到 O(1),代价却是任何修改都要重写全表。线段树把两个都要:一棵完全二叉树,叶=单元素,每个内部节点存其区间的聚合值;任意查询区间从根递归,完全覆盖的直接取用,最终拆成不超过 2log₂n 个预置节点拼出答案,单点更新自底向上只改 log₂n 个祖先——查询与修改双双 O(log n)。区间整体加法用懒标记:递归停在第一个恰好覆盖的节点,把增量记进账本并挂一只「未拆封包裹」,之后查询或修改路过才拆包下推给两个孩子,区间修改由此也是 O(log n);空间只花 2-4n。家族各有死穴:前缀和查询 O(1) 但修改 O(n);树状数组 Fenwick 代码十行、内存减半,却只支持可逆运算,做不了区间最大值。RMQ、竞赛题、扫描线、LCA 全是它的工地。场景是一棵横躺的 3D 完全二叉树:前排叶子就是数组,柱高即值;按「查询动画」看金色节点依次点亮、飞进答案球;按「区间加+懒标记」看橙色包裹挂上树梢、查询路过时半路拆包;按「与前缀和对照」看绿色祖先链几步登顶、红色前缀表整排重写的赛跑。拖「数组规模」重建,拖「查询区间」挑一段自己拆。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Summing or maximizing an array range [l, r] by brute force costs O(n), and changing one element forces a recompute; prefix sums crush a query to O(1) but every update rewrites the whole table. The segment tree refuses to choose: a complete binary tree whose leaves are the array elements and whose every internal node stores the aggregate of its span. Any query range recurses from the root - nodes fully inside are taken wholesale - and the range ends up tiled by at most 2*log2(n) preset blocks; a point update climbs one ancestor chain touching only log2(n) nodes - so queries and updates are both O(log n). A range-wide add uses lazy propagation: recursion stops at the first node exactly covered, books the increment into that node's total and hangs an unwrapped parcel - the lazy tag - which is only unwrapped and pushed down to the two children when a later query or update passes through, so range modification is also O(log n), all for 2-4n of space. The family has its weak spots: prefix sums answer in O(1) but update in O(n); the Fenwick tree is ten lines of code with half the memory yet handles only invertible operations, so no range maximum. RMQ, contest problems, sweep lines and LCA all stand on it. The scene is a complete binary tree lying on its side: the front-row leaves are the array, column heights are the values.
