Press query animation to watch gold blocks light up one by one and fly into the answer orb; press range add + lazy to hang orange parcels in the treetop and see one unwrapped mid-route by a passing query; press the prefix-sum comparison to race a green ancestor chain against the red full-table rewrite. Drag the array-size slider to rebuild, drag the query-range sliders to pick your own segment. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: CPU 的 SIMD 单元把寄存器加宽到 128/256/512 bit,当成 4、8、16 个并排的 lane 用:一条 vaddps 指令同一拍就算完 8 对 float 的和;配合 FMA(乘加融合,一条指令做 a×b+c)与双发端口,AVX2 每核每拍 16 个 float FMA,3 GHz 下约 96 GFLOPS/核——峰值算术吞吐按 lane 数倍增:AVX2 整数吞吐 ×8、AVX-512 ×16。但账面峰值要真正兑现有四个前提:数据对齐到 32/64 字节、访问连续让硬件预取器吃得饱、元素之间独立没有链式依赖、分支要少——发散的分支会直接破坏向量化;数组长度不是 lane 整数倍时,余数元素用掩码(predication)收尾,被掩的 lane 清零,不浪费一拍。编译器自动向量化(-O3 就能把 AXPY 循环翻成 SIMD 指令)与手写 intrinsics 的差距常在 2-5 倍,而 GPU 不过是把同一思想推到上千 lane 的极端。图像处理、卷积、softmax 与激活函数、音视频编解码、数据库扫描,全是 SIMD 的工地。场景里同一数组只喂一条产线:标量模式一拍走一个立方体,SIMD 模式一拍点亮全部 lane;按「标量对照」把宽通路缩回单车道感受 8 倍落差,按「FMA 双发」看节奏与吞吐翻倍,按「尾部掩码收尾」看余数元素如何被清零收场。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A CPU's SIMD unit widens its registers to 128, 256 or 512 bits and treats them as 4, 8 or 16 side-by-side lanes: a single vaddps instruction finishes eight pairs of float additions in the same cycle. Combined with FMA (fused multiply-add, one instruction computing a*b+c) and dual-issue ports, AVX2 retires sixteen float FMAs per core per cycle - about 96 GFLOPS per core at 3 GHz. Peak arithmetic throughput simply scales with the lane count: x8 on AVX2 integers, x16 on AVX-512. But the paper number is paid out only under four conditions: the data must be aligned to 32/64 bytes, access must be contiguous so the hardware prefetcher keeps pace, elements must be independent with no chained dependencies, and branches must be rare - divergent branches kill vectorization outright. When the array length is not a multiple of the lane count, the leftover elements are finished under a mask (predication): masked lanes are zeroed and no cycle is wasted. Compiler autovectorization (-O3 alone can turn an AXPY loop into SIMD instructions) typically lands 2-5x short of hand-written intrinsics, and a GPU is just the same idea pushed to thousands of lanes. Image processing, convolution, softmax and activation functions, audio-video codecs and database scans all run on this machinery. In the scene one array feeds one production line: scalar mode advances one cube per beat, SIMD mode lights every lane at once. Press the scalar toggle to narrow the datapath back to a single lane and feel the 8x gap, press dual-issue FMA to double the cadence and the throughput, and press tail masking to watch the remainder elements get zeroed away. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: P 与 NP:验证容易,求解未必
topics.titleEn: P vs NP: Easy to Check, Hard to Solve
topics.descZh: 排序、最短路这类问题,计算机能在多项式时间内直接「求解」,归入 P 类;而填好的数独逐行、逐列、逐宫一扫便知没有重复,大合取式拿一组赋值逐项核对便知真假——这类「验证答案很容易」的问题归入 NP 类。显然 P⊆NP,真正的难题是反方向:验证容易,是否意味着求解也容易?这就是克雷研究所悬赏百万美元的 P vs NP。沟通两边的桥梁是归约:把问题 A 的实例多项式地翻译成问题 B 的实例,解出 B 就等于解出 A;Cook-Levin 定理证明布尔可满足性 SAT 是 NP 完全的(NP 中最难的代表),Karp 随后把 3SAT、团、顶点覆盖、哈密顿回路、图着色、背包、TSP 判定版等 21 个经典问题逐一归约连通——全体 NP 完全问题一荣俱荣、一损俱损:任何一个找到多项式算法,全体沦陷。密码学押注 P≠NP(更精确地说依赖单向函数):RSA 们的安全性正建立在「验证容易、求解很难」的不对称上。实用主义三招:近似算法(TSP 的 Christofides 有 1.5 倍保证)、参数化算法(按小参数 k 指数、按 n 多项式)、工业 SAT 求解器(最坏指数、常数极小,实解上万变量)。彩蛋:随机 3SAT 在「子句数/变量数」比值 α≈4.267 处可满足率从 1 骤降到 0——约束密度的相变,最难的实例恰好聚集在阈值附近。演示:数独棋盘看验证扫查瞬间完成、回溯搜索树节点暴涨;拖 n 滑块看 2ⁿ 穷举柱与 n² 验证柱的剪刀差;跑归约动画看 3SAT 变成团;调 α 按「采样 3SAT」亲手撞上相变。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Sorting and shortest paths can be solved directly in polynomial time - class P. A finished sudoku, by contrast, is verified by one sweep over its rows, columns and boxes; a big Boolean formula is checked by testing one assignment term by term - problems whose answers are cheap to verify form NP. Clearly P is contained in NP; the hard question is the reverse: does easy verification imply easy solving? That is the Clay Institute's million-dollar P vs NP problem. The bridge is reduction: translate an instance of problem A into an instance of problem B in polynomial time, and a solver for B solves A. The Cook-Levin theorem proves Boolean satisfiability (SAT) is NP-complete - among the hardest in NP - and Karp then chained 21 classic problems (3SAT, clique, vertex cover, Hamiltonian cycle, graph coloring, knapsack, decision-TSP...) onto it: all NP-complete problems stand or fall together - a polynomial algorithm for any one of them topples them all. Cryptography bets P is not NP (more precisely it relies on one-way functions): RSA and friends rest on the asymmetry of easy to verify, hard to solve. Practitioners have three workarounds: approximation algorithms (Christofides guarantees a tour within 1.5x optimal for TSP), parameterized algorithms (exponential in a small parameter k, polynomial in n), and industrial SAT solvers (worst-case exponential with a tiny constant - tens of thousands of variables solved in practice). Easter egg: random 3SAT undergoes a phase transition at clause-to-variable ratio alpha of about 4.267, where satisfiability plunges from 1 to 0 - the hardest instances cluster right at the threshold. In the demo: watch the sudoku sweep finish instantly while the backtracking tree's node count explodes; drag n to see the 2^n brute-force bars shear away from the flat n^2 verification bars; run the reduction animation turning 3SAT into a clique; and sample 3SAT instances at your chosen alpha to hit the phase transition yourself. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 缓冲区溢出与内存安全:越界的字节
topics.descZh: C 语言不检查数组边界:把 100 字节写进 64 字节的栈缓冲区,多出来的 36 字节会顺着栈向上「淹没」相邻数据。栈帧从低地址到高地址依次摆着:局部变量(含缓冲区)→ 保存的帧指针 → 返回地址;输入足够长时,返回地址就被攻击数据覆写——函数执行 ret 时,程序计数器被装上这个伪造值,控制流跳到攻击者指定的位置,这就是 1988 年莫里斯蠕虫利用的经典漏洞,数千台机器一夜沦陷。三十年防御进化:金丝雀 canary 在函数入口于返回地址前放一个哨兵值,返回前检查,被改即终止进程;ASLR 地址空间随机化让每次启动的栈/堆/共享库基址随机,写死的偏移失效;NX/DEP 把栈页标记为不可执行,注入的代码根本跑不起来;攻击者于是改用 ROP 面向返回编程,拼接程序里现成的代码片段(gadget)绕过 NX,防线又催生 CFI 控制流完整性;釜底抽薪是 Rust/Go/Java 这类内存安全语言的运行时边界检查——微软与谷歌统计自家产品约 70% 的严重漏洞源于内存安全问题,行业正在用 Rust 重写关键组件。工程教训:永远检查长度、用带边界的 API、开满编译器保护(-fstack-protector 等)。演示:拖「输入长度」滑块把数据块逐格灌进栈塔,亲眼看它越过 buf 边界、染红金丝雀与返回地址;按「函数返回」看四种结局——无防御时控制流被劫持、金丝雀报警当场终止、ASLR 让写死的跳转地址失效、NX 页拒绝执行;开「边界检查写入」对照安全版本,再按「重新调用」在 ASLR 下换一组随机基址。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: C never checks array bounds: write 100 bytes into a 64-byte stack buffer and the extra 36 bytes flood upward over the neighboring data. A stack frame lays out from low to high addresses as: local variables (including the buffer), then the saved frame pointer, then the return address; given enough input, the return address is overwritten with attacker data - when the function executes ret, the program counter is loaded with that forged value and control flow jumps wherever the attacker points: the classic bug the 1988 Morris worm exploited, toppling thousands of machines overnight. Thirty years of defense: the stack canary places a sentinel before the return address at function entry and checks it before returning, killing the process on tamper; ASLR randomizes stack/heap/library base addresses at every launch so hardcoded offsets miss; NX/DEP marks stack pages non-executable so injected code cannot run; attackers answered with ROP (return-oriented programming), chaining ready-made code gadgets already in the program to bypass NX, which in turn motivated CFI (control-flow integrity); the root cure is memory-safe languages - Rust/Go/Java with runtime bounds checks: Microsoft and Google report roughly 70% of severe security bugs are memory-safety issues, and the industry is rewriting critical components in Rust. Engineering lessons: always check lengths, use bounded APIs, and turn on compiler hardening (-fstack-protector and friends). In the demo: drag the input-length slider to pour data into the stack tower cell by cell and watch it cross the buffer edge, dyeing the canary and the return address red; press function return to see four endings - hijacked with no defenses, killed on the spot by the canary, hardcoded offsets defeated by ASLR, or the NX page refusing to execute; switch on bounds-checked writes to compare the safe version, and press re-call to draw a fresh random base under ASLR. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 量子隐形传态:态在这里消失,在那里出现
topics.titleEn: Quantum Teleportation: Destroyed Here, Reborn There
topics.descZh: 把一个未知量子态 |ψ⟩ = α|0⟩ + β|1⟩ 从 Alice 送到 Bob,有三个拦路虎:不可克隆定理(没法复制一份再发副本)、测量即坍缩(看一眼就把态毁了)、以及光速(没法「隔空搬运」)。1993 年 Bennett 等人给出的方案优雅得像变戏法:Alice 和 Bob 先共享一对纠缠 Bell 态;Alice 把手里的 ψ 比特与自己的纠缠比特一起做一次 Bell 基测量——四个等概率结果 Φ₊/Φ₋/Ψ₊/Ψ₋ 之一;这一测,ψ 在 Alice 侧被销毁,而 Bob 那半纠缠对瞬间坍缩成 ψ 的某个「泡利变体」(I、X、Z 或 XZ 之一作用过的版本,平均每个结果 1/4 概率);Alice 用经典信道把 2 比特测量结果告诉 Bob,Bob 按说明书施加对应的泡利修正门,他的比特就地变成精确的 |ψ⟩。注意账本:1 对纠缠 + 2 经典比特换 1 个量子比特的传送;原态在测量中毁灭——没有克隆,量子信息守恒;而且无论纠缠多强,没有那 2 个经典比特 Bob 什么都做不了——所以隐形传态不超光速,相对论毫发无损。纠缠在这里不是「传输」而是「资源」:像一根预铺好的量子专线,每次传送消耗一对。2017 年「墨子号」卫星把光子态从地面传上 1400 km 高空的另一地面站,城市级量子网络与量子中继已把隐形传态当作标准件。演示里用两个 Bloch 球拖出任意初态,按「传送一次」跑完整协议:看 Bell 测量掷出四种结果之一、经典包飞过信道、Bob 的箭头经过 X/Z 修正旋转到与原态重合、Alice 侧同时熄灭;按「无经典信道」看 Bob 拿着变体干瞪眼(平均保真度只有 1/2);按「不可克隆」体验被禁止的复印。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Getting an unknown quantum state psi = alpha|0> + beta|1> from Alice to Bob faces three obstacles: the no-cloning theorem (no copying), collapse on measurement (looking destroys), and light speed (no carrying at a distance). The 1993 Bennett protocol is elegant stage magic: Alice and Bob first share an entangled Bell pair; Alice measures her two qubits (the psi qubit plus her half of the pair) together in the Bell basis - four equiprobable outcomes Phi+, Phi-, Psi+, Psi-; the measurement destroys psi on Alices side while Bobs half instantly collapses into some Pauli variant of psi (acted on by I, X, Z or XZ, one quarter each); Alice sends the 2-bit result over a classical channel, Bob applies the matching Pauli correction, and his qubit becomes exactly |psi>. Note the ledger: one entangled pair plus two classical bits buys one teleported qubit; the original is destroyed in the measurement - no clone, quantum information conserved; and no matter how strong the entanglement, without those two classical bits Bob can do nothing - so teleportation never beats light speed, and relativity is unharmed. Entanglement here is not transport but a resource: a pre-laid quantum line, one pair consumed per transmission. In 2017 the Micius satellite teleported photon states 1400 km up to a ground station, and quantum networks now treat teleportation as a standard part. In the demo, set any initial state on the two Bloch spheres with the sliders and press teleport once to run the full protocol: watch the Bell measurement roll one of four outcomes, the classical packet fly across, Bobs arrow rotate through X/Z corrections onto the original state while Alices side goes dark; press no-classical-channel to watch Bob stuck with a variant (mean fidelity only 1/2); press no-cloning to meet the forbidden copy. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: 你在搜索框打出 "apr",候选词 0.1 秒内浮现——这背后不是在十万词条里做模糊匹配,而是一棵前缀树(trie):每个节点是一个字符,从根到节点的路径就是前缀。"apr" 三个字符走三步落在一个节点上,查询成本只跟词长有关、与词库大小无关——十万词和一亿词都是 3 步。哈希表查一个词同样快,但它把前缀信息全打碎了:以 "ap" 开头的词散落在桶的四面八方,想找「所有 ap 开头的词」只能全表扫描;前缀树则把共同前缀收拢成同一条路,走到节点后收下整棵子树,前缀查询变成一次下行的顺路收获。候选词再按使用频率排序:每个节点存一个计数器,历史查询把高频词顶到建议前列——这就是搜索框前三名的来历。代价是内存:字符级分叉产生大量稀疏节点,工程上用压缩路径(radix tree,把单链压缩成一条边)或双数组 trie 压到可承受;路由器还发明了同构用法:IP 路由表按二进制位建前缀树,查 200.100.5.x 时取「最长前缀匹配」——/24 的专网路由优先于 /8 的默认路由,互联网每天靠这棵树转发百亿亿个包。拖「查询词」看树的下行路径点亮,拖「词库规模」看查询步数纹丝不动;按「线性扫描对照」看朴素搜索的多慢,按「IP 路由」看最长前缀匹配,按「压缩前后」看节点数坍缩。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Type "apr" into a search box and candidates appear in 0.1 seconds - not fuzzy matching across a hundred thousand entries, but a trie: each node is one character, each root-to-node path a prefix. Three characters land you three steps down, and query cost depends only on word length, not dictionary size - a hundred thousand words or a hundred million, still three steps. A hash table answers a single word just as fast, but it shreds prefix information: words starting with "ap" scatter across buckets, and finding all of them means a full scan. A trie gathers shared prefixes onto one path; walk to the node and take its whole subtree - prefix queries come free with the descent. Candidates then rank by frequency: every node keeps a counter, and past queries push hot words to the top of the suggestions - that is where the top three come from. The cost is memory: character-level branching creates sparse nodes, so production systems compress single-child chains (radix trees) or pack the trie into double arrays; routers invented an isomorphic use - IP forwarding tables are tries over binary bits, and 200.100.5.x resolves by longest-prefix match, a /24 specialized route beating a /8 default, a tree forwarding quintillions of packets a day. Drag the query to light up the descent, drag dictionary size to watch the step count refuse to move; press linear scan to see naive search crawl, IP routing for longest-prefix match, compression for the node count collapsing. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 3D 节点树(球+连线,字符标签);查询字符逐个下行点亮;命中子树整体高亮;候选词气泡按频率弹出;对照面板:线性扫描进度条 vs 树 3 步完成。

topics.descZh: 网线上、压缩包里、SSD 闪存间,每天有万亿量级的 CRC 在值班,而它的全部数学只有一句话:把比特串看成 GF(2) 上的多项式——系数只有 0 和 1、加法是不进位的 XOR——然后除以双方约定的生成多项式,把余数附在消息后面;接收方整除一遍,余数非零就是传输出错。不进位的世界里除法只剩下移位和 XOR,硬件实现是一排移位寄存器加几个异或门(LFSR):数据流过时除法同步进行,一位延迟一个门,千兆网线上一秒钟做十亿次。它的检错能力精确可控:生成多项式只要含两个以上非零项,所有单个比特错必被抓;阶数为 r 的 CRC,长度 ≤ r 的突发错误全部可检——CRC-32 的 32 位余数让 5 字节以内的任何突发无处遁形,还对长度小于 2³¹ 的消息保证双重错可检。但要分清:CRC 不是密码学哈希,它能防错误不防恶意——攻击者可以计算并补出一个让 CRC 通过的恶意消息,所以 TLS 之外还要 HMAC;以太网帧尾 4 字节 FCS、ZIP 的 CRC-32、蓝牙与 USB 的 CRC-16/32,全是这条 1961 年数学的现役部署。拖「生成多项式」换 CRC-8/16/32 看检错范围,拖「注入错误」翻转比特;按「长除慢放」看移位-XOR 一步一顿,按「单位错演示」看余数报警,按「突发错误」连翻五个比特。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
On network cables, inside zip archives, between SSD and memory, trillions of CRCs stand guard daily, and their entire mathematics is one sentence: read the bit string as a polynomial over GF(2) - coefficients are 0 or 1, addition is carry-free XOR - divide by an agreed generator, append the remainder; the receiver divides again, and a nonzero remainder means corruption. Without carries, division shrinks to shifts and XORs, and hardware is a row of flip-flops with a few XOR gates (an LFSR): division happens in flight, one gate per bit, a billion divisions a second on gigabit wire. Error detection is precisely controllable: any generator with two or more nonzero terms catches every single-bit error; an r-th order CRC detects all bursts of length up to r - CRC-32's 32-bit remainder catches any burst within 5 bytes and guarantees double-error detection for messages shorter than 2^31 bits. But be clear: CRC is not a cryptographic hash - it defends against errors, not adversaries, who can compute a valid CRC for a malicious message; TLS adds HMAC on top. Ethernet's 4-byte FCS, ZIP's CRC-32, Bluetooth and USB CRC-16/32 are all this 1961 mathematics still on active duty. Drag the generator to swap CRC-8/16/32 and watch detection ranges, drag error injection to flip bits; press long division to step through shift-and-XOR, single-bit error to see the remainder alarm, burst error to flip five bits at once. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 比特流(发光方块队列)流入 LFSR 移位寄存器(各级方盒+XOR 抽头闪灯);并排显示多项式长除竖式;接收端整除检查:绿勾/红叉;错误注入闪电图标。

topics.descZh: 1936 年,24 岁的图灵在论文里证明了计算机科学第一块基石,同时划下第一道天花板:不存在一个程序 H,能对任意程序 P 和输入 I 判定「P 跑 I 会不会停机」。证明只需五步:假设 H 存在;构造对抗程序 D——读入 P,去问 H「P 自己吃自己会不会停」,若答案是会,D 就当场死循环,若答案是不会,D 就立即停机;现在把 D 喂给 D:H 说 D(D) 会停 → D 陷入死循环;H 说不会停 → D 立即停机——两种情况都与 H 的判定矛盾,矛盾的唯一出口是 H 根本不存在。这个「自己反自己」的把戏与三年后哥德尔不完备定理同构:哥德尔构造「本命题不可证」的句子,图灵构造「本程序对自身判定取反」的程序,对角线法一脉相承。后果比想象中大:Rice 定理随后证明,任何关于程序行为的非平凡性质(「这个程序有没有漏洞」「这段代码是不是病毒」)都不可判定——不是难,是数学上不存在。工程上的退路不是放弃而是收窄:类型系统排除整类错误、有界模型检查只看 N 步内、测试与静态分析覆盖常见模式;而「这段代码会不会死循环」的日常疑问,永远只能对具体程序给出具体答案,没有通吃的银弹。拖「程序样本」切换被检对象,拖「步数上限」看模拟器卡死;按「悖论现场」看 D 吃 D 双灯齐灭,按「对角线网格」看与哥德尔的同款证明,按「Rice 定理」看性质判定的边界。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
In 1936, 24-year-old Turing proved computing's first cornerstone and drew its first ceiling in the same stroke: no program H can decide, for every program P and input I, whether P run on I halts. The proof takes five steps: assume H exists; build the adversary D - read P, ask H whether "P fed itself" halts, and if the answer is yes, loop forever, if no, halt immediately; now feed D to itself. If H says D(D) halts, D loops; if H says it doesn't, D halts - both contradict the verdict, and the only exit is that H never existed. This self-referencing trick is isomorphic to Godel's incompleteness three years later - Godel built "this statement is unprovable," Turing built "this program negates its own verdict on itself," the same diagonal. The fallout is bigger than it looks: Rice's theorem proves any nontrivial semantic property of programs - "is this bug-free," "is this code malware" - undecidable, not hard but mathematically nonexistent. Engineering retreats by narrowing, not surrendering: type systems rule out whole error classes, bounded model checking looks N steps deep, tests and static analysis cover common patterns - but "will this loop terminate" forever admits only per-program answers, never a universal bullet. Drag the program sample to switch the suspect, drag the step limit to stall the simulator; press paradox live to watch D eat D with both lamps dying, diagonal grid for Godel's twin proof, Rice's theorem for the property-decision frontier. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 抽象机器空间:程序卡片流、H 判决机(双灯:停/不停)、对抗程序 D 的构造动画、D(D) 自指回环;对角线网格(程序×程序,红蓝对角);模拟器步数计数溢出。

topics.descZh: 统计「十亿访客里有几个不重复的用户」,精确数法要一个装十亿 ID 的哈希集合——几个 GB 内存;HyperLogLog 用 12 KB 做同样的事,误差约 2%,它的洞察只有一句:均匀随机的哈希值里,「前导零的个数」携带基数信息。一个集合基数越大,出现「一长串前导零」的哈希值的概率就越大——看到 k 个前导零,基数大概率在 2^k 量级。单次观测噪声太大,LogLog 的办法是分桶平均:用哈希值的前几个 bit 把元素分到 m 个桶(比如 16384 个),每个桶只记一个数字——该桶见过的最大前导零数;最后用调和平均把所有桶的估计聚合起来,调和平均对离群桶不敏感,这正是选它的原因。HyperLogLog 再修两处偏差:小基数时的线性计数(空桶太多就直接数)与大基数时的偏差修正表,把误差压到约 1.04/√m,且无需存任何元素本身。工程上它是 Redis 的 PFADD/PFCOUNT、Google 的 PowerDrill、各家数据库的近似 COUNT(DISTINCT)——所有「UV 统计、独立访客、不同卡片数」的海量场景,本质都是在「精度 2%」与「内存 12 KB」之间做交换。反方向姊妹是布隆过滤器:那个回答「见过没有」,这个回答「见过几个」。拖「元素数」看估计曲线贴合真值,拖「桶数 m」看误差与内存的交换;按「散列入桶」看前缀分流,按「寄存器更新」看最大前导零,按「调和估计」看聚合公式,按「对比精确」看内存差距。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Counting distinct visitors out of a billion, the exact way needs a hash set holding a billion IDs - gigabytes of memory; HyperLogLog does the same job in 12 KB with about 2 percent error, and its insight is one sentence: in uniformly random hash values, the number of leading zeros carries cardinality information. The bigger a set, the likelier some hash begins with a long run of zeros - see k leading zeros and the cardinality is probably on the order of 2^k. One observation is too noisy, so LogLog averages over buckets: the first few bits of each hash route the element to one of m buckets (say 16384), and each bucket keeps a single number - the longest leading-zero run it has seen; a harmonic mean then aggregates all buckets, chosen because it tolerates outlier buckets. HyperLogLog patches two edges - linear counting when many buckets are empty (small cardinalities) and a bias-correction table for large ones - cutting the error to about 1.04 over the square root of m while storing no elements at all. In production it is Redis's PFADD/PFCOUNT, Google's PowerDrill, and every database's approximate COUNT(DISTINCT) - all the massive unique-visitor tallies are trading two percent accuracy for twelve kilobytes. Its opposite-number sibling is the Bloom filter: that one answers 'have I seen it', this one answers 'how many'. Drag element count to track the estimate hugging truth, drag bucket count m for the accuracy-memory trade; press hash routing to watch the prefix split, register update for the longest zero-run, harmonic estimate for the aggregation, versus exact for the memory gap. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 元素流(发光方块)经哈希变成二进制串;前缀路由到 m 列桶;每列一个寄存器柱显示最大前导零;调和平均仪表实时输出估计值与真值曲线;内存对比条:哈希集合 GB 级 vs HLL 12 KB。

topics.descZh: 一笔转账要同时改两个数据库,要么都成功、要么都回滚——跨机器的「都」字怎么保证?两阶段提交(2PC)的答案是把决定权收给一个协调者:第一阶段「准备」,协调者问所有参与者「能提交吗」,每个参与者把 undo 日志写进磁盘后回答 yes 或 no——yes 是带后悔药的承诺:从此刻起它能提交也能回滚,但必须停住等第二阶段;第二阶段「提交」,协调者只要收到全票 yes 就广播 commit,所有参与者正式生效;任何一张 no 或超时,广播 rollback,大家 undo。协议本身简单,恶名在故障模式:最毒的一刀是「参与者投完 yes 后协调者失联」——参与者已锁定资源,不能单方面提交也不能回滚(它不知道别人投了什么),只能卡在 in-doubt 状态死等协调者苏醒,锁不释放,整条业务线排队;这正是 Raft/Paxos 一类共识协议与「协调者高可用」要解决的问题。第二毒是协调者在写 commit 记录前宕机——重启后读日志就能续发决定,所以「先写日志再发消息」是 2PC 的命根。代价清单:一次提交至少两次往返、每个参与者多一次 fsync,延迟是单机的三倍以上;MongoDB 4.0+、TiKV 的 Percolator 变体等分布式数据库都内置了它的变形。拖「故障时机」看每种宕机发生在哪一步,拖「节点数」看消息轮数;按「正常提交」看两幕完整流程,按「参与者宕机」看 in-doubt 阻塞,按「协调者宕机」看日志恢复续发,按「中止回滚」看 no 票引发的全员 undo。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
One transfer must update two databases - all-or-nothing across machines. How is that 'all' guaranteed? Two-phase commit's answer is a coordinator that owns the decision. Phase one, prepare: the coordinator asks every participant 'can you commit?' and each writes an undo log to disk before answering yes or no - yes is a promise with a safety catch: from that instant it can commit or roll back, but must stay parked until phase two. Phase two, commit: all yes votes and the coordinator broadcasts commit and everyone takes effect; a single no or timeout broadcasts rollback and everyone undoes. The protocol is simple; its infamy lives in the failure modes. The cruelest cut: a participant answers yes, then the coordinator vanishes - the participant holds locks, may not commit alone, may not roll back alone (it cannot know how the others voted), and freezes in the in-doubt state waiting for the coordinator to wake - the blocking that Raft-style consensus and highly available coordinators exist to cure. Second cruelest: the coordinator dies just before writing its commit record - on restart it replays the log and re-sends the decision, which is why 'log before message' is 2PC's lifeline. The bill: at least two round trips, one extra fsync on every participant, latency three times a local commit - and distributed databases from MongoDB 4.0 to TiKV's Percolator variant ship its descendants built in. Drag failure timing to place each crash on the timeline, drag node count for the message bill; press normal commit for the full two acts, participant crash for in-doubt blocking, coordinator crash for log-replay recovery, abort for one no sending everyone back. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 顶部协调者节点+下方参与者节点(数据库图标);阶段一 prepare 消息(绿)逐个飞出、各节点写 undo 日志闪盘图标后回票;阶段二 commit(金)/rollback(红)广播;宕机场景节点变灰、in-doubt 锁图标挂起;消息计数器与状态机面板。

topics.descZh: 你要招一名秘书,100 份申请一个个来,见面即决策:当场录用或永别,不能回头;目标只有一个——录用到「最好的那位」的概率最大化。怎么面?面完所有人再决定不可能,最好的可能早已错过;太早定,又可能错过更好的。1960 年代给出的最优解优雅得惊人:先观察前 n/e ≈ 37% 的候选人,只记录最大值、一个都不选;之后遇到的第一个「比前面所有人都强」的,当场录用。这个策略的成功率恰好也是 1/e ≈ 36.8%——注意这不是及格率,而是任何策略都无法逾越的天花板:在信息只能单向流动的世界里,你注定有三分之二的情况拿不到第一名。背后的数学是动态规划:设观察期 r,录用到最好的概率 P(r) = (r/n)·Σ(1/k)(k 从 r 到 n-1),求极值,当 n 很大时 r*/n → 1/e。它同样回答更日常的问题:租房看多少套再出手?相亲见多少人再定?前提是候选随机到达、你只在乎「第一名」;若规则改成「满意即好」,策略与成功率都会变。这个 1960 年的模型如今活在最优停止理论里,成了拍卖出价、资产卖出的共同骨架。拖「候选数 n」看 37% 划线,拖「观察期 r」看成功率曲线;按「单轮演示」看一条高度序列与决策点,按「成功率曲线」看 P(r) 的驼峰,按「千轮模拟」看频率收敛到 36.8%,按「全知对比」看上帝视角的差距。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
You hire one secretary from a hundred applicants who arrive one by one; at each interview you must hire on the spot or say goodbye forever, and your whole score is the probability of hiring the single best. Interview everyone and the best may already be gone; decide early and something better may follow. The optimal answer, worked out in the 1960s, is startlingly elegant: observe the first n/e - about 37 percent - hiring none, recording only the best so far; then take the first later candidate who beats everyone seen before. The success probability of this policy is exactly 1/e - about 36.8 percent - and that is not a passing grade but the ceiling no strategy can beat: in a world where information only flows one way, two-thirds of the outcome is not yours to control. The mathematics is dynamic programming: with an observation window r, the probability of winning is P(r) = (r/n) times the sum of 1/k from r to n-1, and maximizing it drives r/n to 1/e as n grows. The same skeleton answers everyday questions - how many apartments to view before renting, how many people to date before settling - under the assumptions of random arrival and caring only about first place; change the goal to 'any acceptable one' and both strategy and odds shift. The 1960 model now lives inside optimal stopping theory, the shared frame of auction bidding and asset selling. Drag candidate count n to move the 37 percent line, drag window r to trace the success curve; press single run to watch one quality sequence and its decision, success curve for the hump of P(r), thousand runs to watch frequency converge on 36.8, omniscient for the gap to perfect hindsight. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 候选人柱体(高度=质量)逐个入场排成一排;37% 观察区半透明着色、被拒者变灰;录用瞬间金色闪光;右侧 P(r) 曲线实时绘制、当前 r 标记;千轮模拟时直方图向 36.8% 收敛。

topics.descZh: 有些系统的真相看不见,只能看见它扔出来的线索——天气是隐的,你朋友的行动(散步/购物/打扫)是显的;隐马尔可夫模型把这类「隔着毛玻璃猜状态」形式化:状态按马尔可夫链转移(下一状态只依赖当前),每个状态按自己的概率分布发出观测;围绕它有三个经典问题各有算法:评估——前向算法 O(N²T) 算出「这条观测序列出现」的概率;解码——Viterbi 算法用动态规划从 N^T 条状态路径里高效挑出最可能的一条(记录每步最优、最后回溯);学习——观测序列只有输出没有标注时,鲍姆-韦尔奇(EM 的前身)交替估计状态期望与重估转移/发射参数直到收敛;这套机器统治了语音识别三十年(音素作为隐状态),也是基因序列找编码区、拼音输入法整句转换、金融 regime 切换检测的第一代主力——直到深度学习接管,但「隐状态+发射」的思考方式已经渗进整个序列建模。拖「转移概率」看隐状态的黏性,拖「观测噪声」看线索变得含糊;按「生成观测」让天气暗中掷骰子,按「前向评估」看概率格逐列点亮,按「Viterbi 解码」看红线回溯最优路径,按「Baum-Welch 学习」看热图迭代收敛。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Some systems hide their truth and only throw out clues - the weather is hidden, your friend's activities (walk / shop / clean) are visible; the Hidden Markov Model formalizes this guessing-through-frosted-glass: states evolve as a Markov chain (the next state depends only on the current one), and each state emits observations from its own probability distribution; three classic problems come with three classic algorithms: evaluation - the forward algorithm computes, in O(N²T), the probability that this observation sequence appeared; decoding - the Viterbi algorithm uses dynamic programming to pick the single most likely state path out of N^T candidates (record the best move per cell, backtrack at the end); learning - when you only have outputs and no labels, Baum-Welch (the ancestor of EM) alternates between estimating state expectations and re-estimating transition/emission parameters until convergence; this machinery ruled speech recognition for thirty years (phonemes as hidden states) and was the first-generation workhorse for finding coding regions in genes, whole-sentence pinyin input, and financial regime detection - deep learning has since taken over, but the hidden-state-plus-emission way of thinking has seeped into all of sequence modeling. Drag transition prob to feel the stickiness of the hidden states, drag observation noise to blur the clues; press generate obs to let the weather roll dice backstage, press forward eval to watch probability cells light up column by column, press Viterbi decode to watch the red line backtrack the best path, press Baum-Welch learn to watch the heatmap converge. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 上排晴/雨两颗玻璃感隐状态球,弧形转移箭头有脉冲点流动;下排散步/购物/打扫三颗观测球,虚线光束粗细随发射概率变化;前方 10 格时间线摆出观测序列,每格上下两片概率格随前向算法逐列点亮;Viterbi 红线穿格回溯最优路径;右侧 2×2 转移矩阵热图随 EM 迭代渐变收敛。

topics.descZh: 把一份数据复制到三台机器,你就免费买到了可用性,也签下了一份风险合同:网络一旦把集群劈成两半(P=分区容忍,必选——网络必然故障),复制之间就出现裂口,这时 C(线性一致)与 A(处处可响应)只能保一个——Gilbert 与 Lynch 2002 年证明了这条 CAP 定理;CP 阵营(ZooKeeper、etcd):分区时少数派宁可不服务,等多数派凑齐再写,一致性无价;AP 阵营(Cassandra、DNS):两半都继续收写,各留一份「暂时的真相」,愈合后再用向量时钟/最后写入胜出等策略合并——期间读到的可能是旧数据;被误读最多的是「三选二」:没有分区时 C 与 A 可兼得,真正的日常权衡是延迟(PACELC),Quorum 滑杆(W+R>N):读多写少调 W、写多读少调 R;理解 CAP 的正确姿势不是背结论,而是盯着「分区发生的那一秒」——所有分布式数据库的架构分歧,都是从那一秒开始分岔的。拖「写 Quorum W」看写入要凑几张票,拖「读 Quorum R」看读到多新的数据;按「无分区基线」看复制流水线,按「分区-CP」看少数派拒绝写入,按「分区-AP」看两半真相分叉,按「愈合与冲突」看版本合并收场。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Replicate one dataset across three machines and you get availability for free - and sign a risk contract: the moment the network splits the cluster in two (P = partition tolerance, mandatory - networks do fail), a crack opens between the replicas, and then C (linearizability: every read sees the latest write) and A (every non-failing node answers) cannot both hold - the CAP theorem, proved by Gilbert and Lynch in 2002; the CP camp (ZooKeeper, etcd): during a partition the minority side would rather serve nothing and wait for the majority to reunite - consistency at any price; the AP camp (Cassandra, DNS): both halves keep accepting writes, each holding a temporarily true copy, merged after healing with vector clocks or last-write-wins - reads in between may be stale; the most misread part is the pick-two slogan: with no partition, C and A coexist fine - the everyday trade is latency (PACELC), and the quorum knobs (W+R>N) are that slider: read-heavy tune W, write-heavy tune R; the right way to read CAP is not to memorize the slogan but to stare at the second the partition happens - every distributed database's architecture forks from that second. Drag write quorum W to see how many votes a write must gather, drag read quorum R to see how fresh your reads are; press no-partition baseline to watch smooth replication, press partition-CP to watch the minority refuse writes, press partition-AP to watch two truths fork, press heal & merge to watch versions reconcile. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 三颗节点球由绿色复制链路连成三角,客户端写入光点落到节点、再沿链路脉冲复制到副本;分区时两条链路闪红断开,少数派节点弹红色拒绝环或版本号分裂成 v′;愈合阶段链路恢复、版本比较后合并闪光;示波器画出 R-W Quorum 平面,绿区表示 W+R>N 的强一致读,白点为当前工作点。

topics.descZh: 1917 年维尔南把密码学推到前无古人的高度:密钥与明文等长、真随机、只用一次,逐位异或——密文里从此不含任何明文的统计痕迹,香农 1949 年证明这是数学意义上唯一的「完美保密」:敌人烧穿全部算力,得到的也只是「明文可能是任何等长文本」的均匀分布。但完美有三张账单:真随机数在计算机时代极难量产,伪随机数生成器的规律一用就破功;与明文等长的密钥必须提前安全送到对方手里,分发和保管的通道本身就先成为漏洞;最致命的是重用——两条密文一异或,密钥当场抵消,剩下的 P1⊕P2 会在字母频率分析下裸奔,二战后美军「维诺纳」计划正是抓住苏联密码本误重用,破出绵延数年的情报流;冷战热线靠信使手递密钥本,今天它借量子密钥分发翻案:窃听必留痕迹的送钥通道,让「先囤密文等量子计算机」的对手无米下锅。拖「密钥重用次数」看密钥抵消如何泄底,拖「密钥长度」看截取位数对破译进度的影响;按「加解密演示」看三条位流逐位异或,按「重用攻破」看频率柱状图从密文里长出语言残影,按「真随机 vs PRNG」看两种密钥热图的规律差异,按「分发难题」看信使与量子信道对窃听者的攻防。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
In 1917 Vernam took cryptography further than anything before it: a key as long as the message, truly random, used exactly once, XOR-ed bit by bit - the ciphertext carries no statistical trace of the plaintext, and in 1949 Shannon proved this is the only mathematically perfect secrecy: an enemy could burn the whole world's computing power and learn nothing beyond that the plaintext is equally likely to be any text of that length. But perfection bills you three times. True randomness is brutally hard to manufacture at scale - a pseudo-random generator gives the game away the moment it runs. A key as long as the message must reach your correspondent in advance and in secret - distribution becomes the vulnerability. And reuse is fatal: XOR two ciphertexts and the key cancels on the spot, leaving P1 XOR P2, naked under letter-frequency analysis - after WWII the VENONA program caught Soviet pads reused by mistake and read years of traffic. The Cold War hotline moved pads by courier; today the scheme rides again on quantum key distribution, where eavesdropping necessarily leaves fingerprints. Drag key reuse to watch a cancelled key give everything away, drag key length to see what more material does to the crack; press encrypt / decrypt to watch three bit ribbons XOR bit by bit, press reuse break to see frequency bars grow a language shadow, press true random vs PRNG to compare two key heatmaps, press key delivery for the courier-versus-quantum race against an eavesdropper. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 三条位流色带逐位异或:明文(绿)、密钥(橙)、密文(蓝),白色 XOR 门随游标逐列发光;重用时两条密文带异或出红色泄露带,12 根字母频率柱亮起语言残影;左侧真随机与 PRNG 两张密钥热图并排对比;右侧信使沿红色弧线往返,量子信道光子链飞驰,窃听者一碰光子即触发红色警报环。

topics.descZh:
2014 年,Goodfellow 把「让机器学会生成」写成一场博弈:生成器 G 吃进 100 维高斯噪声 z,吐出假样本 G(z);判别器 D 看一眼样本,吐出「这是真数据」的概率。两者共用一个价值函数 V(D,G)=E[log D(x)]+E[log(1−D(G(z)))]——D 拼命最大化它,把假货揪出来;G 拼命最小化它,让假货过关。理论上这场极小极大博弈存在纳什均衡:G 的分布与数据分布完全重合时,D 对任何输入都只能输出 1/2,「看不清」恰是「骗过了」的证明;训练因此像自由市场里造假者与鉴伪师的军备竞赛,双方轮流出招、交替升级。但两个网络同时学习并不安分,三道难题接踵而至:模式坍缩——G 发现只造一两种最安全的假货就能暂时骗过 D,输出多样性应声崩塌;不收敛与振荡——两股梯度互相干扰,损失曲线锯齿交锋、迟迟不肯落定;梯度消失——D 太强时 log(1−D(G(z))) 饱和,G 收不到误差信号,于是实操改用最大化 log D(G(z)) 的非饱和损失。修复工具箱随之成型:WGAN 用 Wasserstein(推土机)距离替代 JS 散度,让梯度在分布没对上的区域依然有效,再以权重裁剪或梯度惩罚维持 Lipschitz 约束;谱归一化压住 D 的火力,特征匹配与 mini-batch 判别专治千篇一律,条件 GAN 用标签给生成加上方向盘。2016–2020 年,GAN 是生成图像的主舞台:StyleGAN 逐级合成以假乱真的人脸,超分辨率、图像修复、数据增广全面开花,deepfake 则是同一枚硬币的阴影面;生成质量交给 Inception Score 与 FID 打分,FID 衡量真假两个分布的特征距离,越低越好。2020 年之后,训练更稳的扩散模型接管舞台,但对抗训练的思想并未退场——它活在对抗样本、生成对抗的评估博弈与 RLHF 的偏好对齐里。拖「学习率」看训练快慢与振荡,拖「噪声维度」看多样性与坍缩倾向;按「判别器攻势」「生成器反攻」「模式坍缩」「WGAN 修复」看四种战局。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 一张二维数据平面上,三个青色高斯光斑是真实数据的三座峰,紫色粒子是 G 吐出的假样本,起伏网格曲面是 D 的决策面——绿峰判真、红谷判假;判别器攻势中曲面迅速包住三峰、假粒子成片闪红、准确率飙升;生成器反攻中紫粒子拖着橙色梯度箭头爬向真峰,准确率跌向 50%;纳什均衡时曲面摊平到 0.5、紫青重合、FID 探底;模式坍缩时假粒子全部涌进一座峰、覆盖掉到 33%,WGAN 修复再像推土机一样把假样本摊回三峰。
topics.descEn:
In 2014 Goodfellow recast generative modeling as a game between two machines: a generator G takes a 100-dimensional Gaussian noise vector z and emits a fake sample G(z), while a discriminator D looks at any sample and outputs the probability that it is real. Both share one value function, V(D,G) = E[log D(x)] + E[log(1−D(G(z)))]: D climbs to maximize it and unmask fakes, G dives to minimize it and slip fakes past the judge. In theory this minimax game has a Nash equilibrium: when the distribution of G exactly matches the data distribution, D outputs 1/2 for every input - the inability to tell is the very proof of deception - so training becomes an arms race between a counterfeiter and an appraiser in a free market. Yet training two networks at once is unruly, with three classic pathologies: mode collapse, where G finds that one or two safe fake types suffice and its output diversity crumbles; oscillation and non-convergence, as the two gradients interfere and the loss curves saw at each other; and vanishing gradients, when a too-strong D saturates log(1−D(G(z))) so G receives no error signal - hence the non-saturating loss that maximizes log D(G(z)) instead. A repair kit followed: WGAN swaps JS divergence for the Wasserstein earth-mover distance so gradients stay useful where distributions disagree, holding the Lipschitz constraint with weight clipping or gradient penalty; spectral normalization reins in D; feature matching and mini-batch discrimination fight sameness; conditional GAN adds labels to steer generation. From 2016 to 2020 GANs ran the main stage of image generation: StyleGAN composed startling faces level by level, super-resolution, inpainting and data augmentation flourished, and deepfake was the dark side of the same coin; quality was scored by Inception Score and FID, where lower FID means the two feature distributions sit closer together. After 2020, diffusion models with steadier training took over the stage, but adversarial thinking lives on in adversarial examples, adversarial evaluation and the preference games of RLHF. Drag the learning-rate slider to watch training speed and oscillation, drag noise dims to see diversity and collapse tendency; press D attacks, G fights back, mode collapse and WGAN repair for the four standoffs. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh:
任何矩阵——方的、长方的、甚至不满秩的——都能分解为 A=UΣVᵀ:先做一个旋转(Vᵀ,右奇异向量),再沿一组互相垂直的轴各缩放一份(对角阵 Σ,奇异值 σ₁≥σ₂≥…≥σᵣ),最后再旋转(U,左奇异向量)。把单位圆送进去,出来的必定是个椭圆,奇异值恰好是各半轴长——旋转只换方向,缩放才产生形状,这就是「任何线性变换=旋转-缩放-旋转」的几何本质。埃克特-杨定理进一步说:只保留前 k 项的 A_k=Σᵢ≤k σᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ,是一切秩 k 矩阵中对 A 的最佳逼近,谱范数误差恰为 σₖ₊₁——奇异值从大到小排好队,顺序就是重要性顺序,保留能量比例=Σᵢ≤kσᵢ²/Σσᵢ²。图像压缩是最直观的战场:一张 512×512 灰度图秩至多 512,原样要存 262144 个数;只留 k=5 项,只需 5×1025=5125 个数,压缩比约 50:1,画面只剩轮廓感;k=50 时压缩比约 5:1,已接近原图;存储量从 n² 降到 k(2n+1)。JPEG/DCT 用的是人人相同的「固定基」,SVD 的基是数据自己长出来的——哪组方向最能解释这张图,分解过程自己会算出来。同一台机器换个名字就是 PCA:对中心化数据矩阵做 SVD,右奇异向量就是主成分方向,σᵢ²/(n−1) 恰是协方差矩阵的特征值。它还能算伪逆(秩亏矩阵也能解最小二乘)、滤噪声(小奇异值多半是噪声,砍掉,PSNR 回升)、做推荐(用户-物品矩阵拆成潜在因子,Netflix 大赛的经典武器)、做潜语义分析(LSA);PageRank 的本质也只是求最大特征向量。数值上,Golub–Kahan 双对角化加 QR 迭代在 LAPACK 里打磨了几十年,稳定可靠;条件数 κ=σ₁/σₙ 时刻提醒你这个矩阵「有多病」。拖「保留秩 k」看重构精度与谱截断,拖「噪声水平」看噪声淹没与滤除;按「变换三连」看圆变椭圆,按「逐步分解」看三块矩阵卡片依次点亮,按「图像压缩」看像素方块逐渐归位,按「噪声滤除」看 PSNR 回升。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 左侧舞台演示变换三连:带 12 个采样点的单位圆盘先被 Vᵀ 转过一个角度,再被 Σ 沿正交主轴拉成椭圆,主轴亮起并标出半轴长 σ₁σ₂,最后被 U 转到最终姿态,12 条映射连线实时跟随;右侧立起 16×16 像素面板与奇异值谱阶梯柱,按 k 截断重构、被砍掉的谱柱闪灰;噪声滤除模式下含噪面板被逐步抹平,PSNR 数字回升,黄色截断线随 k 移动。
topics.descEn:
Every matrix - square, rectangular, or even rank-deficient - factors as A = UΣVᵀ: first a rotation (Vᵀ, the right singular vectors), then independent stretches along mutually orthogonal axes (the diagonal Σ, holding singular values σ₁ ≥ σ₂ ≥ … ≥ σᵣ), then a final rotation (U, the left singular vectors). Send a unit circle in and an ellipse always comes out; the singular values are exactly its semi-axes - rotation only reorients, scaling creates shape: the geometric soul of every linear transform, rotate then scale then rotate. The Eckart-Young theorem adds: the rank-k truncation A_k = Σᵢ≤k σᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ is the best rank-k approximation of A among all matrices, with spectral-norm error exactly σₖ₊₁ - singular values listed large to small order information by importance, and the retained energy share is Σᵢ≤kσᵢ²/Σσᵢ². Image compression is the most intuitive battleground: a 512×512 grayscale image has rank at most 512 and stores 262144 numbers; keeping k=5 terms needs 5×1025 = 5125 numbers, about 50:1, leaving only the outline, while k=50 gives about 5:1 and a near-original picture; storage drops from n² to k(2n+1). JPEG/DCT compresses with a fixed basis shared by everyone; the SVD basis grows out of the data itself. The same machine renamed is PCA: SVD of the centered data matrix makes the right singular vectors the principal directions, and σᵢ²/(n−1) are exactly the covariance eigenvalues. It also computes the pseudoinverse (least squares even for rank-deficient matrices), filters noise (small singular values are mostly noise - cut them and PSNR climbs), drives recommender systems (user-item matrices split into latent factors, the classic Netflix-prize weapon) and latent semantic analysis (LSA); PageRank at heart just seeks the largest eigenvector. Numerically, Golub-Kahan bidiagonalization plus QR iteration, polished for decades inside LAPACK, is rock-solid; the condition number κ = σ₁/σₙ keeps warning how sick a matrix is. Drag rank k to steer reconstruction and spectrum truncation, drag noise level to drown and rescue the pixels; press transform trio to watch the circle become an ellipse, step-by-step to light the three matrix cards in turn, image compression to watch pixels settle, noise filtering to see PSNR recover. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 左侧舞台演示变换三连:带 12 个采样点的单位圆盘先被 Vᵀ 转过一个角度,再被 Σ 沿正交主轴拉成椭圆,主轴亮起并标出半轴长 σ₁σ₂,最后被 U 转到最终姿态,12 条映射连线实时跟随;右侧立起 16×16 像素面板与奇异值谱阶梯柱,按 k 截断重构、被砍掉的谱柱闪灰;噪声滤除模式下含噪面板被逐步抹平,PSNR 数字回升,黄色截断线随 k 移动。

topics.descZh:
把加密数据直接交给云端计算,云端全程只见密文、不知明文,算完把结果还给主人,只有握私钥的主人能解出答案——这是「隐私计算」的圣杯:医院联合研究、私人数据上云做 AI 推理、加密检索、隐私投票都指望它。最早的线索藏在 RSA 里:它是乘法同态,E(m₁)·E(m₂)=E(m₁·m₂),指数相加恰好对应明文相乘;Paillier 则是加法同态。但「教科书 RSA」正因这个性质可被攻破——攻击者把密文平方就得到明文平方的密文,所以实用方案必须加 OAEP 之类的填充破坏结构:同态起初被当漏洞,后来被当宝藏。2009 年 Gentry 首次造出全同态加密(FHE),核心是「带噪声的加密」:每次同态运算都往密文里掺噪声,加法让噪声线性长一小步,乘法让噪声近似平方跳一大步,噪声越过阈值密文就永久报废;他的绝招是自举——把解密电路本身也同态地跑一遍,在密文上给密文降噪刷新,理论上可以无限次运算。现代方案 BGV/BFV 做整数精确运算,CKKS 做浮点近似运算(适合机器学习),安全性都压在格上的 LWE 问题——小秘密加小噪声的线性方程组,目前没有量子快速算法,天然抗量子;微软 SEAL、OpenFHE 等开源库已经可用。代价依然高昂:密文膨胀数千到数万倍,一个 32 位整数加密后变成几十 KB,运算比明文慢 10⁴–10⁶ 倍;NTT 快速数论变换与 SIMD 打包(一次同态运算并行处理数千个明文槽)正持续压缩差距,加密推理一帧已从小时级降到秒级。按噪声预算分三档:PHE 部分同态(只有加或只有乘,Paillier、RSA)、SHE 层次同态(有限深度)、FHE 全同态(任意电路)——深度预算就是噪声预算,乘法最费。拖「运算深度」看噪声水位与深度预算,拖「参数规模」切 128/192/256 位看膨胀与耗时;按「同态运算」看两只密码箱在算符门里合并、雪花变多,按「噪声与自举」看水位逼近红线时进舱刷新、水位骤降,按「RSA 教训」看密文平方如何缩小明文范围,按「云端推理」看打码图片穿过同态神经网络、回到手机解出「猫」。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 左侧主人台亮着终端与私钥金钥匙,旁为公钥加密机;中央玻璃云机房机架闪烁,密码箱里的数字被打码成雪花噪点,箱侧立着噪声水位条与红色报废线。加密循环:明文球进加密机变成噪声箱,沿光弧飞入云端;同态运算:两只密码箱推入算符门合并,雪花变多、水位上涨;噪声与自举:水位爬向红线,密码箱进顶部刷新舱后骤降;RSA 教训:攻击者平方密文,明文范围盘收缩并亮红字;云端推理:打码图片穿过同态神经网络,结果箱沿光弧返回、解出「猫」。
topics.descEn:
Hand encrypted data straight to the cloud: the cloud sees only ciphertext the whole time, computes on it, and hands back a result that only the private key can open - the holy grail of private computing behind joint hospital studies, private on-cloud AI inference, encrypted search and private voting. The first clue hid inside RSA: it is multiplicatively homomorphic, E(m1)·E(m2) = E(m1·m2), because adding exponents multiplies plaintexts; Paillier is additively homomorphic. Yet textbook RSA is broken by this very property - an attacker squares an intercepted ciphertext and gets the encryption of the squared plaintext - so real systems add OAEP-style padding to destroy the structure: homomorphism was first treated as a bug, later as a treasure. In 2009 Gentry built the first fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) on noisy encryption: every homomorphic operation stirs noise into a ciphertext - additions grow it a small linear step, multiplications a near-squared leap - and past the threshold the ciphertext is dead; his trick is bootstrapping: run the decryption circuit itself homomorphically, refreshing the ciphertext inside ciphertext, so in theory computation can go on forever. Modern schemes rest security on the LWE problem over lattices (linear equations with a small secret and small noise; no known quantum shortcut, post-quantum by construction): BGV/BFV for exact integer arithmetic, CKKS for approximate floating-point arithmetic suited to machine learning; Microsoft SEAL and OpenFHE are ready to use. The bill is steep: ciphertexts bloat thousands to tens of thousands of times (one 32-bit integer becomes tens of KB) and run 10^4-10^6 times slower than plaintext; NTT and SIMD batching (thousands of plaintext slots per homomorphic op) keep closing the gap, and encrypted inference per frame has fallen from hours to seconds. Three tiers by noise budget: PHE (add-only or multiply-only, Paillier/RSA), SHE (limited depth), FHE (any circuit) - depth budget is noise budget, and multiplication spends it fastest. Drag op depth to ride the noise gauge, drag parameter scale to switch 128/192/256-bit security; press homomorphic ops to merge cipher-boxes at the operator gate, noise and bootstrapping for the plunge before the red line, the RSA lesson for ciphertext squaring, cloud inference to watch a mosaicked image come back as a cat. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 左侧主人台亮着终端与私钥金钥匙,旁为公钥加密机;中央玻璃云机房机架闪烁,密码箱里的数字被打码成雪花噪点,箱侧立着噪声水位条与红色报废线。加密循环:明文球进加密机变成噪声箱,沿光弧飞入云端;同态运算:两只密码箱推入算符门合并,雪花变多、水位上涨;噪声与自举:水位爬向红线,密码箱进顶部刷新舱后骤降;RSA 教训:攻击者平方密文,明文范围盘收缩并亮红字;云端推理:打码图片穿过同态神经网络,结果箱沿光弧返回、解出「猫」。

topics.descZh: 2.45 GHz 让水分子翻转生热;驻波制造冷热点,转盘把热点摊平
topics.descEn: 2.45 GHz flips water molecules to make heat; standing waves make hot spots, the turntable spreads them

topics.descZh: 灯丝是台 2700 K 的黑体辐射器:维恩峰落在 1.07 μm 近红外,可见光只占 ~7%——60 W 换 800 lm,剩下 93% 全是热;LED 让电子空穴复合直接产光子,9 W 就是 1000 lm,寿命 25000 h 对 1000 h——光和热的账本,一页看懂。
topics.descEn: A filament is a 2700 K blackbody radiator: the Wien peak sits at 1.07 µm in the near infrared and only ~7% of the power leaves as visible light — 60 W for 800 lm, 93% heat; an LED makes photons directly by electron–hole recombination: 9 W for 1000 lm, 25000 h vs 1000 h — the light-vs-heat ledger on one page.

topics.descZh: 混凝土不是晒干是水化:水是反应物,C₃S + H₂O → C-S-H 凝胶+Ca(OH)₂,针晶互相搭接把砂石粘死;强度按 1 天 30% → 7 天 65% → 28 天 100% 爬坡,Abram 定律水越少越强;钢筋补抗拉、热胀系数几乎相同、pH 13 钝化防锈——失水开裂,养护就是保水。
topics.descEn: Concrete doesn't dry — it hydrates: water is a reactant, C₃S + H₂O → C-S-H gel + Ca(OH)₂, needle crystals bridging grains into stone; strength climbs 30% at 1 day → 65% at 7 → 100% at 28, and Abrams's law rewards less water; rebar carries the tension with a nearly identical expansion coefficient while pH 13 passivates it — losing water means cracks, curing means keeping it wet.

topics.descZh: 灯丝电子被 40–150 kVp 加速撞钨靶:轫致辐射拉出连续谱,少数打掉 K 层电子补出 59 keV 特征线——与焰色光谱同源的跃迁;>99% 的能量变成热,阳极只好旋转;骨(钙 Z=20)比软组织(Z≈7)挡光多几个数量级,所以骨白肉灰;kVp 越高越穿透也越灰,造影剂用碘破局。
topics.descEn: Filament electrons accelerated by 40–150 kVp slam a tungsten target: bremsstrahlung draws the continuum and a few knock out K-shell electrons for the 59 keV line — the same transition physics as flame spectra; over 99% of the energy becomes heat, so the anode spins; bone (Ca, Z=20) out-attenuates soft tissue (Z≈7) by orders of magnitude — white bones, grey flesh; higher kVp pierces more but washes out, and iodine contrast saves the vessels.

topics.descZh: 2.4 GHz 波长 12.5 cm、只有 3 个不重叠信道,5 GHz 信道多但穿墙差;OFDM 把数据拆到几十个子载波并行,保护间隔把墙的反射从敌人变成队友;CSMA/CA 先听后说+随机退避,撞了就 CW 翻倍重来;SNR 一掉,MCS 从 256-QAM 逐档降到 QPSK——速率掉一个数量级。
topics.descEn: 2.4 GHz has a 12.5 cm wavelength and only 3 non-overlapping channels; 5 GHz offers many more but hates walls; OFDM splits data across dozens of subcarriers and the guard interval turns wall echoes from enemy to ally; CSMA/CA listens before talking with random backoff, doubling the window on collision; as SNR drops, MCS steps down from 256-QAM to QPSK and the rate falls an order of magnitude.

topics.descZh: 指尖抽走交叉电极的电荷,行列扫描把触摸变成坐标
topics.descEn: A fingertip draws charge from crossed electrodes; row-column scans turn touch into coordinates

topics.descZh: 四颗卫星的伪距球面交汇出位置,相对论修正让坐标不漂移
topics.descEn: Four pseudorange spheres meet at a position; relativity corrections keep the coordinates from drifting

topics.descZh: MOSFET 电控水闸搭出逻辑门,逻辑门接成 8 位行波进位加法器
topics.descEn: MOSFET switches build logic gates, and gates become an 8-bit ripple-carry adder

topics.descZh: 芯包折射率差让光全反射前进,单模解决多模色散展宽
topics.descEn: A core-cladding index gap keeps light in total internal reflection; single-mode fiber avoids modal dispersion

topics.descZh: 光子经过微透镜、拜耳滤镜和光电二极管,最后变成彩色像素
topics.descEn: Photons pass microlenses, Bayer filters and photodiodes before becoming color pixels

topics.descZh: 控制滑移率保持抓地与转向,避免车轮抱死滑行
topics.descEn: Control slip to keep traction and steering instead of locking the wheels

topics.descZh: 叶片升力驱动转子,贝茨极限与变桨控制功率
topics.descEn: Blade lift drives the rotor; the Betz limit and pitch control shape power

topics.descZh: 控制棒调节裂变链式反应,停堆后衰变热仍需冷却
topics.descEn: Control rods tune the fission chain; decay heat still needs cooling after shutdown

topics.descZh: 氢核进动、射频翻转与梯度编码把信号变成图像
topics.descEn: Proton precession, RF tipping and gradient encoding turn signals into images

topics.descZh: 双金属片或居里磁钢用热反馈自动断开与恢复加热
topics.descEn: Bimetal strips or Curie magnets use thermal feedback to cycle heating

topics.descZh: 磁头翻转磁畴,或用隧穿电子给浮栅充电保存比特
topics.descEn: Flip magnetic domains or tunnel electrons into a floating gate to store bits

topics.descZh: 接近的车把反射波前压紧,与本振混出拍频 f_d=2v/λ——90 km/h 就是 4 kHz 蜂鸣;斜 45° 只测到 v·cosθ
topics.descEn: An approaching car squeezes the reflected wavefronts; mixed down, the beat f_d=2v/λ is the speed — 90 km/h hums at 4 kHz; 45° off-axis reads only v·cosθ

topics.descZh: 镅-241 的 α 电离空气撑起 50 pA 安静电流,一缕烟把离子半路抱走——采样室电流骤跌,差分判据拉响蜂鸣
topics.descEn: Am-241 α's ionize the air into a steady 50 pA; a wisp of smoke mugs the ions, the sensing current sags, and the differential verdict sounds the horn

topics.descZh: 10 ms 判「≥30 g 且持续」,叠氮化钠 30 ms 吐出 60 升氮气;排气孔边压边泄把头部载荷压进 60 g
topics.descEn: A 30 g verdict in 10 ms; sodium azide yields 60 L of N₂ in 30 ms; side vents bleed the gas and keep head load under 60 g

topics.descZh: 室颤是波互相撞碎、泵血归零;除颤不是电醒——一次大电流让全场同时去极化归零,窦房结重新发令
topics.descEn: VF is crashing waves and zero output; the shock doesn't kick-start — it depolarizes everything at once so the sinus node can lead again

topics.descZh: 袖带压过收缩压断流,缓缓放气听柯氏音;振荡包络的峰=平均压,两肩读出收缩压/舒张压
topics.descEn: Inflate past systolic to stop flow, bleed slowly past Korotkoff sounds; the oscillation envelope peaks at MAP, its shoulders read systolic/diastolic

topics.descZh: 切片把模型拆成一叠轮廓,喷嘴逐层铺丝摞回去;悬挑超过 45° 没东西可踩——加支撑、重新摆,或看它拉丝失败
topics.descEn: A slicer cuts the model into outlines and the nozzle stacks them back; overhangs past 45° need supports, a new orientation — or they sag

topics.descZh: 电梯从不「吊」轿厢:钢丝绳靠摩擦夹在曳引轮绳槽里,对重替电机扛走轿厢自重,电机只付差额 P=Δm·g·v——半载配平巡航≈0;超速 115% 限速器甩锤联动安全钳瞬间咬死导轨
topics.descEn: Elevator ropes are gripped by friction, not hooked: a counterweight carries the car's own weight so the motor only pays the difference P=Δm·g·v — near zero when balanced; overspeed trips the governor into the wedge safety gear

topics.descZh: 32768 Hz=2¹⁵ 的压电石英音叉,经 15 级二分频变成每秒一个脉冲,推动步进电机和轮系让秒针一秒一跳——慢放 ×32768 能亲眼看一次弯曲
topics.descEn: A 32768 Hz (=2¹⁵) piezo quartz fork, divided by 15 ÷2 stages into one pulse per second, drives a stepper motor so the second hand ticks once a second — slow down ×32768 to watch a single flex

topics.descZh: P=ρQghη≈85% 的弗朗西斯水轮发电机,夜里反转抽水上山、晚高峰放水还电——往返 ~78% 的抽水蓄能占全球储能 90% 以上,是电网最大的「电池」
topics.descEn: From the Francis turbine at P=ρQghη ≈ 85% to the reversible unit that pumps uphill on cheap night power and repays at peak, pumped storage is over 90% of world storage — the grid's biggest battery

topics.descZh: 旋转激光头每秒发出上百万个纳秒光脉冲,给每个回波计时 d=c·t/2,把街道逐点画成彩色点云;雾和黑漆会让它失明,所以要摄像头与雷达融合
topics.descEn: A spinning head fires millions of nanosecond pulses per second and times every echo at d = c·t/2, painting the street into a colored point cloud; fog and black paint blind it, hence sensor fusion

topics.titleZh: 开关电源 · 降压变换器
topics.descZh: 线性稳压把多出的电压全烧成热,开关管只用「全开/全关」付零头:占空比即电压比 Vout=D·Vin,电感当电流的飞轮、LC 把斩波磨成直流——效率 95%,充电器又小又不烫的真相
topics.descEn: A linear regulator burns the surplus as heat; a switch pays only the on/off pennies: duty equals ratio, Vout = D·Vin, the inductor flies the current through and LC smooths the chops — 95% efficiency is why chargers run cool and small

topics.descZh: 麦克风拾噪、芯片算反相、扬声器对撞——延迟 0.25 ms 就让 2 kHz 的反相变成同相
topics.descEn: A mic hears, a chip inverts, the driver collides — 0.25 ms of delay turns 2 kHz anti-noise INTO noise

topics.descZh: 微胶囊里带正电的白色 TiO₂ 与带负电的黑色碳黑随电场泳动:白上浮=亮、黑上浮=暗,像素写成;粒子贴壁卡住即双稳态,断电画面原地保持;反射环境光成像像纸,太阳越亮越清楚;整屏闪黑清残影,翻页毫焦、待机零瓦,续航按周计。
topics.descEn: Inside each microcapsule, charged white TiO2 and black carbon pigments swim with the field: white up = bright, black up = dark; flakes jam on the wall so the image persists with zero power; reflective like paper, clearer in sunshine; a full-black flash clears ghosts — mJ per page, 0 W at rest, battery life in weeks.

topics.descZh: 硒鼓黑暗中绝缘、见光即导:电晕丝喷上 −600 V 静电,激光逐行扫描放走背景电荷,文字处留下看不见的电位潜影;反极性墨粉扑上潜影文档现形,转印到纸、180 °C 熔定,清扫归零——转一圈印一页。
topics.descEn: A photoconductive drum insulates in the dark and conducts in light: a corona wire sprays −600 V onto it, a laser discharges the background line by line, and the glyphs survive as an invisible potential latent image; oppositely charged toner slams on, transfer pulls it onto paper, a 180 °C roll fuses it — one revolution, one page.

topics.descZh: 积水在胎前被压成楔形水膜,动压 ½ρv² 从接地面前缘钻入胎底顶起轮胎;接地印缩成细条、摩擦同比例消失。超过 v_H≈6.36√p 整胎打水漂,刹车转向全失灵,ABS 也无米下锅;胎纹沟槽是排水泵,深度就是雨天保命钱。
topics.descEn: Standing water piles into a bow wedge at the tire's leading edge; dynamic pressure ½ρv² wedges under the tread and lifts the car, so the contact patch shrinks to a sliver and grip vanishes in proportion. Past v_H ≈ 6.36√p the whole tire planes — brakes, steering and even ABS go dead. Tread grooves are the pump that keeps you alive.

topics.descZh: 注入 FDG,高代谢细胞哄抢;F-18 衰变放正电子,飞 1–2 mm 撞上电子湮灭成一对背对背的 511 keV γ;晶体环只认 6 ns 内成对到达的符合事件,一条条响应线交叠,亮处就是肿瘤——关掉符合窗,噪声淹没一切。
topics.descEn: Inject FDG and hungry cells grab it: F-18 decays, the positron flies 1–2 mm and annihilates with an electron into two back-to-back 511 keV γ. The ring counts only pairs arriving within ~6 ns — each coincidence is a line through the annihilation point; millions of lines overlap and the tumour glows. Drop the window and randoms drown the image.

topics.descZh: 没有泵也没有电,全靠两件几何:水箱快排把碗内水位顶过存水弯堰口,虹吸点火、一口气把碗抽空;浮子-进水阀负反馈把水位锁回设定线,细流补水管悄悄重建水封——这道几厘米的水弯,是屋里唯一挡着下水道臭气的闸门。
topics.descEn: No pump, no power — just geometry: the tank dumps fast, bowl water crests the trap weir, the siphon ignites and gulps the bowl empty; float-valve feedback refills to a set line while the trickle tube quietly restores the seal — a few centimetres of water are all that bar sewer gas from the room.

topics.descZh: 偏载衣物把 F=mrω² 甩进悬挂:过共振区振幅飙到 12 mm 就触发保护——降速翻滚把衣物摊匀,再二次升速;弹簧存冲击、阻尼器把它变热,阻尼比 0.2 弹个不停、0.35 一晃就稳;振幅-转速曲线每个峰,都是一次「重新分布」。
topics.descEn: An off-centre load flings F=mrω² into the suspension; when amplitude spikes past 12 mm near resonance the machine slows, tumbles the load even, then spins up again — springs bank the shock, dampers spend it as heat, ζ=0.2 bounces on while 0.35 settles in one sway; every peak on the amplitude-rpm curve is a re-distribution event.

topics.descZh: 燃烧三角缺一角就灭:压缩氮气把干粉顶上虹吸管、喷向火焰根部——磷酸铵盐覆盖表面隔绝氧气、吸热降温,还顺手捕获 H·/OH· 掐断链式反应;CO₂ 靠 1.5 倍空气密度沉底闷熄;压力表掉进红区,就是复燃的倒计时。
topics.descEn: Knock out one leg of the fire triangle: nitrogen drives dry powder up the siphon tube to the flame base — monoammonium phosphate smothers, cools, and scavenges H·/OH· radicals to break the chain reaction; CO₂ at 1.5× air density floods low and suffocates; a gauge in the red is a countdown to re-ignition.

topics.descZh: 用 5 V 几十毫安的线圈电流,换来 220 V 十安负载的通断:线圈通电、铁芯吸合衔铁、触点「啪」地闭合;断电瞬间 L·di/dt 把线圈电压顶到 −237 V,续流二极管把它钳回 −0.8 V;辅助触点并联启动按钮,就是最老的自锁电路。
topics.descEn: A 5 V, tens-of-milliamp coil buys control of a 220 V, 10 A load: energize the coil, the armature snaps over, contacts close; on release L·di/dt spikes the coil to −237 V unless a flyback diode clamps it at −0.8 V; an auxiliary contact paralleled with the start button is the original latch circuit.

topics.descZh: 敞口沸腾是恒温器,温度顶死 100 °C;扣上限压阀蒸汽憋住,压强抬到 1.7 bar,饱和曲线把沸点抬到 115 °C——高 15 °C 速率翻倍,炖煮时间减半;配重阀超标就跳喷,冷却不泄压,大气压把盖子焊死。
topics.descEn: Open boiling is a thermostat pinned at 100 °C. Seal the regulator and steam backs up to 1.7 bar, where the saturation curve puts boiling at 115 °C — fifteen degrees that double reaction rates and halve cooking times. The weighted valve chatters when over-pressure; cool without venting and the atmosphere welds the lid shut.

topics.descZh: 磁吸引是不稳定平衡,越近吸得越狠:EMS 用传感器闭环把 10 mm 气隙一秒千次保住,断反馈当场吸死;EDS 靠超导磁体在轨道线圈里感生排斥,越快越稳、低速浮不起——轮子先跑,悬浮后只剩风阻,500 km/h 反而划算。
topics.descEn: Magnetic attraction is unstable — closer means stronger. EMS holds a 10 mm gap with a feedback loop firing a thousand times a second; cut it and the gap slams shut. EDS lets superconducting magnets induce repulsion in track coils — stronger with speed, useless at rest, so wheels first. After levitation only air drag remains, and 500 km/h starts to make sense.

topics.descZh: 提升链是全程唯一的发动机:mgh 充值、俯冲换速、回环要 v≥√(gr)、失重山丘座椅松手——能量账本逐米扣款,质量不影响圈速。
topics.descEn: The lift chain is the ride's only motor: mgh deposited, the drop cashes it for speed, loops demand v≥√(gr), crests let go — friction debits meter by meter and mass never matters.

topics.descZh: 摆锤惯性锁、8 ms 火药预紧器收紧 4 cm、限力器 6 kN 故意放带钳住峰值,气囊 30 ms 接住头——不系带的头部减速度峰值差五倍。
topics.descEn: A pendulum inertia lock, a pyro pretensioner cinching 4 cm in 8 ms, a limiter paying out past 6 kN, the bag catching at 30 ms — the unbelted head peaks five times higher.

topics.descZh: Y 形通道把两排凸角依次咬合,劈尖负责拆开;横向拉开时斜面把拉力变成法向压力,tanα<μ 就是自锁——拉不开靠几何不靠强度。
topics.descEn: A Y-channel interleaves two rows of wedges; horns pry them apart on the way back. Sideways, flanks turn tension into normal pressure — tan α < μ locks by geometry, not strength.

topics.descZh: 弯月面封住 20 μm 喷嘴;热泡 2 μs 煮出一次性蒸汽活塞,压电直接挤墨;液滴断裂拖出卫星滴,毛细回填连射 10 kHz——纸走过,点阵成字。
topics.descEn: Surface tension seals a 20 μm nozzle; the thermal bubble is a one-shot steam piston, piezo just squeezes; satellites betray excess energy, capillary refills at 10 kHz — dots become words.

topics.descZh: 蒸发吸潜热、蒸汽压差快递、冷凝放热、毛细芯泵回——一根管子近等温,等效导热是铜几十倍;功率超过回流能力就干烧失控。
topics.descEn: Evaporation freighted with latent heat, vapor racing on its own Δp, condensation into fins, the wick pumping liquid back — near-isothermal at tens of copper, until dry-out.

topics.descZh: 铯超精细跃迁 9,192,631,770 Hz 就是"秒"的定义:磁选态、微波腔敲门、检测电流画出共振峰,反馈把石英按在峰顶——GPS 每天靠它修 38 μs。
topics.descEn: The Cs hyperfine jump at 9,192,631,770 Hz defines the second: state selection, a 9.19 GHz knock, detector current tracing the bell — feedback pins quartz; GPS corrects 38 μs a day.

topics.descZh: 一个塔功率有限,把地图切成六边形蜂窝、同频隔远复用;跨过小区边界,信号曲线交叉的瞬间切换基站,通话不掐线。
topics.descEn: One tower's power only stretches so far, so the map is cut into hexagonal cells with frequencies reused at a distance; cross the boundary and the signal curves cross — the call hands over without dropping.

topics.descZh: X 光把 3D 压成 2D,骨头后面全糊;CT 绕头一圈记下正弦图,滤波反投影逐角刷回切片——从模糊晕影锐化出颅骨与出血灶。
topics.descEn: An X-ray flattens 3D into 2D and hides what's behind bone; a CT circles the head filling a sinogram, and filtered back-projection smears the slice sharp angle by angle — skull, ventricles and bleed emerge.

topics.descZh: 燃气射流按文丘里卷吸一次空气,火孔上同时点燃预混内锥与扩散外焰——蓝是足氧的完全燃烧;空气门一关,蓝焰当场变黄:半熟的碳粒被烧成 1200 K 的黑体小灯珠,黑烟积碳;气流慢过火焰速度回火,快过吹熄极限脱火。
topics.descEn: The gas jet entrains primary air Venturi-style, and the port lights a premixed inner cone inside a diffusion mantle — blue is complete combustion with air to spare; shut the shutter and blue turns yellow on the spot: half-burnt soot glows as 1200 K blackbody beads and deposits as grime; flow slower than flame speed lights back, faster and the flame blows off.

topics.descZh: 洗碗机靠 60–70 °C 定向射流轰击:循环泵约 25 L/min 送水,喷口反冲力矩 τ≈ṁ·v·r·sinθ 让喷臂无电机自转;酶在 50–65 °C 剪碎蛋白淀粉,表面活性剂卷走油脂,亮碟剂使水铺膜不留斑;全程 9–12 L 水、约 1 kWh,手洗需 60–100 L。
topics.descEn: A dishwasher cleans by bombarding dishes with aimed 60–70 °C jets: the pump pushes ~25 L/min, and recoil torque τ≈ṁ·v·r·sinθ spins the arms with no motor; enzymes cut protein and starch at 50–65 °C, surfactants roll up grease, rinse aid makes water sheet off spotless — 9–12 L and ~1 kWh per cycle vs 60–100 L by hand.

topics.descZh: 两位判官守一条回路:过载 1.45×In 时双金属按 I² 积热慢弯、一小时内顶开锁扣,容忍电机 5–7×In 启动浪涌;短路 5×In 以上线圈吸力∝(NI)² 瞬间吸动衔铁、10 ms 猛拉触头;弧角把电弧拉上钢片栅切成 11 段短弧,弧压升至约 340 V 反超 230 V 电源,电流被强制过零熄灭。
topics.descEn: Two judges guard one loop: at 1.45×In overload the bimetal heats as I² and trips within an hour, tolerating 5–7×In motor inrush; above 5×In the coil pull ∝(NI)² snaps the contacts open in 10 ms; runners lift the arc onto steel plates that slice it into segments, arc voltage beats the supply and forces a current-zero extinction.

topics.descZh: 白天峰荷,上库放水冲下 500 m 落差,可逆式水轮机正转发电点亮城市;深夜低谷,同一台机器反转成泵,用基荷余电把水抽回山巅;一根轴两种身份:抽 100 份电发回约 76 份,往返效率 ~76%,响应 1–3 分钟,占全球电网储能装机九成以上。
topics.descEn: At evening peak, water plunges 500 m down the penstock and the reversible turbine spins forward, generating power; in the nightly valley the same machine reverses into a pump. One shaft, two identities: 100 units in, ~76 out — 76% round-trip efficiency, full power in 1–3 minutes, over 90% of the world's grid storage.

topics.descZh: 红/绿/蓝三颗芯片各以 1 kHz PWM 调光，8 位占空比→256³=1677 万色；人眼空间积分子像素成感知混合色；Gamma 2.2 曲线对齐感知均匀步长；OLED 各像素自发光——关闭时真正黑，LCD 背光漏光泛灰。
topics.descEn: Red/green/blue chips each PWM-dimmed at 1 kHz; 8-bit duty cycle → 256³=16.7 M colors; the eye spatially integrates sub-pixels into perceived blended color; Gamma 2.2 maps linear light to perceptual equal steps; OLED pixels self-emit — true black when off, no backlight bleed.

topics.descZh: 电池→逆变器(~98%)→永磁同步电机(~95%)→单速减速齿轮(~98%)→车轮，整体约 91%，是内燃机的 3 倍；再生制动把动能反向回收约 70%；寒冷使内阻升高、续航缩短 10–30%。
topics.descEn: Battery → inverter (~98%) → PMSM (~95%) → single-speed reduction (~98%) → wheels — overall ~91%, triple an ICE; regen braking recovers ~70% of kinetic energy on deceleration; cold raises internal resistance and cuts range 10–30%.

topics.titleZh: 核裂变链式反应与反应堆
topics.descZh: U-235 吸收热中子→裂变放 ~200 MeV+2-3 个快中子；水慢化至热能；k=1 临界稳态，控制棒吸收中子调节 k；0.65% 缓发中子让操作员来得及响应；SCRAM 一键插棒，链式反应瞬间熄灭。
topics.descEn: U-235 absorbs a thermal neutron → fission releases ~200 MeV + 2-3 fast neutrons; water moderates them to thermal energy; k=1 is the critical steady state; control rods absorb neutrons to tune k; 0.65% delayed neutrons give operators time to respond — SCRAM inserts all rods and kills the chain reaction instantly.

topics.descZh: 河水进厂闯四道关:混凝——铝盐中和胶体 Zeta 电位,「矾花」越滚越大;沉淀——矾花沉底刮走;过滤——一米石英砂截住漏网,活性炭吃掉异味;消毒——次氯酸钠氧化病原体,留 0.3–0.5 mg/L 余氯护送进管网;浊度从几十 NTU 降到 1 以下,一吨水约 0.3 kWh——龙头的每一秒都是四道关的接力。
topics.descEn: River water runs four gates: coagulation — aluminum salts neutralize the colloids' zeta potential and "flocs" snowball; sedimentation — flocs settle and are scraped away; filtration — a metre of sand catches stragglers while carbon eats taste; disinfection — hypochlorite oxidizes pathogens, leaving 0.3–0.5 mg/L chlorine to guard the pipes; turbidity falls below 1 NTU for ~0.3 kWh per tonne — every second at your tap is this relay.

topics.descZh: CPU 一拍取一数、内存约两百拍：中间垫 L1/L2/L3，按 64 B 整行搬运，访问一字节、八个邻居一起上车；行序扫矩阵每 8 次访问只付 1 次 miss，列序每步都踩新行，同样的算法耗时差数倍；多核各存一份时靠 MESI 写失效与回写，缓存之间不打架。
topics.descEn: The CPU takes one number per cycle while DRAM needs ~200: L1/L2/L3 caches bridge the gap in 64-byte lines — touch one byte and its 7 neighbors ride along. Row-major scanning pays one miss per 8 accesses; column-major trips a fresh line every step, and the same algorithm runs several-fold slower. Multi-core copies stay coherent via MESI invalidation and writeback.

topics.descZh: GPU 画一帧就是把每个三角形切成像素：只在包围盒内逐像素算边缘函数判内外，重心坐标把三个顶点的颜色和深度插到像素上，z-buffer 每像素只留最近的；百万像素全并行——上千个小核心同一时刻跑同一份短程序，所以它不怕重复、就怕 if 分支。
topics.descEn: Drawing a frame means slicing every triangle into pixels: edge functions test inside/outside within the bounding box, barycentric coordinates interpolate vertex color and depth per pixel, and the z-buffer keeps only the nearest hit. Millions of pixels run in parallel — thousands of tiny cores executing the same short program, which is why GPUs love repetition and hate branches.

topics.descZh: 全网同步发电机被电网「焊」成一个旋转体，50 Hz 就是发电-用电平衡的实时天平；负荷突增的瞬间，转子动能被抽走、频率跌破 49.9，调速器按下垂特性秒级顶上（有差），AGC 积分器分钟级追平（无差）；惯量 H 决定跌落斜率——风电光伏经变流器并网不背惯量，同扰动跌得更快更深。
topics.descEn: All synchronous generators are welded by the grid into one great rotor, and 50 Hz is the live balance of generation against load. A load step steals rotor kinetic energy and frequency sags past 49.9; governors push back within seconds (droop, with offset) and the AGC integrator restores exactly 50.00. Inertia H sets the slope of the dip — converter-connected wind and solar carry none, so the same event bites deeper and faster.

topics.descZh: LED 斜照桌面，微透镜把表面纹理成像到一颗 18×18 的小 CMOS 上，以约 1500 fps 连拍；芯片把相邻两帧做块匹配互相关，误差最小的相关峰给出位移，乘以像素比例就是移动量——表面纹理是「标尺」；光滑玻璃无纹理、相关峰消失，光标于是不走；滚轮则是一枚光学编码器。
topics.descEn: An LED rakes light across the desk and a lens images the surface texture onto a tiny 18x18 CMOS shooting ~1500 fps. The chip block-matches consecutive frames: the correlation peak's shift, times the pixel scale, is the motion — the texture is the ruler. Smooth glass has no texture, the peak vanishes, and the cursor stops; the scroll wheel is an optical encoder.

topics.descZh: 窦房结停摆或房室传导阻滞时心室没人点火，几秒停搏就能晕厥；起搏电极以 2–5 V、0.4–1.5 ms 的脉冲「夺获」心肌，阈值以上必然起搏；按需模式感知到自身心跳就抑制、消失才发放；DDD 双腔心房感知-心室跟踪，把房室同步还给心脏。
topics.descEn: When the SA node stalls or AV conduction blocks, nobody fires the ventricle and seconds of asystole cause syncope. The lead captures myocardium with a 2–5 V, 0.4–1.5 ms pulse — above threshold, capture is guaranteed. Demand mode senses every intrinsic beat and stays silent; DDD tracks the atrium and paces the ventricle after a fixed AV delay, restoring AV synchrony.

topics.descZh: 自然呼吸靠膈肌下拉造负压「吸」，呼吸机反过来用正压把气「推」进肺：PEEP 在呼气末撑开塌陷肺泡、可交换面积变大，潮气量决定进气量；容量控制定流量、压力随肺的硬度浮动，压力控制定压力、潮气量随顺应性变；肺保护通气 6 mL/kg+平台压<30，ARDS 肺变硬后同样参数压力飙升。
topics.descEn: Nature inhales by pulling the diaphragm down; a ventilator pushes air in with positive pressure instead. PEEP splints collapsed alveoli open at end-expiration, growing the exchange area; tidal volume sets the dose. Volume control fixes flow and lets pressure float with lung stiffness; pressure control fixes pressure and lets volume float with compliance. Lung-protective ventilation means 6 mL/kg and Pplat < 30 — stiffen the lung to ARDS and the same settings slam into the red.

topics.descZh: PDAF 把镜头两侧的像素各看半个光瞳：对焦不准时两幅半像错位，φ=kφ·离焦量是条直线——互相关量出错位就知道往哪拧、拧多少，一两步落位；CDAF 只会测对比度在山坡上爬，来回试错慢好几拍；暗光下噪声淹没 φ、山坡被铲平，激光 ToF 便来补位，VCM 音圈每秒推着镜头平移几十次追焦。
topics.descEn: PDAF gives half the pupil to each side of the sensor: defocus shifts the two half-images by φ=kφ·defocus, a straight line — measure the offset by cross-correlation and you know exactly where to move the lens, landing in one or two steps. CDAF just climbs the contrast hill, trial by trial and much slower; in dim light noise drowns φ and the hill flattens until laser ToF takes over, while the VCM voice coil shuttles the lens dozens of times a second.

topics.descZh: 方向盘转角给出「想要」的横摆 r=v·tanδ/L，陀螺仪加轮速测出「实际」的横摆，两者一差就是失控指令：推头是前轴先到附着极限、车头往外滑，甩尾是后轴失附、横摆发散自旋；ESP 每秒采样 25 次以上，对内侧后轮或外侧前轮单轮闪红制动产生纠正横摆力矩、同时收油，两条横摆曲线当场收拢——湿滑路面失控率因此降约一半。
topics.descEn: Steering angle sets the wanted yaw r=v·tanδ/L; a gyro and wheel speeds measure the actual yaw — their difference is the loss. Understeer saturates the front axle and the nose plows wide; oversteer lets the rear go and yaw diverges into a spin. Sampling ≥25 Hz, ESP flashes red on one braked wheel — inner rear or outer front — while cutting throttle, and the two yaw curves collapse together: wet-road loss-of-control crashes drop by about half.

topics.descZh: 水烧到 ~98 °C 温度就钉在沸腾平台，700 W 全变成汽化潜热，米边吸水边糊化；自由水烧干的一瞬热容骤降，锅底温度脱离沸点向上飞冲——底部的感温磁钢在 103–105 °C 失磁跳闸断电，「跳闸」本身就是饭熟的传感器；水太多永远烧不干就是煮粥，水太少提前跳闸就是夹生。
topics.descEn: At ~98 °C the temperature pins on a boiling plateau and all 700 W goes into latent heat while the rice absorbs and gelatinizes. The instant free water dies, heat capacity plummets and the pot bottom surges past boiling — until the Curie-point magnet loses its grip at 103–105 °C and trips the power. The trip IS the doneness sensor: too much water never dries (porridge), too little trips early (crunchy rice).

topics.descZh: 指纹是周期 ~0.5mm 的凸脊-凹谷花纹;电容阵列逐格测触点电容,脊贴得近电容大、谷悬空电容小,拼出脊亮谷暗的灰度像;湿手=水把脊谷桥接,对比度被抹平;超声脉冲穿透表皮在真皮层回波成像,脏污湿手都挡不住,光学式靠全反射在脊处漏光;识别只存细节点(端点/分叉)不存图片,分数过阈值才解锁——低了误识,高了拒识。
topics.descEn: A fingerprint is a ~0.5 mm pattern of ridges and valleys. A capacitive array reads each contact cell: ridges touch close (big C, bright), valleys hover (small C, dark), assembling a grayscale image. A wet finger bridges ridge and valley and washes the contrast away; ultrasound pulses penetrate to the dermis and echo back, ignoring water and grime; optics frustrate total internal reflection at ridge contact. Matching stores minutiae — endings and bifurcations — never the picture; the score must beat the threshold: too low accepts strangers, too high rejects owners.

topics.descZh: 「我在哪」与「房间长什么样」是同一个问题的两面:LDS 测距头每秒转数圈刷出点云,与已有地图扫描匹配,把轮式里程计的漂移拉回零;命中格记墙、光路格记空,占据栅格边走边长;弓字形分区覆盖逐行推进,随机碰撞式在同房间覆盖率爬得又慢又乱;悬崖传感器避楼梯口,低电量回充后从断点续扫。
topics.descEn: "Where am I" and "what does the room look like" are two faces of one problem: the spinning LDS head brushes out point clouds several turns a second, and scan-matching them against the existing map pulls odometry drift back to zero. Hit cells become walls, ray cells become free — the occupancy grid grows as it goes. Boustrophedon coverage sweeps row by row while random bouncing crawls across the same room; cliff sensors dodge the stairwell, and a low battery docks and resumes from the breakpoint.

topics.descZh: 功率=电压×电流:老 USB 5V×2A 只有 10W;PD 协议先在 CC 线上「握手」——充电器广播 5/9/15/20V 电压档,手机按电池状态点菜、几百毫秒重新协商;电池恒流灌到 ~80% 转恒压涓流,越接近满越慢是保护;温度越过 40°C 热管理自动降档限流;PPS 连续调压让 buck 始终待在效率最优点。
topics.descEn: Power = voltage × current: old USB 5V×2A is just 10 W. USB-PD first "handshakes" on the CC line — the charger advertises its 5/9/15/20 V gears, the phone orders by battery state and re-negotiates every few hundred ms. The cell charges at constant current to ~80%, then constant-voltage trickle: slower near full is protection, not a fault. Past 40 °C thermal management downshifts; PPS continuous voltage keeps the buck at its efficiency sweet spot.

topics.descZh: 光子打进 p-n 结耗尽区，把电子踢上导带、留下空穴；没有电场它们几纳米内复合、光子的功白干；内建 0.7 V 电场在复合前把电子扫向 n 区、空穴扫向 p 区，接通外电路电流就流过——硅电池 1.1 eV 带隙决定红外穿透明、超额能量变热。
topics.descEn: A photon lands in the depletion region, kicks an electron to the conduction band and leaves a hole; with no field the pair recombines within nanometers and the work is lost; the junction's built-in 0.7 V sweeps electrons to n and holes to p before they reunite — close the circuit and current flows; silicon's 1.1 eV gap lets infrared slip through and turns excess energy into heat.

topics.descZh: 几十级梯级首尾铰接绕成闭合环：上段踏板翻平载客，两端转向处翻立收进桁架底下空跑回来；电机拖动链轮、链条拽着整队梯级走，扶手带必须严格同速——滑差一点就把乘客往前"吃"；30° 倾角 1 m/s，一台一小时送近万人。
topics.descEn: Dozens of steps hinge into a closed loop: treads flatten to carry riders, fold upright at the landings and ride back inside the truss; a motor turns the sprocket and the chain drags the whole train, while the handrail must match exactly — any slip

topics.descZh: 读写器发出 13.56 MHz 交变磁场，标签线圈感应取电、整流唤醒芯片；芯片没有发射机，它靠拉自己的负载"反射"出 0/1——读写器天线电压随之微幅起伏，解码成 ID；无源标签读几厘米到一米，ETC 与有源标签自带电池能跑上百米。
topics.descEn: A reader radiates a 13.56 MHz field; the tag's coil harvests it, rectifies, and boots the chip; with no transmitter aboard, the chip answers by toggling its own load — the reader's antenna voltage wobbles 0/1 and decodes the ID; passive tags read centimeters to a meter, while battery-backed ETC tags reach hundreds of meters.

topics.descZh: 热量自己只会从热到冷,所以要用压缩机做功把它搬上去:高温高压的气体在冷凝器里放热变液,毛细管一节流压强骤降,蒸发器里吸热汽化——这才是冷的地方;COP=T_c/(T_h−T_c),温差越大越费电。
topics.descEn: Heat only flows hot→cold on its own, so a compressor is paid to pump it uphill: hot high-pressure gas sheds heat in the condenser, the capillary tube slashes the pressure, and the evaporator absorbs heat as it boils — that's where the cold is; COP=T_c/(T_h−T_c), and bigger gaps cost more watts.

topics.descZh: 天线发 10.5 GHz 的微波迎着你,你走近时反射波带上了多普勒频移——它探测的是「移动」,站着不动它就不开门;频移超阈值电机带动吊轮开门,保持时间倒数后再关,光幕被挡当场反转。
topics.descEn: An antenna beams 10.5 GHz microwaves at you, and your approach Doppler-shifts the echo — it senses motion, so stand still and it won't open; past the threshold a motor drives the hanging rollers, a hold timer counts down to close, and the light curtain reverses the door the instant you're in it.

topics.descZh: 三个「回」字让任何角度都能摆正,黑白格是 0/1 数据,掩膜打散大色块;Reed-Solomon 纠错拿一半码字做预算,擦掉三成照样扫得出——超过预算那一刻,当场失败。
topics.descEn: Three nested squares square up any rotation, the black-and-white modules are 0/1 data, a mask breaks up big monochrome blocks; Reed–Solomon spends half the codewords as budget, so a third can be torn away and it still scans — cross the budget and it fails on the spot.

topics.descZh: 笔尖 0.5 mm 钢珠既是阀门又是碾墨机:滚动把粘稠油墨卷出铺在纸上,重力不在供墨路径上,所以倒着也能写——粘度是全场关键
topics.descEn: The 0.5 mm ball is valve and mill at once: rolling drags viscous ink out onto the paper, and since gravity plays no part in feeding, it writes upside down — viscosity runs the whole show

topics.descZh: 头盔不靠「硬」保命靠「碎」:EPS 泡沫压溃 2 cm 把几毫秒的冲击拉长,峰值加速度腰斩再腰斩——动量定理 F·t=Δp 里,时间就是命
topics.descEn: A helmet saves you by crushing, not by being hard: 2 cm of EPS foam stretches a millisecond impact, halving peak acceleration again and again — in F·t=Δp, time is life

topics.descZh: 把沿线红绿灯按距离/车速排成时刻表,车队一路遇绿:绿波是空间在时间里的投影;速度一偏波就散架,时空图里它是一条斜带
topics.descEn: Time the signals by distance over speed and the platoon rides green all the way: a green wave is space projected into time; drift off the design speed and the band falls apart — on the space-time diagram it's one diagonal stripe

topics.descZh: 一滴样本沿硝酸纤维膜自己爬:金纳米颗粒带着抗体抓住目标分子,流到 T 线被第二抗体逮住成夹心显色,C 线则始终抓游离金标——C 线不亮,这试纸作废
topics.descEn: A drop crawls up the nitrocellulose strip on its own: gold nanoparticles drag antibodies that catch the target, the T line traps the sandwich and shows color, and the C line always catches free gold — no C line, void test

topics.descZh: 发射线圈把交变磁场打进地里,金属里的涡流回敬一个反磁场:接收线圈一失衡,电桥当场报警——铁的相位与非铁不同,扫频一比就能分家
topics.descEn: The transmitter coil drives an alternating field into the ground and eddy currents answer with an opposing field: the receiver goes off balance and the bridge alarms — ferrous and non-ferrous answer in different phase, so a frequency sweep sorts them

topics.descZh: 指甲盖上的硅雕质量块被四根悬臂梁吊着,加速度一来它就滞后偏移,两侧梳齿电容立刻读出差值:重力也是加速度,所以静置的手机知道自己歪没歪
topics.descEn: A silicon proof mass hangs on four etched springs; under acceleration it lags behind, and the comb capacitors on both sides read the shift instantly — gravity is an acceleration too, which is how a still phone knows which way is down

topics.descZh: LCD 靠背光硬挡、黑仍漏光；OLED 把光源拆到每个像素：空穴与电子在发光层复合成激子、落回能隙发出光子——选材即选色，TFT 独立开关让黑屏零发光，代价是蓝光先老、烧屏留影
topics.descEn: An LCD fights its always-on backlight and leaks gray into black; OLED breaks light into every pixel — holes and electrons recombine into excitons that fall across the emitter's gap as photons. Pick the molecule, pick the color; black truly draws zero, until blue ages.

topics.descZh: 一滴血被虹吸进反应腔：葡萄糖氧化酶专一咬住葡萄糖，介体从酶手里接走电子跑到电极上放电——恒电位下电流正比浓度，五秒读数；干扰物也能交电子，试纸得用电压筛掉它们
topics.descEn: A drop wicks into the reaction chamber: glucose oxidase grips only glucose, mediators ferry electrons to the electrode, and at a fixed potential the current reads concentration in five seconds. Interferents donate electrons too — the strip's voltage screens them out.

topics.descZh: 电池只有 3 V，电蚊拍要上千伏：二极管与电容搭成倍压梯，正负半周各充一半、每一级都踩着上一级的肩——输出≈2N·V峰值；蚊子碰网当场短路放电，火花一声、电压跳水再缓缓回充
topics.descEn: The cell holds 3 V but the grid wants kilovolts: diodes and capacitors stack a Cockcroft–Walton ladder, each half-cycle charging every other stage on the shoulders of the last — output ≈ 2N·V. A mosquito shorts the grid: one spark, the voltage dives, then refills.

topics.descZh: 熔喷布的纤维迷宫有三招:大颗粒惯性撞纤维、中颗粒直接拦截、小于 0.1µm 的布朗乱步撞运气——唯独 0.3µm 上下一身轻;驻极静电把这最难一段拽下来,汗水一泡就前功尽弃
topics.descEn: The melt-blown fiber maze works three tricks: big particles crash by inertia, mid-size ones are intercepted outright, sub-0.1 µm ones wander in on Brownian luck — only near 0.3 µm does a particle sail through; electret charge drags that hardest band down, and one soak of sweat undoes it

topics.descZh: 秤不是直接称重,是称「铝梁弯了多少」:应变片栅丝随梁微伸微缩,电阻变一点点;四片接成惠斯通电桥,温漂互相抵消,毫伏级输出标定成克
topics.descEn: A scale doesn't weigh mass, it weighs how much an aluminum beam bends: strain-gauge grids stretch and shrink with it, resistance shifting slightly; four gauges in a Wheatstone bridge cancel temperature drift, and millivolts become grams

topics.descZh: 正常回路火线电流必须等于零线电流;一旦有人成了「另一条路」,差动线圈立刻察觉 30mA 的差额,25 毫秒内跳闸——地线则是提前铺好的逃生道,让保护器在你之前先动
topics.descEn: In a healthy loop the live current must equal the neutral current; the moment you become

topics.descZh: 红光与红外穿过指尖:氧合血红蛋白与脱氧血红蛋白对两色吸收不同,脉搏那一下的波动把动脉血从组织背景里减出来——两只 LED 加一个光电管,四舍五入就是无创血氧
topics.descEn: Red and infrared cross a fingertip: oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin absorb the two colors differently, and the pulse's surge lets arterial blood be subtracted from tissue background — two LEDs and a photodiode round off to needle-free SpO₂

topics.descZh: 毛细胞坏了声音就断了?绕过它:麦克风采声、处理器按频率分道、电极沿耳蜗螺旋按音高排布直接刺激听神经——把声学换成电学,大脑自己学会重新听
topics.descEn: Hair cells dead, sound lost? Bypass them: a microphone feeds a processor that splits bands, electrodes threaded along the cochlear spiral stimulate the nerve low-to-high by place — acoustics swapped for electrics, and the brain teaches itself to hear again

topics.descZh: 把已知条纹投到脸上,相机看它如何被几何扭曲:条纹的位移就是深度——每一点从两组射线交会中解出坐标;红外点阵每秒铺三万点,解锁手机的面容
topics.descEn: Project known stripes onto a face and watch geometry warp them: each stripe's displacement is depth — every point solves its coordinates from the intersection of two rays; an infrared grid lays down thirty thousand dots a second to unlock your phone

topics.descZh: 热只有三条逃路:传导、对流、辐射——保温瓶逐条设卡:真空夹层让传导与对流无路可走,镀银内壁把辐射原路弹回,瓶塞堵住最后一道窄门;热水十二小时只掉几十度,反过来冷饮也一样保得住;杜瓦当年发明它,是为了存住液化气体,后来才轮到咖啡
topics.descEn: Heat has only three escape routes — conduction, convection, radiation — and the vacuum flask blocks each in turn: the vacuum jacket starves conduction and convection, the silvered walls bounce radiation straight back, the stopper narrows the last door; hot water drops just a few dozen degrees in twelve hours, and cold drinks get the same service; Dewar built it for liquefied gases — coffee came later

topics.descZh: 脚踩踏板推总泵活塞,刹车油把同样的压强送到四只分泵——帕斯卡定律是整条油路的宪法;油路做成 X 型双回路,断一路还剩对角一半;真空助力器借发动机负压放大脚力;真正要命的是油沸腾:气泡可压缩,脚感瞬间变棉花——换油的日历不是仪式,是保命
topics.descEn: The pedal shoves the master-cylinder piston and brake fluid hands the same pressure to all four calipers — Pascal's law is the constitution of the circuit; the lines cross in an X, so one failed loop still leaves the diagonal half; a vacuum booster borrows intake manifold suction to amplify your foot; the real killer is boiling fluid — vapor compresses, the pedal goes to mush — and the brake-fluid calendar is survival, not ritual

topics.descZh: 遥控器把指令写成 38 kHz 载波上的时间密码:9 毫秒引导码开路,32 位地址加命令再加反码,每位用 560 微秒的脉冲加不同长度的间隔分出 0 和 1;载波不是花腔——阳光与灯泡的红外噪声是低频的,38 kHz 带通接收器只认这段高频闪烁;一键一码,音量长按是 110 毫秒一次的重复码
topics.descEn: The remote writes its command as a time-code on a 38 kHz carrier: a 9 ms lead pulse, 32 bits of address, command and inverted command, each bit a 560 µs burst told apart by the gap length; the carrier isn't ornament — sunlight and lamps spray low-frequency infrared noise, and the 38 kHz band-pass receiver only answers this flicker; one key one code, and held volume keys repeat every 110 ms

topics.descZh: 定码钥匙被「抓空气+重放」一次秒破;滚动码让钥匙与车共享计数器和密钥:每次按下发送 E_K(counter++),车校验前 256 个同步窗 → 重放的旧报文早已过期被拒;盲区按了几百次靠窗口重同步,超出才回退配对;Keeloq 66 位、现代 AES-128 变体;中继攻击不破码只实时转发——防它靠距离
topics.descEn: A fixed-code fob dies to one capture-and-replay. Rolling code shares a counter and key between fob and car: every press sends E_K(counter++), the car accepts within a 256-step window — replays are expired and refused. Out-of-sync presses resync through the window; beyond it, pairing. Keeloq 66 bits, now AES-128 variants. Relay attacks never crack the code, just forward it — the defense is distance.

topics.descZh: 手抖是 5–8 Hz、±0.5–1° 的角晃动,1/30 s 快门里影像抹过几十像素;陀螺测角速度 → 控制器算补偿 → 音圈电机把浮动镜组横向平移 δ=f·tanθ(50 mm 每 1° 平移 0.87 mm),让光原路打回同一像素;光学防抖买 3–5 档快门(8–32 倍曝光);五轴机身防抖再加旋转;防抖稳住的是相机不是被摄物——追拍照样糊
topics.descEn: Handshake is ±0.5-1° of angular wander at 5-8 Hz; a 1/30 s shutter smears the image over dozens of pixels. The gyro senses the rate, the controller commands a voice-coil motor to shift the floating lens by δ=f·tanθ (0.87 mm per degree at 50 mm), bouncing the light back to the same pixel. That buys 3-5 stops (8-32x exposure); five-axis sensor-shift adds rotation. OIS stills the camera, not the subject — panning still blurs.

topics.descZh: 2 mm 辐条的欧拉屈曲临界只有 ~23 N,连一壶水都撑不住;轮子靠预紧活:32 根辐条各 ~1000 N 把轮圈绷成预应力结构;500 N 载荷只让轮毂下方辐条减载 10–15%,上方几乎不变——轮毂挂在上层辐条上;剪断一根邻居立刻补位;张力不均,轮圈跳「8」字
topics.descEn: A 2 mm spoke buckles at ~23 N — it could not hold a kettle. The wheel lives on pretension: 32 spokes at ~1000 N stretch the rim into a prestressed structure. A 500 N rider only unloads the bottom spokes 10-15% — the hub hangs from the upper ones. Cut one and its neighbors take over at once; uneven tension hops the rim in a figure of eight.

topics.descZh: 底部发热盘把 2000 W 灌进一升水,100 °C 一到温度钉住——多出来的电全在造蒸汽;一缕蒸汽顺气道冲上手柄顶的蒸汽开关,双金属片跳变「咔哒」断电;空烧没有蒸汽,锅底温控器高温兜底
topics.descEn: The base element pours 2000 W into a liter of water; at 100 °C the temperature pins — every extra watt makes steam; a wisp races up the channel to the steam switch, a bimetal disc snaps and cuts the mains; a dry boil makes no steam, so a plate thermostat backs it up
