topics.descZh: 2.4 GHz 是拥挤走廊:Wi-Fi、微波炉全在里面;蓝牙切成 79 条小巷,主从按同一伪随机序列每 625 µs 换巷子说话——单个干扰最多毁一个时隙;被反复打脏的信道进 AFH 黑名单,图样当场重排
topics.descEn: 2.4 GHz is a crowded corridor: Wi-Fi, microwaves, earbuds all inside; Bluetooth slices it into 79 alleys, hopping every 625 µs on a shared pseudo-random sequence — one interferer ruins one slot at most; repeatedly dirty channels get AFH-blacklisted and the map rewires live

topics.descZh: 小票上的字不是墨——涂层里无色染料与显色剂相安无事,打印头一排微电阻把点位瞬间烤到 200 °C,染料熔化遇显色剂分子重排现出黑字;一排点打一行,走纸一行行;不用墨盒,代价是纸会自己慢慢褪色
topics.descEn: A receipt’s print isn’t ink — leuco dye and developer sit at peace until a row of micro-resistors flashes dots to 200 °C, dye melts, meets developer and flips black; one array prints a row, the paper steps; no cartridge — paid for in paper that slowly fades

topics.descZh: 9 bar 的过热水穿过压实的粉饼,咖啡粉就是阻力床:布粉不均水就抄近道——通道效应让一半过萃、一半欠萃;预浸先低压润床、主萃取再全压;25 秒出 36 g 落在黄金萃取带,CO₂ 与油乳化成金色 crema
topics.descEn: Nine bars of hot water are driven through a tamped puck — the puck is a resistance bed, and uneven distribution lets water cheat through channels, over-extracting half while starving the rest; a low-pressure pre-infusion evens the bed; 36 g in 25 s rides the golden extraction band

topics.descZh: 避雷针不吸雷,它抢雷:下行先导逐级下探时,曲率半径最小的尖端场强最先爆表、发出上行先导迎上去——闪电选最顺的路;接闪后电流沿引下线与接地网泄入大地,保护范围按滚球法画,楼里的人躲在同一枚法拉第笼中
topics.descEn: A lightning rod doesn't attract lightning — it wins it: as stepped leaders probe downward, the sharpest tip concentrates field strength first and launches an upward leader; current drains down the conductor into the ground grid; protection is drawn by the rolling-sphere method

topics.descZh: 黑匣子不是黑的是橙色:两台记录仪把 25 小时飞行参数与 2 小时舱音写进循环覆盖的固态存储;钛壳-隔热-缓冲四层护甲扛得住 3400 g 冲击、1000 °C 半小时火烧与 6000 米水压;失事后靠 37.5 kHz 水下信标响 30 天替搜寻者喊话
topics.descEn: The black box is bright orange: two recorders write 25 hours of flight data and 2 hours of cockpit audio into looping solid-state memory; a titanium shell, insulation and cushioning survive 3400 g, thirty minutes at 1000 °C and 6000 m of water; a 37.5 kHz beacon pings for thirty days

topics.descZh: 卡钳液压夹住旋转的通风盘:摩擦面裸露在气流里散热远胜鼓式,盘内辐条被转成离心风扇;增益≈1、踩多少得多少,线性稳定但要更大液压;热衰退两路:摩擦片高温析气垫开接触面、制动液沸腾踏板变海绵
topics.descEn: Caliper pistons pinch a ventilated rotor: the friction faces ride in the airstream and internal vanes pump air like a centrifugal fan; gain ≈1 — what you press is what you get, linear but thirstier hydraulics; fade comes two ways: hot pads gas out the contact face, boiling brake fluid turns the pedal to sponge

topics.descZh: 眼轴过长,远处平行光被 60 D 的角膜+晶状体聚在视网膜之前——看远糊;凹透镜先发散一档、焦点后推回视网膜:镜片不治眼轴、只重排光路;度数=焦距倒数×100;散光是角膜两方向曲率不均,柱镜把焦点对齐
topics.descEn: An eye too long focuses parallel rays in front of the retina — distant blur; a minus lens diverges first and pushes focus back: glasses don't shorten the eye, they re-route the light; power is 100/f; astigmatism splits focus by meridian and a cylinder lens lines the two back up

topics.descZh: UVB 晒伤表皮、UVA 穿进真皮晒老,防晒要广谱:有机滤剂是分子开关——吸收光子、异构弛豫把能量变热散掉;氧化锌/二氧化钛宽带吸收+散射、20~50 nm 透明不泛白;SPF30=透过 3%、指数收益递减;出汗摩擦膜厚减半、两小时补涂
topics.descEn: UVB burns the epidermis, UVA reaches the dermis and ages it — protection must be broad-spectrum: organic filters are molecular switches that absorb a photon and relax it away as heat; ZnO/TiO₂ absorb and scatter across the band, 20–50 nm and clear on skin; SPF30 passes 3%, sweat halves the film — reapply

topics.descZh: 顶部电阻丝把狭小腔体烧到 180–200 °C,大风轮强制热风循环、把食物表面的热边界层吹薄——h 从 ~12 跳到 ~52 W/(m²·K)、静置烤箱的 3–5 倍;表面先被吹干,一干就冲过 140–165 °C 触发美拉德上色;温控 ±4 °C 反复通断,不预热则第一波热被食物吸走;同样 10 分钟,风扇一关上色差一截
topics.descEn: A coil roasts the narrow cavity to 180–200 °C and a fan drives the hot air round, thinning the food's thermal boundary layer — h jumps from ~12 to ~52 W/(m²·K), 3–5× a static oven; the surface dries, then shoots past 140–165 °C into Maillard browning; same 10 minutes, fan off — far less color; hot wind plus a spray of oil mimics deep-frying

topics.descZh: 加热丝把 SnO₂ 颗粒烤到 ~300 °C,吸附氧抓走电子成耗尽层、电阻高达 ~32 kΩ;甲烷夺回电子,电阻跳水数倍至数十倍触发蜂鸣;报警点 10% LEL=0.5 vol%,距 5–15 vol% 爆炸窗留足 10 倍;天然气轻则顶装、液化气重则底装;CO 走电化学池、按暴露时间加权报警
topics.descEn: A heater bakes the SnO₂ grains to ~300 °C; adsorbed oxygen snatches free electrons into a depletion layer at ~32 kΩ; methane reclaims them and R dives severalfold, tripping the horn; the alarm sits at 10% LEL — a 10× margin under the 5–15 vol% explosion window; a pellistor bridge is the contrast; CO uses an electrochemical cell with time-weighted alarms

topics.titleZh: 投影仪与 DLP 微镜
topics.descZh: 白光被色轮切成 R/G/B 子场轮流打上 DMD:几十万颗 ~10 µm 微铝镜各管一个像素,只在 ±12° 两态静电翻转(~2–20 µs):+12° 反射进镜头、−12° 倒进吸光槽;灰度=一帧内「开」的占空比,人眼把 PWM 闪光积分成稳定全彩;反射式光效远超透射式 LCD,代价是扫视时的彩虹重影
topics.descEn: A spinning color wheel slices white into R/G/B sub-fields for the DMD, where hundreds of thousands of ~10 µm micromirrors flip electrostatically between ±12°: +12° reflects into the lens, −12° dumps into a light sink; gray = on-time duty within a frame, and the eye integrates the PWM flashes into stable full color; reflective beats transmissive efficiency, at the price of rainbow fringes

topics.descZh: 扇叶是一支旋转的机翼:1200 rpm 时叶根线速度只有 7.5 m/s,叶尖却有 50.3 m/s,差 6.7 倍,来流角沿叶展从 ~18° 缩到 ~3°;安装角必须从根 ~30° 拧到尖 ~15°,才能让每段迎角都落在 8–15°;换成零扭转平叶,叶尖迎角冲到 29° 当场失速,失速叶展飙到 90%+,风量塌掉、只剩涡脱落的嗡嗡声;拖回设计扭转,失速归零、风带顺滑;风扇不制冷,50 W 电机还微微加热空气,凉意全靠对流+汗蒸发(2.4 MJ/L)
topics.descEn: A fan blade is a rotating wing: at 1200 rpm the root moves at 7.5 m/s while the tip hits 50.3 m/s — 6.7x — so the inflow angle swings from about 18 degrees to 3 degrees along the span. Pitch must twist from ~30 degrees at the root to ~15 at the tip to hold every section at 8-15 degrees angle of attack; a flat blade drives the tip to 29, stalls 90% of the span, and trades airflow for buzz. Fans do not chill air — the 50 W motor even heats it slightly; you cool by convection plus sweat evaporation (2.4 MJ per liter)

topics.descZh: 万物按 εσT⁴ 辐射;300 K 人体峰值 9.7 μm,正落在 8–14 μm 大气窗;热电堆黑斑吸收窗内光,几十对热电偶靠塞贝克效应串出数百 µV;仪表扣除反射项后按 T=(V/εσ)^¼ 反演;命门是发射率:抛光金属 ε≈0.10 被当 0.98 用,350 K(77 °C)当场读成 29 °C、差 48 K;贴 ε≈0.95 黑胶带归位;T 差 1% → 功率差 4%,四次方是灵敏度也是误差放大器
topics.descEn: Everything radiates as εσT⁴; a 300 K body peaks at 9.7 μm, right inside the 8–14 μm atmospheric window. A thermopile black absorber warms by hundredths of a kelvin and dozens of series thermocouples turn that into a few hundred µV via the Seebeck effect; the gun subtracts the reflected ambient term and inverts T=(V/εσ)^¼. Emissivity is the trap: polished metal ε≈0.10 dialled in as 0.98 turns a 350 K (77 °C) plate into a 29 °C reading — 48 K off; ε≈0.95 black tape snaps it back

topics.descZh: 30 °C/80% RH 的空气含 24 g/m³ 水汽;风机把它压过 5 °C 冷盘管,该温度饱和只容 7 g/m³,17 g/m³ 当场凝成水珠进水箱,折 22 L/天;露点由 Magnus 公式给出(30 °C/80% → 26 °C),盘温拉回露点之上滴水当场停止;<2 °C 结霜堵风需化霜;冷凝器把潜热+压缩功约 900 W 排回风道,出风干而暖升高 15 K;300 W 跑 22 L/天 ≈ 2.8 L/kWh——除湿就是一台被摁到露点以下的冷凝器
topics.descEn: Air at 30 °C/80% RH carries 24 g/m³ of vapor; a fan pushes it over a ~5 °C coil that holds only ~7 g/m³ at saturation, so 17 g/m³ condenses into the tank — about 22 L/day at 0.26 g/s. The dew point (26 °C here, via Magnus) is the cliff: lift the coil back above it and dripping stops instantly, while below 2 °C frost chokes the duct. The condenser dumps latent heat plus 300 W of compressor work back into the stream — exhaust leaves dry and ~15 K warmer — and the whole machine runs at about 2.8 L per kWh

topics.titleZh: 自动喷淋头与热敏玻璃球
topics.descZh: 电影里「一个喷头冒烟、全楼喷水」是误导:每只喷头都是独立的感温自动阀,火正上方的顶棚射流(温升随半径按 2/3 次方衰减)只加热最近的玻璃球——内充酒精/甘油膨胀液,受热先吃掉小气泡、再撑裂球壳,管网 0.4-1.2 MPa 的水随即顶开密封塞,撞上溅水盘打成伞幕;K=80 喷头 0.1 MPa 出 80 L/min、一只管约 12 m²,标定温度 57/68/79/93 °C 四档,快速响应球(RTI≤50)比标准球早动作几十秒——整场火通常只开 1-2 只。
topics.descEn: Movies lie: one smoky head does not drench the whole floor. Each sprinkler is an independent heat valve — the ceiling jet (Alpert: excess temperature falls as r^(-2/3)) heats only the nearest glass bulb, whose alcohol/glycerin fill swallows its bubble until wall stress shatters it; then 0.4-1.2 MPa of pipe pressure blows the cap and the deflector fans the water into an umbrella. A K=80 head gives 80 L/min at 0.1 MPa over ~12 m²; bulbs are rated 57/68/79/93 °C, and fast-response bulbs (RTI≤50) open tens of seconds before standard ones — usually just 1-2 heads ever open.

topics.titleZh: 酒精检测仪与燃料电池传感
topics.descZh: 肺泡气与血液的酒精按约 2100:1(体积)平衡分配(亨利定律,35 °C)——呼气 0.38 mg/L 对应血液 80 mg/100 mL;吹气 5 秒、末段才是深肺泡气;燃料电池传感器:乙醇在铂工作电极氧化 CH₃CH₂OH+H₂O→CH₃COOH+4H⁺+4e⁻,电流∝浓度、积分读出 BAC;代谢 ≈0.015 g/dL 每小时,一杯啤酒约 2 小时代谢完;中国红线酒驾 20、醉驾 80 mg/100 mL;半导体氧化物家用款对香水/丙酮当场误报,执法级每月标气校准 ±5%
topics.descEn: Alcohol partitions between blood and alveolar air at about 2100:1 by volume (Henry's law, 35 °C) — 0.38 mg/L of breath maps to 80 mg/100 mL of blood; a 5 s blow samples the deep alveolar tail. In the fuel cell, ethanol oxidizes at the platinum working electrode, CH₃CH₂OH+H₂O→CH₃COOH+4H⁺+4e⁻; current is proportional to concentration and integrates to BAC. Metabolism clears ≈0.015 g/dL per hour — one beer takes ~2 h. China's lines: 20 (driving after drinking) and 80 (drunk) mg/100 mL. Cheap semiconductor units false-alarm on perfume and acetone; enforcement units are calibrated monthly to ±5%

topics.titleZh: 手机振动马达 ERM 与 LRA
topics.descZh: ERM 偏心轮马达靠 F=m·e·ω² 甩出惯性力,12000–17000 rpm 对应 200–280 Hz,起振 30–50 ms、停振拖尾 100 ms 以上——"嗡"的模糊震感;LRA 线性谐振致动器把磁质量挂在弹簧上、谐振在 ~175 Hz(iPhone Taptic 类),Q≈10–30 一推就大,起停只要 10–20 ms,反向电流急刹车收出短促的"哒";ERM 转子起停的惯性是代价,LRA 只在谐振点高效省电;点击/滚动/失败的触感语言全靠驱动包络设计
topics.descEn: An ERM flings an eccentric mass: F=m·e·ω² at 12000–17000 rpm (200–280 Hz), but inertia costs 30–50 ms to spin up and 100+ ms to wind down — a blurry

topics.descZh: 两根能横移动程 152–160 mm 的尖轨,贴紧哪根基本轨、车轮就顺着哪边走;转辙机电动扳动并锁闭,密贴间隙 4 mm 即不开放信号;侧向走导曲线大半径绕行,号数越大越缓:12 号侧向限速 45 km/h、18 号 80、42 号可到 160;两股轨道交叉处必须断开轨条给轮缘留槽(辙叉"有害空间"),车轮冲过缺口时靠护轨(轮缘槽 42 mm)把轮对扶正——俯视慢放,四条轮轨接触点依次交接
topics.descEn: Two switch rails slide 152–160 mm; whichever stock rail they hug decides the route. The point machine throws and locks them — a 4 mm gap and the signal stays red. The diverging route swings through a large-radius curve: a No.12 turnout allows 45 km/h sideways, No.18 80, No.42 up to 160. Where the routes cross, the rails must be broken to give flanges a flangeway — the frog's

topics.descZh: 转子 50 齿、定子 8 极的两相混合式步进电机:步距角 360°/(50×4)=1.8°,200 整步/圈;电流按 i_A=I·cosθ、i_B=I·sinθ 细分,256 微步每步仅 0.007°;T=K·I·sinδ,负载角超约 2 个整步即失步——开环无反馈,3D 打印层错位多源于此;16 细分+20 齿带轮=80 步/mm。
topics.descEn: A two-phase hybrid stepper with 50 rotor teeth and 8 stator poles: 1.8° per full step (200/rev); currents shaped as iA=I·cosθ, iB=I·sinθ give 0.007° per microstep at 256 divisions; torque T=K·I·sinδ, and past ~2 full steps of load angle the rotor loses sync — open-loop, no encoder, the classic 3D-print layer shift. 16 microsteps + a 20-tooth pulley = 80 steps/mm.

topics.titleZh: 焦平面快门与果冻效应
topics.descZh: 两片薄帘在传感器前夹出 0.8-2.5 mm 的缝,以约 6.4 m/s 扫过画幅:1/8000 s 曝光就是 0.8 mm 缝被帘速「稀释」的结果;缝小于画幅,闪光只能照亮一条带——这就是 X-sync 1/200-1/320 的由来;3.8 ms 的逐条扫描把旋转的螺旋桨拍弯、把 1.5 m/s 的竖杆拍斜 13°,电子快门读出 33-66 ms、果冻再放大 10 倍。
topics.descEn: Two titanium-carbon curtains sweep a 0.8-2.5 mm slit across the sensor at ~6.4 m/s: a 1/8000 s exposure is just a 0.8 mm gap diluted by curtain speed; when the slit is narrower than the frame, a flash lights only one band - the origin of the 1/200-1/320 s X-sync limit; the ~3.8 ms strip-by-strip scan bends spinning propellers and tilts a 1.5 m/s rod by 13°, while electronic readout (33-66 ms) makes rolling shutter 10x worse.

topics.descZh: 压电陶瓷片(PZT,Ø16-20 mm)在 1.7 MHz 谐振下以约 1 μm 振幅辐射 0.3-1 MPa 强声波,顶起 2-5 cm 驻波喷泉,锥面按 d∝(σ/ρf²)^{1/3} 失稳、碎成 1-5 μm 冷雾:200-400 mL/h 只需 20-30 W,不煮不杀菌——硬水钙镁盐变成房间白粉、孢子随气溶胶入肺,纯净水与定期消毒是纪律;对照热蒸发式 450 W。
topics.descEn: A PZT disc (Ø16-20 mm) driven at 1.7 MHz resonance flexes ~1 μm and beams 0.3-1 MPa of ultrasound through the water, lifting a 2-5 cm standing-wave fountain whose cone shatters into 1-5 μm droplets at the capillary scale d∝(σ/ρf²)^{1/3} — 200-400 mL/h of cool mist for just 20-30 W, with no boiling and no sterilization: hard-water salts turn into white dust on furniture and spores ride the aerosol, so distilled water and weekly disinfection are the discipline; thermal units boil instead at 450 W.

topics.descZh: 磁带 23.39 mm/s 太慢装不下 MHz 带宽——让磁头自己转:ø62 mm 磁鼓 1,500 rpm、两磁头 180° 对置,磁带 221° 螺旋包角,每 1/50 s 写下一条 58 μm 斜磁迹;相对写入速度 ~4.9 m/s 是带速的 ~200 倍;方位角 ±6° 交替把邻迹串扰压低 ~40 dB、省掉保护带,CTL 脉冲管跟踪对齐。
topics.descEn: Tape at 23.39 mm/s is far too slow for MHz bandwidth — so spin the heads: a 62 mm drum at 1,500 rpm carries two heads 180° apart, the tape wraps 221° helically, and each 1/50 s field gets a 58 μm slanted track. Head-to-tape writing speed ~4.9 m/s, ~200× the tape speed. ±6° alternating azimuth beats crosstalk by ~40 dB without guard bands; CTL pulses keep the heads on-track.

topics.titleZh: 直驱轮毂电机与行星减速
topics.descZh: 同一只轮毂两条路线:直驱——外转子贴磁钢低速大力矩,无齿静音、效率 ~85-90%、电机 4-6 kg,刹车时反电动势反充电池(城市工况回收 ~5-15% 续航);行星毂——小电机快转经 4-9:1 齿系放大扭矩,电机 1.5-3 kg 但效率低 5-10%,棘爪让滑行自由却斩断了回收。
topics.descEn: One hub, two answers. Direct drive: an outer-rotor PM motor makes torque at low rpm — gearless, silent, ~85-90% efficient, 4-6 kg, and braking feeds BEMF back to the battery (5-15% range in city riding). Planetary hub: a small fast motor through a 4-9:1 gearset multiplies torque — 1.5-3 kg but 5-10% less efficient, and the freewheel pawls that make coasting silent also cut off regen.

topics.descZh: 一颗机械轴=底壳+弹簧+滑芯+上下触点:按下→弹簧压缩→滑芯裙边在 2.0 mm 行程压下镀金弹片、触点导通(红轴 ~45 cN 线性、总程 4.0 mm);青轴套件 1.9 mm 越顶「咔哒」跳落,段感峰 ~50 cN,听觉+触觉双确认;机械 ~1 亿次寿命 vs 薄膜 ~500 万;8×18 矩阵 26 线扫 144 键,无二极管三键成回路即出鬼键。
topics.descEn: One switch = base + spring + stem + contacts: press, spring compresses, the skirt trips a gold leaf at 2.0 mm of the 4.0 mm travel (red: ~45 cN linear); blue's click jacket snaps over-center at 1.9 mm with a ~50 cN peak - audible and tactile confirmation. ~100 M cycles vs ~5 M for membrane; an 8×18 matrix scans 144 keys on 26 wires, and three keys without diodes make a ghost.

topics.descZh: 主支柱=双撑杆机构:放下位侧撑杆+锁撑杆越过死点 ~3-5° 机械自锁,再插下位锁销——液压全失也锁得住;~20.7 MPa 液压作动筒先把 knee 拉回中位解锁、再整体折进轮舱,舱门按时序先开后关;应急靠重力+动压吹出、锁定钩上锁;油气式缓冲按 3.05 m/s 下沉率设计,行程 ~0.45 m、过载 2-3 g,油液过节流孔把动能变热。
topics.descEn: The main leg is a double-link mechanism: side stay and drag brace sit 3-5° past dead center, self-locked with a downlock pin even with total hydraulic failure; a ~20.7 MPa actuator centers the knee to unlock, then folds the leg into the bay, doors opening first and closing last; emergency extension is gravity plus ram air. The oleo strut absorbs a 3.05 m/s sink over ~0.45 m at 2-3 g, oil through an orifice turning motion into heat.

topics.descZh: 折叠伞是一套塞进口袋的多级连杆:8 根主骨加撑骨与折骨,开伞时中棒主弹簧顶推下滑环,撑骨把主骨从拢姿推到张姿,折骨把伞面张成球冠,自由度 F=3(n−1)−2j=1;收伞反向折叠锁定;过载时「反肘」翻转泄风、扳回即复原,15 m/s 风压约 140 Pa;三折收纳 20-25 cm,展开 95-105 cm。
topics.descEn: A folding umbrella is a multi-stage linkage in your pocket: 8 main ribs plus stretchers and folding arms; opening, the main spring shoves the runner up, stretchers push the ribs from fold to spread, and the canopy stretches into a spherical cap with F=3(n−1)−2j=1; closing folds it back and locks; overload flips the elbow to shed wind and springs back - 15 m/s is about 140 Pa; folded 20-25 cm, opened 95-105 cm.

topics.descZh: 巡航 11 km 外压仅 ~0.22 atm(−57 °C),客舱却维持 2400 m 当量(~0.75 atm),ΔP≈8 psi 全由蒙皮扛;气源是发动机压气机引气,经空调组件降温;外流阀这只电动排气口按飞行剖面程序控制舱压:起飞后 30 s 内增压到场压、巡航保 8 psi、下降按 300-500 ft/min 舱高减压护耳;舱高超 14000 ft 自动掉面罩,失压后 35000 ft 清醒时间仅 ~30 s。
topics.descEn: At 11 km cruise outside pressure is ~0.22 atm (-57 °C) while the cabin holds a 2400 m equivalent (~0.75 atm) - ΔP≈8 psi carried entirely by the skin. Air comes from engine bleed, cooled by the packs; the electric outflow valve schedules it: field pressure within 30 s of takeoff, 8 psi held in cruise, 300-500 ft/min cabin descent to spare your ears, masks above 14000 ft, and ~30 s of useful consciousness at 35000 ft after a rapid decompression.

topics.descZh: 调光旋钮背后是 TRIAC 双向可控硅:每半周从过零点关断,RC 网络给 DIAC 充到 ~30 V 雪崩才点火,导通维持到半周结束;旋钮改触发角 α(0°→150°),灯上有效电压 100%→~17%,功率按 P∝V² 骤降到 ~3%;陡峭导通前沿(数百 V/μs)是无线电干扰源,LC 滤波器专职压它;LED 非阻性负载,前沿相控每秒闪 100 次——要选后沿相控(逆并联 MOSFET)。
topics.descEn: Behind the knob is a TRIAC: off from each zero crossing until the RC network charges a DIAC to its ~30 V avalanche point and fires it, conducting to the half-cycle's end. The knob sets firing angle α (0°-150°): lamp RMS voltage 100%→~17%, power P∝V² down to ~3%. The steep leading edge (hundreds of V/μs) is EMI that an LC filter tames; LEDs, not being resistive, flicker 100×/s on leading-edge dimmers - use trailing-edge (back-to-back MOSFET) types.

topics.descZh: 一条螺旋 V 形槽(90°、深 ~25 μm)装下两路声音:左右声道分别刻在两个 45° 侧壁上,唱针水平振动被分解拾取;33⅓ rpm 下线速度从外圈 50 cm/s 掉到内圈 20 cm/s,内圈波长短、循迹失真大——「内圈音质差」是几何必然;刻录低频压 20 dB 高频提升,放音 RIAA 反向还原;动态范围 60-70 dB,输给 CD 的 96 dB,却保住连续刻痕的模拟温度。
topics.descEn: One spiral V-groove (90°, ~25 μm deep) carries stereo: left and right channels are cut into the two 45° walls, resolved by the stylus's horizontal wiggle. At 33⅓ rpm the linear speed falls from 50 cm/s outside to 20 cm/s inside — shorter wavelengths, more tracing distortion; the inner-groove penalty is geometry. Cutting attenuates lows ~20 dB and boosts highs; RIAA equalization reverses it on playback. Dynamic range 60-70 dB versus CD's 96 — but continuous, analog warmth.

topics.titleZh: 基础隔震与铅芯橡胶支座
topics.descZh: 硬扛会把楼层摇得更狠(共振放大 2-4 倍);隔震换思路:在基础与结构间垫柔性层,周期从 0.3-0.5 s 拉到 2-3 s,避开地震能量主频段,上部结构近似刚性平动,加速度降到 1/3-1/5;LRB=叠层橡胶承重(单座 500-8000 t)+铅芯屈服耗能(阻尼 15-25%),300-500 mm 位移全发生在隔震层;1994 北岭:地面 0.49 g,隔震医院内仅 0.13 g。
topics.descEn: Bracing hard makes the building shake worse — resonance amplifies floor motion 2-4×. Isolation changes the game: a flexible layer under the structure stretches the period from 0.3-0.5 s to 2-3 s, out of the earthquake's energy band, so the superstructure rides nearly rigid — accelerations cut to 1/3-1/5. An LRB stacks rubber for vertical load (500-8,000 t per bearing) around a lead core that yields to dissipate (15-25% damping); 300-500 mm of drift lands in the isolation layer. Northridge 1994: 0.49 g outside, 0.13 g inside the isolated hospital.

topics.descZh: 肾停机后尿素、肌酐、钾都得有人接盘:透析器里 1-1.5 万根空心纤维(内径 200 μm,总面积 1.5-2 m²)让血与透析液隔膜对流——逆流让浓度梯度全程在线,顺流则在出口耗尽;弥散清小分子、超滤除水 1-4 L,透析液含 K 1-3 mmol/L 才能把血钾拉下来;每周 3 次 ×4 h,Kt/V≥1.2;清得太快会脑水肿——失衡综合征教会我们慢慢来。
topics.descEn: When the kidneys stop, urea, creatinine and potassium need a stand-in. Inside the dialyzer, 10-15 thousand hollow fibers (200 μm bore, 1.5-2 m² total) carry blood against a counterflowing dialysate — countercurrent keeps the concentration gradient alive end to end; co-current exhausts it. Diffusion clears small solutes, ultrafiltration removes 1-4 L of water, and dialysate K at 1-3 mmol/L pulls potassium down. Three 4-hour sessions a week at Kt/V≥1.2; clearing too fast swells the brain — dialysis disequilibrium teaches patience.

topics.descZh: 密闭下壶受热,蒸汽压把水顶上中央管穿粉入上壶——不是蒸汽冲咖啡,是压差泵:工作压 ~1-1.5 bar、安全阀 ~2-3 bar、水温 ~90-100 °C(比意式 9 bar 低两个数量级);1933 年 Bialetti 发明,意大利家庭保有量 ~90%。
topics.descEn: Heat raises vapor pressure in the sealed lower chamber and pushes water up the central tube through the grounds - not 'steam brewing coffee' but a pressure-difference pump: working pressure ~1-1.5 bar, safety valve at ~2-3 bar, brew water ~90-100 °C (two orders below espresso's 9 bar). Invented by Bialetti in 1933; ~90% of Italian households own one.

topics.titleEn: Tempered Glass and the Safety Hammer
topics.descZh: 620-650 °C 后高压风骤冷,把表面压进 ~100-150 MPa 残余压应力:裂纹要先抵消压应力才能扩展,抗弯强度达普通玻璃 4-5 倍、耐热震 200-300 °C;内层储能巨大,被钨钢尖击穿即雪崩碎成 2-5 mm 钝粒,自爆多因 NiS 杂质。
topics.descEn: Heat to 620-650 °C, quench with high-pressure air: the surface is pressed into ~100-150 MPa residual compression balanced by core tension. Cracks must pay off the compression first, so bending strength is 4-5× annealed glass and thermal shock tolerance 200-300 °C. But the core stores huge energy - pierce the surface with a carbide tip and the pane avalanches into 2-5 mm blunt granules; spontaneous breaks usually trace to NiS inclusions.

topics.descZh: 包裹先过 DWS(称重+测体积+六面扫码),映射到 ~200-400 个滑槽之一;小车以 ~2-2.5 m/s 匀速走环线,临近格口 ~1 m 收到翻板指令,垂直小带横甩卸货;每秒每米 ~1 件、单线 1-2 万件/h、错分率 <0.1%,指令迟到进异常口。
topics.descEn: Parcels first pass DWS (dynamic weighing + laser dimensioning + six-face scanning) and are mapped to one of ~200-400 chutes; carts cruise the loop at ~2-2.5 m/s, get the dispatch command ~1 m before the target chute, and a perpendicular mini-belt throws the parcel sideways. Beat: ~1 parcel per metre-second, 10-20k/h per line, mis-sorts <0.1%; late commands go to the reject port.

topics.descZh: 燃气射流卷吸 ~50-60% 一次空气预混,绝热焰温 ~1,960 °C;热电偶热端 600-800 °C,塞贝克效应产 20-40 mV 直接吸住电磁阀——零放大电路;点火按住 5-15 s,熄火后 10-30 s 电势跌过释放阈断气,国标 ≤45 s。
topics.descEn: The gas jet entrains ~50-60% primary air into a premixed flame at ~1,960 °C adiabatic. The thermocouple tip sits at 600-800 °C, its 20-40 mV Seebeck EMF holding the solenoid directly - no amplifier at all. Hold the knob 5-15 s to charge the valve; after flameout the EMF fades in 10-30 s and the gas is cut within the 45 s the standard allows.

topics.descZh: CD 的 1.411 Mbps,MP3 压到 128 kbps≈10:1——听不见的不编:2-4 kHz 最灵,20 Hz 与 16 kHz 抬高 40-60 dB;强音把邻带掩蔽阈抬到其下 10-25 dB;按 SMR 分比特,320 kbps 几乎透明。
topics.descEn: CD stereo is 1.411 Mbps; MP3 squeezes it to 128 kbps (~10:1) by not coding what you cannot hear: hearing is sharpest at 2-4 kHz with the threshold 40-60 dB higher near 20 Hz and 16 kHz; a loud tone lifts neighboring thresholds to 10-25 dB below itself. Bits are allocated by SMR; 320 kbps is nearly transparent.

topics.descZh: 轨道电路把线路切成 1-2 km 闭塞分区;应答器掠过 ~0.1 s 拍入坡度限速;CTCS-3 加 GSM-R 无线闭塞中心连续下发 MA,追踪间隔 ~3 min;ATP 实时算制动曲线:350 km/h 紧急制动 ~4.3 km,越线自动卸牵引+制动。
topics.descEn: Track circuits slice the line into 1-2 km blocks that glow red when occupied; balises upload gradient and speed limits in ~0.1 s as the train passes. CTCS-3 adds a GSM-R radio block centre issuing movement authorities continuously at ~3 min headway. ATP computes the braking curve live - 350 km/h needs ~4.3 km to stop at ~1.1 m/s² average - and crossing it cuts traction and brakes automatically.

topics.descZh: 1941 年德·梅斯特拉尔从粘在狗毛上的牛蒡果悟出:一面尼龙注塑 100-300 钩/cm²,一面圈绒;按压时钩穿圈回弹卡住,挂合率 70-90%。剪切向整面同时受力,25 mm 搭接承载数 kg;剥离向逐钩撬出仅 1-1.5 N/cm——撕拉声即逐钩解锁,寿命 5,000-10,000 次,方向性锁合用于航天防月尘与医疗快解。
topics.descEn: In 1941 de Mestral studied burrs stuck to dog fur: one side molds 100-300 nylon hooks per cm², the other a loop pile; pressed, hooks pierce loops and spring back locked at 70-90%. Shear loads the whole face at once - a 25 mm lap carries several kg - while peeling pries hooks out one by one at just 1-1.5 N/cm, the rip being sequential unlock; 5,000-10,000 cycles, directional locking from space dust shields to medical closures.

topics.descZh: CD 在 1.2 mm 聚碳酸酯上刻 0.5 μm 宽坑、轨距 1.6 μm,坑深 ≈ λ/(4n)≈123 nm;780 nm 激光打在坑沿,坑底与台面反射光程差 λ/2 干涉相消读出 1,平台读 0。恒线速 1.2-1.4 m/s(内圈 ~500 r/min),1×=150 KiB/s;三光束循迹、像散对焦,EFM+CIRC 可修复 2.4 mm 划痕;DVD 650 nm、蓝光 405 nm 达 25 GB。
topics.descEn: A CD etches 0.5 μm pits at 1.6 μm pitch into 1.2 mm polycarbonate, pit depth ≈ λ/(4n) ≈ 123 nm; over a pit edge the 780 nm laser sees a λ/2 round-trip difference, interference cancels and the detector reads 1, lands read 0. Constant linear velocity 1.2-1.4 m/s (~500 rpm inner), 1× = 150 KiB/s; three-beam tracking, astigmatic focus, EFM + CIRC heal 2.4 mm scratches; DVD 650 nm, Blu-ray 405 nm up to 25 GB.

topics.descZh: 底座 9-11 叶混流叶轮以 20-30 L/s 送气,经 ~1 mm 环缝以 60-90 km/h 喷出;射流按伯努利在环框后缘造负压诱导吸入,边缘又卷吸四周空气,放大 15-18 倍输出 300-500 L/s,再沿柯恩达弧面转向前方。无叶片切割、气流平滑安全;代价是效率低于轴流扇、窄缝有啸声。
topics.descEn: A hidden 9-11-blade mixed-flow impeller feeds 20-30 L/s through a ~1 mm annular slit at 60-90 km/h; by Bernoulli the jet lowers pressure behind the ring, inducing air in, while its edges entrain the surroundings - 15-18x amplification, 300-500 L/s out - then the Coanda surface bends it forward. No blades to chop the flow: smooth, safe; the price is lower efficiency than axial fans and slit hiss.

topics.descZh: PTFE 的 C–F 键能高达 485 kJ/mol,氟原子把碳骨架包成电中性铠甲,表面能仅 18-20 mN/m(水 72、油 ~30),水珠以 110-120° 接触角滚动;涂层是喷砂铝基+底漆+2-3 道面漆、400 °C 烧结成 20-60 μm 连续膜;260 °C 起分解、空烧 2-3 min 即撞红线;硬度仅 Shore D≈55,金属铲一铲报废——本质是让液体抓不到任何表面力。
topics.descEn: PTFE's C-F bonds (485 kJ/mol) let fluorine sheathe the carbon backbone in a neutral armor: surface energy 18-20 mN/m vs water 72, so drops bead at 110-120 degrees and nothing sticks. The coating is four layers - blasted aluminum, primer, top coats sintered at 400 °C into one 20-60 μm film; breakdown starts at 260 °C and a dry pan crosses it in 2-3 minutes; Shore D ~55 means one metal spatula ends it. In essence: no surface force left to grab.

topics.descZh: 氰基丙烯酸酯 CH₂=C(CN)COOR 的双键被氰基+酯基双吸电子基夹击,β 碳裸露;表面潮气里的 OH⁻ 一触即发,阴离子连锁秒级把聚合度冲到 10³-10⁴;粘度 2-5 mPa·s 毛细钻进微观粗糙度,固化剪切 10-20 MPa。皮肤有水+氨基酸碱基故秒粘,聚乙烯 ~31 mN/m 不润湿故不粘;交联网络硬而脆、耐热 ~80 °C,掺橡胶微球增韧——本质是你手指上的潮气就是引发剂。
topics.descEn: Cyanoacrylate CH2=C(CN)COOR carries cyano and ester groups that strip its double bond, exposing the beta carbon; the OH- in a surface moisture film attacks it and anionic chain polymerization hits degree 10^3-10^4 in seconds. At 2-5 mPa·s the monomer wicks into micro-roughness, curing to 10-20 MPa shear. Skin bonds in seconds (water plus amino bases), polyethylene never (~31 mN/m, no wetting). The crosslinked network is brittle, softening at 80 °C; rubber microspheres toughen it. In essence: your moisture is the initiator.

topics.descZh: BaTiO₃ 掺 La³⁺ 成 N 型半导体陶瓷,室温阻值仅 10-100 Ω;低于居里点(120-250 °C 可调)四方铁电相势垒低、大功率加热,越过 Tc 变立方顺电相、晶界势垒陡升,30 °C 温区阻值跳 10³-10⁶ 倍;于是 T↑→R↑→P=V²/R↓ 自动退火,无温控器恒温 Tc±5 °C,风堵自动降功率;聚合物版 PE+碳黑做成 60-140 °C 动作的自恢复保险丝;镍铬丝 α≈0.4%/°C 没有悬崖——本质是相变把温控器烧进了材料。
topics.descEn: BaTiO3 doped with La3+ becomes an N-type semiconducting ceramic: below the Curie point (120-250 °C, tunable) the tetragonal ferroelectric phase conducts and heating runs at full power; past Tc the cubic paraelectric phase raises grain-boundary barriers and resistance leaps 10^3-10^6 times within a 30 °C window. The loop closes itself: T up, R up, P=V^2/R down - it holds Tc±5 °C with no thermostat and throttles when airflow blocks. The polymer twin (PE plus carbon black) makes 60-140 °C self-recovering fuses; nichrome's 0.4%/°C has no cliff. In essence: the thermostat is fired into the material.

topics.descZh: 定频空调靠开停控温:±1-2 °C 锯齿、启动电流 5-10 倍;变频把整流-PFC-逆变三级接到压缩机上,PWM 调频 20-120 Hz、容量 10-100% 连续可调,室温贴线 ±0.5 °C,SEER 从 3 左右抬到 4-5,省电 20-40%;低于 20 Hz 要强制升频回油。
topics.descEn: Fixed-speed AC controls temperature by on-off hysteresis: ±1-2 °C sawtooth, 5-10x inrush current. Inverter drives feed the compressor through rectifier-PFC-inverter stages, PWM-modulating 20-120 Hz for 10-100% continuous capacity - the room hugs the setpoint within ±0.5 °C, SEER climbs from ~3 to 4-5, bills drop 20-40%. Below 20 Hz it must speed up anyway to carry oil back.

topics.descZh: 每分钟几千次的受控闪电:点火线圈先在初级磁场里攒下 ½LI²≈100 mJ,断电瞬间 dI/dt≈1 A/μs 经 1:90 匝比顶出 20-40 kV,按 Paschen 定律击穿 0.7-1.1 mm 间隙;火花 1-3 ms、30-100 mJ,铱金中心极 0.4-0.6 mm 把击穿电压降下来,热值选不对就积碳或早燃。
topics.descEn: Controlled lightning a few thousand times a minute: the coil banks ½LI² of about 100 mJ in its primary field, then an interruption at dI/dt≈1 A/μs through a 1:90 turns ratio swings the secondary to 20-40 kV, breaking down a 0.7-1.1 mm gap per Paschen's law. The spark lives 1-3 ms at 30-100 mJ; a 0.4-0.6 mm iridium center electrode lowers the demand, and the wrong heat range means fouling or pre-ignition.

topics.descZh: 钢笔不按压也出水:大气压就是总泵——写字流出多少墨,笔舌 0.1-0.3 mm 毛细沟槽就补进多少空气,内外压差始终≈0;笔尖中缝是随 0.2-1 N 压力开合的弹簧阀(开度按 g³ 立方律),铱粒耐磨十年,金尖 80 μm/N 的弹性就是手感;负压上墨靠活塞把笔腔抽到 −24 kPa。
topics.descEn: A fountain pen writes without pressing: atmospheric pressure is the pump - whatever ink leaves through the slit, air returns through the 0.1-0.3 mm capillary grooves of the feed, so the pressure difference stays near zero. The nib slit is a spring valve opening with 0.2-1 N of force (cubic in gap), the iridium pellet lasts decades, and an 80 μm/N gold tip is what you feel; a piston inks it by pulling the barrel to −24 kPa.

topics.titleZh: 车载毫米波雷达与 FMCW
topics.titleEn: Automotive Radar & FMCW: Ranging by Beat Frequency
topics.descZh: 77 GHz 毫米波雷达以 FMCW(调频连续波)工作:发射锯齿 chirp(带宽 ~1 GHz),回波延迟 τ=2d/c 与本地信号混频出拍频 f_b=S·τ——测频比测时容易十几个数量级,1 GHz 带宽给出 15 cm 距离分辨率。chirp 串之间目标还在动:回波相位以 4πv/(λ·f_s) 的步进旋转,二维 FFT(距离×多普勒)同时给出距离与相对速度;3 发 4 收 MIMO 用接收相位差量出方位角(~10°)。探测 200 m+,雨雾黑夜不致盲——摄像头看不清的地方,毫米波照常上班;AEB 自动紧急制动的最后一道保险常是它。
topics.descEn: A 77 GHz automotive radar runs FMCW: it transmits sawtooth chirps (~1 GHz wide), and the echo delay tau = 2d/c mixed with the local signal yields a beat frequency f_b = S·tau - measuring frequency beats measuring time by a dozen orders of magnitude, and 1 GHz of bandwidth buys 15 cm of range resolution. Between chirps the target moves: echo phase rotates stepwise, and a 2D FFT (range x Doppler) returns range and relative velocity together; 3-TX 4-RX MIMO reads azimuth from the receive phase difference (~10 deg). Detection past 200 m, blind to neither rain nor night - where cameras fail, millimeter waves clock in; the last line of AEB braking is usually this sensor.

topics.titleEn: Hearing Aids: Returning Lost Decibels by Frequency
topics.descZh: 老年性耳聋从 4-8 kHz 开始塌(耳蜗底回先衰老)——「听得见但听不清」:元音(低频)还在,辅音 s/t/k(高频)没了。助听器的回答是频率选择性的增益:麦克风 → ADC → 多通道宽动态范围压缩(WDRC,8-20 通道按测听图配增益:4 kHz 处 2 dB 输入给 30 dB 增益,90 dB 输入只给 5 dB——把 100 dB 的自然动态压进受损后 ~30 dB 的窗口)→ 接收器。增益不是越大越好:超过 ~60 dB,接收器漏音经耳道返回麦克风形成正反馈,2-5 kHz 尖啸——自适应反馈对消器估计漏音路径、反相抵消。双麦克风指向性在噪声里抬高信噪比,总延迟必须 <10 ms,否则口齿自听错乱。
topics.descEn: Age-related hearing loss collapses the 4-8 kHz band first (the cochlea base ages earliest) -

topics.titleEn: Toaster: Telling Time with a Strip of Metal That Bends
topics.descZh: 烤面包机是定时器与烤箱合一的机器:按下拨杆,卡爪咬住面包架、触点闭合,发丝般的镍铬(Nichrome)加热丝以 800-1500 W 两面夹击,槽壁抛光反射把红外与对流的热包住;表面到 ~150 °C,美拉德反应点火,面包色就是烤制的进度条。但计时器不是时钟:两种膨胀系数相差十几倍的金属(因瓦与黄铜)辊压贴合,受热便弯向低膨胀侧,弯到预置角度顶开卡爪,弹簧把面包架弹起——「烤好」是一次可听可见的机械事件。色度旋钮改变的不是时间,而是双金属片与卡爪的初始距离;零电子、断电不乱,电水壶的蒸汽断电与熨斗的温控用的都是同一片金属。
topics.descEn: A toaster is an oven and timer in one body: press the lever, the claw bites the carriage, the contacts close, and hair-thin nichrome wires bombard both faces at 800-1500 W while polished slot walls reflect the infrared back in; at ~150 C the Maillard reaction fires and bread color is the progress bar. The timer is not a clock: two metals with expansion coefficients an order of magnitude apart are rolled into one strip, heat bends it toward the low-expansion side, and at a preset angle it trips the claw - the spring fires the toast up. Done is a mechanical event. The browning knob changes not time but the starting gap between strip and claw; zero electronics, and the same trick trips kettles and irons.

topics.titleEn: Head-Up Display: Projecting the Gauges into a Virtual Image a Dozen Meters Out
topics.descZh: HUD 的光路是把光「折叠」进挡风玻璃:成像源(TFT/LCOS)→ 曲面折叠镜(兼准直)→ 挡风玻璃一次反射,把车速画成悬浮在路面远方的虚像。关键参数是虚像距离 VID(2-15 m):人眼从看仪表盘(0.8 m)切换到看路(∞),每次要付 ~0.35 s 的调节+聚合税;虚像投远之后焦点不用再换,低头-抬头-对焦三件事并成一件,视线离开路面的时间从 1.2 s 砍到 0.3 s。代价在玻璃本身:夹层三明治内外表面各反射一次会产生重影,解法是把 PVB 胶片做成 0.4-1.0° 楔角,让副像偏出眼盒;而眼盒(~100×50 mm)是所有光学的硬预算——眼睛一出盒,显示就消失。AR-HUD 再进一步,把箭头贴在 15 m 外的真实车道上。
topics.descEn: A HUD folds light into the windshield: image source (TFT/LCOS) -> a curved folding mirror (which also collimates) -> one reflection off the glass, painting your speed as a virtual image floating over the road. The key number is virtual image distance VID (2-15 m): switching focus from the cluster (0.8 m) to the road (infinity) costs ~0.35 s of accommodation and convergence each time; with the image thrown far, focus never changes, and eyes-off-road time drops from 1.2 s to 0.3 s. The cost sits in the glass itself: the sandwich reflects twice and ghosts; the fix is a 0.4-1.0 deg wedge in the PVB interlayer so the secondary image falls outside the eye box - and the eye box (~100x50 mm) is the hard budget of all the optics: drift out of it and the display vanishes. AR-HUD goes further and pins arrows onto the real lane 15 m out.

topics.titleZh: 手表心率:光电容积描记
topics.titleEn: PPG: Your Smartwatch Reads Your Pulse in Green Light
topics.descZh: 手表背面那颗闪烁的绿灯,是一项叫光电容积描记(PPG)的老技术:血液对绿光(525 nm,血红蛋白吸收峰附近)的吸收远高于皮肤与骨骼,心脏收缩时动脉毛细血管充血量只微增 1-3%,反射光就随之变暗——LED 打绿光进皮肤,光电二极管收反射,滤掉直流后剩下约 1% 的交流分量,那就是你的脉搏波:波峰间隔换算心率,波形形态还能估血压趋势。它是一场干扰的战争:运动伪影靠加速度计信号做自适应对消;佩戴过松漏光、过紧反而压扁微循环丢信号;纹身挡光、低温血管收缩、深肤色黑色素吸收强,手表会自动加大 LED 电流硬凿信号。血氧版本换了打法:红光(660 nm)+红外(940 nm)双波长,利用氧合/去氧血红蛋白在红光段吸收的巨大差异,比值之比 R 代入 SpO₂ = 110 − 25R。医疗级对照:手表级心率误差 ±2-5 bpm,单导联 ECG 房颤筛查已获 FDA 认可。拖「心率」滑杆看血管充红-放红的节拍同步加快;按「运动伪影」看波形被搅乱再被算法救回;按「佩戴过松漏光」与「血氧双波长」各看一眼。
topics.descEn: The blinking green light on the back of your watch is an old technology called photoplethysmography, PPG. Blood absorbs green light (525 nm, near the hemoglobin absorption peak) far more than skin or bone; when the heart contracts, arterial capillaries fill by only 1-3% in volume, and the reflected light dims accordingly. The LED shines green into the skin, a photodiode collects the reflection, and after the DC component is filtered out, an AC component of roughly 1% remains - that is your pulse wave: peak intervals give heart rate, and the waveform shape even tracks blood-pressure trends. It is a war against interference: motion artifacts are cancelled adaptively using accelerometer signals; a strap too loose leaks light, a strap too tight squeezes the microcirculation shut and loses the signal; tattoos block light, cold vasoconstriction weakens it, and strong melanin absorption in dark skin makes the watch push LED current harder. The SpO2 version changes tactics: red (660 nm) plus infrared (940 nm) dual wavelengths exploit the huge absorption difference between oxygenated and deoxygenated hemoglobin in the red band, and the ratio-of-ratios R feeds SpO2 = 110 - 25R. Against medical references: watch-grade heart rate is within about 2-5 bpm, and single-lead ECG atrial-fibrillation screening is FDA-cleared. Drag the heart-rate slider to watch the vessels flush and drain faster; press motion artifact to see the waveform scrambled and rescued by the algorithm; try loose-fit light leak and dual-wavelength SpO2.

topics.titleEn: PIR Sensors: Seeing You at 9.5 um
topics.descZh: 你的身体一直在广播:皮肤 33 °C(306 K),按维恩位移定律 λmax=2898/T≈9.5 μm,辐射峰值落在远红外;按斯特藩-玻尔兹曼定律,20 °C 房间里净辐射约 100 W。楼道里那颗白色传感器「看见」的就是这盏灯——但它看的不是亮,而是变:热释电晶体(钽酸锂)被红外照得表面升温几个 mK,自发极化改变,释放表面束缚电荷,输出 μV-mV 级脉冲;红外恒定则输出为零,所以 PIR 对静止不动的人天生失明。单元件会被室温漂移骗到,于是两枚元件背靠背反接做差分:环境整体变化共模抵消;再让菲涅尔透镜把视野切成十几个扇区,奇偶扇区轮流投射到 A、B——人走过,差分先正后负,极性顺序还能判方向;后级放大→窗口比较→延时定时器,灯亮 N 秒,常与照度联动夜亮昼灭。局限同样写在物理里:白玻璃不透 9.5 μm,隔窗失明;环境温度逼近体温时对比度归零;气流与宠物误触发;上电要预热 30-60 s。试一试:按「走过触发」看扇区逐格点亮与差分波形;按「静止失明」站住三秒看波形归零;按「宠物误触发」再打开「宠物滤镜」对照;把「环境温度」拉到 33 °C 以上,它当场变瞎。
topics.descEn: Your body broadcasts all the time: skin at 33 C (306 K) radiates with its peak at lambda max = 2898/T = about 9.5 um by Wien displacement - deep infrared - and sheds roughly 100 W net in a 20 C room by the Stefan-Boltzmann law. The white dome in the corridor sees exactly this lamp - but it does not see brightness, it sees change: a pyroelectric crystal (lithium tantalate) warmed by a few millikelvin shifts its spontaneous polarization and releases bound surface charge, producing microvolt-to-millivolt pulses; constant IR gives zero output, so a PIR is natively blind to a person standing still. A single element would be fooled by slow room drift, so two elements sit back-to-back, wired in opposition: whole-scene changes cancel as common mode. A faceted Fresnel lens then slices the field of view into a dozen or more sectors that project alternately onto A and B - a walking person sweeps sector boundaries and the differential swings positive then negative, the order of polarity even revealing the walking direction. The back end amplifies, compares against a window threshold and starts a delay timer that holds the lamp on for N seconds, usually gated by an ambient-light sensor so it stays dark by day. The limits are physics too: ordinary glass is opaque at 9.5 um, ambient temperature near skin temperature erases the contrast, drafts and pets cause false alarms, and the crystal needs 30-60 s to stabilize after power-up. Try it: press walk-by to watch sectors light up with the differential wave; press hold still and watch it flatten to zero in three seconds; press pet false alarm, then switch on the pet filter to compare; push ambient temperature past 33 C and it goes blind on the spot.

topics.titleZh: 手术机器人主从遥操作
topics.titleEn: Surgical Robots: A Steadier Hand, Not an Autonomous One
topics.descZh: 手术机器人的真相是「更稳的手」,不是「自动的大脑」。达芬奇系统把医生搬下手术台:双目内窥 10 倍放大 3D 视野解决「看不清」,主从遥操作解决「手不稳」——控制器把主手动作按 3:1 到 5:1 缩放,再用 1.5 Hz 截止的低通滤掉 7-10 Hz、约 100 μm 的生理性震颤,残余只剩几微米,床旁机械臂才动手;EndoWrist 器械腕带来 7 自由度、540° 转腕,把套管下人手仅剩的 4 自由度补成完整手腕。同样的手幅,组织里的针脚随缩放比成倍变细——本页的缝合演示看得见。关键认知:机器人零自主,每一步都由医生逐条指令驱动,异常即冻结,FDA 至今未批任何自主手术功能;代价同样真实:无触觉反馈、装机对接 20-30 分钟、整机 100-250 万美元、每例耗材 2-4 万元。远程手术是主从链路的延伸:端到端延迟必须压进 100-150 ms,2001 年跨大西洋 7000 km 的林德伯格手术约 155 ms 已是极限,5G 已示范跨海手术。试一试:打开「手抖模拟」看输入乱颤、输出纹丝不动;拖「缩放比」看针脚变细;把「延迟」拉到 300 ms 看输出追不上手。
topics.descEn: The truth about surgical robots is a steadier hand, not an autonomous brain. The da Vinci system takes the surgeon off the table: a stereo endoscope at 10x magnification fixes cannot-see, and master-slave teleoperation fixes will-not-hold-still - the controller scales master motions by 3:1 to 5:1, filters out the 7-10 Hz, roughly 100 um physiological tremor with a low-pass cut near 1.5 Hz, leaves a few micrometers of residual, and only then does the bedside arm move; the EndoWrist joint adds 7 degrees of freedom and 540-degree wristing, restoring the full wrist that a shaft through a trocar reduces to 4. The same hand travel makes stitch spacing shrink in proportion to the scale ratio - visible in the suturing demo on this page. The key fact: zero autonomy - every motion is driven, instruction by instruction, by the surgeon; on any fault the system freezes, and the FDA has never approved an autonomous surgical function. The costs are just as real: no haptic feedback, 20-30 minutes of docking, a 1-2.5 million dollar system and 20-40 thousand yuan of disposables per case. Telesurgery is the same chain stretched across distance: end-to-end latency must stay under 100-150 ms; the 2001 Operation Lindbergh across 7,000 km ran at about 155 ms, near the limit, and 5G demos have crossed seas. Try it: switch on hand tremor and watch the input jitter while the output stays glassy; drag the scale ratio and watch stitches tighten; push latency to 300 ms and watch the instrument chase the hand.

topics.titleZh: ATM 与钞票通道:一张纸的安检流水线
topics.titleEn: The ATM: A Security Line for Banknotes
topics.descZh: 把钱塞进取款机的一瞬间,一张纸就开始闯五关:摩擦辊(大额机型配真空吸附)把叠在一起的钞票逐张分离,一次只放一张上皮带;皮带以约 1 m/s 夹送前进;磁头扫过磁性墨水印出的图案;红外透光传感器量厚度与水印——双张意味着厚度翻倍(阈值约 1.5 倍单张),当场拦截原路退回;沿边双传感器用计时差判歪斜,CIS 接触图像传感器留档清点。全部通过才准入钞箱,任何一关不过都退回持卡人——「先验后收」。取款走 escrow 托架:钞票先被拉到暂存位请你点收,15-30 秒不取,机器自动收回注销,防止遗落与纠纷;存款同理。循环存款机更进一步:验讫的存款直接转入付钞箱再次付出,补钞频率大降。数字:入钞速度典型 4-8 张/秒,escrow 超时 15-30 秒,单箱容量 2000-3000 张。演示里跟着一张钞票穿过五道传感器,每道依次点亮判定;塞进双张看通道当场卡停退钞;按「超时收回」看取款无人领取、倒计时结束钞票被吸回注销。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The moment you push cash into the machine, every note starts a five-gate security line: friction rollers (vacuum pickups on larger units) separate stacked notes so exactly one at a time enters the belt; the belt pinches them forward at about 1 m/s; a magnetic head reads the pattern printed in magnetic ink; an infrared transmission sensor measures thickness and watermark - a double note means double thickness (threshold around 1.5x a single), jamming the channel and returning the note on the spot; twin edge sensors judge skew by timing differences while a CIS contact imager archives the count. Only notes passing every gate enter the cassette - any failure sends the note back to the cardholder: verify first, accept later. Withdrawals use an escrow holder: notes are pulled to a staging position for you to take; if nobody collects within 15-30 seconds the machine swallows them back and cancels the transaction, preventing losses and disputes. Deposits work the same way. Cash-recycling machines go further: verified deposits pass straight into the payout cassette to be paid out again, cutting refill trips dramatically. The numbers: deposit speeds of 4-8 notes per second, escrow timeouts of 15-30 s, 2000-3000 notes per cassette. In the demo, follow one note through five sensors that light up in turn; insert a double to watch the channel jam and spit it back; press timeout retract to see unclaimed withdrawal notes get sucked back and cancelled. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 电池管理与均衡:木桶的电子保姆
topics.titleEn: Battery Management & Balancing: Taming the Weakest Cell
topics.descZh: 电动汽车的 400 V 电池组是 96 颗锂电芯的串联:同一条电流依次穿过每一颗芯,任何一颗过充(>4.25 V 负极析锂)或过放(<2.5 V 铜集流体溶解)都足以让整组报废甚至起火——所以电池管理系统(BMS)要做四件事:监测每芯电压/温度/电流、保护性截停充放电、均衡、SOC 估计。均衡的根源在串联本身:回路电流处处相同,容量不齐的电芯必然「有人先满、有人没饱」——充电时电压最高的芯先顶到上限,全组被迫截停,可用容量等于最弱那颗芯(木桶效应)。被动均衡用 30-100 Ω 电阻把高压芯的涓流(常见约 100 mA)放掉,便宜但发热浪费;主动均衡用电容/电感把电荷搬给低压芯,效率高成本高;均衡电流远小于工作电流,只能照顾静态不均,出厂按容量/内阻/自放电分档配组才是大头——温差 5 °C 就能让老化差约 2 倍,所以模组底部要做液冷。SOC 靠安时积分+开路电压修正+卡尔曼滤波。演示里 12 节电芯列队充电:拖「芯不均匀度」看最高芯亮红触发截停、可用容量当场缩水;开「均衡」看涓流把它拉回、全组一起满格;切「主动」看电荷搬家;按「SOC 估计演示」看漂移与修正。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: An EV 400 V pack is 96 lithium cells in series: one single current threads through every cell in turn, so a single overcharge (above 4.25 V, lithium plating on the anode) or over-discharge (below 2.5 V, the copper collector dissolving) can wreck the pack or set it on fire. The battery management system therefore does four jobs: monitor every cell voltage, temperature and current; protectively cut charge or discharge; balance; and estimate state of charge. Balancing is rooted in the series string itself: with identical current everywhere, cells of unequal capacity must fill at different speeds - the highest-voltage cell hits the ceiling first and forces the whole pack to stop, so usable capacity equals the weakest cell, the wooden-barrel effect. Passive balancing bleeds high cells through 30-100 ohm resistors at a trickle of roughly 100 mA - cheap, but the energy is burned as heat; active balancing shuttles charge to low cells through capacitors or inductors - efficient but costly. Balancing current is far smaller than the working current, so it only trims static mismatch; factory matching by capacity, internal resistance and self-discharge does the heavy lifting - a 5 C temperature spread alone roughly doubles the aging difference, hence liquid cooling beneath the modules. SOC comes from coulomb counting plus open-circuit-voltage correction plus a Kalman filter. In the demo 12 cells charge in a row: drag the mismatch slider to watch the tallest cell flash red and force a cutoff while usable capacity shrinks on the spot; switch balancing on and watch the trickle pull it back until the whole row fills together; toggle active mode to see charge being carried between cells; press the SOC demo to watch drift and correction. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 太阳能热水器:水自己会爬
topics.titleEn: Solar Water Heater: Water That Climbs by Itself
topics.descZh: 楼顶那排真空管没有泵也没有电,热水却自己「爬」上水箱——这就是热虹吸:水在集热器里被太阳加热、密度变小,沿上升管浮升进水箱,箱底冷水下沉、沿下降管回到集热器补充,循环自驱动,动力只是密度差×重力×高度差(Δρ·g·h,几帕到几十帕),泵被物理定律代替。真空管是这套系统的关键:内外管之间抽成真空,传导与对流两条散热路全被掐断;内管表面的选择性吸收涂层(Al-N/Al)吸收率 α>0.92、发射率 ε<0.08——尽量收下太阳的短波,尽量不吐出自己的长波,像一只只进不出的热二极管。铁律:水箱必须高于集热器——低于它,夜间变冷的集热器会驱动反向虹吸,把整箱热水的热量一夜偷走;北方严寒地区则用防冻液二次回路或排空策略过冬。账本:1 m² 集热器在中国北方一年可得热 400-700 kWh,覆盖家庭 60-70% 的热水需求,阴天由电辅热兜底。拖「日照强度」看虹吸流速与水温爬升;拖「水箱高度差」感受循环对几何有多敏感;按「真空绝热对照」看真空失效时的热逃逸;把日照拉到 0(夜间)再把高度差拖成负值,看倒流偷热的现场。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: The row of evacuated tubes on the roof has no pump and no electronics, yet hot water climbs to the tank by itself - thermosiphon: water heated in the collector expands and its density drops, so it floats up the riser into the tank while cooler water at the tank bottom sinks and returns along the down pipe to be reheated. The loop drives itself on nothing more than density difference times gravity times height (drho*g*h - a few pascals to a few tens): physics replaces the pump. The vacuum tube is the key: the space between the outer and inner glass is evacuated, cutting both conduction and convection; the inner tube carries a selective absorbing coating (Al-N/Al) with absorptance above 0.92 and emittance below 0.08 - drink in the sun's short wavelengths, refuse to radiate out its own long waves: a thermal one-way valve. The iron rule: the tank must sit above the collector. Below it, the cold collector at night drives a reverse siphon that silently drains the whole tank of heat overnight; in hard-freeze regions a glycol secondary loop or a drain-back strategy survives the winter. The ledger: one square meter of collector harvests 400-700 kWh of heat per year in northern China, covering 60-70% of a household hot water demand, with electric backup for overcast stretches. Drag sunlight intensity to watch flow speed and tank temperature respond; drag the tank height difference to feel how sensitive the loop is to geometry; press the vacuum comparison to watch heat escape when the vacuum fails; pull sunlight to zero (night) and drag the height difference negative to catch the reverse-siphon thief in action. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 肌电假肢:残端的肌肉还在发电
topics.descZh: 截肢后,残端肌肉只要还健康,收缩时照常发电:脊髓运动神经元放电激动肌纤维,动作电位经组织容积传导到皮肤表面,成为幅度 10 μV–1 mV、频率 20–500 Hz 的一片噪声毛刺——这就是表面肌电 EMG。信号链三步:表面差分电极(两片+参考)先抑制远方来的共模干扰;20–450 Hz 带通滤掉基线漂移与高频噪声,50/60 Hz 陷波对付工频;再整流取包络(RMS,时间常数 100–200 ms,太短抖动、太长迟钝),得到平滑的「用力程度」。最简单是双通道阈值控制:屈肌超阈值→闭合,伸肌超阈值→张开;比例控制把包络幅度映射成握力。进阶是模式识别:多电极通道提取时域特征(MAV、过零数、波形长度),分类器(LDA/小网络)识别四到八种手势意图,实验室准确率超过 95%。目标肌肉再神经支配 TMR 把截断的臂丛神经缝到残端其他肌肉上,把「手的信号」搬到皮肤表面——通道更丰富、手势库更大。最大短板是开环:手没有触觉,用户要靠眼睛盯;振动/电刺激触觉反馈闭环是前沿。日常挑战:电极移位、出汗衰减、肌电疲劳、电池一天一充。演示里拖动「收缩力度」看发光波沿肌束传播、原始肌电毛刺在示波器上抬起,包络过阈值后机械手开合;切「模式识别」看四条置信度条实时竞争;按「电极偏移」「出汗干扰」看误动作;勾选 TMR 看手势库翻倍。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: After an amputation, healthy residual muscles still fire normally when they contract: spinal motor neurons excite the fibers, and the action potentials reach the skin surface through volume conduction as a patch of noisy spikes, 10 uV to 1 mV in amplitude over 20-500 Hz - that is surface electromyography, EMG. The signal chain has three stages: a differential electrode (two pads + one reference) first rejects far-field common-mode interference; a 20-450 Hz bandpass removes baseline drift and high-frequency noise, with a 50/60 Hz notch for the power line; then rectification extracts the envelope (RMS, time constant 100-200 ms - too short jitters, too long feels sluggish), giving a smooth measure of effort. The simplest control is two-channel thresholding: flexor over threshold -> close, extensor over threshold -> open; proportional control maps envelope amplitude into grip force. The advanced option is pattern recognition: several electrode channels yield time-domain features (MAV, zero crossings, waveform length) and a classifier (LDA or a small network) recognizes four to eight intended gestures, above 95% accuracy in the lab. Targeted muscle reinnervation (TMR) sews the cut brachial-plexus nerves onto other residual muscles, moving the hand's signals to the skin surface - richer channels, a larger gesture set. The biggest weakness is open loop: the hand feels nothing, so users must watch it; vibrotactile and electrical feedback closed loops are the frontier. Daily challenges: electrode shift, sweat attenuation, EMG fatigue, and a battery that needs daily charging. In the demo, drag the contraction slider to watch glowing waves run along the muscle bundles and raw EMG spikes climb on the scope, then the envelope crosses threshold and the hand acts; switch to pattern recognition to watch confidence bars compete in real time; press electrode shift or sweat interference to see mis-grasps; tick TMR to double the gesture library. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 颗粒捕捉器:炭烟的陶瓷迷宫
topics.descZh: 柴油机是扩散燃烧:燃油喷进气缸来不及与空气混匀,富油区高温缺氧,天然产生炭烟——碳核上吸附着有机物与硫酸盐,几十到几百纳米。DPF 颗粒捕捉器是壁流式蜂窝陶瓷(堇青石或碳化硅,200–300 cpsi 蜂窝孔,壁厚 0.3–0.5 mm,壁内微孔约十微米):相邻孔道一端封堵、另一端敞开,交替排列——废气没有直路,被迫穿过这面多孔壁,颗粒撞在壁上被拦,过滤效率大于 95%(质量计);气体走了「墙」,炭烟留下了。炭越积越多,背压升高、油耗升、动力降,必须定期再生:被动再生——上游 DOC 把 NO 氧化成 NO₂,C+2NO₂→CO₂+2NO 在 250–450 °C 持续慢烧;主动再生——排温不够就后喷燃油或推迟喷射,把载体烧到 550–650 °C,C+O₂ 放热链式推进,10–30 分钟,通常每几百公里一次。温度是双刃剑:低于 550 烧不动,超过 800 载体烧结甚至烧熔。灰分(机油添加剂的钙/锌/磷与磨损金属)不可燃,慢慢占容——几万公里后要拆下来灰洗;再生失败、长期短途会堵死限扭「跛行」。与汽油机的三元催化 TWC、柴油机的 SCR 尿素共同构成排放后处理三件套;满载炭量 5–8 g/L,再生额外燃耗 2–4%。演示里拖「排温」看被动/主动再生的切换,孔道积炭变暗、背压表爬升;点火后看温度前锋扫过、炭烧成 CO₂、背压回落;按「灰分累积」「再生失败」看长期后果;勾「三件套全景」看 DOC→DPF→SCR 流水线。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: A diesel engine burns by diffusion: fuel is sprayed into the cylinder without time to mix evenly, so fuel-rich zones at high temperature run out of oxygen and naturally make soot - carbon cores coated with organics and sulfates, tens to hundreds of nanometers. The DPF (diesel particulate filter) is a wall-flow honeycomb ceramic (cordierite or silicon carbide, 200-300 cpsi cells, 0.3-0.5 mm walls, pores around ten microns): adjacent channels are plugged at opposite ends, alternating - exhaust has no straight path and is forced through the porous walls, where particles are caught, giving over 95% filtration efficiency by mass; the gas walks through the wall, the soot stays. As carbon accumulates, backpressure rises, fuel consumption climbs and power drops, so the filter must regenerate periodically: passive regeneration - the upstream DOC oxidizes NO into NO2, and C+2NO2->CO2+2NO slow-burns the soot continuously at 250-450 C; active regeneration - when exhaust temperature is too low, fuel is injected late or post-injected to push the substrate to 550-650 C, where C+O2 -> CO2 releases heat that drives the burn front forward, taking 10-30 minutes, typically every few hundred kilometers. Temperature is double-edged: below 550 nothing burns, above 800 the substrate sinters or even melts. Ash (Ca/Zn/P from oil additives plus wear metals) is incombustible and slowly fills the volume - after tens of thousands of kilometers the filter must be removed and ash-washed; failed regens and long-term short trips clog it solid, triggering torque limits and limp mode. Together with the gasoline three-way catalyst (TWC) and diesel SCR urea system it forms the aftertreatment trio; full soot capacity is 5-8 g/L of substrate and regeneration costs 2-4% extra fuel. In the demo, drag the exhaust temperature to switch passive/active regeneration and watch channels darken and the pressure gauge climb; ignite to see the burning front sweep through, soot leave as CO2 and backpressure fall; press ash accumulation or regen failure for the long-term story; tick the trio panorama for the DOC -> DPF -> SCR pipeline. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.titleZh: 内窥镜:一根能拐弯的眼睛
topics.titleEn: The Endoscope: An Eye That Bends
topics.descZh: 不用开刀就能看见胃里的一小块溃疡——内窥镜把「眼睛 + 手电 + 机械手」全部塞进一根 9 mm 的软管。头端四件套:物镜(视场 140-170°)、导光束(体外冷光源把强光送进来,体内只留冷光不灼伤)、水气通道(冲洗视野、充气撑开腔体)、器械通道(2.8-3.7 mm,活检钳、圈套器、注射针都从这里进)。弯曲部是灵魂:四根钢丝两两一组,L/R 与 U/D 两个手轮拉这头、松那头,几厘米长的弯曲段就能拐出 210° 以上、弯曲半径 5-10 mm——在幽门皱襞之间掉头。图像走两条路:老一代纤维镜用「传像束」——上万根光纤按完全相同的排列熔在两端,每根光纤靠全反射传一个像素,断一根就永远死一个点;现代电子镜干脆把 CMOS/CCD 塞进头端,体内拍照、导线传电,分辨率到十万~百万像素,NBI 窄带成像还能突出黏膜血管纹理。胶囊内镜是它的极简版:26×11 mm、LED + 相机 + 电池,每秒 2-6 帧,靠蠕动自然推进 8-14 小时拍完小肠。数字:胃镜外径 9-10 mm,插入深度 ~1 m,可做活检、息肉切除、止血夹、支架——看到即治到。演示里拖「插入深度」沿食道进胃,拖 L/R 与 U/D 操纵弯曲部,监视器画面(左下示波窗)实时变化;对准红色病灶按「活检钳」取样;切「纤维镜」看传像束剖面与断丝死点;按「胶囊内镜」看它随蠕动漂完小肠。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn: Seeing an ulcer inside the stomach without opening the patient - an endoscope packs an eye, a flashlight and a robotic hand into a 9 mm flexible tube. Four things live in the tip: an objective lens (140-170 degree field), a light guide (an external cold-light source sends bright light down, so nothing hot burns tissue), an air/water channel (to rinse the lens and inflate the cavity), and a 2.8-3.7 mm working channel for biopsy forceps, snares and needles. The bending section is the soul: four steel wires in two opposing pairs - two handwheels pull one side and slacken the other, letting a few centimeters of scope bend past 210 degrees with a 5-10 mm radius, turning corners among gastric folds. Images travel two ways: older fiberscopes use a fused image bundle - tens of thousands of fibers ordered identically at both ends, each carrying one pixel by total internal reflection; break one fiber and that pixel dies forever. Modern video endoscopes just put a CMOS/CCD in the tip, photographing in vivo with 0.1-1 megapixels, and NBI narrow-band imaging brings out mucosal vessel texture. The capsule endoscope is the minimal version: 26 x 11 mm, LED plus camera plus battery, 2-6 frames a second, riding peristalsis for 8-14 hours through the small intestine. The numbers: gastroscopes are 9-10 mm across, reach about a meter in, and can biopsy, snare polyps, clip bleeds and place stents - see it, treat it. In the demo, drag insertion depth to slide down the esophagus into the stomach, steer L/R and U/D to aim the bending section and watch the monitor view (scope window) respond; aim at a red lesion and press biopsy forceps to sample it; switch to fiberscope for the bundle cross-section and dead pixels; press capsule endoscope to drift through the small bowel. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause

topics.descZh: 闪光灯管在一毫秒里喷出五万瓦的功率——是电水壶的二十倍——而喂它的只是一节 3.7 V 的锂电池。魔法分三步:升压电路(反激变压器+整流)把 3.7 V 抬到 300-340 V 存进主电容,这个过程叫「回电」,要 1-5 秒,咔哒声与「滋」声都是它在充电;拍照瞬间,触发线圈再叠加一个几千伏的高压脉冲,击穿氙气灯管内的气体,惰性气体被电离成等离子体通道;主电容随即通过这条通道放电,几十到两百焦耳的能量在 1 ms 内倾泻,氙气被激发出包含全部可见光的连续光谱——色温 5500 K 左右,与正午日光几乎一致,这就是闪光灯「补光像没补」的原因。闪光指数 GN = 距离 × 光圈,ISO 100 下 GN 36 意味着 3.6 m 处开 f/10 恰好正确曝光;现代 TTL 系统在正式曝光前先打一次 1/1000 功率的「预闪」,通过镜头测光反算输出,再由主闪完成——预闪与主闪间隔仅几十毫秒,人眼以为只闪了一下。回电时间是连拍的硬约束:电容没充满就按快门,只能打出半亮;而 LED 常亮灯虽然可以视频补光,峰值亮度却差氙灯两个数量级——毫秒级的高功率,目前仍是电容加气体的专利。拖「电池电压」看升压输出,拖「储能」看回电时间;按「放电慢放」看 1 ms 曲线,按「GN 计算」现场算曝光,按「预闪测光」看 TTL 两连闪。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A flash tube dumps fifty kilowatts for a millisecond - twenty times an electric kettle - fed by a single 3.7 V lithium cell. The magic is three steps: a boost circuit (flyback transformer plus rectifier) lifts 3.7 V to 300-340 V and stores it in the main capacitor - the "recycle" that takes 1-5 seconds, its hum and click the sound of charging; at the shutter, a trigger coil stacks on a few-thousand-volt pulse that ionizes the xenon gas into a plasma channel; the main capacitor then dumps tens to two hundred joules through that channel in a millisecond, exciting xenon into a continuous spectrum across all visible wavelengths - about 5500 K, nearly identical to noon daylight, which is why flash fill-light looks like no light at all. Guide number = distance x aperture: GN 36 at ISO 100 means f/10 exposes correctly at 3.6 m. Modern TTL systems fire a 1/1000-power preflash before the real exposure, meter through the lens, compute the output, and let the main flash finish - the two pulses tens of milliseconds apart read as one. Recycle time is the burst-shooting constraint: press early and you get half brightness; LED continuous lights handle video but trail xenon by two orders of magnitude in peak output - millisecond-scale power is still the capacitor-and-gas monopoly. Drag battery voltage for boost output, drag stored energy for recycle time; press discharge slow-motion for the 1 ms curve, GN calculator to solve an exposure live, TTL preflash to see the double blink. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 闪光灯剖面:电池、变压器(绕组动画)、主电容(储能液柱上升)、氙管(触发瞬间白光爆闪);光锥打向人像;能量-时间曲线 canvas;预闪/主闪双脉冲。

topics.descZh: 堵住双耳再哼歌,歌声依然清晰——这条路平时就在工作:声音到达耳蜗有两条路,一条是主流的气导(声波→外耳道→鼓膜→三块听小骨→耳蜗),另一条是骨导(振动直接经颅骨传进耳蜗)。骨传导耳机把这条备用路变成主路:贴在颞骨上的振子让颅骨整体微振,耳蜗里的淋巴液被直接激起行波,毛细胞照常发电位——耳道全程开放,环境音一个不落,跑步骑车时听得见身后车流;贝多芬失聪后咬住连接钢琴的木棒作曲,用的就是这条路。骨导在临床上还是鉴别诊断的钥匙:韦伯试验把震动的音叉顶在颅骨正中,单耳传导性耳聋(鼓膜或听小骨坏了)的患者会说患侧更响——患侧耳道被环境声「淹没」的干扰消失了,骨导信号反而凸出;感音性耳聋(耳蜗或听神经坏了)则健侧更响。林纳试验对比同一耳的气导与骨导:正常人气导更长,传导性耳聋反过来——两个试验一组合,病灶位置当场定位。骨导的短板在高频:颅骨是个低通滤波器,4 kHz 以上衰减明显,音乐细节打折,所以它适合通话、导航与运动场景,不适合录音师的监听。拖「音量/频率」看两条通路的响应差,拖「气导损失」模拟传导性耳聋;按「两条通路对照」看气导与骨导的并行,按「韦伯试验」看音叉偏侧,按「贝多芬模式」咬住木棒听琴。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Hum with your ears plugged and the song stays clear - that route is always working: sound reaches the cochlea by two paths, air conduction (the main one: canal, eardrum, three ossicles, cochlea) and bone conduction (vibration straight through the skull). Bone-conduction headsets promote the backup to the main road: transducers on your temples set the whole skull micro-vibrating, cochlear fluid takes up the wave directly, hair cells fire as usual - ear canals stay open, ambient sound fully audible, traffic behind you included on a run; Beethoven composed with a rod clenched in his teeth after going deaf, on this very path. Clinically, bone conduction is a diagnostic key: in the Weber test a vibrating tuning fork on mid-skull sounds louder in the affected ear for conductive loss - with the canal's ambient masking gone, the bone signal stands out - while sensorineural loss hears it in the healthy ear. The Rinne test compares the two paths in one ear: normal hearing gives longer air conduction, conductive loss reverses it - together the two localize the lesion on the spot. The weakness is high frequencies: the skull is a low-pass filter, rolling off above 4 kHz, so bone conduction suits calls, navigation and sport, not the studio. Drag volume/frequency to split the two paths' response, drag air-conduction loss to simulate conductive deafness; press two-path comparison, Weber test for the fork's lean, Beethoven mode to bite the rod. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 头部剖面(半透明颅骨+耳部解剖:耳道、鼓膜、听小骨链、螺旋耳蜗);颞骨上骨传导振子;两路动画:空气波纹进耳道 vs 颅骨振动波直达耳蜗;音叉;行波沿耳蜗展开。

topics.descZh: 电吉他不插电时声音干瘪,插电后的全部灵魂来自一排磁铁加一圈线:拾音器的磁极把钢弦局部磁化——琴弦本身成了一块磁铁;弦振动时,它在磁极上方的位置周期性摆动,穿过线圈的磁通随之涨落,法拉第定律当场变现:线圈两端感应出几毫伏到几百毫伏的交变电压,频率就是弦的振动频率,谐波成分也是弦的谐波成分——拾音器不是麦克风,它直接读出弦的力学振动,不采空气。单线圈的烦恼是嗡声:一圈几千匝的线就是一台天线,50/60 Hz 的电网 hum 被原样收进来;1955 年 Gibson 的 Seth Lover 给出双线圈方案:两组线圈反向绕、磁极反向排(humbucker),电网 hum 在两圈里感应出同向电流、相减归零,而弦的信号因磁极反向感应出反向电流、相减后反而相加——噪声成对出现被抵消,信号成对相反而被保留,一石二鸟。拾音位置还是音色旋钮之外的另一颗旋钮:琴桥端靠近弦的固定端,高次谐波节点多、音色冲而亮;琴颈端靠近振动腹,基频强、音色暖——同一个吉他手换一次挡位等于换了半个音色。拖「弦振幅」看磁通涨落,拖「拾音位置」听音色迁移;按「单/双线圈对照」看 hum 相消,按「磁场慢放」看弦如何 squeeze 磁感线,按「谐波节点」看位置为何改音色。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
An unplugged electric guitar is dull; everything on the amp comes from magnets plus a coil: the pickup's pole pieces partially magnetize the steel string - the string itself becomes a magnet. As it vibrates over the poles, the flux threading the coil rises and falls, and Faraday's law pays out: millivolts to hundreds of millivolts of alternating voltage, its frequency the string's, its harmonics the string's - the pickup is not a microphone; it reads the string's mechanical motion directly, air not involved. The single coil's curse is hum: thousands of turns make a fine antenna, and 50/60 Hz mains hum arrives as-is. In 1955 Gibson's Seth Lover doubled up: two coils wound in opposite directions with reversed pole polarity (the humbucker) - mains hum induces identical currents in both and cancels, while the string, seen through reversed poles, induces opposite currents that subtract into addition: noise cancels, signal reinforces, two birds one stone. Pickup position is a second tone knob: the bridge sits near the string's fixed end where high harmonics have nodes - bright and biting; the neck sits near antinodes, fundamentals strong - warm; one switch flicks half the timbre. Drag string amplitude to watch flux swing, drag pickup position to slide the tone; press single/double comparison to watch hum cancel, field slow-motion for the string squeezing field lines, harmonic nodes for why position changes tone. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 琴弦(钢色)横跨磁极(银柱),磁感线弧;弦振动时磁感线被挤压波动;线圈(铜色绕组)端电压波形示波;hum 源(50 Hz 波)与双线圈相消示意;位置切换(桥/颈)。

topics.descZh: 一只电吹风在巴掌大的壳里塞下一台电动机、一只风扇和一段 1000-2000 瓦的电炉丝,还要保证它永远不会把你头发点着——它的电路图只有一句话:加热丝与电机并联,开关串联在各自支路。冷风档只有电机支路通电,风扇把室温空气推过去;热风档把加热丝接进电路,镍铬丝的电阻按功率定制(1200 W 对应约 40 Ω),空气被强迫对流加热,出口温度 60-100 °C。真正的心思全在安全链上:加热丝附近装着一枚双金属片温控器(约 90-120 °C 跳开)与一枚一次性热熔断器,串联在加热支路里——进风口被头发堵住、风量骤减时,出口温度几秒内蹿过设定值,双金属片跳开断电,降温后自动复位;若它失灵,熔断器熔断,整机报废但房子还在。风量与温度是一对共轭旋钮:同一根加热丝,风大则出风温度低,风小则温度飙升触发保护——所以老式吹风机用「高/低」两档(串联二极管半波或分段电阻),而不是无级调温。高端机型换上无刷电机:转速十万 rpm 级、风量翻倍、噪音更低,再用热敏电阻对加热丝实时闭环,做到「大风低温」快干不伤发。拖「风量」看出风温度的此消彼长,拖「加热档」看功率分配;按「冷风」看只有风扇转,按「热风」看丝红风热,按「过热保护」看堵塞后温控跳闸,按「无刷对比」看高速马达的账本。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A hair dryer packs a motor, a fan and a 1000-2000 watt coil of nichrome into a shell the size of your hand, and must never set your hair on fire - its circuit is one sentence: heating element and motor in parallel, a switch in each branch. Cool setting powers the fan alone, pushing room-temperature air through; hot setting adds the element, its resistance sized to the power (1200 W is about 40 ohms), and forced convection carries the heat out at 60-100 degrees. The real engineering lives in the safety chain: a bimetal thermostat (tripping near 90-120 degrees) and a one-shot thermal fuse sit in series with the element - block the air inlet with hair, outlet temperature blows past the setpoint within seconds, the bimetal opens and resets as it cools; if it fails, the fuse melts, the dryer is dead but the house is fine. Airflow and heat are conjugate knobs: the same wire with more air runs a cooler nozzle, and with little air the temperature runs away into protection - which is why classic dryers offer two heat settings (a series diode's half wave, or a tapped resistor) rather than stepless temperature. Premium models swap in a brushless motor: hundred-thousand-rpm-class speed, double the airflow, lower noise, with a thermistor closing the loop on the wire for high-flow low-heat drying that is fast and gentle. Drag airflow for the nozzle temperature trade, drag heat setting for the power split; press cool for fan only, hot for glowing wire and warm wind, overheat protection for the tripped thermostat after a blocked inlet, brushless comparison for the high-speed motor's ledger. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 吹风机纵向剖视:进风格栅、电机+风扇、螺旋镍铬丝(通电发红)、云母支架、出风口;空气流粒子由蓝变红;双金属片与熔断器在加热支路上高亮;堵塞演示时风粒子骤减、丝温红闪、温控跳开。

topics.descZh: 市电断掉的那半秒钟里,谁替服务器撑着?UPS 的回答分三档。后备式(离线式)最简单:平时市电直接喂负载,UPS 只在旁边给电池浮充;停电瞬间继电器「咔嗒」切到逆变器,由电池直流变交流续命——切换时间 4-10 毫秒,电脑电源的大电容足够扛住,精密仪器却会眨眼。在线互动式加了一级 AVR:电压偏低时先由抽头变压器升压稳住,不起逆变,只有真正断电才切换;它治的是电压跌落(sag)——那才是比停电更常见的电网病。双转换在线式最贵也最稳:市电永远先整流成直流、再逆变回交流,负载吃的每一度电都是 UPS 重新做出来的——市电的浪涌、频率漂移、谐波全被隔离在外,切换时间恒为零,代价是两次变换损失 5-10% 效率,以及风扇常转的噪音。账本的核心是电池:一节 12 V 7 Ah 铅酸电池存约 84 瓦时,带一台 300 W 的 PC 最多十几分钟——UPS 的使命不是长跑,而是「撑到你保存文件或发电机起来」;机房方案里,UPS 接力柴油发电机,一个管分钟,一个管小时。新的变法是用锂电池与超级电容替铅酸:寿命从 3-5 年拉到 10 年,循环上千次,体积减半。拖「市电电压」看三种机型各自的反应,拖「负载功率」看备电时间;按「后备切换」看继电器切换与波形缺口,按「在线互动」看 AVR 抽头动作,按「双转换」看整流-逆变双级,按「电池续航」看放电曲线。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
When the mains die for half a second, who holds up the server? A UPS answers in three grades. Standby (offline) is the simplest: mains feeds the load directly while the UPS trickle-charges its battery; at a blackout a relay clicks over to the inverter, and battery DC becomes AC again - 4-10 milliseconds of gap, which a PC power supply's capacitors shrug off but precision instruments blink at. Line-interactive adds an AVR tap transformer: sags are corrected by switching taps without leaving bypass mode, and only a true outage triggers the transfer - it treats voltage sag, the grid's more common disease than blackouts. Double-conversion online is the expensive steady one: mains is always rectified to DC and inverted back to AC, so every watt the load sees is remade by the UPS - surges, frequency drift and harmonics never reach through, transfer time is zero by construction, and the price is 5-10 percent lost in the two conversions plus a fan that never sleeps. The battery is the real ledger: one 12 V 7 Ah lead-acid brick stores about 84 watt-hours, good for a dozen-odd minutes on a 300 W PC - a UPS is not built for the long run but for holding until you save your file or the generator catches; in data centers the UPS relays to diesel, one covering minutes, the other hours. Lithium and supercapacitors are replacing lead: lifetime from 3-5 years to 10, a thousand cycles, half the volume. Drag mains voltage to watch each type react, drag load power for runtime; press standby transfer for the relay click and waveform notch, line-interactive for the AVR taps, double conversion for the rectifier-inverter pair, battery runtime for the discharge curve. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 机柜剖视:市电进线→继电器/整流器→逆变器→负载插座,电池组侧挂;示波器画市电波形,停电处缺口与续接波形对比;三档机型切换(继电器咔嗒/抽头跳变/双级常通);电池电量条随放电下降。

topics.descZh: 机场安检机在几秒内「看穿」你的行李,靠的是一只会画线的眼睛:传送带把包拖进铅帘隧道,底部的 X 射线管发出扇形光束,正上方的探测器阵列逐线接收——包走一寸,图画一寸,像传真机一样把整个行李扫成一张数字影像。真正让安检员能「分物」的是双能技术:同一列探测器分高低两档管电压(或双层闪烁体)各收一遍,同一个像素就有了两份衰减数据——高能下光电吸收变弱而康普顿散射相对占优,元素越重、这个比例变化越陡;用两档数据的比值反推「等效原子序数」,就能给每个像素标上材质:有机物(水、塑料、炸药)橙红,混合物绿色,金属与无机物蓝色。再加形状识别:爆炸物与毒品有特征轮廓与密度,算法在图上叠出红色警报框,配合操作员放大、翻转、三视图切看。剂量账很克制:过一次安检机每件行李约 0.1-1 μGy,吃一根香蕉的天然辐射都比它多;真正被屏蔽的是操作员——射线源下方铅板与隧道铅帘把漏射线压到本底量级。与医用 CT 的差别在视角:安检机是单视角投影(叠加成像),CT 才是环形扫描三维重建,所以安检图上物物重叠是常态——操作员的本事就是把重叠的层次拆开。拖「传送速度」看逐线成像的节奏,拖「管电压」看穿透力与对比度;按「逐线成像」看扇形束画线,按「双能判物」看橙绿蓝上色,按「威胁报警」看算法叠框,按「铅帘防护」看射线被挡在隧道里。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
An airport scanner sees through your bag in seconds with an eye that draws lines: the belt carries luggage under lead curtains, an X-ray tube below fans out a beam, and a detector row directly above receives it - one inch of travel, one line of picture, a fax machine building a full image. What lets the operator sort materials is dual energy: the same detector column samples at two tube voltages (or two scintillator layers), so every pixel carries two attenuation readings - at higher energy photoelectric absorption fades while Compton scattering holds, and the heavier the element, the steeper that ratio shifts; inverting the ratio yields an effective atomic number, and each pixel gets a material tag: organics (water, plastics, explosives) in orange, mixed in green, metals and inorganics in blue. Shape recognition comes on top: explosives and narcotics have signature outlines and densities, and the algorithm overlays red alarm boxes for the operator to zoom, flip and slice through three views. The dose ledger is restrained: one bag pass delivers about 0.1-1 microgray - a banana's natural radioactivity gives you more; the party actually shielded is the operator - lead under the source plus the curtain tunnel hold leakage to background levels. The difference from medical CT is the viewpoint: security is single-view projection (everything superimposed), CT alone rotates and reconstructs in 3D, so overlapping objects are the operator's daily puzzle. Drag belt speed for the line-by-line rhythm, drag tube voltage for penetration versus contrast; press line-scan imaging to watch the fan draw, dual-energy coloring for the orange-green-blue tags, threat overlay for the alarm boxes, lead curtains for rays stopped inside the tunnel. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 安检机立体剖视:传送带+铅帘+底部射线管扇形束+顶部探测器列;行李逐线成像、图像从左到右生长;同一行李分橙/绿/蓝三色材质图与灰度图对比;危险品轮廓出现红色警报框;剂量计数器。

topics.descZh: 电子学的起点是一段被烧红的灯丝:1880 年爱迪生发现灯泡里加一块金属板,烧热的阴极就会向它送电——爱迪生效应,当年没人答得上「电是怎么越过真空的」,直到电子被发现;1904 年弗莱明把它做成真空二极管,一条只许单向通行的阀门,交流由此变直流;1906 年德福雷斯特在阴极与阳极之间插进一张金属栅网,栅压的微小变化就能节制阳极的大电流——三极管,人类第一个电子放大器,微弱信号从此可以放大上千倍,无线电跨洋、雷达网、电视、电话中继全从这张小栅网里长出来,第一台通用电子计算机 ENIAC 用了 17468 只管,换坏管成了值班员的日常。但它是天生的热机器:阴极要烧到约 1000 K 才肯吐电子,灯丝耗电、玻璃易碎、参数漂移,1947 年登场的晶体管只用三十九年就把它请进博物馆;不过真空管没有死绝:电吉他音箱爱它的软削波——偶次谐波,乐手叫「温暖」;微波炉的磁控管、医院的 X 射线管、卫星上的行波管,都是它活在今天的直系后代。拖「栅极电压」看闸门开度如何节制电子流,拖「灯丝温度」看阴极多冷就多沉默;按「二极管整流」看交流被削成半波,按「三极管放大」看小波进大波出,按「音频信号」看复杂波形原样放大,按「软削波失真」看波峰被揉圆、偶次谐波冒头。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Electronics starts with a red-hot filament: in 1880 Edison noticed that a metal plate inside a light bulb picks up current from the heated cathode - the Edison effect, unexplained until the electron was discovered; in 1904 Fleming shaped it into the vacuum diode, a one-way valve that turns AC into DC; in 1906 De Forest slipped a wire mesh between cathode and plate, and a tiny swing of grid voltage began to throttle a large anode current - the triode, the first electronic amplifier, copying faint signals a thousandfold. Transoceanic radio, radar, television and telephone repeaters all grew out of that small grid; the first general-purpose electronic computer, ENIAC, burned 17468 tubes and swapping dead ones became a daily chore. But the tube runs hot by nature: the cathode gives up electrons only near 1000 K, filaments eat power, glass breaks, parameters drift - and the 1947 transistor needed just thirty-nine years to sweep it into museums. It never quite died, though: guitar amps prize its soft clipping - even harmonics players call warmth - while the magnetron in microwave ovens, medical X-ray tubes and satellite traveling-wave tubes are its living descendants. Drag grid voltage to throttle the electron gate, drag filament temp to watch a cold cathode fall silent; press diode rectify to watch AC trimmed to half-waves, press triode gain for small wave in and large wave out, press audio signal to see a complex waveform amplified in shape, press soft clipping to watch peaks rounded and even harmonics rise. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 大号玻璃管剖视:红热灯丝线圈、阴极筒、金属栅网、阳极板与顶部吸气剂;青色电子粒子从阴极涌出,在栅网处被扣留或放行,阳极随电流发亮;示波器同步画栅极输入小波与阳极输出大波;二极管模式栅网退场、交流被削成半波,软削波模式波峰被揉圆、谐波失真表攀升。

topics.descZh: 烘干机的本质是一门「搬运课」:把水从衣物里搬进空气、再搬出家门,路线有两条,账本截然不同。通风式是粗放派:电热管 3–5 kW 把空气烧到六七十度,热风穿过滚筒卷走水分,湿空气直接排到户外——能量收进来又全扔出去,一度电只干一度电的活;热泵式是精算派:闭式循环里,蒸发器从排出的湿空气里吸热,把水汽冷凝成水收进水箱,冷凝器再把这份热外加上压缩机做功一并还给进风——能效比 3 左右意味着一度电搬走三度电的热,耗电只有通风式的三分之一到一半,而且 50 °C 低温烘干更护衣物纤维。滚筒里的机械设计同样有讲究:提升筋把衣物抬到顶部再跌落,让每片布料轮流暴露给热风;湿度传感器靠两枚电极测布料电导,干了自动停机;反向旋转能打散缠绕成团的床单;而绒毛过滤器是安全底线——细小纤维堵住风道、热量散不出去,是烘干机火灾的头号原因。冷凝水直接排进下水,所以热泵机连排气孔都不需要,塞进任何衣柜都能开张。拖「装载湿度」看含水率如何决定工时与耗电,拖「环境温度」看进风温度怎么改写热泵账本;按「通风式路线」看电表随湿气直排飞转,按「热泵式路线」看热量在回路里循环,按「能量对比」看两只电表的转速差,按「湿度控制」看传感器如何提前停机省电。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A clothes dryer is really a course in moving water: lift it out of the laundry into the air, then out of the house - and there are two routes with very different ledgers. The vented type is the spendthrift: a 3-5 kW heating element burns air to sixty or seventy degrees, the hot wind sweeps moisture out of the drum, and the damp air is dumped straight outdoors - energy comes in and all of it leaves, one kilowatt-hour buys one kilowatt-hour of work. The heat-pump type is the accountant: in a closed loop an evaporator pulls heat out of the exhaust air and condenses the water into a tank, then a condenser hands that heat - plus the compressor's work - back to the incoming air. A COP around 3 means one kilowatt-hour moves three out as heat, cutting power use to a third or a half, and 50 °C drying is kinder to fabric. Inside the drum the mechanics matter too: lifters carry clothes to the top and drop them, so every patch of fabric takes its turn in the hot wind; two electrodes read the conductivity of the cloth and stop the cycle when it is dry; reversing rotation keeps sheets from tangling; and the lint filter is the safety line - fine fibers clogging the duct are the number-one cause of dryer fires. Condensate drains on its own, so a heat-pump dryer needs no vent at all and runs inside any closet. Drag load dampness to see how water content sets the runtime and the bill, drag room temperature to see how intake temperature rewrites the heat-pump ledger; press vented route to watch the meter spin as moisture dumps outdoors, heat-pump route to watch heat recycle in the loop, energy compare to see the two meters race, moisture control to see the sensor stop early and save. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视烘干机:滚筒带提升筋旋转,衣物团轮流抬升跌落,青色湿气粒子从衣物蒸发;通风式路线电热丝红热、湿气顺风道直排「窗外」、电表飞转;热泵式路线蒸发器—压缩机—冷凝器回路里暖色粒子循环、冷凝水滴入水箱、电表慢转;绒毛过滤器逐渐堵塞并闪警告;双电表对比两条路线的耗电差距。

topics.descZh: 气雾罐能在任何角度喷出均匀的雾,靠的不是压缩空气,而是一锅「两相平衡」:罐里装着约九成有效成分液体和一成液化推进剂——丙烷、丁烷或二甲醚,1970 年代前的氟利昂已为臭氧层退役。密闭后部分推进剂气化,在液面上方建立蒸气压;关键是只要还剩一滴液化气,这个压强就只由温度决定——气液相平衡,不随罐子空了多少而变,所以第一喷和最后一喷同样有力。按下一体阀:阀杆下压打开通道,蒸气压把罐底液体沿浸没管顶上来,在喷嘴小孔处骤然降压,被高速气流剪切撕成微米级雾锥——压差越大,雾越细。安全账本有两页:20 °C 时罐内约 2–4 bar,扔进火里温度冲到 60 °C,饱和蒸气压翻倍,罐体爆破是真实的「爆米花」;液体烧完后罐里只剩蒸气,压强才随每一次喷发衰减——「罐子不响但喷不出东西」,说明只剩气了。压缩空气款是反面教材:没有液化气储备,压强随用随跌,最后一喷软得像叹气;而倒着喷时浸没管离开液面,出来的只有推进剂白雾——清洁电路板的「气吹」正是利用这一点。拖「罐体温度」看蒸气压如何随温度爬坡,拖「剩余液体量」看液面与喷次余额;按「按压喷雾」看阀杆开合与雾锥成形,按「温度与压强」看压强表跟着温度走,按「最后一喷」看液面见底后压强掉头,按「倒置喷气」看只有白雾没有液体。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
An aerosol can sprays an even mist at any angle not because it holds compressed air, but because it runs on a two-phase equilibrium: about ninety percent product liquid and ten percent liquefied propellant - propane, butane or DME; the Freon used before the 1970s retired for the ozone layer. Sealed, part of the propellant evaporates and builds vapor pressure over the liquid; the key is that while one drop of liquefied gas remains, that pressure depends only on temperature - vapor-liquid equilibrium - not on how empty the can is, so the first spray hits as hard as the last. Press the valve: the stem sinks and opens the passage, vapor pressure pushes liquid up the dip tube, and at the nozzle orifice the pressure drops suddenly - shear tears the liquid into a micron-scale cone of droplets; the bigger the pressure drop, the finer the mist. The safety ledger has two pages: at 20 °C the can holds about 2-4 bar; in a fire at 60 °C the saturated vapor pressure doubles and the can bursts like real popcorn. Once the liquid is gone only vapor remains and pressure finally decays with each spray - a silent can that sprays nothing is all gas. Compressed-air cans are the cautionary tale: no liquefied reserve, pressure sagging with every use, the last puff a sigh. Upside down, the dip tube leaves the liquid and only propellant mist comes out - the circuit-board air duster exploits exactly this. Drag can temperature to watch vapor pressure climb the saturation curve, drag remaining liquid to watch the level and the spray count; press press & spray to see the valve cycle and the cone form, temp vs pressure to see the gauge follow the temperature, the last spray to see pressure collapse on an empty can, spray inverted for white mist with no liquid. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视气雾罐:彩色液相随「剩余液体量」升降,雾状气相粒子在液面上方漂移,浸没管从阀直插罐底;按压时阀杆下压、液体沿管上行、喷嘴喷出橙色彩雾锥,倒置时换成白色推进剂雾;压强表指针与温度联动,60 °C 上下罐底闪出火焰与红色高温警告;「最后一喷」模式液面见底、压强衰减。

topics.descZh:
「声波牙刷」并不靠你听见的「声音」刷牙:人耳能听到的声音最高约 2 万赫兹,而它的刷杆以 200–400 赫兹高频往复摆动,折合每分钟约 24000–31000 次——「声波」只是营销给这段频率起的名字;真正干活的是一台磁悬浮摆动马达:主板输出交变电流,铜线圈产生交变磁场,推拉悬浮的永磁转子来回偏摆,再经一根柔性传动轴把摆动传给刷杆与刷毛,柔性轴同时隔断振动,握柄才不会发麻;设计的点睛之笔是共振:刷杆-刷头系统的固有频率被刻意调到驱动频率附近,同样大小的磁力,摆幅被放大数倍,达到 ±5–20°、刷毛尖端振幅约 1–3 毫米——共振是一根把小力放大成大摆的杠杆,频率一旦偏出共振区,摆幅立刻塌缩,这正是「驱动频率」滑杆要让你亲手感受的事;它的看家本领是流体清洁:刷毛高频摆动搅动唾液与牙膏液,产生湍流和微气泡,把液体泵进刷毛接触区以外约 3–4 毫米的缝隙——牙缝深处刷毛根本够不到的地方,靠流体剪切与气泡溃灭剥掉菌斑生物膜,这就是「不接触也能刷」;对照的旋转-振动式用圆形刷头约 8000 次/分旋转加 20000 次/分脉动,以机械摩擦为主;临床研究显示两类牙刷清除牙菌斑都显著优于手动,彼此差异却不大,胜负手在方法与时长:2 分钟、四个象限各 30 秒;过压是隐形杀手:牙龈被约 100–200 克的力压迫就会受伤,大力按压不仅磨出楔状缺损,还会把高频摆幅「压死」,反而更刷不净,所以较好的机型在约 300–500 克时就让提示灯变色、马达降扭;最后一笔行为学与工艺的账:2 分钟定时加每 30 秒换区提醒,针对的正是「多数人手动刷牙实际不到 45 秒」;锂电池与无线感应充电(磁耦合)意味着机身不开充电孔,防水靠超声波焊接壳体做到 IPX7,可以整机水洗。拖「驱动频率」扫过共振峰,拖「按压力度」压垮摆幅;按「共振摆动」看钟形共振峰,按「流体清洁」看缝隙里的流场,按「双通道对比」看机械与流体各自的边界,按「过压警告」看红区降扭。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
- 场景要点: 剖视牙刷平放:手柄里铜线圈推拉磁悬浮转子,经柔性轴带动刷杆与刷毛,正对一排放大牙齿与粉牙龈;共振模式下刷杆按设定频率正弦摆动,示波器画出摆幅-频率钟形共振峰,对准 260 赫兹时摆幅暴涨、青色流场粒子喷出、清洁半径圈扩大、偏离即塌缩;流体模式贴近牙缝看微气泡剥走黄菌斑;双通道模式左右对比纯机械摩擦与机械加流体;过压模式刷毛压扁、摆幅压死、压力计冲进红区、马达降扭、牙龈发红。
topics.descEn:
A 'sonic' toothbrush does not clean with sound you can hear: human hearing tops out near 20 kHz, while its brush rod swings back and forth at 200–400 Hz — roughly 24000–31000 strokes per minute; 'sonic' is just the marketing name for that band. The real workhorse is a magnetically levitated swing motor: the control board feeds alternating current into a copper coil, the alternating magnetic field pushes and pulls a levitated permanent-magnet rotor, and a flexible drive shaft carries the swing on to the rod and bristles while blocking vibration, so the grip does not buzz in your hand. The masterstroke is resonance: the rod-head system is deliberately tuned so its natural frequency sits near the drive frequency, and the same magnetic force now swings several times wider — ±5–20°, about 1–3 mm at the bristle tips. Resonance is a lever that turns a small force into a big swing; slide off resonance and the amplitude collapses at once — exactly what the frequency slider lets you feel. The signature skill is fluid cleaning: high-frequency bristle swing stirs saliva and toothpaste into turbulence and micro bubbles, pumping liquid into gaps 3–4 mm beyond where the bristles touch — deep interdental places no bristle reaches — where fluid shear and collapsing bubbles strip the plaque biofilm away: brushing without contact. The rival orbital type spins a round head about 8000 times a minute plus 20000 pulsations a minute, relying mostly on mechanical friction; clinical studies show both types remove plaque significantly better than manual brushing, with little difference between them — technique and the clock decide: 2 minutes, four quadrants, 30 seconds each. Overpressure is the hidden hazard: about 100–200 g is enough to injure the gum line, and pressing hard not only wears wedge-shaped defects into enamel but also crushes the high-frequency swing, cleaning worse — so better models sense about 300–500 g, change the warning light and cut motor torque. Finally the behavioral and engineering bill: a 2-minute timer with 30-second quadrant prompts answers the fact that most people brush manually for under 45 seconds; a lithium cell with wireless inductive charging (magnetic coupling) means no charging port, so IPX7 waterproofing comes from ultrasonically welded shells and the whole brush can be rinsed under the tap. Drag drive frequency to sweep across the resonance peak, drag press force to crush the swing; press resonance swing for the bell-shaped peak, fluid cleaning for the flow field in the gaps, dual channel for the boundary between mechanics and fluid, overpressure for the red zone and torque cut. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视牙刷平放:手柄里铜线圈推拉磁悬浮转子,经柔性轴带动刷杆与刷毛,正对一排放大牙齿与粉牙龈;共振模式下刷杆按设定频率正弦摆动,示波器画出摆幅-频率钟形共振峰,对准 260 赫兹时摆幅暴涨、青色流场粒子喷出、清洁半径圈扩大、偏离即塌缩;流体模式贴近牙缝看微气泡剥走黄菌斑;双通道模式左右对比纯机械摩擦与机械加流体;过压模式刷毛压扁、摆幅压死、压力计冲进红区、马达降扭、牙龈发红。

topics.descZh: 银行点钞机哗哗过钞的每一秒,机器已经给每张钞票考了四场物理:钞票以 0.5–1.5 m/s 穿过检测通道,传感器每秒采集几百行数据,荧光、磁性、红外、光学几何几种效应同时打分,任何一项不过关,电机立刻停机反转、报警吐钞——验钞机的本质,是一条多传感器融合的传送带安检线。第一关紫外:真钞用棉短绒掺木浆抄造,不含荧光增白剂,365 nm 紫外灯下整张暗沉;办公纸为显白普遍加了增白剂,紫外下发亮蓝白光,荧光强度是第一道粗筛;真钞还藏着无色荧光面额数字与随机荧光纤维,靠斯托克斯位移发光:吸收 365 nm、发射 420–450 nm 蓝光。第二关磁性:部分油墨掺氧化铁微粉,技术源自支票 MICR 磁码,人像与冠字号码局部带磁,磁头阵列按位置记录磁通变化再与模板比对——这一关看的不是「有没有磁」,而是「哪一段有磁」。第三关红外:不同油墨对 850–950 nm 近红外吸收不同,真钞人像边缘与面额区在红外图像里「消失」,高仿币最常栽在这里。第四关光学几何:透射光照出水印的厚薄浮雕,安全线、对印、光变油墨逐一核对,对辊测厚(纸厚约 0.1 mm)专抓洗改面额。四路分数加权成置信度,阈值在拒真与纳假之间谈判:GB 16999-2010 要求 A 类机检出率不低于 95%,而误报主因恰是磨损旧钞。这还是一场军备竞赛:雕版高仿逼近印制工艺,真钞用动感光变镂空安全线反击——伪钞追一种效应,真钞就加一种。拖「传送速度」看采样与误报的矛盾,拖「伪钞仿真度」看它能骗过几关;按「荧光关」「红外·水印」「高仿挑战」看各道关卡如何排雷。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
Every second a banknote machine rattles through a stack, it puts each note through four physics exams: the note crosses the sensing channel at 0.5-1.5 m/s, sensors capture hundreds of data rows per second, and fluorescence, magnetism, infrared and optical geometry all score it at once - fail any one and the motor stops, reverses and spits the note out with an alarm.
