A validator is at heart a conveyor-belt security line built on sensor fusion. Gate one, ultraviolet: genuine paper is cotton linter and wood pulp with no optical brightener, staying dark under a 365 nm lamp, while office paper loaded with brightener glows blue-white - fluorescence is the cheapest first screen; genuine notes also hide colorless fluorescent digits and random fibers that glow by the Stokes shift, absorbing 365 nm and emitting 420-450 nm blue. Gate two, magnetism: part of the ink carries iron-oxide micropowder, a craft inherited from cheque MICR coding - the portrait and serial areas are magnetic, and head arrays log flux by position against a template; what counts is not whether there is magnetism but where it sits. Gate three, infrared: inks absorb 850-950 nm near-IR differently, so the portrait edges and denomination areas of a genuine note vanish in the IR image - where most high-grade fakes trip. Gate four, optics and geometry: transmitted light images the watermark relief, security thread, see-through prints and color-shift ink are checked, and a roller pair gauges a 0.1 mm thickness profile to catch washed denominations. Scores fuse into a confidence level whose threshold negotiates between rejecting genuine worn notes and accepting fakes - GB 16999-2010 requires a Class A machine to detect at least 95 percent, while worn old cash drives most false alarms. And it is an arms race: engraved counterfeits close in on printing craft, genuine notes answer with motion color-change windowed threads - fakes chase one effect, genuine notes add another. Drag belt speed to see sampling versus false rejects, drag fake fidelity to see how many gates it can fool; press UV gate, IR and watermark, counterfeit challenge to watch each line of defense. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视验钞机通道:捻钞轮把纸币送入,对辊先测厚度;通道顶自左向右排着紫外 LED 排、光学行扫与红外 LED 排,底部是磁头阵列与传送带,放大版纸币沿通道飞行逐关受检。荧光关紫外灯亮紫光,假纸整张泛蓝白、真钞只点亮荧光「100」与红蓝纤维;磁性关磁头上方同步画出磁通波形,无磁伪钞波形平坦;红外·水印模式透射光让水印浮雕显现、特定图案在红外图像里隐身;高仿挑战中高仿币连过三关,在红外关置信度跌穿红线,报警停机、吐钞退回。

topics.descZh: VR 头显要在两块离眼睛只有 3–5 cm 的小屏幕上,骗过一整套为真实世界进化出来的感知系统,这笔账要一笔一笔算。立体账:两块屏给左右眼各喂一张微小视差的图,视差角 θ≈B/z,瞳距 B 约 63 mm,渲染引擎为每只眼各算一个偏移视锥,大脑自动把两幅图融成立体深度;光学账:3–5 cm 远小于人眼约 10 cm 的近点,裸眼根本对不上焦,大孔径透镜把虚像推到 1.3 m 至无穷远的「舒适距离」,菲涅尔透镜用环形刻槽、pancake 折叠光路用半反半透镜来回反射,把厚透镜压薄,透镜带来的枕形畸变靠渲染时预弯反向的桶形畸变抵消,边缘色散再由出厂校准补偿;延迟账:从头动到画面响应的 motion-to-photon 必须小于 20 ms,否则前庭系统察觉「人在动、画面没动」,晕动症立刻上门——链条是 IMU 以 1000–4000 Hz 采样、姿态预测打底、GPU 在 90 Hz 的 11.1 ms 帧预算内画完、异步时间扭曲在最后一刻按最新 IMU 重投影兜底,再交显示扫描出手;低余晖显示让每帧只亮 1–2 ms,转头时视网膜上不留拖影,代价是亮度;舒适账:聚散调节冲突——眼外肌把两眼对齐到 0.5 m 的虚拟物体,晶状体却仍锁定 1.3 m 的虚像,两者长期打架是眼疲劳与部分人眩晕的来源;最后是省钱账:inside-out 多相机 SLAM 以毫米级精度实时解算头显 6DoF 位姿,手柄靠红外 LED 点阵或电磁定位,注视点渲染顺着人眼「中央清晰、周边模糊」的脾气只把注视区画到全清,省下 30–50% 像素。拖「视差深度」推物体远近,拖「动显延迟」亲手把画面拖晕;按「双目视差」「畸变矫正」「延迟与低余晖」逐项验收,按「眩晕账本」看冲突叠加爆表。3D 交互演示 · 鼠标拖动旋转 / 滚轮缩放 · 空格播放/暂停
topics.descEn:
A VR headset has to fool, with two small screens sitting just 3-5 cm from the eyes, a perceptual system evolved for the real world, and it pays four bills to do it. Stereo: each eye gets its own image with a tiny parallax, parallax angle of about B/z with an interpupillary distance B near 63 mm, and the engine renders every frame twice through two offset frusta - the brain fuses the pair into depth. Optics: 3-5 cm is far inside the eye's roughly 10 cm near point, so focus is impossible bare-eyed; a large-aperture lens pushes the virtual image out to a comfortable 1.3 m or beyond, Fresnel annular grooves or a pancake folded path of partial mirrors make the thick lens thin, the lens pincushion distortion is cancelled by pre-bending the frame with the opposite barrel warp, and edge color fringing is calibrated away. Latency: motion-to-photon must stay under 20 ms, or the vestibular system notices that the body turned but the world did not, and motion sickness arrives - the chain runs IMU sampling at 1000-4000 Hz, pose prediction, a GPU frame inside the 11.1 ms budget at 90 Hz, then asynchronous timewarp reprojecting with the latest IMU at the last instant before display scanout; low persistence lights each frame for only 1-2 ms so head turns leave no smear on the retina, traded for brightness. Comfort: the vergence-accommodation conflict - the eye muscles aim both eyes at a 0.5 m virtual object while the lens stays focused at the 1.3 m image - quietly tires eyes and nauseates some people. And the thrift bill: inside-out multi-camera SLAM solves the 6DoF pose in real time to millimeter precision, controllers follow via infrared LED constellations, and foveated rendering exploits the eye sharp-center blurry-periphery nature to render only the gaze region in full detail, saving 30-50 percent of pixels. Drag parallax depth to push objects near and far, drag latency to break the illusion yourself; press the preset buttons to audit each bill, and the discomfort ledger to watch them stack. 3D interactive demo - drag to orbit / scroll to zoom - Space = play/pause
- 场景要点: 剖视头显内左右屏发出红、青两色视差图,经带环形刻槽的菲涅尔透镜汇入眼杯;两眼视线沿深度标尺在虚拟物体处相交,滑杆推着物体在 0.3–10 m 间滑行;畸变模式里屏幕预弯网格与透镜枕形相互抵消;延迟模式里头显横摇,虚像平面滞后拖影,延迟降到 20 ms 内拖影消失;眩晕账本里物体拉近,视网膜上焦外模糊圆涨大,眩晕指数飙升并列出工程解法。
